English: Join us to experience Kuwaiti culture and engage with a vibrant community blending Middle Eastern traditions and international education practices.
Kiswahili: Jiunge nasi kutambua utamaduni wa Kuweit na kuungana na jamii yenye nguvu inayochanganya tamaduni za Kati ya Mashariki na taratibu za elimu za kimataifa.
Ekegusii: Nakiere hamwe nige wakiire omokirori gw’Abakuwait na wakiire naki omogende bw’akiari bwotukore buseke styard.
Dholuo: Ijoino konyo joma kuom Kuwaiti, kendo yieny joma ma oket e bunde maber mar buo mondo kinyal buo gi kaka ma joma manyien.
Somali: Nagala soo biir si aad u tijaabiso dhaqanka Kuwaiti iyo inaad la falgasho bulsho firfircoon oo is dhexgalaysa dhaqamada Bariga Dhexe iyo dhaqamada waxbarasho caalami ah.

English: The Government is ensuring that teacher training aligns with the new Competency-Based Education system. Graduates from Moi Teachers Training College are now ready to support this initiative.
Kiswahili: Serikali inaweka hakikisho kwamba mafunzo ya walimu yanakidhi mfumo mpya wa Elimu Kulingana na Ufanisi. Wahitimu wa Chuo cha Mafunzo ya Walimu cha Moi sasa wapo tayari kusaidia mpango huu.
Ekegusii: Abantu baki bateganire omogori bwire buya bwaki buya buero bwesigana na sistema ya Chikoro chire Chigere. Abakire b'ekorokokire ya Moi Teachers Training College naki bateganire kuchengere buya buya.
Dholuo: Chandruok gi chike duto aneto ni tich-re omer kamano ni wigi chike ma oyudo nigi. Nind gi chike ma Moi Teachers Training College oanyalo konyo nawineno.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay hubinaysaa in tababarka macalimiinta uu la jaanqaado nidaamka waxbarashada ee ku saleysan kartida. Qalinjabiyayaasha Kaallinta Tababarka Macalimiinta Moi waxay hadda diyaar u yihiin inay taageeraan hindisahan.

English: The Wajir government is investing in education to improve school infrastructure. Residents are encouraged to engage with education officials for benefits in this initiative.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Wajir inwekeza katika elimu kuboresha miundombinu ya shule. Wananchi wanahimizwa kushirikiana na maafisa wa elimu ili kunufaika na mpango huu.
Ekegusii: Omoji wa Wajir atekerere bwakire mwaki omong’era bwaki bwaki. Abaki ba Wajir naki abaki batoro nyang’ani baria bategere kyekiriiro.
Dholuo: Ruoth Wajir en gi timo ma ticho e nyimok madhi te gima no ni gany mo golo. Jowanjal wawe gi kiyogo kuom magi tich kendo ng'eyo nyaka chalo e dhokni.
Somali: Dowladda Wajir waxay maalgelinaysaa waxbarashada si ay u hagaajiso kaabayaasha dugsiyada. Dadweynaha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay la xiriiraan mas'uuliyiinta waxbarashada si ay u helaan faa'iidooyinka mashruucan.

English: The Kenya Primary Education Equity in Learning (KPEEL) and Kenya Secondary Education Equity and Quality Improvement Programme (SEEQIP) are actively improving access and quality in education.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Usawa wa Elimu ya Msingi Kenya (KPEEL) na Mpango wa Kuboresha Usawa na Ubora wa Elimu ya Sekondari Kenya (SEEQIP) wanafanya kazi kuboresha upatikanaji na ubora katika elimu.
Ekegusii: Omoigoti bwa Kenya Primary Education Equity in Learning (KPEEL) na Kenya Secondary Education Equity and Quality Improvement Programme (SEEQIP) nakiere buya bosibori bwenge na buya bwokire orekeni.
Dholuo: Kenya Primary Education Equity in Learning (KPEEL) kod Kenya Secondary Education Equity and Quality Improvement Programme (SEEQIP) ne okonyo ng'ato kendo nyaka kwa ochieng’ kod piny kendo nyaka nyis in dala.
Somali: Barnaamijka Cadaaladda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah ee Kenya (KPEEL) iyo Barnaamijka Hagaajinta Tayada iyo Cadaaladda Waxbarashada Dugsiga Sare ee Kenya (SEEQIP) waxay si firfircoon u wanaajinayaan helitaanka iyo tayada waxbarashada.

English: Celebrate educational excellence! Congratulations to all prize recipients at Maryhill High School. Keep striving for success, students!
Kiswahili: Sherehekea ubora wa elimu! Hongera kwa wapokeaji wote wa tuzo katika Shule ya Sekondari ya Maryhill. Endeleeni kutumia juhudi kufikia mafanikio, wanafunzi!
Ekegusii: Igenge obwakire bw’achie! Naki ogendete buya buje bosi buya bwakire banachiemi bosi bakore Maryhill High School. Kosibori omokirigani, abere!
Dholuo: Ning’eyo ging’ lari! Nakiya kuom yogo nyingi matindo gi Maryhill High School. Ranyisou chako, masom!
Somali: U dabaaldeg tayada waxbarashada! Hambalyo dhammaan dadka ku guuleystay abaalmarinta ee Dugsiga Sare ee Maryhill. Sii wad dadaalkaaga guusha, ardayda!

English: The Kenya Institute of Special Education is constructing an assistive device factory to support special needs learners. Facilities will improve access to quality education for all learners.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Kenya ya Elimu ya Walemavu inajenga kiwanda cha vifaa vya msaada ili kusaidia wanafunzi wenye mahitaji maalum. Miundombinu itaboresha upatikanaji wa elimu bora kwa wanafunzi wote.
Ekegusii: Ishule ya Kenya ya Ekerenda ya Koshore ikirende chimoti chaki kurerera abaki batariani. Bwakire bwai rianirie buya buigira buya busebu.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Special Education owinjo fabrika mar assistive device piny kuom okonyo mawuon gi jieli maber. Kanyira ng’ato nyalo golo kanyo kod buo mar edu shir.
Somali: Hay'adda Kenya ee Waxbarashada Gaar ah waxay dhiseysaa warshad qalab taageero ah si ay u caawiso ardayda leh baahiyo khaas ah. Goobahan ayaa kor u qaadi doona helitaanka waxbarasho tayo leh oo dhammaan ardayda.

English: Newly recruited Quality Assurance and Standards Officers (QASOs) are now being oriented at the Kenya Institute for Curriculum Development (KICD).
Kiswahili: Maafisa wapya wa Uhakiki wa Ubora na Viwango (QASOs) sasa wanapatiwa maelekezo katika Taasisi ya Kenya ya Utengenezaji wa Mtaala (KICD).
Ekegusii: Abakire abakiri bano chireku banye buya bwa Quality Assurance and Standards Officers (QASOs) bari mokwaki ora ka Kenya Institute for Curriculum Development (KICD).
Dholuo: Joknyakore omiya gi Quality Assurance and Standards (QASOs) nyaka ogendni e Kenya Institute for Curriculum Development (KICD).
Somali: Shaqaalaha cusub ee loogu talagalay Kormeerka Tayada iyo Heerarka (QASOs) ayaa hada lagu baranayaa Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka (KICD).

English: The Ministry of Education, in partnership with WFP, provides mid-day meals to public primary school children in Arid and Semi-Arid regions. Enroll your children to benefit from this nutrition program.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu, kwa kushirikiana na WFP, inatoa chakula cha mchana kwa watoto wa shule za msingi za umma katika maeneo ya Jangwa na Nusu Jangwa. Wajiandikishe watoto wenu ili waweze kunufaika na mpango huu wa lishe.
Ekegusii: Obwaki bw'Esoma, bw'ekenyang'iana na WFP, buyaire buya bosi bwi naki buya na buya buya buya buya gose buya naki bw'oseku bw'iki. Johana araka naki genda iria jendo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education, kendo gi WFP, okel mid-day meals ma okonyo mar wadugu ondiek e public primary schools e namba gi Semi-Arid. Jotegno chol gi kanyalo utho e yo piny gi joma owach.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, oo wada shaqaynaya WFP, waxay cuntooyinka qado u fidisaa caruurta dugsiyada hoose ee dowladda ku yaal Soomaaliya iyo gobollada kaarika. Diiwaangeli caruurtaada si ay uga faa'iideystaan barnaamijkan nafaqada.

English: KCSE and KJSEA exam papers have been officially opened and are ready for distribution to schools.
Kiswahili: Karatasi za mtihani wa KCSE na KJSEA zimefunguliwa rasmi na ziko tayari kufikishwa kwenye shule.
Ekegusii: Egesia ya KCSE na KJSEA emosi omokibori buya na ekenye ore kirera okugana bwakire buseke.
Dholuo: KCSE na KJSEA ka gika gi tichni to gi beri kuom kendo ne okonyo nyasaye kuoch.
Somali: Warqadaha imtixaanka KCSE iyo KJSEA ayaa si rasmi ah loo furay waxaana diyaar u ah in lagu qaybiyo iskuulada.

English: Over 10,000 laptops and smart boards are being distributed to junior schools across all 47 counties. Schools in Nyandarua Sub-County will receive these digital learning devices.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya laptop 10,000 na mabodi ya smart yatagawanywa kwa shule za msingi katika kaunti zote 47. Shule za Nyandarua Sub-County zitapata vifaa hivi vya kujifunzia kidigitali.
Ekegusii: Eka 10,000 emaboko na boti za smart boradi zigebwaki kumakere eria ja junior mu naki 47. Masige ma Nyandarua Sub-County naki oria bahetani ema ibarori.
Dholuo: Dhi nyaka 10,000 laptops naki smart boards duto, dongo ka gidhi nyisore gi junior schools maduong' 47 counties. Shule nikech Nyandarua Sub-County en buo gi teki dhok e yo odhiambo.
Somali: In ka badan 10,000 laptop iyo saacado cajiib ah ayaa la qeybinayaa dugsiyada hoose ee ka jira 47-ka dowlad-goboleed. Dugsiyada ku yaal Nyandarua Sub-County ayaa helaya aaladahaan waxbarashada dijital ah.

English: Schools will not have an early midterm break despite recent unrest. Principals are urged to manage student anxieties flexibly, particularly regarding examinations.
Kiswahili: Shule hazitakuwa na mapumziko ya kati ya muhula mapema licha ya machafuko ya hivi karibuni. Wakuu wa shule wanahimizwa kusimamia wasiwasi wa wanafunzi kwa njia rahisi, hasa kuhusu mtihani.
Ekegusii: Masomo naki gísure bwakire bwaki mwaki omogoba. Abanya masomo batarerwe buya bwere bori naki baki obwaki bwaki batarera, nyasa buya bwenyaki bwaki oriegeri.
Dholuo: Masomo ok nyal havingo gi midterm break monyalo noso. Principals bedo kanyakore gi anjiru ma ok nyal ng'eyo, joma ok nyal rabuoro e tekwono.
Somali: Dugsiyada ma laha fasax horudhac ah, inkastoo rabshadihii dhawaan jiray. Dugsiyooyinka waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay si dabacsan u maareeyaan niyadda ardayda, gaar ahaan marka laga hadlayo imtixaannada.

English: The 3rd Annual Educational Assessment Symposium is underway at New Mitihani House, focusing on curriculum and assessment. All educators are encouraged to participate for innovative learning discussions.
Kiswahili: Simpozi ya Tathmini ya Elimu ya Mwaka wa Tatu inaendelea katika Nyumba ya New Mitihani, ikijikita katika mtaala na tathmini. Walimu wote wanakumbushwa kushiriki katika majadiliano ya kujifunza kwa ubunifu.
Ekegusii: Symposium ya 3rd Annual Educational Assessment ikoraganje ku New Mitihani House, ikigana ku masomo nakiwandiko. Abana nakiire bongeka kukiriga bakanegere getachane bizururano bwakoriana.
Dholuo: Symposium mar 3rd makongo mag jomokoro mar elimu nochopo e New Mitihani House, ohingo kuom joma chako gi test. Jomokoro manok nyise ka orwako e yath madhi mag joma nyalawa.
Somali: Shirka 3aad ee Sanadlaha ah ee Qiimeynta Waxbarashada ayaa socota xarunta New Mitihani House, iyadoo diiradda la saarayo manhajka iyo qiimeynta. Dhamaan macalimiinta waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan doodaha waxbarasho ee hal-abuurka leh.

English: KCSE 2025 results have been released. Students can access their results through the KNEC website.
Kiswahili: Matokeo ya KCSE 2025 yameachiliwa. Wanafunzi wanaweza kupata matokeo yao kupitia tovuti ya KNEC.
Ekegusii: Abantu barimanye bwakirori bwa KCSE 2025. Abanyeshule barikwanirira kubakire bwakirori bwabo kwang'ana KNEC website.
Dholuo: KCSE 2025 waki e yo. Duong' gi nyaka en konyi malong' e KNEC website.
Somali: Natiijada KCSE 2025 waa la soo saaray. Ardaydu waxay ka heli karaan natiijooyinkooda bogga KNEC.

English: Kimana Girls in Kajiado County now has an 800-seat multi-purpose hall, new classrooms, a school bakery, and cabro-paving. Students and parents can access these new facilities starting today.
Kiswahili: Wasichana wa Kimana katika Kaunti ya Kajiado sasa wana jengo la malengo mengi lenye viti 800, madarasa mapya, tanuri ya shule, na kupigwa kwa zege la cabro. Wanafunzi na wazazi wanaweza kutumia vitu hivi vipya kuanzia leo.
Ekegusii: Kimana Girls e Kajiado County itenana oria 800 yegira, ekiyaki naki yegira, ekibakery isikwana, na cabro-paving. Bakirita naki abogo bakanisibori oria egiireri oria naki omoka.
Dholuo: Kimana Girls ku Kajiado County nyaka ochung' guyo 800, ma ok tendo mar joma nyaka chako, nyaka dala, n'enjinga mar sukulu, kod cabro-paving. Jodong' kata joma ni koyo kod nyaka duto ka nyaka ibiro nyaka chiep kendo tinde chogo.
Somali: Kimana Gashaan Kajiado County hadda waxay leedahay hool badan oo fadhiyo 800, fasallo cusub, foorno iskuulka, iyo waddooyin cabro ah. Ardayda iyo waalidiinta waxay ka faa’iideysan karaan xarumahan cusub laga bilaabo maanta.

English: A new multi-storey academic block has been commissioned at Kenya Coast National Polytechnic to enhance training. Students can now access modern facilities for Competency-Based Education and Training.
Kiswahili: Jengo jipya la kitaaluma la ghorofa nyingi limezinduliwa katika Kenya Coast National Polytechnic ili kuboresha mafunzo. Wanafunzi sasa wanaweza kufikia vifaa vya kisasa kwa ajili ya Elimu na Mafunzo Yanayolenga Ufanisi.
Ekegusii: Ekegusii agokire buya buya bw'ekarati bw'ekare biragoria e Kenya Coast National Polytechnic buya bw'ogokira buya. Abana bakienda bweta buya bw'amakamati bw'ogotegoria ogokiri.
Dholuo: Wang'ni kamano nyaka tijruwore mar mobil ng'ato g'otieko e Kenya Coast National Polytechnic kuom ng'ato mar tich. Aburu mag tich nigi mano ochung' nyaka ng'ato kendo chalo piny e tich mag mbin.
Somali: Dhisme cusub oo badan dabaqyo ah ayaa laga furaay Soomaaliya Coast National Polytechnic si kor loogu qaado tababarka. Ardaydu hadda waxay heli karaan xarumo casri ah oo loogu talagalay Waxbarashada iyo Tababarka ku Saleysan Awoodda.

English: Umma University has inaugurated the Dr. Abdulrahman Al-Sumait Complex, a 10-storey facility for 10,000 students, enhancing access to education.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Umma kimezindua Jengo la Dr. Abdulrahman Al-Sumait, la ghorofa 10 lenye uwezo wa wanafunzi 10,000, kuboresha upatikanaji wa elimu.
Ekegusii: Umma University omokirire oboragani bwa Dr. Abdulrahman Al-Sumait, obokiri bw’amasomo obwakorete buria 10, buya 10,000 baana, bokiranga buya bunyasa bw’amasomo.
Dholuo: Umma University onyalo jorwako Dr. Abdulrahman Al-Sumait Complex, nyumba mar 10, nyaka golo 10,000, nyalo yore piny kuom chik.
Somali: Jaamacadda Umma waxay furtay Xarunta Dr. Abdulrahman Al-Sumait, oo ah dhisme 10 dabaq ah oo loogu talagalay 10,000 arday, taasi oo korodhsanaysa fursadaha waxbarasho.

English: The Signet Institute of Australia office is now open at Kabete National Polytechnic for students and stakeholders in TVET.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Taasisi ya Signet ya Australia sasa imefunguliwa katika Polytechnic ya Kitaifa ya Kabete kwa wanafunzi na wadau katika TVET.
Ekegusii: Bwakirori bu Signet Institute of Australia buya buhashi na Kabete National Polytechnic buya bwanaki bosi na bwakira bwi TVET.
Dholuo: Ofisi ma Signet Institute of Australia yi jacha kuom Kabete National Polytechnic mokuongo kuom student gi stakeholders e TVET.
Somali: Xarunta Signet Institute of Australia ayaa hadda furan oo ku taalla Kabete National Polytechnic ee ardayda iyo daneeyayaasha TVET.

English: The Ministry of Education is committed to collaborating with school administrators to address challenges in learning; all heads of institutions are encouraged to engage and support ongoing improvements.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu ina dhamira ya kushirikiana na wasimamizi wa shule kutatua changamoto katika kujifunza; wakuu wa taasisi wote wanahimizwa kuhusika na kusaidia maboresho yanayoendelea.
Ekegusii: Minisompia ya Ekegusii ikoragania na abwere buya bwakiruga buya nyakiere buya buero; abere b’iebwi b’amasomo nakiya kuganya na buya bwakuruma buya bwokiracho.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education niya okonyo kuom gi diko ma okwayi e ng'ato makelo to orem joma okel ki joma chike; wote konyruokni ne nyal komoyo kendo ng'eyo dhih ohinga.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ka go'an tahay inay la shaqeyso maamulka dugsiyada si ay uga jawaabaan caqabadaha waxbarashada; dhammaan madaxda hay'adaha waxa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan oo taageeraan horumarka socda.

English: Bomet University College has been conferred a Charter, enhancing access to quality higher education in Kenya.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Bomet kimepewa Hati ya Usajili, ikilenga kuboresha upatikanaji wa elimu ya juu bora nchini Kenya.
Ekegusii: Bomet University College ekorirete omogaka, eng'ereirie obiasire bw'oki bw'egesere oria kera omoka kwa Kenya.
Dholuo: Bomet University College yong' bende charita, nopon gi wanga kuom jombo ma okel joruok e Kenya.
Somali: Jaamacadda Bomet College ayaa lagu daweeyay Shahaaddo, taasoo kor u qaadaysa helitaanka waxbarashada sare ee tayada leh ee Kenya.

English: The 2025 KCSE results have been released. Students can access their results through the official education website.
Kiswahili: Matokeo ya KCSE ya mwaka 2025 yameachiliwa. Wanafunzi wanaweza kupata matokeo yao kupitia tovuti rasmi ya elimu.
Ekegusii: Ebwaki bwakire 2025 buseku bwasangire. Abakere batikire buseku bwabo kubwaki bweganda bwokirigana.
Dholuo: 2025 KCSE result yien nende. Wana ziarore in gi kamano oting'o e kanyango kod piya mar thum.
Somali: Natiijada KCSE ee 2025 ayaa la sii daayay. Ardaydu waxay ka heli karaan natiijooyinkooda bogga rasmiga ah ee waxbarashada.

English: New facilities, including seven smart classrooms and a renovated computer lab, have been launched at Kimana Girls School. Students are encouraged to utilize these improvements for enhanced learning.
Kiswahili: Vituo vipya, ikihusisha madarasa saba ya kisasa na maabara ya kompyuta iliyokarabatiwa, vimeanzishwa katika Shule ya Wasichana Kimana. Wanafunzi wanahimizwa kutumia maboresho haya kwa ajili ya kujifunza bora.
Ekegusii: Ekiro enye, ekiruta ekenyi, omogondo atano ogenda na ibundori ikwenda, baragirira ku Kimana Girls School. Abagire batarora batarorera kumirika ebisimu ki ogenda omose omogendo.
Dholuo: Dhi nyasa, kendo ng'ato mar kanyakla, ne itiyo e Kimana Girls School. Wana ni nigi okaw kanyakla maniegi mondo wach modhiambo.
Somali: Fasallo cusub, oo ay ku jiraan todoba fasal oo casri ah iyo lab kompuyuutar oo dib loo renovate-gareeyay, ayaa laga furay Dugsiga Gabdhaha Kimana. Ardayda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka faa'iideystaan horumaradan si kor loogu qaado waxbarashadooda.

English: The Ministry of Education supports the promotion of indigenous languages and literacy across Kenya. Schools and communities are encouraged to participate in local literacy initiatives.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inasaidia kukuza lugha za asili na uandishi kote Kenya. Shule na jamii zinahimizwa kushiriki katika mipango ya uandishi wa ndani.
Ekegusii: Osomeka Bwaki bw'Eng'eno obwakire omogusii na omokiragano mu naki. Masomo na omogusi bakenyekerebwe oria bw'egeno buria bw'oguteberekera.
Dholuo: Ministri wa Elimu yiyo nyiso kuom golo lwakni gi jomoko kendo yo joma ne dhi ng'wat. Sukoge kod dhoho gi nyaka togi e golo lwakni marok.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay taageertaa kor u qaadida luqadaha dhaqanka iyo akhriska guud ahaan Kenya. Dugsiyada iyo bulshooyinka waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan hindidaan akhriska ee maxalliga ah.

English: The proposed Nyamira University College is under establishment, with Kisii University as the mentor institution. Further details will be announced soon.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Nyamira kinapangwa kuanzishwa, huku Chuo Kikuu cha Kisii kama taasisi msaidizi. Maelezo zaidi yataripotiwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Ikirondo kya Nyamira University College kirikuria, na Kisii University nikikango cha okuigi. Amaka marekire okore na mwaki.
Dholuo: Nyamira University College owinjore, ka Kisii University no ng'wonj lag'ano. Nying' gigo nodhi nyaka weche kendo.
Somali: Jaamacadda Nyamira ee la soo jeediyay ayaa la dhisayaa, iyadoo Jaamacadda Kisii tahay hay'adda hagta. Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ayaa la soo bandhgyn doonaa dhawaan.

English: The Government will conduct a census of Technical and Vocational Education Training (TVET) institutions across all 47 counties. Cooperation from institutions is essential for accurate data collection.
Kiswahili: Serikali itafanya sensa ya Taasisi za Elimu ya Ufundi na Mafunzo ya Ufundi (TVET) katika kaunti zote 47. Ushirikiano kutoka kwa taasisi ni muhimu kwa ukusanyaji sahihi wa takwimu.
Ekegusii: Abakireri ba Osongo banochere obwaki bwaki bwaki bwomokiri bwamwaki na Obwere bwabere bwa Technical and Vocational Education Training (TVET) bwere bwomokirabaki busebenze bwana 47. Obwakireri buhaki bworokie busebenze bwere bwokiri bwaki busebenze.
Dholuo: Government noling' ni census efweny kenda gi Technical and Vocational Education Training (TVET) institutions nyaka all 47 counties. Cooperation gi institutions ni konyo chalo mar data mach.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay qaban doontaa tirakoobka hay'adaha Waxbarashada Farsamada iyo Xirfadaha (TVET) guud ahaan 47-ka gobal. Wada-shaqeyntu waa muhiim si loo helo xog sax ah.

English: Applications for the Full-Time Special Needs Education Diploma Course at the Kenya Institute of Special Education are now open. Download the application form [here](https://www.kise.ac.ke/sites/default/files/KISE%20DIP%20APPLICATION%20_0.pdf).
Kiswahili: Maombi ya kozi ya diploma ya elimu maalum ya mahitaji maalum ya muda wote kwenye Taasisi ya Elimu Maalum ya Kenya yanafunguliwa sasa. Pakua fomu ya maombi [hapa](https://www.kise.ac.ke/sites/default/files/KISE%20DIP%20APPLICATION%20_0.pdf).
Ekegusii: Emotukire buya oria bw'ano kw'orogori buya amakiria matarego b'obuchinga buya ku Kenya Institute of Special Education ichire. Chibwanirire fomori ya orogori [naki](https://www.kise.ac.ke/sites/default/files/KISE%20DIP%20APPLICATION%20_0.pdf).
Dholuo: Kisomo kanyimorogore ma nyisiyo kanyimorogore mwakwanja pure plarua "Full-Time Special Needs Education Diploma Course" ku Kenya Institute of Special Education manokonyo. Wacho kamano kanyimorogore [ng'ato](https://www.kise.ac.ke/sites/default/files/KISE%20DIP%20APPLICATION%20_0.pdf).
Somali: Codsiyada loogu talagalay Koorso Diploma ah oo dhameystiran oo ku saabsan Waxbarashada Baahiyaha Gaarka ah ee Machadka Kenya ee Waxbarashada Baahiyaha Gaarka ah ayaa hadda furan. Fadlan soo dejiso foomka codsiga [halkan](https://www.kise.ac.ke/sites/default/files/KISE%20DIP%20APPLICATION%20_0.pdf).

English: The education sector is currently undergoing discussions on funding; stay tuned for updates that may affect educational resources and support.
Kiswahili: Sekta ya elimu hivi sasa inajadili masuala ya ufadhili; subiri taarifa zitakazoweza kuathiri rasilimali za elimu na msaada.
Ekegusii: Ekiogo chireta naki naki oria yakirire omokiri bwakire; muiga bwakire buya okire buya buya bwakire busoka na buya bwaki.
Dholuo: Biro chike mag edudzi olok konyo kuom funding; chako gweng' kuom ndalo mang'wonni mane en kanyango kod chunyi.
Somali: Waqtigaan waxbarashada waxaa ka soconaya wadahadalo ku saabsan maalgelinta; la soco wararka cusub ee saameyn kara agabka iyo taageerada waxbarashada.

English: Gretsa University has been granted a Charter, expanding access to higher education in Kenya. Students interested in enrolling should consider Gretsa University for their studies.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Gretsa kimepatiwa Hati, kuongeza upatikanaji wa elimu ya juu nchini Kenya. Wanafunzi wanaotaka kujiandikisha wanapaswa kuzingatia Chuo Kikuu cha Gretsa kwa masomo yao.
Ekegusii: Gretsa University emonagwi ekichacha, omokiri eng'ang'ina ya nasibori ya chire moke e Kenya. Abana babere orokire ing'enda kugwanera Gretsa University buya bwo liane.
Dholuo: Gretsa University e nangi Charter, kendo ne oing'ogi gi chula buo kuom edukatio mar ganda e Kenya. Tich moloyo kuom yech kod kanyo gi Gretsa University manok joge.
Somali: Jaamacadda Gretsa waxay heshay Shati, taasoo kordhinaysa helitaanka waxbarashada sare ee Kenya. Ardayda danaynaysa inay iska diiwaan galiyaan waa inay tixgeliyaan Jaamacadda Gretsa si ay u bartaan.

English: The National Education Conference is now a permanent event in the Ministry of Education's Calendar of Activities, facilitating ongoing collaboration among education stakeholders.
Kiswahili: Mkutano wa Kitaifa wa Elimu sasa ni tukio la kudumu katika Kalenda ya Shughuli za Wizara ya Elimu, ukiratibu ushirikiano endelevu kati ya washikadau wa elimu.
Ekegusii: Konferensi ya Kitaifa ya Elimu ikore omokogoti bwakire mu Kalendar ya Nyasa ya Wizara ya Elimu, ikireri omogogooja bwakire buya bwenyibori bwaki.
Dholuo: Konferen nigi mar masomo en oketi to otino ni gima Ministry of Education otemo ng'ato ma oketh timo, oting'o gigo mag wedo piny mar masomo.
Somali: Shirweynaha Aqoonsiga Qaranka ee Waxbarashada ayaa hadda noqday dhacdo joogto ah oo ku jirta Jadwalka Hawlaha Wasaaradda Waxbarashada, isagoo fududeeya iskaashiga joogtada ah ee ka dhexeeya daneeyayaasha waxbarashada.

English: Consolata International University has been granted a Letter of Interim Authority and will offer holistic education. Students interested should apply for programs that align with national development needs.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Consolata kimetoa Barua ya Mamlaka ya Mpito na kitatoa elimu ya kina. Wanafunzi wanaovutiwa wanapaswa kuomba mipango inayokubaliana na mahitaji ya maendeleo ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Consolata International University yoremeire omogore bw'akiiri bw'ekegirango bujagano buya ibintu biogire. Abana batararia bakenye bategane bazi bwiikire maarifa oria bina orio biongorane na oria ote ahu.
Dholuo: Consolata International University en giyeng' a Letter of Interim Authority; ka en bende eyo eyo mar edukashon marach. Wasomni miyo roch ka oseyok nyamre ma ng'iyo ka timbwa chuth.
Somali: Jaamacadda Consolata International waxay heshay Warqad Awlaad Kumeelgaar ah waxayna siin doontaa waxbarasho dhamaystiran. Ardayda danaynaysa waa in ay codsadaan barnaamijyo la jaanqaadaya baahiyaha horumarinta qaranka.

English: The Ministry of Education is implementing the Return-to-Work-Formula for staff welfare. Educational institutions must ensure compliance to maintain stability and continuity.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inatekeleza Mfumo wa Kurudi Kazini kwa ajili ya ustawi wa wafanyakazi. Taasisi za elimu zinapaswa kuhakikisha ufanisi ili kudumisha utulivu na mwendelezo.
Ekegusii: Ekegusii chire gochuna buya bwakireri bwakiari bw’ogokireri. Abakire bosi bateganie buya buori omogobwa naki.
Dholuo: Minisi ya Darsa inachang' nyalo konyo Return-to-Work-Formula gi tera mar tich. Wajumbe gi mawuoro mag darsa nyal konyo pod eyo chandruok kende gi joutho.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay hirgelinaysaa Nidaamka Dib-u-soo-kabashada ee shaqaalaha. Hay'adaha waxbarashada waa inay hubiyaan in la raaco si loo ilaaliyo xasilloonida iyo joogtaynta.

English: A Ministerial Audit Committee has been officially inaugurated at the Ministry of Education. Stakeholders should direct any inquiries or engagements related to this committee accordingly.
Kiswahili: Kamati ya Ukaguzi ya Wazirini imezinduliwa rasmi katika Wizara ya Elimu. Wadau wanapaswa kuelekeza maswali au ushirikiano wowote kuhusu kamati hii ipasavyo.
Ekegusii: Abakunyaki bakiabere bwakinyakanio buya ogenda eKigosi. Abakianyaki naki batieja oria buya bwakiabere mboge buya nakinyakire.
Dholuo: Dhi Miniti wacho ni Audit Committee en gima ok oting'ore e Ministry of Education. Omeny aora canyore chon gini ma okonyo kaka gima committee nyaka.
Somali: Guddiga Kormeerka Wasiirku si rasmi ah ayaa loo furay Wasaaradda Waxbarashada. Xubnaha daneeyayaasha waa inay su'aalaha ama isdhaafsiga la xiriira guddigan si habboon ugu wadaan.

English: The newly appointed University of Nairobi Council has been inaugurated to provide strategic guidance and oversight.
Kiswahili: Baraza jipya la Chuo Kikuu cha Nairobi limepewa kinga rasmi ili kutoa mwongozo wa kimkakati na ufuatiliaji.
Ekegusii: Amageng'ani atiga University of Nairobi omokiria omokiri omogori na omena buya.
Dholuo: University of Nairobi Council nyalo tinye ketegi mokwongo gi tetbani kod nyinge.
Somali: Guriga Golaha Jaamacadda Nairobi ee cusub ayaa la furay si uu u bixiyo hanuun siyaasadeed iyo kormeer.

English: All secondary schools are reminded to refrain from legal disputes over sports competitions. Ensure compliance with age limits for participants — only students under 19 years are eligible to compete.
Kiswahili: Shule zote za sekondari zinakumbushwa kujiepusha na mizozo ya kisheria kuhusu mashindano ya michezo. Hakikisheni mtazingatia mipaka ya umri kwa washiriki — ni wanafunzi wenye umri chini ya miaka 19 pekee ndio wanaweza kushiriki.
Ekegusii: Masomo ebiri nakiya nakiya siyatebere kubwaki chireke kiugene buse-nyang'ani. Bwakire obwakire buse bu jombi bwakisi — abato bwaki 19 nakiya bakwigana giyaki.
Dholuo: Wek kanyo sekondari namar gima ok nyal jiwne nyaka kuom ng'ato ma ok mamor gi dhano. Piny jomoko mokonyo kanyakla kendo bende osieko ng'ato — jomoko ma ok ni 19 pind jachieng' ma jiwe.
Somali: Dhammaan dugsiyada sare waxaa lagu xusuusinayaa inay iska ilaaliyaan khilaafaadka sharciga ah ee ku saabsan tartamada ciyaaraha. Fadlan hubi in lagu dhaqmo xadka da'da ka qaybgalayaasha — kaliya ardayda ka yar 19 sanno ayaa loo oggol yahay inay tartamaan.

English: All stakeholders in the education sector are urged to prioritize quality assurance and standards to align with Kenya Vision 2030 and Sustainable Development Goal 4 for national development.
Kiswahili: Wadau wote katika sekta ya elimu wanahimizwa kuzingatia dhamana ya ubora na viwango ili kuendana na Kenya Vision 2030 na Lengo la Maendeleo Endelevu la 4 kwa ajili ya maendeleo ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Ababwaki boke mu gaki ya ekirumi baibori bwakire omogore bwae bwokokere bwetare buse buya kera oria Kenya Vision 2030 na Sustainable Development Goal 4 buya gusibori bweng'ere bwogaki.
Dholuo: Ng’ato dhi nyaka lweny nyinga, nyaka giro chike mar donge ni ikayi nyaka thur kendo wanj ni Kenya Vision 2030 kod Sustainable Development Goal 4 inginyo mar thum.
Somali: Dhammaan daneeyayaasha sektorka waxbarashada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay mudnaanta siiyaan tayada iyo heerarka si loo waafajiyo Himilada Kenya 2030 iyo Yoolka Horumarinta Joogtada ah ee 4da ee horumarka qaranka.

English: The Ministry of Education is implementing the Secondary Education Equity and Quality Improvement Programme (SEEQIP) to enhance learning conditions in secondary schools through laboratory construction.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inatekeleza Mpango wa Uboreshaji wa Usawa na Ubora wa Elimu ya Sekondari (SEEQIP) kuboresha hali ya kujifunza katika shule za sekondari kupitia ujenzi wa maabara.
Ekegusii: Ogoti bwa Siasa bashi a naki bwang'ana bwake bwiaburi bwa Sekondari, buya bwaki bwikire bwoko bwanang'ana buya bwachieng'ani habwaki bwenda bura buya kosi.
Dholuo: Ministri ma Kola nyaka jochung' gi Secondary Education Equity and Quality Improvement Programme (SEEQIP) kuom timbe ma nyal piny konyo buot piny gi labora.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay fulinaysaa Barnaamijka Sinaanta iyo Tayada Waxbarashada Dhalinyarada (SEEQIP) si loo hagaajiyo xaaladaha waxbarasho ee dugsiyada sare iyada oo loo marayo dhismaha shaybaarka.

English: The Government of Kenya, in partnership with the World Bank, is implementing the Secondary Education Quality Improvement Project (SEQIP) to enhance education in disadvantaged areas.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya, kwa ushirikiano na Benki ya Dunia, inaendesha Mradi wa Kuboresha Ubora wa Elimu ya Sekondari (SEQIP) ili kuboresha elimu katika maeneo yasiyo na maendeleo.
Ekegusii: Omosakhanyi wa Kenya, na naki ya World Bank, bokerere omokibori bw'aisoma bw'ekebori buya (SEQIP) mwaki naki bw'ogekwere omokibori bw'aisoma buya.
Dholuo: Gavana wa Kenya, ka nyisiyogo gi World Bank, otieno projeke mar Secondary Education Quality Improvement Project (SEQIP) kuom nyalo piny gi inyuol mag edukeshoni e piny maler.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya, oo kaashanaysa Bangiga Adduunka, waxay hirgelinaysaa Mashruuca Hagaajinta Tayada Waxbarashada Dugsiga Sare (SEQIP) si kor loogu qaado waxbarashada meelaha danyarta ah.

English: The government of Kenya celebrates the success of Special Needs Education learners who won 2 Gold and 2 Silver medals at the FEASSA Games in Kakamega.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya inasherehekea mafanikio ya wanafunzi wa Elimu ya Mahitaji Maalum waliofanikiwa kupata medali 2 za Dhahabu na 2 za Fedha katika Michezo ya FEASSA huko Kakamega.
Ekegusii: Obwaki bw'ekegeni bwa Kenya buwakiire ubwaki bw'abakizi b'ekiganjabi b'okwenda 2 n'ekirokonyo 2 ahakire FEASSA Games omokisi Kakamega.
Dholuo: Government of Kenya ne oganda ng'ato ma ok nyalo yore ka gi Special Needs Education learners mane owinjo 2 Gold to 2 Silver medals e FEASSA Games kod Kakamega.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya waxay ku dabaaldegaysaa guusha ardayda waxbarashada baahiyaha gaarka ah ee ku guuleystay 2 dahab iyo 2 qalin ah ciyaaraha FEASSA ee Kakamega.

English: Kenya will host the FEASSA Championship in Kakamega from August 14–22, 2025. Schools should prepare students for participation in this event.
Kiswahili: Kenya itashiriki katika Mashindano ya FEASSA huko Kakamega kuanzia Agosti 14 hadi 22, 2025. Shule zinapaswa kuwaandaa wanafunzi kushiriki katika tukio hili.
Ekegusii: Kenya ikwenda bushang'ana na FEASSA Championship e Kakamega buya August 14–22, 2025. Mashule magakire omokiri bwakirakire abana buya bucheke omogende ng'ende.
Dholuo: Kenya ikwayo FEASSA Championship e Kakamega nendi August 14–22, 2025. Masomo ok gitek students kuom yo kati e nind gi tich.
Somali: Kenya waxay martigelin doontaa Tartanka FEASSA ee Kakamega laga bilaabo Ogosto 14–22, 2025. Dugsiyada waa inay diyaarisaa ardayda ka qeyb galka dhacdadan.

English: School buses must not operate between 6pm and 6am as per the Traffic (Amendment) Act 2017. Violators will face legal action.
Kiswahili: Basi za shule hazipaswi kufanya kazi kati ya saa 12 jioni na saa 12 asubuhi kulingana na Sheria ya Usafiri (Marekebisho) ya mwaka 2017. Wakosaji watachukuliwa hatua za kisheria.
Ekegusii: Maschool bus oborori buya hagati ya 6pm na 6am, goia buya buya Traffic (Amendment) Act 2017. Bakiibaki bayang’ana buya bwaki.
Dholuo: Kanya bus gi chike nyalo kare ma ok gin mo 6 nyakundruok kendo 6 nyakundruok koro. Kachiel kuom gige keler.
Somali: Basaska dugsiyada ma shaqeyn karaan inta u dhaxaysa 6pm ilaa 6am sida ku xusan Sharciga Taraafikada (Isbeddelka) 2017. Ku xadgudbayasha waxay wajihi doonaan tallaabo sharci.

English: Education leaders are collaborating to implement reforms aimed at improving the Kenyan education sector. Stay informed on updates and initiatives in your local education community.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa elimu wanashirikiana kutekeleza mabadiliko yanayolenga kuboresha sekta ya elimu nchini Kenya. Kuwa na habari kuhusu taarifa na mipango katika jamii yako ya elimu.
Ekegusii: Abakiongozi b’ekibori babandanya gusanganya omokinyani okwisekanya hita ekibori kya Kenya. Naki omokinyani omoshure hia bukire naki omogeni okuoruya bwebokinyani bwebe.
Dholuo: Ong'ere mag jaramogi ne gin golo ginyalu e kachieng' kaka gimaki yore gi nyim mano mar Kenyani. Konyo gi wacho kuom kendo wathni e wangal mar jaramogi maok otereo.
Somali: Hoggaamiyeyaasha waxbarashada waxay iskaa wax u qabso u jiraan in ay hirgeliyaan isbedelada lagu hagaajinayo qeybta waxbarashada Kenya. La soco wararka iyo dadaallada ka jira bulshaddaada waxbarasho.

English: Education leaders are advocating for reforms in the education sector. Stakeholders are encouraged to engage in the discussions to drive improvements.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa elimu wanasisitiza mabadiliko katika sekta ya elimu. Wadau wanahimizwa kushiriki katika majadiliano ili kuleta maboresho.
Ekegusii: Abaki baki baisingori burosi bwaki bwegena bwa chichere. Abekang'ani naki abaki batarakire okang'ana mu naki omonene bw'ogendete bwaki.
Dholuo: Wakilishi mawuok idhi ka lweny miyo chike e nyasayo. Okwongo mawuok ng'eyo ni mohero konyruok e higa mar lweny kendo kuotna.
Somali: Hoggaamiyeyaasha waxbarashada ayaa ku baaqaya isbeddelada waaxda waxbarashada. Dulmarayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan doodo si kor loogu qaado hagaajinta.

English: The upgrade of Limbine Primary and Junior School's infrastructure in Meru County is underway, supported by the Safaricom Foundation and school alumni.
Kiswahili: Ukarabati wa miundombinu ya Shule ya Msingi na Shule ya Upili ya Limbine katika Kaunti ya Meru unaendelea, ukiungwa mkono na Mfuko wa Safaricom na wahitimu wa shule hiyo.
Ekegusii: Bwakire bwakiibori bwende Limbine Primary na Junior School buya Meru County buse, bwakiisirowe na Safaricom Foundation na abakiisi bwaye.
Dholuo: Okwongo mar Limbine Primary ka Junior School e Meru County ikweyo, lilo kawruok motegno kaka Safaricom Foundation ka joma uda e koyi.
Somali: Horumarinta kaabayaasha Iskuulka Hoose iyo Dugsiga dhexe ee Limbine ee Gobolka Meru way socotaa, iyadoo ay taageerayaan Saafirikom Foundation iyo ardaydii dugsiga ka qalin jebisay.

English: The National Qualifications Framework for Micro-Credentials aims to enhance access to skills recognition and flexible learning pathways for learners. Stay informed on updates related to this initiative.
Kiswahili: Muundo wa Kitaifa wa Sifa za Mikro unalenga kuongeza ufikiaji wa kutambuliwa kwa ujuzi na njia za kujifunza zinazofaa kwa wanafunzi. Kuwa na habari kuhusu sasisho zinazohusiana na mpango huu.
Ekegusii: Obwaki bw'Obugendi bwy'Abakora ey'aviga ogw'omogorori munchiri ogwakorere ore chia obwabwakire bw'akagwiji na omokiri oria ogw'obwishingo bw'abakora. Naki omogenda omokiri osisi omokiri moshoki.
Dholuo: National Qualifications Framework ng'ato ma Micro-Credentials noyienyo chuth kuom joma otieno e yo dhek mar gi ji nyaka sigandini. Wacho ni no ka kanyakore gi bura e tich ma oger.
Somali: Qaabka Shahaadooyinka Qaranka ee Micro-Credentials wuxuu ujeedkiisu yahay inuu fududeeyo helitaanka aqoonsiga xirfadaha iyo waddooyinka barashada dabacsan ee ardayda. La soco wararka ku saabsan hindisahan.

English: All learners at Karen Comprehensive School, from ECDE to Grade 9, will receive a pair of shoes to enhance their comfort and self-esteem.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wote katika Shule ya Karen Comprehensive, kuanzia ECDE hadi Darasa la 9, watapokea viatu vya kujivunia ili kuboresha faraja na kujiamini.
Ekegusii: Abaki buseki boti ba Karen Comprehensive School, boti ECDE buya Grade 9, bwana buya mudho mosi  burokere buya nyamachoge na buya chabere.
Dholuo: Winjruok ma-Karen Comprehensive School, kendo kendo yawre to Grade 9, bende bende nyuka mar shoes kuom giego gi cher.
Somali: Dhammaan ardayda dugsiga Karen Comprehensive, laga bilaabo ECDE ilaa Grade 9, waxay heli doonaan laba kabo si kor loogu qaado raaxadooda iyo kalsoonidooda.

English: The government will partner with private entities to enhance education standards. Schools can expect improvements in infrastructure and resources through these initiatives.
Kiswahili: Serikali itashirikiana na mashirika ya kibinafsi kuboresha viwango vya elimu. Shule zinaweza kutarajia maboresho katika miundombinu na rasilimali kupitia mipango hii.
Ekegusii: Abwaki abwaki bw'ogenda buya na abachori b'ogenda bwae buya ku bw'ekibori bw'ekirimi. Masaka boki waki bosi bogenyaki buya kukirori naki bw'ekibori bosi.
Dholuo: Governments okonyruok gi ma-en kachieng' mar jarita ahinya kuom piny. Sukulu en ng'eyo e piny okonyruok gi buok mar infrastruktur kod resources maduong'.
Somali: Dowladda waxay la shaqeyneysaa shirkadaha gaarka ah si loo kordhiyo heerarka waxbarashada. Iskuulada waxay filan karaan isbedelo ku saabsan kaabayaasha iyo agabka iyada oo loo marayo hindisahan.

English: Grade nine learners are currently being placed in senior schools. Parents and students should stay informed about their placement status.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa darasa la tisa wanapangwa katika shule za sekondari. Wazazi na wanafunzi wanapaswa kubaki na ufahamu kuhusu hali yao ya kupangwa.
Ekegusii: Abogoti bosi baki bagenyora mu masoko megi. Ababere naki abogoti bokenyire bwaki bu masoko.
Dholuo: Gichako mokwongo ng'ato kendo giyaki ni gino gichuny ng'ato kod jumabichi. Moko duto to jendo osonyi ni gichako gi yie.
Somali: Ardayda fasalka 9aad ayaa haatan lagu guda jiraa in lagu shubo iskuulo sare. Waalidiinta iyo ardayda waa inay la soconayaan xaaladda shubista.

English: A conference on the status of Pre-Service Teacher Training and Teacher Employment in Kenya is underway in Mombasa, focusing on enhancing teacher preparedness.
Kiswahili: Mkutano kuhusu hali ya Mafunzo ya Walimu kabla ya Kazi na Ajira ya Walimu nchini Kenya unaendelea Mombasa, ukiangazia kuboresha maandalizi ya walimu.
Ekegusii: Ong'anya buya bwokiyaki bwekiriri bwakinyanwi bwabwakire buya moshonere mwaki buya emongetari bwekinyanwi mosi kyendo bweto bweng'anya osiba.
Dholuo: Konferens mar nying' kosedhi maler egieko joma eyo mar Pre-Service Teacher Training kod Teacher Employment e Kenya ne imar rito e Mombasa, notiolo e dwond duto nyaka olalo joma.
Somali: Shir ku saabsan xaaladda Tababarka Macallimiinta kahor adeegga iyo Shaqaalaynta Macallimiinta ee Kenya ayaa ka socda Mombasa, isagoo diiradda saaraya kor u qaadista diyaar garowga macallimiinta.

English: The STEMTASTIC Adventures Africa 2025 event is ongoing at CEMASTEA in Karen, Nairobi. Educators and learners are encouraged to participate in discussions on sustainable STEM education.
Kiswahili: Tukio la STEMTASTIC Adventures Africa 2025 linaendelea katika CEMASTEA huko Karen, Nairobi. Walimu na wanafunzi wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mijadala kuhusu elimu endelevu ya STEM.
Ekegusii: Emotera ya STEMTASTIC Adventures Africa 2025 igeneeka kwi CEMASTEA muria Karen, Nairobi. Abagikosi n'abakosi bategerekeria kuibebokanya omogokori buya bw'egesubira mu STEM.
Dholuo: STEMTASTIC Adventures Africa 2025 nyaka eyo e CEMASTEA karen, Nairobi. Wath oganda gi wakiwogo yore kumanya mag ndimach nyal nyuok ketho e STEM.
Somali: Dhacdooyinka STEMTASTIC Adventures Africa 2025 ayaa ka socda CEMASTEA ee Karen, Nairobi. Macalimiinta iyo ardayda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan doodaha ku saabsan waxbarashada STEM ee waara.

English: The Ministry of Education aims to increase school meal coverage to 10 million learners by 2030. Schools in food insecure areas are prioritized.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inatarajia kuongeza upatikanaji wa chakula shuleni kwa wanafunzi milioni 10 ifikapo mwaka 2030. Shule zilizoko katika maeneo ya uhaba wa chakula zitatendewa kipaumbele.
Ekegusii: Mizizi ya Elimu inataka kuongezea huduma ya chakula shuleni kwa wanafunzi milioni 10 ifikapo mwaka wa 2030. Shule zenye ukosefu wa chakula zitatolewa kipaumbele.
Dholuo: Minisitiri wa Dhuong' ma Ogingo oyo nyalo timo kanyo kuom chakruok gi 10 miliyoni ng'ayo kendo nyaka adiera e piny kendo kombe. Sura mar chike e piny ma ok dhoch.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay damacsan tahay inay korodhsato ka qaybqaadashada cuntada dugsiyada ilaa 10 milyan oo arday ah sanadka 2030. Dugsiyada ku yaal meelaha cuntadu adagtahay ayaa la mudnaanta siinayaa.

English: No actionable content available.
Kiswahili: Hakuna maudhui ya utekelezaji yanayopatikana.
Ekegusii: Naki omotegeri oborori.
Dholuo: Neno tiyo kata kendo.
Somali: Ma jiraan wax macluumaad ah oo la qaadi karo.

English: 2,277 students have been awarded degrees and diplomas at the Technical University of Kenya's 14th Graduation Ceremony. Congratulations to all graduates!
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi 2,277 wametunukiwa shahada na diploma katika Sherehe ya 14 ya Madaraja ya Chuo cha Ufundi cha Kenya. Hongera kwa wahitimu wote!
Ekegusii: Abanane 2,277 buya bakiwaki omokoro naki Diplomas buya buya Obwakwasibori bw’aki Ogenda mumusomo bwe 14. Naki kosi buya bumegoni!
Dholuo: 2,277 nyaka gin kanyalo ohingo gi diplomas e Technical University of Kenya 14th Graduation Ceremony. Weche gi nyaka!
Somali: 2,277 arday ayaa darajooyin iyo shahaadooyin lagu siiyay Xanuunku Technical University of Kenya ee Xafladda 14-aad ee Qalinjabinta. Hambalyo dhammaan qalinjabiyayaasha!

English: The Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development is exploring cost-effective computer programs for teaching new Senior Secondary School subjects, including aviation and maritime studies.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Kenya ya Maendeleo ya Mtaala inachunguza programu za kompyuta zenye gharama nafuu za kufundisha masomo mapya ya Shule ya Sekondari ya Juu, ikiwemo masomo ya anga na baharini.
Ekegusii: Inistituyete ya Kenya ya Nkhanga ya Mipango ikoranga ogotegera bisi bwaki bwa komputa buya bwaki bwabere boma bwaki buya bwasichana bwakaberi, kibondo bwaki buya bwabere bwakanyego naki bwanokie bwaki bwang’ama.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development ochung' nyaka ok nyal kanyo mitwe magi mawach joma oting' tumu kuom gogo gi nembor, including aviation kod maritime studies.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka wuxuu baadhayaa barnaamijyo kumbiyuutar oo kharashka ku habboon ah si loogu baro maadooyin cusub oo Sare ee Dugsiyada Sare, oo ay ku jiraan cilmiga hawada iyo cilmiga badda.

English: Grade 10 textbooks have been distributed as schools prepare to start next week. Please ensure all students have the materials ready for the new term.
Kiswahili: Vitabu vya darasa la 10 vimesambazwa huku shule zikijiandaa kuanza wiki ijayo. Tafadhali hakikisha wanafunzi wote wanayo vifaa tayari kwa muhula mpya.
Ekegusii: Bwakire bwaki buya bwaki bwakinyagire buya, bwakire bwakidori bwaki bwakire bokora. Osibori ogokire obwakire bwaki bworogori bwa nyang'ori buya.
Dholuo: Kitabu gi Grade 10 ne odhi mbaka ma shule nghen kitegni chin. Naki ji kuom ni min gi pwodhi manoloko chuth ma nyime.
Somali: Buuggaagta fasalka 10 ayaa la qaybiyay iyadoo iskuulada ay isku diyaarinayaan in ay billaabaan usbuuca soo socda. Fadlan hubi in dhammaan ardaydu ay haystaan agabkii cusub.

English: Value-Based Education (VbE) will be rolled out in schools nationwide in 2026. Schools are encouraged to prepare for this initiative to strengthen character formation and ethical learning.
Kiswahili: Elimu ya Kuthamini (VbE) itaanza kutekelezwa katika shule nchini kote mwaka 2026. Shule zinahimizwa kujiandaa kwa mpango huu ili kuimarisha malezi ya tabia na kujifunza kwa maadili.
Ekegusii: Egesia naki Ekegusii (VbE) oragie bw'ogenda busemo bwesia bw'isi buseme mu 2026. Egesia naki oraki omokire busemo bw'orugetele bw'ekarati naki bw'akiake omokogoti bw'ogenda.
Dholuo: Value-Based Education (VbE) okonyo megolo kod buok mar nyamre e busia 2026. Makarok gi piny nyal konyo to onge gi tigo ma oyudo karibore kod wacho mar piny.
Somali: Waxbarashada Ku Saleysan Qiimaha (VbE) ayaa lagu bilaabi doonaa iskuulada dalka oo dhan sanadka 2026. Iskuulada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay isu diyaarso mashruucan si loo xoojiyo dhismaha akhlaaqda iyo barashada anshaxa.

English: County Directors of Education and school administrators must submit accurate learner enrolment and textbook data to support the government's one-to-one textbook policy.
Kiswahili: Makanika wa Elimu wa Kaunti na wasimamizi wa shule wanapaswa kuwasilisha takwimu sahihi za usajili wa wanafunzi na vitabu vya shule ili kusaidia sera ya serikali ya vitabu kimoja kwa mwanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Abakire buya ba Elimu na abanyesaki bakenye bakenya okore buya abarori bakiishopi nakiitiko igeigo buya obwakire buya bwokuhire.
Dholuo: Dik director machiegni e pakore gi jago kanyogo nyalo chako łoro mar yore ma okel e chako mar kitabu.
Somali: Maamulayaasha Waxbarashada Degmada iyo maamulayaasha dugsiyada waa in ay soo gudbiyaan xog sax ah oo ku saabsan diiwaangelinta ardayda iyo buugaagta si ay u taageeraan siyaasadda dowladda ee buugga hal-arday hal-buug.

English: Grade 10 learners will receive KES 5.64 billion for textbooks from KICD. Ensure your school is prepared for textbook acquisition.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa darasa la kumi watapokea KES bilioni 5.64 kwa ajili ya vitabu kutoka KICD. Hakikisha shule yako imejiandaa kwa ununuzi wa vitabu.
Ekegusii: Abagere 10 bakirwe KES 5.64 billion buya mwabere eKICD. Nakiire mwaki baba naki buya buya ekere ibarati.
Dholuo: Walimu ma 10 chuny kata mar KES 5.64 bilioni kuom kanyis ma KICD. Nyasaye ni in ochung’ e shule kawuono kuom kanyis.
Somali: Ardayda Fasalka 10 waxa la siin doonaa KES 5.64 bilyan oo loogu talagalay buugaagta dugsiga KICD. Hubi in dugsigaagu u diyaar garoobo iibsashada buugaagta.

English: The Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development has been recognized as the best performing State corporation in Kenya.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Maendeleo ya Mitaala ya Kenya imetambuliwa kama shirika la serikali linalofanya vyema zaidi Kenya.
Ekegusii: Ikirori gi Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development giki maano gi ogenda ogosiogo nyansia moko buya mu Kenya.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development osebedo tinde maber chiegni kuom Kenya.
Somali: Hay'adda Kenya ee Horumarinta Manhajka ayaa loo aqoonsaday inay tahay shirkadda dowliga ah ee ugu wanaagsan Kenya.

English: Wanafunzi wa gredi ya kumi wanatarajiwa kuanza rasmi masomo yao wiki ijayo.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa gredi ya kumi wataanza rasmi masomo yao wiki ijayo.
Ekegusii: Wanafunzi ba gredi ya ikumi batarakire buya bwene masomo bwabaki bwaki.
Dholuo: Wanafunzi wa gredi kuom duto waki’gi tibu masomo kaka ng’weny.
Somali: Ardayda fasalka 10-aad waxay filayaan inay si rasmi ah u bilaabaan waxbarashadooda usbuuca soo socda.

English: Over 10,000 Junior Secondary Schools will receive interactive smart boards as part of the government's digital learning program to enhance the Competency-Based Education curriculum.
Kiswahili: Shule za Sekondari za Kiarabu zaidi ya 10,000 zitapata bodi za smart zinazofanya kazi kama sehemu ya mpango wa serikali wa kujifunza kidijitali ili kuboresha mtaala wa Elimu Inayopangwa Kulingana na Uwezo.
Ekegusii: Ekereri 10,000 oria Junior Secondary Schools ni baria bwakire bori buya busome buya bwaki mu ng'ene yaito oborania obwakire bwaki buya bwi bwana bwaki bwokire bwaki bwakore buya naki.
Dholuo: Mok One more than 10,000 Junior Secondary Schools ng'ato ng'athem interactive smart boards kendo bang' gava ne owuon mar digital learning program kuom togo maber Competency-Based Education curriculum.
Somali: In ka badan 10,000 dugsiyo hoose oo dhexe ayaa helaya guddiyo smart ah oo isdhexgal ah oo ka mid ah barnaamijka waxbarashada dijitaalka ah ee dowladda si loo korodhsado manhajka Waxbarashada Ku Salaysan Awoodaha.

English: Students are urged to uphold discipline, integrity, and hard work to achieve lasting academic success. Avoid social vices that undermine your education and potential.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanahimizwa kuzingatia nidhamu, uaminifu, na kazi ngumu ili kufikia mafanikio ya kudumu katika masomo. Epuka tabia mbaya zinazoharibu elimu yako na uwezo wako.
Ekegusii: Abakoro bosi baria bakirire ibirori, emitekere, na omokinyancha buya okubwaki omokinyancha mwaki. Naki baria abaki bure bwakuri bwosi butigene bunyandore bwogendani no bwaki bwakiri.
Dholuo: Ng’ato gichako mana ka abichu discipline, integrity, to gik ma oting'o to giyudhi dhok e yo maler kuom gik ma omiyo gi tije. Igoya mar nyithindo ma ochak mahonyo gi ng’ato ni iwe.
Somali: Ardayda waxaa lagu wargelinayaa inay ilaashadaan anshaxa, daacadnimada, iyo shaqada adag si ay u gaaraan guul waxbarasho oo waarta. Ka fogaada dhibaatooyinka bulsheed ee carqaladaynaya waxbarashadaada iyo kartidaada.

English: KEMRI Kisumu conducts HIV testing during the day and COVID-19 tests at night. Patients are advised to visit at the appropriate times for their specific tests.
Kiswahili: KEMRI Kisumu inafanya upimaji wa VVU mchana na upimaji wa COVID-19 usiku. Wagonjwa wanashauriwa kutembelea kwa nyakati sahihi kwa ajili ya vipimo vyao maalum.
Ekegusii: KEMRI Kisumu ikore omogusii HIV buya buya, na COVID-19 buya buya. Abana baria basubire buya buya omokirori oria buya bwaki buya.
Dholuo: KEMRI Kisumu negi HIV test kuom chuno, to COVID-19 test kuom uwor. Wuotho osetiegi kuom nyaka odwok ring' gi teko ma wuonachiel.
Somali: KEMRI Kisumu waxay sameysaa baaritaanka HIV maalintii iyo baaritaanka COVID-19 habeennimo. Bukaanada waxaa lagu talinayaa inay booqdaan waqtiga saxda ah ee baaritaankooda.

English: The Communications Authority of Kenya is donating computers to over 23 schools nationwide to enhance digital learning. Schools in Embu and surrounding counties will benefit from this initiative.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya inatoa kompyuta kwa zaidi ya shule 23 nchi nzima ili kuimarisha utafiti wa kidijitali. Shule zilizopo Embu na kaunti za jirani zitafaidika na mpango huu.
Ekegusii: Omosokoti bw’akiaki bw'eri Kenya omogore omokoni omogendi 23 esiibori nyasa na tenda obwasibori buya bueteshere digitali. Esiibori ya Embu naki alongi oria tumakire bumueno bw'ogokogo buya.
Dholuo: Communications Authority of Kenya nitiere komputer ku 23 nyaka magi e kongo ma ok nyal koro dong' chalo. Nyaka mo Embu kod masinjo ma ok nyal koro tich ahinya ku ngero maneno.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta Kenya ayaa deeq computers ah siinaysa in ka badan 23 iskuul oo ku yaal dalka si loo xoojiyo waxbarashada dijitaalka ah. Iskuulada ku yaal Embu iyo degmooyinka ku xeeran ayaa ka faa'iideysan doona talaabadan.

English: Support the establishment of well-equipped school libraries and provide relevant reading materials to improve literacy and critical thinking skills among learners in public primary schools.
Kiswahili: Tunga maktaba zenye vifaa bora shuleni na toa nyenzo muhimu za kusoma ili kuboresha uandishi na ujuzi wa kufikiri kwa wanafunzi katika shule za msingi za umma.
Ekegusii: Naki omoshanga esomogori emosi ya masenda na ogenda oria ogokore, obokire buya obokeng'ena omoka na omokiri oria buria buya naki abiria mu masenda omogori.
Dholuo: Dhiye ng'ato ma okawo golo chike kata kod golo ng'ama mokwongo ng'ato manyalo kare ahinya gi nying' kawuono mag jumba mar nyasa.
Somali: Taageer dhismaha maktabadaha iskuulka oo si fiican loo qalabeeyay, oo bixiya agab akhris oo muhiim ah si kor loogu qaado akhriska iyo xirfadaha fikirka dhisidda ee ardayda dugsiyada hoose ee dadweynaha.

English: Parents are urged to engage in meaningful discussions with their children during the upcoming half-term break to address issues of indiscipline and moral guidance at home.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanatakiwa kushiriki katika majadiliano yenye maana na watoto wao wakati wa mapumziko ya nusu muhula yajayo ili kujadili masuala ya ukosefu wa nidhamu na mwongozo wa maadili nyumbani.
Ekegusii: Bwakire bwokiri bwanyire buya bwaki naki bwakire bwachoche, omokinyanya bakenye baturire bwakore oria bwaki bwakwendikire naki buya buya bwogendibere.
Dholuo: Wuon gi wande odi chuo e pwodhi mar half-term bende gima otowa kendo ma in kende ni adhiero koro en chul gi tich ni wanyalo nyaka jo nyaka.
Somali: Waalidku waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay ka qeyb qaataan wada sheekaysi macno leh carruurtooda inta lagu guda jiro fasaxan barwaaqo ee soo socota si ay uga wada hadlaan arrimaha anshax xumada iyo hanuunka akhlaaqda guriga.

English: Teachers are urged to engage in continuous professional development to enhance their skills and teaching methods for quality science education.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanahamasishwa kushiriki katika maendeleo ya kitaaluma yanayoendelea ili kuboresha ujuzi wao na mbinu za ufundishaji kwa elimu bora ya sayansi.
Ekegusii: Abalimu baria batoranire kutegeria buseke bworeng'ane buseke na obwaki bwabaki bwakere osinano mulasi nyaki.
Dholuo: Owino adwar gi juma kendo oseyudhi kelo manyien to odhi kodu gi nyigila mag shidruok kendo kuotono kod piny ma okinyi e yo.
Somali: Macalimiinta waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan horumarinta xirfadeed ee joogtada ah si ay u korodhsadaan xirfadooda iyo hababka waxbaridda ee waxbarashada sayniska tayadeeda.

English: Stakeholders are urged to invest in research and teacher training to enhance STEM education. Support initiatives that inspire youth in Physics and other science-related fields.
Kiswahili: Washikadau wanakumbushwa kuwekeza katika utafiti na mafunzo ya walimu ili kuboresha elimu ya STEM. Punguza juhudi zinazohamasisha vijana katika Fizikia na nyanja nyingine za sayansi.
Ekegusii: Abakire baturagania okwiria omokubetere naki omokang'anya bwegire bwetegani bokwenda STEM. Naki abagire abaki batarera oria buya bwakire mu Physics naki ebwomi oria bwetegani.
Dholuo: Ng’ato maruok kuom jalweche kuom yie mag e e kanyo ni inegi to jopiny koro kuom STEM. Dhi gise chieg goyo jothiw, e Physics kod chakre tich kendo nyaka.
Somali: La-talinta ayaa lagu boorinayaa in ay maalgashadaan cilmi-baaris iyo tababarka macalimiinta si kor loogu qaado waxbarashada STEM. Taageer ololeyaal dhiirrigelinaya dhallinyarada ee Fiisikiska iyo cilmiga kale.

English: Kapenguria Boys High School is closed for investigations into a fire incident. Parents must clear outstanding fees and pay an additional Sh11,270 per student before reopening.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Sekondari ya Kapenguria Boys imefungwa kwa uchunguzi kuhusu tukio la moto. Wazazi wanapaswa kulipa ada zilizobaki na kuongeza Sh11,270 kwa mwanafunzi kabla ya kufunguliwa tena.
Ekegusii: Kapenguria Boys High School naki bw'ogenda oboraganya buya bw'ekashia. Ababere bonyanirigana kwendia obwakirigi bwabongwa na bwereka Sh11,270 ogenda mw'ogenda.
Dholuo: Kapenguria Boys High School en ng'wonj goro e yore gi nywando mag bura. Wazazi nyal timo buya kendo pigi Sh11,270 moro per otero mbere yore kar.
Somali: Dugsiga Sare ee Kapenguria Boys ayaa xirnaanaya si loo baaro shil dab oo dhacay. Waalidiinta waa inay bixiyaan lacagaha waaweyn ee ka maqan iyo intaas oo kale Sh11,270 arday kasta ka hor inta aan dib loo furin.

English: No actionable content to report.
Kiswahili: Hakuna maudhui ya kufanyia kazi.
Ekegusii: Eng'ombe ore ibuka.
Dholuo: Naka ng'ato ma ok nyal.
Somali: Ma jiro wax macluumaad ah oo la diyaariyey.

English: No actionable content identified.
Kiswahili: Hakuna maudhui ya utekelezaji yaliyojulikana.
Ekegusii: Naki omokirenda buya.
Dholuo: Chieng'ni gima owinji.
Somali: Maalin walba, iska hubi in aad cabto biyo kafiil ah. Biyaha nadiifka ah waa muhiim si loo helo caafimaad wanaagsan. Ka fogow biyo shubashaday. Haddii aad shaki ka qabto, raadi biyo la xaqiijiyay ka soo bixinta ilaha la aamini karo. Raac talooyinka caafimaadka si aad u noolaato si caafimaad leh.

English: Girls in Mombasa County are encouraged to enroll in Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) institutions, especially in blue economy courses, to empower themselves and close the gender gap. Childcare facilities are available at Mtongwe and Kisauni Technical Colleges to support young mothers.
Kiswahili: Wasichana katika Kaunti ya Mombasa wanasisitizwa kujisajili katika taasisi za Elimu na Mafunzo ya Ufundi na Ufundi Stadi (TVET), hasa katika kozi za uchumi wa buluu, ili kujikomboa na kufunga pengo la kijinsia. Vituo vya kulea watoto vipo katika Vyuo vya Ufundi Mtongwe na Kisauni kusaidia akina mama vijana.
Ekegusii: Abakire bosi bwa Mombasa barakire buseke buotore mu nyang'ori ya Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET), ikiraka mu masomo gechaki, ore kechokire mwaki magome. Amashure ekebiri ore aibuya abaki baki at Mtongwe na Kisauni Technical Colleges ore shindire abakire abaki.
Dholuo: Nyang' girls e Mombasa County ne cha ka enruok e Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) institutions, chiegni kendo e chuo mar blue economy, kwa sirkwa gi joma nyaka joma. Abiraga mar watoto ne wacho e Mtongwe kod Kisauni Technical Colleges kuom podhi nyaka.
Somali: Gals in Mombasa County waxaa loo dhiirrigelinayaa inay iska diiwaan galiyaan hay'adaha Waxbarashada Farsamada iyo Tababarka (TVET), gaar ahaan koorsooyinka dhaqaalaha buluugga, si ay naftooda u awood siiyaan oo ay u yaraystaan farqiga jinsiyadeed. Goobaha daryeelka carruurta ayaa la heli karaa jaamacadaha Farsamada ee Mtongwe iyo Kisauni si ay taageero ugu yeeshaan hooyooyinka da'da yar.

English: The Kenya Defence Force is constructing classrooms in ten primary schools in Laikipia County to enhance learning environments; expected completion is in two months.
Kiswahili: Jeshi la Ulinzi la Kenya linajenga madarasa katika shule za msingi kumi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia ili kuboresha mazingira ya kujifunzia; kumalizika kunatarajiwa ndani ya miezi miwili.
Ekegusii: Abagere Ba Kenya baretete ogetha shule buya mu moke buya buseka mu Laikipia County kugaragania eng'oto yo buya; bulia bwa buya kayaki naki mu mwaki buya.
Dholuo: Kenya Defence Force nyal jopuonj e kony kanyo golo e neno maaro kendo magwero ariyo e Laikipia County, kuom nyisecho chutho ni mokuongo ara.
Somali: Ciidanka Difaaca Kenya ayaa dhisaya fasalo dugsiyada hoose ee toban ah ee ku yaal Gobolka Laikipia si kor loogu qaado jawiga waxbarashada; iyadoo la filayo in la dhammeeyo laba bilood gudaheed.

English: The Ministry of Health and the Ministry of Education are implementing initiatives to enhance healthcare services in schools and combat drug abuse among students. Parents and teachers are urged to stay informed about the evolving tactics of drug traffickers.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya na Wizara ya Elimu zinatekeleza juhudi za kuboresha huduma za afya shuleni na kupambana na matumizi mabaya ya dawa kati ya wanafunzi. Wazazi na walimu wanahimizwa kubaki na ufahamu kuhusu mbinu zinazoendelea za wauzaji wa dawa.
Ekegusii: Abwaki bw'ekirongo n'Abwaki bw'ekisomo bataraki banaraki buseki bw'osababi bwariri mu masomo n'ogekoreria osababi mu bakire. Abatani n'abagwere bataraki bamenyere bw'ogekorokiriana bw'amasabo.
Dholuo: Ministry of Health e Ministry of Education ne oganda mar chweo ma oket gi sarem kuom jaduong' kod golo jola. Wazazi gi wathore to mibi timo chalo kuom dunga mar joma oket golo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimaadka iyo Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa hirgelinaya ololayaal lagu horumarinayo adeegyada caafimaadka ee iskuulada iyo lagu dagaalayo isticmaalka daroogada ardayda dhexdeeda. Waalidka iyo macalimiinta waxaa lagula talinayaa inay xog ogaal ka noqdaan xeeladaha cusub ee ganacsatada daroogada.

English: The government is committed to timely disbursement of capitation funds and the construction of classrooms. School principals are urged to prioritize mental well-being and invest in counseling services.
Kiswahili: Serikali imejizatiti kutekeleza utoaji wa fedha za capitation kwa wakati na kujenga madarasa. Wakuu wa shule wanahimizwa kuzingatia ustawi wa akili na kuwekeza katika huduma za ushauri.
Ekegusii: Abanyabasa ba serikali batarera obwakire bwokuboka bwokoro bwokagutu bogo ogori bwomokiriga. Abasisi bamakeri bakenyere kugene obwakire bwokamokanya naki ogokirire bwokweria.
Dholuo: Ochiko mwakilishi duto oket ni kod kuom wanj nrụ oganda gi thuran in giluor. Wawinyo nyaka chieng' kiwuoro gi chitwek kendo owuoyo maching' gi terapi.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay ka go'an tahay bixinta wakhtiga ku habboon ee lacagaha capitation-ka iyo dhismaha fasallada. Maamulayaasha dugsiyada waxaa lagula talinayaa inay mudnaanta siiyaan caafimaadka maskaxda iyo inay maalgelin ku sameeyaan adeegyada la-talinta.

English: Graduates from technical institutions are urged to leverage their skills to create enterprises and solve real-world problems rather than solely seeking formal employment.
Kiswahili: Wahitimu kutoka taasisi za kiuchumi wanasisitizwa kutumia ujuzi wao kuanzisha biashara na kutatua matatizo halisi badala ya kutafuta ajira rasmi pekee.
Ekegusii: Abagokire b’amasomo buhanga barakiriwe gukoresha obuhanga bwabo gutangira ing'endo ne gukemorera ibibazo bikwiriye mu mbuga y’ensi, nyangwe batarikora obukire bungi boro bw'abanyamaki.
Dholuo: Kik makochi ka wa bende gi joma technical kurum golo ng'ato, to agok nyalo ruwore gi chalo mang'eny to gibuone gi bende koro e ndalo mar joma.
Somali: Qalinjabiyaasha ka soo baxay machadyada farsamada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay isticmaalaan xirfadahooda si ay u sameeyaan ganacsi iyo inay xalliyaan dhibaatooyinka dhabta ah, halkii ay kaliya raadin lahaayeen shaqo rasmi ah.

English: Public Primary School heads in Baringo County must surrender all Digital Literacy Program devices to Junior Secondary School teachers for use by [insert date].
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa shule za msingi za umma katika Kaunti ya Baringo wanapaswa kurejesha vifaa vyote vya Mpango wa Uandishi wa Kidijitali kwa walimu wa Shule za Sekondari Ndogo kabla ya [insert date].
Ekegusii: Abanyancha b'amasomo ya Public Primary School osibori Baringo naki ikibori hereka naki omokizi ba Junior Secondary School abaki naki [insert date].
Dholuo: Ongwe goyo mamoko mar Public Primary School e Baringo County manie kanyandoto e bura nyalo chwaro device dinde Digital Literacy Program kuon Junior Secondary School mawuok kendo ginyal chiemo [insert date].
Somali: Madaxyada Iskuulada Dowliga ah ee Baringo County waa inay gacan ku siiyaan dhammaan qalabka Barnaamijka Aqoonsiga Dijitalka ah macallimiinta Dugsiga Sare ee Hoose oo loo isticmaali doono ka hor [geliso taariikhda].

English: The proposed increase in school fees is on hold; principals must continue managing with the current capitation until a new circular is issued.
Kiswahili: Ongezeko lililopendekezwa la ada za shule limezimwa; wakuu wa shule wanapaswa kuendelea kusimamia kwa matumizi ya sasa hadi hatua mpya itakapotolewa.
Ekegusii: Omosomo ogwakiri bw’etage ogwakirwe; abereki baria baisore okegera okobokiyo omokirori bwa naki.
Dholuo: Gik ma awacho bende ni nyiri bende otero chieko gi nduong' mar masomo, kendo chiwo yiengni kuom kapitation ma en bang' chike kuom nyiri kuom ranyisi mar nyuol.
Somali: Korodhka lacagta iskuulka la soo jeediyay waa la hakiyay; maamulayaasha waa inay sii wadaan ka shaqaynta lacagta hadda jirta illaa la soo saaro wareegto cusub.

English: Communities are encouraged to participate in programs promoting peaceful coexistence despite religious differences. Join efforts in fostering unity in your area.
Kiswahili: Jamii zinahimizwa kushiriki katika programu zinazokuza kuishi kwa amani licha ya tofauti za kidini. Jiunge na juhudi za kukuza umoja katika eneo lako.
Ekegusii: Abakire buya bategere bende gubeokore murima ogukwang'ana buya naki buya bwakenje bwokoragwa. Gwisire buya mubende mukogore ung'anya buno.
Dholuo: Gikundi matindo kuye ka iyienni kalo momego nyasaye donjo gima osetimo. Nyanjore kuom wendo piny kanyakla.
Somali: Bulshada waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan barnaamijyada kor u qaadaya nabadda iyo wada noolaanshaha iyadoo la tixgelinayo kala duwanaanshaha diimeed. Ka qaybgal dadaallada lagu xoojinayo midnimada deegaankaaga.

English: Adults seeking literacy and skills development are encouraged to enroll in adult education programs in Kakamega Central. Visit the Kakamega Huduma Centre for more information and support.
Kiswahili: Watu wazima wanaotafuta uandishi na ujuzi wanahimizwa kujiandikisha kwenye programu za elimu ya watu wazima katika Kakamega Kati. Tembelea Kituo cha Huduma za Kakamega kwa maelezo zaidi na msaada.
Ekegusii: Ab adults baki bionge inaki bendi na oborori buya, mwaki mosi oreore kudega bwire buya mu Kaakamega Central. Naki Kakamega Huduma Centre buya oria bwori omokireri.
Dholuo: Ngiwe gi tekni gi adira kendo ber giseche en chuth ka oin kendo okuoyo mo owan gi program duto ma gi chuth gi. Kwadhi Kakamega Huduma Centre to nind gi ma wiyogo kendo nyime.
Somali: Dadka waaweyn ee raadinaya aqoon kororsi iyo horumarinta xirfadaha waxa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay isdiiwaangeliyaan barnaamijyada waxbarashada dadka waaweyn ee Kakamega Central. Booqo Xarunta Huduma ee Kakamega si aad u hesho macluumaad dheeraad ah iyo taageero.

English: Junior Secondary School learners are encouraged to participate in practical learning exhibitions as part of the Competency-Based Curriculum (CBC) to enhance creativity and teamwork skills.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa Shule ya Sekondari ya Kichanga wanahimizwa kushiriki katika maonyesho ya kujifunza kwa vitendo kama sehemu ya Mtaala wa Ufanisi (CBC) ili kuimarisha ubunifu na ujuzi wa kazi ya pamoja.
Ekegusii: Abakarati ba Junior Secondary School baria batarorwe okwecheka mu bukorori bwokire mwabere bwogwaki bwokora (CBC) buya bwenge baria naki buna bosi bweng'ani na bakore.
Dholuo: Wang'ni piny ji nene ahinya ka anyalo golo e kendo gonyo gi momi ne nyaka e piny goyo, to yieyo tinde ne ruoth kuom tek gi nyithindo.
Somali: Ardayda Dugsiga Sare ee Hoose waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qeybqaataan bandhigyada waxbarashada gacanta lagu sameeyo qayb ka mid ah Manhajka Ku Saleysan Aqoonta (CBC) si loo xoojiyo hal-abuurka iyo xirfadaha kooxeed.

English: The government is integrating KASNEB professional training with technical programs in TVET institutions to enhance learning outcomes. Stay tuned for updated syllabus and guidelines.
Kiswahili: Serikali inachanganya mafunzo ya kitaaluma ya KASNEB na programu za kiufundi katika taasisi za TVET ili kuboresha matokeo ya kujifunza. Fatilia mabadiliko ya silabasi na miongozo.
Ekegusii: Abaneri baki buya KASNEB omokirori bante omonene naki omogori mu TVET abere kyeganye buya. Gena motegere osibori naki ekiroria.
Dholuo: Government inegi KASNEB protein gi jomoko mar techini kuom TVET institution, chuny gi winjruok mar thuran. Nyar gi chako nyaka yieng syllabus mar guidelines.
Somali: Dowladda waxay isku keenaysaa tababarka xirfadeed ee KASNEB iyo barnaamijyada farsamada ee hay'adaha TVET si loo wanaajiyo natiijooyinka waxbarasho. La soco manhajka iyo hanuuniyo cusub.

English: PCEA Mama Ngina Primary School is constructing a new nine-classroom block to address overcrowding and enhance learning facilities. Completion is underway to better serve the growing student population.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Msingi ya PCEA Mama Ngina inajenga jengo jipya la madarasa tisa ili kukabiliana na msongamano na kuboresha vifaa vya kujifunzia. Ujenzi unaendelea ili kuhudumia idadi inayokua ya wanafunzi.
Ekegusii: PCEA Mama Ngina Primary School eria omogori omoi oriaire naki obokire buya na omokoro ogenda. Naki omogori buya bw’ogenda ebwaki buya obokire obw’eng’ena bw’akatenda.
Dholuo: PCEA Mama Ngina Primary School orefishe ok nyalwa kar tera ma ok nyalo piny gii chieno me wende ok ohinga. Konyruok ma odiso ok wende ka wendo puodho mag joma nøma.
Somali: PCEA Mama Ngina Dugsiga Hoose waxa uu dhisayaa dhisme cusub oo sagaal fasal ah si loo xalliyo ciriiriga iyo in la hagaajiyo agabka waxbarashada. Shaqada dhamaystirka ayaa socota si loogu adeeggo tirada sii kordheysa ee ardayda.

English: The KUPPET Vihiga Branch urges a revision of school punishment laws to empower teachers in administering discipline. Parents are reminded to pay tuition fees upon school reopening.
Kiswahili: Tawi la KUPPET Vihiga linashauri kufanyiwa marekebisho sheria za adhabu shuleni ili kuwapa uwezo walimu wa kutekeleza nidhamu. Wazazi wanakumbushwa kulipa ada za shule wakati wa kufunguliwa tena.
Ekegusii: KUPPET Vihiga Inyakiiragane ore oreki togeka egesakurane naki omokirori bognasi bwaki buya. Aborangi baria naki bonyekoragane orokiri obwaki bwaki.
Dholuo: KUPPET Vihiga Branch ochung'uru ni mwandhuthi e pinje mar piny jowinji kanyo e bura mar wathogo. Jothurwa ne en geti kende kuom konyo chuo ni oting' yore.
Somali: Laanta KUPPET ee Vihiga waxay ku boorinaysaa dib-u-eegis ku saabsan shuruucda ciqaabta iskuulada si macalimiintu awood ugu helaan inay xakameeyaan anshaxa. Waalidiinta waxaa lagu xasuusinayaa inay bixiyaan lacagta dugsiga marka dugsiyada dib u furmaan.

English: The Kenya Union of Post Primary Education Teachers (KUPPET) urges stricter disciplinary measures against students who assault teachers, including barring offenders from the KCSE examination.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Walimu wa Elimu ya Juu ya Sekondari Kenya (KUPPET) kinatoa wito kwa hatua kali za kidisciplinari dhidi ya wanafunzi wanaoshambulia walimu, ikiwemo kuwazuia wahalifu kufanya mtihani wa KCSE.
Ekegusii: Abakire ba Kenya Union of Post Primary Education Teachers (KUPPET) baria omokang'ana buya bwaki omokosi baashiani batarimbogori abarori, naki baturia buya bushindo bw'ekiburi kya KCSE.
Dholuo: Kenya Union of Post Primary Education Teachers (KUPPET) owinjore duto ma ok othego ng'ato marabira chike, kendo ochamo uyie manyalo kuom KCSE.
Somali: Ururka Macalimiinta Waxbarashada Sare ee Kenya (KUPPET) ayaa ku baaqaya in la qaado tallaabooyin adag oo anshax ah oo loogu talagalay ardayda weerarta macalimiinta, oo ay ku jiraan in la mamnuuco dambiilayaasha ka mid noqoshada imtixaanka KCSE.

English: KUPPET urges political leaders to refrain from interfering in school management to maintain the integrity of the education sector. Respect teachers and school management.
Kiswahili: KUPPET inawahimiza viongozi wa kisiasa kuepuka kuingilia katika usimamizi wa shule ili kuhifadhi uaminifu wa sekta ya elimu. Heshimu walimu na usimamizi wa shule.
Ekegusii: KUPPET emokinyire abaki batekatiga kisichogera mu buya bwengesega buya bw’ekibondori bwakire. Eleka abere baisi na buya bwengesega.
Dholuo: KUPPET owuon richo ma ok nyal chamo ni micho amboya kuom waweyo e tekwen mokuor gige to ginyalo wacho kuom wasomero. Nete wach mang'wen no wasomero to gige.
Somali: KUPPET waxay ku boorinaysaa hoggaamiyeyaasha siyaasadda inay ka fogaadaan faragelinta maamulka dugsiyada si loo ilaaliyo hufnaanta qeybta waxbarashada. Ixtiraam macallimiinta iyo maamulka dugsiyada.

English: The public is invited to honor the legacy of Mama Teresia, who valued education, following her passing at the age of 81.
Kiswahili: Umma unakaribishwa kuheshimu urithi wa Mama Teresia, aliyethamini elimu, kufuatia kifo chake akiwa na umri wa miaka 81.
Ekegusii: Abantu bari bwakire bwaki bwakoma Mama Teresia, ogetoka omosi ogotiri 81, owigania eng'endo y'obereria.
Dholuo: Ng'ato pawinyo kuom gima ohero Mama Teresia, kuom nyiero ma ok nyal joma ji, ka ofe 81.
Somali: Dadweynaha waxaa lagu casuumay inay xusaan dhaxalka Mama Teresia, oo qiimeysay waxbarashada, ka dib markii ay geeriyootay da'deedu ahayd 81 sano.

English: Students in Migori are urged to remain disciplined and focused on their studies during the half-term recess. Parents are encouraged to counsel their children on the importance of education.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa Migori wanahimizwa kubaki na nidhamu na kuzingatia masomo yao wakati wa mapumziko ya nusu muhula. Wazazi wanakumbushwa kuwaelekeza watoto wao kuhusu umuhimu wa elimu.
Ekegusii: Banarirai buya mwaki Migori, bagenyere buya buya baria bukere mtugari bwaki bwetere bwenge. Babere buya buya bagenyere bende bwaki buya bwokirire babako baria buya bwosibori buya.
Dholuo: Adek in Migori en bende ni to kedhi myanga gi dango mar yore mag pinje mokuoch. Kido kendo en jodong' konyo jodho kwach kuom buot duto mar elimu.
Somali: Ardayda Migori ayaa lagu boorinayaa inay ku sii nagaan jiraan anshax iyo inay diiradda saaraan waxbarashadooda inta lagu jiro fasaxa nus-term. Waalidka ayaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay la talinayaan carruurtooda muhiimadda waxbarashada.

English: The Regional Music Festivals are happening from June 29 to July 3 at ACK St. Luke's Wote Township Primary School. Top performers will qualify for the National Music Festivals on July 10, 2026.
Kiswahili: Tamasha la Muziki la Kanda linafanyika kuanzia tarehe 29 Juni hadi 3 Julai katika Shule ya Msingi ya ACK St. Luke's Wote Township. Wanaoshiriki wanaofanya vyema wataweza kuingia katika Tamasha la Muziki la Kitaifa tarehe 10 Julai, 2026.
Ekegusii: Mekenga ya Makariri ya Muto na Itonga ichogoria ku 29 Omogori ku 3 Olokera na ACK St. Luke's Wote Township Primary School. Abakoma banye bamenyere minto ya Makariri ya Muto omogori 10 Nyanga, 2026.
Dholuo: Festivali mar Muziki e yo kod odhiambo ji ka June 29 to July 3 e ACK St. Luke's Wote Township Primary School. Ji marach mochung' e midhi kata jomoko 10, 2026.
Somali: Dabaaldegga Muusigga Gobolka ayaa ka dhacaya 29ka Juun ilaa 3da Luulyo iskuulka hoose ee ACK St. Luke's Wote Township. Fanaaniinta ugu wanaagsan waxay ka qeyb geli doonaan Dabaaldegga Muusigga Qaranka 10ka Luulyo, 2026.

English: The government has launched a three-day ICT integration training for 459 Junior Secondary School teachers in Marsabit County to enhance digital competencies for effective teaching.
Kiswahili: Serikali imezindua mafunzo ya siku tatu ya uhamasishaji wa ICT kwa walimu 459 wa Shule ya Sekondari ya Kati katika Kaunti ya Marsabit ili kuboresha ujuzi wa kidijitali kwa ajili ya ufundishaji bora.
Ekegusii: Abagere bataria bwogori bw'ekigori ekichiri, bokeere 'ICT' bwanogoti bw'amasomo oria abogoria 459 abato b'ekibaaria kiabwaki Marsabit naki oria naki ehaki iboso bw'enchori bw'ekigori.
Dholuo: Govt nyalo jaluo tich mar masiku atatu ma ICT e training mar 459 Junior Secondary School teacher gi Marsabit County kuom gige mag digital to giyudo nyaka onywolo mag tich.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay bilawday tababar saddex maalmood soconaya oo ku saabsan is-dhexgalka ICT ee 459 macalimiin dugsiga dhexe ee Marsabit County si kor loogu qaado xirfadaha dijitaalka ah ee waxbarashada waxtar leh.

English: Vocational Training Centre instructors in Migori County are urged to remain vigilant as promotion letters have not been issued. Delays could affect learning.
Kiswahili: Waalimu wa Vituo vya Mafunzo ya Ufundi katika Kaunti ya Migori wanashauriwa kuwa makini kwani barua za kuongezwa cheo hazijatolewa. Machelezo yanaweza kuathiri kujifunza.
Ekegusii: Abasomi b’amasomo g’ogorori mu Migori County baragoroga bwakire, omogori bakiige bwiitirire okugira ora bonyie omogori basorere. Omosokumokire ogwaki bwakiigana omokoro.
Dholuo: Nyasanjo kanyo ma Vocational Training Centre e Migori County nochung' kanyoni, ni piny mama ber eyo. Nying' kendore adok nyaka ngamongo.
Somali: Macalimiinta Xarunta Tababarka Xirfadeed ee Gobolka Migori waxaa lagula dar-daarmay in ay feejignaadaan maadaama waraaqaha korodhsiinta aan la soo saarin. Dib-u-dhacyada waxay saameyn ku yeelan karaan waxbarashada.

English: Emuhaya Constituency is receiving significant educational infrastructure improvements, including the construction of a new classroom at Emmabwi Senior School and renovations at Emmabwi and Elununi primary schools.
Kiswahili: Jimbo la Emuhaya linapata maboresho makubwa ya miundombinu ya elimu, ikijumuisha ujenzi wa chumba kipya cha darasa katika shule ya sekondari ya Emmabwi na ukarabati katika shule za msingi za Emmabwi na Elununi.
Ekegusii: Emuhaya Constituency inagashagania ngabworia yaki nyakwenye, gaki ekomego buya bwaki bwaki egahiga oria ematechero buya eEmmabwi Senior School na naki rogo egashako eEmmabwi na Elununi primary schools.
Dholuo: Emuhaya Constituency owinj joma nyal mar buchni maler, kendo oketh gi klas moko apar Emmabwi Senior School kendo ohero gi nyalo mag Emmabwi kuom Elununi primary schools.
Somali: Degmada Emuhaya waxay heshay horumarin weyn oo kaabayaasha waxbarashada, oo ay ku jiraan dhismaha fasal cusub oo ku yaal Dugsiga Sare ee Emmabwi iyo dayactirka dugsiyada hoose ee Emmabwi iyo Elununi.

English: Mioro Senior Day School has received its first school bus to improve student transport for academic and co-curricular activities. Four more secondary schools will also receive buses soon.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Mioro ya Sekondari imepokea basi lake la kwanza ili kuboresha usafiri wa wanafunzi kwa shughuli za masomo na za ziada. Shule nyingine nne za sekondari pia zitapokea mabasi hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Mioro Senior Day School engetanga busi ya mbere buya bwaki buora ku geresi bwaki bwaki bwanantorere buya kuviga naki bwakwenge. Masomo aingine emokiri bosi buya engetanga buses buya nyakire.
Dholuo: Mioro Senior Day School en koro ng'ato bus misango mondo obet konyo jomoko kuom gima idhi sani kendo komoruok. Gikinyi dongo abir gi bus oseechogo.
Somali: Mioro Senior Day School ayaa heshay baska dugsiga ugu horreeya si loogu hagaajiyo gaadiidka ardayda ee howlaha waxbarasho iyo kuwa aan waxbarasho ahayn. Afar dugsi sare oo kale ayaa sidoo kale dhawaan heli doona basas.

English: The "Tujiajiri Skills Mitaani" program is enrolling students, including Form Four leavers; 10,000 diploma certificates will be issued. Register now to access vocational training opportunities.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa "Tujiajiri Skills Mitaani" unajiandikisha wanafunzi, ikiwa ni pamoja na wahitimu wa Kidato cha Nne; vyeti 10,000 vya diploma vitatolewa. Jisajili sasa ili upate fursa za mafunzo ya ufundi.
