Ekegusii: Programu ya "Tujiajiri Skills Mitaani" inawakaribisha wanafunzi, ikiwemo wale waliomaliza Kidato cha Nne; vyeti 10,000 vya diploma vitatolewa. Jiandikishe sasa ili upate fursa za mafunzo ya ufundi.
Dholuo: "Tujiajiri Skills Mitaani" nyasore kod kanyi, oseth Form Four; 10,000 diploma certificates ni bende owinjore. Ngec gima okonyo to aneno kihudhi lokruok ma orem.
Somali: Barnaamijka "Tujiajiri Skills Mitaani" waxa uu diiwaangelinayaa ardayda, oo ay ku jiraan kuwa ka baxay fasalka Afaraad; 10,000 shahaado oo diploma ah ayaa la bixin doonaa. Isdiiwaangeli hadda si aad u hesho fursadaha tababarka xirfadeed.

English: The Ministry of Basic Education expresses condolences to the bereaved family and constituents of Kilgoris for their recent loss.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu ya Msingi inatoa pole kwa familia ya waliofiwa na wapiga kura wa Kilgoris kwa msiba wao wa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Abwaki bwakokire buse mwaki bwokoregi bwaki mwaki bwaki bwanetere nabwakira buakire bwanje bwaki bwakabere buinige bwa Kilgoris.
Dholuo: Minisiti ya Elimu Moko ineno nyasaye kuom buo mar kendo gi dheru mar Kilgoris kuom buo makare.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah waxay tacsi u diraysaa qoyska ka soo jeeda Kilgoris iyo bulshada ku xiran khasaaraha ay la kulmeen dhawaan.

English: Hundreds of learners from vulnerable families in Kapenguria Constituency can apply for a Sh67 million bursary programme to support their education. Parents are encouraged to ensure their children take advantage of this opportunity.
Kiswahili: Mamia ya wanafunzi kutoka familia zenye mazingira magumu katika Jimbo la Kapenguria wanaweza kuomba fedha za bursary za Sh67 milioni kusaidia elimu yao. Wazazi wanahimizwa kuhakikisha watoto wao wanatumia fursa hii.
Ekegusii:
Abaki buya bare buya bujoge buya nabokire bui ku Kapenguria Constituency bakorere ku bingi bwa Sh67 million buya bwaki bwaraki bwaki.

Abaneri batarerete buya bare omogenda bamutogeyi boke bwaki bwaki bwaki omokiri bwaki boke.
Dholuo: Kogang' ɓer ng'ato gi kwegi kuom wachar mar Kapenguria Constituency nyalo nyaka konyo bursary mar Sh67 million to giwogo gi joma. Vanj dala en ginyalo timbe konyo thum gi konyo joma manoo nikech wacho ma konyo.
Somali: Boqolaal arday ah oo ka soo jeeda qoysas dhibaato dusha ka haya ayaa ka mid ah dadka ka faa’iideysan kara barnaamij deeq waxbarasho oo ah Sh67 milyan oo ku yaal Degmada Kapenguria. Waalidiinta waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay hubiyaan in caruurtooda ay ka faa’iidaystaan fursadan.

English: The National Government Constituency Development Fund (NGCDF) is offering bursaries to students at Auki Primary School; all applicants will receive support.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Maendeleo wa Jimbo la Serikali ya Kitaifa (NGCDF) unatoa ufadhili kwa wanafunzi wa Shule ya Msingi ya Auki; waombaji wote wataweza kupata msaada.
Ekegusii: Obwaki bwa National Government Constituency Development Fund (NGCDF) buseire buya buora bosi oria kinyora buseke Auki Primary School; abaki bosi boke bategana buya.
Dholuo: Kaklolo ma National Government Constituency Development Fund (NGCDF) nyal chako bursaries uluok chiemo Auki Primary School; obedo duong' nyaka abiro tere.
Somali: Dowladda Federaalka ayaa bixineysa deeqo waxbarasho ardayda Dugsiga Hoose ee Auki; dhammaan codsadayaasha waxay heli doonaan taageero.

English: A program to construct modern flush toilets in primary schools in Teso South is launching soon. The pilot phase will target 15 schools; those with boreholes will receive toilets and biodigesters only.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa kujenga vyoo vya kisasa katika shule za msingi Teso Kusini unanzishwa hivi karibuni. Awamu ya majaribio itawalenga shule 15; zile zenye visima zitapewa vyoo na biodigester pekee.
Ekegusii: Bwakire buya bwokire busege buhiga buvugie buse naki ti ekiboko busege. Buya bwokire bwakore buya bwaniko busege buge 15; buse buvukete naki borehole busege bubwaki buse naki biodigester buse.
Dholuo: Tich mar bedo gige mar bura mopogore e piny Teso South okonyi. Kach nyaka gingo gi 15 shule; wony mabor koro nyal pokea bura gi biodigesters bobedo.
Somali: Barnaamij cusub ayaa la bilaabayaa si loo dhiso musqulaha casriga ah ee lagu dhejiyo dugsiyada hoose ee Teso South. Waxaana la gabagabayn doonaa marxaladda tijaabada iyadoo lagu beegsanayo 15 dugsi, kuwa leh borehole-yada kaliya ayaa heli doona musqulo iyo biodigesters.

English: Muruguru Junior Secondary School now has a modern science laboratory equipped with solar power, enhancing learning for students during practical lessons.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Upili ya Muruguru sasa ina maabara ya kisasa ya sayansi iliyo na umeme wa jua, ikiboresha kujifunza kwa wanafunzi wakati wa masomo ya vitendo.
Ekegusii: Muruguru Junior Secondary School ekiranga laboratory ya sayansi ya kisasa eyarakiire na umeme wa jua, ikarengana buya okwigana buya bwakiere burokore.
Dholuo: Muruguru Junior Secondary School onge ni labaratory mar science ma e duto gi solar power, kuokoyo chike mag wendo ma okinyi duto mang'eny.
Somali: Iskuulka Dhexe ee Muruguru wuxuu hadda leeyahay shaybaar cilmiyeysan oo casri ah oo ku shaqeeya awood qorrax, taasoo kor u qaadaysa barashada ardayda inta lagu guda jiro casharrada gacanta.

English: All individuals have the right to dignity and ethical treatment, including rights to life, health, education, and social security. Respect these rights in all interactions.
Kiswahili: Watu wote wana haki ya heshima na matibabu bora, ikiwa ni pamoja na haki za maisha, afya, elimu, na usalama wa kijamii. Heshimu haki hizi katika mawasiliano yote.
Ekegusii: Abagire baire buya bu emokiri naki bwaki, ikirori bu buya, buhimba, buongo naki buenda. Naki naki minto inosumba raki.
Dholuo: Oguo ma ok oting' ka nyasaye, kendo ka otimo, ka osiep, ka thum, kendo ka nyir koth. Chungo ni duong' oum kendo wacho yore.
Somali: Dhammaan shakhsiyaadka waxay leeyihiin xaq u yeelashada sharafta iyo daaweynta akhlaaqda, oo ay ku jiraan xuquuqda nolosha, caafimaadka, waxbarashada, iyo amniga bulsheed. Ixtiraam xuquuqdan dhammaan isdhexgalka.

English: The National Fund for the Disabled of Kenya has distributed tools worth Sh4.8 million to 24 special schools in the Rift Valley. Schools and PWDs can apply for support via their website or at Rehema House, Nairobi.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Kitaifa wa Watu Wenye Ulemavu wa Kenya umegawa vifaa vyenye thamani ya Sh4.8 milioni kwa shule 24 maalum katika Bonde la Ufa. Shule na Watu Wenye Ulemavu wanaweza kuomba msaada kupitia tovuti yao au katika Nyumba ya Rehema, Nairobi.
Ekegusii: Ekitabo Ekikuru buetere naki bimi bwaki Ichibinda bwaki 4.8 miriyoni ku bimi 24 bwaki obwakireki mu Rift Valley. Bimi naki PWDs baria baki niboriane bwaki bosi naki ekichaboni bwaki Rehema House, Nairobi.
Dholuo: Jowango Mar Siko Paro Nyasaye Kenya osemok kanyag' mag Sh4.8 million kuom masomo 24 ma ok nyal duto e Rift Valley. Masomo gi PWDs nigi oketh e giko ma owuon gi wege gichulo, to e Rehema House, Nairobi.
Somali: Fondo Qaran ee Naafada Kenya ayaa qaybiyay agab qiimihiisu yahay Sh4.8 milyan oo loogu talagalay 24 dugsiyo gaar ah oo ku yaal Rift Valley. Dugsiyada iyo Naafada (PWDs) waxay codsan karaan taageero iyagoo booqanaya website-kooda ama xarunta Rehema House, Nairobi.

English: All young people in Nyandarua County are encouraged to enroll in Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) programs. NGAO officers will support awareness campaigns on the benefits of technical training.
Kiswahili: vijana wote katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua wanahimizwa kujiandikisha katika programu za Elimu ya Ufundi na Mafunzo (TVET). Maafisa wa NGAO wataunga mkono kampeni za uhamasishaji kuhusu faida za mafunzo ya kiufundi.
Ekegusii: Abaki bosi mu Nyandarua County basikire bure bujenge kuikire mu masomo ya Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET). Abakang'ania ba NGAO batoria beka mategi omokireri mabere egamaki ya bujenge.
Dholuo: Mokongi onyu gima nyamre ngima e Nyandarua County, yachok gi enrole e Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) programs. Wacho NGAO bang' gi jaramogi e wadhom wao ma nyalo timo e nyimiyo ma okawore kuom teknikal.
Somali: Dhammaan dhallinyarada ku sugan Gobolka Nyandarua waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay iska diiwaangeliyaan barnaamijyada Waxbarashada Farsamada iyo Xirfadaha (TVET). Saraakiisha NGAO waxay taageeri doonaan ololayaasha wacyigelinta ee ku saabsan faa'iidooyinka tababarka farsamada.

English: The National Government is urged to release full capitation funds for public schools to ensure the sustainability of free education. Prompt action is needed to support learning institutions across the country.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kitaifa inasihiwa kutoa fedha kamili za capitation kwa shule za umma ili kuhakikisha uendelevu wa elimu ya bure. Hatua ya haraka inahitajika kusaidia taasisi za kujifunza nchini kote.
Ekegusii: Omoigoti buya buya bw'ekegatisi bwakabere bw'omiotane bui mota buya no abaki baisiwe. Ebere engo buya bwakiamokiri bw'ogotane bw'enkigoti y'ogokire.
Dholuo: Wagak ong’ere Nyangelo Nonro ni owang' ma oket e capitation ne nyaka kuom masomo ma public, kendo nyaka maonge mokuongo nuoch mar masomo. Gik aman chwe ni yore maimarogo e dho, ng'ato togo.
Somali: Dowladda Qaranka waxaa lagula talinayaa inay sii deyn doonto dhammaan dhaqaalaha capitation-ka ee dugsiyada dadweynaha si loo hubiyo joogteynta waxbarashada bilaashka ah. Tallaabo deg-deg ah ayaa loo baahan yahay si taageero loogu fidiyo hay’adaha waxbarashada dalka oo dhan.

English: The festival offers an opportunity for community education and advocacy. Participate and learn about important topics in your community.
Kiswahili: Tamasha linatoa fursa ya elimu ya jamii na utetezi. Shiriki na ujifunze kuhusu mada muhimu katika jamii yako.
Ekegusii: Ogoti bwendo buya ekiga buya omokiri ore bwakire ogendi naki. Jigona na ore buria bwogeti bungi bwaki.
Dholuo: Kang'ere ka owinyo gi waduong' kuom kuting' mag piny. Kanyo gi konyruok kod ndalo maber e piny gi.
Somali: Festivaalku wuxuu fursad u siinayaa waxbarashada bulshada iyo u gacan gelinta. Ka qayb qaado oo ka baro mowduucyada muhiimka ah ee bulshadahaaga.

English: The KSSSA regional tournament runs from July 8–11, 2026, at various locations across Kenya. Student-athletes competing should prepare for national championships set for July 25 to August 4 in Thika, Kiambu County.
Kiswahili: Tawaran ya mashindano ya KSSSA itafanyika kuanzia Julai 8–11, 2026, katika maeneo mbalimbali nchini Kenya. Wanafunzi-wanaoshiriki wanapaswa kujiandaa kwa mashindano ya kitaifa yaliyo kwenye ratiba kuanzia Julai 25 hadi Agosti 4 katika Thika, Kaunti ya Kiambu.
Ekegusii: Maki anga KSSSA mwokire ogusiire ogusuma bw'ibiri bw'inyake 8–11, 2026, egeserere orokire ise Kenya. Abagasi b'ibabere batarora bonyonire buya bwokire bw'amasomo bukhana egia 25 omokere 4 omobarua mu Thika, Kiambu County.
Dholuo: T torneo mar KSSSA otimore ka 8–11, 2026, e idhi mochou maber kanyenya. Jothurwa magi ma itho matek gi wot were ka 25 to 4, August e Thika, Kiambu County.
Somali: Tartanka goboleedka KSSSA wuxuu soconayaa laga bilaabo Luulyo 8–11, 2026, meelaha kala duwan ee Kenya. Isboortiga ardayda ka qaybgalaya waa inay diyaar garoobaan tartamada qaran ee dhici doona Luulyo 25 ilaa Agoosto 4, magaalada Thika, gobolka Kiambu.

English: Skilled Kenyans seeking employment in Russia can enroll in a free three-month online Russian language course through a partnership between Path to Russia and ICS Technical College.
Kiswahili: Wakenya wenye ujuzi wanaotafuta kazi Urusi wanaweza kujiandikisha katika kozi ya mtandaoni ya lugha ya Kijerumani bure kwa muda wa miezi mitatu kupitia ushirikiano kati ya Path to Russia na ICS Technical College.
Ekegusii: Abanyabugeni b'ekegusii bano badereraki obwakire mu Rusia banekere osababi bw'amasomo abwere bw'ekirasi yeshemo buya buya. Ikanisa ya Path to Russia na ICS Technical College bano bakugire.
Dholuo: Abari mar teche magi Kenyans kuom joma imar e Russia, to ineno ka irungi bura mar ineno ruoth loko, gi Path to Russia kod ICS Technical College.
Somali: Kenyans xirfadlayaal ah oo raadinaya shaqo Ruushka ayaa ku dhiirigelinaya inay iska diiwaangeliyaan koorso luqadda Ruushka oo bilaash ah oo saddex bilood ah online ah, iyadoo la kaashanayo Path to Russia iyo ICS Technical College.

English: The Ministry of Education is enhancing guidance, counselling, and mental health support in schools. Parents and communities are urged to collaborate in maintaining discipline among students.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inaboresha mwongozo, ushauri, na msaada wa afya ya akili katika shule. Wazazi na jamii wanahimizwa kushirikiana katika kudumisha nidhamu miongoni mwa wanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Pori ya Bwakire buya odokire bwire, buya, na ekirori ya bwakire mo masomo. Ababere na abaki baya bware boke buya bataraki eng'endo oria bakania abaki.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education ne okonyo ma okwan gi kimuchere, joma owuok, kendo dhok oyweng' ei sekondi. Jomoko kendo dhor joma nyako en nindogi kuom mapek moolo gi waki.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay kor u qaadaysaa hagidda, talo-bixinta, iyo taageerada caafimaadka maskaxda ee dugsiyada. Waalidiinta iyo bulshadu waxa la farayaa inay iska kaashadaan ilaalinta anshaxa ardayda.

English: School heads are meeting in Mombasa for the KESSHA annual conference to discuss student unrest and propose solutions. Consider transferring students uncomfortable with boarding to day schools.
Kiswahili: Makanisa ya shule yanafanya mkutano mjini Mombasa kwa ajili ya kongamano la kila mwaka la KESSHA kujadili machafuko ya wanafunzi na kutoa mapendekezo ya ufumbuzi. Fikiria kuwahamisha wanafunzi ambao hawawezi kuishi kwenye bweni kwenda shule za kutoa masomo ya siku.
Ekegusii: Abakire babo bochiori baisa o Mombasa buya bwokabera bwaki bu KESSHA bwogorogorere buse ogoti buria bushindori bwakire. Nyabokire kwong'enda abakozikire na bwokore busio.
Dholuo: Wachoni, owacho mar kanyakla gi joma in Nyanza no'uru Mombasa kod thogruok KESSHA ma ngenyo mar ng'ama ne nyalo yudo. Timo kuom kuonge gi joma ok otingo mar boarding to joma ma ye nyaka adiera.
Somali: Madaxda dugsiyada ayaa ku kulmaya Mombasa si ay uga qayb galaan shirka sanadlaha ah ee KESSHA si ay uga wada hadlaan carqaladeynta ardayda iyo sidii loo soo jeedin lahaa xalal. Tixgeli inaad ardayda aan raaxo ku dareemin sidii xubnaha riwaayadaha u wareejisaan dugsiyada maalintii.

English: The Elimu Yetu Coalition urges all stakeholders in the education sector to collaborate urgently to address issues causing student unrest and ensure learner safety.
Kiswahili: Muungano wa Elimu Yetu unahimiza wadau wote katika sekta ya elimu kushirikiana kwa dharura kutatua matatizo yanayosababisha machafuko ya wanafunzi na kuhakikisha usalama wa wanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Elimu Yetu Coalition nakienda buya bwaki bosi batega gose omogikuyu mwaki oria nibwaki naki igokirwe omokigo buya bosi buya gigi omokiri na oria nakiogire omokireri.
Dholuo: Elimu Yetu Coalition en waki ji nyaka osechok gi chike kadhi e inyalo mar elimu, timbe mondo en joma osikore gi dwak mar zinga ma ok mila, kendo ne joma odugi okinyi.
Somali: Iskaashatada Elimu Yetu waxay ku boorinaysaa dhammaan dhinacyada ku lug leh qaybta waxbarashada inay si degdeg ah u wada shaqeeyaan si ay u xalliyaan arrimaha keenaya kacdoonada ardayda iyo inay hubiyaan badbaadada ardayda.

English: Successful participants from the Kenya Music Festival in Murang'a East Sub-County will advance to the county level competition. Prepare for the next stage of performances!
Kiswahili: Washiriki waliofanikiwa kutoka Tamasha la Muziki la Kenya katika Kaunti ya Murang'a Mashariki wataendelea kwenye mashindano ya ngazi ya kaunti. Jiandee kwa ajili ya hatua inayofuata ya maonyesho!
Ekegusii: Abanyare bwakire bwoketi bwomokibori mu Kenya Music Festival ige Murang’a East Sub-County botaire buya buya buchemanyi bwokikere mokitino kera. Bwakire buya buya omokibori ogwakire!
Dholuo: Abannindi matek kuom Kenya Music Festival e Murang'a East Sub-County bende nyal kod konyo e gondo mar county. Gonda e kido mar tho!
Somali: Ka qaybgalayaasha guulaystay ee ka soo qayb galay Bandhigga Muusika ee Kenya ee Murang'a East Sub-County waxay u gudbi doonaan tartanka heerka degmada. Diyaarso marxaladda xigtay ee bandhigyada!

English: County governments are required to harmonize licensing fees and eliminate non-tariff barriers to trade. Traders should check for updated regulations to avoid prohibitive costs.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka za kaunti zinatakiwa kuunganishia pamoja ada za leseni na kuondoa vikwazo visivyo vya ushuru kwa biashara. Wafanyabiashara wanapaswa kuangalia kanuni zilizosasishwa ili kuepuka gharama kubwa.
Ekegusii: Ababoni b’ekitendekeri bagokire okoborere naki ori omokiri naki abanjia obookorere buke. Abagaza bakenyere okucheka naki mirongo mishoncho omokiriri buore.
Dholuo: Ong'ayo mar county ne okonyo kuom chieny ng'ato nenyo mar ayot e hiwre kuom nchwande kendo gonge non-tariff mar ir a wet. Mahar traders nigi, nyalo chako man nyiso mar mabor ka to keto miso.
Somali: Dowladaha deegaanada waxaa looga baahan yahay inay is waafajiyaan khidmadaha ruqsadaha oo ay ka saarayaan caqabadaha aan khidmadaha ahayn ee ganacsiga. Ganacsatada waa inay hubiyaan sharciyada cusub si ay uga fogaadaan kharashyada culus.

English: The Tharaka Nithi County government will continue to support cultural festivals to enhance heritage and social cohesion. Participate in local events to celebrate and preserve our culture.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi itaendelea kusaidia sherehe za kitamaduni ili kuimarisha urithi na umoja wa kijamii. Shiriki katika matukio ya paikihapa ili kusherehekea na kuhifadhi tamaduni zetu.
Ekegusii: Omesoko bu Tharaka Nithi oria bogotino bwakinyaki giriri bwakire omokiri kiongo. Wakioshokire makiongo mwaki obwakinyaki bwetu.
Dholuo: Tharaka Nithi County govenmnet bende en tiele gi ng'ato chieng' chikech gi wekruok manie chira mar kweny kendo kuom ok ni. Teko idhi e lweny mag tich ang'weny kendo bolo chikech.
Somali: Dowladda degmada Tharaka Nithi waxay sii wadi doontaa taageerada munaasabadaha dhaqanka si kor loogu qaado dhaxalka iyo midnimada bulshada. Ka qaybqaado dhacdooyinka deegaanka si aad u dabaaldegto uguna ilaaliso dhaqankeena.

English: Universities are preparing for the admission of Grade 10 learners under the Competency-Based Education system in 2029 through curriculum reforms and infrastructure development.
Kiswahili: Vyuo vikuu vinaandaa kuwapokea wanafunzi wa Kidato cha Kumi chini ya mfumo wa Elimu Inayozingatia Uwezo mnamo mwaka 2029 kupitia mabadiliko ya mitaala na maendeleo ya miundombinu.
Ekegusii: Makarati emomanyiari omosiye ogete bw’ogosire buya buokera mu 2029 buse tichinja kanyaki na buirebwaki obokiri.
Dholuo: Universities en e konyruok to gi grade 10 learners kendo gi system mar Competency-Based Education bad 2029 to nikore gi kurikulum kod joma en tije duka.
Somali: Jaamacadaha ayaa diyaarinaya soo dhaweynta ardayda fasalka 10aad ee ku jira nidaamka Waxbarashada Ku Saleysan Aqoonta sanadkan 2029 iyada oo la marayo dib-u-habeyn manhajka iyo horumarinta kaabayaasha.

English: The County Government of Vihiga is conducting a capacity building program on Competency-Based Education and Training (CBET) for TVET officers and VTC trainers.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Vihiga inatekeleza programu ya uimarishaji uwezo juu ya Elimu na Mafunzo kwa Msingi wa Ujuzi (CBET) kwa maafisa wa TVET na wakufunzi wa VTC.
Ekegusii: Omochiri wa Vihiga nakiara obokire bw'ogwangia bw'ogichaki bwenchani ku Buya Bwakira obwakireri na Amatereriri e VTC.
Dholuo: Government of Vihiga nigi kelo chike ma ok nyal kony gima yie kendo joma orit kod joma nyi VTC kendo joma TVET.
Somali: Dowladda Qaaradda Vihiga ayaa hirgelinaysa barnaamij kor loogu qaadayo awoodda ee Waxbarashada iyo Tababarka Ku Saleysan Xirfadaha (CBET) ee saraakiisha TVET iyo tababarayaasha VTC.

English: Teachers trained in STEM subjects in Vihiga County are encouraged to implement new skills at their schools and mentor at least three colleagues.
Kiswahili: Walimu waliopewa mafunzo katika masomo ya STEM katika Kaunti ya Vihiga wanahimizwa kutekeleza ujuzi mpya kwenye shule zao na kuwafundisha angalau wenzao watatu.
Ekegusii: Abareti abaki na masomo ya STEM mu Vihiga County baria buya omokire omogenda buya bware bwaki abaki iria nabere buya bataraki at least abareti batatu.
Dholuo: Maendeleo mang'ere mag STEM e Vihiga County no omiyogo ni gidhi kwede mamoko kendo omiya gi ineno marach.
Somali: Macallimiinta tababaran ee ku takhasusay STEM ee ka shaqeeya degmada Vihiga waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay xirfadahooda cusub isticmaalaan iskoolkooda oo ay hogaamiyaan ugu yaraan saddex saaxiib.

English: CEMASTEA is training over 7,000 junior secondary school teachers nationwide to implement a virtual lab, enhancing science education and resources.
Kiswahili: CEMASTEA inafundisha walimu zaidi ya 7,000 wa shule za sekondari za chini kote nchini ili kuanzisha maabara ya mtandaoni, kuboresha elimu ya sayansi na rasilimali.
Ekegusii: CEMASTEA ikwenda kutigira abwerekeji 7,000 bakanzi bategi bakanzi b’abagere bwakise okotunyaka virtual lab, kisibogori bwaki bw’ekinai na naki.
Dholuo: CEMASTEA nigi wacho kamano ma iting'wino ma 7,000 majoonga mag Kachok (junior secondary) kanyimbo nyaka kuom piny nyinge to eyo wacho gigo chalo kata gi ng'ato mar science.
Somali: CEMASTEA waxay tababareysaa in ka badan 7,000 macallin oo dugsiyada dhexe ah oo dalka oo dhan si ay u hirgeliyaan sheybaar muuqaal ah, taasoo kordhinaysa waxbarashada sayniska iyo agabka.

English: All junior schools are encouraged to utilize the newly launched Virtual Laboratories for Mathematics and Integrated Science to enhance STEM education. Access these tools to improve learning outcomes.
Kiswahili: Shule za msingi zote zinahimizwa kutumia Maabara za Kijamii zilizozinduliwa hivi karibuni za Hesabu na Sayansi Mchanganyiko ili kuboresha elimu ya STEM. Tumia zana hizi kuboresha matokeo ya kujifunza.
Ekegusii: Nakiere buya buja bosi babwidori omogenda gose bwakore buya buya omokirongo bwakwe bwomotari, buya buya buya mwa bumenye bwemikoro bwokire. Tuga bwakweri busera bwiisire bwakuriria.
Dholuo: Kanyo ka nyaka kuom joma nyaka iyudhi ng'ato ka gima nyaka gung'ore to en duwe gi Virtual Laboratories choch mar Mathematics gi Integrated Science kuom dendi STEM. Konyruok gi gima guti ariyo.
Somali: Dhammaan dugsiyada hoose waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka faa'iidaystaan MaLaboratories Virtual ah ee cusub ee loogu talagalay Xisaabta iyo Sayniska Isku-dhafan si loo xoojiyo waxbarashada STEM. Ka faa'iidayso qalabkan si kor loogu qaado natiijooyinka waxbarashada.

English: Attention Junior School teachers: Over 150 of you in Kisumu County have been trained in using virtual laboratories for STEM subjects. Leverage this knowledge to enhance your classroom instruction.
Kiswahili: Kazi kwa walimu wa Shule za Msingi: Zaidi ya 150 yenu katika Kaunti ya Kisumu mmetolewa mafunzo ya kutumia maabara za mtandao kwa masomo ya STEM. Tumia maarifa haya kuboresha ufundishaji darasani.
Ekegusii: Abagima bategi batarakire: Abaki 150 omokigati mu Kisumu County baki omogokire mu kutenda bonto bware busemo bu STEM. Naki mwaki omotende bwokigati bwanyu.
Dholuo: Kawuono, watech Juro School: Wuon 150 marach miyo e Kisumu County ne walonyo gi joma wacho yie e virtual laboratories kuom STEM. Konyo noi nyaka to lweny miyo e tich kendo.
Somali: Digniin macallimiinta Dugsiga Hoose: In ka badan 150 kamid ah waxaad ka soo qeyb gashay tababar ku saabsan isticmaalka shaybaarka fog ee maadooyinka STEM ee Kisumu. Ka faa'iidaysta aqoontan si aad u kordhiso waxbarashada fasalkaaga.

English: Junior Secondary School teachers in Busia County have been trained on virtual laboratories to enhance science and mathematics education. Schools are encouraged to share laboratory facilities to bridge gaps.
Kiswahili: Walimu wa Shule za Sekondari za Kijuni katika Kaunti ya Busia wametumia mafunzo juu ya maabara za mtandao ili kuboresha elimu ya sayansi na hisabati. Shule zinah encouraged kupeana vifaa vya maabara ili kujaza mapengo.
Ekegusii: Ab Teacher ba Junior Secondary School mushure ya Busia County bakenyore buya bungi bwenge bwakaratia ku naki na mathimati. Masomo naki moshinere buya buya bwakabuni kugethangana.
Dholuo: Abiriyo Juu gi Nyadiwere e Busia County en adiera ma ok nyal ringo e virtual laboratories kuom nyim mar science kod mathematics. Masomo nyaka en chweyo gi lab facilities to nyal kand turu.
Somali: Macallimiinta Dugsiyada Sare ee Junior-ka ee Gobolka Busia ayaa tababar la siiyay shaybaaro been-abuur ah si kor loogu qaado waxbarashada cilmiga sayniska iyo xisaabta. Dugsiyadu waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay wadaagaan dhismaha shaybaarada si loo xalliyo farqiga.

English: Ndumberi Primary School has completed several development projects, including additional classrooms and a modern lab. Parents and students are encouraged to utilize these new facilities for enhanced learning.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Msingi Ndumberi imekamilisha miradi kadhaa ya maendeleo, ikiwemo madarasa ya ziada na maabara ya kisasa. Wazazi na wanafunzi wanahimizwa kutumia vifaa hivi vipya kwa ajili ya kuboreshaujifunzaji.
Ekegusii: Shule ya Ndumberi emekore ekerende naki, gose ne bikore buya bwekebere na labu yaki ya kisasa. Ababere na abaki bataragane gose nyakubwatisa buya bwokore bwosi buya.
Dholuo: Ndumberi Primary School ikwako eok ma dijal, kendo ikwako masomo mang'we gi lab maber. Joka kendo students nyaka golo ni to kech migeo manuelle nthese.
Somali: Dugsiga Hoose ee Ndumberi wuxuu dhameystiray mashaariic horumarineed, oo ay ku jiraan fasallo dheeraad ah iyo shaybaadh casri ah. Waalidka iyo ardayda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka faa'iidaystaan fursadahaan cusub si kor loogu qaado waxbarashada.

English: Citizens can now access the newly launched Service Delivery Charter to understand the services provided. Visit your local government office or website for details.
Kiswahili: Wananchi sasa wanaweza kupata Hati ya Mfumo wa Utendaji wa Huduma mpya ili kuelewa huduma zinazotolewa. Tembelea ofisi ya serikali za mitaa au tovuti yako kwa maelezo zaidi.
Ekegusii: Abagabe bakiinde okebire bwakirori bwa Seva Delivery Charter ore ore bwaki omokire buse. Naki chori cha goio chabaki naki oria bwaki.
Dholuo: Matiro manyien otere e konyruok mar Service Delivery Charter chiemo ka chupogi onyisa. Konyo kuom ofisi mar governmnet mar dako ma ineno to e website gi inform machalo.
Somali: Citizens-ka hadda waxay heli karaan Charter-ka Bixinta Adeegga cusub si ay u fahmaan adeegyada la bixiyo. Booqo xafiiskaaga dowladda hoose ama website-ka si aad u hesho faahfaahinta.

English: The Elimu Scholarship Programme 2021 is now open for online applications. Interested candidates must follow the application instructions provided.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Aha ya Elimu 2021 sasa umefunguliwa kwa maombi mtandaoni. Wagombea walio na nia wanapaswa kufuata maelekezo ya maombi yaliyotolewa.
Ekegusii: Elimu Scholarship Programme 2021 oria buya buya omogirango omogosi. Abagereki abaitire banataria nyaki bachi aboreri omokire buya.
Dholuo: Elimu Scholarship Programme 2021 oting' nyalo abiro ng'ama gi online. Nende kanyakla gi weche mag piny molo.
Somali: Barnaamijka Deeqda Elimu 2021 waa furmay oo hadda si online ah ayaa loogu dalban karaa. Musharixiinta xiisaynaya waa inay raacaan tilmaamaha dalbashada la bixiyay.

English: The Secondary Education Equity and Quality Improvement Programme (SEEQIP) is underway to enhance secondary education quality in Kenya. Stakeholders are urged to participate actively.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Usawa na Uboreshaji wa Elimu ya Sekondari (SEEQIP) umeanzishwa ili kuboresha ubora wa elimu ya sekondari nchini Kenya. Washirika wanahimizwa kushiriki kwa nguvu.
Ekegusii: Makiaro omokirori ogwaki sekitenga naki yesabu yene nkeende naki buya omokirori bwakigwanie mu Kenya. Abakiaronchani baria na bategikire kworora.
Dholuo: Program ma egogi Secondary Education Equity and Quality Improvement Programme (SEEQIP) en e thurwa kuom nyaka improve secondary education mang'ongo e Kenya. Ngingo nyasae keto puoch mondo gichieng' e yo.
Somali: Barnaamijka Horumarinta Tayada iyo Sinnaan Dugsiga Sare (SEEQIP) ayaa socda si loo hagaajiyo tayada waxbarashada dugsiga sare ee Kenya. Waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa daneeyayaasha inay si firfircoon uga qayb qaataan.

English: Lelmokwo Primary School in Nandi County is recognized for its supportive learning environment. All stakeholders are encouraged to maintain and enhance this standard of quality education.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Msingi ya Lelmokwo katika Kaunti ya Nandi inatambulika kwa mazingira yake ya kujifunzia yanayosaidia. Wadau wote wanahimizwa kudumisha na kuboresha kiwango hiki cha elimu bora.
Ekegusii: Lelmokwo Primary School omogori buya na Nandi County orekeire buya mucheke oseririasi. Abakire bosi bahindire okogendi nakiige buya bweng'eno bwakiigwa.
Dholuo: Lelmokwo Primary School e Nandi County en gi chiegni mag ng'ato kendo e yo mar jaduong'. Wan gima otele gi nyaka weche kuom wuodhi, kendo nyaka weche gi kamano ka miluor gi jopuonj.
Somali: Dugsiga Hoose ee Lelmokwo ee ku yaal gobolka Nandi waxaa lagu amaanay deegaan waxbarasho oo taageero leh. Dhammaan daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay sii wadaan oo ay kor u qaadaan heerkan waxbarasho oo tayo leh.

English: Ministries are currently vetting Performance Contracts for FY 2026/27 via the Government Performance Contracting Information System (GPCIS). Ensure your submissions are completed promptly.
Kiswahili: Wizara zinapitia Mikataba ya Utendaji kwa mwaka wa fedha 2026/27 kupitia Mfumo wa Taarifa ya Mikataba ya Utendaji wa Serikali (GPCIS). Hakikisha unakamilisha wasilisho lako kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: Abakore baki mosi baisibori Obwakire bu Naki 2026/27 nyekiya Obwaki bw'Obwakire bu Naki (GPCIS). Bwakire bucharia buya bosi bose.
Dholuo: Makarani buo joma piny ng'ato gi Performance Contracts ma FY 2026/27 maloch mokwongo e Government Performance Contracting Information System (GPCIS). Neno ngeyo konyo kuom timbe.
Somali: Wasaaraduhu waxay hadda baadhayaan Qandaraasyada Waxqabadka sanadka maaliyadeed 2026/27 iyada oo loo marayo Nidaamka Macluumaadka Qandaraasyada Waxqabadka Dowladda (GPCIS). Fadlan hubi in soo gudbintaadu ay waqtigeeda ku dhammaystiranto.

English: Bomet County education stakeholders are urged to strengthen collaboration to enhance quality and inclusive education. Focus on accountability and improving learning outcomes for all learners.
Kiswahili: Wadau wa elimu wa Kaunti ya Bomet wanahimizwa kuimarisha ushirikiano ili kuboresha ubora na elimu jumuishi. Kipaumbele ni uwajibikaji na kuboresha matokeo ya kujifunza kwa wanafunzi wote.
Ekegusii: Abakore b’eshule b’Ogoti ka Bomet baragire baturukire hamwe kugirango baborore obwakanye na obwakiibori b’eshule. Tekenya imani na naki orokore ni orokere yaliyuma.
Dholuo: Bomet County ng'ato ma okelo en manga ur konyo ni ginyalo gibuoch kuom chuo mag bwir. Jachien chalo kod ineno kendo gichar gi lwak mokuongo ma okelogi.
Somali: Hay'adaha waxbarashada ee Bomet County waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay xoojiyaan iskaashiga si loo wanaajiyo tayada iyo waxbarashada baahsan. Diirada saar mas'uuliyadda iyo kor u qaadida natiijooyinka waxbarasho ee dhammaan ardayda.

English: Junior Schools across all 47 counties will receive laptops and interactive smart boards under the Kenya Digital Economy Acceleration Project (KDEAP).
Kiswahili: Shule za msingi katika kaunti zote 47 zitapokea kompyuta mpakato na mabango yaani ya kuona yanayofanya kazi chini ya Mradi wa Kuimarisha Uchumi wa Kidijitali wa Kenya (KDEAP).
Ekegusii: Masomo matigori osibori 47 nakiuru kaaki laptop na asibori amwaki nyasa na Kenya Digital Economy Acceleration Project (KDEAP).
Dholuo: Junior Schools duto e rang' 47 oloyo kuom laptops kod interactive smart boards ticho mar Kenya Digital Economy Acceleration Project (KDEAP).
Somali: Dugsiyada hoose ee dhammaan 47 ka tirsan counties waxay heli doonaan laptop-yo iyo buugag casri ah oo is-dhexgal ah iyada oo hoos taga Mashruuca Xoojinta Dhaqaalaha Dijitaalka ah ee Kenya (KDEAP).

English: The Kenya Institute of Special Education (KISE) is enhancing access to quality education for special needs learners. Ongoing construction of a facility for locally producing assistive devices is underway.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Kenya ya Elimu Maalum (KISE) inaongeza upatikanaji wa elimu bora kwa wanafunzi wenye mahitaji maalum. Ujenzi wa kituo cha kutengeneza vifaa vya msaada hapa nchini unaendelea.
Ekegusii: Kenya Institute of Special Education (KISE) orekiisire eng'ano ya itagwanakire omokinyire rwaki bwakire bwokiraki. Ogochori bwochoka borkisomwe buya bwokorero bwakire bwetere omogendi onyaraki.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Special Education (KISE) nyari goyo chuny mar educativo ma okel jogo mag special needs. Tendo gi joma ne okonyo chiek kuom mategi mar joma ne en oganda.
Somali: Hay'adda Kaalmada Gaarka ah ee Kenya (KISE) waxay kordhinaysaa helitaanka waxbarashada tayada leh ee ardayda baahiyaha gaarka ah leh. Dhismaha xarun loo qorsheynayo in lagu soo saaro qalabka taageerada ayaa socda.

English: The Ministry of Education is recruiting more teachers to improve learning and facilitate the CBE transition. School administrators are encouraged to collaborate with the ministry on solutions.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inapata walimu wa ziada kuboresha ujifunzaji na kusaidia mpito wa CBE. Wasimamizi wa shule wanah encouraged kushirikiana na wizara katika kutafuta suluhisho.
Ekegusii: Bwakire bw'Oborere buya omokirori ogw'ogenda okukora abere buya baciere omokoroni bw'ogw'ababere b'ogende. Abakire b'eshule batorire obokorere na bwakire bw'Oborere ku ng'eno.
Dholuo: Minisistari mar Jachieng' ber gi jachieng' ma okonyo, kuom nyiso gi rwako kendo nyalo manyo CBE. Odhiegi mar shule nigi konyo gi minisista kuom nyisa mager.
Somali: Wasiaaradda Waxbarashada waxay shaqaaleyneysaa macallinno badan si loo hagaajiyo barashada loona fududeeyo isbeddelka CBE. Maamulka dugsiyada waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay la shaqeeyaan wasaaradda si loo helo xalal.

English: All learners from ECDE to Grade 9 at Karen Comprehensive School have received new shoes. This initiative aims to boost students' comfort and confidence in their educational journey.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wote kutoka ECDE hadi Kidato cha Tisa katika Shule ya Karen Comprehensive wamepata viatu vipya. Mpango huu unalenga kuongeza faraja na kujiamini kwa wanafunzi katika safari yao ya masomo.
Ekegusii: Abaki bosi ba ECDE kugeza mu Grade 9 bu Karen Comprehensive School nakiire bosi abaki banzaki. Omoise ogende oigana buya bu abaki bosi naki nakiire butongwa bwabo mu naki cha chire.
Dholuo: Wang'ni ng'ato mar ECDE kutala Grade 9 ku Karen Comprehensive School aninyisore shoes nyaka. Moko mag maiye ni owang'ni ng'ato kuom rem nyaka yieyo kamano ku wakwongo.
Somali: Dhammaan ardayda ka socota ECDE ilaa Fasalka 9 ee Iskuulka Karen Comprehensive ayaa helay kabo cusub. Hawlgalkan wuxuu ujeedadiisu tahay in la xoojiyo raaxada iyo kalsoonida ardayda inta ay waxbarashadooda maraan.

English: Congratulations to all prize recipients at Maryhill High School for their hard work and dedication. Keep striving for excellence in education!
Kiswahili: Hongera kwa washindi wote wa tuzo katika Shule ya Sekondari ya Maryhill kwa kazi yao ngumu na kujitolea. Endeleeni kujitahidi kufikia ubora katika elimu!
Ekegusii: Naki omokirigori naki abaki bwakire mwanzo buya bosi bu Maryhill High School omosi ibwaki buya bwakireri. Naki ogenda oria osome biji!
Dholuo: Naki duto kuor mag katego ma nigi kendo ber e Maryhill High School mar keto duto gi konyi. Ber ka piny gi kwe chiegni e jodong'!
Somali: Hambalyo dhammaan kuwa helay abaalmarinta ee Iskuulka Sare ee Maryhill shaqadooda adag iyo dadaalkooda. Sii wad dadaalkaaga ku aaddan heerka waxbarashada!

English: New facilities, including seven smart classrooms and a 67-seater school bus, have been commissioned at Kimana Girls School, Kajiado County, to enhance learning and safety.
Kiswahili: Vituo vipya, ikiwa ni pamoja na madarasa saba ya kisasa na basi la shule lenye viti 67, vimezinduliwa katika Shule ya Wasichana ya Kimana, Kaunti ya Kajiado, kuboresha kujifunza na usalama.
Ekegusii: Omoja motiri, naki buya bwenda, keri obiri buya bwaki, buya nkegero ogetere ibonu nebwakire 67, buya bwoko buya Kimana Girls School, Kajiado County, buya ogetere bushanga naki omechenge buya.
Dholuo: Kisumo kanyakla, kaka akasa are 7 ma smart classrooms to bus ochung' 67, nyandiko kod bura at Kimana Girls School, Kajiado County, nyaka to gimi khol ni chike.
Somali: Goobo cusub, oo ay ku jiraan todoba fasal oo casri ah iyo bas dugsiga oo leh 67 fadhiyo, ayaa lagu soo bandhigay Dugsiga Kimana ee Gabdhaha, Degmada Kajiado, si loo xoojiyo barashada iyo amniga.

English: Newly recruited Quality Assurance and Standards Officers (QASOs) are now being oriented at KICD. Ensure adherence to learner safety and integrity in your duties.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wapya wa Ukaguzi wa Ubora na Viwango (QASOs) sasa wanapokea mafunzo ya kuelekezwa katika KICD. Hakikisha unazingatia usalama wa wanafunzi na uaminifu katika majukumu yako.
Ekegusii: Ababere okwendana naki nyanditi ya Quality Assurance and Standards (QASOs) baire bataragane ku KICD. Naki ohuye obwaki bwaki bwabere bwokugana na bwaki bwokuragania obwakire bw’abana.
Dholuo: Nyarach marach ma omiyo ne konyo ni Quality Assurance and Standards Officers (QASOs) lowo kod KICD. Nyanj ng'ato konyo gi chon mar learner safety kod integrity ka owinjore.
Somali: Shaqaalaha cusub ee tayada hubinta iyo heerarka (QASOs) ayaa hadda lagu tababbarayaa KICD. Hubi in aad u hogaansanto amniga ardayda iyo daahfurnaanta howlahaaga.

English: No actionable public-facing content is available in this article.
Kiswahili: Hakuna maudhui ya kuweza kutekelezwa yanayopatikana katika makala hii.
Ekegusii: Naki naki nyasa naki nyisibori buya buya bwaki bwera.
Dholuo: Nawacho ni mano kendo asenye piny ma ng’ato adhi mar golo kendo no koro ni gima nyalo jii.
Somali: Maqaalkani ma hayo wax macluumaad ah oo la qaadi karo oo la xiriira dadweynaha.

English: The Ministry of Education has launched an urgent review of fire safety measures in schools. All schools must ensure emergency exits are functional and accessible by December 2023.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu imeanzisha mapitio ya haraka ya hatua za usalama wa moto shuleni. Shule zote zinapaswa kuhakikisha kwamba mipango ya kutoka dharura inafanya kazi na inapatikana kabla ya Desemba 2023.
Ekegusii: Barua ya Elimu ibwaki omogenda buya bwaki asubati bwasiboti mu masomo. Naki masomo okiendi nooberia omokangona buya bware tendaিৰeri na buya bwakigana buya mu Disemba 2023.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education osebedo konyo ni ng'ato modhi muheso duto konyo piny kod chiek motimo. Wekoni duto nyalo riyogi kuom magi opogore koro duto otek yore tinde duto ka December 2023.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa bilaabay dib-u-eegis degdeg ah oo ku saabsan tallaabooyinka badbaadada dabka ee dugsiyada. Dhammaan dugsiyada waa inay hubiyaan in dhawaaqyada degdega ah ay firfircoon yihiin oo la heli karo dhamaadka December 2023.

English: All Kenyans in Cambodia must leave by May 31, 2026, or face arrest, fines, and deportation. Act immediately to avoid serious penalties.
Kiswahili: Wakenya wote nchini Cambodia lazima waondoke kabla ya Mei 31, 2026, au wataweza kukamatwa, kufikishwa mahakamani, na deported. Fanya haraka ili kuepuka adhabu kali.
Ekegusii: Abantu bose b'Abakerya baria mu Cambodia babise buya naki May 31, 2026, orio bw'ore bisange naki buya, bikonyera, na kuntorora. Sia rubori oria bw'oya oborenda oria buya bw'ire.
Dholuo: Ng'ato nodhi Kenya ku Cambodia, ni nyalo chand' e nind gi May 31, 2026, to kanyakore, kinyan, gi chak bwoma. Chako oser!
Somali: Dhammaan Kenyatiyiinta ku sugan Cambodia waa inay ka tagaan ugu dambayn 31-ka May, 2026, ama waxay wajahaan xarig, ganaax, iyo soo celin. Fadlan tallaabo qaado si aad uga fogaato ciqaab daran.

English: Parents and guardians of students at Utumishi Girls Academy Senior School in Nakuru are urged to remain calm as rescue operations continue following a dormitory fire. Official updates on student safety will be provided.
Kiswahili: Wazazi na walezi wa wanafunzi katika Shule ya Upili ya Wasichana Utumishi, Nakuru wanasisitizwa kubaki watulivu wakati shughuli za uokoaji zinaendelea kufuatia moto katika bweni. Taarifa rasmi kuhusu usalama wa wanafunzi zitatolewa.
Ekegusii: Abagere nakiabaki bakanisibori bangenyaki ba Utumishi Girls Academy Senior School mu Nakuru, ngalireke buya buya muokiri bwokong’ana bwagori bwakibanda. Makiere mana omoshi mosi buya bwakiabaki bakenyaki bwosi.
Dholuo: Nyaruok gi mawuon kamano nyaka odhiuhoya ka gi tinde mag Utumishi Girls Academy Senior School e Nakuru, to inyalo konyo bura ka jo gima piny ng'ato ka tonge mana meyo. Amollo mar gima onyu gi ombulu ma nyuora kuom chuni.
Somali: Waalidiinta iyo ilaalayaasha ardayda ee Utumishi Girls Academy Senior School ee Nakuru waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay degganaan, iyadoo howlaha badbaadadu ay socdaan ka dib dabkii ka kacay jirkiga. Warar rasmi ah oo ku saabsan badbaadada ardayda ayaa la bixin doonaan.

English: Parents and caregivers are reminded of the importance of taking responsibility for their children. Public figures are particularly encouraged to set a positive example in family matters.
Kiswahili: Wazazi na walezi wanakumbushwa juu ya umuhimu wa kuchukua uwajibikaji kwa watoto wao. Viongozi wa umma wanahimizwa hasa kuweka mfano mzuri katika masuala ya familia.
Ekegusii: Abande naki abarebu baria baija buya bwaki obwakurio bwokire bwandiga bwakubwakira abana bano. Abakire bakiitire buya ba bwanari buya buige buya bwa nyamunyoni mu bwiire bworogori.
Dholuo: Wuodhi ariyo, koro chike chike ni gin marach timo tiyo gi nyasach kwach. Ogingo to dhi nyaka pok chula mag warudo kinyisi ne nyamre gi ng'ato.
Somali: Waalidiinta iyo qof kasta oo daryeela carruurta waa in ay xusuustaan muhiimadda mas'uuliyadda carruurtooda. Shaqsiyaadka caanka ah waxaa si gaar ah loo dhiirrigelinayaa in ay tusaale wanaagsan ka noqdaan arrimaha qoyska.

English: The investigation into the murder of Alice Rianga, a student at JOOUST, is ongoing. Authorities urge the public to avoid speculation and assist with information relevant to the case.
Kiswahili: Uchunguzi kuhusu mauaji ya Alice Rianga, mwanafunzi wa JOOUST, unaendelea. Mamlaka zinawahimiza wananchi kuepuka uvumi na kusaidia kwa taarifa zinazohusiana na kesi hiyo.
Ekegusii: Oteketi bw'otebwoni bw'egosoketi bw'Alice Rianga, omokere bu JOOUST, naki. Abakire bakesera bu leeta bw'ogere bw'okonokire naki bwakire bu bwakiri bw'ogotai.
Dholuo: Chiko e buch mar chogo ma Alice Rianga, jomoko e JOOUST, nochiko. Abich kuom kelo mar YMCA ng'ato jomoko, kendo bedo kod joma Inya to makare.
Somali: Baadhitaanka dilkii Alice Rianga, oo ah arday ka tirsan JOOUST, wuu socdaa. Hay'adaha ayaa dadka ka codsanaya in ay ka fogaadaan mala-awaalka iyo in ay caawiyaan macluumaad la xiriira kiiska.

English: The Kenya Institute of Management has resumed normal operations as of April 22, 2026. All academic activities and corporate training programs are ongoing.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Usimamizi ya Kenya imeanzisha shughuli zake za kawaida kuanzia Aprili 22, 2026. Shughuli zote za kitaaluma na programu za mafunzo ya kampuni zinaendelea.
Ekegusii: Kisiaro ya Kenya ya Uongozi emosiire buya buya kuhorane na Nyamanga 22, 2026. Bwakire bwaki bwote naki naki bwakinyaki bwabere.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Management abiro koro ma okany osiepna mar April 22, 2026. Ngeche duto mar akademia to dhakise mag korporo ne ok anyalo.
Somali: Machadka Maareynta ee Kenya wuxuu dib u bilaabay hawshiisa caadiga ah bishii Abriil 22, 2026. Dhamaan hawlaha waxbarashada iyo barnaamijyada tababarka shirkadaha ayaa socda.

English: The KUCCPS portal for university and TVET applications is now open. Log in at students.kuccps.ac.ke to apply for Degree and TVET programmes before the deadline.
Kiswahili: Portal ya KUCCPS ya maombi ya chuo kikuu na TVET sasa iko wazi. Ingia katika students.kuccps.ac.ke kutuma maombi ya programu za Shahada na TVET kabla ya muda kufikia mwisho.
Ekegusii: Portal ya KUCCPS yaki abaki uregi ne ya TVET ikwete buya. Kiyega buya kwi students.kuccps.ac.ke buya bwokiri buengu na TVET naki kuria buya.
Dholuo: Portal ma KUCCPS mar university kod TVET applications oting'o. Konyo ku students.kuccps.ac.ke nokuom joma degree kod TVET ei ni konyo ng'ato gi timbe.
Somali: Barta KUCCPS ee codsiyada jaamacadaha iyo TVET hadda waa furan. Gali students.kuccps.ac.ke si aad u codsato barnaamijyada Shahaadada iyo TVET ka hor waqtiga kama dambeysta ah.

English: The Kenya Medical Training College warns students and parents to verify admission information through official channels only and avoid sharing personal information with unauthorized individuals.
Kiswahili: Chuo cha Mafunzo ya Tiba Kenya kinawashauri wanafunzi na wazazi kuthibitisha taarifa za kuingilia kupitia njia rasmi pekee na kuepuka kugawana taarifa binafsi na watu wasio na kibali.
Ekegusii: Chuo cha Mafunzo ya Tiba Kenya kinatoa onyo kwa wanafunzi na wazazi kuangalia taarifa za kujiunga kupitia njia rasmi pekee na kuepuka kushiriki taarifa za kibinafsi na watu wasio na mamlaka.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Training College onyo students na abich moloyo gihier admissions mokuongo kende ma ok en chalo ni koro kanyakre buoro mako.
Somali: Kulliyadda Tababbarka Caafimaadka Kenya waxay uga digaysaa ardayda iyo waalidiinta inay xaqiijiyaan macluumaadka gelitaanka oo kaliya kanaallo rasmi ah isla markaana ka fogaadaan wadaagidda macluumaadka shakhsiyeed dadka aan oggoleyn.

English: KNUT members, prepare for upcoming elections with the potential contest between Wilson Sossion and current Secretary General Collins Oyuu for leadership positions. Stay informed.
Kiswahili: Wajumbe wa KNUT, jiandaeni kwa uchaguzi ujao wa kutakuwa na ushindani kati ya Wilson Sossion na Katibu Mkuu wa sasa, Collins Oyuu kwa nafasi za uongozi. Endeleeni kujua yanayojiri.
Ekegusii: Abakinyi ba KNUT, budirire omokanya oria bw'omerera omogira oria bwokire itire ya Wilson Sossion na mugira ikinyi Abogii Oyuu bw'ogotire amasomo. Bwakire oria bworkeneke.
Dholuo: Membri wa KNUT, ji aher keth joma oseria ma gin gi, ma yande mar Wilson Sossion to mano joma ni mino Secretary General Collins Oyuu ma en ketho. Toroka ni yien.
Somali: Xubnaha KNUT, diyaar garooba doorashooyinka soo socda oo ay ka dhici karto tartan u dhaxeeya Wilson Sossion iyo Xoghayaha Guud ee hadda Collins Oyuu jagada hogaamineed. La soco wararka.

English: KUCCPS has begun placing students in universities and colleges based on KCSE results and course preferences. Applicants will receive SMS notifications to check their placements on the KUCCPS portal.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS imeanza kuwatega wanafunzi katika vyuo vikuu na vyuo kwa msingi wa matokeo ya KCSE na mapendeleo ya kozi. Waombaji watapokea ujumbe wa SMS ili kuangalia nafasi zao kwenye tovuti ya KUCCPS.
Ekegusii: KUCCPS ekirang’ire bwakire busomogwenche bwakiori kinyariri naki abafrigani batarera. Ababere bakenyerea sms bwaseme na bakenyire esimwori anda KUCCPS.
Dholuo: KUCCPS en gima osetimo chike mag studendi e universiti and colleges to telo KCSE. Okwere ma alwora mathoth ni bed matego SMS sigetni e KUCCPS portal.
Somali: KUCCPS ayaa bilaabay in ardayda lagu xiro jaamacadaha iyo kulliyadaha iyadoo lagu saleynayo natiijooyinka KCSE iyo doorashada koorsooyinka. Codsadayaasha waxay heli doonaan fariimo SMS ah si ay u hubiyaan meelaha ay ku jiraan ee ku saabsan KUCCPS.

English: KNEC invites applications for the 2026 examiners' training for KJSEA and KCSE. Eligible teachers and college tutors with TSC registration and three years' experience can apply.
Kiswahili: KNEC inakaribisha maombi ya mafunzo ya wakaguzi wa mwaka 2026 kwa KJSEA na KCSE. Walimu na wahadhiri wa vyuo wenye usajili wa TSC na miaka mitatu ya uzoefu wanaweza kuomba.
Ekegusii: KNEC oigo ogokire bhokuborere bwa 2026 bwogoto bwakiga KJSEA na KCSE. Abakaru abaterere na batanarige buigwa TSC hamwe n’ikusarane y’ogirango itatu bakanigwa bhokuborere.
Dholuo: KNEC oywak awach buura mar 2026 mag londe duto ng'ato KJSEA kod KCSE. Waduok ma adiera kaka kachien gi jomoko TSC ne odhiambo chieko years tati nyaka buo.
Somali: KNEC ayaa dalbanaysa codsiyada tababarka imtixaanka 2026 ee KJSEA iyo KCSE. Macallimiinta ama macallimiinta jaamacadaha ee xaq u leh, oo leh isqorista TSC iyo khibrad seddex sano ah, ayaa codsan kara.

English: The Kenya National Examinations Council (KNEC) is accepting applications for the 2026 Junior School Examiners Training. Interested teachers should apply via the KNEC portal by the deadline to be considered.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Mitihani la Kenya (KNEC) linakubali maombi ya mafunzo ya Wasimamizi wa Shule za Msingi ya mwaka 2026. Walimu wanaovutiwa wanapaswa kuomba kupitia lango la KNEC kabla ya mwisho wa tarehe ili kuzingatiwa.
Ekegusii: Abakire ba Kenya National Examinations Council (KNEC) baria bakirire ogendani buya oboke bwa 2026 Junior School Examiners Training. Abakisi banene bataria buya bokianga bwi KNEC portal, ore ogende buya kara ibokire.
Dholuo: Kenya National Examinations Council (KNEC) en golo odhiambo ma ji 2026 Junior School Examiners Training. Wang' yamo giko cani piny ketho gingo odhiambo e KNEC portal nyaka bende noge kamano.
Somali: Guddiga Imtixaannada Qaranka ee Kenya (KNEC) wuxuu qaadanayaa codsiyo tababarka imtixaannada dugsiga hoose ee 2026. Macallimiinta danaynaya waa in ay codsadaan iyada oo loo marayo bogga KNEC kahor dhamaadka waqtiga si loo tixgeliyo.

English: All schools in Kisii County are directed to immediately readmit over 200 teenage mothers without additional conditions. Ensure their return to class as soon as possible.
Kiswahili: Shule zote katika Kaunti ya Kisii zinatakiwa kuruhusu kurejea kwa wastani wa wasichana zaidi ya 200 waliokuwa na mimba bila masharti ya ziada. Hakikisha wanarudi darasani haraka iwezekanavyo.
Ekegusii: Masoko ogenda mugakira Kisii bategana gendaki omotegere omogoma 200 bagenge bosibori, nyang’ere bure. Begana buya buya omong’ina oria.
Dholuo: Jokiw ka g’ogo mar Kisii County nyal goyo konyo jana ma nyalo chiemo 200 ka uondo wacho duto. Dhi nyal chike jomoko e klas maduong’ kanyakla.
Somali: Dhammaan dugsiyada degmada Kisii waxaa laga farayaa inay si degdeg ah dib ugu soo celiyaan in ka badan 200 oo hooyo dhallinyaro ah shuruud la’aan. Hubi inay si dhaqso ah ugu laabtaan fasalka.

English: The University of Nairobi is ranked as Kenya's top university and 17th in Africa according to the latest QS World University Rankings for Sub-Saharan Africa.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Nairobi kinashika nafasi ya juu kama chuo kikuu bora nchini Kenya na nafasi ya 17 barani Afrika kulingana na orodha mpya ya QS World University Rankings kwa Sub-Saharan Africa.
Ekegusii: Yunivesitii ya Nairobi ibwandidwa kya bwakirori ya juu mu Kenya na buya 17 mu Afrika bu kiana QS World University Rankings ya Sub-Saharan Africa.
Dholuo: Chuo kikuu cha Nairobi ne chakach gima nyalo maler e Kenya kendo ne 17th e Afrika, maler e chandruok QS World University Rankings mar Sub-Saharan Afrika.
Somali: Jaamacadda Nairobi ayaa lagu fasiray jaamacadda ugu sareysa Kenya iyo 17-aad Afrika sida ku cad qiimeynta ugu dambeysa ee QS World University Rankings ee Afrika hoos u dhaadhac.

English: Qualified Kenyan pharmacy professionals are invited to apply for jobs in Jersey Island before the deadline of June 18, 2025. Apply only through the Diaspora Placement Agency and do not pay recruitment fees.
Kiswahili: Wataalamu wa pharmacy wa Kenya wenye sifa wanakaribishwa kuomba kazi kwenye Kisiwa cha Jersey kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya Juni 18, 2025. Omba tu kupitia Shirika la Uwekaji Walio nako na usilipie ada za ajira.
Ekegusii: Abagakire omogaka ba Kenya baria baire ogendete buya bosi mu Jersey Island minto ikirenge ya June 18, 2025. Ogengetere buya kuboka Diaspora Placement Agency na ntang'ani oria okorora maza.
Dholuo: Lwanda gin Kenyani mar pharmacy ok nyalo nongo’ ei kanyani e Jersey Island kawo kanyo gima endi ka 18, ng'wech 2025. Nongo’ to ni ok etie matego mar recruitment.
Somali: Dhamaadka bisha Juun 18, 2025, hay'adaha caafimaadka ee Kenya ayaa lagu boorinayaa inay codsadaan shaqooyinka Jasiiradda Jersey. Fadlan codso kaliya adiga oo adeegsanaya Hay'adda Furtada Qaaradda (Diaspora Placement Agency) oo ha bixin khidmadda shaqaaleysiinta.

English: Kenyan activist Boniface Mwangi has been arrested and is being held at Pangani Police Station. He is expected to be arraigned on July 21, 2025.
Kiswahili: Activist wa Kenya, Boniface Mwangi, amekamatwa na anashikiliwa katika Kituo cha Polisi Pangani. Anatarajiwa kupelekwa mahakamani tarehe 21 Julai, 2025.
Ekegusii: Muganga wa Kenyan Boniface Mwangi agerekereriwe na abarori b'abo bw'abe Pangani Police Station. Anatanakhanya oigorori mwaki wa mwaki wa 21, 2025.
Dholuo: Jaluo Boniface Mwangi abiro makelo kendo odiso e Pangani Police Station. Okwere e lokruok kuom July 21, 2025.
Somali: Fannaanka Kenyan Boniface Mwangi ayaa la qabtay waxaana lagu hayaa Xarunta Booliiska ee Pangani. Waxaa la filayaa in lagu soo oogo maxkamadda 21ka Luulyo, 2025.

English: The 2026 school calendar is now available: First term starts January 5; the year includes breaks and national examinations. For full details, visit the Ministry of Education website.
Kiswahili: Kalenda ya shule ya mwaka wa 2026 sasa inapatikana: muhula wa kwanza unaanza januari 5; mwaka huo unajumuisha mapumziko na mitihani ya kitaifa. Kwa maelezo zaidi, tembelea tovuti ya Wizara ya Elimu.
Ekegusii: Kalendarii ya shule ya 2026 igo itoresire: Omosera ogende oronki 5; egeserere eria eko anga obwaki bwaki na ng’endo zia chirega. Kanga oria ogemogore, oreka genda website ya Minisita wa Elimu.
Dholuo: Kalenda mar shule yaka 2026 omiyo ineno: Ekwong' kama mokuongo ma Jano 5; mwaka inyakonyo kaka maua gi dhii kod jochung' dan. Kaka kuom opogore magi, konyo ku website ya Ministry of Education.
Somali: Jadwalkii dugsiga ee 2026 ayaa hadda la heli karaa: Term-ka koowaad wuxuu bilaabmaa Janaayo 5; sanadku wuxuu ka koobanyahay fasaxyo iyo imtixaano qaran. Faahfaahin buuxda, booqo bogga Wasaaradda Waxbarashada.

English: Over 400,000 teachers are now covered under the Social Health Authority (SHA) medical scheme as of December 1, 2025, offering improved outpatient and inpatient services.
Kiswahili: Walimu zaidi ya 400,000 sasa wanapata huduma kupitia mpango wa matibabu wa Mamlaka ya Afya ya Kijamii (SHA) kuanzia Desemba 1, 2025, ukitoa huduma bora za wagonjwa wa nje na wa ndani.
Ekegusii: Abakosi barenga 400,000 barabwakirire omoka buya bwa Social Health Authority (SHA) buya bwa buya oba basaanga mazi omokirori na buya 1 okuwomoka, 2025, bakeji bokiabaki bwonchari bwanire na bworanya.
Dholuo: Nyasaye 400,000 jowete oketo e ji ma oketo ka Social Health Authority (SHA) kendo e yo gima omiya chiege kendo gima omiya jochieng' ma nyalo en nind gor.
Somali: In ka badan 400,000 macallimiin ayaa hadda lagu daboolay qorshaha caafimaadka bulshada (SHA) laga bilaabo 1-da Diseembar, 2025, iyadoo la siinayo adeegyo caafimaad oo avanzed ah oo loogu talagalay bukaannada isbitaallada iyo kuwa ka baxsan.

English: The Council of Governors has raised concerns regarding alleged harassment of governors by Senators Sifuna, Kajwang', Cherargei, and Mwaruma during CPAC hearings.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Magavana limeeleza wasiwasi kuhusu madai ya kulazimishwa kwa magavana na Maseneta Sifuna, Kajwang', Cherargei, na Mwaruma wakati wa vikao vya CPAC.
Ekegusii: Ong'era bw'ogendi b'ekibera b'amasomondo bazamire obwakire b'ekirekereri bw'amasomondo burokere Sifuna, Kajwang', Cherargei, na Mwaruma mu bwakire bw'CPAC.
Dholuo: Council of Governors oyno gi chandruok gi anyuol mar wa womoko eyo kanyiengo mar senators Sifuna, Kajwang', Cherargei, kendo Mwaruma kod CPAC.
Somali: Guddiga G governors ayaa muujiyay walaac ku saabsan cabashooyin ku aaddan dhibaataynta ay ku hayaan guddoomiyayaasha Senators Sifuna, Kajwang', Cherargei, iyo Mwaruma inta lagu jiro maqalka CPAC.

English: Eat a balanced diet rich in fruits to help combat hair loss. Prioritize incorporating the right fruits into your daily meals for better hair health.
Kiswahili: Kula chakula chenye mlo kamili kilichojaa matunda kutasaidia kupunguza kupotea kwa nywele. Kipaumbele cha weka matunda sahihi katika milo yako ya kila siku kwa afya bora ya nywele.
Ekegusii: Naki buya bwaki bwokire bwokong’ana bwakiragane buya ore bwokare bwokire bwaki mwaki. Ore bushindano omokiririe omokirikari omoge ogokire bwaki bwokirimani bwaki.
Dholuo: Nyang' nyasi magi e yo mwakoyo ma oriti gi maki to ok nyal kachuo gima wacho ka. Pesa nyaka gite ok gitimo maki ma oting'o e nyasi mokuongo.
Somali: Cunto dheeli tiran oo hodan ku ah miro ayaa kaa caawin doonta inaad la tacaasho timaha oo dhummaya. Mudnaanta sii inaad ku darto miro sax ah cuntooyinkaaga maalinlaha ah si timahaagu u caafimaad qabaadaan.

English: Parents are advised to check on the well-being of their children affected by the Nova Pioneer school bus accident on March 25. Some children were injured and taken to hospitals for treatment.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanashauriwa kuangalia ustawi wa watoto wao walioripotiwa kuathirika na ajali ya basi la shule la Nova Pioneer mnamo Machi 25. Watoto wengine walijeruhiwa na kupelekwa hospitalini kwa matibabu.
Ekegusii: Bwakire nyamworire bwanana bwere omosigori bwokire bwanena naki iskufu ya Nova Pioneer omogendo bwokire mogo ekegoresi bwokire machi 25. Abana abwenyaga bwere omokinya naki babere omomotere mosi oserone.
Dholuo: Walimu nyaka kucek gima wiyogo kendo gima chieko koro wacho magi onge ma be kethere e Nova Pioneer bus mudho mar March 25. Gima chieko maber anene kendo ginyalo ndalo e abor bang' kuom tich.
Somali: Waalidka waxaa lagu talinayaa inay hubsadaan xaaladda carruurtooda ee ay saameysay shilka basasku ee Nova Pioneer ee dhacay Marta 25. Carruur qaar ayaa dhaawacmay waxaana loo qaaday isbitaallada si loo daweeyo.

English: There are no actionable public service announcements from the provided information.
Kiswahili: Hakuna matangazo ya huduma za umma ambayo yanaweza kuchukuliwa kutoka kwa taarifa iliyotolewa.
Ekegusii: Naki oria omogori ogenda buya kakirenda.
Dholuo: N/A
Somali: Ma jiraan wax ku saabsan ogaysiisyo adeeg dadweyne oo la qaadi karo oo ka imanaya macluumaadka la bixiyay.

English: Support is available for needy students facing financial hardship to access secondary education. Contact your local education office for assistance.
Kiswahili: Msaada unapatikana kwa wanafunzi wenye uhitaji wanaokumbwa na matatizo ya kifedha ili kupata elimu ya sekondari. Wasiliana na ofisi yako ya elimu ya eneo lako kwa msaada.
Ekegusii: Omosaraki emonane obaki ekerandi bwogire egesibori abanjere gochore. Gekire buya gi ofisi ya masomo ya buya.
Dholuo: Owino konyo tere ma nyandiko mag yweyo mar nind gi mizo mar itiyo giko jamani ma ni konyo. Konyo godo yiero ma loki odhi gima wacho ohu.
Somali: Taageero ayaa la heli karaa ardayda u baahan oo la kulmaya dhibaato dhaqaale si ay u helaan waxbarashada dugsiga sare. La xiriir xafiiskaaga waxbarashada deegaanka si aad u hesho caawimaad.

English: Super Metro Limited's operator license is suspended due to safety and compliance violations. Public is advised not to board Super Metro vehicles until compliance is met.
Kiswahili: Leseni ya uendeshaji ya Super Metro Limited imesitishwa kutokana na ukiukaji wa usalama na taratibu. Umma unashauriwa kutoingia kwenye magari ya Super Metro hadi wahakikishe wanafuata kanuni.
Ekegusii: Super Metro Limited ekorere ya chireka ikinyasa haki na mwakire bw'osi. Abagusi batarwe bairore gi Super Metro kinyara ikinyasa bw'osi bufwaki.
Dholuo: Licensa mar Super Metro Limited nyal e piny gi manyien kuom mawuok gi dongo. Abindu to konyo kata bende ok nyal kuom Super Metro waki chiegni.
Somali: Shatiga hawlgalka Super Metro Limited wuu hakad la galay sababo la xiriira amniga iyo ku dhaqanka shuruucda. Bulshada waxaa lagu talinayaa inay ka fogaadaan gaadiidka Super Metro ilaa la buuxiyo shuruudaha.

English: If you or someone you know is struggling with emotional distress or domestic issues, please reach out to a mental health professional or local support services for assistance.
Kiswahili: Iwapo wewe au mtu unayemjua anakabiliwa na matatizo ya hisia au masuala ya nyumbani, tafadhali wasiliana na mtaalamu wa afya ya akili au huduma za msaada za eneo lako kwa msaada.
Ekegusii: Naki ogendaka naki omokireri ogetiri ekeria na naki orege oria, bwogenda omoshanga ogeka buya na buya abaki naki okera.
Dholuo: Ka in wawe ka oewu ok nyalo wanga gi chalo ma oieny, yo uwach nyaka ocheny kod maagano ma en kuom health magero pita, kata tebu ma ok ang'ere.
Somali: Haddii aad adiga ama qof aad taqaanid ay la tacaalayaan dhibaatooyin ama stress maskaxeed, fadlan la xiriir xirfadle caafimaad maskaxeed ama adeegyada taageerada ee deegaanka si ay kuu caawiyaan.

English: Civic Email, a platform allowing Kenyans to email objections to lawmakers, is available for use. Visit the website to participate in advocacy efforts.
Kiswahili: Civic Email, jukwaa linalowezesha Wakenya kutuma pingamizi kwa wabunge, linapatikana kwa matumizi. Tembelea tovuti ili kushiriki katika juhudi za utetezi.
Ekegusii: Civic Email, moshonchori ogokire obwaki mwaki ugoma, ikirori omokirire okomokire. Naki nkionyoro oria nyasa omoshonchori.
Dholuo: Civic Email, piny kod gi Kenyans manok e mail objections to lawmakers, yingo marach. E kendo kuom website ni warito e advocacy efforts.
Somali: Civic Email, madal u fududaynaysa Kenyaanta inay email u diraan sharci-dejiyayaasha, ayaa diyaar u ah in la isticmaalo. Booqo bogga si aad uga qayb qaadato dadaallada shirarka.

English: The Independent Policing Oversight Authority (IPOA) is investigating the incident involving the death of blogger Albert Ojwang while in police custody.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka Huru ya Uangalizi wa Polisi (IPOA) ina uchunguzi kuhusu tukio la kifo cha mchapishaji Albert Ojwang akiwa chini ya ulinzi wa polisi.
Ekegusii: Abagiri b'Obwaki b'Enchere (IPOA) bari mu mageso omogunda bwaki bw'ogise naki ng'enda omonene o b'ogorokero Albert Ojwang akorera mu ekigoti.
Dholuo: Independent Policing Oversight Authority (IPOA) nyaka konyo bango ka injiye boge mag blogger Albert Ojwang wakati mag yo chiegni.
Somali: Hay'adda Madax-bannaan ee Kormeerka Booliska (IPOA) ayaa baaraysa dhacdadan la xiriirta geerida blogger Albert Ojwang intii uu ku jiray gacanta booliska.

English: No actionable information is present in the source.
Kiswahili: Hakuna taarifa inayoweza kuchukuliwa katika chanzo.
Ekegusii: Naki bwakire buya obwakirire, ka boke buya ore buya.
Dholuo: N/A
Somali: Ma jiraan wax macluumaad ah oo la qaadan karo oo ku jirta isha.

English: The Ministry of Education is auditing student enrolment data and will withhold capitation funds from schools that cannot verify their records. Only verified institutions will receive future funds.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inafanya ukaguzi wa data za usajili wa wanafunzi na itashikilia fedha za matumizi kwa shule ambazo hazitaweza kuthibitisha rekodi zao. Ni taasisi zinazothibitishwa pekee ndizo zitaweza kupokea fedha zijazo.
Ekegusii: Omooyo wa Dini burori ekeng'ere obokengi bw'ane na'ayo bwenyire nga' ing'ani omosendenyaki bw'ane mokioba buseori buja. Naki naki omosendenyaki bw'ane burori betiri bujoge obw'aki.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education e nying' ma en chodi ka engeyo piny jo-enrolment, kendo nyiso gi capitation funds e schools ma ok pamo ni en nyal gi record. Schools ma en nyak pamo nikech record magi, to nyiso gidhi fund ma otieno.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay baaraysaa xogta diiwaangelinta ardayda waxayna ka joojin doontaa lacagaha capitationka iskuulada aan xaqiijin karin diiwaankooda. Kaliya hay’adaha la xaqiijiyay ayaa heli doona lacagaha mustaqbalka.

English: The Ministry of Education is reviewing the governance and management framework for Junior Secondary Schools to consider deploying principals for independent leadership.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inafanya mapitio ya mfumo wa utawala na usimamizi wa Shule za Sekondari za Kijuni ili kutathmini uwezekano wa kuwateua wakuu wa shule kwa ajili ya uongozi huru.
Ekegusii: Serikali ya Elimu iri oigana naki egogori na obwakire bwa nyaki ya Junior Secondary Schools buya hamwe naki buya oreka ohenya bwakire.
Dholuo: Waduong' kuom Elim nyaka ngaloyo chalo ma oketh e kanyono gi giwore gi waki e chalo ma oketi golo kwa chike ma oketh.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa dib u eegaysa qaab-dhismeedka maamulka iyo hogaaminta Dugsiyada Sareee ee Junior si loo tixgeliyo in madaxda loo magacaabo hogaamin madax-bannaan.

English: Teachers and police officers are urged to engage in discussions about their economic challenges impacting their livelihoods. Your voices are important in shaping future policies.
Kiswahili: Walimu na maafisa wa polisi wanahimizwa kujihusisha katika majadiliano kuhusu changamoto zao za kiuchumi zinazoathiri maisha yao. Sauti zenu ni muhimu katika kuunda sera za baadaye.
Ekegusii: Abagere naki abakarari baragiriwe okucheka omogori buya bweti bwaki buya bora bwaki bagenyi bama. Dumu bwaki bonyere bosi buya bomi bwaki buya obokire buya.
Dholuo: Wagendini kendo jang'och mari jihang' to nind gi chuny kendo nyiso joma karibonyo kaka engeyo. Ogingo magi en gima ji dongo e nyuka mago.
Somali: Macallimiinta iyo ciidamada booliiska waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan doodaha ku saabsan caqabadaha dhaqaale ee saameynaya noloshooda. Codkiinu waa muhiim si loo sameeyo siyaasadaha mustaqbalka.

English: The involvement of police in managing national examinations has been eliminated to reduce pressure on learners. Students and parents can focus on learning without fear during exams.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano wa polis katika kusimamia mitihani ya kitaifa umondolewa ili kupunguza shinikizo kwa wanafunzi. Wanafunzi na wazazi wanaweza kuzingatia kujifunza bila hofu wakati wa mitihani.
Ekegusii: Ikigori gya abateka mu kuringanisha mirangori ekegana gaki gisiria, kutigana okugenda omogoti kinyasa. Abang'ana nakiama basengana na kutigira obwakire busekurire mu mirangori.
Dholuo: Dala mana gi polisi ka gichung injin gi chieng' kendo gicheng' gige kod jendini. Jami gi kaka owinj giting' ma nyaka jingi gi ng'ama maler ka gichung gi injin.
Somali: Ka qaybgalka booliiska ee maareynta imtixaannada qaranka waa la joojiyey si loo yareeyo cadaadiska ardayda. Ardayda iyo waalidiintu waxay diiradda saari karaan waxbarashada iyada oo aan cabsi ka qabin imtixaannada.

English: Teachers from schools with low enrolment will be redeployed to address staff shortages in other institutions. Stay informed about potential changes to school operations as needed.
Kiswahili: Teachers kutoka shule zenye usajili mdogo watahamishwa ili kukabili upungufu wa wafanyakazi katika taasisi zingine. Kuwa na taarifa kuhusu mabadiliko yanayoweza kutokea katika shughuli za shule kadri itakavyohitajika.
Ekegusii: Abere burori bakiere na shoo ziawi ne bigenyanga bosi naki baisabere banye buya kumosi buya naki bweru buya. Tiga naki miri ya mosi ikore nyakibori buya.
Dholuo: Walimu kuom shule magi egi obwogo, ka piny ne, nyalo gikwayo e golo kendo ginyalo yudo. Nying'oya e dalu ni kendo opogore gi kanyo mar golo viso.
Somali: Macallimiinta ka yimid dugsiyada leh qarash yar ayaa lagu bedeli doonaa si loo xalliyo yaraanta shaqaalaha dugsiyo kale. La soco isbeddelada suurtagalka ah ee howlwadeenada dugsiyadda sida loo baahdo.

English: Students seeking placement for 2026 courses should refer to the KUCCPS Students' Portal for cluster subject requirements and cut-off points info. Do not attempt to calculate your own cluster points; they are computed automatically by KUCCPS.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanaotafuta nafasi za masomo ya mwaka wa 2026 wanapaswa kutembelea Tovuti ya Wanafunzi ya KUCCPS kwa taarifa kuhusu mahitaji ya masomo ya kundi na alama za ukomo. Usijaribu kuhesabu alama zako za kundi mwenyewe; zinahesabiwa moja kwa moja na KUCCPS.
Ekegusii: Abakere batarera obororere bw'amasomo bw'2026 barinda kwokira ku KUCCPS Students' Portal buya obwakire bw'amasomo n'amae obwakire. Mosi osokire okoborora ibirori bicha; bicha biterete buya KUCCPS.
Dholuo: Wanafunzi odwaro nomi mago kanyo ku 2026 nyaka oyie yogo nikioro ku KUCCPS Students' Portal ang'weny mokwongo ku cluster subject requirements to ka cut-off points. Okwong' osiep kanyo cluster points; KUCCPS okonyo chalo manu.
Somali: Ardayda raadinaya meel dhigasho koorsooyinka 2026 waa inay tixgeliyaan Portal-ka Ardayda ee KUCCPS si ay u helaan shuruudaha mowduucyada iyo macluumaadka dhibcaha goolka. Ha isku dayin inaad xisaabiso dhibcahaaga kooxeed; waxay si toos ah u xisaabin doonaan KUCCPS.

English: Parents searching for private schools in Kenya should consider the top-rated institutions for 2026. Visit school websites to explore academic offerings and enrollment options.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanaotafuta shule binafsi nchini Kenya wanapaswa kuzingatia taasisi bora kwa mwaka wa 2026. Tembelea tovuti za shule ili kuchunguza mipango ya masomo na chaguzi za kujiandikisha.
Ekegusii: Ababere baki bosa buya buya naki abantugwetire osero ibwaki bwakore 2026. Ria boma bizi muno bwaki buya bwere aberekere naki bosianga bwaki.
Dholuo: Obila mag piny moyudi e kanga motegno, nyasaye to goke sioyo e nyaka konyo ngo'uru ma oduogo 2026. Konyo kuwebsite mar shule kanyo kanyoregi gi nyinge mar thum.
Somali: Waalidiinta raadinaya dugsiyada gaar ah ee Kenya waa inay tixgeliyaan hay’adaha ugu sarreeya ee darajada leh 2026. Booqo bogagga dugsiyada si aad u eegto waxbarashada iyo fursadaha diiwaangelinta.

English: Kenya Medical Training College (KMTC) offers various certificate, diploma, and higher diploma programs in health sciences. Visit the KMTC official website for detailed course requirements, fees, and application details.
Kiswahili: Chuo cha Mafunzo ya Tiba Kenya (KMTC) kinatoa programu mbalimbali za cheti, diploma, na diploma ya juu katika sayansi za afya. Tembelea tovuti rasmi ya KMTC kwa maelezo kamili kuhusu mahitaji ya kozi, ada, na maelezo ya maombi.
Ekegusii: Kenya Medical Training College (KMTC) inye naki buya bw'ogenda, amagwate na bw'ogenda bw'ekiburi mu buya bw'ekisoma. Kerekeria mu website ya KMTC ng'ogende emosi ya mashako, egereyego, na amagara ag'ogenda.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Training College (KMTC) nyal to konyo manyien gi certificate, diploma, gi higher diploma e health sciences. Dhi kuonje kuom website mar KMTC to wacho mar ng'ato mag course, ondiek, gi chako mar kuom.
Somali: Koleejka Tababarka Caafimaadka Kenya (KMTC) wuxuu bixinayaa barnaamijyo shahaado, diploma, iyo diploma sare ah oo ku saabsan sayniska caafimaadka. Booqo website-ka rasmiga ah ee KMTC si aad u heshid shuruudaha koorsada, kharashyada, iyo faahfaahinta codsiga.

English: Parents and guardians shopping for school uniforms in Nairobi can find reliable suppliers at trusted stores like Animet Ltd, Uniform Distributors, and School Outfitters.
Kiswahili: Wazazi na walezi wanaonunua mavazi ya shule Nairobi wanaweza kupata wasambazaji wa kuaminika katika maduka yanayotambuliwa kama Animet Ltd, Uniform Distributors, na School Outfitters.
Ekegusii: Baba na nakiito baogeere omokiri ya masomo mu Nairobi bangi banyekere abakire nakiito ku migiri ekire buya nakiito buya nka Animet Ltd, Uniform Distributors, na School Outfitters.
Dholuo: Kanyimbe magi kelo joma okel mange, gi nyaka gweng' school uniforms e Nairobi no ng'eyo gi chike makata e duka ma otwe Animet Ltd, Uniform Distributors, to School Outfitters.
Somali: Waalidka iyo masuuliyiinta digaalayaasha iskuulka ee Nairobi waxay ka heli karaan alaab-qeybiyayaal lagu kalsoonaan karo dukaamada la aamini karo sida Animet Ltd, Uniform Distributors, iyo School Outfitters.

English: A second revision window for senior school placement will be available for learners transitioning to Grade 10 from January 6 to January 9, 2026.
Kiswahili: Dirisha la pili la marekebisho la uhamisho wa shule za sekondari litapatikana kwa wanafunzi wanaohama kuelekea Kidato cha 10 kuanzia Januari 6 hadi Januari 9, 2026.
Ekegusii: Makioberia omokirenda bwire bwakare bwakire ebichakire bwakibori bwakire bosi abakiijire kosi ekyake kwa Kiisi 10 guokirire January 6 mpaka January 9, 2026.
Dholuo: Seche mar ndochie ma okinyi e yo mar piny kuom wagi tho ni dendi e kit gi nigi 10 kuom Janwari 6 ndalo 9, 2026.
Somali: Dib-u-eegis labaad oo ah meel bannaan oo loogu talagalay goobta dugsiga sare ayaa la heli doonaa ardayda ku socota Fasalka 10 laga bilaabo Janaayo 6 ilaa Janaayo 9, 2026.

English: Do not use or promote "free TikTok coin" generators; they are scams and may violate TikTok's terms of service. Purchase coins only through the TikTok app for safe and legal transactions.
Kiswahili: Usitumie au kukuza "sarafu za bure za TikTok"; ni udanganyifu na zinaweza kukiuka makubaliano ya huduma ya TikTok. Nunua sarafu tu kupitia programu ya TikTok kwa ununuzi salama na wa kisheria.
Ekegusii: Naki osibori kana ogotondere "free TikTok coin" omokinyani; naki bosiaki na igere mwaki buya buya. Okerana emokinyani ki TikTok app buya omokinyani wa igere come buya.
Dholuo: Nawad gi ng'ato mag "free TikTok coin" generators; to ok ng'ama piye gi teko mamoko. Nying' coins kende gi TikTok app mondo ubed gi chalo mag timbe.
Somali: Ha isticmaalin ama dhiirrigelin "lacagta TikTok ee lacag-la'aanta ah" ee abuurista; kuwaas waa khiyaano waxayna xad-gudub noqon karaan shuruudaha adeegga TikTok. Lacagaha iibsada kaliya iyada oo loo marayo barnaamijka TikTok si loo hubiyo in macaamilkaagu ammaan yahay oo sharciga waafaqsan.

English: Youths are encouraged to join the #TukoKadi voter registration campaign, which aims to empower citizens and promote civic participation ahead of the 2027 General Election.
Kiswahili: Vijana wanahimizwa kujiunga na kampeni ya usajili wa wapiga kura #TukoKadi, ambayo inalenga kuwawezesha raia na kuimarisha ushiriki wa kiraia kabla ya Uchaguzi Mkuu wa 2027.
Ekegusii: Abakiri batarerere buya kujiire mu kampeni ya #TukoKadi yokwongera abaki, eyakiijire kugwanyisa abaki na kuhamoha mwagire monto kwa Elections ya 2027.
Dholuo: Dhi nyaka joti to i join kampeni ya #TukoKadi ku yore voter registration, nyandiko okwongo chwech kadhi keth maboro e bende to romo civic participation ma okore 2027 General Election.
Somali: Dhalinyarada waxaa la dhiirrigelinayaa inay ku biiraan ololaha #TukoKadi ee diiwaangelinta codbixiyayaasha, kaas oo ujeedkiisu yahay in la awoodsiiyo muwaadiniinta lana dhiirrigeliyo ka qeybgalka bulshada ka hor Doorashada Guud ee 2027.

English: The National Cohesion and Integration Commission (NCIC) urges all public figures to refrain from making inflammatory statements that could incite ethnic tensions.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Ulinganifu na Uhakikisho wa Kitaifa (NCIC) inaomba viongozi wa umma wote kujiepusha na kutoa matamshi yanayoweza kuchochea mvutano wa kikabila.
Ekegusii: Ababeri boi Nyakisa na Intaneti (NCIC) babanita omokiriri buya bosi boke buya naki'a buya omokinyokiriana oria boki kamwaki ekigori.
Dholuo: National Cohesion and Integration Commission (NCIC) nyal chamo all public figures ang'eyo to kadhi ochwegi ma ok nyal konyo joma en gima omok gi weche mag ethni.
Somali: Guddiga Qaranka ee Midnimada iyo Isdhexgalka (NCIC) wuxuu ku boorinayaa dhammaan shaqsiyaadka bulshada in ay ka fogaadaan hadallada kicinta leh ee sababi kara cadaawadda qabiilka.

English: The High Court has revoked Philip Aroko's bail in the murder case of MP Charles Ong'ondo Were, leading to his rearrest. Further investigation is ongoing.
Kiswahili: Mahakama Kuu imemfutia dhamana Philip Aroko katika kesi ya mauaji ya Mbunge Charles Ong'ondo Were, na kusababisha kukamatwa kwake tena. Uchunguzi zaidi unaendelea.
Ekegusii: Koti Nya Jano egeserete buya bwaki Philip Aroko mu egesori ya waki omokiri MP Charles Ong'ondo Were, na buya bwaki bwaki buya buseki buya. Ekekoria eshite oseria.
Dholuo: High Court okonyo bail mar Philip Aroko kuom chalo mar MP Charles Ong'ondo Were, kendo oikoni kuom ne. Nyasaye ohinga magi kendelea.
Somali: Maxkamadda Sare ayaa isticmaashay dammaanadda Philip Aroko ee kiisaska dilka MP Charles Ong'ondo Were, taasoo keentay in dib loo qabto. Baaritaan dheeraad ah ayaa socda.

English: The Central Bank of Kenya has released lending rate data for January 2026, showing an average commercial bank rate of 14.82%. Borrowers should check individual banks for specific rates.
Kiswahili: Benki Kuu ya Kenya imetoa takwimu za viwango vya mkopo kwa Januari 2026, ikionyesha kiwango cha wastani cha benki za biashara ni 14.82%. Wakataji mikopo wanapaswa kuangalia benki binafsi kwa viwango maalum.
Ekegusii: Benki Nkuru ya Kenya ekereriire data ya emwiiri ya abandu buya Januwari 2026, buya buya bosi benderia esaro ya abenki akekere 14.82%. Ababwiire buya bewaki buya buya buge bwine buya bendebgwe abenki ataka.
Dholuo: Central Bank of Kenya awonji data mag chier dholuo konyruok saa January 2026, nyalo chang' gi chier mag banki ma nenyis 14.82%. Boro konyruok joma chwech to ji wacho chier ma okinyi.
Somali: Bangiga Dhexe ee Kenya ayaa soo saaray xogta heerarka amaahda ee bisha Janaayo 2026, waxayna muujineysaa celcelis ah 14.82% heerka bangiyada ganacsiga. Dhalinyarada amaahda qaadanaya waa inay hubiyaan heerarka gaar ah ee bangiyada.

English: The public is urged to demand transparency regarding the source of funds allocated for "empowerment" projects and to report any suspected corruption or mismanagement related to public resources.
Kiswahili: Umma unashauriwa kudai uwazi kuhusu chanzo cha fedha zilizotolewa kwa miradi ya "uwezeshaji" na kuripoti ufisadi au usimamizi mbovu wowote unaohusiana na rasilimali za umma.
Ekegusii: Abagi bosi bakurire kugenenga omogogoro obwakwambiri bwakwamoka bw’orori bwamako bwosi "empowerment" na buya buya babsigane obori bwaki bwetenda omokire buya obwakorori naki otanga bwaki bwakwere.
Dholuo: Nige thum to nene mondo ochak piny buoyo mar chiegni aor e "empowerment" kata nengo mondo ok wacho ma wan gi yore mag thum mar piny.
Somali: Bulshada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay dalbadaan hufnaan ku saabsan ilaha lacagaha loogu talagalay mashaariicda "xoojinta" iyo inay soo sheegaan wax kasta oo la malaynayo musuqmaasuq ama maamul xumo ee la xiriira kheyraadka dadweynaha.

English: Opposition leaders from various African nations have been denied entry into Angola, affecting their attendance at an invited event. Those involved should seek clarification from Angolan authorities.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa upinzani kutoka mataifa mbalimbali ya Afrika wamezuiliwa kuingia Angola, hali inayohathiri حضور yao kwenye tukio lililo waalika. Wale walioathiriwa wanapaswa kutafuta ufafanuzi kutoka kwa mamlaka za Angola.
Ekegusii: Ab leader baki naki naki African mana bakorere kwongere en Osukuma, oseria omokirori bw'akiere ekinyegere. Baki bano naki bw'ogotire bende omokogori omosana bw'ogogeti osikaraga.
Dholuo: Mawegi mowuok kendo topogore tho magang' kendo nyaka ng'ato ma ok nyal kuom Angola, kaen kar timo tiende mar joma otimo. Jowa sebedo piny nyaka golo bisgoru kendo wacho ng'ato mar Angola.
Somali: Hoggaamiyayaasha mucaaradka ee dalalka Afrika kala duwan ayaa laga diiday inay galaan Angola, taasoo saameyn ku yeelatay ka qaybgalka dhacdo ay martiqaad ahaan ku leeyihiin. Kuwa ku lugta leh waa in ay raadiyaan faahfaahin ka helaan maamulka Angola.

English: TikTok users can now customize their "For You" feed with new tools: Manage Topics and Smart Keyword Filters in the app's settings. Adjust your content preferences today!
Kiswahili: Watumiaji wa TikTok sasa wanaweza kubadilisha mtiririko wao wa "Kwa Wewe" kwa zana mpya: Usimamizi wa Mada na Filters za Maneno Mahiri katika mipangilio ya programu. Panga mapendeleo yako ya maudhui leo!
Ekegusii: Abana ba TikTok bna nyasa batisanete "For You" feed yao na batega: Diki ya Nyanzagati na Smart Keyword Filters mu bichekebori bya app. Omosome bwogogaga boro bwae bwaki!
