Dholuo: Abich Tok nigi kuom tich mar "For You" e ndalo mar nyime: Timo Dho, kod Smart Keyword Filters e chieg mar app. Timo nyime ka konyo today!
Somali: Isticmaalayaasha TikTok hadda waxay u habeyn karaan 'For You' feed-kooda iyada oo la adeegsanayo aalado cusub: Maareynta Mawduucyada iyo Filtrooyinka Erayga Farsamada ee dejimaha app-ka. Habee doorashadaada maaddooyinka maanta!

English: Kenyans are invited to participate in the Annual KDF Day celebrations at Moi Barracks in Eldoret to honor the courage and dedication of the Kenya Defence Forces.
Kiswahili: Wakenya wanakaribishwa kushiriki katika sherehe za Siku ya KDF za kila mwaka kwenye Kambi ya Moi huko Eldoret ili kuhonor ujasiri na kujitolea kwa Vikosi vya Ulinzi vya Kenya.
Ekegusii: Abak kenyani batanetie omogaka omokiriri ya KDF ya mwaki mu Moi Barracks Eldoret, gorori buya bwaki omokiriri naki omokazi buya bwaki Obwaki Bwakiriri bwa Kenya.
Dholuo: Kenyans nyaka maber konyo kinyasa chung' wa KDF Day e Moi Barracks ku Eldoret mondo obed gi chiegni kendo komi Kenya Defence Forces.
Somali: Shacabka Kenyan-ka waxaa lagu casuumayaa inay ka qayb qaataan dabaaldegga Sannadlaha KDF ee ka dhacay Moi Barracks ee Eldoret, si loogu xaqiijiyo geesinimada iyo daacadnimada Ciidanka Difaaca Kenya.

English: No actionable content was found in this article related to education or public service announcements.
Kiswahili: Hakuna maudhui yanayotekelezeka yaliyopatikana katika makala hii yanayohusiana na elimu au matangazo ya huduma za umma.
Ekegusii: Naki ikibori bwakire buya bwaki bweria buya ebwenyanja oria ikire oria bure.
Dholuo: Nok gi kanyo ka nyaka wiye ka ginno e article ma en e yor gi timbe mar wacho kod inyuolo kuom edukeshoni kata wacho mar inyuolo piny.
Somali: Maqaalkan wax macluumaad ah oo ficil ah kama aysan helin wax xiriir la leh waxbarashada ama qadka adeegga dadweynaha.

English: The Ministry of Education has approved over 2,000 senior school transfer requests, with 98,000 applications still pending review. Parents and learners are advised to stay patient during this process.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu imeidhinisha ombi zaidi ya 2,000 ya uhamisho wa shule za sekondari, huku maombi 98,000 yakiwa yanangoja kupitia. Wazazi na wanafunzi wanashauriwa kuwa na subira wakati wa mchakato huu.
Ekegusii: Obwaki bu Egesatia bwaragire buorori bwokire bwi 2,000 bwankire bwokireri bu senior, na buorori bwakire 98,000 obwakire bwaki buorori murai buja. Abaki nakiantiki baregire buigana esime bu periri bujio.
Dholuo: Minisiteri mar Edication owinjore kadok 2,000 ma gima otumie ka omera, nikech 98,000 ma otumie ni konyo tek. Nyasach kuom joge e miye ni to opo mag mwand mi timo chiemb.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay oggoltay in in ka badan 2,000 dalabyo loogu gudbiyo dugsiyada sare, iyadoo 98,000 codsi ay wali sugayaan in la eego. Waa lagula talinayaa waalidiinta iyo ardayda inay dulqaad muujiyaan inta aan la dhammeystirin habkan.

English: The Teachers Service Commission is prioritizing Bachelor of Education Technology graduates for staffing in Senior Schools under the Competency-Based Education system.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma za Walimu inatoa kipaumbele kwa wahitimu wa Shahada ya Elimu ya Teknolojia katika kuajiriwa kwenye Shule za Sekondari chini ya mfumo wa Elimu Inayotegemea Uwezo.
Ekegusii: Obwakire bu Teachers Service Commission buya oreke Bachelor of Education Technology baria buya buya ore zeke mu Senior Schools omokirori oseria ore Competency-Based Education.
Dholuo: Teachers Service Commission en nyal maber kuom kiasi ma Bedruok gi Bachelor of Education Technology yore ni en tho gi kanyakla kod Senior Schools under Competency-Based Education system.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macalimiinta ayaa mudnaanta siinaya dhallinyarada ka qalin jabisa Bachelor of Education Technology si ay u shaqeeyaan dugsiyada sare ee ku shaqeeya nidaamka Waxbarashada Ku Saleysan Aqoonta.

English: Grade 9 students can revise their senior school placements from December 23-29, 2025. Contact your school head for application details.
Kiswahili: Timu za darasa la tisa zinaweza kufanyia marekebisho ya nafasi zao za shule za sekondari kuanzia Desemba 23 hadi 29, 2025. Wasiliana na kiongozi wa shule yako kwa maelezo zaidi kuhusu maombi.
Ekegusii: Abasomori bano boti bokore bọgana bwaki bwebanoge bwakinyanwa bwaki buya bwokiririe buya na Disemba 23-29, 2025. Gendete nyakwariria buya ng'enda bano yesebere.
Dholuo: Wang' adhiambo mar Grade 9 nyaka okwayi e yo mar senior school odhiambo pii ka December 23-29, 2025. Konyruok gi jowi dhako mar inye kuom tho.
Somali: Ardayda fasalka 9-aad waxay dib-u-eegis ku sameyn karaan meelaha ay ka qornaayeen dugsiga sarsare laga bilaabo 23ka ilaa 29ka Diseembar, 2025. La xidhiidh madaxa dugsigaaga faahfaahinta codsiga.

English: The Ministry of Education has released an updated list of C3 County secondary schools for Grade 10 placement in 2026. Parents are advised to verify school details through official channels and reputable media.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu imetangaza orodha iliyosasishwa ya shule za sekondari za Kaunti ya C3 kwa ajili ya usajili wa Kidato cha Kumi mwaka 2026. Wazazi wanashauriwa kuangalia maelezo ya shule kupitia njia rasmi na vyombo vya habari vinavyoaminika.
Ekegusii: Obwaki bwo Obwaki bw'Abana bwasibogetere orere oriena bw'ekegusii bw'amasomo bw'ikusenye bw'ekibeti kya C3 mu masomo egi 2026. Ababere bategereje okweria obwakinyari bu bwere, bwanga obwaki bwere bwere bwere buzirighire abantungi.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education omiye list mar C3 County secondary schools nane kogo 10 e mwaka 2026. Wazazi to ng'ado ji juk mag nyaka kadi e chandruok manyaka.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa soo saartay liis la cusboonaysiiyay oo dugsiyada sare ee C3 Degmada ah loogu talagalay kaalinta Fasalka 10 ee 2026. Waalidiinta waxaa lagu talinayaa inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta dugsiyada iyada oo la adeegsanayo kanaallo rasmiga ah iyo saxaafad lagu kalsoon yahay.

English: Are you considering your future career? Review the most marketable courses in Kenya for 2025 to ensure your choice aligns with high-demand skills for employment and self-employment opportunities.
Kiswahili: Je, unafikiria kuhusu kazi yako ya baadaye? Kagua kozi zinazouzwa zaidi nchini Kenya kwa mwaka wa 2025 ili uhakikishe chaguo lako linakidhi ujuzi wanaohitajika kwa nafasi za ajira na fursa za kujiajiri.
Ekegusii: Ona omokirende okogoti omokiri? Wang'anya emokireri jia ikireng'ere mu Kenya mapeji 2025 buya omohanya omokiri bwogoti buya topogoria korera na bosi buya oraki.
Dholuo: Iwang'ni cha kwa kendo gima ok nyalo kony kanyalo. Jungi gi neno ma ok anyal konyi maler e Kenya kwa 2025 to ing'eyo chike mokuongo chike kendo karita ma ok nyalo mwandifa e kanyako.
Somali: Ma waxaad ka fakaraysaa mustaqbalkaaga shaqo? Eeg koorsooyinka ugu iibinta badan Kenya ee sanadka 2025 si aad u hubiso in doorashadaada ay ku jirto xirfadaha lagu dalbanayo ee shaqo iyo fursadaha iskaa wax u qabso.

English: The Ministry of Education will soon publish the official list of Extra-County Schools for Grade 10 placement in 2026. Stay tuned for updates on the ministry's official website.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu itachapisha hivi karibuni orodha rasmi ya Shule za Ziada za Kaunti kwa ajili ya usajili wa Kidato cha Kumi mwaka wa 2026. Fuata tovuti rasmi ya wizara kwa habari zaidi.
Ekegusii: Omoige buya bw'Inyare buya obogonyang'ire orori bw'Extra-County buya bware bw'Grade 10 mu 2026. Naki oria omokinyaki buya bwegana buya buya bw'omoige.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education buo chalo ng'eyo piny mar lisi nigi gi Extra-County Schools maka Grade 10 kuom 2026. Nyancha ohero kuom wendo e ng'ato mar ministry.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay dhawaan daabici doontaa liiska rasmiga ah ee Dugsiyada Dheeraadka ah ee loogu talagalay goobaha fasalka 10 ee 2026. La soco wararka ku saabsan bogga rasmiga ah ee wasaaradda.

English: The Ministry of Education has released Grade 10 senior school placement results; learners can check their placements on the KNEC KJSEA portal using their assessment number and registered name.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu imetangaza matokeo ya uhamisho kwa wanafunzi wa darasa la 10; wanafunzi wanaweza kuangalia uhamisho wao kwenye portal ya KNEC KJSEA wakitumia nambari yao ya tathmini na jina walilojiandikisha.
Ekegusii: Abanyang'ania bakiaro bw'ong'era bw'ekikuyu 10 bonyere  na bakiire; abakiaria karia bakiang'ania bange bonyora mu KNEC KJSEA  portal na namba yabo ya  bw'ong'era na eria yabo eshori.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education oyudi chalo mar gin gi pwodho mar Grade 10; jodongo bang' ni buok gi pwodho tek KNEC KJSEA portalo kod jorinyo gi din.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa soo saartay natiijooyinka rakaabka dugsiga sare ee fasalka 10; ardaydu waxay ka hubin karaan goobta KNEC KJSEA iyagoo isticmaalaya lambarka qiimaynta iyo magaca diiwaangelinta.

English: The Ministry of Education has released the full list of national schools admitting Grade 10 learners under the CBC for 2026. Parents are encouraged to review school offerings before placement.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu imetoa orodha kamili ya shule za kitaifa zinazokubali wanafunzi wa Daraja la 10 chini ya CBC kwa mwaka 2026. Wazazi wanahimizwa kupitia huduma za shule kabla ya kuwekwa.
Ekegusii: Obwaki bw'ekaranga bwakire omokang'anyi buya bw'abiikire buya bw'amiarenda bw'abere 10 buadere akiraka bw'ekiga ekiri 2026. Ababere b'anogore buya bw'ekabere bw'ekiru bwasomere.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education emer kod lista yakiote mag oting’ eyo nyaka piny gi Grade 10 tich jodak CBC ma okel 2026. Wazazi nine odhiere konyo wakili madhi kendo nyaka ok protrza.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa soo saaray liiska dhamaystiran ee dugsiyada qaranka ee qaadaya ardayda fasalka 10aad ee hoos yimaada CBC sanadka 2026. Waalidiinta waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay dib u eegaan waxyaabaha dugsiyada bixiyaan ka hor inta aan la keenin.

English: The Ministry of Education has approved select senior schools to offer Agriculture, Aviation, and Home Science for Grade 10 under the Competency-Based Education system. For details, visit the Ministry of Education website.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu imethibitisha shule za sekondari kuchaguliwa kutoa Kilimo, Anga, na Sayansi ya Nyumbani kwa Kidato cha 10 chini ya mfumo wa Elimu Inayopatikana Kulingana na Uwezo. Kwa maelezo zaidi, tembelea tovuti ya Wizara ya Elimu.
Ekegusii: Omoige buseki bu Kegorgia bwakire masomo maite bwakire buseketi bu Ng'eno, bu Kisii naki bulogori bu Mang'ori bu Grade 10 bu Kegoria bu Majanjo. Koresha buseki bu Kegorgia bwayago.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education abiro kata gige makata mondo okel Agriculture, Aviation, gi Home Science e Grade 10 pod Jomoko to. Moko dhi nyaka tinde e website ma Ministry of Education.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa ansixisay dugsiyada sare ee xulashada leh inay bixiyaan Beeraha, Duulista, iyo Sayniska Guriga fasalka 10aad iyadoo la isticmaalayo nidaamka Waxbarashada Ku Salaysan Kartida. Faahfaahin dheeri ah, booqo bogga internetka ee Wasaaradda Waxbarashada.

English: Grade 10 learners must select 12 schools for Senior School placement: six STEM, three Arts & Sports Science, and three Social Sciences. Placements will be automated; check KEMIS for results.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa darasa la 10 lazima wyb seçe shule 12 kwa ajili ya nafasi za Shule Kuu: shule sita za STEM, shule tatu za Sanaa na Sayansi ya Michezo, na shule tatu za Sayansi za Kijamii. Nafasi zitaandaliwa kwa njia ya automatiska; angalia KEMIS kwa matokeo.
Ekegusii: Abaki 10 baki bakanie masomo 12 oria bwakinyang'ana sadiki: naki naki STEM, mosome motatu Arts & Sports Science, na mosome motatu Social Sciences. Kegana kiebwanie nike; bwanorie KEMIS oria bwasibori.
Dholuo: Wath ni grade 10 nyaka chir 12 schools onge goyo Senior School: thum STEM, thum arts kata Sports Science, kendo thum Social Sciences. Goyo makare joge odek; urwe KEMIS kuom kanyinge.
Somali: Ardayda darajada 10aad waa in ay doortaan 12 iskuul si ay uga mid noqdaan waxbarashada Sare: lix STEM, seddex Farshaxan & Isboorti, iyo seddex Cilmiga Bulshada. Meelaha waxbarashada waxaa la hagaajin doonaa si otomaati ah; hubi KEMIS si aad u aragto natiijooyinka.

English: This is a reminder to all Multinational Security Support Mission officers: remain vigilant and adhere to safety protocols while on duty in Haiti to reduce the risks of accidents and violence.
Kiswahili: Huu ni ukumbusho kwa maafisa wote wa Shughuli za Kusaidia Usalama wa Kimataifa: kuweni makini na fuateni kanuni za usalama mnipokazi nchini Haiti ili kupunguza hatari za ajali na vurugu.
Ekegusii: Naki naki buya bw'ogoti Obwakongera bw'Abagiti Obwakibori: mwaki buya na mwaki naki buya ekahi eknya mu Haiti kumera bhomokiri buya na bw'akibori na bwenjire.
Dholuo: Nia ere gi ka gi nueyo ma multimaji Security Support Mission: riyogo gi piny na maler ne uwacho to tije chieg ka gi en mashin nyaka dhiang' to oyande risks mag dhang' gima en.
Somali: Tani waa xusuusin dhammaan sarkaaladda Hawlgalka Taageerada Amniga Multinational: fadlan ka taxaddar oo raac xeerarka amniga inta aad shaqeyneyso Haiti si loo yareeyo khataraha shilalka iyo rabshadaha.

English: Mutahi Kahiga has resigned as Vice Chair of the Council of Governors. He issued a public apology to the Odinga family and to Kenyans for his recent remarks.
Kiswahili: Mutahi Kahiga amejiuzulu kama Naibu Mwenyekiti wa Baraza la Magavana. Ameomba radhi hadharani kwa familia ya Odinga na Wakenya kwa maoni yake ya hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Mutahi Kahiga orogotere ng'anya za Vice Chair wa Council of Governors. Oregoti obwakire obwakire buya ku Odinga emaki na Abakisi naki orokere buya bwa buya bwi mosi.
Dholuo: Mutahi Kahiga adhi gi resi kama Vice Chair ma Council of Governors. Osepe ni maok e gima odug e Odinga ka Kenyans puonj e gima ohinga motindo.
Somali: Mutahi Kahiga ayaa is casilay xilka Ku Xigeenka Golaha Madaxweynayaasha. Wuxuu raalli gelin dadweyne u diray qoyskii Odinga iyo bulshada Kenyan-ka ah hadalladiisii u dambeeyay.

English: Eugene Wamalwa has introduced his wife to the public; she is expected to be the First Lady if he becomes President in the future.
Kiswahili: Eugene Wamalwa amemtanabahisha mkewe kwa umma; anatarajiwa kuwa Mama wa Kwanza ikiwa atakuwa Rais siku za usoni.
Ekegusii: Eugene Wamalwa aerekirie omokiri buya; aigwa oria aighete Omosorori epokire babere bw'ore oregorere Omosari buya.
Dholuo: Eugene Wamalwa owinjore chike gi yien; owinj gi koro dudi kama ok ungel kanyokwiri mar Nyanj.
Somali: Eugene Wamalwa wuxuu bulshada u soo bandhigay naftiisa; waxaa la filayaa inay noqoto First Lady haddii uu mustaqbalka noqdo Madaxweyne.

English: The National Police Service has established a dedicated counselling unit to provide psychological support to officers facing mental health challenges.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Kitaifa ya Polisi imeanzisha kitengo maalum cha ushauri kutoa msaada wa kisaikolojia kwa maafisa wanaokabiliwa na changamoto za afya ya akili.
Ekegusii: Nakiroono ya Polisi ya Taifa emokere unit yaki rigi olanderi oria omokiranya abaki baaba naki ekerereri.
Dholuo: Ka Koti Olukoye Moko, National Police Service abiero konyo gima omiyo gingo tich mar konyo ma ka joma ni kanyono bedo ka joni kadhoko kendo.
Somali: Hay'adda Booliska Qaranka ayaa sameysay unug la-talin gaar ah si ay taageero nafsi ah ugu siiso sarkaaladda la kulmaya caqabadaha caafimaadka maskaxda.

English: Schools must submit Competency-Based Curriculum project scores for Grades 3, 7, 8, and Grade 9 by the deadline to avoid a penalty of Ksh500 per student. Access the CBA portal for details.
Kiswahili: Shule zinatakiwa kuwasilisha alama za mradi wa Mitaala kwa Misingi ya Uwezo kwa Darasa la 3, 7, 8, na darasa la 9 kabla ya wakati uliowekwa ili kuepuka faini ya Ksh500 kwa mwanafunzi. Tembelea lango la CBA kwa maelezo zaidi.
Ekegusii: Masomo mang'anya ogendete omokirukire ogore buya bwaki bwose bwakigori 3, 7, 8 na 9 naki bwokiongo obwakire buya bwende toki oro bwogendete omokiri buria bwaki bwaki Ksh500 omokirubori. Naki oria CBA portal omokirukotore obwakire buya.
Dholuo: Masomo onego nyaka itum kit gi scores mar Competency-Based Curriculum kuom Grades 3, 7, 8, gi Grade 9 kendo oyie kod ng'ato makelo Ksh500 kede. Nyanja CBA portal kudhi e rwako.
Somali: Dugsiyada waa inay soo gudbiyaan dhibcaha mashruuca Manhajka Aqoonta Ku Saleysan ee Qaybta 3, 7, 8, iyo Qaybta 9 waqtiga loogu talagalay si looga fogaado ganaax Ksh500 arday kasta. Booqo portal-ka CBA si aad u hesho faahfaahin.

English: Victims of fraud related to the Social Health Authority (SHA) Fund are urged to report incidents via the SHA Call Center at 147. Immediate legal action will be taken against offenders.
Kiswahili: Madhara wa udanganyifu wa Shirika la Afya Jamii (SHA) wanatiwa moyo kuripoti matukio kupitia Kituo cha Simu cha SHA kwa nambari 147. Hatua za kisheria zitachukuliwa mara moja dhidi ya wahalifu.
Ekegusii: Abagore bano bakiaga buya buse, jia boke bosi buya mosi bu Ekenaria SHA fund, ndiri bosibori bwaki anga bu naire bu Ekenaria SHA Call Center ku 147. Bunduki bwaki bwogekube bwogenangwa bosi boki.
Dholuo: Wang'ni mar fraud ma okiny koluok kuom Social Health Authority (SHA) Fund, wacho ni toth jomoko ni nigi kanyien gi SHA Call Center kod 147. Serekani mar dhane moko chalo ni go.
Somali: Dadka ku dhibaataysan khiyaano la xiriirta Fonka Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay waxyaabaha dhacaya ku soo warbixiyaan xarunta wicitaanka SHA ee 147. Tallaabo sharci degdeg ah ayaa la qaadayaa ka dhanka ah kuwii falka geystay.

English: Workers in the sugar industry are set to strike starting Thursday if Sh10.8 billion in unpaid wages is not addressed. All sugar companies may join in solidarity if demands are unmet.
Kiswahili: Wafanyakazi katika sekta ya sukari wanaeza kuanza mgomo kuanzia Alhamisi ikiwa Sh10.8 bilioni za mishahara isiyolipwa hazitatatuliwa. Kampuni zote za sukari zinaweza kujiunga kwa umoja ikiwa mahitaji hayatatimizwa.
Ekegusii: Abakinye bakiami bwo buya bwaremesere omokiri, bwaki bwere na kutama naki mugwané naki Sh10.8 bilioni batarushire. Abakiami bose ba buya bokena bwaremesere bwaki buria naki.
Dholuo: Wang'ni gi duong' ma dholuo nyaka omiya jaluo ma nyaka chim cha juma gi Sh10.8 bilioni kuom nyaka omiya. Kendo komiti dholuo nyaka nigi kuom ni kendo ka nyaka chim wawinj e gina joma g'uchu ma ginye.
Somali: Shaqaalaha wax soo saarka sonkorta ayaa bilaabi doona grev isniinta haddii lacag dhan Sh10.8 bilyan oo mushahar ah aan la bixin. Dhammaan shirkadaha sonkorta ayaa ku biiri kara muujinta midnimo haddii codsiyada aan la fulin.

English: No actionable content available.
Kiswahili: Hakuna maudhui ya kuchukua hatua yaliyopo.
Ekegusii: Naki nonang'ana chirori.
Dholuo: N/A
Somali: Ma jiro wax xog ah oo la qaadi karo.

English: Increased security measures are in effect around State House following a tragic incident. All visitors are reminded to comply with security protocols at Gate D.
Kiswahili: Hatua za kuimarisha usalama zipo ndani ya Ikulu kufuatia tukio la kusikitisha. Wageni wote wanakumbushwa kufuata taratibu za usalama katika Lango D.
Ekegusii: Bwakire bwaki nyang'ore bwakaite bwakire bwaki bw'enyoma bosi bosi bwigwe bu State House bu buno bwaki. Abakaya bosi baki ɔgwirakire bosi nyang'ore ekyare bwaki Gate D.
Dholuo: Ngeyo mar dako piny ne onywolo kuom State House kendo e mang'ongo mar yore. Wagena wacho ni oseth riri kuom yore konyo ku Gate D.
Somali: Talaabooyin amni oo dheeri ah ayaa la qaaday agagaarka State House ka dib dhacdo murugo leh. Dhammaan booqdayaashu waa in ay la socdaan shuruucda amniga ee albaabka D.

English: Attention teachers: The TSC medical cover will officially lapse on November 30, 2025, at 11:59 p.m. Ensure all treatments and admissions are completed before this deadline.
Kiswahili: Tangaza walimu: Bima ya afya ya TSC itakoma rasmi tarehe 30 Novemba, 2025, saa 5:59 usiku. Hakikisha matibabu na uhamisho yamekamilishwa kabla ya tarehe hii.
Ekegusii: Abaki abate: Ekibaru cha TSC cha buya buya chiswaki na pili buya buya, Eria 30, 2025, ore 11:59 p.m. Vangirire buya buya bwose na odiri bwose buya buya biondeka bw’ise.
Dholuo: Jaduong' gi joma: TSC medical cover nyaka oseti e November 30, 2025, sa 11:59 p.m. Nyasaye chayo kendo wil joluo ka ng'ato okonyo chalo.
Somali: Dhammaan macallimiinta: Caymiska caafimaadka TSC ayaa rasmiyan dhici doona 30ka Noofambar, 2025, saacadda 11:59 p.m. Hubi in dhammaan daaweynta iyo gelitaanka la dhammeeyo ka hor waqtigan.

English: The Teachers Service Commission has opened 9,159 teaching vacancies for permanent and pensionable positions. Interested candidates must apply online by December 8, 2025, via www.tsc.go.ke.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma za Walimu imefungua nafasi 9,159 za ufundishaji za kudumu na za pensheni. Wagombea wenye nia wanatakiwa kuomba mtandaoni mpaka tarehe 8 Desemba 2025 kupitia www.tsc.go.ke.
Ekegusii: Komishini ya Abareki bategenye 9,159 ebasa obwakinyegeri bw'egakura na bwokori. Abakire batarakire naki bakenye babere online kosi December 8, 2025, kukor www.tsc.go.ke.
Dholuo: Teachers Service Commission onyalo 9,159 ndalo ma okinyi mar buoya gi ochako. Wang'ni kadaneya bene konyo online kendo gima osiemogo yie ni December 8, 2025, kuom www.tsc.go.ke.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa furay 9,159 boos oo waxbarasho oo joogto ah iyo kuwo gunno leh. Musharrixiinta daneynaya waa inay khadka tooska ah ku codsadaan ilaa 8-da Diseembar, 2025, iyaga oo booqanaya www.tsc.go.ke.

English: KNEC will release KJSEA results on December 11, 2025. Learners will report to Grade 10 on January 12, 2026. Teachers should prepare required documentation for any benefits related to examiner deaths.
Kiswahili: KNEC itatoa matokeo ya KJSEA tarehe 11 Desemba, 2025. Wanafunzi watarejea darasa la 10 tarehe 12 Januari, 2026. Walimu wanapaswa kuandaa nyaraka zinazohitajika kwa ajili ya manufaa yanayohusiana na vifo vya makatibu wa mitihani.
Ekegusii: KNEC ikire naki KJSEA buya bwaki omosi 11, 2025. Abagere bategere bwakere mu Grade 10 omosi 12, 2026. Abasomi bategere buya bwaki buorere bwakire kubwaki bida buya buya oborere bwakinyaki.
Dholuo: KNEC owinj gi KJSEA ng'ato kuonde 11, 2025. Makaranda nene bende pona e Grade 10 nyaka 12, 2026. Sirkal kamano okonyo do bura mar pi ng'ato mar jaluo.
Somali: KNEC waxay soo saari doontaa natiijooyinka KJSEA 11ka Diseembar, 2025. Ardaydu waxay tegi doonaan Fasalka 10ka 12ka Janaayo, 2026. Macallimiintu waa inay diyaar u yihiin dokumentiyada loo baahan yahay wax kasta oo la xidhiidha dhimashada imtixaanka.

English: KNUT members are reminded that all full-time officers must vacate office after their five-year term or upon turning 65. Ensure your membership is current for participation in leadership matters.
Kiswahili: Wajumbe wa KNUT wanakumbushwa kuwa maafisa wote wa muda wote lazima waondoke ofisini baada ya muda wao wa miaka mitano au wanapofikisha umri wa miaka 65. Hakikisha uanachama wako ni wa sasa ili kushiriki katika masuala ya uongozi.
Ekegusii: Ababere ba KNUT baria naki, bosi bosi buya bendi boke omokireri oangu buya opokorere na bwakiri bwenda buya oria naki 65. Naki onyerere bosi bwe ya oreka osera omobori buya.
Dholuo: Abaluhya mar KNUT, nyasaye ng'ato oger kanyoni isik nind kod pok ng'ama koro nyaka ratiro mar jo higni manie iye kendo ng'ama ng'omiyo 65. Wachone ni ng'ato wacho nyaluok ka ng'ato oyier mondringo mar chiegni.
Somali: Xubnaha KNUT waa in la xasuusiyo in dhammaan officers-ka shaqada buuxda ay tahay inay baneeyaan xafiiska kadib shanta sano ee adeegooda ama marka ay gaaraan da'da 65. Hubi in xubinnimadaadu ay tahay mid casri ah si aad uga qayb gasho arrimaha hoggaanka.

English: The Kenya School of Government has canceled Certificates of Achievement Serial No. MA 0251 to MA 1000 due to forgery; these certificates are invalid and should not be used.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Serikali ya Kenya imesitisha Vyeti vya Ufanisi Serial No. MA 0251 hadi MA 1000 kwa sababu ya uongozi; vyeti hivi si halali na havipaswi kutumika.
Ekegusii: Shule ya Serikali ya Kenya yatikisa Mashahidi ya Ufanisi ya Namba MA 0251 hadi MA 1000 kwa sababu ya udanganyifu; mashahidi haya ni batili na hayapaswi kutumika.
Dholuo: Kenya School of Government asalire Certifikat mar Achievements Serial No. MA 0251 gi MA 1000 kendo ni kanyalo ibiro; certifikat nyien ok ginyalo kendo ok bende giwech.
Somali: Dugsiga Dowladda Kenya wuxuu joojiyey Shahaadooyinka Guusha Tirooyinka MA 0251 ilaa MA 1000 sababo la xiriira been-abuur; shahaadooyinkan ma shaqeynayaan oo looma baahan yahay in la isticmaalo.

English: Starting December 1, 2025, over 400,000 teachers and their dependents will transition to the Social Health Authority scheme, providing expanded medical benefits and access to over 9,000 healthcare facilities.
Kiswahili: Kuanzia Desemba 1, 2025, walimu zaidi ya 400,000 na wategemezi wao watahamia kwenye mpango wa Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii, ukitoa faida za kiafya zilizopanuliwa na ufikiaji wa vituo vya afya zaidi ya 9,000.
Ekegusii: Begonire Disemba 1, 2025, abaroria 400,000 na abasaaki bomsibori bakenyere ku ichemo chaki Social Health Authority, bokenyeni obori buya bwakiranga na bonyengete ku obokioria 9,000 bwokibori.
Dholuo: Kang'ero wuon December 1, 2025, teachers 400,000 kendo kanyakla riyogi kuom schema Social Health Authority, ka ginyalo ginyoo giwenyono mar cha cha mar 9,000 healthcare facilities.
Somali: Laga bilaabo Diseembar 1, 2025, in ka badan 400,000 macallin iyo xubnahooda ku saabsan ayaa u guaydi doona nidaamka Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada, iyagoo helaya faa'iidooyin caafimaad oo ballaaran iyo gelitaan ka badan 9,000 oo xarumo caafimaad.

English: All students at Jomo Kenyatta University of Agriculture and Technology must vacate the campus by Sunday, November 2, 2025, at 4:00 p.m. due to the indefinite suspension of learning activities.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wote katika Chuo Kikuu cha Kilimo na Teknolojia cha Jomo Kenyatta wanapaswa kuhama chuoni kabla ya Jumapili, Novemba 2, 2025, saa 10:00 jioni kutokana na kusitishwa kwa shughuli za kujifunza mpaka taarifa nyingine.
Ekegusii: Naki abokireri bose ba Jomo Kenyatta University of Agriculture and Technology batarereke esibori egesia nyasa, Osorori 2, 2025, na 4:00 p.m. naki ore mokomi omokinyere buya.
Dholuo: Okwong’ mana nyiso gi Jomo Kenyatta University of Agriculture and Technology nyaka gir bende konyo kuon piny gi wuok, November 2, 2025, piny 4:00 p.m. ka wanyalo kelo duto mar hesabu.
Somali: Dhammaan ardayda Jaamacadda Jomo Kenyatta ee Beeraha iyo Teknolojiyadda waa inay ka baxaan kampuska Axadda, Noofambar 2, 2025, saacadu markay tahay 4:00 galabnimo sababo la xiriira joojinta aan wakhtigu lahayn ee hawlaha waxbarashada.

English: The Universities Academic Staff Union (UASU) demands full payment of Ksh7.9 billion in salary arrears before lecturers return to work, affecting academic activities across public universities.
Kiswahili: Shirikisho la W Staff wa Vyuo Vikuu (UASU) linadai malipo kamili ya Ksh7.9 bilioni ya madeni ya mishahara kabla ya wahadhiri kurejea kazini, ikihusisha shughuli za akademia katika vyuo vikuu vya umma.
Ekegusii: Ishureti ri UASU iria na omokire buya bw’egesere bw’ahorendani bwa Ksh7.9 bilioni mu eguru oro omotaka orekererete buya, omokinyogi omogogoti mwaghenyo oria ogokinyangi oria omoraganja motiriri.
Dholuo: Universities Academic Staff Union (UASU) okwayi nitie kanyo ma wuon Ksh7.9 billion e wadhowi wadhiok, ma okonyo kutegno ni ma lecet ng’ato otemo, to ni inyalo lam kadh kanyakla e wadhodhi gombo.
Somali: Ururo Shaqaalaha Jaamacadaha (UASU) waxay dalbadeen in la bixiyo lacag dhan Ksh7.9 bilyan oo deyn ah kahor inta macallimiinta aysan shaqada u noqon, taasoo saameyn doonta hawlaha aqooneed ee jaamacadaha dowliga ah.

English: Results for the 2025 KCSE, KPSEA, and KJSEA exams will be released by KNEC in December. Students should prepare for the transition to senior school in January 2026.
Kiswahili: Matokeo ya mtihani wa KCSE, KPSEA, na KJSEA ya mwaka 2025 yatarajiwa kutolewa na KNEC mwezi Desemba. Wanafunzi wanapaswa kujiandaa kwa kuhamia shule za upili Januari 2026.
Ekegusii: Ebendi bwogana 2025 KCSE, KPSEA, na KJSEA bonyore bwakire bu KNEC mwaki wa Disemba. Abana bonyorire bwogendi bu mwena bu kisii bwakire bu mwaki wa Januari 2026.
Dholuo: Tich mar 2025 KCSE, KPSEA, kendo KJSEA maber chalo e December. Wanafunzi kuom nyaka kumiya goyo ang'wenyo e senior school e Januari 2026.
Somali: Natiijooyinka imtixaannada 2025 KCSE, KPSEA, iyo KJSEA ayaa KNEC soo bandhigi doonaa bisha Diseembar. Ardaydu waa inay is diyaariyaan isbeddelka dugsiga sare bisha Janaayo 2026.

English: A new political party has been formed to contest the 2027 elections. The launch will take place in May — all interested supporters are encouraged to attend.
Kiswahili: Chama kipya cha kisiasa kimeundwa kushiriki katika uchaguzi wa 2027. Uzinduzi utafanyika mwezi Mei — wafuasi wote wanaofurahia wanahimizwa kuhudhuria.
Ekegusii: Abandu batoria oria bataratenga abwaki buya batarena omokosi bw'ekegena 2027. Obwakurori bujaki buya bwonjirira mw'egesibori ya May — abaki batoria oria bosi baraki batorai bweri.
Dholuo: Paro marach gi politik hi nyalo konyo tho e golo 2027. Kadhumo no ndogo mayom — chiembi nyandi eyo tich gi chalo okonyo.
Somali: Parti cusub ayaa la aas aasay si ay uga qayb gasho doorashada 2027. Munaasibadda dhicitaanka ayaa dhici doonta bisha May — dhammaan taageerayaasha danaynaya ayaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka soo qayb galaan.

English: Elders from the Gusii community will hold a major ceremony at Gusii Stadium soon to endorse Fred Matiang'i as a key political figure. All are invited to attend.
Kiswahili: Wazee wa jamii ya Gusii watashiriki katika sherehe kubwa katika Uwanja wa Gusii hivi karibuni kumpigia debe Fred Matiang'i kama kiongozi muhimu wa kisiasa. Wote mnakaribishwa kuhudhuria.
Ekegusii: Abagere bu Egesa naki bosi boki otokore omogaka bu Gusii Stadium bochenda gutamba Fred Matiang'i ng'enda omogori ogekarera. Bwakire bwaki bwikire buiso.
Dholuo: K'inyas ka g'amba mar Gusii bende bende ogendgi chogo magi yien na Gusii Stadium e chanda kuom yakinyi Fred Matiang'i gi kromi. Nyasaye ma oting'o omondia.
Somali: Odayaasha bulshada Gusii ayaa qaban doona munaasabad weyn oo ka dhacaysa Gusii Stadium si ay u taageeraan Fred Matiang'i sidii shaqsi siyaasadeed muhiim ah. Dhammaan waa la soo dhaweynayaa inay yimaadaan.

English: The family of gospel artist Betty Bayo has announced her passing. Condolences can be directed to the family as arrangements are made for her funeral.
Kiswahili: Familia ya msanii wa injili Betty Bayo imetangaza kifo chake. Rambirambi zinaweza kuelekezwa kwa familia wakati mipango ya mazishi inaandaliwa.
Ekegusii: Itarate ya omotegisani ogosi Betty Bayo ekorese okebere. Tigi-naki naki ikibori kainnorie buya benaki buya oria omoyerogori.
Dholuo: Jamii ya mzungu gospel Betty Bayo yong’eyo nengo piny. Nyaka tich ni mamoko maduong’ ku jamii kendo nyise wachar yore.
Somali: Qoyska fannaanada gospel-ka ee Betty Bayo ayaa ku dhawaaqay geerideeda. Tacsiyadu waxaa lagu hagaajin karaa qoyska iyadoo loo sameynayo qabanqaabada aaska.

English: Kenya is now offering 500 scholarships and 20 annual exchange programs for students in health-related fields, funded by China's $500 million support initiative. Interested applicants should apply now.
Kiswahili: Kenya sasa inatoa ufadhili wa masomo 500 na mipango ya kubadilishana ya kila mwaka 20 kwa wanafunzi katika nyanja za afya, ikifadhiliwa na mpango wa msaada wa dola bilioni 500 kutoka China. Waombaji wanaovutiwa wanapaswa kuomba sasa.
Ekegusii: Kenya ikorere 500 shirikisho na 20 misha ya kupitisha mwakilishi kwa wanafunzi bota buseki, ichoreri nakiya ya pesa 500 million ya China. Abaki bwanjogori naki ekunyarite.
Dholuo: Kenya en ka winj 500 scholarships gi 20 programs mar exchange mwaka duto ma ok gi somo ka health, kuom funding mar China $500 million. Wakenyani mohanya ma inyal keth.
Somali: Kiiniya waxay hadda bixineysaa 500 deeqo waxbarasho iyo 20 barnaamij isdhaafsiga sanadkiiba ah ardayda ku hawlan caafimaadka, oo ay maalgelinayso $500 milyan oo taageero ah oo ka timid Shiinaha. Codsadayaasha daneynaya waa inay hadda codsadaan.

English: Diamond Platnumz has signed a $5 million deal with Warner Music Group, emphasizing the strong position of African artists in negotiating with international labels.
Kiswahili: Diamond Platnumz ametia saini mkataba wa dola milioni 5 na Warner Music Group, akionyesha nguvu ya wasanii wa Afrika katika kufanya mazungumzo na lebo za kimataifa.
Ekegusii: Diamond Platnumz amekubali mkataba wa $5 million na Warner Music Group, akiashiria nguvu ya wasanii wa Afrika katika mazungumzo na lebo za kimataifa.
Dholuo: Diamond Platnumz asigned deal $5 million gi Warner Music Group, kendo ok in gi chalo mar jaluo Africa to chunya kelo ma ineno gi international labels.
Somali: Diamond Platnumz ayaa heshiis $5 million ah la saxiixday Warner Music Group, taasoo muujineysa awoodda xooggan ee fannaaniinta Afrikan ah marka ay la xiriiro calaamadaha caalamiga ah.

English: The Government of Kenya invites qualified individual consultants to apply for the NYOTA Project consultancy roles by submitting Expressions of Interest (EOIs) by November 28, 2025, at 10:00 a.m. EAT.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kenya inawakaribisha wakandarasi binafsi walio na ujuzi kuomba nafasi za ushauri wa Mradi wa NYOTA kwa kuwasilisha Maelekezo ya Interesse (EOIs) kabla ya Novemba 28, 2025, saa 4:00 asubuhi EAT.
Ekegusii: Abagaitani ba Kenya batania abateganaki bakananga kugikora kwa NYOTA Project buse ogwanire Expressions of Interest (EOIs) ginyang'endi buse Novemba 28, 2025, buse 10:00 a.m. EAT.
Dholuo: Government of Kenya en owuok ji kinde ma oting'ocio kuor NYOTA Project kendo ng'eyo Expressions of Interest (EOIs) kuom November 28, 2025, nyaka 10:00 a.m. EAT.
Somali: Dowladda Kenya waxay ku martiqaadaysaa lataliyayaal gaar ah oo aqoon leh inay codsadaan doorarka latalinta ee Mashruuca NYOTA iyagoo soo gudbinaya Muujinta Danaha (EOIs) ilaa 28ka Nofembar 2025, saacadda 10:00 subaxnimo EAT.

English: The National Assembly has rejected Senate amendments to increase county allocations by Ksh65 billion. The bill will proceed to mediation to resolve the deadlock.
Kiswahili: Bunge la Kitaifa limekataa marekebisho ya Seneti ya kuongeza mgao wa kaunti kwa Ksh65 bilioni. Muswada utaelekea kwenye usuluhishi ili kutatua mkwamo.
Ekegusii: Abakire b'Engeri Bwakore buseere busiri bw'ibiro b'akiiru buwaki bwasageria sukiri bw'akatiga bw'amahe ne Ksh65 billion. Entebe eya busiri bweria ikangia buseere za kung'anya ogenda.
Dholuo: National Assembly amar eyo lathni ma oket gi bende ketho mag seneti mwonde pwodhi Ksh65 bilioni. Gik ndio ng'ato kendo chiegni mar ni ibiro konyo jen.
Somali: Golaha Qaranka ayaa diiday isbeddeladii Aqalka Sare ee kordhinta lacagaha deegaannada Ksh65 bilyan. Qaanuunka ayaa loo gudbin doonaa dhexdhexaadinta si loo xalliyo khilaafka.

English: Lee Funeral Home in Nairobi provides customized funeral and cremation services, 24-hour body collection, and assistance with legal documentation for burials and international transfers.
Kiswahili: Lee Funeral Home mjini Nairobi inatoa huduma za maziko na kuchoma mwili zilizo boreshwa, ukusanyaji wa miili masaa 24, na msaada katika nyaraka za kisheria za maziko na uhamisho wa kimataifa.
Ekegusii: Lee Funeral Home mu Nairobi inakora emokire ya naki, omokiri bwaki bu naki, naki nakiiga ekibuge bwaki bu burials na intaneti obokai.
Dholuo: Lee Funeral Home e Nairobi nyal paro jopiny ma oseyudo, okinyi duto e kar dho, kendo wan gi thuol mar jopiny kuom kendo yore mag duong' gi piny.
Somali: Lee Funeral Home ee Nairobi waxay bixisaa adeegyo gaarka ah oo aas iyo gubid ah, uruurinta meydka 24 saacadood, iyo caawimaad ku saabsan dukumintiyada sharci ee aaska iyo gudbinta caalamiga ah.

English: The Kenya Defence Forces (KDF) reaffirms its loyalty to the Commander-in-Chief and commitment to national security. Please report any unverified claims to ensure public trust in security institutions.
Kiswahili: Jeshi la Ulinzi la Kenya (KDF) linathibitisha uaminifu wake kwa Kamanda Mkuu na kujitolea kwa usalama wa taifa. Tafadhali ripoti madai yeyote yasiyothibitishwa ili kuhakikisha uaminifu wa umma katika taasisi za usalama.
Ekegusii: Abagane b'Ekongoi ya Kenya (KDF) baisera obwakire bwabo ku Meya w'ekere na batarataria obwakire bwanakiri. Naki nakoreria anyi batisikirani b'ositikigori okusigana bwasiboria mu ekere.
Dholuo: Kenya Defence Forces (KDF) ichung' jowetimo mondo owinjore e Kiongozi-moko kendo ichung' gi chiko mar dhano. Ndakore piny chiegni omiyo ok we niyo otieno oganda mar jomoko e dhano.
Somali: Booqo ciidamada difaaca Kenya (KDF) waxay cadeynayaan daacadnimadooda taliyaha guud iyo ballanqaadyadooda ku aaddan amniga qaranka. Fadlan warbixini wixii sheegasho ah oo aan la xaqiijin si loo hubiyo kalsoonida bulshada ee hay’adaha amniga.

English: The Junior Secondary School (JSS) placement portal will reopen for seven days, allowing learners to revise their school choices for the January 2026 term.
Kiswahili: Portali ya kujiunga na Shule ya Sekondari ya Kati (JSS) itafunguliwa tena kwa siku saba, ikiwapa wanafunzi fursa ya kurekebisha chaguzi zao za shule kwa muhula wa Januari 2026.
Ekegusii: Iporitani ya Junior Secondary School (JSS) itang'ana ikiriani bw'ogotera oria ikibokiri, eweko bw'ana batora bosi obokigenoria oria busharita bwa January 2026.
Dholuo: Portal mar Junior Secondary School (JSS) ng'wonye chike mabor, joombiri e dho mwakoni 7, mana kyaw pote duto kuom gima wagaru kanyo chike mag shule mogik mondo oting'o mo January 2026.
Somali: Barta aqoonsiga ee Dugsiga Sare ee Hoose (JSS) ayaa dib u furi doonta toddobo maalmood, taasoo u oggolaaneysa ardayda inay dib u eegi karaan doorashada dugsiyadooda ee xilliga Janaayo 2026.

English: The Universities' Academic Staff Union (UASU) will begin a strike at the Technical University of Kenya on October 20, 2025, if unresolved grievances are not addressed.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Wafanyakazi wa Akili wa Vyuo Vikuu (UASU) kitaanza mgomo katika Chuo Kikuu cha Teknolojia cha Kenya mnamo Oktoba 20, 2025, ikiwa malalamiko ambayo hayajatatuliwa hayatashughulikiwa.
Ekegusii: Abagambane bu ubugeni bw’amasomo bwa UASU bota buza kukire bw’abarabu bw’Technical University of Kenya mwakenya 20, 2025, naki bw’ose oreoba okwekenyego.
Dholuo: Luo Nyasaye Waluora (UASU) en gi owadgi chiegni e Technical University of Kenya chinywalo gima osetimo 20, 2025, ni bura mar owang' kendo ne en kosi.
Somali: Ururka Shaqaalaha Akadeemiga Jaamacadaha (UASU) ayaa bilaabi doona kacdoon iyo gacan ka hadal jaamacadda farsamada Kenya 20-ka Oktoobar, 2025, haddii aan la xalin cabashooyinka aan la qaadin.

English: The Teachers Service Commission (TSC) is developing a central database for unemployed Kenyan teachers seeking international teaching positions. Interested educators must resign from their current roles to apply.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma ya Walimu (TSC) inaunda hifadhidata kuu kwa walimu wa Kenya wasio na ajira wanaotafuta nafasi za ufundishaji kimataifa. Walimu wanaopenda kujiunga inabidi wajiuzulu kutoka nafasi zao za sasa ili kuomba.
Ekegusii: Nakiaro buya bw'ogenda, Abasomesi b'ogenda (TSC) buya bwakire eng'anya y'ekirondo maaro buya, abakiabire abanyegera abotetete b'ekisomo. Abasomesi bareta bwaki omorogori bw'abo bakania, nakiabire kaenga.
Dholuo: Teachers Service Commission (TSC) en okonyo database ma makare mondiuru ka kikach ni walimu timo ka Ang'wen. Walimu ma nyalo kayore ang'wen noloyo kendo obedo ni bende nyinge konyo.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta (TSC) wuxuu diyaarinayaa kayd dhexe oo loogu talagalay macallimiinta reer Kenya ee aan shaqaynayn oo raadinaya fursado caalami ah. Macallimiinta danaynaya waa inay ka tagaan shaqooyinkooda hadda si ay u codsadaan.

English: Parents of Litein Boys High School are legally challenging a Ksh69 million damage fee imposed after student unrest. Legal action has been initiated to seek accountability and a fair assessment of damages.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wa Shule ya Sekondari ya Litein wanapinga kisheria ada ya fidia ya Ksh69 milioni iliyowekwa baada ya machafuko ya wanafunzi. Hatua za kisheria zimeanzishwa kutafuta uwajibikaji na tathmini haki ya madhara.
Ekegusii: Abakinyabaki ba Litein Boys High School baria bagenyaga omogaka ogw'ekibori Ksh69 million ogwakang'anya omosi ogw'a mwana. Abakinyabaki baria bagenye okwitanga omogaka bw'ekire achahorere omogaka ogwakabere amogenda.
Dholuo: Kanyakla of Litein Boys High School paseno ng’ato ng’ato mar ksh69 million mohon ng’ato gi yore mag luta. Yore mag konyo gima ginyalo chuli gi pi owuon e yo.
Somali: Waalidka iskuulka Litein Boys High School waxay sharciga ku jiheysanayaan lacag caymis ah oo ah Ksh69 milyan oo la saaray ka dib rabshad ka dhacday ardayda. Tallaabo sharci ah ayaa la bilaabay si loo raadiyo mas'uuliyadda iyo qiimeyn cadaalad ah oo ku saabsan khasaarihii dhacay.

English: For academic inquiries at JKUAT, contact the Deputy Vice Chancellor of Academic Affairs at [email protected] or call 067-5870001-5.
Kiswahili: Kwa maswali ya kisayansi katika JKUAT, wasiliana na Naibu Makamu wa Chuo wa Masuala ya Kizazi kupitia [email protected] au piga simu 067-5870001-5.
Ekegusii: Maki nyang'anya maita buya kuri JKUAT, nyakinyagia Deputy Vice Chancellor wa Academic Affairs ku [email protected] kana ugendere 067-5870001-5.
Dholuo: Kawiyogo kuom piny waduong' kuom JKUAT, konyo Deputy Vice Chancellor of Academic Affairs e [email protected] to nying' 067-5870001-5.
Somali: Haddii aad qabtid su'aalo akademik ah oo ku saabsan JKUAT, la xiriir Ku-simaha Madaxda Jaamacadda ee Arrimaha Akademiga adigoo diraya iimayl [email protected] ama wac 067-5870001-5.

English: The Teachers Service Commission is ordered to pay a teacher 22 years of salary following an unlawful retirement. Affected individuals should contact TSC to ensure compliance.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma za Walimu inatakiwa kulipa mwalimu mshahara wa miaka 22 kufuatia uzeo usio halali. Watu walioguswa wanapaswa kuwasiliana na TSC kuhakikisha utekelezaji.
Ekegusii: Naki omokirori bosi boti 22 buchokire bwaki omogosi buya kisi bwoketire. Abokisi baki bogenorie TSC mokeire bwaki buya bung’ene.
Dholuo: Teachers Service Commission owinjore kuchi mamoko mar teachers 22 mwaka gi chiegni to dhi nyaka ma dongo. Wuoth tauto gi nyasaye wach ni ke TSC to chako kijiji kendo mwandhe.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macalimiinta ayaa amar lagu siiyay in ay bixiyaan mushaharka macalimiin 22 sano ah kadib markii la siiyay nasasho sharci darro ah. Shaqsiyaadka ay arrintani khusayso waa in ay la xiriiraan TSC si loo hubiyo u hoggaansanaanta.

English: Applications for the France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship 2026 are now open for Kenyan and international Master's and PhD students. Visit the Campus France website for more information.
Kiswahili: Maombi ya Stipendi ya France Excellence Eiffel 2026 sasa yamefunguliwa kwa wanafunzi wa Master na PhD kutoka Kenya na kimataifa. Tembelea tovuti ya Campus France kwa maelezo zaidi.
Ekegusii: Abakire buya bwa France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship 2026 bwaruguru. Bwakire buya bunyasa kosi abakiria kosi batoroa na PhD. Go na site ya Campus France bosibori oria.
Dholuo: Dhi nyaka kuom ituwore ma France Excellence Eiffel Scholarship 2026 maber nigi kuwe kanyakore mooyo mar Kenya kod kanyalo piny. Wacthie chalo website mar Campus France kuom ma wacho e odhiambo.
Somali: Codsiyada deeqda waxbarasho ee France Excellence Eiffel 2026 ayaa hadda furan ardayda Mastarka iyo PhD-da ee Soomaaliyeed iyo caalamka. Booqo bogga Campus France si aad u hesho macluumaad dheeri ah.

English: The application window for Kenya Medical Training College (KMTC) programmes is open from October 1–14, 2025. Apply via the KUCCPS student portal and pay KSh 1,500 to complete your application.
Kiswahili: Dirisha la maombi kwa programu za Chuo cha Mafunzo ya Tiba Kenya (KMTC) lipo wazi kuanzia Oktoba 1–14, 2025. Omba kupitia lango la wanafunzi la KUCCPS na lipa KSh 1,500 kukamilisha maombi yako.
Ekegusii: Omosasa nyanagoria ya Kenya Medical Training College (KMTC) ikorwagia buya buya 1–14, 2025. Naki egendi buya kya KUCCPS na uphi KSh 1,500 buya okorora omosasa nyanagoria.
Dholuo: Nono mar Kenya Medical Training College (KMTC) nyalo ur kodo tindo manok oting'o 1–14, 2025. Tindo e KUCCPS student portal, kendo chako KSh 1,500 monde oting'o tindo piny.
Somali: Fursadda codsiga barnaamijyada Kenya Medical Training College (KMTC) waxaa furan laga bilaabo Oktoobar 1–14, 2025. Ku codso bogga ardayda ee KUCCPS oo bixi KSh 1,500 si aad u dhammaystirto codsigaaga.

English: Kenyan students can apply for international scholarships; identify the right scholarship, review specific requirements, and begin applications early to meet deadlines.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa Kenya wanaweza kuomba ruzuku za kimataifa; tambua ruzuku inayofaa, kagua mahitaji maalum, na anza maombi mapema ili kukutana na tarehe za mwisho.
Ekegusii: Abanore buya bwakireri bwakire ichora kwaji, bonyanire ebyekarire, na bendechore bosi buya bwakireri buya bwakisoryori.
Dholuo: Wakenya waduong' man Atmosg ni watiwa mokanya nding' owuor; luwore komo nding' owuor, nyisore choch gi chunya, kendo nyal golo mokanya buo ka oyidio lelo.
Somali: Ardayda Kenya waxay codsan karaan deeqo waxbarasho caalami ah; hubi deeqda saxda ah, dib u eeg shuruudaha gaarka ah, oo bilaaw codsiyadaaga goor hore si aad u buuxiso waqtiga kama dambaysta ah.

English: Kylian Mbappe faces a minimum ten-match ban following a red card incident, but will still be eligible to play against Arsenal in the Champions League on April 16.
Kiswahili: Kylian Mbappe anatarajiwa kutengwa kwa mechi kumi baada ya kupata kadi nyekundu, lakini bado atakuwa na uwezo wa kucheza dhidi ya Arsenal katika Ligi ya Mabingwa tarehe 16 Aprili.
Ekegusii: Kylian Mbappe agendire omokireri omosibori ogenda ikinyi ikumi, naki atarenda kuigana ne Arsenal mu Champions League mwaki wa 16, April.
Dholuo: Kylian Mbappe en kende ohim gi nyis mwandu mar ten ma en chalo, to okan e kar kamano omiyo ok nyasa e Arsenal ni mudho Champions League e Aprili 16.
Somali: Kylian Mbappe waxa uu wajahayaa ugu yaraan toban ciyaarood oo ganaax ah kadib markii uu qaatay kaar cas, laakiin wali wuu ka qayb qaadan karaa ciyaarta Arsenal ee Champions League 16ka Abriil.

English: No actionable content available.
Kiswahili: Hakuna maelezo ya kuchukuliwa hatua.
Ekegusii: Bwakire bunyire.
Dholuo: Ekwanda diko kadi, e od ok anyal.
Somali: Ma jiraan wax talo ah oo la qaadi karo.

English: To withdraw money from PayPal to M-Pesa, visit the official PayPal Mobile Money portal; ensure the names on both accounts match. Limits are Ksh150,000 per transaction and Ksh300,000 per day.
Kiswahili: Ili kutoa pesa kutoka PayPal kwenda M-Pesa, tembelea portal rasmi ya PayPal Mobile Money; hakikisha majina kwenye akaunti zote yanashabihiana. Mipaka ni Ksh150,000 kwa kila muamala na Ksh300,000 kwa siku.
Ekegusii: Omoseri omokogeti omonyaki ogokora oria PayPal na M-Pesa, ogokire mu portali ya PayPal Mobile Money; omogwati bwakondere buya bwese buya bwokire. Omokiri buya bwabaki ni Ksh150,000 buya bwekigori na Ksh300,000 buya bwokiri.
Dholuo: To giny jala kuom PayPal kendo ng'ado M-Pesa, naki portal ma ok nyal PayPal Mobile Money; naki gima ni chike kendo ochiko ma obet gi jatuo ma duok. Jotieno ne Ksh150,000 kuom transaction kendo Ksh300,000 ndalo.
Somali: Si aad lacag uga soo baxdo PayPal una dirto M-Pesa, boqo bogga rasmiga ah ee PayPal Mobile Money; hubi in magacyada labada akoonti ay is waafaqsan yihiin. Xadka waa Ksh150,000 halkii hawl-gal iyo Ksh300,000 maalintii.

English: Former Cabinet Secretary Raphael Tuju has been reported missing; his abandoned vehicle was found in Karen. Authorities are conducting a search and investigation.
Kiswahili: Waziri mstaafu Raphael Tuju amepotea; gari lake lililotelekezwa limepatikana Karen. Mamlaka zinafanya uchunguzi na kutafuta.
Ekegusii: Mokiri wa Kowanyaboki Raphael Tuju aoraki chirekendo; ekekori yake emorosere chire mwaki Karen. Obokire bosi buya naki naki hia na andi.
Dholuo: Ong'eyo ma Odhiambo a golo rapa Raphael Tuju asechiko; chesto mag piny e Karen nyaluwore. Abwaki manono ne itho kelo gi nyithindo.
Somali: Wasiirkii hore ee Kabinetka Raphael Tuju ayaa la sheegay in uu waayay; baabuurkiisa la'aan ah ayaa lagu helay Karen. Authorities waxay wadaan baaritaan iyo raadinta.

English: NCBA Bank is auctioning 70 cars online, starting from KSh 450,000. Submit your bids on the CarDuka platform by March 23 to participate.
Kiswahili: Benki ya NCBA inauza magari 70 mtandaoni, kuanzia KSh 450,000. Wasilisha zabuni zako kwenye jukwaa la CarDuka kabla ya tarehe 23 Machi ili ushiriki.
Ekegusii: NCBA Bank isere buya buya 70 motokari ku online, waki bwire KSh 450,000. Naki buya bwogikire ku CarDuka ki 23, Marìsi ogotigete.
Dholuo: NCBA Bank en gi jomoko 70 kanyakla online, man gi ng'ato KSh 450,000. Konyi bid nyaka bende e CarDuka platform by March 23 kuom owinj.
Somali: Bangiga NCBA wuxuu iibinayaa 70 baabuur oo khadka internetka ah, laga bilaabo KSh 450,000. Soo gudbi dalabkaaga madasha CarDuka ka hor 23-ka Maarso si aad uga qayb gasho.

English: No actionable content available.
Kiswahili: Hakuna maudhui ya kuchukua hatua yaliyopo.
Ekegusii: Naki atogoti osibori buya.
Dholuo: Okwan gi kanyo.
Somali: Ma jiraan wax macluumaad oo la qaadi karo.

English: No actionable information for Kenyan education sector found in the provided article.
Kiswahili: Hakuna taarifa inayoweza kutumika kwa sekta ya elimu ya Kenya iliyo patikana katika makala iliyotolewa.
Ekegusii: Naki naki ore akoroti bwogori buya bwakireri buya buye buya bwakere buya bwokiri bwose.
Dholuo: Koro kanyo ni gin ma ok kelo ni modo kuom ndiko ma otieno e ndagruok mach.
Somali: Ma jirto macluumaad wax-qabad oo laga helay maqaalkan ku saabsan qaybta waxbarashada ee Kenya.

English: Kenya Airways has named its newest Boeing 737 aircraft after long-serving employee Caroline Ndonga to honor her contributions in the aviation sector.
Kiswahili: Kenya Airways imeuita ndege yake mpya ya Boeing 737 kwa jina la mfanyakazi wa muda mrefu Caroline Ndonga ili kumheshimu kwa mchango wake katika sekta ya anga.
Ekegusii: Kenya Airways omokore omokanya bwa Boeing 737 bwokiri bwaki ogenda Caroline Ndonga nke omokiri onchera ibwaki busembere bwakinyogori mu ng'ari.
Dholuo: Kenya Airways eneno ndege ma Boeing 737 mokwongo kuom jowete mago Caroline Ndonga to g'ikwayi godo e kwe.
Somali: Kenya Airways waxay magacawday diyaaraddii ugu dambeysay ee Boeing 737 oo ah mid lagu xusay shaqaale dheer-joog ah, Caroline Ndonga, si loo ixtiraamo waxqabadkeeda dhinaca duulista.

English: Mike Sonko has been honored with three international awards at the GLISPA UK 2025 Summit in London for his contributions to peace and development.
Kiswahili: Mike Sonko amepewa tuzo tatu za kimataifa katika Mkutano wa GLISPA UK 2025 huko London kwa mchango wake katika amani na maendeleo.
Ekegusii: Mike Sonko akore omokore chaki oria itatu buya mu GLISPA UK 2025 Summit mu London nokokiro bushokendo na obwakire.
Dholuo: Mike Sonko owinjore gi kadhi tati mar joma chwe mwakoro GLISPA UK 2025 Summit ku London nikech rwako pi dhok kana mwakoyo.
Somali: Mike Sonko ayaa lagu sharraxay saddex abaalmarin oo caalami ah oo la siiyay kulanka GLISPA UK 2025 ee London sababo la xiriira ka qaybqaadashadiisa nabadda iyo horumarka.

English: Kenyan students can apply for the DAAD International Postgraduate Scholarship 2026 for Master's and MPhil programs in Germany, with specific deadlines per field. Confirm requirements and dates via DAAD before applying.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa Kenya wanaweza kuomba Scholarships ya DAAD ya Kimataifa ya Postgraduate 2026 kwa programu za Master's na MPhil nchini Ujerumani, kwa tarehe maalum kulingana na fani. Thibitisha masharti na tarehe kupitia DAAD kabla ya kuomba.
Ekegusii: Abanogenda baki batega kwa DAAD International Postgraduate Scholarship 2026 moki no Master's na MPhil bwakirimu Geremani, na ekenye oria buya buya bwaki bwakiri. Naki kaenda kwandu naki bonyerete na oria buya bwaki buya bwakiri buya DAAD mbere ikwaki.
Dholuo: D students duka e DAAD International Postgraduate Scholarship 2026 to Master’s kod MPhil programs e Germany, naye gi deadline mag piny. Tiyo gin kanyo gik ma owinjo kendo date e DAAD asenyo chalo.
Somali: Ardayda Kenya waxay dalban karaan deeqda waxbarasho ee DAAD ee Masterka iyo MPhil-ka 2026 oo loogu talagalay barnaamijyada Jarmalka, iyadoo la raacayo mudada gaarka ah ee beero kala duwan. Hubi shuruudaha iyo taariikhaha adigoo la xiriiraya DAAD kahor inta aanad dalban.

English: Teachers in Kenya will transition from Minet medical cover to the Social Health Authority by December 2025 for improved healthcare access.
Kiswahili: Teachers nchini Kenya watabadilisha kutoka bima ya afya ya Minet hadi Mamlaka ya Afya ya Kijamii ifikapo Desemba 2025, ili kupata huduma za afya bora.
Ekegusii: Abagere ba Kenya bategere inyaki ya Minet buya bosi mu Social Health Authority kiugendo kitakire omokiri wa 2025 buya buya bwenyanga bwaki.
Dholuo: Walimu ku Kenya bende aoro e Minet medical cover ku Social Health Authority mana latolo ku 2025 modhi mang'won.
Somali: Macallimiinta Kenya waxay u guuri doonaan daryeelka caafimaadka ee Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada badhtamihii 2025 si ay u helaan daryeel caafimaad oo ka wanaagsan.

English: The Teachers Service Commission proposes that each comprehensive school be led by a principal and two deputies, pending legal amendments to recognize this structure.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma za Walimu inapendekeza kwamba kila shule kamili iongozwe na mkuu na naibu wawili, huku mabadiliko ya kisheria yakisubiri kutambulisha muundo huu.
Ekegusii: Abakire b’Emokigo ya Baraza bw’Abakirigori ba Nchire baisekania ngo ikomokire y’eyenge bwaninge buone buya na abatia burebwa, kire bwakire buseke mu kitokiri kire ekirongo.
Dholuo: Komisheni en gi Tichor e Nyasaye ohero ni chwe chalo chako dhi kasich bende gikcieng ma dhokwa wacho ni joma chako ma in kanyo.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa soo jeedinaya in iskuul kasta oo dhammaystiran uu hogaaminayo maamule iyo laba kuxigeen, iyadoo laga sugayo isbeddelada sharciga si loo aqoonsado qaabdhismeedkan.

English: The Teachers Service Commission has permanently deregistered 69 teachers for learner abuse. Report any incidents within 24 hours via the new hotline or email for anonymous complaints.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma za Walimu imetatua kwa kudumu walimu 69 kwa unyanyasaji wa wanafunzi. Ripoti tukio lolote ndani ya saa 24 kupitia laini mpya ya msaada au barua pepe kwa malalamiko ya siri.
Ekegusii: Abakire ba Teachers Service Commission baerekere abarimu 69 moki abakiiga bengi. Ria boki bw'ekiore buya mu masaa 24 ore kiya kitigori cha omokireri kana email ekibakire ige.
Dholuo: Oganda magi Teachers Service Commission adhi gima 69 maen gima oserwati gi lempogi. Tiyogi every nyiso ma okat 24 awuor gi hotline nyakato kata email gi nyiso maber.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegyada Macallimiinta ayaa si joogto ah u ka saaray 69 macallin diiwaanka sababo la xiriira sixitaanka ardayda. Warbixi dhacdooyinka muddo 24 saacadood gudahood iyada oo la adeegsanayo khad cusub ama email si aad u gudbiso cabashooyin qarsoodi ah.

English: All boarding schools in Gatundu South are now closed for thorough investigations into recent arson incidents. Parents should ensure their children return home immediately.
Kiswahili: Shule zote za bweni Gatundu Kusini zimefungwa kwa uchunguzi wa kina kuhusu matukio ya moto ya recently. Wazazi wanapaswa kuhakikisha watoto wao wanarudi nyumbani mara moja.
Ekegusii: Bwakire bwakire bwakire bwabandi bosi bu Gatundu South bwere buja buya bendi buya bwtigana bwagakanya. Abashoncho bokwogere bu bwaboka bwabo buya busibori bwi mwaki bwetegera.
Dholuo: Gikoni ng'ato mar boarding e Gatundu South gi kare gichak ka joma yie konyo. Jatelo ne gung'eyo chuno ma konyo maru.
Somali: Dhammaan dugsiyada khudradda ee Gatundu South hadda waa xiranyihiin si loo sameeyo baaritaano qoto dheer oo ku saabsan dhacdooyinka gubashada dhawaan. Waalidiinta waa inay xaqiijiyaan in carruurtooda ay si dhaqso ah u soo laabtaan guryaha.

English: The Teachers Service Commission is inviting applications for 24,000 Junior School internship positions. Visit www.tsc.go.ke for job descriptions and application details.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma za Walimu inakaribisha maombi ya nafasi 24,000 za mafunzo ya shule ya msingi. Tembelea www.tsc.go.ke kwa maelezo ya kazi na maelezo ya maombi.
Ekegusii: Abagosi ba Bwakire buya bwa Teachers Service Commission bonyegere buya bwaki bwakire buya 24,000 bushikeya bwang’oto. Naki www.tsc.go.ke omokireri omogoti na buya bwaki.
Dholuo: Teachers Service Commission en ring' applications maler ma 24,000 Junior School internship. Konyo www.tsc.go.ke to kende ji ma in gima job kendo application.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macalimiinta wuxuu soo dhaweynayaa codsiyada shaqo ee 24,000 boos oo khibrad ah oo Dugsiga Hoose ah. Booqo www.tsc.go.ke si aad u hesho sharaxaadaha shaqada iyo faahfaahinta codsiga.

English: The Nursing Council of Kenya mandates all nursing and midwifery schools to submit student lists electronically and ensure compliance with program prerequisites for indexing.
Kiswahili: Baraza la Uuguzi la Kenya linaagiza shule zote za uuguzi na wakunga kuwasilisha orodha za wanafunzi kwa njia ya kielektroniki na kuhakikisha kwamba zinatimiza vigezo vya programu kwa ajili ya kuorodheshwa.
Ekegusii: Naki ikirukia ya Nursing Council of Kenya ibwaki bwakire mwachaki buya moshoni naki bende bwebwaki naki chiabaki biloshu chire komagiri buya.
Dholuo: Nursing Council of Kenya owuon golo ni dodothi nyaka wakuo gi yot e nenti kata mayom chuni nyaka ginyal goyo listo duto mar wakiwe gi ebono to nyaka ogend e duto mar joma owuoyo.
Somali: Guddiga Kalkaalinta ee Kenya wuxuu waajibinayaa dhammaan dugsiyada kalkaalinta iyo ummuliserada inay si elektaroonik ah u gudbiyaan liisaska ardayda, iyo in la hubiyo inay raacaan shuruudaha barnaamijka ee loogu talagalay liisanka.

English: The National Treasury will disburse Ksh23 billion for education, including Ksh17 billion for school capitation and Ksh5.9 billion for national exams.
Kiswahili: Hazina ya Taifa itatoa Ksh23 bilioni kwa ajili ya elimu, ikiwa ni pamoja na Ksh17 bilioni kwa ajili ya ruzuku za shule na Ksh5.9 bilioni kwa ajili ya mitihani ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Nasi ya Taifa ikorera kandi Ksh23 billion buya buuntu, na Ksh17 billion buya ibwaki bwokiri na Ksh5.9 billion buya buya nyang’anya.
Dholuo: Dala Mariongo ma Kager chako Ksh23 billion bakeng' kuom edhiga, owacho Ksh17 billion ma oket gi mwakano kod Ksh5.9 billion kuom japuonj kanyakla.
Somali: Q treasury-ga Qaranka ayaa bixindoona Ksh23 bilyan oo loogu talagalay waxbarashada, oo ay ku jiraan Ksh17 bilyan oo loogu talagalay capitation-ka dugsiyada iyo Ksh5.9 bilyan oo loogu talagalay imtixaanaadka qaran.

English: HELB has awarded loans to 136,634 first-time applicants for the 2025/2026 academic year. Universities can access tuition loan allocations through the HELB institutional portal.
Kiswahili: HELB imepewa mikopo kwa waombaji wapya 136,634 kwa mwaka wa masomo 2025/2026. Vyuo vya elimu vinaweza kupata mapato ya mikopo ya ada kupitia lango la HELB la taasisi.
Ekegusii: HELB ekekorere abona 136,634 abere bori bwaki bwakire buya bwa 2025/2026. Masomo akang'ana obwana buya muboka bw'HELB.
Dholuo: HELB awama ndere kuom 136,634 joma ok nyal bura e mwakanyo 2025/2026. Yuniversiti golo konyo ginyalo ndere mag joma chiegni kuom portal ma HELB.
Somali: HELB waxay deyn siisay 136,634 codsadeyaal markii ugu horeysay sanadka tacliinta 2025/2026. Jaamacaduhu waxay ka heli karaan deynneradooyinka lacagta waxbarashada bogga rasmiga ah ee HELB.

English: Chelsea has climbed to fourth place in the Premier League after a 1-0 victory over Manchester United.
Kiswahili: Chelsea imepanda nafasi ya nne kwenye Premier League baada ya ushindi wa 1-0 dhidi ya Manchester United.
Ekegusii: Chelsea omoreri mokwendo wa naki ya nane mu Premier League buya bwakomoka 1-0 kutiriria Manchester United.
Dholuo: Chelsea en omiyo konyo gisuma chigo chaluok kanyadhi gi 1-0 nyaka yore ma Manchester United.
Somali: Chelsea waxay ku soo kacday booska afraad ee Premier League ka dib guul ay gaartay 1-0 ka dhan ah Manchester United.

English: The National Police Service is undertaking a nationwide crackdown on Public Service Vehicles (PSVs) due to a rise in fatal road accidents. All road users are urged to adhere to traffic regulations to ensure safety.
Kiswahili: Huduma ya Polisi wa Kitaifa inatekeleza operesheni ya kitaifa dhidi ya Magari ya Huduma ya Umma (PSVs) kutokana na kuongezeka kwa ajali barabarani mbaya. Watumiaji wote wa barabara wanasisitizwa kufuata sheria za usafiri ili kuhakikisha usalama.
Ekegusii: Abanotekere baki ba National Police Service buya bwakirire obwakire omokorino bwokera bwokorera Public Service Vehicles (PSVs) buya bwokora omokirori bwakire omoka bwakitobori. Abanogori bochire bakenyegane abaki bwananduke omokirori bworanya.
Dholuo: National Police Service in gi chieg ni ng'ato mar nyaka ochung' ei Public Service Vehicles (PSVs) kendo muno ni jodak miyo piny motegno gi giwruok mar nyasaye. Nitswalo nyasa miyo nyi michiny ng'ato mar gi piny kendo obedo lweny.
Somali: Hay'adda Booliska Qaranka waxay waddaa olole qaadashada ah ee gaadiidka Dadweynaha (PSVs) sababo la xiriira kororka shilalka wadada oo dhimasho keena. Dhammaan dadka isticmaala waddooyinka waxaa lagu boorinayaa in ay raacaan xeerarka taraafikada si loo hubiyo badbaadada.

English: No actionable content found.
Kiswahili: Hakuna yaliyohusika ya kuchukua hatua.
Ekegusii: Naki ogogetere.
Dholuo: Piny adhi e yo ni to no trade.
Somali: Wax macluumaad sameyn kara lama helin.

English: To all fans of Samidoh, if you are concerned about his recent emotional post, consider reaching out with words of support and encouragement during this time.
Kiswahili: Kwa mashabiki wote wa Samidoh, ikiwa unahusishwa na ujumbe wake wa hivi karibuni wa hisia, fikiria kumfikia kwa maneno ya msaada na kutia nguvu katika kipindi hiki.
Ekegusii: Abakire ba Samidoh, niba mugirango muganye ikirukano chaki, muimire buya bwenu n'ogutenda amagenge n'oguchakire koshoka bw'aki.
Dholuo: Kanye Somo Samidoh, to chalo mar ng'ato ma ok atimre koro, chuko ring'a maber e gima wok g'acho gi ji chalo kendo nyaka podhogi e this time.
Somali: Dhammaan taageerayaasha Samidoh, haddii aad ka walwalsan tahay qoraalkiisa cusub ee dareenkiisa, ka fiirso inaad la xiriirto erayo taageero iyo dhiirigelin waqtiyadan.

English: Authorities are investigating the discovery of 33 bodies in a mass grave in Kericho County. Residents are urged to remain calm as police and forensic experts work to identify the remains.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka zinafanya uchunguzi kuhusu kupatikana kwa mwili 33 katika kaburi la pamoja katika Kaunti ya Kericho. Wananchi wanasisitizwa kubaki watulivu huku polisi na wataalamu wa kijinai wakifanya kazi ya kubaini utambulisho wa mabaki hayo.
Ekegusii: Abakinyuri baria kueng'ena omokorere 33 naki omosacha ogana Kericho. Abakire baire ogukora nyang'anya kutiriri ikire buya abapolisi naki abokorainia babande kukanya emonyeshe.
Dholuo: Ababichni mago kuom chandruok 33 kwom wuoth mar Kericho. Wagene wan gi chogo kola kuom ndalo owuon kendo lwenje mar keny tango oluwi nyaka idhi.
Somali: Madaxweynuhu wuxuu baaritaan ku hayaa helitaanka 33 meyd oo ku yaal qabriga guud ee Gobolka Kericho. Dadweynaha waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay degganadaan inta booliska iyo khubarada baaritaanka ay ka shaqeynayaan aqoonsiga meydadka.

English: Idd Aziz is the first Kenyan artist to perform at both the Coachella and Burning Man festivals in 2025, showcasing Kenyan music on international stages.
Kiswahili: Idd Aziz ni msanii wa kwanza wa Kenya kutumbuiza katika sherehe za Coachella na Burning Man mwaka wa 2025, akionyesha muziki wa Kenya katika majukwaa ya kimataifa.
Ekegusii: Idd Aziz naki omokinyanji omonchene oigana buse nabokiriba buse bu Coachella na Burning Man mwakire 2025, okwendia omonchene bw’Engabo ya Kenya kuvoga mwaki bu mesoketi enyamache.
Dholuo: Idd Aziz en kanyenya artist buye oho ni yene manadi e Coachella to e Burning Man festivals kuom 2025, orey owinj kata Kenyan e weche mar dunia.
Somali: Idd Aziz waa fanaan Soomaaliyeed oo ah kii ugu horeeyay ee Kenyan ah oo ka soo qayb galaya labadaba Coachella iyo Burning Man oo dhici doona 2025, isagoo muujinaya muusiggan Kenyan ah masraxyo caalami ah.

English: Individuals found guilty of espionage in Iran may face the death penalty. All citizens are urged to respect national security laws to avoid severe legal consequences.
Kiswahili: Watu wanaopatikana na hatia ya ujasusi nchini Iran wanaweza kukabiliwa na adhabu ya kifo. Wananchi wote wanasisitizwa kuheshimu sheria za usalama wa kitaifa ili kuepuka madhara makubwa ya kisheria.
Ekegusii: Abaki bengi bataria omogori ogena naki Iran, baria bakenyete oborere, bakenyete naki naki ya die. Baki bengi batarukire kumokore omonene busania bwige obo naki bwetenda bwogena naki bwogekirwe.
Dholuo: Nitiere magi ne gin e piny Iran, golo jopiny yath jowuok. Jopiny onge jopiyo oyawore mar piny ngima kendo chako pero nyaka konyo ng'ato mar makmana.
Somali: Qof kasta oo lagu helo eedeymo basaasnimo xarunta Iiraan wuxuu wajihi karaa dil. Dhamaan muwaadiniinta waxaa lagu boorinayaa in ay ixtiraamaan shuruucda amniga qaranka si ay uga fogaadaan cawaaqib sharci oo culus.

English: The Catholic Church has elected a new pope, following the papal conclave on May 8, 2025. The new leader will soon address the faithful and begin his mission.
Kiswahili: Kanisa Katoliki limechagua papa mpya, baada ya mkutano wa kardinali tarehe 8 Mei 2025. Kiongozi mpya hivi karibuni atawazungumzia waumini na kuanza ujumbe wake.
Ekegusii: Abanogoro Abakatolike bakenyete omokogoto omosha, nyang’ete omogoo bwa papal conclave bwaki bwere mbochonge 8, 2025. Omokogoto omoshi bokenyete abakristu baabokinamikire buya buja bosi.
Dholuo: Kanisa Katolika nyalo tinye otemany, ka ng'ato ni pakalu papal on May 8, 2025. Koro nyaka, otemany olera en gi iye gima yath.
Somali: Kaniisada Katooliga ayaa dooratay pap cusub, ka dib shirkii papka ee May 8, 2025. Hogaamiyaha cusub wuxuu dhawaan ka hadli doonaa kuwa rumeysan wuxuuna bilaabi doonaa hawshiisa.

English: No actionable content available.
Kiswahili: Hakuna maudhui ya kutekelezwa yanayopatikana.
Ekegusii: Abakwe ne agietorani.
Dholuo: N/A
Somali: Ma jiro wax macluumaad ah oo hawlgal ah.

English: Newly employed teachers can now request transfers without the five-year minimum service rule through the Teachers Service Commission's digital transfer system. Apply on the official TSC portal.
Kiswahili: Teacher wapya sasa wanaweza kuomba uhamisho bila sheria ya huduma ya chini ya miaka mitano kupitia mfumo wa dijitali wa uhamisho wa Tume ya Huduma za Walimu. Omba kwenye tovuti rasmi ya TSC.
Ekegusii: Ab teachers abogoti ba na batariga busia bogenje ogotere oria bw'ekoreri buya bw'ezekeri bw'obora-nyaki mu sistema ya digital ya Teachers Service Commission. Gonge boke ku portal ya TSC.
Dholuo: Okwach nyaka owuon piny kendo nyise migweno chike gi tich luor nyaka golo duto. Dok tet TSC portal.
Somali: Macalimiinta cusub ayaa hadda codsan kara in lagu wareejiyo iyaga oo aan lahayn shuruudda ugu yaraan shanta sano ee adeegga iyadoo loo marayo nidaamka dijitaalka ah ee wareejinta ee Komishanka Adeegga Macalimiinta. Codso bogga rasmiga ah ee TSC.

English: Youth seeking internships in the private sector can apply through the NYOTA Project by dialing *254# and following the prompts. Applications are open from July 11 to August 15.
Kiswahili: Vijana wanaotafuta mafunzo kwenye sekta binafsi wanaweza kuomba kupitia Mradi wa NYOTA kwa kupiga *254# na kufuata maelekezo. Maombi yamefunguliwa kuanzia Julai 11 hadi Agosti 15.
Ekegusii: Abakire b’engoro baria bakwangani bosi busekeria mu nyang’anya oria bwaki biroka NYOTA Project banuye *254# na bwango bemo. Abaki bwaki bosi bwandori bwengi busekeria bwaki buja mbiri 11 bwaki bwegere 15.
Dholuo: Ng'ato duto maruok kuom internship e sekta marprivat owinji chieng' NYOTA Project nyalo chayo kuom *254# kendo uborne e ndalo. Chayo gi nyaka omiyo manok from July 11 to August 15.
Somali: Dhalinyarada raadinaysa fursadaha internship-ka ee bulshada gaarka ah waxay ka dalban karaan Mashruuca NYOTA adoo wacaya *254# una raacaya tilmaamaha. Codsiyada waxaa furanyahay laga bilaabo Luulyo 11 ilaa Agoosto 15.

English: The government reaffirms that parents will not bear school fees as free education remains a priority. Stay informed on funding updates for secondary education.
Kiswahili: Serikali inathibitisha kuwa wazazi hawatalipa ada za shule kwani elimu bure ni kipaumbele. Kuwa na ufahamu kuhusu updates za ufadhili wa elimu ya sekondari.
Ekegusii: Ombondu ogwankire oria abwaki banchang'ereka atuma omosibori buya buya. Naki buya buya obu oseria bwaki bwanene buseke.
Dholuo: Chamo ng'ato duto, kuom iek ne dako e school fees, omiyo dhok e thuolo mar mopogore. Chik nyaka inwacho gambo ma okonyo e funding mar secondary education.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay mar kale xaqiijinaysaa in waalidiintu aysan bixin doonin kharashka dugsiga maadaama waxbarashada bilaashku ay ahmiyad mudan tahay. La soco wararka ku saabsan maalgelinta waxbarashada sare.

English: Nakuru Girls High School is closed indefinitely following student unrest. All learners must vacate the premises immediately.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Sekondari ya Wasichana Nakuru imefungwa kwa muda usiojulikana kufuatia machafuko ya wanafunzi. Wanafunzi wote wanapaswa kuondoka kwenye majengo mara moja.
Ekegusii: Nakuru Girls High School irekire buya buya magara oikwere omokiri. Abana boni bosi bategere buya bwere bwogotana.
Dholuo: Nakuru Girls High School a gichop gi sikhoyo chike. Neno duto odhi gi joma ranyisi kuom konyo.
Somali: Dugsiga Sare ee Gacanta Haweenka Nakuru waa xiranyahay muddo aan la cayimin sababo la xiriira rabshado arday. Dhammaan ardayda waa inay derbiyada ka baxaan deris ahaan.

English: TECNO has launched the SPARK 40 Series, featuring advanced models with wireless charging and high-performance specs. These devices are now available for purchase.
Kiswahili: TECNO imezindua Mfululizo wa SPARK 40, ukijumuisha mifano ya kisasa yenye kuchajiwa bila waya na vipengele vya juu vya utendaji. Vifaa hivi sasa vinapatikana kwa ununuzi.
Ekegusii: TECNO emuriire SPARK 40 Series, ekirandori kireega wakiya na bosi buya. Ebisani bikire naki naki bw'ogekire.
Dholuo: TECNO abiro ka SPARK 40 Series, mane en gi mawuok bende mohero kanyo kod mago mar chiemo. Dhi nyalo mading' gi jibu.
Somali: TECNO waxa ay soo bandhigtay taxanaha SPARK 40, oo leh moodallo horumarineed oo leh dalacsiga aan xadhig lahayn iyo qeexitaanno waxqabad sare leh. Qalabkan hadda wuu diyaar yahay in lagu iibsado.

English: KUCCPS has released the 2025 placement results for 2024 KCSE candidates. Check your results and download admission letters from your institution's website.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS imetangaza matokeo ya nafasi ya 2025 kwa wagombea wa KCSE 2024. Angalia matokeo yako na pakua barua za kupokelewa kutoka tovuti ya taasisi yako.
Ekegusii: KUCCPS emireri omokiraka omogani 2025 omokiri 2024 KCSE. Ria mwaki naki omogani na oria naki embori yenu buya buya.
Dholuo: KUCCPS apenji timo ma 2025 mar placement nigi 2024 KCSE candidates. Tich gi chalo ma kanyo kendo yudo admission letters mai yudi e website mar inacho.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay soo saartay natiijada 2025 ee go'aan qaadashada ardayda 2024 KCSE. Fadlan hubi natiijadaada oo kala soo bax waraaqaha aqbalaadda bogga internetka ee hay'addaada.

English: The Murang'a County Assembly will proceed with the vetting of remaining nominees for the Public Service Board as Nancy Macharia has declined her nomination due to a World Bank consultancy.
Kiswahili: Bunge la Kaunti ya Murang'a litaendelea na mchakato wa kuangalia wapendekezwa waliobaki kwa ajili ya Bodi ya Huduma za Umma baada ya Nancy Macharia kukataa uteuzi wake kutokana na kazi ya ushauri wa Benki ya Dunia.
Ekegusii: Abakora buya bwa Murang'a bwana bagere kugurania abakiingira buya bwa Public Service Board ka Nancy Macharia aborere kosi ching'ana cha World Bank.
Dholuo: Murang'a County Assembly owinjore kendo gima ne oduogo e jomoko ma onge jodwaro e Public Service Board, kendo Nancy Macharia en ok jotegno ma jothoroe ni owuon e World Bank.
Somali: Assembley-ga Gobolka Murang'a wuxuu sii wadi doonaa baaritaanka xulashada hadhay ee Xisbiga Adeegga Dadweynaha maadaama Nancy Macharia ay diidday xulashadeeda sababo la xiriira latalin ka socda Bangiga Adduunka.

English: The Kenya Union of Post-Primary Education Teachers (KUPPET) has issued a 7-day ultimatum for negotiations on a new Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA). If unmet, a nationwide strike will commence on June 28.
Kiswahili: Shirikisho la Walimu wa Elimu ya Juu Kenya (KUPPET) limetoa muda wa siku 7 kwa mazungumzo kuhusu Mkataba Mpya wa Mazungumzo ya Pamoja (CBA). Ikiwa hautatekelezwa, mgomo wa kitaifa utaanza tarehe 28 Juni.
Ekegusii: Kenya Union of Post-Primary Education Teachers (KUPPET) omwaki naki egesibori ya miondori 7 buya oria bwakire buana mabo mokerenda ogekene bwakire bwakire bwakore. Naki osoromokire, bwakire buya bwekorire ohu buya kumokirongo oria Junu 28.
Dholuo: Kenya Union of Post-Primary Education Teachers (KUPPET) omedhi gi chike mar tande abich 7 kuon kanyakla kuom jo konyo ng'ato mar wan gi chike maber (CBA). Kendo nyaka kar, ng'ato mar kachieng' e Kenya remre kata jomanyal e June 28.
Somali: Ururka Macalimiinta Waxbarashada Casriga ah ee Kenya (KUPPET) wuxuu bixiyay amar 7 maalmood ah oo lagu gorgortamayo Heshiiska Isku-dhafka ee cusub (CBA). Haddii lafulin waayo, shaqo-joojin qaran ayaa bilaabmi doonta 28ka Juun.

English: Moi University has undertaken retrenchment affecting 376 employees, with severance payouts of Ksh 167.4 million. A court ruling on this matter is expected soon.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Moi kimefanya kupunguza wafanyakazi 376, na malipo ya kuachishwa kazi ni Ksh 167.4 milioni. Uamuzi wa mahakama kuhusu jambo hili unatarajiwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Moi University yakiore eng'era 376 emokiri, na omokong'ania obwakire bwomoka bwaki 167.4 million. Okokire buya bwomokiri buya bwakire kuri ing'ere.
Dholuo: Moi University abichie ka oketo kany niko 376 buya, kendo gadh nyaka Ksh 167.4 million. Kach mar ng'ato konyo ikwang' mamiya ongerso.
Somali: Jaamacadda Moi waxay qaaday tallaabo shaqo ka joojinta oo saameynaysa 376 shaqaale, iyadoo lacag celin ah ay tahay Ksh 167.4 milyan. Go'aan maxkamad arrintan ku saabsan ayaa la filayaa inay soo baxdo dhowaan.

English: The duration of diploma courses in Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) has been reduced to 1.5 years. Applications can be made through the KUCCPS portal.
Kiswahili: Muda wa kozi za diploma katika Elimu ya Ufundi na Mafunzo ya Ufundi (TVET) umepunguzwa hadi miaka 1.5. Maombi yanaweza kufanywa kupitia lango la KUCCPS.
Ekegusii: Obwakireri bwa masomo a diploma mu Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) buyaigerere ogenda naki. Abaluya bonyekere kiretu ku KUCCPS portal.
Dholuo: Nyalo chunya gima diploma e Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) nene ma 1.5 mwaka. Tich kuom tindi e portal ya KUCCPS.
Somali: Muddada koorsooyinka shahaadada ee Waxbarashada Farsamada iyo Tababarka Aqoonta (TVET) ayaa la dhimay ilaa 1.5 sano. Codsiyada waa la sameyn karaa iyada oo loo marayo bogga KUCCPS.

English: Residents of Pumwani, Nairobi, are urged to remain calm and avoid protest areas following recent unrest after a fatal police shooting. Authorities are investigating the incident.
Kiswahili: Wananchi wa Pumwani, Nairobi, wanahimizwa kubaki na utulivu na kuepuka maeneo ya maandamano kufuatia machafuko ya hivi karibuni baada ya kupigwa risasi kwa polisi. Mamlaka zinafanya uchunguzi juu ya tukio hilo.
Ekegusii: Ababere baki Pumwani, Nairobi, baria batoririe bwakire na bategere omoi bwaki omoshanga obwakoshwa. Abati buya bano bakienda omokigori bwaki.
Dholuo: Wang'ni Pumwani, Nairobi, nyal chako tich marach gi nyaka ok wete mabor githor marach ka gich tek gi ji maber lokruok. Ma oknyal tich kendo chalo tich.
Somali: Waxa bulshada Pumwani, Nairobi, lagu boorinayaa inay deggan yihiin oo ay ka fogaadaan meelaha mudaharaadka ka socda kadib rabshadihii dhacay ka dib markii boolisku toogtay. Hay'adaha ayaa baaritaan ku sameynaya dhacdadaas.

English: Jackson Kuria Kihara, known as Cop Shakur, has officially left the Fighting Brutality and Impunity (FBI) movement.
Kiswahili: Jackson Kuria Kihara, anayejulikana kama Cop Shakur, ametangaza rasmi kuondoka kwenye harakati za Fighting Brutality and Impunity (FBI).
Ekegusii: Jackson Kuria Kihara, akireri naki Cop Shakur, asisye buya muhurere wa Fighting Brutality and Impunity (FBI).
Dholuo: Jackson Kuria Kihara, owinjore mag Cop Shakur, asetimi mane oting' i Fighting Brutality and Impunity (FBI) movement.
Somali: Jackson Kuria Kihara, oo loo yaqaan Cop Shakur, wuxuu si rasmi ah uga baxay dhaqdhaqaaqa Fighting Brutality and Impunity (FBI).

English: This article does not contain relevant information for a Public Service Announcement concerning the Kenyan education sector.
Kiswahili: Makala hii haina taarifa muhimu kwa Tangazo la Huduma ya Umma kuhusu sekta ya elimu nchini Kenya.
Ekegusii: Omosaraki ogokire obwakire bwakire bwaki bwakire bwetire buya bwakobori bwakinyang'ani bwaki bwakire bwaki na oboshonchori bwaki; ogokire ogonyang'a obwakire buya.
Dholuo: Article wik manok to kata wuoth otach mar Public Service Announcement ma gima ot noo gi weche mar sekondari e Kenya.
Somali: Maqaalkani ma contains macluumaad ku habboon oo ku saabsan Ogeysiiska Adeega Dadweynaha ee la xiriira waaxda waxbarashada Kenya.

English: No actionable information to provide.
Kiswahili: Hakuna taarifa yoyote ya kuchukua hatua.
Ekegusii: Amang'ana naki naki oigwanania.
Dholuo: Neno ni timo bura.
Somali: Ma jiraan xog waxqabad leh oo la bixiyo.

English: Kenyans can now use the Hustler Fund to pay Social Health Authority (SHA) premiums in installments. Ensure you have a clean loan repayment record and up-to-date SHA details to access this feature.
Kiswahili: Wakenya sasa wanaweza kutumia Mfuko wa Hustler kulipia bima za Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii (SHA) katika vipande. Hakikisha una rekodi safi ya malipo ya mkopo na taarifa za SHA za kisasa ili kupata huduma hii.
Ekegusii: Abantu b’Kenya baryaki boki ekahereza Hustler Fund kobwaki gwera Social Health Authority (SHA) motu bwaki. Naki omokokiri abwakore ekiregesi kyekire naki obwakise bwa SHA bwakinyang'anya hakiri obwaki bwokora.
Dholuo: Kenyani ng'eyo kanyakni Hustler Fund kaka pek gi Social Health Authority (SHA) premiums kendo kaka jachugi. Nyis miyo young' kendo gonyo lucho mar loan kendo yo SHA marahuma to okonyo kendo chieng' weche.
Somali: Kenyaanka waxay hadda isticmaali karaan Hustler Fund si ay u bixiyaan lacagaha caafimaadka ee Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) qayb-qayb. Hubi inaad leedahay taariikh nadiif ah oo lacag celin ah iyo faahfaahinta SHA oo casri ah si aad u hesho adeeggan.

English: The ODM party is urged to convene a National Delegates Conference (NDC) to address concerns about the intimidation of dissenters.
Kiswahili: Chama cha ODM kinashauriwa kuitisha Mkutano wa Kitaifa wa Wajumbe (NDC) kukabiliana na wasiwasi kuhusu kutishwa kwa wapinzani.
Ekegusii: Ona ODM barabara, giana bwogogori bwakore Nnational Delegates Conference (NDC) okong'anya ebire naki omokiri naki akaibori.
Dholuo: ODM omedi konyo ka konyo National Delegates Conference (NDC) mamoko omiya dala kuom pier ema oting'o ni koro gi joma otera.
Somali: Xisbiga ODM waxaa lagu boorinayaa in uu qabto Shirweyne Qaran (NDC) si looga wada hadlo cabashooyinka ku acerca ah cabsi gelinta kasoo horjeeda.

English: There will be new contract extensions for Mohamed Salah and Virgil van Dijk, ensuring their futures at Liverpool until the end of the 2026/27 season.
