Kiswahili: Kutakuwa na nyongeza za mkataba mpya kwa Mohamed Salah na Virgil van Dijk, kuhakikisha kwamba wanaendelea na Liverpool hadi mwisho wa msimu wa 2026/27.
Ekegusii: Makiro magwaki omogaka omokiriri Mohamed Salah na Virgil van Dijk, bwakire chichaki chao ku Liverpool omokigori buya 2026/27.
Dholuo: Naka konyo chik manie ng'ato makende gi Mohamed Salah kod Virgil van Dijk, kendo nandi ng'ato ma okonyo buo kendo maber e Liverpool ng'ato gi konyo manie kendo kutiek e 2026/27.
Somali: Mohamed Salah iyo Virgil van Dijk ayaa helaya heshiisyo cusub oo lagu kordhinayo, taasoo hubinaysa mustaqbalkooda Liverpool ilaa dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedka 2026/27.

English: HELB assures Kenyans that reports of freezing bank accounts of loan defaulters are false. Visit HELB's official page for verified updates.
Kiswahili: HELB inawahakikishia Wakenya kwamba ripoti za kuf freezing akaunti za benki za wadai wasiokidhi masharti ni za uongo. Tembelea ukurasa rasmi wa HELB kwa habari zilizothibitishwa.
Ekegusii: HELB ikiranire Abakenya naki inyu nibaki abaki ibokiri bwaki bwa ba bwakoretani omogenderi. Naki milakire burokire bwa HELB buya buiringe.
Dholuo: HELB nind gi Kenyans ni chalo mar seche makelo e bank kuom banta mar loan defaulters adier. Konyi ku HELB's official page maduong' gi ng'ato kwayo.
Somali: HELB waxay xaqiijineysaa Kenyada in warbixinada ah in akoonnada bangiga ee lagu guuldareysto deyn bixinta la xayiray ay yihiin been. Booqo bogga rasmiga ah ee HELB si aad u hesho warar sax ah.

English: The Ministry of Education will launch the pilot phase of the Kenya Education Management Information System (KEMIS) in July 2025 to digitize student data from ECDE to universities.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu itazindua awamu ya majaribio ya Mfumo wa Habari wa Usimamizi wa Elimu Kenya (KEMIS) mnamo Julai 2025 ili kubadilisha habari za wanafunzi kutoka ECDE hadi vyuo vikuu.
Ekegusii: Abareki baki bwakirori bw'Obwaki bw'Osienyi buya obwakokire omokoka bwi KEMIS omogoti ogwabaki buya July 2025 naki bu giang'ane obuchai bwebache buana bwi ECDE no binansia.
Dholuo: Ministir gi Piny Pochi en gi pwodho eyo kod Kenya Education Management Information System (KEMIS) karieko e July 2025, kuom pinyjogo duto mar mwana chwe, chik gi univesiti.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay billaabi doontaa marxaladda tijaabada ee Nidaamka Macluumaadka Maareynta Waxbarashada Kenya (KEMIS) bisha Luulyo 2025 si ay u dijitoobaan xogta ardayda laga soo bilaabo ECDE ilaa jaamacadaha.

English: Eveleen Mitei has been appointed as the acting CEO of the Teachers Service Commission. Support her during this transition period.
Kiswahili: Eveleen Mitei amepewa wadhifa wa kaimu Mkurugenzi Mtendaji wa Tume ya Huduma za Walimu. Msaada kwake katika kipindi hiki cha mpito.
Ekegusii: Eveleen Mitei omogendi naki bwakire CEO omokorwa wa Abakereri. Mosiogotire naki omokorire ino obwakire.
Dholuo: Eveleen Mitei amedhi kama CEO wa wakati wa Teachers Service Commission. Wekni go kaka nderegi ni.
Somali: Eveleen Mitei ayaa loo magacaabay agaasimaha ku meel gaarka ah ee Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta. Ka caawi intaanu isbedelkan socon.

English: Enrollment is open at Rosslyn Academy for students from kindergarten to grade 12. Visit the official website for more information on applications and admissions.
Kiswahili: Usajili umefunguliwa katika Chuo cha Rosslyn kwa wanafunzi kutoka chekechea hadi daraja la 12. Tembelea tovuti rasmi kwa maelezo zaidi kuhusu maombi na uandikishaji.
Ekegusii: Ekereri naki buya ku Rosslyn Academy omokiri bwa kindergaten gosegrade 12. Omosera buya egwenda ebwebwaki eria oria oserori naki omoshanga.
Dholuo: Dhi nyaka uriru e Rosslyn Academy mar jo-kidogo to jo-kababu 12. Dhi visit weche maber ma ok oduogo kosebedo chike yie no ng'ato.
Somali: Diiwaangelinta ayaa furan xarunta Rosslyn Academy ardayda ka soo bilaabma dhigaalka caruurta ilaa fasalka 12. Booqo website-ka rasmi ah si aad u hesho macluumaad dheeri ah oo ku saabsan codsiyada iyo soo dhaweynta.

English: The KUCCPS portal is open for the Second Revision of university and college placements until June 7, 2025. Eligible applicants should log in at students.kuccps.net to select their programs.
Kiswahili: Poti ya KUCCPS iko wazi kwa Marekebisho ya Pili ya nafasi za vyuo na kadhalika hadi tarehe 7 Juni 2025. Waombaji wanaostahili wanapaswa kuingia kwenye students.kuccps.net ili kuchagua programu zao.
Ekegusii: Portal ya KUCCPS ekererete buya busongore bwakire buya bwa kawi bobi 7, 2025. Abakiyaki batanano buya bokenye ogokiri bwaki ogotere.
Dholuo: Portal ya KUCCPS ne ogend gi siko machalo ma wuoth ang'wen ogend kendo ka puothe 7, 2025. Wuodhi mang'ere manadogo yiene to yalo login e students.kuccps.net to chako tho mar program.
Somali: Boorarka KUCCPS waa furan yahay oo loogu talagalay dib-u-eegista labaad ee deggista jaamacadaha iyo kollajyada ilaa Juun 7, 2025. Codsadeyaal u qalma waa inay galiyaan students.kuccps.net si ay u doortaan barnaamijyadooda.

English: Kenyatta University is ordered to include Nyambura Kimani in its upcoming graduation ceremony and pay her Ksh850,000 in damages for the denial of her graduation rights.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Kenyatta kimeamriwa kumuunga Nyambura Kimani katika sherehe yake ya kuhitimu inayokuja na kulipa Ksh850,000 kama fidia kwa kukataliwa haki yake ya kuhitimu.
Ekegusii: Kenyatta University emechokere omokireri Nyambura Kimani mu buseku bwa getare yayo buya na oria omoka Ksh850,000 naki obori buya bwokire buya buseku bwaki.
Dholuo: Kenyatta University to konyo Nyambura Kimani kod yore niya okonyne e nyinge mar jopiny gi chiegni kendo wachni Ksh850,000 e nyime mar ng'ato mar jowinjore.
Somali: Jaamacadda Kenyatta waxaa lagu amray inay ku darto Nyambura Kimani xafladda qalinjinta ee soo socota oo ay siiso Ksh850,000 oo magdhow ah, maadaama ay diideen xuquuqdeeda qalinjinta.

English: Attention prospective secondary school teachers: To qualify for teaching positions, you must have a minimum C+ mean grade at KCSE and C+ in two teaching subjects. Ensure your qualifications meet TSC requirements.
Kiswahili: Tangazo kwa walimu wapya wa shule za sekondari: Ili kufuzu kwa nafasi za kufundisha, unahitaji kuwa na kiwango cha chini cha C+ katika mtihani wa KCSE na C+ katika masomo mawili ya kufundisha. Hakikisha ni sifa zako zinakidhi mahitaji ya TSC.
Ekegusii: Omosome omogoti oria ogotigana ogotende: Kugana naki omosome oria obokirire chuka, ogene orekenya C+ izia buya bwa KCSE na C+ migenyere mbiri erikinyani. Nakiire orekenya enkirooreri ya TSC.
Dholuo: Wang'ni nyaka moko ma okonyo gin masomo ma ng'ato ma sekondari: Moko kamano, obet ni itimore kanyis gi C+ ka pwodhi KCSE, kendo C+ ka masomo abiri ma iwinjo. Nyingi ni kwalifikeshon nyal sekedo ma TSC.
Somali: Dhiirigelin macallimiinta suurtagalka ah ee dugsiyada sare: Si aad u noqoto macallin, waa inaad haysataa C+ celcelis ah oo ka mid ah KCSE iyo C+ laba maaddo. Hubi in shahaadooyinkaagu ay la jaan qaadaan shuruudaha TSC.

English: Attention 2024 KCSE candidates: Today, May 27, 2025, is the final day to revise your course choices on the KUCCPS portal, which closes at midnight. Act now to secure your placement!
Kiswahili: Tahadhari wagombea wa KCSE 2024: Leo, Mei 27, 2025, ni siku ya mwisho kubadilisha uchaguzi wa kozi kwenye portali ya KUCCPS, ambayo inafungwa saa sita usiku. Chukua hatua sasa ili kuhakikisha nafasi yako!
Ekegusii: Makiaro 2024 KCSE aibori: Naki, May 27, 2025, naki naki kyia mwigori okorenda naki kikere ku KUCCPS portal, ikarenda naki osorana. Kora naki kiiori nyaki!
Dholuo: Ngongʼ 2024 KCSE candidates: Lwedo, May 27, 2025, nʼeno nyaka chako rup mokwongo ma ok nyal kuom KUCCPS portal, ma ok okonyo ka midho. Tende ji kendo nyaka chuny gi isabi!
Somali: Digniin musharrixiinta KCSE 2024: Maanta, May 27, 2025, waa maalinta ugu dambeysa ee aad ka beddeli karto doorashooyinkaaga koorsada ee bogga KUCCPS, kaasoo xirmaya habeenki. Waxaad hadda sameyn kartaa tallaabo si aad u xaqiijiso booskaaga!

English: The Kenya Women Teachers Association (KEWOTA) is organizing a nationwide walk to raise Ksh400 million for a mental health center for teachers. All educators are encouraged to participate and support this initiative.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Walimu Wanawake Kenya (KEWOTA) linapanga matembezi ya kitaifa ili kukusanya Ksh400 milioni kwa ajili ya kituo cha afya ya akili kwa walimu. Walimu wote wanahimizwa kushiriki na kuunga mkono mpango huu.
Ekegusii: Omosokoti wa Abwaki Babere (KEWOTA) oria oregere omokiri gechiri kutenda omogenda buya buya bwakugendere Ksh400 miriyo ekilambo kosi naki buya. Abwaki boni bosi dituokere omokiri ogwaki.
Dholuo: Kenya Women Teachers Association (KEWOTA) in gi wachar e saambili molol, guok kuom wachak Ksh400 million mohonye gi center mar mental health ma gicheng' ka pod ng'ato. Bende gisechuloni nyaka wa ni ng'ato duto to onge yo.
Somali: Ururka Haweenka Macallinada Kenya (KEWOTA) waxay qabanqaabineysaa socod qaran si loo ururiyo Ksh400 millón oo loogu talagalay xarun caafimaadka maskaxda ee macallimiinta. Dhammaan macallimiinta waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan oo ay taageeraan mashruucan.

English: The High Court has suspended the police recruitment exercise scheduled for October 3, 2025. Aspiring recruits should monitor updates regarding the resolution of this legal matter.
Kiswahili: Mahakama Kuu imeahirisha zoezi la kuajiri polisi lililopangwa kufanyika tarehe 3 Oktoba 2025. Wale wanaotaka kuajiriwa wanapaswa kufuatilia taarifa kuhusu ufumbuzi wa jambo hili la kisheria.
Ekegusii: Orua omogori buya bw'oyaki bw'ogenda omokori bw'akiire bwa October 3, 2025. Abagania gose bokere oria buya bw'ogenda kukiri okuhiirira omokiri omobororane.
Dholuo: Kuom joma wengi, High Court yawuoyo joma ong'ere to nyaka timo yore mar police, maodhi timo e timo maber gi juma ma okinyi 3, 2025. Joma towuok ng'eyo konyo jochung' gi wacho ma oduogo e nyaka seche.
Somali: Maxkamadda Sare ayaa hakisay hawsha qorista booliska oo la qorsheeyay in ay dhacdo Oktoobar 3, 2025. Ruqsadaha doonaya in ay ku biiraan waa inay la socdaan wararka ku saabsan xallinta arrintan sharciga ah.

English: No actionable information for the public is available at this time.
Kiswahili: Hakuna taarifa ambayo inaweza kutekelezwa kwa umma kwa wakati huu.
Ekegusii: Ng'eno egesere buya buya buere emosi.
Dholuo: Nefwando gi chuny mokuongo ma okinyi e triang'ino ma ok nyalo chako.
Somali: Waqtigan xaadirka ah, macluumaad wax ku ool ah oo bulshada loogu talagalay ma jiro.

English: The government will launch a new digital platform for managing external debt payments on February 2. This system aims to enhance efficiency and transparency in debt management.
Kiswahili: Serikali itaanzisha jukwaa jipya la kidigitali la kusimamia malipo ya madeni ya nje tarehe 2 Februari. Mfumo huu unalenga kuboresha ufanisi na uwazi katika usimamizi wa madeni.
Ekegusii: Omoige buya bw’ogenda buya bosi buru ogetere pima ya ng’ana bwebwaki naki 2. Ebwaki buya buya buya naki bw’ogena bukiire na busuguta mu bwaki bwegusiri.
Dholuo: Chomi osebedo ni govment ochandruo chuto chieko gi eyo ma okonyo ruothne pesa mar kieko koro chitho 2. Tich naneno ni omiyo nigo weng' mokuongo gi ngato mag kowe kare ruothne.
Somali: Dawladda ayaa bilaabi doonta madal cusub oo dijitaal ah oo loogu talagalay maareynta waxbixinta daymaha qalaad 2-da Febraayo. Nidaamkan wuxuu ujeedkiisu yahay inuu kordhiyo waxtarka iyo hufnaanta maareynta daymaha.

English: Absa offers a variety of investment funds in Kenya, ideal for both short-term and long-term investors. Explore options for capital preservation, income generation, and capital growth.
Kiswahili: Absa inatoa aina mbalimbali za mifuko ya uwekezaji nchini Kenya, inayofaa kwa wawekezaji wa muda mfupi na mrefu. Chunguza chaguzi za kuhifadhi mtaji, kuunda kipato, na ukuaji wa mtaji.
Ekegusii: Absa inakora oboki bori bwaki bwokanya mu Kenya, bwaki bwekorane na abekanyebwa batanhuka na abekanyebwa bwerere. Kinyarire obokire bwi nyaranga, buya buya, naki naki.
Dholuo: Absa ok nyal nyiso chandruok dede mar investimenti e Kenya, ka en ng'wonyi gi nyim g'weny. Wathinyo ma en dendi, bayo mar ruk, gi chandruok mar gima kanyo.
Somali: Absa waxay bixisaa noocyo kala duwan oo fursadaha maalgashiga ah oo ku yaal Kenya, oo ku habboon maalgashadayaal gaaban iyo kuwa muddo dheer ah. Baadh fursadaha ilaalinta raasumaalka, dhalinta dakhliga, iyo korodhka raasumaalka.

Ekegusii: Instructions not provided for translation.
Dholuo: N/A
Somali: Ma jiraan wax talaabo ah oo la qaadi karo.

English: Learn how to remove the TikTok watermark for cleaner videos on other platforms by cropping, screen recording, or using professional editing software.
Kiswahili: Jifunze jinsi ya kuondoa alama ya TikTok kwenye video zako ili ziwe safi kwenye majukwaa mengine kwa kukata, kurekoda skrini, au kutumia programu za kitaalamu za kuhariri.
Ekegusii: Naki omokireri inya igotuma naki kosiaga oTikTok okwaki omosibori oria itaheri enyabwa, kosiaga, kana naki oborori omokiri.
Dholuo: Chako gi ng’ato piny to dongo TikTok watermark gi nyaka bur chiemo duto kendo themo, keto dongo kuonde, to kod koro kaimedi to akar kuom gik ma okonyo.
Somali: Baro sida loo saaro calaamadda TikTok si aad u hesho fiidiyowyo nadiif ah oo ku saabsan madal duwan adigoo jaraya, duubaya shaashada, ama isticmaalaya barnaamijyo tafatir xirfad leh.

English: The Ministry of Health is launching a nationwide immunization campaign against typhoid and measles-rubella from July 5 to July 14, 2025, targeting children aged 9 months to 14 years. Ensure your eligible child is vaccinated.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Afya inaanzisha kampeni ya kitaifa ya chanjo dhidi ya tifosi na surua-kuharisha kuanzia Julai 5 hadi Julai 14, 2025, ikilenga watoto wenye umri wa miezi 9 hadi miaka 14. Hakikisha mtoto wako anayestahili anapata chanjo.
Ekegusii: Abwaki bw'ekaranga baffe bosi buliaja buya dampo bwokiri bw'ekamori bw'ekirori naki bw'ekitabu na mesasi-burubabari guoriti guse akina nyasa 5 naki 14, 2025, bosi buya bujori abaki abo naki bwosi 9 naki 14 miranya. Gekere abaki ba segori buya bakenyore.
Dholuo: Ministry ot Health oyamre kanyakla kweneno kanyakna ma nyaka wacho gi typhoid kod measles-rubella sigend gi July 5 to July 14, 2025, mag joma osero ndalo 9 to 14 ng’wech. Wacho ni joma osero niyueyo kat kemou.
Somali: Wasaaradda Caafimadka waxay bilawday olole tallaal oo qaran ka dhaceyso lidka dhoofar iyo jeermis-dhagaaga laga bilaabo 5-ta Luulyo ilaa 14-ka Luulyo 2025, iyadoo loo jeedo carruurta da'doodu tahay 9 bilood illaa 14 sano. Hubi in ilmahaaga u qalma la tallaalo.

English: Kamene Goro, a successful media personality and law graduate, emphasizes the importance of pursuing passions and staying true to oneself in career choices.
Kiswahili: Kamene Goro, mtu maarufu katika vyombo vya habari na mhitimu wa sheria, anasisitiza umuhimu wa kufuata shauku na kubaki mwaminifu kwa nafsi yako katika chaguzi za kazi.
Ekegusii: Kamene Goro, omokang'ani bwakidiria na omokinyigi bw'ekere, akang'anya obwakire busekerere omonene nabw'ekere bwakinyogorere na busekerere obwakinyono mu bwakabiri.
Dholuo: Kamene Goro, jowang' mar media ne jomoko ma pod tich, owach ni nyamre konyo ng'ato nyaka to nene e buogo mar chier gi kare mang'we.
Somali: Kamene Goro, oo ah qof caan ah oo warbaahinta ah iyo qareen qalin-jabin, ayaa muujinaysa muhiimada ay leedahay in la raaco xiisaha iyo in la ahaado daacad naftaada marka la dooranayo xirfadaha.

English: This article does not contain any actionable public service information.
Kiswahili: Makala hii haina taarifa za huduma za umma zinazoweza kutekelezwa.
Ekegusii: Makonge siria mwaki oria ogendire buya obwaki.
Dholuo: Koyugi ni gima owala gi teko mar public service en bura.
Somali: Maqaalkani ma koobna wax macluumaad ah oo aan ficil ahaan loo qaadi karin.

English: The government will cover national examination fees for the Kenya Primary School Education Assessment (KPSEA), Junior Secondary School (JSS), and Kenya Certificate of Secondary Education (KCSE) exams.
Kiswahili: Serikali itagharamia ada za mitihani ya kitaifa kwa ajili ya Kenya Primary School Education Assessment (KPSEA), Shule ya Sekondari ya Kijuni (JSS), na Kenya Certificate of Secondary Education (KCSE).
Ekegusii: Ong'endi buya buya nakira omotiriri ogotirebwe buya bw'egesarebu ya Kenya Primary School Education Assessment (KPSEA), Junior Secondary School (JSS), na Kenya Certificate of Secondary Education (KCSE).
Dholuo: Gavament konyo kuom mag kanyundo mar makelo kanyo ki ochako ma Kenya Primary School Education Assessment (KPSEA), Junior Secondary School (JSS), e joma Kenya Certificate of Secondary Education (KCSE).
Somali: Dowladdu waxay bixin doontaa khidmadaha imtixaanka qaran ee qiimeynta waxbarashada dugsiga hoose ee Kenya (KPSEA), dugsiga dhexe (JSS), iyo shahaadada dugsiga sare ee Kenya (KCSE).

English: The Ministry of Education has disbursed over Ksh22 billion to public basic education institutions for Term Two. School administrators must manage these funds transparently and avoid illegal charges.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu imepeleka zaidi ya bilioni 22 za Ksh kwa taasisi za elimu ya msingi za umma kwa kipindi cha Pili. Wasimamizi wa shule wanapaswa kudhibiti fedha hizi kwa uwazi na kuepuka ada zisizo halali.
Ekegusii: Miniistiri ya Edhesheni ikanga obwakiere eng'eno Ksh22 billion buisanga bu kosi za edhesheni bu kosi ya Abwaki. Abatwaki ba masomo baria baige fsibu ya bwaki ya bosi boki abaganya oboroti bwaki.
Dholuo: Ministri ma Katiso en gi chuth kanyakla Ksh22 billioni kuom gima oket gi public basic education institutions maber ma Term Two. Wachni ma kanyo nyaka timo temb e yo kendo nigi piny gi dhok maber.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa deeq ka badan Ksh22 bilyan siisay hay’adaha waxbarashada aasaasiga ah ee dadweynaha muddada Labaad. Maamulayaasha iskuulada waa in ay maareeyaan lacagahan si hufan oo ay ka fogaadaan khidmadaha sharci-darrada ah.

English: The KUCCPS portal for the second revision of courses for 2024 KCSE candidates is now open from May 18 to May 27, 2025. Eligible applicants are urged to revise their choices during this period.
Kiswahili: Portali ya KUCCPS kwa marekebisho ya pili ya kozi za wagombea wa KCSE 2024 sasa imefunguliwa kuanzia Mei 18 hadi Mei 27, 2025. Wagombea wanaostahiki wanashauriwa kurekebisha uchaguzi wao wakati huu.
Ekegusii: Poritali ya KUCCPS ya kukoreka kwesibori ka ibarua ya 2024 KCSE irikori buya gucokire kuMay 18 nyanchani May 27, 2025. Ababere batogorijwe bano batarogori buya kugucokora ikagori yabo nyang'ana e ji.
Dholuo: Portal kuom KUCCPS mwach nigi mar tekwen gi sekondi mar joma okel 2024 KCSE en wuok to dari May 18 kendo May 27, 2025. Joma okel kuom joma manyalo jigol miyo kwom joma ema tich.
Somali: Khadadka KUCCPS ee dib-u-eegista labaad ee koorsooyinka ee musharixiinta 2024 KCSE ayaa hadda furan laga bilaabo May 18 ilaa May 27, 2025. Codsadeyaasha waaweyn waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay dib u eegaan dookhooda intaan la guda galin waqtigan.

English: The Teachers Service Commission (TSC) will appoint a new CEO. Educators are encouraged to advocate for leadership that prioritizes teacher welfare and classroom experiences.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma za Walimu (TSC) itateua Mkurugenzi Mtendaji mpya. Walimu wanahimizwa kutetea uongozi unaoweka kipaumbele kwa ustawi wa walimu na uzoefu wa darasani.
Ekegusii: Abamere ba Teachers Service Commission (TSC) bamagana omokiri osibori. Abakinyani bakenyere ogogogetere okwitendereza ohoro bwakire bwabaki na ekigorie kija.
Dholuo: Komishini ma En-gi Kachieng’ (TSC) en ruoth nakuo. Wuoyo gi nondo kanyo nyaka ne nyakiwou ma en kanyo ber kuom piny gi nyaka koro yieng’ gi bungu.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macalimiinta (TSC) wuxuu soo magacaabi doonaa maareeye cusub. Macalimiinta waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay taageeraan hogaamin mudnaanta siisa danta macalimiinta iyo khibradaha fasalka.

English: Moi University has terminated the contracts of 800 employees due to financial challenges; affected staff must return university property by their last working day, 30 days from this notice.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Moi kimet_terminal mikataba ya wafanyakazi 800 kutokana na changamoto za kifedha; wafanyakazi walioathirika wanatakiwa kurudisha mali za chuo kabla ya siku yao ya mwisho ya kazi, siku 30 kutoka tangazo hili.
Ekegusii: Moi University abwaki mwaki omokiri bw’ogotire obwakire ba 800. Ababere bagerere bakurire omokiri bwanang'ana bokeria omogende buya naki mwaki wa 30 buya buidogo bw'oru.
Dholuo: Moi University obiro gi chaj mahoyo mar 800. Ndakorno oikoso nyaka gidhi gi chuma ma wacho; joma okonyo nyaka giyudhi chuma mar uni jasa 30 ndok.
Somali: Jaamacadda Moi waxay joojisay heshiisyada 800 shaqaale ah sababo la xiriira caqabado dhaqaale; shaqaalaha ay saameysay waa inay soo celiyaan hantida jaamacadda maalintooda ugu dambeysa ee shaqada, 30 maalmood gudahood ka bilaabato ogeysiiskan.

English: The Education Ministry has not allocated any funds for the upcoming 2025–2026 national exams, including KCSE and JSS. Stakeholders are urged to seek clarifications on exam funding.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu haijatoa fedha kwa ajili ya mitihani ya kitaifa ya mwaka 2025-2026, ikijumuisha KCSE na JSS. Wadau wanahimizwa kutafuta ufafanuzi kuhusu ufadhili wa mitihani.
Ekegusii: Ministiria y'Emaraya ikwaki na mkirori ogana ogokire omokubuni bw'ana bw'ekalang'ani 2025–2026, buya KCSE na JSS. Abakiri bataragane bateganire ushikire boki bw'ekalang'ani.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education abiro kany maseno mar dongo maber kuom 2025–2026 national exams, omiye KCSE kod JSS. Nakiambo oting' gi diya kuom joma yoweyo mar dongo.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ma ay qoondeyn wax lacag ah imtixaannada qaran ee soo socda 2025–2026, oo ay ku jiraan KCSE iyo JSS. Dhamaan daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay raadsadaan faahfaahin ku saabsan maalgelinta imtixaannada.

Kiswahili: Hakuna matangazo ya huduma kwa umma yanayoweza kuchukuliwa kutoka kwa maandiko yaliyopewa.
Ekegusii: Naki obori bwakinyanaki buya bwose omoshonizi bwaki ogotete.
Dholuo: Adhi ni pimo tiyo mag ndwongo, to piny kendo mapema ni gima dhako koro, iweyo ma aktuose?

English: Report any suspected counterfeit currency operations to the authorities immediately. Stay vigilant and help combat financial crime.
Kiswahili: Ripoti shughuli zozote za sarafu bandia zinazoshukiwa kwa mamlaka mara moja. Kuwa makini na saidia kupambana na uhalifu wa kifedha.
Ekegusii: Rekebari egete obwakare bwakandori bwakigwamo mwaki owuche naki. Nakiore ogetabere na gende ogokire omokosi bwakare.
Dholuo: Rii kodh pinje yore gi chieko mar chuthwe nyaka otong' menyene. Nying' kanyal gi konyo mano kanyen.
Somali: Si degdeg ah u warbixi wax kasta oo ku saabsan lacagta been abuurka ah ee aad shaki ka qabto. U noqo feejigan oo ka qayb qaado la dagaallanka dhibaatooyinka maaliyadeed.

English: Boxing Day is observed on December 26 as a day of generosity and charity, not fighting. Engage in family gatherings and charitable acts to honor its true meaning.
Kiswahili: Siku ya Boxing Day inaadhimishwa tarehe 26 Desemba kama siku ya ukarimu na hisani, si kupigana. Shiriki katika mikusanyiko ya familia na matendo ya hisani kuheshimu maana yake halisi.
Ekegusii: Omondi wa Boxing Day ore okwagana na December 26 buya naki ogenda naki abekirigana na ogenda, ogokibori. Kire omogosi naki buya buya na buya bwaki nobori obwakirangani obwakirigana.
Dholuo: Boxing Day chik gi December 26 nyaka nyal kisumu ikare gi dhano to osio, kendo nyal piny. Pwodhi gi piny kuom jowere kata mwandu mag dhano mondo timo tich ma ok oseted.
Somali: Maalinta Sanduuqa waxaa la xusaa December 26 maalin naxariis iyo deeqsinimo, ma ahan dagaal. Ku dhaqaaq kulamada qoyska iyo falalka deeqsinimo si aad u ixtiraamto macnaha dhabta ah ee maalintan.

Dholuo: Nyiso duto giyou do amora.

English: Residents are warned to remain vigilant as detectives are searching for Sebi Obonyo, a suspect who violently attacked his ex-lover in Nyakbong' village, Kisumu. Report any sightings to authorities.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wanatahadharishwa kubaki makini wakati wachunguzi wakiendelea kumtafuta Sebi Obonyo, mtuhumiwa aliye mshambulia kwa nguvu mpenzi wake wa zamani katika kijiji cha Nyakbong', Kisumu. Ripoti kuhusu taarifa zozote za kuonekana kwake kwa mamlaka.
Ekegusii: Abakire baarekeria bakoja valiganti, omokirigani naki kimaabi, echonchaki Sebi Obonyo, okaraki omokoboi wegi ochorongi ngoya buya mu Nyakbong' omokinyang'ani, Kisumu. Borori buya buya ekia batoraiti.
Dholuo: Ng'o chogo, jitwan gi joma, chik to poro gima detective ne okong' kor oweri Sebi Obonyo, joma okelo kamano tinde yalo mag buya gi ochung' ma Nyakbong' village, Kisumu. Jotegno nyaka na nyik gi chiege mar joma yotweyo.
Somali: Waxa dadweynaha laga digayaa in ay feejignaan siiyaan maadaama boolisku raadinayaan Sebi Obonyo, oo ah qof lagu tuhmayo inuu si xun weeraray xaasaskiisa hore ee ku sugan tuulada Nyakbong' ee Kisumu. Warbixin kasta oo ku saabsan muuqaalada la xiriira ayaa la gaarsiinayaa hay'adaha.

English: All students and teachers are reminded that school plays should be directed by teachers and not involve political figures. Let artistic expression remain free from political interference.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi na waalimu wote wanakumbushwa kwamba michezo ya shule inapaswa kuelekezwa na waalimu na isitohusishe viongozi wa kisiasa. Acha kujieleza kwa sanaa kubaki bila kuingiliwa kisiasa.
Ekegusii: Abagoti naki abechi bamakireri nguokire ikire naki oduma baki giamande abambiri. Bwakire mwankireri buya bwanatitokiri okirikire omokirwa omagaki.
Dholuo: Wang'ni kendo joge manonegi, wacho ni shule nyaka tich ni joge, kendo nikiye no newe. Nyasaye mamoko ogand mari kendo tich nyaka ni wan joma ne.
Somali: Dhammaan ardayda iyo macalimiinta waxaa lagu xasuusinayaa in cayaarta iskuulka ay macalimiintu hagaan oo aanay ku lug yeelan dadka siyaasadeed. U ogolow muujinta farshaxanku inay xor ka ahaato faragelinta siyaasadeed.

English: This text does not contain actionable information for the creation of a Public Service Announcement. Please provide a specific education-sector news article or relevant update for drafting a PSA.
Kiswahili: Nakala hii haina taarifa zinazoweza kutekelezeka kwa ajili ya kuandaa Tanganizo la Huduma ya Umma. Tafadhali toa makala maalum kuhusu sekta ya elimu au taarifa husika kwa ajili ya kuandaa PSA.
Ekegusii: Naki akaire mang'anya omokirori bw'ekende naki naki naki, ondugo oria naobori gieng'ana!
Dholuo: Koro kit gi dhano maber. Ruoth, koro n’eng’eyo bur gi timo ma duto. Kayo ni, kamano awinjore gi pi lead kendo timo maber. Kik imiyo ni wange.
Somali: Fadlan keeni maqaal warar ama warbixin ku saabsan qaybta waxbarashada si aan u qoro PSA.

English: The Directorate of Criminal Investigations (DCI) has identified businessman Philip Aroko as a person of interest in the murder of MP Charles Ong'ondo Were. Aroko is urged to cooperate with the investigation. Report tips confidentially to 999, 112, or #FichuaKwaDCI (0800 722 203).
Kiswahili: Mkurugenzi wa Uchunguzi wa Makosa ya Jinai (DCI) amemtambua mfanyabiashara Philip Aroko kama mtu wa kuzingatiwa katika mauaji ya Mbunge Charles Ong'ondo Were. Aroko anasihiwa kushirikiana na uchunguzi. Ripoti za ushauri kwa siri zitumwe kwa 999, 112, au #FichuaKwaDCI (0800 722 203).
Ekegusii: Omisekeri gw’ogusumba (DCI) omokore buya Philip Aroko ogenda oyaki bw’obi mwango ogukoranya MP Charles Ong'ondo Were. Aroko nikore ing'eno n’ogotuma omogano ogukoranya. Ria omogano nyakirimakire 999, 112, kana #FichuaKwaDCI (0800 722 203).
Dholuo: Directorate of Criminal Investigations (DCI) okonji bu frasi Philip Aroko ma oketi gi duto kuom wagor MP Charles Ong'ondo Were. Aroko en kwayo kuom ng'ato ma okanyore e duto. Gikonyo tips gi piny piny ma oketie to 999, 112, kata #FichuaKwaDCI (0800 722 203).
Somali: Hay'adda Dacwad-Ogaysiinta Dembiyada (DCI) waxay aqoonsatay ganacsade Philip Aroko inuu yahay qof laga danaynayo dilka xildhibaan Charles Ong'ondo Were. Waxaa lagu boorinayaa Aroko inuu la shaqeeyo baaritaanka. Talooyinka si qarsoodi ah ugu soo wargeli 999, 112, ama #FichuaKwaDCI (0800 722 203).

English: No actionable information available.
Kiswahili: Hakuna taarifa ya kufanya kazi inapatikana.
Ekegusii: Omosore enyamunyekeri.
Dholuo: Nar apoya mar yien.

English: Busia County has launched the Lenacapavir injection for HIV prevention. Residents, especially those at higher risk, are encouraged to access this long-acting protection available at health facilities.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Busia imezindua sindano ya Lenacapavir kwa ajili ya kuzuia UKIMWI. Wakazi, hasa wale walio katika hatari kubwa, wanahimizwa kufikia ulinzi huu wa muda mrefu unaopatikana katika vituo vya afya.
Ekegusii: Busia County yong'anya injekesheni ya Lenacapavir omokiriri buya HIV. Abagere, osiana na abaki boi, baragire boke omogotire ochire buya ino chitenda chirebire naki chezia.
Dholuo: Kaunti ya Busia owinjore Lenacapavir injection mondo oyudhi HIV. Nigi, chao kendo ng'ato ma ochung' ma okonyo, negi nyal konyo inoni e dongo ma giwe chath kendo e kanyakla.
Somali: Degmada Busia ayaa bilawday qanjiradda Lenacapavir ee ka hortagga HIV. Dadka deggan, gaar ahaan kuwa halis ugu jira, waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay helaan difaacan waxtar leh oo laga heli karo xarumaha caafimaadka.

English: Ahmed Maalim Hassan has been declared the new Member of Parliament for Banissa Constituency following his victory in the by-election on November 27.
Kiswahili: Ahmed Maalim Hassan ametangazwa kuwa Mbunge mpya wa Jimbo la Banissa baada ya kushinda uchaguzi mdogo mnamo Novemba 27.
Ekegusii: Ahmed Maalim Hassan omoshonjiaki omotere ogokire Member of Parliament buya bwa Banissa Constituency kianyake okororokire mukire buya owagore omokiriga 27.
Dholuo: Ahmed Maalim Hassan omiyo owinyo ni Memba wa Parliament nyaka mar Banissa Constituency, kendo oter owino ma oket konyo ni by-election kuom Novemba 27.
Somali: Ahmed Maalim Xasan ayaa loo doortay Xildhibaan cusub oo ka tirsan deeganka Banissa ka dib guushiisii codbixinta ee 27ka Noofembar.

English: There is no actionable information for students, teachers, parents, or the public from this article.
Kiswahili: Hakuna taarifa inayoweza kutekelezwa kwa wanafunzi, walimu, wazazi, au umma katika makala hii.
Ekegusii: Naki naki abere omokire ogendane buya buya omokire buya buya, chire, ogenda, toshoru, ore naki.
Dholuo: Ketik ma ok anyal ng'ato bedo ka dalgoyo, duong' ni chalo manie, ma ok osiemo chalo mwaki.
Somali: Maqaalkan ma siinayo macluumaad wax-qabasho ah ardayda, macalimiinta, waalidiinta, ama bulshada.

English: Leonard "Leo" Wamuthende has won the Mbeere North parliamentary by-election with 15,802 votes, enhancing UDA's presence in Embu County ahead of the 2027 General Election.
Kiswahili: Leonard "Leo" Wamuthende ameshinda uchaguzi mdogo wa ubunge wa Mbeere North kwa kura 15,802, akiimarisha uwepo wa UDA katika Kaunti ya Embu kabla ya Uchaguzi Mkuu wa 2027.
Ekegusii: Leonard "Leo" Wamuthende omogendi Mbeere North parliamentary by-election na 15,802 omokosi, ogogotanga UDA obwirane buya mu Embu County kibiaki 2027 General Election.
Dholuo: Leonard "Leo" Wamuthende en okonyo Mbeere North parliamentary by-election na 15,802 votes, okonyo UDA ng'eyo ka jowuoth Embu County kendo duto ma 2027 General Election.
Somali: Leonard "Leo" Wamuthende ayaa ku guuleystay doorashada dib u dhacday ee baarlamaanka Mbeere North isagoo helay 15,802 cod. Tani waxay xoojineysaa joogitaanka UDA ee degmada Embu ka hor doorashada guud ee 2027.

English: The public is advised to remain informed about media freedom issues following the recent incident involving GSU officers at the Standard Group headquarters.
Kiswahili: Umma unashauriwa kuendelea kujua kuhusu masuala ya uhuru wa vyombo vya habari kufuatia tukio la hivi karibuni lilihusisha maafisa wa GSU katika makao makuu ya Standard Group.
Ekegusii: Abamare bonyang'ana bwakire bwanikana buya bwakire bworagani bwabana ba GSU omokiriri ku Standard Group.
Dholuo: Umoko wa jomoko to yien ni gima gikonyo mar media kuom chandruok mar joma ginu GSU e gjore mag Standard Group.
Somali: Dadweynaha waxaa lagu wargelinayaa inay sii wataan inay ka warqabaan arrimaha xoriyada warbaahinta kaddib dhacdadii dhawaan ka dhacday xarunta Standard Group ee la xidhiidha saraakiisha GSU.

English: The High Court will rule on April 23 regarding the renewed bail application for former Kiambu Governor Ferdinand Waititu. The hearing will be conducted virtually.
Kiswahili: Mahakama Kuu itatoa uamuzi tarehe 23 Aprili kuhusu ombi mpya la dhamana la aliyekuwa Gavana wa Kiambu Ferdinand Waititu. Kusikilizwa kutafanywa kwa mtandao.
Ekegusii: Endakirori Ekiati ikorokoria on April 23 kera ogendori obwakire bwaki obokire buya bwe Nyamira owaki Ferdinand Waititu. Ogotigana bwakireri buya boki.
Dholuo: Ong'ere ma Hignere oseti e kidi kod 23 Nyasaye kuom bende ng'ato chalo miyo joo Kiambu, Ferdinand Waititu. Ogo ma ng'ato chalo bende oseti e ndalo mar adwaro.
Somali: Maxkamadda Sare ayaa go’aan ka gaari doonta 23ka Abriil codsiga deyn dib loo soo cusbooneysiiyay ee madaxweynihii hore ee Kiambu Ferdinand Waititu. Dacwadda waxaa si khadka ah loo furi doonaa.

English: All Kenyans are encouraged to learn and promote the national values and principles of governance outlined in the Constitution of Kenya 2010. Please embody and advocate for patriotism, unity, and social justice in your communities.
Kiswahili: Wakenya wote wanatakiwa kujifunza na kuendeleza maadili na kanuni za utawala zilizoainishwa katika Katiba ya Kenya ya 2010. Tafadhali kuwa mfano na kutetea ujasiri wa kitaifa, umoja, na haki za kijamii katika jamii zenu.
Ekegusii: Abagigi bosi boingia naki okiere ocherani omogamo na obwakire bw’osekenye buno buse gaki 2010. Makiwaki na bokera oserianyi, orienyaki, na busiakiri bu rekero mo chirechiri chenu.
Dholuo: Ang'wen ringo dhi nyaka wacho kendo omiyo gi neno mag nyamre kod ndiko ma okonyo e Kanyas 2010. Nyaka orumo kendo owang' pe ng'ato, gien kendo koro mar ng'ato e mamoko gi.
Somali: Dhammaan Kenyan-ka waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay bartaan oo ay taageeraan qiyamka qaran iyo mabaa'diida maamul ee ku xusan Dastuurka Kenya 2010. Fadlan ka dheh oo u ololay patriotism, midnimo, iyo cadaalad bulsho bulshooyinkaaga.

English: Kiambu County has achieved a record Sh6.5 billion in own-source revenue for the 2025/2026 financial year through digitized collection methods.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kiambu imepata kiwango cha rekodi cha Sh6.5 bilioni katika mapato yake ya ndani kwa mwaka wa fedha 2025/2026 kupitia mbinu za ukusanyaji za kidijitali.
Ekegusii: Kaunti ya Kiambu ikwirete ore oria Sh6.5 bilioni muorere 2025/2026 omokeli oria ogendeti okorenda.
Dholuo: Kiambu County en kod tich buya Sh6.5 billion e dala mar owach machalre gi chuo chwiwruok maber.
Somali: Degmada Kiambu ayaa gaartay rikoor ah Sh6.5 bilyan oo dakhli ah oo ka soo xarooda ilaha gudaha sanadka maaliyadeed 2025/2026 iyada oo loo marayo hababka ururinta dijitaalka ah.

Kiswahili: Hakuna vitu vyovyote vya kutekeleza au matangazo katika makala iliyotolewa.
Ekegusii: Naki naki matendo naki oria joturi.
Dholuo: Dala to nyalo ka malo.
Somali: Maqaalka la bixiyay ma hayo wax talaabooyin lagu dhaqaaqo ama ogeysiisyo.

English: Public officers in Kericho County are urged to embrace the Social Health Authority (SHA) and familiarize themselves with healthcare benefits to ensure accurate information and service access.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wa umma katika Kaunti ya Kericho wanahimizwa kukumbatia Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii (SHA) na kujifunza kuhusu faida za huduma za afya ili kuhakikisha upatikanaji wa habari sahihi na huduma.
Ekegusii: Abanyaki baki baki mu Kericho County barigorie kuchirechera Social Health Authority (SHA) na batarire buya buya bwakwenda bwendo buya bwaki buya bwanaki na buya bure buya bwamokiyango.
Dholuo: Abiro gima public Kuom Kericho County olose anyal ka konyo Social Health Authority (SHA) kendo ne ooyo kanyo to yiech malko gi jomoko mar yens.
Somali: Saraakiisha dadweynaha ee Gobolka Kericho waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay qaataan Maamulka Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA) oo ay isku bartaan faa'iidooyinka caafimaadka si loo hubiyo in macluumaadka iyo helitaanka adeegga ay sax yihiin.

English: The French Government and Nakuru County are enhancing digital health services and supporting TVET institutions with digital equipment. Stay informed about new opportunities for training and employment.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Ufaransa na Kaunti ya Nakuru zinaboresha huduma za afya za kidijitali na kusaidia taasisi za TVET kwa vifaa vya kidijitali. Fuata taarifa za fursa mpya za mafunzo na ajira.
Ekegusii: Abagere ba Franse na Omosome wa Nakuru bakiiragania omogenda bw'esiari naki’omokere buya bw'andai bw'urimi. Ekanegere ikinyenye bwakire inyaki kera omotera no omoshwari.
Dholuo: Kagwenge mar France e Nakuru County nyaka udi ng'ato mag digital health services to odhiero TVET institutions gi digital equipment. Chuno yore maber matut mokuongo bedo e training kod employment.
Somali: Dowladda Faransiiska iyo Gobolka Nakuru waxay kor u qaadayaan adeegyada caafimaadka dijitaalka ah waxayna taageerayaan hay'adaha TVET qalabka dijitaalka ah. La soco fursadaha cusub ee tababarka iyo shaqooyinka.

English: The Affordable Housing Programme is now underway in Marsabit County with 220 housing units planned; local contractors are encouraged to ensure timely project delivery.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Nyumba za Kijamii umeanza sasa katika Kaunti ya Marsabit ukipanga nyumba 220; wajenzi wa hapa wanahimizwa kuhakikisha uwasilishaji wa mradi kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: Ekitabo ki Nyasae ga Afya chibori hena Marsabit County na nyasa 220 chihindu; abasharti baki bware bosi bagenyire mwake buya.
Dholuo: Programu mag Nyumba eyo Ng'eyo en kuom Marsabit County, kama 220 nyumba nyaka to yo; jokontrakta mar tindi duto wan gi joma okonyo chamgi chieng'.
Somali: Barnaamijka Guryaha La Lahaado ayaa hadda lagu fuliyaa Degmada Marsabit iyadoo 220 guri la qorsheeyay; qandaraaslayaasha deegaanka ayaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay hubiyaan in mashruucu si waqtigii loogu dhameeyo.

English: State-of-the-art Mechanical and Masonry Workshops have been established at Sot Technical Training Institute in Bomet East Sub-County, funded by the Finlay Community Trust.
Kiswahili: Warsha za kisasa za Mitambo na Ufundi wa Ujenzi zimeanzishwa katika Taasisi ya Mafunzo ya Kiufundi ya Sot katika Kaunti Ndogo ya Bomet Mashariki, zikiwa zimedhaminiwa na Walio katika Mfuko wa Jamii wa Finlay.
Ekegusii: Maonchori ekooreki na nakioreki mekaraki emaberenchori Sot Technical Training Institute bosi Bomet East Sub-County, handia buya Finlay Community Trust.
Dholuo: Kawanga ma nitie buya mag Mechanical gi Masonry oseri e Sot Technical Training Institute kod Bomet East Sub-County, to nyalo piny e Finlay Community Trust.
Somali: Alaabada mehanika iyo dhismaha casriga ah ayaa lagu dhisay Dugsiga Tababarka Farsamada ee Sot ee ku yaal Bomet East Sub-County, waxaana maalgeliyay Trust-ka Bulshada Finlay.

English: Entrepreneurs in Uasin Gishu County can benefit from policy awareness forums organized by the Micro and Small Enterprises Authority. Check with MSEA for upcoming events.
Kiswahili: Wajasiriamali katika Kaunti ya Uasin Gishu wanaweza kufaidika na mikutano ya uhamasishaji wa sera inayoratibiwa na Mamlaka ya Micro na Biashara Ndogo. Wasiliana na MSEA kwa matukio yanayokuja.
Ekegusii: Abanyaki bakorire Uasin Gishu bakenye omotetani bochene oreka bw'ogogoria bw'egikere naki yorokore bu Abwino na Kirombe (MSEA). Nyasa bu MSEA oria matorori omokiri.
Dholuo: Ma entrepreneurs e Uasin Gishu County, in gi benefit kanyere madhi gi forums mar policy awareness ma en e Micro and Small Enterprises Authority. Timi ka MSEA kendo tich ni oserenye.
Somali: Ganacsatada ku sugan Degmada Uasin Gishu waxay ka faa'iideysan karaan kulamada ogawshaha siyaasadda ee ay qabanqaabiso hay'adda Micro and Small Enterprises. La xiriir MSEA si aad u ogaatid dhacdooyinka soo socda.

English: Residents of Kapsowar Ward received free healthcare services during a recent medical outreach. Stay informed about future healthcare initiatives in your area.
Kiswahili: Wakaazi wa Kapsowar Ward walipokea huduma za afya bure kwenye kampeni ya hivi karibuni ya matibabu. Endelea kujua kuhusu mipango ya huduma za afya katika eneo lako.
Ekegusii: Abakireri baki Kapsowar Ward bagiakire inyigwa za ugore chire. Naki ikarori busebo bwaki bwakirorere buse buya bwaki bwaki bukiere.
Dholuo: Eyo mar Kapsowar Ward to nyaka winjruok piny ka ka e yo achiel gi wan gi gima. Konyruok yath e yo mar wan gima ma ok otiere e piny mane.
Somali: Degaanada Kapsowar Ward waxay heleen adeegyo caafimaad oo bilaash ah intii lagu jiray ololaha caafimaadka ee dhowaan. La soco howlgallada caafimaad ee mustaqbalka ku saabsan deegaankaaga.

Kiswahili: Hakuna maudhui ya umma yanayofaa yanayopatikana.
Ekegusii: Ogorori buya bwaki.
Dholuo: An ni koro pubo mar konyo.
Somali: Ma jiro wax macluumaad ah oo la qaadi karo oo ku jira.

Kiswahili: Hakuna tangazo la umma lenye hatua linalopatikana katika maandiko yaliyopewa.
Ekegusii: Naki naki naki yaki.
Dholuo: Owang' dhak kendo bende, to koro jengi yo.
Somali: Ma jiraan ogaysiisyo dadweyne oo wax-qabad leh oo ku jira qoraalka la bixiyey.

English: Presidential Portraits are available at KNA offices for Sh 300 (A2) and Sh 200 (A3). Purchase via E-Citizen: Dial *222#, select payment options, enter service code PPPT, and follow prompts.
Kiswahili: Picha za Rais zinapatikana katika ofisi za KNA kwa Sh 300 (A2) na Sh 200 (A3). Nunua kupitia E-Citizen: Piga *222#, chagua chaguzi za malipo, ingiza nambari ya huduma PPPT, na fuata maelekezo.
Ekegusii: Ebenyabaki ya Mzee wa nchi ibwaki emokere marekenye ab KNA bw'oshwini Sh 300 (A2) na Sh 200 (A3). Kekenyere nyamokire kuboka E-Citizen: Nyang'anya *222#, ogore obwaki bwenyene, ing'anya kodhi ya serivisi PPPT, na omokere ibwakire.
Dholuo: Portrit mag Odhiambo nyaka chopo e KNA gi Sh 300 (A2) ne Sh 200 (A3). Ocheck e E-Citizen: Kony kende *222#, chuno kita makelo, nyal piny code PPPT, ochung’ ni bura.
Somali: Sawirrada Madaxweynaha waxaa laga heli karaa xafiisyada KNA qiimo ahaan Sh 300 (A2) iyo Sh 200 (A3). Iibso adoo adeegsanaya E-Citizen: Dhagsii *222#, dooro fursadaha lacag bixinta, geli koodhka adeegga PPPT, oo raac tilmaamaha.

English: Office space is available for leasing at Kenya News Agency premises in various counties. Visit the local KNA office to view available spaces and follow the leasing steps.
Kiswahili: Ofisi zinapatikana kwa ajili ya kukodishwa katika ofisi za Kenya News Agency katika kaunti mbalimbali. Tembelea ofisi za KNA za eneo lako ili kuona ofisi zinazo patikana na ufuate hatua za kukodisha.
Ekegusii: Eka na nyamware naki omoryoreri omoka mategana ku Kenya News Agency hamwe na buya buya. Genda ku ofisi ya KNA ya hena omokore nyamware naki omokiriri naki obokkore buya naki.
Dholuo: Ndege manyien nyaka gin magi oko e Kenya News Agency ka joramo duto a ng'wane. Konyo ku KNA kucung' gi dala ng'ato mondo uteme manyien kendo undu ka ng'ama otok e leasing.
Somali: Xafiisyada ayaa laga heli karaa kiraynta xarunta Warbaahinta Kenya ee gobollada kala duwan. Booqo xafiiska KNA ee deegaankaaga si aad u aragto xafiisyada la heli karo oo raac tillaabooyinka kiraynta.

English: Subscribe to Kenya News Agency products for news, photos, and videos. Options: Yearly - Sh 100,000, Half-Yearly - Sh 50,000, Quarterly - Sh 25,000. Follow payment steps via E-Citizen.
Kiswahili: Jisajili kwa huduma za Shirika la Habari la Kenya kwa ajili ya habari, picha, na video. Chaguo: Mwaka mzima - Sh 100,000, Miezi Sita - Sh 50,000, Robo Mwaka - Sh 25,000. Fuata hatua za malipo kupitia E-Citizen.
Ekegusii: Tegera ku Kenya News Agency buya buya bwete, oria, na vidiyo. Omocho: Mwaka - Sh 100,000, Ogendani - Sh 50,000, Ogereri - Sh 25,000. Itonyi ingira obokire okwenda E-Citizen.
Dholuo: Wachung' neno mar Kenya News Agency kuom neno, picha, e video. Ngero: Chieng' - Sh 100,000, Piny ma higa - Sh 50,000, Konyruok - Sh 25,000. Timo chiegni mar weche kendo timo joma E-Citizen.
Somali: Isku qor alaabada Hay’adda Wararka Kenya si aad u hesho warar, sawirro, iyo fiidiyowyo. Xulashada: Sanadlaha - Sh 100,000, Laba Sano - Sh 50,000, Rubuc - Sh 25,000. Raac tillaabooyinka lacag bixinta ee E-Citizen.

English: Interested in purchasing historical or current photographs? Visit KNA offices at Uchumi House 5th floor in Nairobi, or pay via E-Citizen for quick access. Prices are Sh 2,500 for historical and Sh 1,000 for current photos.
Kiswahili: Unataka kununua picha za kihistoria au za sasa? Tembelea ofisi za KNA katika Jengo la Uchumi ghorofa ya 5 katika Nairobi, au lipa kupitia E-Citizen kwa upatikanaji wa haraka. Bei ni Sh 2,500 kwa picha za kihistoria na Sh 1,000 kwa picha za sasa.
Ekegusii: Naki omokigo oria na buya bwaki? Naki ogenda KNA naki buya buya buya buya, Uchumi House, oria oria ore o 5 naki Nairobi, buya bosi ogenda E-Citizen. Bwakire buya naki Sh 2,500 ebuya bwaki omogoya na Sh 1,000 ebuya bwaki buya.
Dholuo: Ingi tiyo buwot ma okinyi kata ma rangi? Konyo KNA ka ranyisi e Uchumi House, nyaka 5th floor e Nairobi, kata wacho tuk e E-Citizen ma yeso buwot. Bura ni Sh 2,500 nokal ma okinyi to Sh 1,000 nokal ma rangi.
Somali: Haddii aad xiisaynayso iibsashada sawirro taariikhi ah ama kuwo hadda jira, booqo xafiisyada KNA ee Uchumi House dabaq 5aad ee Nairobi, ama lacag bixi adigoo adeegsanaya E-Citizen si aad u hesho adeeg degdeg ah. Qiimaha waa Sh 2,500 sawirrada taariikhiga ah iyo Sh 1,000 sawirrada hadda jira.

English: Foreign journalists must obtain a clearance letter from the Director of Information at Uchumi House, Nairobi, to apply for work permits or special passes. Ensure you have a valid passport, professional certificate, and an introduction letter from your media organization.
Kiswahili: Waandishi wa habari wa kigeni lazima wapate barua ya kibali kutoka kwa Mkurugenzi wa Taarifa katika Uchumi House, Nairobi, ili kuomba vibali vya kazi au ruhusa maalum. Hakikisha una pasipoti halali, cheti cha kitaaluma, na barua ya utambulisho kutoka shirika lako la habari.
Ekegusii: Abanyaburori b'amasoko bakenyere ekisikanya buya omokiriri ogwa Makarani w'Abasibori e Uchumi House, Nairobi, bw'oshotiye omanyire okwenda bibori ky'ose okobwaki bw'ogokororenye. Naki echire buya oserenge, erewaki ikiranjore, na buya ekisikanya buya buseki bw'oshindire mu buya bwo buya.
Dholuo: Jurnaliste nang'eto nyak gin ka en ur kelo ceri maler e Director of Information e Uchumi House, Nairobi, to timo work permits kata special passes. Namirokuo ka okonyo passport maa, ceri maler mar oher, to kod urwe ceri maler e kanyiko mago.
Somali: Saxafiyiinta ajaanibka ah waa in ay helaan warqadda oggolaanshaha ka socota Agaasimaha Warfaafinta ee Uchumi House, Nairobi, si ay u codsadaan ogolaansho shaqo ama baasaboorka gaarka ah. Hubi inaad haysato baasaboorka saxda ah, shahaadada xirfadeed, iyo warqad soo dhaweyn ah oo ka socota ururkaaga warbaahinta.

English: Students seeking industrial attachment with Kenya News Agency must apply in person at Uchumi House, Nairobi, and ensure accreditation by the Media Council of Kenya before reporting.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanaotafuta ufunguo wa viwanda na Kenya News Agency wanapaswa kufika mara moja katika ofisi za Uchumi House, Nairobi, na kuhakikisha wamepata ithibati kutoka Baraza la Vyombo vya Habari la Kenya kabla ya kuwasilisha.
Ekegusii: Abasi bendi abaki bakiere indiani na Kenya News Agency nakiabere gotang'ane buya kucha Uchumi House, Nairobi, nakiobere mwendo wakiabere gonyagia na Media Council of Kenya buya kouse.
Dholuo: Abal bende gima ok nyal konyo industrial attachment gi Kenya News Agency, nyal konyo ka owang' kod mano ma ok nyal nyaka e Uchumi House, Nairobi, nayie konyo accreditation e Media Council of Kenya mbere ng'ato chuny.
Somali: Ardayda raadinaya xidhiidh warshadeed ee Kenya News Agency waa inay si shakhsi ah u codsadaan Uchumi House, Nairobi, iyo inay hubiyaan aqoonsiga Ururka Warbaahinta Kenya ka hor intaanay soo sheegin.

English: Attention students in Murang'a County: Over 300 students who scored C+ and above in the 2025 KCSE have received a bursary of Sh10,000 each under the Inua Masomo programme to aid university transition.
Kiswahili: Tafadhali wanafunzi wa Kaunti ya Murang'a: Wanafunzi zaidi ya 300 waliofaulu kwa C+ na zaidi katika KCSE ya mwaka 2025 wametunukiwa bursari ya Sh10,000 kila mmoja kupitia mpango wa Inua Masomo ili kusaidia mpito wa chuo kikuu.
Ekegusii: Abaki baki bori chuchu Murang'a: Abaki 300 baria bamoso C+ na naki mu 2025 KCSE bakenye omogori buya Sh10,000 buya bwakire Inua Masomo mokubwakiriria bwendo bakanisha buya.
Dholuo: Wang'ni nyasaye e Murang'a: Neko midhoga 300 ma oket C+ kendo oser ower e 2025 KCSE ne en bursa ya Sh10,000 nyaka kendo e inua Masomo, mabuok gi tich mar univesiti.
Somali: Dardaaran ardayda ku sugan Gobolka Murang'a: In ka badan 300 arday oo helay darajada C+ iyo wax ka sarreeya sannadka 2025 KCSE ayaa helay deeq waxbarasho oo ah Sh10,000 qof kasta oo ka tirsan barnaamijka Inua Masomo si loo caawiyo kala-guurka jaamacadeed.

English: Over Sh30 million has been raised for the Nairo/Lorokusho Education Fund to support education for children in pastoralist communities in Marsabit. Community leaders and well-wishers are encouraged to continue supporting this initiative.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya Sh30 milioni zimeshakusanywa kwa ajili ya Mfuko wa Elimu wa Nairo/Lorokusho kusaidia elimu ya watoto katika jamii za wafugaji huko Marsabit. Viongozi wa jamii na wapenda mema wanahimizwa kuendelea kuunga mkono juhudi hizi.
Ekegusii: Ebwaki bwa Sh30 milioni buya wigana buya Nyikina/Narokokushio Ekegusii buya bwaki bwaki rose buya buya buya chicha bwaki bwaki buya muakurano boke buya Marsabit. Abakioria baki omogaka na aborai boke boki bwakire buya bwaki buya nyekenya buya bwaki.
Dholuo: Nango Sh30 milioni agone e Nairo/Lorokusho Education Fund ka ngeye gi educasione moro e gichung' gi nyaka kuom pastoralist gi Marsabit. Lwaki maber gi jodak achiel ok onyalo tindo gi this initiative.
Somali: In ka badan Sh30 million ayaa la uruuriyay si loogu taageero Sanduuqa Waxbarashada Nairo/Lorokusho ee waxbarashada carruurta ku nool bulshooyinka xoolo-dhaqatada ee Marsabit. Hoggaamiyeyaasha bulshada iyo kuwii kale ee doonaya inay gacan qabtaan ayaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay sii wadaan taageerida hindisahan.

English: All public primary schools in Machakos County will receive water storage tanks to improve hygiene and learning conditions. School heads should prepare for deliveries in phases across the county.
Kiswahili: Shuleni zote za msingi za umma katika Kaunti ya Machakos zitapokea matangi ya kuhifadhia maji ili kuboresha usafi na hali ya kujifunza. Wakuu wa shule wanapaswa kujiandaa kwa mgao wa vifaa kwa awamu katika kaunti nzima.
Ekegusii: Mashuleni osekeria buwaki bwaki mu Machakos County boti bosi boma buya bwa kuhigitia ubugeni na oboki bwaki. Abakire bakanisa bosi omokanya buya mwandani bwaki bwaki bwigire kenyakie.
Dholuo: Okwanyruok gi ginyim alando mag piny Machakos nyalo tawne mago ma okinyi gi mabuoye mag chon. Wuon shule osedhe opar nyaka toye mago kendo e chako chieng' piny.
Somali: Dhammaan dugsiyada hoose ee dadweynaha ee Gobolka Machakos waxay heli doonaan haamaha kaydinta biyaha si loo hagaajiyo nadaafadda iyo xaaladaha waxbarashada. Madaxyada dugsiyada waa inay u diyaar garoobaan keenista qaybaha kala duwan ee gobolka.

English: Students are urged to protect their schools and focus on their studies to ensure academic excellence. Parents should speak positively about their children to influence their futures positively.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanahimizwa kulinda shule zao na kuzingatia masomo yao ili kufikia ubora wa kitaaluma. Wazazi wanapaswa kusema mambo mazuri kuhusu watoto wao ili kuathiri maisha yao ya baadaye kwa njia chanya.
Ekegusii: Abakinyi baria buya bakiere ekere na naki bokiere buya obwakire buya. Abere bakenye buya nyaraki bano kosi bakiere bwaki buya.
Dholuo: Jaluo duto ne ng’ato ni gimet korach kendo gichang' to odhiambo nying' kuom lweny. Wabala ogendini kuom wana maladhe ma gichako chwande.
Somali: Ardayda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay ilaaliyaan dugsiyadooda oo ay diiradda saaraan waxbarashadooda si ay u gaaraan heer akademi oo wanaagsan. Waalidku waa in ay si wanaagsan uga hadlaan carruurtooda si ay mustaqbalkooda si togan u saameeyaan.

English: Ronald Ngala Utalii College will begin admitting students in September 2026. Prospective students should prepare for enrollment through the KUCCPS.
Kiswahili: Chuo cha Utalii Ronald Ngala kitaanza kupokea wanafunzi mwezi Septemba mwaka 2026. Wanafunzi wanaotarajia kujiunga wanapaswa kujiandaa kwa ajili ya usajili kupitia KUCCPS.
Ekegusii: Ronald Ngala Utalii College naaki omokogendo cha buya bwakiri mwesang'ano 2026. Abakire bosi bategere buya buwaki ekibori cha KUCCPS.
Dholuo: Ronald Ngala Utalii College oremo adhi gi ohingo mag Odhiambo 2026. Ng'ato miluor konyo gi weche mag enrollments through KUCCPS.
Somali: Koleejka Ronald Ngala Utalii wuxuu bilaabi doonaa qaadashada ardayda bisha Sebtembar 2026. Ardayda danaynaysa waa inay is diyaariyaan si ay ugu qoraan KUCCPS.

English: Voters are urged to remain vigilant against influence from money and religion in the democratic process ahead of the 2027 elections. Prioritize leadership qualities and public interest in your electoral choices.
Kiswahili: Wapiga kura wanasisitizwa kubaki makini dhidi ya ushawishi wa pesa na dini katika mchakato wa kidemokrasia kabla ya uchaguzi wa 2027. Tathmini sifa za uongozi na maslahi ya umma katika uchaguzi wenu.
Ekegusii: Abagani barangire bakiire omokirisa obwakirenge buya abori bwaki bwanetere emaisi na ore abwaki bwanetere omokirisa mu naki ogenda 2027. Gikirana abukire bwabaki naki omogeno muno naki obwaki bwekire okorukira.
Dholuo: Abiro nyaka owach ni voters nochi wacho ka gima nitie money kata chiehuok muoneso ma jomoko ma konyo gwenyo 2027. Timo gima oseth mar uwombo kata gima juma dhokruok e piny.
Somali: Codbixiyeyaasha waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay ka taxadaraan saameynta lacagta iyo diinta ee habka dimuqraadiga ah ka hor doorashada 2027. Muhiimad sii hogaaminta iyo danaha bulshada xulashada codkiinna.

English: All leaders are urged to reject violence and tribal politics as Kenya approaches the General Election. Embrace responsible leadership for national unity and peace.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wote wanahimizwa kukataa vurugu na siasa za kikabila tunapokaribia Uchaguzi Mkuu wa Kenya. Kumbatia uongozi wenye uwajibikaji kwa ajili ya umoja wa kitaifa na amani.
Ekegusii: Abak领导 baabaki bokuyaenge omogendo naki omoko mwaki naki kuomogiriri. Nyakokire omogendo mwaki ogenda bwakire naki enkiro.
Dholuo: Kaka chiegni onge to nyaka kwang' ketho ng'ato mar dhok gi miyo, ka Kenya kik beri kuno e ketho mar kit gi. Weche tiyeni chiegni makare kuom ogend gi piny kod dhoho.
Somali: Dhammaan hoggaamiyeyaasha waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay diidaan rabshadaha iyo siyaasadda qabiilka marka Soomaaliya ay u dhawaaneyso Doorashada Guud. Ku soo dhowaada hoggaamin mas'uul ah si loo helo midnimo qaran iyo nabad.

English: The new Jamia Mosque in Isebania, Kuria West Sub County is now open and will serve the local Muslim community and those across the Kenya-Tanzania border.
Kiswahili: Msikiti mpya wa Jamia katika Isebania, Wilaya ya Kuria Magharibi sasa umefunguliwa na utatoa huduma kwa jamii ya Waislamu wa eneo hilo na wale wanaoishi mipakani kati ya Kenya na Tanzania.
Ekegusii: Mosque ya Jamia emosi Isebania, Kuria West Sub County irigana na iyebaki, ikirorere buya omogaka motenya na abaki barchs in Kenya na Tanzania.
Dholuo: Jamia Mosque nyakonyo e Isebania, Kuria West Sub County onge to, kendo oket mooji kendo ne odhi e jamii musulmani mar lweny gi ja Kenya-Tanzania.
Somali: Masjidka cusub ee Jamia ee Isebania, Degmada Kuria West ayaa hadda furan waxaana u adeegaya bulshada Muslimiinta ee deegaanka iyo kuwa ka soo jeeda xadka Kenya-Tanzania.

English: Students at St. John Kanunga Senior School are reminded to uphold discipline, integrity, and hard work to ensure sustainable academic success.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa Shule ya Upili ya St. John Kanunga wanakumbushwa kuzingatia nidhamu, uaminifu, na kazi ngumu ili kuhakikisha mafanikio ya kitaaluma yanayodumu.
Ekegusii: Abanyeshuri b'iri St. John Kanunga Senior School barikunyaki chibori, omokuboori, na obwakirori buya, buya bosi buya omong'anya ekibanja kiria.
Dholuo: Boka ma St. John Kanunga Senior School nyalo konyo ng’ato mokwongo, to, luor, kendo weche mag gi timbe mboch moyuma.
Somali: Ardayda dugsiga sare ee St. John Kanunga waxaa lagu wargelinayaa in ay ilaaliyaan anshaxa, daacadnimada, iyo shaqada adag si ay u gaaraan guul waxbarasho oo waarta.

English: Youth are urged to resist manipulation by politicians for violent acts. Embrace peace and unity as the country approaches the General Election in 2027.
Kiswahili: Vijana wanahimizwa kujizuia na udanganyifu wa wanasiasa wa vitendo vya vurugu. Kukumbatia amani na umoja nchi inapokaribia Uchaguzi Mkuu wa 2027.
Ekegusii: Bwakire buya bosi bwaki iteire gaki bikore baki bwong'ore buya bwenda bwu election buya bwa 2027. Naki bwakire buya bosi bwaki ogerere omogori naki omogori naki buya.
Dholuo: Wang'na kachuon godo ka wa konyo ni joge ma ok nyueyo gi thum marich. Koro ng'eya piny gi nyuata ka piny ginyal gi General Election 2027.
Somali: Dhalinyarada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay iska caabiyaan qabqablayaasha siyaasadeed ee ku dhaqaaqaya falal rabshad. Qabso nabad iyo midnimo iyadoo dalka uu u dhowaanayo Doorashada Guud ee 2027.

English: Nandi community members are urged to preserve their cultural heritage and support the Nandi Kaburwo Council of Elders in promoting peace and unity amid modernization challenges.
Kiswahili: Wanajamii wa Nandi wanahimizwa kuhifadhi urithi wao wa kitamaduni na kuunga mkono Baraza la Wazee la Nandi Kaburwo katika kukuza amani na umoja katikati ya changamoto za maendeleo.
Ekegusii: Abanyankore ba Nandi baria bakanakire okusibaria obori bwabo bwokwenda na busongoria Nandi Kaburwo Council of Elders mu gashia bwogenda na umogaka.
Dholuo: Ng'ama Nandi wanyaluoch ka wathoge kuom chalo gi dhako dudo, kendo konyo Nandi Kaburwo Council of Elders ka ɨdhi ne karwagi kod rwakoro ni konyo ng'ama yore.
Somali: Bulshada Nandi waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay ilaashadaan dhaqankooda iyo inay taageeraan Golaha Odayaasha Nandi Kaburwo si loo dhiirrigeliyo nabadda iyo midnimada xilliyada casriyeynta.

English: Tharaka Nithi County Government will establish small museums in each constituency to preserve cultural heritage. Residents are encouraged to participate and learn about their traditions.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi itajenga makumbusho madogo katika kila jimbo ili kuhifadhi urithi wa kitamaduni. Wananchi wanahimizwa kushiriki na kujifunza kuhusu desturi zao.
Ekegusii: Ekiikosi ya Tharaka Nithi ichakora makiami matogoria mu itariria naki saki mwandira gora mwaki buya. Abaki bataramokere obwaki na okobori oria buya bwabo.
Dholuo: Kawawar thuku Tharaka Nithi kuom to kod okinyi piny mondo bende wacho sigand kendo jopiny wacho ni waduong' ni ma ok gima omiyo ahinya. Okwachni weche gi nyathi eyo bende nigi koro ne gigoko gik osiepe.
Somali: Dowladda Gobolka Tharaka Nithi waxay dhisi doontaa museums yar yar oo ku yaal degmo kasta si loo ilaaliyo dhaxalka dhaqanka. Waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa dadka deggan inay ka qeyb qaataan oo ay bartaan dhaqankooda.

English: Residents of Tharaka Nithi County are encouraged to attend the Chuka Igambang'ombe Cultural Festival on July 17-18 at Kaanwa Chief's Camp to celebrate local heritage and culture.
Kiswahili: Wananchi wa Kaunti ya Tharaka Nithi wanahimizwa kuhudhuria Tamasha la Utamaduni la Chuka Igambang'ombe tarehe 17-18 Julai katika Kambi ya Mkuu wa Kaanwa ili kusherehekea urithi na utamaduni wa eneo hilo.
Ekegusii: Ababere ba Tharaka Nithi baria bakanirire kujia ku Chuka Igambang'ombe Cultural Festival ku July 17-18 kanyaki Kaanwa Chief's Camp bw'okerebete omokere naki omokiri.
Dholuo: Geng' Tharaka Nithi, in bende ng'ama piny mwakalu Chuka Igambang'ombe Cultural Festival machon gogo Julai 17-18 k'Ombu Kaanwa, e yo piny mar heritagero ni ulambo.
Somali: Deegaanka Tharaka Nithi waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka soo qayb galaan Xafladda Dhaqanka Chuka Igambang'ombe ee soconaysa 17-18ka Luulyo ee Kambiis Kaanwa si loo dabaaldego dhaxalka iyo dhaqanka deegaanka.

English: The Eastern Region Music Festivals are taking place from June 29 to July 3 at ACK St. Luke's Wote Township Primary School, showcasing learners' talents in various artistic performances. Top performers may qualify for the National Music Festivals on July 10, 2026, at Kibabii University.
Kiswahili: Mashindano ya Muziki ya Mkoa wa Mashariki yanatekelezwa kuanzia Juni 29 hadi Julai 3 katika Shule ya Msingi ya ACK St. Luke's Wote Township, yakionyesha vipaji vya wanafunzi katika maonyesho mbalimbali ya sanaa. Wasanii bora wanaweza kufuzu kwa Mashindano ya Muziki ya Kitaifa mnamo Julai 10, 2026, katika Chuo Kikuu cha Kibabii.
Ekegusii: Omochani wa Maisha Omosia hataisibori chireka chicheng'ana June 29 kugeza July 3 e ACK St. Luke's Wote Township Primary School, omogore buya bwaki buya nakiijogori bwerere. Bakigana buya bacha bakiere kuchenda Omochani wa Maisha Nnationa chireka July 10, 2026, e Kibabii University.
Dholuo: Mise ni Eastern Region Music Festivals itiyogo odhiambo kuom June 29 kuting' July 3 e ACK St. Luke's Wote Township Primary School, moko ne tielo nyasaye mag ler kendo joma e piny dhok. Joma nene e dongo ma okonyi to nind gi ng'ato ga National Music Festivals e July 10, 2026, e Kibabii University.
Somali: Festival-yada Musiikada Gobolka Bari waxay dhici doonaan laga bilaabo Juun 29 illaa Luulyo 3, xarunta dugsiga hoose ee ACK St. Luke's Wote Township, iyada oo lagu soo bandhigayo hibada ardayda ee bandhigyada farshaxanka. Qofka ku guuleysta bandhigyada ugu sarreeya waxaa laga yaabaa inuu ka qabsado Festival-ka Musiikada Qaranka ee Luulyo 10, 2026, jaamacadda Kibabii.

English: Residents are encouraged to attend the Tharaka Cultural Festival on June 25 at Nkondi and the Chuka Cultural Festival in July to celebrate and preserve indigenous languages and cultural heritage.
Kiswahili: Wananchi wanahimizwa kuhudhuria Tamasha la Utamaduni la Tharaka tarehe 25 Juni mjini Nkondi na Tamasha la Utamaduni la Chuka mwezi Julai ili kusherehekea na kuhifadhi lugha za asili na urithi wa kitamaduni.
Ekegusii: Abakire baigana omokanga omokosi ogwirane na Tharaka Cultural Festival nyamokiri 25 gwa Nkondi na Chuka Cultural Festival mwakire omogori nyanogakire okorera na okorora ekegusii naki omotenda.
Dholuo: Kak konyo ji kuom tawere Tharaka Cultural Festival nyaka June 25 e Nkondi gi Chuka Cultural Festival e July, kendo jiyang' koding' kod nyalo ruoth mar luo mar ich.
Somali: Degaano waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qeybgalaan Xafladda Dhaqanka Tharaka 25-ka Juun ee Nkondi iyo Xafladda Dhaqanka Chuka bisha Luulyo si ay uga dabaal degaan oo ay u ilaashadaan luqadaha asaliga ah iyo dhaxalka dhaqanka.

English: The construction of the Raila Odinga Mausoleum in Bondo, Siaya County will begin this August and is expected to be completed by September 30.
Kiswahili: Ujenzi wa Makaburi ya Raila Odinga huko Bondo, Kaunti ya Siaya utaanza Agosti hii na unatarajiwa kukamilika ifikapo Septemba 30.
Ekegusii: Igenyi eguri ya Raila Odinga mu Bondo, Siaya, ikarengire buya kukanganya iugendere chinkana chio ching'anya naki chichokire mu Sempteba 30.
Dholuo: Pacho ma nyalo ka Raila Odinga Mausoleum e Bondo, Siaya County nyalo timo ma this August kendo nyalo weyo chik ni September 30.
Somali: Dhismaha Qabriga Raila Odinga ee Bondo, Gobolka Siaya wuxuu bilaabanayaa bisha Agoosto, waxaana la filayaa in la dhammeeyo 30-ka Sebtember.

English: Residents of Kilgoris Sub-County are encouraged to remain calm and strong during the mourning period for former MP Gideon Konchellah, who passed away.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Kilgoris Sub-County wanahimizwa kubaki watulivu na wenye nguvu wakati wa kipindi cha maombolezo ya mbunge wa zamani Gideon Konchellah, aliefariki.
Ekegusii: Abakire baki Kisii batarerwe kugira ugogore n'okore bworia bwaki mugore bwaki Gideon Konchellah, naki akaore.
Dholuo: Dholuo mar Kilgoris Sub-County ngʼat marach ka wuodhi kitiyo kendo nyaka ulembe gi piny mamit, ka wachonore gi Gideon Konchellah, mane oduogo.
Somali: Dadweynaha Kilgoris Sub-County waxaa la faray in ay deggan yihiin oo ay noqdaan kuwo xoog leh xilliga muujinta qaslayaasha ah ee Guddoomihii hore ee Baarlamaanka Gideon Konchellah, oo geeriyooday.

English: Senator Richard Onyonka's family is in mourning following the death of his mother, Mama Teresia Nyaboke Omoke, at 81.
Kiswahili: Familia ya Senator Richard Onyonka inahangaika kufuatia kifo cha mama yake, Mama Teresia Nyaboke Omoke, akiwa na umri wa miaka 81.
Ekegusii: Mokosi wa Senator Richard Onyonka oria ore mwagoka oboya omokiri yaki moshoke, Mama Teresia Nyaboke Omoke, omokireri omoka 81.
Dholuo: Seneta Richard Onyonka ng'ato ma konyruok ka weche mar mama eye, Mama Teresia Nyaboke Omoke, ka okonyo 81.
Somali: Qoyska senator Richard Onyonka ayaa ka murugoonaya geeridii hooyadiis, Mama Teresia Nyaboke Omoke, oo ku geeriyootay 81 jir.

English: The late Senior Superintendent of Police Peter Kazungu Charo will be laid to rest on Saturday, April 25, at Mavueni in Kilifi North Sub-County, Kilifi County.
Kiswahili: Marehemu Mkurugenzi Msaidizi wa Polisi Peter Kazungu Charo atazikwa siku ya Jumamosi, Aprili 25, katika Mavueni, eneo la Kilifi Kaskazini, Kaunti ya Kilifi.
Ekegusii: Omoigwa omonene wa abarakwa Peter Kazungu Charo ogechoka omokigori bwa Chabire, ku Mavueni naki Kilifi North Sub-County, Kilifi County.
Dholuo: Omiyo Senior Superintendent of Police Peter Kazungu Charo oseth gi in at Mawueny, Kilifi North Sub-County, Kilifi County, kuonde piny, Abich 25.
Somali: Taliyaha sare ee booliiska ee dhintay, Peter Kazungu Charo, ayaa lagu aasayaa Sabtida, Abriil 25, Mavueni, degmada Kilifi North ee gobolka Kilifi.

English: The Kenya News Agency is seeking qualified individuals for various management positions. Interested candidates should apply as per the application guidelines posted by the Ministry of Information.
Kiswahili: Shirika la Habari la Kenya linatafuta watu walio na sifa kwa nafasi mbalimbali za usimamizi. Wagombea waliovutiwa wanapaswa kuomba kulingana na mwongozo wa maombi uliowekwa na Wizara ya Habari.
Ekegusii: Amashauri ya Nhasi ya Kenya arikomoka abere buya abarikure mwakireri ogwaki. Abakire bano bategere bangania kulinda Kagwaki ka Abashauri buya abashiare na Ministry of Information.
Dholuo: Kenya News Agency ospok gi wuoth kendo moko ma okwongo e yo mar management. Konyruok ma okinyi, chike ma onge chonruok ma oser kendo piny e gige mar Ministry of Information.
Somali: Hay'adda Wararka Kenya waxay raadinaysaa shaqsiyaad aqoon leh oo u qalma xilal maamul oo kala duwan. Dadka xiiseynaya waa inay codsadaan sida ku xusan hageyaasha codsiga ee ay soo bandhigtay Wasaaradda Macluumaadka.

English: Citizens are encouraged to understand and embody the National Values and Principles of Governance as outlined in the Kenyan Constitution. Embrace patriotism, unity, and participatory democracy.
Kiswahili: Wananchi wanahimizwa kuelewa na kuishi kulingana na Thamani na Misingi ya Kitaifa ya Utawala kama ilivyoainishwa katika Katiba ya Kenya. Kubali uzalendo, umoja, na demokrasia inayoshiriki.
Ekegusii: Abagere bakiembire kubwaki na emonyakire na ekekaranya ya Divai naki Nyasae ya Abaki Kenya. Nyang'anya ogete, bwogoti, na ogetang’ania omong'ango.
Dholuo: Ng'ato machiegni nyalo romo nyan gima idhi kata chiel mar Kanyal, ka weche e Kanyawadogo. Nyonje patriotism, dhok, to buok mag tich.
Somali: Citizenska waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay fahmaan oo ay ku dhaqmaan Qiyamka iyo Mabaadii'da Qaranka sida ku xusan Dastuurka Kenya. Ku dhaqma waddaniyadda, midnimada, iyo dimuqraadiyadda ka qaybgalka.

English: For detailed instructions on making payments for news services, purchasing portraits, obtaining photographs, foreign journalist clearances, leasing office space, and student attachments, visit the Directorate of Information's official website.
Kiswahili: Kwa maelekezo ya kina kuhusu jinsi ya kufanya malipo kwa huduma za habari, kununua picha, kupata picha, vibali vya waandishi wa habari wa kigeni, kukodisha ofisi, na uhusiano wa wanafunzi, tembelea tovuti rasmi ya Kikosi cha Taarifa.
Ekegusii: Ore okegana omogendo ogenda omonene okuji chenda forori, ore okumanya atana, ore okusora atana, ore gukioria abatari bende, ore kukore omokiri, na ore okuyia ogenda omokiri bwogenda ka oremokiania obwakire, ikia okotore okwo omogendo ogenda obwakire bw'Obwaki.
Dholuo: Ng'eyo magyenge kod jarok wacho e yo maler kuom ombulu, tindo poro, jaluo chike, aoro kwany wadhou ma iyo, konyo od zinga, kod wan okwongo, ur gima toshini e website mar Directorate of Information.
Somali: Si aad u hesho tilmaamo faahfaahsan oo ku saabsan sida lacagaha loogu shubo adeegyada wararka, iibsashada sawirada, helitaanka sawirrada, oggolaanshaha warbaahinta ajaanibta, kireynta xafiisyada, iyo xirfadleyda ardayda, booqo website-ka rasmiga ah ee Waaxda Macluumaadka.

English: Parents and students affected by the Uasin Gishu Finland and Canada overseas education program are urged to report their grievances to the Ethics and Anti-Corruption Commission for assistance.
Kiswahili: Wazazi na wanafunzi walioathirika na mpango wa elimu ya ng'ambo wa Uasin Gishu Finland na Kanada wanahimizwa kuripoti malalamiko yao kwa Tume ya Maadili na Kupambana na Ufisadi kwa msaada.
Ekegusii: Ababere na abagitanga bagakire mwong’ene wa Uasin Gishu Finland na Canada bure busechi bufungi busekoragira, bakenyere kuorania ibirekire okogotigana na Commission y’Amashengo na Anti-Corruption bu oni ogotigana.
Dholuo: Jokonyo kod dalan chiegni ma ok nyal jomoko Uasin Gishu Finland riek Canada e chuo mar hiwgi ni gima owuon, omiya gik osimbo gi Luo Ethics kod Anti-Corruption Commission ma gin jothurwa e yo.
Somali: Waalidka iyo ardayda ay saameeyeen barnaamijka waxbarashada dibadda ee Uasin Gishu ee Finland iyo Kanada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay cabashooyinkooda ka diraan Komishanka Anshaxa iyo La-dagaallanka Musuqmaasuqa si ay caawimaad uga helaan.

English: Construction of a Sh10 million multipurpose hall at Oloolaiser High School has begun and is expected to be completed by the end of the year.
Kiswahili: Ujenzi wa ukumbi wa matumizi mengi wa Sh10 milioni katika Shule ya Upili ya Oloolaiser umeanza na unatarajiwa kukamilika mwishoni mwa mwaka.
Ekegusii: Bwakire bwaki ogwina ku Sh10 million buya gosego bwaki Oloolaiser High School buya bwaki naki naki buya noorio bwaki omokiriri.
Dholuo: Konyo gi Sh10 million multipurpose hall e Oloolaiser High School donjre ni mangu kochopo ni itimore keth.
Somali: Dhismaha hoolka badan ujeedooyinka ah ee lacagta Sh10 milyan ah ayaa ka bilowday Dugsiga Sare ee Oloolaiser waxaana la filayaa in la dhammeeyo dhammaadka sanadka.

English: Landlords around Chuka University must improve student welfare and security by enhancing living conditions, ensuring proper lighting, waste management, and fair tenancy practices.
Kiswahili: Wapangaji wa nyumba karibu na Chuka University wanapaswa kuboresha ustawi na usalama wa wanafunzi kwa kuboresha hali za maisha, kuhakikisha mwangaza mzuri, usimamizi wa taka, na taratibu za upangaji za haki.
Ekegusii: Abanyaki batarakire Chuka University bosi tekanyire oria bwakire omokiri bwanoru, bwakire oburi, bwakire miyo, bwakire ngaki bwakire bwanoru na bwakire bokeri bwakire.
Dholuo: Malaika e Chuka University nyalo divo yieng' kuom nyasachgi mag chike, kuom koni tond, nyathiny mara, kendo miyo ng'ato nyaka mwacheni kaka e mag nachra.
Somali: Milkiilayaasha ku hareeraysan Jaamacadda Chuka waa inay kor u qaadaan daryeelka ardayda iyo ammaanka iyagoo hagaajinaya xaaladaha deggenaanshaha, xaqiijinta nalal ku filan, maaraynta qashinka, iyo dhaqamada kirada oo cadaalad ah.

English: Muslim community members in Homa Bay are urged to support needy students enrolling in universities and colleges. A fundraising event will be held on July 31, 2026, at Governors Park.
Kiswahili: Wajumbe wa jamii ya Waislamu Homa Bay wanahimizwa kusaidia wanafunzi wahitaji wanaojiandikisha katika vyuo vikuu na vyuo. Tukio la kuchangia fedha litafanyika tarehe 31 Julai, 2026, katika Governors Park.
Ekegusii: Ababera b'ekikuyu bagenyere Homa Bay barungi kudhakana abere b'ekiruo batarikane mu masomo ga vyuo na makoro. Ikang'ana y'ekukanya inyorogori egendi ebuya ku ng'endo ya Julai 31, 2026, abu Governors Park.
Dholuo: Abiro manyien gi komiti ma ok nyiso kuom joma nyalo ȯng'eyo e Homa Bay chieng' kony. Nakiendo mar nyiso ma ok nyiso chalo ka kendo jitimbo osetne ka 31, mwaka 2026 e Governors Park.
Somali: Dhalinyarada Muslimiinta ee Homa Bay waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay taageeraan ardayda baahida leh ee jaamacadaha iyo kulliyadaha gala. dhacdo dhaqaalaha ayaa la qaban doonaa 31ka Luulyo, 2026, park-ka Guddiga.

English: St. Joseph's Sino Secondary School now has a new school bus and renovated classrooms thanks to NG-CDF funding. This initiative aims to enhance educational infrastructure in the community.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Sekondari ya St. Joseph's Sino sasa ina basi jipya la shule na madarasa yaliyo rehabelitated, shukrani kwa ufadhili wa NG-CDF. Mpango huu unalenga kuboresha miundombinu ya elimu katika jamii.
Ekegusii: Shule ya Sekondari ya St. Joseph's Sino inarora ing’ela enonikiri bus mpya na masomo miriiri buka buya naki NG-CDF. Naki inioti ikore omokiyaki oria okiregotho omogoti bw'ami.
Dholuo: St. Joseph's Sino Secondary School nyalo kuom bus nyakare motegno gi klasomabende kendo mane oyier kendo moro ng'ato mar NG-CDF. Gino ni maokse ni en miyo neno biro tich.
Somali: Dugsi Sare ee St. Joseph's Sino hadda wuxuu helay bus cusub iyo fasallo dib loo habeeyey, taasoo ay maalgaliyeen NG-CDF. Mashruucan wuxuu ujeedadiisu tahay in la hagaajiyo kaabayaasha waxbarashada ee bulshooyinka.

English: The County Government of Kericho has advertised 210 vacancies for ECDE teachers. Qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Kericho imetangaza nafasi 210 za walimu wa ECDE. Wanahitajiwa waombaji wenye sifa kuwatuma maombi.
Ekegusii: Abakirebu bwa Kericho bamenye omokirito 210 ogokwigana ogende ECDE. Abakire buya bakenyori babiri bagenye bakere.
Dholuo: Gavana wa Kaunti ya Kericho abiro kendo oter gi 210 bende magwang' mang'eyo mochung' gi ECDE. Abiro chwe gi chier maler ne okonyori ji.
Somali: Dowladda Qarbada ee Kericho waxay shaacisay 210 fursadood oo macallimiin ECDE ah. Codsadaha u qalma waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay codsadaan.

English: All education stakeholders are urged to strengthen collaboration to improve education standards and ensure learners are equipped with essential skills.
Kiswahili: Wahusika wote katika elimu wanahimizwa kuimarisha ushirikiano ili kuboresha viwango vya elimu na kuhakikisha wanafunzi wanapata ujuzi muhimu.
Ekegusii: Abakire naki batega mboge omokiri bategana omokiriri bushindani bwendo bwere nyasa naki buya bwiibori bwana bakorasa omokiri buya.
Dholuo: Mokinyi ma okang'ni nyasa jomoko yogo nag'eng' eyo wuok to golo majo mogenda dhin nyim mwaki to joma chula nigi kucha ma ok pe rang' kanyo kendo ng'ato ohinga.
Somali: Dhammaan daneeyayaasha waxbarashada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay xoojiyaan iskaashiga si loo hagaajiyo heerarka waxbarashada iyo in ardayda la siiyo xirfadaha lagama maarmaanka ah.

English: Residents of Tinderet Sub-county can now access expanded Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) programs at the newly completed tuition block and upcoming Electrical and Electronics Workshop.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Kata ya Tinderet sasa wanaweza kufaidika na programu zilizoimarishwa za Elimu na Mafunzo ya Ufundi na Stadi (TVET) katika jengo jipya la masomo na warsha ya Umeme na Elektroniki inayokuja.
Ekegusii: Abakire b’aTinderet Sub-county baria batigana okoboka wanang'ani waki Technologia ne Vocational Education and Training (TVET) ki ikirori buya bwaki omokiri bwotsia na bukhokire buya bwa Electrical ne Electronics.
Dholuo: Jodongo motegno Tinderet Sub-county nyal wachoni ma nyal oket gi Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) nyinge ka piny mogo nyal olok gi tuition block nyalo marach ahinya kendo Electrical and Electronics Workshop ma tet.
Somali: Sharci-yaqaannada degmada Tinderet waxay hadda heli karaan barnaamijyo farsamo iyo xirfadeed (TVET) oo la ballaariyay, kadib dhismaha cusub ee xarunta kharashka iyo aqoon-is-weydaarsiga korontada iyo elektarooniga ah ee soo socda.

English: The Government will expedite the completion of stalled education projects in Chebara, Elgeyo Marakwet County. Affected facilities include Chebara Vocational Training Centre and several schools.
Kiswahili: Serikali itakamilisha haraka miradi ya elimu iliyokwama katika Chebara, Kaunti ya Elgeyo Marakwet. Vifaa vilivyoathirika ni pamoja na Kituo cha Mikutano ya Ufundi cha Chebara na shule kadhaa.
Ekegusii: Abagi be Govamenti boki omorori buya buya bwaki ikoiche buya omokiri bwomoka ogenda Chebara, Elgeyo Marakwet. Omoifunyi bwaki buya bwokamono bwaki bwoka Chebara Vocational Training Centre na masomo mang'ima.
Dholuo: Govt. en godo to nind gi yueyo nyathi ng'ato ma itimre e nind bura to ber gi nyasach e Chebara, Elgeyo Marakwet County. Zawadi ma itimre e kit ma yudho e Chebara Vocational Training Centre kendo waduong' mang'wen.
Somali: Dawladda ayaa dedejin doonta dhamaystirka mashaariicda waxbarasho ee hakad galay ee Chebara, Gobolka Elgeyo Marakwet. Goobaha ay saameeyeen waxaa ka mid ah Xarunta Tababarka Xirfadeed ee Chebara iyo dhowr iskuul.

English: All Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) institutions in Kenya are urged to adopt modern training methods and collaborate with industries to equip students with skills for the Fourth Industrial Revolution.
Kiswahili: Taasis zote za Teknolojia na Mafunzo ya Ufundi (TVET) nchini Kenya zinahimizwa kupitisha mbinu za kisasa za mafunzo na kushirikiana na viwanda ili kuwapatia wanafunzi ujuzi wa Mapinduzi ya Nne ya Viwanda.
Ekegusii: Amaklima o Nyamachaki na Ogotire Okwang'ani (TVET) mo Kenya mosetegere enyisero ya naki na omotorokie naki naki chimbutu naki omoakire amaki omotenya mwaki owagire to kosi motetegere mwaki ogendi obokore bige.
Dholuo: Ka TVET nyaka kanyakore gi institution ahinya e Kenya ng'e yudore konyo mag piny motegno kendo ologo gi ma oting'o mondo wate kanyaluok kendo notimo manyien kuom Fourth Industrial Revolution.
Somali: Dhammaan hay'adaha Waxbarashada Farsamada iyo Tababarka ee Kenya waxay ku boorinayaan inay qaataan habab tababar casri ah iyo inay la shaqeeyaan warshadaha si ay ardayda u siiyaan xirfadaha Kacaanka Warshadaha Afaraad.

English: Young people in Murang'a County can access free vocational training at the 360 Climate Institute. Enroll now to gain practical skills for employment or self-employment.
Kiswahili: Vijana katika Kaunti ya Murang'a wanaweza kupata mafunzo ya ufundi bure katika Taasisi ya 360 Climate. Jiandikishe sasa ili upate ujuzi wa vitendo kwa ajili ya ajira au kujitegemea.
Ekegusii: Abaki bosi mu Murang'a County bakanogetia oborori bwiire bwokwikonyia ku 360 Climate Institute. Iraore mwaki to kora oria obokire buya bwabaki.
Dholuo: Dudi gi nne mar Murang'a kuom ne ok nyal gitchako modhiero maler e 360 Climate Institute. Nyuol ka gichalo chunyi no nyaka timo cholar keng' kendo nyaka timo mogik.
Somali: Dhallinyarada ku nool Degmada Murang'a waxay heli karaan tababar xirfadeed oo bilaash ah iyo hay’adda 360 Climate Institute. Isdiiwaangeli hadda si aad u hesho xirfado wax ku ool ah oo shaqo ama shaqo madax-bannaani.

English: Teachers will receive salary increases starting July 20, following the implementation of the second phase of the Collective Bargaining Agreement.
