Kiswahili: Walimu watapokea nyongeza ya mishahara kuanzia Julai 20, kufuatia utekelezaji wa awamu ya pili ya Makubaliano ya Kampuni yenye Wafanyakazi wengi.
Ekegusii: Abere omokireri bokiya bendo bende gesi July 20, naki bokeria chire chenda omosera chire oria bw'ekirang'ana.
Dholuo: Mwalimu maduong' goyogi e mburi gi tich mar Joly 20, nyaka wuongo gi naki mar chika mwakanyo mar konyo mar chalo.
Somali: Macallimiinta ayaa heli doona koror mushahar ah laga bilaabo Luulyo 20, kadib hirgelinta saddexaad ee Heshiiska Iskaashiga.

English: Mr. Augustine Nzuki from Tala Township Primary School will represent Kenya in a UNESCO AI training program in Shenzhen, China from July 19 to 26, 2026.
Kiswahili: Bwana Augustine Nzuki kutoka Shule ya Msingi ya Tala Township atawakilisha Kenya katika programu ya mafunzo ya AI ya UNESCO huko Shenzhen, Uchina kuanzia Julai 19 hadi 26, 2026.
Ekegusii: Mzee Augustine Nzuki abana Tala Township Primary School oigana Kenya bw’ogwaki itorori ya UNESCO k’eng’achi ya AI buya Shenzhen, China buya nyaki 19 kage 26, ng’enda 2026.
Dholuo: Mr. Augustine Nzuki kutoka Tala Township Primary School orepresent Kenya e UNESCO AI training program e Shenzhen, China kuhang' 19 ku 26, 2026.
Somali: Mudane Augustine Nzuki oo ka tirsan Dugsiga Hoose ee Tala Township ayaa Kenya u matali doona barnaamij tababarka AI ee UNESCO oo ka dhici doona Shenzhen, Shiinaha laga billaabo 19-ka ilaa 26-ka Luulyo, 2026.

English: Students who did not apply for university programs in previous years can now apply for placements through the new KUCCPS product. Visit the KUCCPS platform to apply and receive your placement letter.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi ambao hawakuomba nafasi za chuo kikuu katika miaka iliyopita sasa wanaweza kuomba nafasi kupitia bidhaa mpya ya KUCCPS. Tembelea jukwaa la KUCCPS kuomba na kupokea barua yako ya nafasi.
Ekegusii: Abanchari baki bataraburire mabori enyuema egesogori ya yunivesity oria omoragiare, ng'eyo babonire baki ogenda biria buya ku KUCCPS. Kegendere buya ku platform ya KUCCPS kugira ugendere aborere baki na egesogori yanyu.
Dholuo: Kaware ka gimon'gi kuom university, nyaka konyo gima oseria to konyo sigandogo moca. Jogi KUCCPS, ng'weny gi joma konyo ngeyo sigandogo.
Somali: Ardayda aan codsan barnaamijyada jaamacadda sanadoodii hore hadda waxay codsan karaan boosaska iyada oo loo marayo alaabta cusub ee KUCCPS. Booqo madasha KUCCPS si aad u codsato oo aad u hesho warqaddaada booska.

English: Mung'ala Secondary School now has new dining facilities, providing a better environment for students during meal times. Enjoy the improved dining experience!
Kiswahili: Shule ya Upili ya Mung'ala sasa ina vituo vipya vya kulia, vinavyotoa mazingira bora kwa wanafunzi wakati wa chakula. Furahia uzoefu bora wa kula!
Ekegusii: Mung'ala Secondary School nakiigana na bwakire bushya bwakugira, buya biria bushasa buya bune bwokore bwokinyekera! Nakiiga bwaki bwakugira!
Dholuo: Mung'ala Secondary School en gima ng'wonyo e yo mar dhoch, oma nyal chopo yore ma ok nyalo chopo mar dende. Gambira e yo mar dhoch ombulu!
Somali: Mung'ala Secondary School waxay hada leedahay goobo cusub oo casho ah, taasoo bixineysa deegaan ka wanaagsan ardayda xiliga cuntada. Ka faa’iidayso waayo-aragnimada cashada ee la hagaajiyay!

English: The education sector has received a record Sh784.5 billion allocation for the 2026/27 Financial Year, benefiting schools, students, and universities across Kenya.
Kiswahili: Sekta ya elimu imepata allocation ya rekodi ya Sh784.5 bilioni kwa mwaka wa fedha 2026/27, ikinufaisha shule, wanafunzi, na vyuo kote Kenya.
Ekegusii: Ekegusii ekoi saki ya masomo eya Sh784.5 bilioni omokiri buya bwa 2026/27, okaki ekoreng'ano bw' mashule, abere, naki univesite buya bw' Kenya.
Dholuo: Sekta mag tich en yore gi Sh784.5 bilyoni maromoe mogik kuom chako 2026/27, nikech itimere shule, wanyasaye, gi yunivesiti chalo Kenya.
Somali: Saqaaradda waxbarashadu waxay heshay miisaaniyad taariikhi ah oo ah Sh784.5 bilyan sanadka maaliyadeed 2026/27, taasoo ka faa'iideysaneysa dugsiyada, ardayda, iyo jaamacadaha guud ahaan Kenya.

English: Private sector stakeholders in Bondo subcounty are encouraged to partner with the Ministry of Education to support Curriculum Based Education (CBE). Contributions of resources and assistance are needed to ensure no learner is left behind.
Kiswahili: Wajumuisha sekta binafsi katika kaunti ndogo ya Bondo wanahimizwa kushirikiana na Wizara ya Elimu kusaidia Elimu Inayoegemea Mtaala (CBE). Msaada wa rasilimali na usaidizi unahitajika kuhakikisha kwamba mwanafunzi yeyote hakosi fursa.
Ekegusii: Abagusi b’ekirugendo b’akere nyachira ku Bondo subcounty baraiya kuhuria na Ministry of Education mu gusubira na Curriculum Based Education (CBE). Abaki b’iri na buya buya bakenyerewe kugira omokinyanya nyang’eni soria.
Dholuo: Gik ma odhiambo e Bondo, nyaka chung' e piny rasmi gi Ministry of Education gima oinuhere Curriculum Based Education (CBE). Koro no genda mar gi resources kod nyiso, to chiwre kak gima chuo en nyinga.
Somali: Waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa daneeyayaasha qaybta gaarka ah ee degmada Bondo inay iskaashadaan Wasaaradda Waxbarashada si ay u taageeraan Waxbarashada Ku Saleysan Manhajka (CBE). Kaalmo iyo agab ayaa loo baahan yahay si loo hubiyo in arday walba ay helaan fursad.

English: The County Government of Kakamega is constructing over 61 modern Early Childhood Development Education (ECDE) centres to improve access to quality education in the region. Parents are encouraged to enroll their children in these newly enhanced public ECDE centres.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Kakamega inajenga zaidi ya vituo 61 vya kisasa vya Elimu ya Maendeleo ya Utotoni (ECDE) kuboresha upatikanaji wa elimu bora katika eneo hili. Wazazi wanahimizwa kuwaj enrolling watoto wao katika vituo hivi vya umma vya ECDE vilivyoboreshwa.
Ekegusii: Abasoresori bwakagoni buKakamega boti naki nyancha 61 buabere bu naki obwakiri bwogokong’ere buessia bwosi bwosi bwokire obwakirigori. Abatiri bakesebogori baria buchebete buori bwakirigori obwakiri bwenje bworong’i bwakira abate naki.
Dholuo: Govenor wa Kakamega en gima okel mondo owacho over 61 ECDE majomain eyo mone osiepe mar joma nyalo nyal e wiye. Wazir rung'ni mondo obedi kanyo jomadak matut e yore ma okel gi.
Somali: Dowladda Qaaradda Kakamega waxay dhisayso in ka badan 61 xarumood oo casri ah oo waxbarashada Hore ee Carruurta (ECDE) si loo hagaajiyo helitaanka waxbarasho tayo leh gobolka. Waalidka waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ku diiwaangeliyaan carruurtooda xarumahan cusub ee la hagaajiyay ee ECDEda dadweynaha.

English: The National Government Constituencies Development Fund is enhancing school infrastructure, including classrooms and laboratories, to improve student learning environments.
Kiswahili: Mfuko wa Maendeleo ya Jimbo la Serikali ya Kitaifa unaboresha miundombinu ya shule, ikijumuisha madarasa na maabara, ili kuboresha mazingira ya kujifunzia kwa wanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Ekigwachi chogori cha Omoja kinyancha Omokiriri chikere omokiriri bwakire, ekikumi naki omokiriri, naki ebwaki busechara bwaki bwaki bosi.
Dholuo: Geverno ng’ama marach kanyakla gi fund mar Constituent Development ng’eyo jumba mar masomo, ka ji nyaka chako ka gi laburatori, kuom to konyo environment mar masomo.
Somali: Hay’adda Horumarinta Deegaanka Degaanka Dowladda Qaranka waxay kor u qaadaysaa kaabayaasha dugsiyada, oo ay ku jiraan fasallada iyo shaybaarka, si loo hagaajiyo deegaanada waxbarasho ee ardayda.

English: Needy students in Kiambu County are receiving financial support through bursary cheques of KSh 5,000 for day scholars and KSh 10,000 for boarders. Ensure to collect your bursary before school reopens.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanahitaji katika Kaunti ya Kiambu wanapata msaada wa kifedha kupitia cheki za bursary za KSh 5,000 kwa wanafunzi wa siku na KSh 10,000 kwa wanafunzi wa bweni. Hakikisha unakusanya bursary yako kabla ya shule kufunguliwa tena.
Ekegusii: Abanyere oria buya mu Kiambu County baria bosianga egesomogori busembi bu KSh 5,000 bu ogendori na KSh 10,000 bu abarori. Naki ohigani busembi bwako omokema oria.
Dholuo: Kano students manyien e Kiambu County okinyi pesa mar bursary gi cheke KSh 5,000 ma day scholars nikech KSh 10,000 ma boarders. Jiwaka uko to ka ng'ato bura buru mag bursary piny to school otere.
Somali: Ardayda u baahan ee ka tirsan Kiambu County waxay helayaan taageero lacag ah iyada oo loo marayo jeegag bursary ah oo ah KSh 5,000 ardayda maalinimada iyo KSh 10,000 ardayda jiifka ah. Hubi inaad soo qaadato bursary-gaaga kahor intaan dugsiga dib u furan.

English: ICS Technical College is offering a free three-month Russian language training program for students in technical and vocational training. Classes start soon; register now to enhance your global employment opportunities.
Kiswahili: Chuo cha Kiufundi cha ICS kinatoa program ya mafunzo ya lugha ya Kirusi bure kwa muda wa miezi mitatu kwa wanafunzi wa mafunzo ya kiufundi na ufundi. Madarasa yananza hivi karibuni; jisajili sasa kuboresha fursa zako za ajira duniani.
Ekegusii: ICS Technical College ikorengii ore obwaki bwogenge bujokire bwaki bwabwakire bataraka bataraki bwiita bujokire bwogenge bwokiri. Maki chaburi; ohikire nyake omokiraki bwokire bwokiri.
Dholuo: ICS Technical College oting' gi chuech mar Russian ma oketh tich kendo e tich maler mag thum tinde. Wadh joma kwayo; register duto nigi to gin kanyalo konyo ngamoro kanyo gi joma mar duniya.
Somali: Koleejka Farsamada ICS wuxuu bixinayaa barnaamij lacag la’aan ah oo tababarka luuqadda Ruushka ah muddo seddex bilood ah ardayda ku jirta tababarka farsamada iyo xirfadaha. Fasalladu waxay bilaabmayaan dhawaan; isdiiwaangeli hadda si aad u kordhiso fursadahaaga shaqo ee caalamiga ah.

English: Students interested in physics can benefit from STEM outreach programs organized by CEMASTEA and partners. Engage with hands-on experiences to ignite your passion for science.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanaovutiwa na fizikia wanaweza kufaidika na mipango ya utoaji wa STEM iliyoandaliwa na CEMASTEA na washirika. Shiriki katika uzoefu wa vitendo ili kuwasha shauku yako ya sayansi.
Ekegusii: Abana baki ogendete mu physics bakizang'anya na STEM outreach programs eziri omokinyi CEMASTEA na abaranga. Terenda omanga omokinyanaki ogotenderira okiresi tirimo.
Dholuo: Wachopo ma okel physics, inyal konyo e programe ma nyal STEM ma CEMASTEA kod ma duto. Nying' e wach mar konyo kod nyim maler kuom sayansi.
Somali: Ardayda xiiseynaysa fiisikiska waxay ka faa'iideysan karaan barnaamijyada STEM ee ay abaabushay CEMASTEA iyo shuraakadeeda. Ka qeybgala waayo-aragnimooyin gacanta ah si aad u dhagaxdhigto xiisahaaga sayniska.

English: Machakos University is constructing a Smart TVET building to enhance technical and vocational education, with completion expected in 12 months. Stay informed for enrollment and training opportunities.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Machakos kinajenga jengo la Smart TVET ili kuboresha elimu ya kitaaluma na ufundi, likitarajiwa kukamilika ndani ya miezi 12. Fuata habari za kujisajili na fursa za mafunzo.
Ekegusii: Machakos University inogangia ekorongori ya Smart TVET bugeayo buya enki'kore y'abateki n'amosendekii, na orokore emokore 12. Naki nakiore omoi omogenda nakiabireyaki.
Dholuo: Machakos University nochako gi building mar Smart TVET to yie ji joma neno machal, kendo ng'eyo ka gima tho ngeyo e yo mwak 12. Chok gi ng'ato ngaphu machalo kendo joma neno.
Somali: Jaamacadda Machakos waxay dhisaysaa dhismo Smart TVET ah si loo xoojiyo waxbarashada farsamada iyo xirfadaha, wuxuuna dhamaadkiisu la filayaa in uu dhamaado 12 bilood gudahood. Kula soco fursadaha diiwaangelinta iyo tababarka.

English: The Ministry of Education is urged to introduce Artificial Intelligence (AI) as a formal subject in secondary schools to enhance students' skills for future careers.
Kiswahili: Wizarati ya Elimu inasihi kuanzisha Akili Bandia (AI) kama somo rasmi katika shule za sekondari ili kuboresha ujuzi wa wanafunzi kwa ajili ya ajira za baadaye.
Ekegusii: Abagere b'Oborere b'Abantu bakunyora mugambi omogoti naki naki ya Artificial Intelligence (AI) ekinyanaka omokireri oria shange chibari cha masomo chire motigere.
Dholuo: Kachok ma tich mag education okonyre e chuny ariyo to itiyo Artificial Intelligence (AI) kamano mar tich maber e shule mar sekondari, chike mondo wanyore thuolo gi chalo mag nyaka.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay keento Sirdoonka Artifishalka (AI) sidii maaddo rasmi ah oo dugsiyada sare lagu bixiyo si loo xoojiyo xirfadaha ardayda ee shaqooyinka mustaqbalka.

English: Young learners in Machakos County had the opportunity to interact with global scientists during a STEM outreach program at Machakos Girls High School.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi vijana katika Kaunti ya Machakos walipata fursa ya kuzungumza na waprofesa wa sayansi kutoka duniani kote wakati wa mpango wa msaada wa STEM katika Shule ya Upili ya Wasichana ya Machakos.
Ekegusii: Abato bano bakiire mu Machakos County bakiire namiriri nakiigwa na okerebuo nakiere bunene baaba nakiigwa gwenyeki mu STEM mu Machakos Girls High School.
Dholuo: Weche gi kendo e Machakos County nyathin gi chike magok kuom gi scientists piny ma mondegi e nyime STEM e Machakos Girls High School.
Somali: Ardayda yar ee gobolka Machakos waxay fursad u heleen inay la xiriiraan saynisyahanno caalami ah intii ay socotay barnaamijka STEM ee ka dhacay Dugsiga Sare ee Gwrang Mchackos.

English: Needy students from Muhoroni and Nyakach Sub-Counties in Kisumu can apply for Sh4.2 million in bursaries to help with school fees. Check with the Senator's Office for application details.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wenye uhitaji kutoka Muhoroni na Nyakach katika Kaunti ya Kisumu wanaweza kuomba ufadhili wa Sh4.2 milioni kusaidia katika ada za shule. Angalia ofisi ya Seneta kwa maelezo ya maombi.
Ekegusii: Abanyabaki batarorere buya naki Muhoroni na Nyakach Sub-Counties mu Kisumu barangire kubirkenya Sh4.2 million buya emokiriri bwakoreri emokwa. Vergeja na Ofisi ya Senator buya obwakire bwakoreri.
Dholuo: Wang’ni kendo nyaka lweny ma ni kuoch goyo lokruok kuom Sh4.2 milioni ma okelo bursing to ang’weny ki jaluo. Konyruok e Ofis ma Senator niya gi nyiso ma kanyo.
Somali: Ardayda u baahan ee ka socota Gobolka Muhoroni iyo Nyakach ee Kisumu waxay codsan karaan Sh4.2 milyan oo deeqo waxbarasho si ay uga caawiyaan kharashaadka iskuulka. La xiriir Xafiiska Senator-ka si aad u hesho faahfaahinta codsiga.

English: Six new school buses have been procured for Nyakach schools through NG-CDF, to be distributed before the end of the financial year 2026/2027, enhancing transport for learning.
Kiswahili: Basi sita mpya za shule zimepatikana kwa shule za Nyakach kupitia NG-CDF, zitakazopewa kabla ya kumalizika kwa mwaka wa fedha 2026/2027, kuboresha usafiri wa kujifunza.
Ekegusii: Basi naki nane buya bwakoretswe buya bwokire Nyakach buzi bwi NG-CDF, bujengani bwera buya bwabwakire buya bwahaki buya buya buryo bwokire bworori ya 2026/2027, bujengani bwahaki bwokwikore buya bwokwigana.
Dholuo: Bonde mar adhi 6 nyakach mag njira yoye ng'ato kuom NG-CDF, to be diro bei koro gi jina mar chuo 2026/2027, to g'iyore transport mar nying' gima.
Somali: Lix bas cusub ayaa loo iibiyey dugsiyada Nyakach iyada oo loo marayo NG-CDF, si ay loo qaybiyo ka hor dhamaadka sanadka maaliyadeed ee 2026/2027, korna u qaadi doonta gaadiidka waxbarashada.

English: Jomo Kenyatta University of Agriculture and Technology hosted the International Kids' Conference, providing a platform for secondary school students to pitch innovative projects and ideas.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Jomo Kenyatta cha Kilimo na Teknolojia kilihost maadhimisho ya Kimataifa ya Watoto, kikitoa fursa kwa wanafunzi wa shule za sekondari kuwasilisha miradi na mawazo ya ubunifu.
Ekegusii: Jomo Kenyatta University of Agriculture and Technology yakioma Intaneti ya Banabere buya, buya abatega bosi abaidaka kitemo chochiri na bosi obwakire bwaboki.
Dholuo: Jomo Kenyatta University of Agriculture and Technology ne neno gi International Kids' Conference, oherie piny kuom joma secondary ma okonyo tich mar yore mag nyaka.
Somali: Jaamacadda Jomo Kenyatta ee Beeraha iyo Teknolojiyada ayaa martigalisay Shirweynaha Caalamiga ah ee Carruurta, iyada oo fursad u siisay ardayda dugsiyada sare inay soo bandhigaan mashaariic iyo fikrado cusub.

English: Students are urged to prioritize discipline and academic excellence to achieve their goals and positively impact their future.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanasisitizwa kuweka kipaumbele nidhamu na uf Excellence wa kitaaluma ili kufikia malengo yao na kuathiri kwa njia chanya wakati wao ujao.
Ekegusii: Abakire batirwe kugirango babere bandidi na buya bw’amasomo kugira batuhiye ibango na busani bw’ebiogori bwabo.
Dholuo: Wang'ni majeru kendo to gi chalo chalo maber, ng'ato chimbe ni to nyalo yudhi mokwongo gi chamo chuo.
Somali: Ardayda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay mudnaanta siiyaan anshaxa iyo heerka waxbarashada si ay u gaaran yoolalkooda una saameeyaan mustaqbalkooda si togan.

English: Students in Kajiado County are urged to embrace Physics and STEM subjects to prepare for careers in science and innovation. Engage in practical learning and seek resources to explore these fields.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Kajiado wanah encouraged kuchukua Fizikia na masomo ya STEM ili kujiandaa kwa kazi katika sayansi na uvumbuzi. Shiriki katika kujifunza kwa vitendo na tafuteni rasilimali za kuchunguza nyanja hizi.
Ekegusii: Abana baki Kajiado County naki ogenda buya bu Physics na masomo ma STEM buya boki orekerere buya naki kariari mu bilimbe na obwakiire. Waki kodhi omokireri omotende na oki omokinyani nyaki ekegusii.
Dholuo: Odhi gi kuom students e Kajiado County, nene onge gi Physics kod STEM ma oket nyaka timo joma e science kod innovation. Keth gi nyandwatruok e piny kod jong'eyo kuom ini kaya.
Somali: Ardayda Gobolka Kajiado waxaa la dhiirigelinayaa inay qaataan Fiisigis iyo maadooyinka STEM si ay u diyaariyaan xirfado cilmiga iyo hal-abuurka. Ka qayb qaado barashada gacanta ah oo raadi ilaha si aad u sahamiso goobahan.

English: Construction of a new classroom at Emmabwi Senior School has begun with Sh 1 million funding. Emuhaya residents can expect further educational infrastructure improvements.
Kiswahili: Ujenzi wa darasa jipya katika Shule ya Upili ya Emmabwi umeanza kwa ufadhili wa Sh milioni 1. Wakazi wa Emuhaya wanaweza kutarajia maboresho zaidi ya miundombinu ya elimu.
Ekegusii: Ekitabu kisasa ekire ekiri na Emmabwi Senior School kinyang'ana ekibuni na mali ya Sh 1 milioni. Abakere b'Emuhaya baria buya bwentsikire bwere bweng'ana bwakiagania bwesi.
Dholuo: Ige ok nyaka tiyo klas motegno e Emmabwi Senior School nigi Sh 1 million. Wuod Emuhaya ochiko kuom weche duto ma ok nyal chako mar education.
Somali: Dhismayaasha fasalka cusub ee iskuulka Emmabwi Senior School ayaa bilaabmay iyadoo la helay maalgelin gaareysa Sh 1 million. Muwaadiniinta Emuhaya waxay filan karaan horumarro kale oo kaabayaasha waxbarashada ah.

English: Parents of Kapenguria Boys High School are required to clear remaining school fees and pay an additional Sh11,270 per student before learning resumes.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wa Shule ya Upili ya Kapenguria Boys wanahitajika kulipa madeni ya shule yaliyosalia na kuongeza Sh11,270 kwa mwanafunzi kabla ya masomo kuanza tena.
Ekegusii: Ababere baki Kapenguria Boys High School baria batararire baisia bosi bwaki bwaki ne barekire Sh11,270 buya bwaki bwokoto baji banya bataria bosi bwaki bwekire.
Dholuo: Ababani mag Kapenguria Boys High School nyal gi kuom pok kaka anyal jochung' ma olosemo kod okonyo Sh11,270 kwa mwana nyaka wang'ni maaro.
Somali: Waalidiinta dugsiga sare ee Kapenguria waxaa loo baahan yahay inay bixiyaan lacagta dugsiga ee haray iyo 11,270 Shillings dheeraad ah arday kasta ka hor inta aysan waxbarashadu dib u bilaaban.

English: The County Licensing (Uniform Procedures) Act, 2024 is being implemented to standardize business licensing across all 47 counties, benefiting traders with easier operations.
Kiswahili: Sheria ya Leseni za Kaunti (Taratibu za Kawaida), 2024 inatekelezwa ili kuimarisha utoaji wa leseni za biashara kote katika kaunti 47, ikiwafaidisha wafanyabiashara kwa kufanya shughuli zao kuwa rahisi.
Ekegusii: Shughuli ya Sharia ya Leseni ya Kaunti (Miko ya Mara) ya mwaka wa 2024 inatekelezwa kuleta uratibu wa leseni za biashara katika kaunti 47, ikiwafaidisha wafanyabiashara kwa kufanya kazi kwa urahisi.
Dholuo: Shule mar County Licensing (Uniform Procedures) Act, 2024 nyalo ber kanyakore ineno gi buya masira ma okok gini e piny 47, ma okonyo puonj kager mar abiro.
Somali: Sharciga Shati-siinta Gobolka (Hannaanka Isku Midka ah), 2024 ayaa lagu dhaqangelinayaa si loo mideeyo shatiyeynta ganacsiga dhammaan 47-ka gobol, taasoo ka faa’iidaysanaysa ganacsatada hawlaha sahlan.

English: Over 10,000 Junior Secondary Schools will receive interactive smart boards to enhance digital learning; 10,382 schools are included in the first phase.
Kiswahili: Shule za Sekondari za Kiwango cha chini zaidi ya 10,000 zitapokea bodi za kijifundo za kisasa ili kuboresha ujifunzaji wa kidijitali; shule 10,382 zimo katika awamu ya kwanza.
Ekegusii: Shule 10,382 dya Junior Secondary zigaigwa naki bwogori togharia bushambo bweng'ori bujana; ng'ano 10,000 dya shule zigaigwa mu naki buya.
Dholuo: Dala 10,000 Junior Secondary Schools ng'eyo be muchi interactive smart boards gi dongo gokuom jatiyo; 10,382 schools ne en taiygi kendo chike ni.
Somali: In ka badan 10,000 dugsiyo hoose oo dhexe ayaa heli doona guddiyada casriga ah ee isdhexgalka si loo xoojiyo waxbarashada dijitaalka ah; 10,382 dugsi ayaa ku jira marxaladdii ugu horeysay.

English: The government is strengthening healthcare services in schools to improve access for students registered under the Social Health Authority (SHA). Parents are encouraged to ensure their children are registered for medical services.
Kiswahili: Serikali inaimarisha huduma za afya shuleni ili kuboresha upatikanaji kwa wanafunzi walioandikishwa chini ya Mamlaka ya Afya ya Kijamii (SHA). Wazazi wanahimizwa kuhakikisha watoto wao wameandikishwa kwa huduma za matibabu.
Ekegusii: Abariki bwakirori bakiabwiria bwakire buya mu burokore bu mokiraki bwakiabwaki mbini bugetere oigari bwareka ba Social Health Authority (SHA). Abatendo bataraki bategorie okuora entakiri yabo baabokirori.
Dholuo: Chayo magentoo e lwakni n gibuok maromi yogo oganda ka okanyo dhako duto ma nyalo chogo e Social Health Authority (SHA). Kaka ningo chikea gikwayi wuon nyaka timo kaluwore gi kit.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay xoojinaysaa adeegyada caafimaadka dugsiyada si ay u hagaajiso helitaanka ardayda ku diiwaangasan Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada (SHA). Waalidiinta waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay xaqiijiyaan in carruurtooda lagu diiwaangaliyo adeegyada caafimaadka.

English: The Kenya Defence Force is constructing classrooms in ten primary schools in Laikipia County, aiming to provide a conducive learning environment. Facilities will be ready in two months.
Kiswahili: Jeshi la Ulinzi la Kenya linajenga madarasa katika shule za msingi kumi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia, lengo likiwa kutoa mazingira bora ya kujifunzia. Miundombinu itakuwa tayari katika miezi miwili.
Ekegusii: Kenya Defence Force ikoranga amang'anya a nyansiongo mu nyang'ina ikiri mwaki ikikumu e Laikipia, ekirebaki kukiria oria bwogori bweng'ano. Bwakire bwarerano mu naki ikibue.
Dholuo: Kenya Defence Force omechango klaseni e diko mar dongo golo e Laikipia County, kanyalo ung'ere piny mar neno. Tich nobed ready e piny abich chunyi.
Somali: Ciidanka Difaaca Kenya waxa uu dhisaya fasallo dugsiyada hoose ee tobanka ah ee ka jira Laikipia, isagoo hiigsanaya in la siiyo deegaan waxbarasho oo habboon. Goobaha waxaa la dhamaystiri doonaa laba bilood gudahood.

English: Teachers are encouraged to engage in continuous professional development to enhance their skills in STEM education and meet current technological demands.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanahimizwa kujihusisha na maendeleo ya kitaaluma yanayodumu ili kuboresha ujuzi wao katika elimu ya STEM na kukidhi mahitaji ya kiteknolojia ya sasa.
Ekegusii: Abakere bategwirire obwakire mu giyegendekere bwokubiri bwogendane buya bwanatiga banyang'ere kukweta bwanani mu STEM naki amagego amaturaka.
Dholuo: Dhi nyaka tembe ka obed gima mar tich e wanya mar STEM kendo konyo joma wach ekuom gi tich mamoko.
Somali: Macallimiinta waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan horumarinta xirfadeed ee joogtada ah si ay u kordhiyaan xirfadooda waxbarashada STEM iyo inay la kulmaan baahiyaha tiknoolajiyada ee hadda.

English: Education stakeholders are urged to support the establishment of well-equipped physical school libraries and provide up-to-date Competency-Based Education (CBE) books to enhance students' reading skills.
Kiswahili: Wadau wa elimu wanahimizwa kusaidia kuanzishwa kwa maktaba za shule zilizo na vifaa vya kisasa na kutoa vitabu vya Elimu Inayozingatia Uwezo (CBE) ili kuboresha ujuzi wa kusoma wa wanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Abaki bwakiriosere bwereke omokirori bwaki buno bwakiurire bukirori bwa mashule naki biafra bwaki mboya, na buse omogendo woekire obokire bwa CBE buya buse buya nubwakire oria ogenda abanya bwaki oria.
Dholuo: Nige goyo wek kothni ma oknji nyaka bende yotore gema mag gima cama kendo timbe gima mekwando ni joma nigi godo gima gi dongruok.
Somali: Dhammaan daneeyayaashu waxa lagu boorinayaa inay taageeraan aasaaska maktabadaha iskuulka ee qalabaysan iyo inay bixiyaan buugaagta Waxbarashada Ku Salaysan Aqoonta (CBE) ee casriga ah si loo koriyo xirfadaha akhriska ardayda.

English: School fees hikes must follow legal procedures and cannot be implemented unilaterally by principals. All changes require discussions with parents and approval from the Ministry of Education.
Kiswahili: Kuongeza ada za shule lazima kufuate taratibu za kisheria na haiwezi kufanywa kwa upande mmoja na wakuu wa shule. Mabadiliko yoyote yanahitaji kujadiliwa na wazazi na kupata kibali kutoka Wizara ya Elimu.
Ekegusii: Ong'anya buya bw'ogusuma buya bwi'ekondu bwagenyigwa na emoshonari buya bwi'ekondu naki kirusia. Ososaini oria orerekyeraki konyoraki bw'otie buya bwi'ogubwaki na obw'osiprari bw'ekondu.
Dholuo: Mizaa mar shule nikan kuom kanyakla e yo mag mite e dhak, to ok nyalo temo mende mag jodongo. Konyruok wacho osetter gi jopiny kod dengo mar Ministry of Education.
Somali: Kordhinta lacagta dugsiga waa in ay raacdaa nidaamka sharciga ah, mana lagu dhaqmi karo si kaligii ah madaxda dugsiyada. Isbedel kasta wuxuu u baahan yahay in la yeesho wadahadal la waalidiinta iyo in ay hesho ogolaansho Wasaaradda Waxbarashada.

English: PCEA Mama Ngina Primary School in Kinoo Ward is undergoing construction of a new nine-classroom block to enhance learning facilities. Expect improved access to quality education soon.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Msingi ya PCEA Mama Ngina katika Kata ya Kinoo inajengwa jengo jipya la madarasa tisa ili kuboresha vifaa vya kujifunzia. Tarajia ufikiaji bora wa elimu ya kiwango cha juu hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: PCEA Mama Ngina Primary School mu Kinoo Ward nakiere kubanga bw'enge na bwenyuni bende maguma mageria ibokiri atang'ani egyurire. Kinyongera obwang'ere bw'ekigendera mu abakiigani.
Dholuo: PCEA Mama Ngina Primary School e Kinoo Ward nema chako mar nyasa ikuru nine ma jathogruok to en ng'ato ma okonyo ringo mag ilim. Eyo ogendini e joma okel chike koro bende.
Somali: PCEA Mama Ngina Dugsiga Hoose ee Kinoo Ward waxaa ka socota dhismaha dhisme cusub oo ka kooban sagaal fasal si loo hagaajiyo qalabka waxbarashada. Ka filan helitaanka waxbarasho tayo leh oo korodhay dhawaan.

English: Skilled Kenyans interested in job opportunities in Russia can enroll in a free three-month online Russian language course starting July 13 at ICS Technical College.
Kiswahili: Wakenya wenye ujuzi wanaovutiwa na fursa za kazi nchini Urusi wanaweza kujiandikisha katika kozi ya mtandaoni ya lugha ya Kirusi isiyolipishwa kwa muda wa miezi mitatu inayanza Julai 13 kwenye Chuo cha Ufundi cha ICS.
Ekegusii: Abakinyaki bakiagori bw’ogendi buya bu watoto bw’ogochenyera mu Russia bategane bendera kubanduka mu kikhwenda kiongochiaki ky’ekekata ekigana naki ky’egwakuria ekisoka muthuri ya Juli 13 na ICS Technical College.
Dholuo: Ong'ere Kenyani ma wuon job mwand kanyo e Russia, nedi ka enrol e kachieng' kusingo mar luo okeyo manok e mwakiyo mar tati, manok magi July 13 e ICS Technical College.
Somali: Somalida xirfadlayaasha ah ee xiiseynaya fursadaha shaqo ee Ruushka waxay isdiiwaangeli karaan koorso af Ruushka oo lacag la'aan ah oo soconaysa saddex bilood, oo bilaabanaysa July 13, Jaamacadda Farsamada ICS.

English: Youth are encouraged to enroll in Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) programs for employable skills. Parents and guardians in Nyandarua County should support this initiative.
Kiswahili: Vijana wanahamasishwa kujiunga na programu za Elimu na Mafunzo ya Ufundi na Kitaalamu (TVET) kwa ajili ya kupata ujuzi wa kufanya kazi. Wazazi na walezi katika Kaunti ya Nyandarua wanapaswa kuunga mkono juhudi hii.
Ekegusii: Abakomokiri baria biyaki baki omokiroria mu Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) buya obokire. Ababere na abekaki mu Nyandarua County naki baki omokirori buya.
Dholuo: Dholet mar jopiny nyal wachone kuom Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) mar joma manyalo golo. Jotegno no nyaka ing'eyo ni ginyal dhok ji e Nyandarua County.
Somali: Dhalinyarada waxaa la dhiirigelinayaa inay iska diiwaangeliyaan barnaamijyada Waxbarashada Farsamada iyo Jilitaanka (TVET) si ay u helaan xirfadaha shaqo. Waaliddiinta iyo masuuliyiinta gobolka Nyandarua waa inay taageeraan hindisahan.

English: Girls in Mombasa County are encouraged to enroll in TVET institutions and pursue blue economy courses to empower their careers.
Kiswahili: Wasichana katika Kaunti ya Mombasa wanahimizwa kujiandikisha katika taasisi za TVET na kufuata kozi za uchumi wa buluu ili kuimarisha ajira zao.
Ekegusii: Abakobwa baki Mombasa County barakwandikire mu mashule ya TVET kendo batarangire mashoko a blue economy ogukongera buya bwabo.
Dholuo: Dhi nyar kanyal Mombasa tunyIs gi konyo konyo ma TVET, kendo ibed gi chihor mar blue economy kuom puodho duto.
Somali: Gabaraha ka soo jeeda Gobolka Mombasa waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay iska diiwaan galiyaan hay'adaha TVET oo ay bartaan koorsooyinka dhaqaalayaasha buluugga ah si ay u xoojiyaan xirfadahooda.

English: Migori County vocational instructors are urged to submit their promotion requests to the County Department of Education as overdue promotions are being addressed.
Kiswahili: Walimu wa fani wa Kaunti ya Migori wanashauriwa kuwasilisha maombi yao ya mwezi wa ongezeko la cheo kwa Idara ya Elimu ya Kaunti kwani kukuza cheo ambayo imechelewa inashughulikiwa.
Ekegusii: Ab instructors baki Migori konchire buya bimise batosi chimbokire buya bwa chire chire buya osibori buya buya buya boke bategonye.
Dholuo: Instructors maruok Migori County ne okwiye nyasa chike mar ka nyaka timbe to County Department of Education, ka chike mar timbe owang' kod chike mar timbe oserere.
Somali: Macallimiinta xirfadaha ee Gobolka Migori waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay keenaan codsiyadooda koritaanka oo ay u gudbiyaan Waaxda Waxbarashada ee Gobolka, maadaama koritaanka daahawday la xalinayo.

English: The Rift Valley Regional Secondary Schools Term Two Games are ongoing until July 11, 2026, at William Ole Ntimama Stadium and Narok High School. Teams are competing for spots in the national championships.
Kiswahili: Michezo ya Shule za Sekondari za Mkoa wa Rift Valley ya Kipindi cha Pili inaendelea hadi Julai 11, 2026, katika Uwanja wa William Ole Ntimama na Shule ya Sekondari ya Narok. Timu zinashiriki kwa ajili ya nafasi katika mashindano ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Matoo maraki evireka ya Rift Valley Regional Secondary Schools Term Two Games ekirogoire kugeza July 11, 2026, ku William Ole Ntimama Stadium na Narok High School. Abaki bakiiria ibuku jia kandori mu national championships.
Dholuo: Ng'ato mar Rafu Valley Regional Secondary Schools Term Two Games ne okonyo kuom July 11, 2026, e William Ole Ntimama Stadium to Narok High School. Timbe ne gin nind Luriburu mar inyoji.
Somali: Ciyaaraha Term Two ee Dugsiyada Sare ee Gobolka Rift Valley waxay socdaan ilaa Luulyo 11, 2026, garoonka William Ole Ntimama iyo Dugsiga Sare ee Narok. Kooxuhu waxay tartamayaan si ay u helaan meelaha tartanka qaran.

English: Mombasa County is launching the "Skills Mitaani" vocational programme to train 10,000 youths in blue economy skills. Enroll now if you are a Form Four leaver awaiting university placement.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Mombasa inaanzisha mpango wa ufundi wa "Skills Mitaani" kuwafundisha vijana 10,000 juu ya ujuzi wa uchumi wa buluu. Jisajili sasa ikiwa umemaliza kidato cha nne na unasubiri nafasi ya chuo kikuu.
Ekegusii: Omochenda wa Mombasa oria "Skills Mitaani" ekikoro kisuma nakiabaki 10,000 bunge buya mu ugoro omoka. Nyasa nibokienne oweyeye Form Four ogaki zia uchinga buya.
Dholuo: Mombasa County en ginyalo "Skills Mitaani" mana ma okel kido 10,000 nyaka konyo chike mag blue economy. Bunyisawa kar kendo en Form Four leaver ma oket kanyalo university.
Somali: Degmada Mombasa waxay bilawday barnaamijka xirfadaha "Skills Mitaani" si ay u tababarto 10,000 dhalinyaro ah xirfadaha dhaqaale buluug. Isdiiwaangeli hadda haddii aad tahay qof ka qalinjebiyey fasalka 4-aad oo sugaya in jaamacad lagu geliyo.

English: Ndumberi Primary School has launched modern learning facilities, including additional classrooms and a new JSS laboratory. Students are encouraged to utilize these upgrades for enhanced learning.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Msingi ya Ndumberi imeanzisha vifaa vya kisasa vya kujifunzia, ikiwa ni pamoja na madarasa mapya na maabara ya JSS mpya. Wanafunzi wanahimizwa kutumia maboresho haya kwa ajili ya kujifunza bora.
Ekegusii: Ndumberi Primary School omokire obwakire buya, bwakire bwakunya bwakakire obokiriri buya na ofisi ya JSS. Abana banekwerekire naki omokire obwakire buya buya obokiriri.
Dholuo: Ndumberi Primary School en ni wach kuom kite mag nyasa, keto kanyo klas nyingi kod labu achiel JSS. Teno niez ga lweny kendo gibed nyiso mokuongo e piny.
Somali: Dugsiga Hoose ee Ndumberi waxa uu hirgeliyay goobaha waxbarashada casriga ah, oo ay ka mid yihiin fasallo dheeri ah iyo maktabad cusub oo JSS ah. Ardayda waxaa ka dhiirrigelinaya inay ka faa'iidaystaan horumaradan si ay u helaan waxbarasho fiican.

English: KUPPET urges political leaders to refrain from interfering in school management to preserve the integrity of the education sector and ensure effective administration.
Kiswahili: KUPPET inawasihi viongozi wa kisiasa wasihusishe katika uendeshaji wa shule ili kuhifadhi uaminifu wa sekta ya elimu na kuhakikisha usimamizi mzuri.
Ekegusii: KUPPET echoborere abaki ba chimboko enga baborere mu mirongo ya shuleni omokire ore okomokire kugira omosi chicha bwa sekta ya edutioni na obokire bwetegere.
Dholuo: KUPPET oikuru viongozi wa siasa ka insore kuchoko kwach ni machiegni chike to gin gima yawuoro ma en kit duka mar elimu kendo ji tetekwa gi nindo.
Somali: KUPPET waxay ku boorrineysaa hoggaamiyayaasha siyaasadda inay ka fogaadaan ku dhex-jiritaanka maamulka iskuulada si loo ilaaliyo sharafka qaybta waxbarashada iyo in la hubiyo maamulka waxtarka leh.

English: Invest in teacher training and research to promote Physics and STEM education. Join efforts to nurture the next generation of innovators for national development.
Kiswahili: wekeza katika mafunzo ya walimu na utafiti ili kuhamasisha elimu ya Fizikia na STEM. Jiunge na juhudi za kulea kizazi kijacho cha wabunifu kwa ajili ya maendeleo ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Tegana ogete magori naki na oandu omokiri omogori orenge Physics na STEM. Naki na oronto ogenda ogokire ekere bw'osubori bw'oguera.
Dholuo: Nyiso kuom wacho mar wathore mag piny gi nyasaye kendo ne okinyi kuom physics kata STEM. Konyo chiw jidho mar iye nyasaye ma onge e weche mag piny.
Somali: Maalgashi ku samee tababarka macallimiinta iyo cilmi-baarista si aad u horumariso waxbarashada Fiisigga iyo STEM. Ku biir dadaallada lagu kalsooni gelinayo jiilka xiga ee hal-abuurayaasha horumarinta qaranka.

English: The Kenya School of Agriculture at Kamutune, Meru County, will be completed by December 2026, providing a center for agricultural training and innovation.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Kilimo ya Kenya katika Kamutune, Kaunti ya Meru, itakamilika mwezi Disemba 2026, ikitoa kituo cha mafunzo na uvumbuzi katika kilimo.
Ekegusii: Ishule ya Kegosasa ya Kenya kwi Kamutune, Kaunti ya Meru, ichokire buya mwaki December 2026, ikiting'ana buya itegero naki ikigwe.
Dholuo: Kenya School of Agriculture ku Kamutune, Meru County, ok wang' e ndalo kuom December 2026, nikech okonyo chunyruok ahinya mag tich gi nyadinda.
Somali: Iskuulka Beeraha ee Kenya ee Kamutune, Degmada Meru, waxaa la dhameystirayaa December 2026, isagoo bixiya xarun loogu talagalay tababarka iyo hal-abuurka beeraha.

English: A sanitation programme is launching to build modern flush toilets and improve hygiene in primary schools in Teso South. Schools will be selected for the pilot phase; details will follow.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa usafi unazinduliwa kuijenga vyoo vya kisasa na kuboresha usafi kwenye shule za msingi katika Teso Kusini. Shule zitachaguliwa kwa hatua ya majaribio; taarifa zaidi zitafuatia.
Ekegusii: Omochi bw’ogusukari bw’ogenda kumina matigori ma bayo na bw’ogogotana mwagano mu masoko g’abasibori abaki. Masoko beku gwetwaki bwegana bw’otogotani; ekereri naki ekerania.
Dholuo: Otime kanyenje owinjre ni to ng’ato kanyal e ng’iyo maber kuom tich mar tich mag Teso South. Tich iwuok otimre kod nidi ma okonyo e tich; nyiri neno ang’wen.
Somali: Barnaamij nadaafadeed ayaa la bilaabayaa si loo dhiso musqulo casri ah oo biyaha dhacaya iyo in la hagaajiyo nadaafadda iskuullada hoose ee Teso South. Iskuullada waxaa lagu dooran doonaa marxaladda tijaabada; faahfaahinta waxay daba socon doontaa.

English: All boarding schools in Tharaka Nithi must address identified safety and infrastructural gaps as per the recent county assessment. Compliance is required within the agreed timelines to ensure student safety.
Kiswahili: Shule za bweni zote katika Tharaka Nithi zinapaswa kushughulikia upungufu ulioanishwa wa usalama na miundombinu kulingana na tathmini ya hivi karibuni ya kaunti. Utii ni wa lazima ndani ya muda uliokubaliwa ili kuhakikisha usalama wa wanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Makiendo ya shule zose za bweni mu Tharaka Nithi agakiri okoraga obwakire bwokigembe na obwakire bwokiranga buya iti okoragire mwigano omoshusiya. Ria ikia naki omokiri oria chire chire.
Dholuo: Nyasaye diko ma oganda bende chike gi gima oting'o ni e Tharaka Nithi mamiyo chako chiegni ka bedo gi chike mag nyasi. Ji aoro tinde, in gi kamano to bende buku lweny mag nyasi.
Somali: Dhammaan dugsiyada sare ee Tharaka Nithi waa in ay ka jawaabaan khilaafaadka amniga iyo kaabayaasha ee la ogaaday sida ku xusan qiimeynta cusub ee gobolka. Waa lagama maarmaan in la raaco waqtiyada la isku afgartay si loo hubiyo amniga ardayda.

English: The Communications Authority of Kenya has donated computers to schools in Embu County to enhance digital learning. Schools are encouraged to integrate these resources into their curriculum.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Mawasiliano ya Kenya imetolea shule katika Kaunti ya Embu kompyuta ili kuimarisha mfunzo ya kidijitali. Shule zinahimizwa kuziunganisha rasilimali hizi katika mtaala wao.
Ekegusii: Omoige buya ya Ongorori bw'Omokiri buya emikoro buya na buya shule buya ku Embu County okuore buya fundi bw'ekigwanania bw'ene. Boshule buya ogokire okole ekoro buya aya omoka ibwaki.
Dholuo: Communications Authority of Kenya oretie computers kuzi joma ku Embu County mano to yore dhokre digital. Joma ku piny nyaka gend kanyakla kendo yiengni dhokre ni okonyo gi curriculumu.
Somali: Hay'adda Isgaadhsiinta ee Kenya ayaa deeq ku siisay iskuulada ka tirsan Gobolka Embu kumbiyuutaro si loo xoojiyo barashada dijitaalka ah. Iskuulada ayaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay agabkan ku daraan manhajkooda.

English: Mioro Senior Day School has received its first school bus to enhance student transport for activities and reduce hiring costs. Four additional schools will also receive buses soon.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Mioro Senior Day imepokea basi lake la kwanza ili kuboresha usafiri wa wanafunzi kwa shughuli na kupunguza gharama za kukodia. Shule nne zaidi pia zitapata mabasi hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Mioro Senior Day School ekirankore eng'anya ya mbere eyakiiri abekuruma kuogenda okuchekire amategi nakiisiye kweria ohiki bwogena busira. Es sekolah nakiingina nekenyaki ari omokinyanya ogokore abekuruma osibori.
Dholuo: Mioro Senior Day School nigi bunde ma wuoyo mar bus mako yiero konyo duto ma nyaka timo gi jodongo ma jachanda e gendo. Kaka oyudi ma sekete e bus gino bende mondo giyou.
Somali: Mioro Senior Day School waxay heshay baska koowaad ee iskuulka si loo hagaajiyo gaadiidka ardayda ee hawlaha loona dhimo kharashaadka kirada. Afar iskuul oo dheeraad ah ayaa sidoo kale dhowaan heli doona basas.

English: Learners at Muruguru Junior Secondary School now have access to a new modern science laboratory equipped with solar power and lab equipment for practical lessons.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa Shule ya Upili ya Muruguru sasa wanayo vifaa vya kisasa vya maabara ya sayansi inayotumia nishati ya jua na vifaa vya maabara kwa ajili ya masomo ya vitendo.
Ekegusii: Abakinyiri baki Muruguru Junior Secondary School basoma ibwakiire naki labo naki magesa egesagwo gwenyemo na obwakire bwa nyasaita bwokere omogaka.
Dholuo: Wanafunzi e Muruguru Junior Secondary School owuok kuom ghwero machielo mag Luo mane okinyi gi solar power kod ng’ato ma nyalo fok yore.
Somali: Dhalinyarada dugsiga hoose dhexe ee Muruguru ayaa hadda helay maktabad saynis casri ah oo lagu qalabeeyey tamarta qorraxda iyo qalab laboratoori oo loogu talagalay casharada praktika.

English: The Kenya Union of Post Primary Education Teachers (KUPPET) stresses the need for stricter disciplinary measures against students who assault teachers; schools must address this growing indiscipline trend.
Kiswahili: Shirikisho la Walimu wa Elimu ya Juu Kenya (KUPPET) linaongeza mkazo kuhusu umuhimu wa kuimarisha hatua za kinidhamu dhidi ya wanafunzi wanaowashambulia walimu; shule lazima zikabiliane na mwelekeo huu unaokua wa ukosefu wa nidhamu.
Ekegusii: Ikireri chaki Kenya chiretu chaki KUPPET kiana buya bwogore buya bwonamu buya buya bwente bubanegere bwakirori; masomo eria ng'ogere bwiuno kiana ogenda ige buya bwokinyara.
Dholuo: Kenya Union of Post Primary Education Teachers (KUPPET) oyie chandru matek gi jomatindo ma ginyal ng'ato ma ok owuoyo jomatindo; shule manach jochung' gi joma owuoyo kata ma ginyal ratiro mabor.
Somali: Ururka Macallimiinta Waxbarashada Dhexe ee Kenya (KUPPET) ayaa adkeysanaya baahida loo qabo in la adkeeyo tallaabooyinka xukunka ah ee lagula dagaallamayo ardayda gumaada macallimiinta; iskuulladu waa inay ka jawaabaan isbeddelkan sii kordhaya ee anshax-xumida.

English: Adults who missed out on formal schooling are encouraged to enroll in adult education programs for literacy and skills development. Visit the adult education desk at Kakamega Huduma Centre for assistance.
Kiswahili: Watu wazima waliokosa elimu rasmi wanashauriwa kujiunga na programu za elimu ya watu wazima kwa ajili ya ujuzi na ujifunzaji. Tembelea dawati la elimu ya watu wazima katika Kituo cha Huduma cha Kakamega kwa msaada.
Ekegusii: Bwakire buya buya, abere basubirie bosi buya buya ne buya bwakiri buya nyansabori bwege naki akenye bwaki. Naki bwegana na desk buya buya bwaki buya Kakamega Huduma Centre buya buya naki omogenda.
Dholuo: Ng'ato ma owuon gi wendo ka oting'o konyo joma giyogo madhi ni enkela manou yie ka ineno. Koro tiyo kendo nyaka en ma giyogo madhi kod higa manebogi e Kakamega Huduma Centre kuom notindgi.
Somali: Dadka waaweyn ee ka maqnaa waxbarashada rasmi ah waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay isqoraan barnaamijyada waxbarashada dadka waaweyn si loogu helo akhris iyo horumarinta xirfadaha. Booqo miiska waxbarashada dadka waaweyn ee Xarunta Huduma ee Kakamega si aad uga hesho caawimaad.

English: The County Government of Vihiga is conducting a week-long capacity building programme on Competency-Based Education and Training (CBET) for TVET officers and VTC trainers.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Vihiga inafanywa programu ya kuimarisha uwezo ya muda wa wiki moja kuhusu Elimu na Mafunzo Yanayopangwa kwa Ujuzi (CBET) kwa maafisa wa TVET na wafundishaji wa VTC.
Ekegusii: Omoige buya bw'Vihiga obokwa bwanama obwakorera emegori ekiri naki oria mong'ania itegero ebire bye Competency-Based Education and Training (CBET) buya abaki b'TVET na abarimu b'VTC.
Dholuo: Chandruok ma Vihiga en owuon e ndalo ng’ama, mondo odhi nyaka gi joma ng’ato kanyo madhi e Competency-Based Education and Training (CBET) ma jopiny gi VTC.
Somali: Dowladda Qaaradda Vihiga waxay qabanqaabinaysaa barnaamij kor loogu qaadayo awoodda oo soconaya todobaad ku saabsan Waxbarashada iyo Tababarka ku Saleysan Aqoonta (CBET) ee shaqaalaha TVET iyo tababarayaasha VTC.

English: Junior Secondary School learners at Ochunyno Junior Secondary School showcased their project on the human skin as part of the Competency-Based Curriculum.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa Shule ya Sekondari ya Kijiji cha Ochunyno walionyesha mradi wao kuhusu ngozi ya binadamu kama sehemu ya Msingi wa Mtaala wa Uwezo.
Ekegusii: Abana bakiiyaki Junior Secondary School bakesiire projekiti yabo kwandaki omogori ogwakire ogwakabere buya bwaki Competency-Based Curriculum.
Dholuo: Eweregi kuom junior, Ochunyno Junior Secondary School, ne okinyi projekti ma okel gi guwruok mar inji.
Somali: Ardayda Dugsiga Sare ee Ochunyno waxay soo bandhigeen mashruucooda ku saabsan maqaarka aadanaha oo ka mid ah manhajka ku saleysan kartida.

English: The National Government is urged to release full capitation funds to public schools promptly to support free education. Parents and students should remain informed on any developments.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Taifa inasihiwa kutoa fedha za ufadhili kwa shule za umma mara moja ili kusaidia elimu bure. Wazazi na wanafunzi wanapaswa kuweka habari kuhusu matukio yoyote.
Ekegusii: Abagusia bâ naki buya naki shia rwabaki rwamwaki omogori omogorokire omogende buire oria buya. Ababere na abaki naki buya beka buya kweri omokiri buya bwatembokire.
Dholuo: Gavana ka yien gi jomok en konyo kapetison daka nigi chike to okwaya chike ma oket nyaka bunde mar dhano. Tichnego kod wasichien okonyo ni we gi cheng' mar kendo.
Somali: Dowladda Qaranka waxa lagu boorinayaa inay si degdeg ah u bixiso lacagaha buuxa ee dugsiyada dowliga ah si ay u taageerto waxbarashada bilaashka ah. Waalidiinta iyo ardayda waa in ay sii wadaan inay ka war hayaan wax kasta oo dhaca.

English: Over 150 Junior School teachers in Kisumu County have been trained to use virtual laboratories for STEM subjects. This initiative aims to improve science education where physical labs are unavailable.
Kiswahili: Walimu zaidi ya 150 wa Shule ya Msingi katika Kaunti ya Kisumu wamepewa mafunzo ya kutumia maabara za virtual kwa masomo ya STEM. Mpango huu unalenga kuboresha elimu ya sayansi ambapo maabara za mwili hazipo.
Ekegusii: Abakire 150 abateka bungee bomeke mu Kisumu County bakenyere kugendesia virtual laboratories bwakire STEM. Naki siagano yesi omogori bwokirire nyanjorera omokirinu bwokiri bwang'ori.
Dholuo: Abawinje 150 maabara Junior ku Kisumu County wadhonje gi tich kuom labu weche-ma. Ini oser timo nyaka diro duto ka gi labu mag piny nyaka to.
Somali: In ka badan 150 macallin oo iskuul hoose ah ayaa lagu tababaray Kisumu County si ay u isticmaalaan labaratoorada khadka tooska ah ee maadooyinka STEM. Hindisahan wuxuu ujeedkiisu yahay in la hagaajiyo waxbarashada sayniska meelaha aan lahayn labaratoorooyin jireed.

English: A Sh67 million bursary programme is available for vulnerable learners in Kapenguria Constituency. Parents are encouraged to apply to ensure their children remain in school.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa kutoa udhamini wa Sh67 milioni upo kwa wanafunzi wanyonge katika Jimbo la Kapenguria. Wazazi wanahimizwa kuomba ili watoto wao wabaki shuleni.
Ekegusii: Ekarumi ya Sh67 mirioni ikorane buya buya bosi abaki naki abaki bwakire mu Kapenguria Constituency. Abaki baria bategereere buya nyang'ia kugitire omaina bwokiriri.
Dholuo: Bursary moko Sh67 million en owaya mar thuoch mag jopiny ma ok oanore e Kapenguria Constituency. Jogo nyaka ng'eyo kuom itie ma ok oyie ninde e sukulu.
Somali: Barnaamij deeq waxbarasho oo qiimo ahaan Sh67 milyan ah ayaa loo heli karaa ardayda nugul ee ku sugan Kapenguria. Waalidiinta waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay codsadaan si carruurtooda ay ugu sii jiraan dugsiga.

English: Wajir County residents are invited to a two-day financial literacy programme to learn about investment opportunities in Kenya's capital markets. Don't miss out on this chance to diversify your wealth creation strategies.
Kiswahili: Wakaazi wa Kaunti ya Wajir wanaalikwa kwenye mpango wa siku mbili wa ufahamu wa kifedha ili kujifunza kuhusu fursa za uwekezaji katika masoko ya mtaji ya Kenya. Usikose nafasi hii ya kuboresha mbinu zako za kujenga utajiri.
Ekegusii: Abakire Wajir baria ekere buya buya bwakire buya ebirebire bwokorere nyarakiiri bwakire buya buya kosiiraki akirogo bwaki. Maki waki bwokore buya bwokogiraki kwomaki bwaki buya naki.
Dholuo: Abiero ka Wajir bang' yiengi konyo tinye mo bwech kuom kanyag' mar thuran mar shaury. Neko nindo kuom ji mang'ongo ni bende nong'ere piny wuoth.
Somali: Dadka ku sugan Wajir County waxaa laga codsanayaa inay ka qayb galaan barnaamij laba maalmood ah oo ku saabsan aqoonta maaliyadeed si ay u bartaan fursadaha maalgashiga ee suuqyada maalgelinta ee Kenya. Ha seegin fursadan si aad u kala duwanayso istaraatijiyadaada dhismaha hanti.

English: All Primary School heads in Baringo County must surrender unused Digital Literacy Program (DLP) devices to Junior Secondary School teachers for lesson delivery.
Kiswahili: Makanisa yote ya Shule za Msingi katika Kaunti ya Baringo yanapaswa kurejesha vifaa visivyotumika vya Mpango wa Ujuzi wa Kidijitali (DLP) kwa walimu wa Shule za Sekondari za Kijuni kwa ajili ya ufundishaji.
Ekegusii: Amaganga gose ng’eno buya bwirire banye boki buno bu Baringo baria bwereka iboki isiogore bu DLP buya nyakwere a Junior Secondary School omogoti omoita okere bwere.
Dholuo: Baringo County, gima gini kido, nyaka kitegi kaluwore DLP mabende to Junior Secondary School ma’kenda manyaka chikege.
Somali: Dhammaan madaxda dugsiyada hoose ee gobolka Baringo waa inay soo dhiibaan qalabka barashada dijitaalka ah (DLP) ee aan la isticmaalin macallimiinta dugsiga hoose dhexe si ay u bixiyaan casharrada.

English: Junior Secondary School teachers in Busia County have been trained to use virtual laboratories for science and mathematics. These resources enhance practical learning despite limited physical labs.
Kiswahili: Walimu wa Shule ya Sekondari ya Kwanza katika Kaunti ya Busia wamepatiwa mafunzo ya kutumia laboratori za mtandaoni kwa ajili ya sayansi na hisabati. Rasilimali hizi zinaongeza mafunzo ya vitendo licha ya kupungua kwa maabara za kawaida.
Ekegusii: Abekirori bakeshura baiso bosi bataraki bataria mwaki gwekire bure, Busia County, batoragwa obwakirori bwochirimbi buhendi bwaki bosi na masomo. Obwakirori buno buwenda buya busekeria obwakorere obwahenzire buya buya buobora.
Dholuo: Teachers ma okonyo Junior Secondary School e Busia County ne okind nyoro kuom yieng' ma nyalo konyo nyaka wacho e bende gi makete. Nigi injo duto mag nyiri e tinene ma oketh e konyruok.
Somali: Macallimiinta Dugsiga Sare ee Júnior ee Gobolka Busia ayaa tababar lagu siiyay sida loo isticmaalo maktabadaha dhijitaalka ah ee cilmiga iyo xisaabta. Kheyraadkan waxay xoojinayaan barashada waxyaabaha gacanta ah inkastoo ay jiraan maktabado jireed oo kooban.

English: Teachers of Mathematics and Integrated Sciences in Vihiga County are encouraged to implement lesson plans developed during the recent SMASSE training on virtual labs and to mentor at least three other teachers.
Kiswahili: Walimu wa Hesabu na Sayansi Jumuishi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga wanahimizwa kutekeleza mipango ya masomo waliyotengeneza wakati wa mafunzo ya hivi karibuni ya SMASSE kuhusu maabara mtandaoni na kuwafundisha angalau walimu wengine watatu.
Ekegusii: Abareka b'egesare na Integrated Sciences mubwaki bw'Vihiga barotebwaki batorerere emahanya bonyene bwanene bw'ekibori omorokio buya bwa SMASSE na batorere abareka atatu banga.
Dholuo: Nang'ere mag Math na Integrated Sciences e Vihiga County wan g'eyo kuom kade molo ma yore gi SMASSE oyudi piny kuom virtual labs, kendo wan g'eyo gi chike mar ng'ato abich.
Somali: Macalimiinta Xisaabta iyo Sayniska Isku Dhafan ee Gobolka Vihiga waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay fuliyaan qorshayaasha casharada ee lagu sameeyey tababarka SMASSE ee dhawaan ka dhacay oo ku saabsan maktabadaha muuqaalka ah iyo inay tababaraan ugu yaraan saddex macalim oo kale.

English: Over 7000 junior secondary school teachers are being trained to implement virtual laboratories in the CBC system, improving STEM education. Schools should participate in this program for enhanced learning.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya walimu 7000 wa shule za sekondari za chini wanapatiwa mafunzo ya kutekeleza maabara za mtandao katika mfumo wa CBC, kuboresha elimu ya STEM. Shule zinapaswa kushiriki katika programu hii kwa ajili ya kujifunza bora.
Ekegusii: Aborania 7000 abeng'ana banchiengo bwakinye buya bwogogoria bakanisibori buya bwenyabaki bwa CBC, bwokwierere buya buya bwa STEM. Masomo naki goko bagenegia buya buno buya bwanigonere.
Dholuo: Teachers ang'wen 7000 ka oseriembe gi kuom asole ji thuran, kendo ohinga STEM. Sukulu ng'ato nyaka onge gi piny maler gi program ng'eno chibedo mayom.
Somali: In ka badan 7000 macallin oo dugsiga hoose dhexe ah ayaa lagu tababarayaa sidii ay u hirgelin lahaayeen shaybaarro lagu shaqeeyo khadka tooska ah ee nidaamka CBC, si loo hagaajiyo waxbarashada STEM. Dugsiyadu waa inay ka qaybqaataan barnaamijkan si loo xoojiyo barashada.

English: Graduates from technical institutions are encouraged to utilize their skills to create enterprises and solve community problems rather than waiting for employment.
Kiswahili: Mahariri kutoka taasisi za kiufundi wanahamasishwa kutumia ujuzi wao kuanzisha biashara na kutatua matatizo ya jamii badala ya kusubiri ajira.
Ekegusii: Abakire bakiengera bosi bosi babwakire bwihe buya bujange buse omokiri obwakirangire omokinyani naki bwihe buya buria okore obwakirire.
Dholuo: Abira kadhi ka chalo gi dhok, itigo nadi e thuolo manie ni kanyakla ng'ato nyaka tich e higni kod ng'ato.
Somali: Dhalinyarada ka qalin-jabisa machadyada farsamada waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay isticmaalaan xirfadahooda si ay u abuuraan ganacsi iyo xal u helaan dhibaatooyinka bulshadooda halkii ay ka sugi lahaayeen shaqo.

English: The Elimu Yetu Coalition highlights that student unrest reflects deeper issues in Kenya's education system; stakeholders are urged to implement supportive policies and address governance challenges.
Kiswahili: Muungano wa Elimu Yetu unasisitiza kwamba machafuko ya wanafunzi yanaakisi matatizo ya kina katika mfumo wa elimu wa Kenya; wadau wanahimizwa kutekeleza sera zinazounga mkono na kutatua changamoto za uongozi.
Ekegusii: Elimu Yetu Coalition ekorogori naki utagere bw'ogenda nyegoti bweteng'ere bw'eduari naki bwakirete buse. Abakire bosi baragoriwa baki batarogore obw'eregi naki etebere buse.
Dholuo: Elimu Yetu Coalition oyo chwe ni wendo ma ok nyalo mondo oting' gi chalo mar suom ki Kenya; abich manadhi owuon ni nyiso ni yoregi koro nyaka apar wath jomoko kendo nigi kar buok.
Somali: Isbahaysiga Elimu Yetu waxa uu iftiiminayaa in kacdoonka ardaydu uu muujinayo dhibaatooyin qoto dheer oo ku jira nidaamka waxbarashada Kenya; dhinacyada la saameeyay waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay hirgeliyaan siyaasado taageero leh iyo inay ka jawaabaan caqabadaha maamul.

English: Students in Migori are urged to remain disciplined and focused on their studies amid rising school unrest. Parents are encouraged to counsel their children during the half-term recess.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa Migori wanashauriwa kubaki watiifu na kuzingatia masomo yao wakati hali ya vurugu shuleni inaongezeka. Wazazi wanahimizwa kuwashauri watoto wao wakati wa mapumziko ya nusu muhula.
Ekegusii: Abasomi baki Migori baria busi bwiendete omokinyanchani na buya busekerere bwi banyosokore. Ababere baria bagandigana buseke bwagakiyanja abane bwaki boti buya bwakisi bwi omogoti.
Dholuo: Wang' yiengi e Migori ne ong'ere ka kwang' joma ne odhi e pinje yath. Rod which alwore gi joma magi kuom wendo to.
Somali: Ardayda Migori waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay joogteeyaan anshaxa iyo diiradda barashadooda iyadoo ay kordhayaan khilaafaadka iskuulka. Waalidiinta waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay talo siiyaan carruurtooda inta lagu jiro fasaxa baroorduubka.

English: The government will ensure timely disbursement of school capitation funds to facilitate effective planning by principals.
Kiswahili: Serikali itahakikisha utoaji wa fedha za uendeshaji shule kwa wakati ili kurahisisha mipango mzuri na wakuu wa shule.
Ekegusii: Omoige bargi bwakireri buya bwokiragania oboge buya bwokigana bwanikie bwakere buya bwanarimu.
Dholuo: Chuo chadhi ng'ayo chalo matek gi chanda marit kuom sukulu, manok atimre ni wamech tindo ji.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay xaqiijin doontaa in lacagaha taageerada iskuullada si waqtigooda ah loo qaybiyo si ay madaxda iskuulladu u fududeysan karaan qorshayntooda.

English: Universities are preparing for the 2029 admission of Grade 10 learners under the Competency-Based Education system by reforming curricula and enhancing infrastructures.
Kiswahili: Chuo kikuu kinaandaa kuwapokea wanafunzi wa Kidato cha 10 mwaka 2029 chini ya mfumo wa Elimu ya Uwezo kwa kuboresha mitaala na kuboresha miundombinu.
Ekegusii: Masomo mebagecha bw'ogendana ogokore buya 2029 bw'abaire bujenge bw'engene buya bw'ogori bw'echakire amafundi na bw'ogererana bw'avyenga.
Dholuo: Wang' niyou daktari nyaka okonya ng'ato 2029 ma okonyo Grade 10 kuom yore mag Competency-Based Education nyaka onyis londo kendo yore kodgi.
Somali: Jaamacadaha waxay diyaarinayaan qaabilaadda ardayda darajada 10aad sanadka 2029 iyagoo dib u habeynaya manhajyada iyo awoodsiinaya kaabayaasha.

English: 459 Junior Secondary School teachers in Marsabit County are undergoing a three-day ICT integration training to enhance digital competencies. Participation is mandatory for all selected teachers.
Kiswahili: Walimu 459 wa Shule za Sekondari Zaidi katika Kaunti ya Marsabit wanapata mafunzo ya siku tatu ya uunganishaji wa ICT ili kuboresha ujuzi wa kidijitali. Ushiriki ni lazima kwa walimu wote waliochaguliwa.
Ekegusii: Abere 459 abere a Junior Secondary School mu Marsabit County naki gikire genda gichibori tati igege ku genge ya ICT matega obokibori mujumbi. Gekire bwakirori bwaki bui abere abogogoti.
Dholuo: 459 ji kuom jodongo maler e Marsabit County ne ok mwandu joma ji joluongo ICT kwayo e piny mar kanyo kendo to gima mar dongo. Wori e tich moloyo joma ji bende ginyal.
Somali: 459 macallimiin dugsiga dhexe ee Marsabit waxay ku jiraan tababar saddex maalmood ah oo ku saabsan is dhexgalka ICT si loo kordhiyo xirfadaha dijitaalka ah. Ka qaybgalka waa waajib dhammaan macallimiinta la doortay.

English: The Ministry of Education is reviewing school fees due to rising operational costs; all school heads are urged to participate in this review process.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inakagua ada za shule kutokana na kuongezeka kwa gharama za uendeshaji; wakuu wote wa shule wanasisitizwa kushiriki katika mchakato huu wa ukaguzi.
Ekegusii: Omosoko buya buse ogokire ogokire bw’eshule ogokie naki oria bwakire buya bwaki; abere bemo nyansogori buya bwi boki oria buse wi bwaki.
Dholuo: Minisiti mar Dala Owere oyweyo kaka wan gige mag dalu, kwayo oyier ruk gi unyasi; gima higa duto nyaka gin otimo podo oketo e wiye owuon ogend.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa dib u eegaysa lacagaha dugsiyada sababtoo ah kororka kharashka howlgalka; dhammaan madaxda dugsiyada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan habkan dib u eegista.

English: Teachers are encouraged to advocate for a review of school punishment laws to ensure they can administer appropriate disciplinary actions. Parents should ensure tuition fees are paid upon school reopening.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanahimizwa kuunga mkono mapitio ya sheria za adhabu shuleni ili kuhakikisha wanaweza kutoa hatua za nidhamu zinazofaa. Wazazi wanapaswa kuhakikisha ada za shule zinalipwa punde tu shule zinapofunguliwa.
Ekegusii: Abagiri batorere omogori batishe omoshanga buya bw’eng'oche busekeire buya bw’ekigo buya bw’oge. Ababere babere kosi omogori baberete animoka ema shana omosongo.
Dholuo: Walimu wang'iyo pod ng'eyo kuom jopiny ma oketh eyo law mar punishe mar shule, ka ng'eyo gigenduny kadi e yo momiyo. Joma en manyalso gima duong' kuom pok dhak shule.
Somali: Macallimiinta waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay taageeraan dib-u-eegid ku saabsan shuruucda ciqaabta dugsiga si loo hubiyo inay awoodaan inay qaadaan talaabooyin xakameed oo ku haboon. Waalidku waa inay xaqiijiyaan in lacagta dugsiga la bixiyo marka dugsigu dib u furmo.

English: Virtual laboratories for Mathematics and Integrated Science are now available for junior schools to enhance the Competency-Based Education curriculum. Schools are encouraged to utilize these resources.
Kiswahili: Maabara za mtandaoni za Hisabati na Sayansi Mchanganyiko sasa zipo kwa shule za msingi ili kuboresha mtaala wa Elimu Inayozingatia Ujuzi. Shule zinahimizwa kutumia rasilimali hizi.
Ekegusii: Maabara ya mtandao ya Hesabu na Sayansi Mchanganyiko inapatikana sasa kwa shule za msingi ili kuimarisha mtaala wa Elimu Inayolenga Uwezo. Shule zinashauriwa kutumia rasilimali hizi.
Dholuo: Malaika ma virtual mag miyo gi Mathematics kod Integrated Science nyakodi kama ji mang'enyere kachieng' mar Competency-Based Education. Waduong' wate kaluwore kijo kendo udi ma.
Somali: Laboratooriyada kaalmada ee Xisaabta iyo Sayniska Isku Dhafka ah ayaa hadda laga heli karaa iskuulada hoose si loo xoojiyo manhajka Waxbarashada ku Salaysan Aqoonta. Iskuulada waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka faa'iideystaan agabkan.

English: Parents are urged to engage their children in meaningful conversations during the half-term break to promote discipline and address grievances without resorting to violence.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanashauriwa kuwashirikisha watoto wao katika mazungumzo ya maana wakati wa likizo ya katikati ya muhula ili kukuza nidhamu na kushughulikia malalamiko bila kutumia vurugu.
Ekegusii: Ababere banyorire baki abaki bw'ogenda menye naki bunyerere buya bu hamwe naki owire bwanaki mu ndori y'ogenda inyangani bushengori, omokang'ani naki buya oisabaki bw'ogenda bwanaki pisi.
Dholuo: Kokuhola ma ok omer chiango mar nyaka gi chiegni, kendo ni gichunguru mar joma en e lowo chiegni, kendo o winjigo e nyasaye kuom iwuon.
Somali: Waalidiinta waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay carruurtooda la yeeshaan wada hadallo muhiim ah wakhtiga fasaxa barwaaqada si loo xoojiyo anshaxa iyo in laga hadlo cabashooyinka iyada oo aan loo baahnayn rabshad.

English: The partnership between KASNEB and TVET institutions will integrate professional accounting certifications with technical training to improve youth employability. Students are encouraged to enroll in these updated programs.
Kiswahili: Ushirikiano kati ya KASNEB na taasisi za TVET utaunganisha vyeti vya uhasibu wa kitaalamu na mafunzo ya kiufundi ili kuboresha ajira ya vijana. Wanafunzi wanahamasishwa kujiandikisha katika programu hizi zilizopitwa na wakati.
Ekegusii: Shirikiano hagati ya KASNEB na taasisi za TVET litaungana mafunzo ya kitaaluma ya uhasibu na mafunzo ya kiufundi ili kuboresha ajira za vijana. Wanafunzi wanashauriwa kujiandikisha katika mipango hii iliyoandaliwa upya.
Dholuo: KASNEB gi TVET yien jooko ni awinjo konyo yore ma okonyo gi k maseche maricho ka weche ma okonyo mondo nyaka gitim yore. Wuon abich en ng'ato owang' kare timo nyaka en.
Somali: Iskaashiga u dhexeeya KASNEB iyo hay'adaha TVET waxay isku dari doonaan shahaadooyinka xisaabeed ee xirfadeed iyo tababarka farsamada si loo kordhiyo shaqo helida dhalinyarada. Ardayda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay iska diiwaangeliyaan barnaamijyadan la cusboonaysiiyay.

English: School heads are urged to consider transferring students uncomfortable in boarding schools to day schools for better supervision.
Kiswahili: Mashauri yanawasisitiza wakuu wa shule kuzingatia kuwahamisha wanafunzi wanaohisi kutokuwa na raha katika shule za bweni kwenda shule za siku kwa usimamizi bora.
Ekegusii: Abanene bosi bakurugania obokire buya bwosi bwabanigana mu masomo ya bording buya buya borana kosi mu masomo ya bukorori buya kubwa buya bwotenda.
Dholuo: Bwakni bende ng'ato ma ok nyalo ng'anyo kuom wacho dhako, ng'ato e bende e kuom tich ka ok nyalo nyiso wacho ma opogol ng'ato.
Somali: Maamulayaasha dugsiyada waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay tixgeliyaan in ay ardayda aan ku raaxaysanayn dugsiyada jiifka ay u gudbiyaan dugsiyada maalinle ah si loo helo kormeer wanaagsan.

English: All schools and colleges are urged to align their programs with global labor market demands by introducing courses and foreign languages to prepare learners for overseas employment opportunities.
Kiswahili: Shule zote na vyuo vinashauriwa kuoanisha programu zao na mahitaji ya soko la ajira duniani kwa kuanzisha kozi na lugha za kigeni ili kuwanda wanafunzi kwa fursa za ajira za kigeni.
Ekegusii: Naki chigori na masomo naki bendi ogete omokosi bwakire buse naki chire chire na mwaki emochi buya obwaki bwokire omoranga no aborere abogokinyegori.
Dholuo: Bende nyaka seche mag shule mondo gi college dhi kwach nyaka inyal maber ni ng'ato to dhok nind godo e piny. Nyaka idhi lweny mag joma omiyo kwach ndalo gi limo kod nyaka kony dhi nyaka piny.
Somali: Dhammaan iskuulada iyo jaamacadaha waxaa lagu boorinayaa in ay barnaamijkooda la jaanqaadaan baahiyaha suuqa shaqada caalamiga ah iyagoo soo bandhigaya koorsooyin iyo luqadaha shisheeyaha si ardayda loogu diyaariyo fursadaha shaqo ee dibadda.

English: Nyali School is under new leadership focused on restoring its academic reputation; parents, students, and stakeholders are encouraged to support this revitalization effort.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Nyali iko chini ya uongozi mpya unaolenga kurejesha sifa yake ya kitaaluma; wazazi, wanafunzi, na wadau wanatakiwa kuunga mkono juhudi hizi za kufufua.
Ekegusii: Shule ya Nyali iri naki nyasa omokore busibori bwaki; aboki, abanyananye, na abashirikie bano nyaki batigane na omokore bwendo bu.
Dholuo: Nyali School en buodu mar womoko man chit gi dhoge mag kanyakla; mama, wasichana, kod joma jomaach wakiwuok kuom ywaye nyaka wiyu.
Somali: Dugsiga Nyali ayaa hogaamin cusub ku jira oo diiradda saaraya sidii loo soo celin lahaa sumcaddiisa waxbarasho; waalidiinta, ardayda, iyo daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay taageeraan dadaalkan dib-u-soo-celinta.

English: Junior Secondary School learners in Nyamira County are encouraged to pursue Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) pathways as they transition to senior school.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa Shule za Sekondari za Kwanza katika Kaunti ya Nyamira wanahimizwa kufuata mwelekeo wa Sayansi, Teknolojia, Uhandisi, na Hisabati (STEM) wanapohamia shule za sekondari.
Ekegusii: Abakizi b’abasomeri b’igae Junior Secondary School mu Nyamira County baria batorera kwang’ania maato ya Science, Technology, Engineering, na Mathematics (STEM) ari na bosiye batoroka buya b’igae senia.
Dholuo: Kanyamfuna e Nyamira County nochok gi weche kuom ninde mag nake, Technology, Engineering, kod Mathematics (STEM) nyaka dongo kuom ranyisi senior school.
Somali: Ardayda dugsiga sare ee Nyamira County waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay raadiyaan waddooyinka Cilmiga, Teknoolajiyadda, Injineernimada, iyo Xisaabta (STEM) marka ay u gudbaan dugsiga sare.

English: CEMASTEA is launching a virtual labs training program for 7,000 junior school teachers to enhance STEM education. Teachers will receive training on digital simulation tools for practical lessons.
Kiswahili: CEMASTEA inazindua programu ya mafunzo ya maabara mtandaoni kwa walimu 7,000 wa shule za msingi ili kuboresha elimu ya STEM. Walimu watapata mafunzo kuhusu zana za kuunda mifano ya kidijitali kwa ajili ya masomo ya vitendo.
Ekegusii: CEMASTEA ikirorirete omogigo wa masweta ogokire buya 7,000 buya bwakoreri bujunior buya bwasemyekeri bwas STEM. Bwakoreri buya batoria omogigo omokirigori ogokire bwanene bwakinyasa bwabwirane.
Dholuo: CEMASTEA ikwero program mar chon gi wacho labu ma okel 7,000 jofunji mang'eny kuom nyiso STEM. Jofunji bende ni wapok wacho konyo digital kuom buo ma okel.
Somali: CEMASTEA ayaa bilaabay barnaamij tababar oo labo-dhisan ah oo loogu talagalay 7,000 macallin oo dugsiga hoose ah si kor loogu qaado waxbarashada STEM. Macallimiinta waxay heli doonaan tababar ku saabsan qalabka shabakad-dijital ah ee casharro falanqayn ah.

English: Bandari Maritime Academy is offering structured French language training for maritime cadets in partnership with Alliance Française de Mombasa to improve job competitiveness.
Kiswahili: Bandari Maritime Academy inatoa mafunzo ya lugha ya Kifaransa yaliyoandaliwa kwa wahitimu wa baharini kwa ushirikiano na Alliance Française de Mombasa ili kuboresha ushindani wa ajira.
Ekegusii: Bandari Maritime Academy ikerere bwogori bwa ekegero bwekirigana na Alliance Française de Mombasa buya mwabwaki tugia buya na obwatekeri bwomoni.
Dholuo: Bandari Maritime Academy noyiero ka French ma nyalo gi kinde duto mar maritime cadets kod Alliance Française de Mombasa ka oterere ka ikwongo mar joma otingo.
Somali: Akadeemiyada Badda Bandari waxay bixineysaa tababar habaysan oo ku saabsan luqadda Faransiiska ee ardayda badda, iyadoo la kaashaneysa Alliance Française de Mombasa si loo kordhiyo tartanka shaqada.

English: Bogesaka D.O.K. Primary and Junior Secondary School in Kisii County is set to undergo a Sh62 million digital upgrade to enhance learning facilities.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Msingi na Sekondari ya Kijamii ya Bogesaka D.O.K. katika Kaunti ya Kisii itapata maboresho ya kidijitali ya Sh62 milioni kuboresha vifaa vya kujifunzia.
Ekegusii: Bogesaka D.O.K. Primary na Junior Secondary School mugirango Kisii County igena omogori ogotagete wa Sh62 million okoragania obokore buse.
Dholuo: Bogesaka D.O.K. Primary ne Junior Secondary School e Kisii County timo kuom shr62 million moyo mar digital ma okonyo nyaka muthuri gi joma ler.
Somali: Iskuulka D.O.K. ee Bogesaka ee Gobolka Kisii ayaa lagu wadaa inuu qaato horumar dijital ah oo lagu kicinayo 62 milyan shilin si loo xoojiyo fursadaha waxbarashada.

English: The government is forming a multi-sectoral team to address school unrest. Parents, teachers, students, and other stakeholders are urged to participate actively in this initiative.
Kiswahili: Serikali inaunda timu ya sekta nyingi kushughulikia machafuko shuleni. Wazazi, walimu, wanafunzi, na washikadau wengine wanahimizwa kushiriki kwa shughuli hii.
Ekegusii: Abarekire chire naki omokireri mosi ogenda kukirekia oborori bwachire bu chikoro. Ababere, abarimu, abaki, naki abashinde bosi barigana koborere omogoti ogwiki omosomi onyo.
Dholuo: Gavumenti nyal ochiemo grupo mag muthurwa to no ng'ato ni gidhi kuom gigni ode. Pacho, teachers, students, kod joma nyalo chuth ghi omer to gigo iye to ok nyal marach kanyoni.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay samaynaysaa koox ka badan hal waax si ay u xalliso xasilooni darro dugsiyada. Waalidiinta, macalimiinta, ardayda, iyo dhinacyada kale ayaa lagu boorinayaa inay si firfircoon uga qayb qaataan dadaalkan.

English: The government has allocated Sh 784 billion to the education sector for the 2026/2027 Financial Year, ensuring enhanced quality education across all counties.
Kiswahili: Serikali imetenga Sh 784 bilioni kwa sekta ya elimu kwa Mwaka wa Fedha wa 2026/2027, kuhakikisha ubora wa elimu unaboreshwa katika kaunti zote.
Ekegusii: Abagere bobi na Sh 784 billion bwi gotoreka omogori buya bu soronchori 2026/2027, bwana bobi naki bantu naki chire bw'ekegusii.
Dholuo: Government owinjore Sh 784 billion to sekondari mar dudi ng'ato ma 2026/2027, kuom miyo ma okelo to jopuonj gwan gi nyaka.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay qoondeysay 784 bilyan oo shillin ah qaybta waxbarashada sanadka maaliyadeed 2026/2027, si loo hubiyo tayada waxbarashada oo la hagaajiyo dhammaan degmooyinka.

English: New classrooms, an administration block, and a dormitory have been commissioned in Marakwet West to improve educational infrastructure. Students and schools are encouraged to utilize these facilities.
Kiswahili: Madarasa mapya, jengo la utawala, na hostel zimeanzishwa Marakwet West kuboresha miundombinu ya elimu. Wanafunzi na shule wanahimizwa kutumia vifaa hivi.
Ekegusii: Akaandori atiri, kiihati chiri, na oganda buya borwa bwenyige Marakwet West kugana tichaki kwomokiriri. Abana na masonga banchiriri bokiakia boti.
Dholuo: Tich mar imbongo, block mar pinje, gi dormitory ne en jowadgi e Marakwet West kuom nyiso chike mang'eny mar thuolo. Jomoko gi shule nyal duto nyaka golo kachok e dhi.
Somali: Fasal cusub, xafiiska maamulka, iyo hoy ayaa lagu daahfuray Marakwet West si loo hagaajiyo kaabayaasha waxbarashada. Ardayda iyo dugsiyada waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka faa'iidaystaan fursadahaan.

English: The Homa Bay County program promotes menstrual hygiene and supports girls' education, reducing dropout rates. Parents and community members are encouraged to support this initiative.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Kaunti ya Homa Bay unakuza usafi wa hedhi na kusaidia elimu ya wasichana, ukipunguza kiwango cha wanafunzi wanaoacha shule. Wazazi na wanajamii wanahimizwa kuunga mkono juhudi hii.
Ekegusii: Purogiramu y'Obwaki Homa Bay inagaisa obwakire bw'amasalu na ikire nakiya bwaki bw'abarori, ikirang'a oria ikwania omogaka. Ababere hamwe n'abakura bakore na nibwaki bu rurimi uru.
Dholuo: Program mar Homa Bay County en kod nyiso miyo magi, kendo ogendini gi chiegni mar wasich. Tich gi gima ji ochung' yie ni timbe di ahero.
Somali: Barnaamijka Gobolka Homa Bay wuxuu dhiirrigelinayaa nadaafadda caadada wuxuuna taageeraa waxbarashada gabdhaha, isagoo yareynaya heerarka ka bixitaanka. Waalidiinta iyo xubnaha bulshada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay taageeraan hindisahan.

English: The government will deliver five school buses to Busia County schools before the end of the financial year to alleviate transport challenges.
Kiswahili: Serikali itatoa mabasi matano ya shule kwa shule za Kaunti ya Busia kabla ya kumalizika kwa mwaka wa fedha ili kupunguza changamoto za usafiri.
Ekegusii: Omelekera ogwenda iria itano y'ogokore buseke naki Busia buseke busembe kera omokosi omokire bw'ekibungirwa.
Dholuo: Government owuon kendo bende chieng' go sibu kendo chombori manie Busia County ng'we chon e yo ma ok nyal mor.
Somali: Dowladda waxay bixin doontaa shan bas oo iskuul ah oo loogu talagalay dugsiyada Gobolka Busia ka hor dhammaadka sanadka maaliyadeed si loo fududeeyo caqabadaha gaadiidka.

English: Kirinyaga County is providing free learning materials, furniture, and uniforms to all 201 ECDE centres. Parents are encouraged to ensure their children benefit from this initiative.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kirinyaga inatoa vifaa vya kujifunzia bure, samani, na mavazi kwa vituo vyote 201 vya ECDE. Wazazi wanahimizwa kuhakikisha watoto wao wanapata faida kutokana na mpango huu.
Ekegusii: Ekerinyaga County ikinyang'ana ibukiso buya, bwenyere, naki naki bwaki buya ematwere ya 201 ECDE. Ababire bateganjo batariri inyang'ora abana babo baria boki naki buya.
Dholuo: Kirinyaga County oting'ore nyasa matek, piny, gi mawuon kendo konyo duto kuom 201 ECDE centres. Wuon mag gi duto ng'ato otemore koro chike ng'ato pod lwenye owuon eyo.
Somali: Degmada Kirinyaga ayaa bixineysa agab waxbarasho, alaab guri, iyo dhar iskuul oo bilaash ah dhammaan 201 xarumood ee ECDE. Waalidka waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay xaqiijiyaan in carruurtooda ka faa'iidaystaan fursaddan.

English: Bursary application forms for tertiary institutions will be available after funds are released. Secondary school bursary funds of Sh35 million for 2025/2026 are now ready for disbursement.
Kiswahili: Fomu za maombi ya bursari kwa vyuo vikuu zitapatikana baada ya fedha kutolewa. Fedha za bursari za shule za sekondari za Sh35 milioni kwa mwaka wa masomo 2025/2026 sasa ziko tayari kutolewa.
Ekegusii: Fomu z'ekirang'o z'ubugene bwa bwengi ziri mooki bw'ose omokeri bw'inyang'ori. Ebirang'o b'ekirang'o bwa bwengi bwegana Sh35 million buhoya bw'2025/2026 zishenye bw'ogokore.
Dholuo: Fomu ma wachung' giriyu moro kendo ok owinjore mag nyiombo piny e kendo binga godo. Fund mag bursary ma yore kama Sh35 million mar mwaka 2025/2026 nigi eyo mar konyo.
Somali: Foomamka codsiga deeqda waxbarasho ee jaamacadaha ayaa diyaar noqon doona markii funds la sii daayo. Deeqda waxbarasho ee iskuulada dhexe oo ah Sh35 milyan sanadka 2025/2026 ayaa hadda diyaar ah in la qaybiyo.

English: The NextGen.Ke Youth Employment Programme is launching a pilot phase from July to December 2026, targeting 500 graduates for internship placements with private sector companies.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Ajira wa NextGen.Ke unanza kipindi cha majaribio kuanzia Julai hadi Desemba 2026, ukilenga wahitimu 500 kwa nafasi za mafunzo katika kampuni za sekta binafsi.
Ekegusii: NextGen.Ke Omoigwa Oria Okwomwaki ikinyobwa omogori buya buya buya 2026, gookiane 500 oria bosi bwagashana mbochani naki bosi buja bweri.
Dholuo: NextGen.Ke Nyaka Maki Program ikwong' gi pilot phase mula chamo July to December 2026, oket gi 500 graduatu kuom internship kod pi joma okel.
Somali: Barnaamijka Shaqaaleynta Dhallinyarada NextGen.Ke waxa uu bilaabayaa wajigiisii tijaabada bilowga ahayd laga bilaabo July ilaa December 2026, isagoo bartilmaameedsanaya 500 arday oo jaamacadeed ah si loogu meeleeyo tababar nololeed shirkadaha gaarka ah.

English: The Vihiga County Assembly is advocating for increased budgetary support and policy reforms for ECDE teachers and Vocational Training Centres. Stakeholders are encouraged to engage in these discussions.
Kiswahili: Bunge la Kaunti ya Vihiga linahimiza kuongezwa kwa msaada wa bajeti na mabadiliko ya sera kwa walimu wa ECDE na Makarabati ya Ufundi. Wadau wanahimiza kushiriki katika majadiliano haya.
Ekegusii: Abagaka b'amasani b'County ya Vihiga baragirira kutegereja buya bw'emikoro n'ekikere ky'emacende ya barimu ba ECDE na masomabere eg'egoti. Abakiongosi barakoraneka mu nashilanga aya.
Dholuo: Vihiga County Assembly en nyal gi ombulu mar budget kendo pinyik angi gi ma ne ECDE teachers kod Vocational Training Centres. Kanyalo gima omiyo gima en chuny gi piny mar iweyo.
Somali: Golaha Degmada Vihiga wuxuu ku baaqayaa in la kordhiyo taageerada miisaaniyadda iyo isbeddelada siyaasadda ee macalimiinta ECDE iyo Xarumaha Tababbarka Farsamada. Dulqaadayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan doodahan.

English: Trans Nzoia County is advocating for the integration of disaster preparedness and emergency response training into the Competency Based Education curriculum. Schools are encouraged to prepare learners with these essential skills.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia inasisitiza kuingizwa kwa mafunzo ya maandalizi ya majanga na majibu ya dharura katika mtaala wa Elimu Inayolengwa na Uwezo. Shule zinahamasishwa kuandaa wanafunzi na ujuzi huu muhimu.
Ekegusii: Trans Nzoia Nakiere ikirekania omokiriri bw’ogori bw’ekomokire na bendera buya buoria bw’ogori bw’ekomokire mu bwogirori bw’egikoro. Abakiri bateganire abaki bano hamwe na eng’eri iri nyaboke.
Dholuo: Trans Nzoia County en gi neno kuom nyaka ber thum mar yieny mar yieny kuom njiedhi mag to. Masomo en ng'ato ema ochung' gi nyaka alana kata ma neno ni.
