Somali: Dowladda Degmada Trans Nzoia waxay taageeraysaa in isku dhafka diyaarinta masiibooyinka iyo tababarka ka jawaabidda degdega ah lagu daro manhajka Waxbarashada Ku Salaysan Aqoonta. Dugsiyada waxaa lagu boorinayaa in ay ardayda ku diyaariyan xirfadaha muhiimka ah ee tan.

English: Uzima University remains accredited and recognized by relevant authorities. The institution has undergone major reforms and now meets the current medical training standards.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Uzima kinaendelea kuthibitishwa na kutambuliwa na mamlaka husika. Taasisi imepitia mabadiliko makubwa na sasa inakidhi viwango vya sasa vya mafunzo ya udaktari.
Ekegusii: Uzima University ikiri ogendekere na naki ite borori naki agorori. Obwakire bwakire bwang'endi naki bwaki ikinyanja bwanene na buya naki buya daki otirenda bwaki.
Dholuo: Uzima University awon gi accreditation kod ngeyo koro ma okel gi tugo mag jomoko. Kanyalo mago ni inyonni e piny gitalo, si timo pupo gi chike mag inye kanyeny.
Somali: Jaamacadda Uzima weli waa la aqoonsan yahay oo ay ansixiyeen hay'adaha khuseeya. Hay'adda ayaa samaysay dib-u-habeyn weyn waxayna hadda buuxisaa heerarka tababarka caafimaadka ee maanta.

English: Kwale County has disbursed Sh400 million in bursaries to support students from vulnerable backgrounds. Parents and students are encouraged to apply for these funds to enhance educational opportunities.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kwale imepewa Sh400 milioni kwa ajili ya ufadhili wa masomo kusaidia wanafunzi kutoka katika familia zenye hali ngumu. Wazazi na wanafunzi wanahimizwa kuomba fedha hizi ili kuboresha fursa za elimu.
Ekegusii: Kaunti ya Kwale ikwanga marokero Sh400 miriondori mu bursa zosiore buya buera buigire aborere bwakirori. Abakire na aborere baryetie nyarenda bwena burchangwaki bwokwanzi buya bwigire bwosiboki.
Dholuo: Kwale County nyalo yore Sh400 million kuom bursary kueny dho bura ma tolak. Piny magi yotore gi dhoo ma ok nyalo tich, to puodhi no ng'eyo kuom golo ma dudi.
Somali: Degmada Kwale waxay bixisay Sh400 milyan oo lacag bursi ah si ay u taageeraan ardayda ka soo jeeda asalka danyarta ah. Waalidiinta iyo ardayda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay codsadaan lacagahan si ay u korodhsadaan fursadaha waxbarasho.

English: All scholars and stakeholders are urged to implement research findings from the 14th TVET and Interdisciplinary International Conference to drive innovation and improve living standards.
Kiswahili: Wanasayansi na wadau wote wanashauriwa kutekeleza matokeo ya utafiti kutoka Mkutano wa 14 wa TVET na Utafiti wa Kiraia wa Kimataifa ili kuhamasisha ubunifu na kuboresha viwango vya maisha.
Ekegusii: Abakinyaki nakiere baabogoti batorire boberi naki baki nkienda yaki 14th TVET na Interdisciplinary International Conference buya na ogotirie yani okogorie obokiri naki boti.
Dholuo: Wang'ni nding' yie koro ng'iyo kaka chako gibiro wach e 14th TVET gi Interdisciplinary International Conference piny e tich mar wahiga gi nigi gi tich mokuongo gi tich mar tho.
Somali: Dhammaan aqoonyahannada iyo daneeyayaasha waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay hirgeliyaan natiijooyinka cilmi-baarista ee shirka 14-aad ee TVET iyo Kulanka Caalamiga ah ee Ka-Xirfadaha si kor loogu qaado hal-abuurka iyo tayaynta heerarka nolosha.

English: School principals in Makueni County are urged to remain vigilant and release students to go home if they request, to prevent unrest and property destruction.
Kiswahili: Makaribu wa shule katika Kaunti ya Makueni wanatakiwa kuwa makini na kuwaachilia wanafunzi waondoke nyumbani wanapohitaji, ili kuzuia machafuko na uharibifu wa mali.
Ekegusii: Abaniani bategati b'eshule mw'ogoti Makueni barengere okabere ogendi na batware abana kw'ibaki bw'ogenda, nta bwaku bwekegere okorere naki k'eshatu na buwkire bw'echienyi.
Dholuo: Omundhori kanyakulala e Makueni County wan gi bando, mitz quch ng'ato gi ng'ato ka waliyo, mana not, koro udi gi chula ma ok wacho ka ogend.
Somali: Madaxda dugsiyada ee Gobolka Makueni waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay taxaddar muujiyaan oo ay ardayda oggolaadaan inay guryahooda tagaan haddii ay codsadaan, si loo xakameeyo kacdoon iyo burbur hantiyeed.

English: The strike by Early Childhood Development Education (ECDE) teachers in Murang'a County is called off following an agreement on a new salary and benefits package, effective July 2026.
Kiswahili: Mgomo wa walimu wa Elimu ya Maendeleo ya Utoto wa Awali (ECDE) katika Kaunti ya Murang'a umesitishwa baada ya makubaliano kuhusu pakiti mpya ya mshahara na manufaa, itakayoanza kutumika Julai 2026.
Ekegusii: Ateka omokigori buse na abarigori aborori buse mu Murang'a omogeni bosi nakiagwa bwigana bu bendi bwakire, ogwena kuijonge mwakiri 2026.
Dholuo: Kenyang' e kech gi tich mar Early Childhood Development Education (ECDE) ma Murang'a County ni nigi piny, to iliekgi maler mar piny gi ng'ato ma ok wacho, nikech piny nochung' July 2026.
Somali: Burburinta macallimiinta Waxbarashada Hore ee Carruurta (ECDE) ee Gobolka Murang'a ayaa la joojiyay kaddib markii la gaaray heshiis ku saabsan mushahar cusub iyo xirmooyin faa'iidooyin, oo dhaqangalaya bishii July 2026.

English: Over 2,500 students from needy families in Thika have received Sh17.7 million in bursaries for university, college, and TVET studies. Ensure your application for support is submitted on time.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya wanafunzi 2,500 kutoka kwa familia zenye mahitaji Thika wameshiriki kwenye ufadhili wa Sh17.7 milioni kwa masomo ya chuo kikuu, chuo, na masomo ya ufundi. Hakikisha maombi yako ya msaada yanawasilishwa kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: Abana 2,500 b’aki omong’era b’ogekore omogega mu Thika baria bagogori 17.7 milioni bukiriri bw’akiboria, esera, naki TVET. Naki okuengi omokoro bwobokiri bwogokore bukhana.
Dholuo: Kak 2,500 maono nyaka kuom ji tinde ka Thika en yamo Sh17.7 triệu mondo abiro teko kwom bursaries e chiegni, koleji, kendo TVET. Jegu nyaka goyo joma wacho ma en ng'ato joma ruto makwongo gi chunyu.
Somali: In ka badan 2,500 arday oo ka soo jeeda qoysaska dakhligoodu hooseeyo ee Thika ayaa helay Sh17.7 milyan oo buundooyin ah oo loogu talagalay waxbarashada jaamacadaha, koleyga, iyo TVET. Hubi in codsigaaga taageero la soo gudbiyo waqti.

English: All secondary schools in Murang'a County that suspended learning due to unrest must reopen and ensure students report back by Monday, June 15.
Kiswahili: Shule za sekondari zote katika Kaunti ya Murang'a zilizositisha masomo kwa sababu ya machafuko lazima zifunguliwe na kuhakikisha wanafunzi wanaripoti tarehe Jumatatu, Juni 15.
Ekegusii: Masomo menye oria atenge ikireri buya buya mu Murang'a County naki buya babatende buya buya omokireri abaki naki Bung'ia, Yuni 15.
Dholuo: Dhi nyaka sekondari onywolo e Murang'a konyu no duto ma otimie ka lweny, nyaka omiyo ma students wachwe konyo ng'weny, Juma, Kony 15.
Somali: Dhammaan dugsiyada sare ee ka jira Gobolka Murang’a oo joojiyay waxbarashada sababo la xiriira xasilooni darrada waa in ay dib u furmaan oo ay xaqiijiyaan in ardaydu ka soo noqonayaan Isniinta, Juun 15.

English: The government has proposed an allocation of Sh784.5 billion to the education sector for the 2026/27 national budget, impacting schools, teachers, and students across Kenya.
Kiswahili: Serikali imependekeza kutenga Sh784.5 bilioni kwa sekta ya elimu katika bajeti ya kitaifa ya 2026/27, ikihusisha shule, walimu, na wanafunzi kote Kenya.
Ekegusii: Abangenyi ba serikali bakiigwa eng'ere Sh784.5 billion buya buseke bugevwaki mu chenda chibwaki cha 2026/27, bacheka bakenye, baria, na abaki bwaki mu Kenya.
Dholuo: Kagwa owuon piny awinjo kachoko Sh784.5 bilioni kuok education, ma ok nyalo wacho yore chike mag 2026/27. Okwang' pacho e shule, walimu, kod jaluo piny Kenya.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay soo jeedisay in Sh784.5 bilyan loo qoondeeyo qaybta waxbarashada ee miisaaniyadda qaranka sanadka 2026/27, taasoo saameyn doonta dugsiyada, macalimiinta, iyo ardayda guud ahaan Kenya.

English: Students from 17 schools in Murang'a East showcased their talents in music and performance during the Kenya Music Festival at Technology Primary School.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi kutoka shule 17 katika Murang'a Mashariki walionyesha talanta zao katika muziki na uchezaji wakati wa Tamasha la Muziki la Kenya katika Shule ya Msingi ya Technology.
Ekegusii: Abagaka baki 17 buuri bu Murang'a East bavamirire obori bwabo mubwakire bwomwaki naki obwakire mwaki bw'ekegusii ku Technology Primary School.
Dholuo: Makaranda 17 kuom Wuodhi Murang'a East muonji twak osiepna e piny mar musik kod jendruok e Kenya Music Festival ka Technology Primary School.
Somali: Ardayda 17 dugsiyada ee Murang'a East ayaa muujiyay kartidooda muusikada iyo bandhigga waqtiga Fanka Muusiga Kenya ee Dugsiga Hoose ee Teknoolojiyadda.

English: Seventeen schools from Murang'a East Sub-County participated in the Kenya Music Festival at Technology Primary School, showcasing talents in various categories.
Kiswahili: Shule kumi na saba kutoka Kaunti Ndogo ya Murang'a Mashariki zilihudhuria Tamasha la Muziki la Kenya katika Shule ya Msingi ya Technology, zikionyesha talanta katika makundi mbalimbali.
Ekegusii: Masomo abiri na mwaki naki Murang'a East Sub-County bagana na Kenya Music Festival ikidoka Technology Primary School, buria bwokire ebichandori bwokarire.
Dholuo: Wagolol maber oromo goyo ahinya watimo piny Murang'a East Sub-County nyaka nigi Kenya Music Festival e Technology Primary School, wacho ma nyalo nyalieng' e kuon kategori marach.
Somali: Seventeen iskuul oo ka tirsan Degmada Murang'a Bari ayaa ka qeyb galay Xafladda Muusiga Kenya ee ka dhacday Iskuulka Hore ee Teknoolojiyadda, iyagoo soo bandhigay kartidooda qeybaha kala duwan.

English: Eighty-seven Grade Four learners from Kaimosi Junior School visited Vihiga County offices to enhance their understanding of governance and leadership.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi arobaini na saba wa darasa la nne kutoka Shule ya Msingi ya Kaimosi walitembelea ofisi za Kaunti ya Vihiga ili kuboresha uelewa wao kuhusu utawala na uongozi.
Ekegusii: Abakane abaki 87 b'abarabaki n'echikoro cha Kaimosi Junior baretete bw'amasoko g'ekati ya Vihiga ki'ogotagani oreka naki obonchesabaki.
Dholuo: Abich 87 lerner ma okinyi Grade Four man Moko ka Kaimosi Junior School nyalor Vihiga County offices mondo nyal gi tich mahonjo kuom governance and leadership.
Somali: 87 arday oo ka tirsan fasalka afaraad ee Dugsiga Kaimosi Junior ayaa booqday xafiisyada gobolka Vihiga si ay u kordhiyaan fahamkooda ku saabsan maamulka iyo hogaaminta.

English: The Technical and Vocational Education and Training Authority (TVETA) has conducted a quality audit of 354 TVET institutions; stakeholders are urged to address identified gaps in trainer licensing and infrastructure.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Elimu ya Ufundi na Mafunzo ya Kitaalamu (TVETA) imefanya ukaguzi wa ubora katika Taasisi 354 za TVET; wadau wanashauriwa kushughulikia mapengo yaliyoainishwa katika upatikanaji wa leseni za wakufunzi na miundombinu.
Ekegusii: Abwaki buya bwogori bwakageria bwakabere 354 oria TBETA; abanya businda barigho batarakire ebikoro ebikiri bwokiri bwasubani ne bwokire bwokwereka.
Dholuo: Technical ne Vocational Education and Training Authority (TVETA) orekidie sayans maler mag 354 TVET institutions; gi chwero ni magwi chieko ng'ato konyruok wohere kod kanyal.
Somali: Hay'adda Qiimaynta Tacliinta Farsamada iyo Tababarka (TVETA) waxay samaysay kormeer tayadeed oo ku saabsan 354 hay'adood oo TVET ah; dhinacyada danaynaya waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay wax ka qabtaan farqiyada la ogaaday ee ku saabsan ruqsadaha macalimiinta iyo kaabayaasha.

English: Quality Assurance and Standards Officers (QASOs) are urged to enhance STEM education and effectively implement the Competency-Based Curriculum (CBC) in schools.
Kiswahili: Maafisa wa Uthibitisho wa Ubora na Viwango (QASOs) wanashauriwa kuboresha elimu ya STEM na kutekeleza kwa ufanisi Mtaala wa Kulingana na Uwezo (CBC) shuleni.
Ekegusii: Abateka batarabwanire buya bwetenda STEM na biongereye okore oseria ogwendo ogukang'ana (Competency-Based Curriculum, CBC) mu makenga.
Dholuo: Okwach gi mago ma ohero Quality Assurance and Standards Officers (QASOs) to ofeche STEM education ka to implement Curriculum otemo-gi (CBC) buo.
Somali: Shaqaalaha Hubinta Tayada iyo Heerarka (QASOs) waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay kor u qaadaan waxbarashada STEM oo si wax ku ool ah ugu fuliyaan Manhajka Ku Saleysan Aqoonta (CBC) dugsiyada.

English: Kisii University encourages students and faculty to adopt a borderless model of education and utilize artificial intelligence as a collaborative tool for meaningful solutions to global challenges.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Kisii kina himiza wanafunzi na wahadhiri kutumia mfano wa elimu usio na mipaka na kutumia akili bandia kama chombo cha ushirikiano kutafuta suluhisho za maana kwa changamoto za kimataifa.
Ekegusii: Kisii University inagwantia abanyamaka na abere buse ogendene bwaki obwakirorere buurogana na buse ogendene bwaki obwakirorere bwokigori bwabere kwa gisomo naki ataka bwokutibori miana buse bwanorere bwaki bwenyene obashindani na kisukuma.
Dholuo: Kisii University nyal koro wanyalo timo korizo mar thuolo gi wath, kuom itiyo artificial intelligence lokore mag pondo nyaka opogore chiwruok mar dunia.
Somali: Jaamacadda Kisii waxay ku dhiirigelinaysaa ardayda iyo macallimiinta inay qaataan qaab waxbarasho aan xuduud lahayn oo ay isticmaalaan sirdoonka macmalka ah sidii aalad iskaashi ah oo lagu heli karo xalal micno leh oo waajahaya caqabadaha aduunka.

English: The Centre for Mathematics, Science and Technology Education in Africa (CEMASTEA) has trained teachers in using AI for lesson planning and enhancing classroom instruction. All educators are encouraged to integrate AI into their teaching practices for improved learning outcomes.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Elimu ya Hisabati, Sayansi na Teknolojia barani Afrika (CEMASTEA) kimewafundisha walimu kutumia AI katika kupanga masomo na kuboresha ufundishaji darasani. Walimu wote wanahimizwa kuingiza AI katika mbinu zao za ufundishaji ili kuboresha matokeo ya kujifunza.
Ekegusii: CEMASTEA oikorei aborere buya bwire buya buya na AI okoboka aborere bamporwa na oregeti. Ogoteganga aborere bose bendo banye AI mu naki bosia buya buya.
Dholuo: CEMASTEA eyo nyinge ni itieno mawuon nyasaye ka lweny e yoreyo kuom AI mar mambo matindo kendo kumando. Wakati wane yo jachien mwandu ok inuok AI ka tich e nyaguma mar dimbe ma gira.
Somali: Xarunta Waxbarashada Xisaabta, Sayniska iyo Teknoolojiyada Afrika (CEMASTEA) waxay tababartay macallimiinta sida loo isticmaalo AI qorsheynta casharada iyo kor u qaadida waxbarashada fasalka. Dhamaan macallimiinta waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa in ay ku darayaan AI hababkooda waxbarasho si kor loogu qaado natiijooyinka waxbarasho.

English: All youth in Elgeyo Marakwet and Uasin Gishu Counties are encouraged to enroll in nearby vocational training centers. Chiefs and Assistant Chiefs will assist in identifying eligible candidates.
Kiswahili: Vijana wote katika Kaunti za Elgeyo Marakwet na Uasin Gishu wanahimizwa kujiandikisha katika vituo vya mafunzo ya ufundi vya karibu. Wajumbe wa kata na Wasaidizi wa Wajumbe wa kata watasaidia katika kutambua wagombea wanaofaa.
Ekegusii: Abagaka bosi baki Elgeyo Marakwet na Uasin Gishu barianyekire kuchenda mushene burokia bwaki buitu. Abakere na Abakere batarai baria batarikire banchimbaki burokia.
Dholuo: Ng'ato gi romo kod nyisigeg mar Elgeyo Marakwet kod Uasin Gishu owachoni kuom nyaka bende en tieke mar joma to joge konyo. Jochiek ne ok nyiso ni nyasach nigi joma owa.
Somali: Dhallinyarada ku nool Elgeyo Marakwet iyo Uasin Gishu waxa lagu boorinayaa inay Iskuulada Tababarka Xirfadeed ee ku dhow iska diiwaangeliyaan. Maayirrada iyo Kaaliyayaasha Maayirrada ayaa ka caawin doona in la helo dadka u qalma.

English: The education sector has been allocated Sh784.5 billion in the 2026/27 budget to support teachers, learners, and education infrastructure.
Kiswahili: Sekta ya elimu imepewa shilingi bilioni 784.5 katika bajeti ya mwaka 2026/27 kusaidia walimu, wanafunzi, na miundombinu ya elimu.
Ekegusii: Makiango yamagani omokore omosangu Sh784.5 bilioni mu budget ya 2026/27 gochamokirenda aborangi, abenge, na oboranya bwakianga.
Dholuo: Kagendo ma elimu omer kuome Sh784.5 bilioni e 2026/27 budget mana otieno jende, jochiemo, kod ng'ato mar elimu.
Somali: Wasaaradda waxbarashada waxaa loogu talagalay 784.5 bilyan Shillings miisaaniyadda 2026/27 si ay u taageerto macallimiinta, ardayda, iyo kaabayaasha waxbarashada.

English: All county health facilities must secure valid licenses from the Kenya Medical Practitioners and Dentists Council by July 31 to maintain eligibility for Social Health Authority funding.
Kiswahili: Vituo vyote vya afya vya kaunti lazima vipate leseni halali kutoka kwa Baraza la Madaktari na Wanafunzi wa Kinyago la Kenya kabla ya Julai 31 ili kuendelea kupata ufadhili kutoka Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii.
Ekegusii: Bwakire buzera bw’abakoma na bwere buya bwebaki ekibanja kyenyi buya buore buya buuganda kera bw'ekega Kenya Medical Practitioners and Dentists Council omokiri wa Nyanya 31 ore buya bw’ogotegera kutegania mfekincho ya Social Health Authority.
Dholuo: Ng’ato chiegni machon e chiemo mar chieng' ochiek gima weche to bedo ni wachit gi ndari mar Kenya Medical Practitioners and Dentists Council nyaka ok Nyasaye 31, ng’ato piny ok nyalo yore gi funding mar Social Health Authority.
Somali: Dhammaan xarumaha caafimaadka ee gobolka waa inay helaan rukhsadaha saxda ah ee ka yimaada Golaha Dhaqtarada iyo Ilkaha Kenya kahor July 31 si ay u sii haystaan xaqa maalgelinta Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada.

English: All stakeholders in Kenya's education and innovation sectors are encouraged to invest in research, technical skills, and entrepreneurship to support the nation's economic growth and development.
Kiswahili: Wadau wote katika sekta za elimu na ubunifu nchini Kenya wanakaribishwa kuwekeza katika utafiti, ujuzi wa kifundi, na ujasiriamali ili kusaidia ukuaji na maendeleo ya uchumi wa taifa.
Ekegusii: Abakire baria bano wakwe ghana buya bwokire obokiri, nakiobori, na bwakire buya mu Kenya betera oborishekirane mu bushongotoni, obwaki bwananiro na bwokiri orokiri bwabere bwomogori bwai.
Dholuo: Ng'wech jopiny nyaka yien e kañg' g'ogo gi tich, buche, gi joma okonyo nyaka nyaka chopo maler, kod mamoko nyaka lende chike e kor kanyan gi tich ma g'weyo.
Somali: Dhammaan daneeyayaasha qaybaha waxbarashada iyo hal-abuurka ee Kenya waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay maal gashadaan cilmi baaris, xirfadaha farsamada, iyo ganacsiga si ay u taageeraan koritaanka iyo horumarka dhaqaalaha dalka.

English: Murang'a County ECDE teachers are urged to sign a new employment contract for salary increments beginning July 1, 2026. Accept the agreement to resume normal learning activities.
Kiswahili: Walimu wa ECDE wa Kaunti ya Murang'a wanahimizwa kusaini mkataba mpya wa ajira kwa ajili ya kuongezeka kwa mishahara kuanzia Julai 1, 2026. Kubali makubaliano ili urejeleze shughuli za kujifunza kama kawaida.
Ekegusii: Abarete buya bwa ECDE bw'egena Murang'a batarakire ikireona chire gaki ikiroriore buya k'abaragati buya bwabw'oma gucokere Kogori oria 1, 2026. Naki ikireona buya bwanike gucokere buya bukiogotire oria bwokire buya bucheki.
Dholuo: Abiria mbela ji ECDE e Murang'a County ni giyo yore kanyo yego mar jochung' e ng'ato ma okinyi ji e ndalo 1, nyakwar 2026. Konyo chalo ma okinyi ji nyime chalo ka madiro.
Somali: Macalimiinta ECDE ee Gobolka Murang'a waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay saxiixaan heshiis shaqo cusub oo ku saabsan kordhinta mushaharka oo bilaabanaysa Luulyo 1, 2026. Aqbal heshiiska si waxbarashada caadiga ah dib loogu bilaabo.

English: Congratulations to Dr. Tabitha Awuor Amollo of Egerton University for winning the OWSD-Elsevier Foundation Award for her groundbreaking research in STEM. Her work on solar energy conversion and thin-film technology exemplifies innovation in addressing global challenges.
Kiswahili: Hongera kwa Dkt. Tabitha Awuor Amollo wa Chuo Kikuu cha Egerton kwa kushinda Tuzo ya OWSD-Elsevier Foundation kwa utafiti wake wa kipekee katika STEM. Kazi yake juu ya ubadilishaji wa nishati ya jua na teknolojia ya filamu nyembamba inadhihirisha ubunifu katika kushughulikia changamoto za kimataifa.
Ekegusii: Naki ebwaki ore Dr. Tabitha Awuor Amollo omogena wa Egerton University omokirere omosiba buya bwaki OWSD-Elsevier Foundation Award kubwakire enyansioneki ya STEM. Omokirigho weye kusiigana enkarori ya mwaki omwaki hamwe naki techinology ya thin-film ikwenda gucuchanda omonene mananire.
Dholuo: Wang'ni Dr. Tabitha Awuor Amollo wuon Egerton University kuom oringo OWSD-Elsevier Foundation Award noyudo mag daloko gi wendo mopogore e STEM. Kundi nigi mondo koro gingo kendo ng'ato ang'wen gi kido mar joma nyaka abiro oduong' e vyalo mar dhano masinde.
Somali: Hambalyo Dr. Tabitha Awuor Amollo ee Jaamacadda Egerton oo ku guuleysatay abaalmarinta OWSD-Elsevier Foundation ee cilmi-baaristeeda cusub ee STEM. Shaqadeeda ku saabsan beddelka tamarta qoraxda iyo farsamada filimka dhuuban ayaa tusaale u ah hal-abuurka wax ka qabashada caqabadaha caalamiga ah.

English: CEMASTEA is conducting a three-day training for Quality Assurance and Standards Officers on improving STEM education under the Competency-Based Education system from June 10 to 12.
Kiswahili: CEMASTEA inafanya mafunzo ya siku tatu kwa Maafisa wa Uhakikisho wa Ubora na Viwango juu ya kuboresha elimu ya STEM chini ya mfumo wa Elimu ya Kulingana na Uwezo kuanzia tarehe 10 hadi 12 Juni.
Ekegusii: CEMASTEA oreka omokiri oria itatu buya for Quality Assurance ne Standards Officers buya bwoikire STEM ekegusii nyansabaki ye Competency-Based Education omagaka June 10 nyake 12.
Dholuo: CEMASTEA ochunge thum oriti niya chienge kuru mar Quality Assurance and Standards Officers kuom gendere STEM edukeshin maler pesa Competency-Based Education system nigi chike 10 mpaka 12.
Somali: CEMASTEA waxay qabanqaabinaysaa tababar saddex maalmood ah oo loogu talagalay Saraakiisha Hubinta Tayada iyo heerarka si kor loogu qaado waxbarashada STEM iyada oo la adeegsanayo nidaamka Waxbarashada Ku Salaysan Aqoonta laga bilaabo Juun 10 ilaa 12.

English: Grade 10 learners show strong interest in continuing STEM education beyond secondary school, with over 95% intending to pursue this pathway. Parents and educators are encouraged to support this trend.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa darasa la kumi wana hamu kubwa ya kuendelea na masomo ya STEM baada ya shule ya sekondari, ambapo zaidi ya asilimia 95 wanakusudia kufuata njia hii. Wazazi na waalimu wanahimizwa kuunga mkono mwenendo huu.
Ekegusii: Abakiruka baye bagenjere 10 baria nabere nakiere matokari ya STEM emorogoti bweri abere borenyiri, na 95% nakiere saponi eria bakanona. Ababere nakiere ndoni ne abatia baci buya emoshuri bobi.
Dholuo: Abal grade 10 nyaka gi chamo buo kuon STEM keyo gi chike, nyaka 95% ni bende nyaka gitimere lowo. Ougo, bachi mang'ere gi jowadho nyaka gidhoyo mano.
Somali: Ardayda fasalka 10aad waxay muujinayaan xiiso xooggan oo ku aaddan inay sii wataan waxbarashada STEM ka dib dugsiga sare, in ka badan 95% waxay qorsheynayaan inay raacaan waddadan. Waalidiinta iyo macalimiinta waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay taageeraan isbeddelkani.

English: Parents and communities are urged to enhance vigilance and cooperation to protect children, monitor their movements, and report any suspicious activities promptly to local authorities.
Kiswahili: Wazazi na jamii wanahimizwa kuimarisha uangalizi na ushirikiano ili kulinda watoto, kufuatilia harakati zao, na kuripoti shughuli zozote za kutia shaka kwa mamlaka za eneo.
Ekegusii: Abakire na obokire buya batorire omokiri nyanje na obokire okorere oria, banarere mwena baana, na bazirere obokire buya bwaki bogenye bosi obaki buya ku masengo.
Dholuo: Nek piny, iyaboya mondo idhi rogho gi neno, kendo olokni kuom nyaka mapiggi, kendo nyisogi alworo chalo koro kendo amiyou gi piny ma ok nyaka gi gik ma ok ochak moloyo.
Somali: Waalidiinta iyo bulshadu waxa lagu boorinayaa inay kor u qaadaan feejignaanta iyo iskaashiga si ay u ilaaliyaan carruurta, u kormeeraan dhaqdhaqaaqeeda, isla markaana ay si dhakhso ah u soo sheegeen waxyaabaha shaki gelinaya ee ay la kulmaan hay'adaha maxalliga ah.

English: KCSE graduates from 2020 to 2025 can access the KUCCPS guide listing universities offering Bachelor of Education courses for new CBE subjects to aid in course selection.
Kiswahili: Waliohitimu KCSE kuanzia mwaka 2020 hadi 2025 wanaweza kupata mwongozo wa KUCCPS unaoonyesha vyuo vinavyotoa kozi za Shahada ya Elimu kwa ajili ya masomo mapya ya CBE ili kuwasaidia kuchagua kozi.
Ekegusii: Abasorori ba KCSE abaki 2020 saba 2025 baria bategana kubona buya bwa KUCCPS buarorere miano ya masomoni boki Bakarori ba Egesero boki CBE buorere buya bwokore bwategana.
Dholuo: Ab gdzie KCSE man gi 2020 to 2025 no en gima ne odugni KUCCPS ma nyal chuth universities kendo ma owinjore Bachelor of Education kuom chiko CBE ma nyal tinde gi nyalo konyo chike.
Somali: Ardayda ka qalin-jabisa KCSE intii u dhexeysay 2020 ilaa 2025 waxay heli karaan hagaha KUCCPS ee liiska jaamacadaha bixiya koorsooyinka Bachelor of Education ee maadooyinka cusub ee CBE si ay u fududeeyaan doorashada koorsada.

English: The Teachers Service Commission (TSC) has published transparent promotion guidelines and a marking scheme for the 2026/2027 financial year to ensure fairness in teacher promotions.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma za Walimu (TSC) imetoa mwongozo wazi wa kuhamasisha na mfumo wa kukadiria kwa mwaka wa fedha 2026/2027 ili kuhakikisha haki katika kuhamasisha walimu.
Ekegusii: Abwaki buya ya Teachers Service Commission (TSC) etareje ogenda buya bwa ongekire na ochakarari bwogoya bwokibuke cha 2026/2027 buya buya buya bwega kworere buya bwenye ogenda buya bwakinyancha.
Dholuo: Komishen ma Tich (TSC) osetie madinda mar promo ni nyathi e yo 2026/2027 ka ei gisege dal ni ariyo ma tik.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta (TSC) ayaa soo saaray hage cad oo kor u qaadista iyo qorshe qiimeyn ah sanadka maaliyadeed 2026/2027 si loo hubiyo cadaalad macallimiinta kor loogu qaadayo.

English: All stakeholders in education must respect their roles to ensure a safe and productive learning environment. Collaboration is key, but it must not lead to interference.
Kiswahili: Wadau wote katika elimu wanapaswa kuheshimu majukumu yao ili kuhakikisha mazingira salama na yenye tija ya kujifunza. Ushirikiano ni muhimu, lakini haupaswi kupelekea kuingilia kati.
Ekegusii: Abegasai bante boke mu ekerebu bure busekwere egesambu naki bwaki omogori obwakinyang'ani. Kegasikenyeki nikiruge, lakini kire omotigo obwaki.
Dholuo: Wangʼeye oro duto kuom nengo gin mag Ngʼato ma nidi to ginyal e gige duto. Kuom konyo mag ndalo, to ok nyal ji nyalo timo.
Somali: Dhammaan daneeyayaasha waxbarashada waa inay ixtiraamaan doorkooda si loo xaqiijiyo deegaan waxbarasho oo ammaan ah oo wax soo saar leh. Iskaashigu waa muhiimada, laakiin maaha in uu keeno faragelin.

English: There are no actionable announcements in this article.
Kiswahili: Hakuna matangazo ya kutekelezeka katika makala hii.
Ekegusii: Naki gochokire kosi omokiriri bw'ogendenda buya.
Dholuo: Konyi neno mar no ng'ato koro miyo.
Somali: Maqaalkani ma laha wax qoraal ah oo la qaadi karo.

English: Parents and educators are urged to encourage students to read complete books to enhance concentration and critical thinking skills. Deep reading is essential for academic success.
Kiswahili: Wazazi na walimu wanashauriwa kuhamasisha wanafunzi kusoma vitabu kamili ili kuboresha uelekeo na ujuzi wa kufikiri kwa kina. Kusoma kwa undani ni muhimu kwa mafanikio ya kitaaluma.
Ekegusii: Abanyangi na abarimu banekere okorora emosi baana bushindu busukari bworukoyie buya matega bwomoraganja naki. Omosoreri obwakire buya mwagahi buya bworaki bworugendo bwakosibori.
Dholuo: Dhok ma ji kuom iweyo gima nyaka kuom ng'ato konyo ng'ato gi tich mamoko kuom kuoth gima giya chiegni kanyo gi yore. Nying' kod owabi e nyiri chalo yo.
Somali: Waalidku iyo macalimiintu waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ardayda ku boorinayaan inay akhriyaan buugaag dhammaystiran si ay u xoojiyaan feejignaanta iyo kartida fekerka. Akhriska qoto dheer waa lagama maarmaan guusha waxbarashada.

English: Schools are encouraged to activate their alumni networks to provide mentorship, support scholarships, and enhance educational resources. Engage former students to strengthen your institution's future.
Kiswahili: Shule zinahimizwa kuanzisha mitandao ya wahitimu zao kutoa ushauri, kusaidia ufadhili wa masomo, na kuboresha rasilimali za kielimu. Washirikishe wanafunzi wa zamani ili kuimarisha mustakabali wa taasisi yenu.
Ekegusii: Masomo emonani orete buya bwabaki bwarebu naki buya bwakora, bwanang'ana gose, naki buya bwachire. Nyasa buya osete buya bwere buya bwabaki, buya wakiore.
Dholuo: Kola ma gimae, wan joo ma wuondo gi jodongo omiya nyaka buo yore, makelo sayans, to nyal gi nyamunjigi. Kony gi jochunge ma gi yo chiego duto e nyumi.
Somali: Dugsiyada waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay furaan shabakadaha alumnigooda si ay u bixiyaan hagitaan, taageero deeqo waxbarasho, iyo inay kororsadaan agabka waxbarasho. La xidhiidh ardaydii hore si aad u xoojisaan mustaqbalka hay'addaada.

English: Teachers are encouraged to prioritize financial literacy as it directly impacts their well-being and effectiveness in the classroom. Invest in your financial education for better professional health.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanahimizwa kuzingatia uelewa wa kifedha kwa sababu unaathiri moja kwa moja ustawi wao na ufanisi darasani. Wekeza katika elimu yako ya kifedha kwa afya bora ya kitaaluma.
Ekegusii: Abagereki baria batararire kukang'ana buya bwenga bw'ekegusii naki bw'otebere buya bwabo na madalimo gogekarire mu bubi bw'ekibari. Koshonte mwaki gwanone mu buya bwa buya bw'ekebirori.
Dholuo: Wang'ni nyaka terere ka watiyore konyo yieng' mar pesa, nitie ka ine konyo wachni gi ohinga mar duhongo. Ndalo kuom joma mar pesa mondo ubed gi yie.
Somali: Macallimiinta waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay mudnaanta siiyaan aqoonta maaliyadeed maadaama ay saameyn toos ah ku leedahay caafimaadkooda iyo waxqabadkooda fasalka. Maal gal aqoontaada maaliyadeed si aad u hesho caafimaad xirfadeed oo wanaagsan.

English: Mitua Girls Senior School successfully conducted a Student Council election through secret ballot, promoting student leadership and participation in school governance.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Upili ya Wasichana Mitua imetekeleza uchaguzi wa Baraza la Wanafunzi kwa njia ya kura za siri, ikisisitiza uongozi wa wanafunzi na ushiriki katika usimamizi wa shule.
Ekegusii: Mitua Girls Senior School yabwakere ogenda buya bwa Student Council buse kera, itagore omokireri buya buya naki omosi kera mu buya bwitiga.
Dholuo: Mitua Girls Senior School obed kanyo ni yore maber gi chunyogo mar Students Council ka wacho ni chalo chike, kendo en gi itung' chwech maber kuom jomatindo.
Somali: Mitua Girls Senior School waxa ay si guul leh u qabatay doorasho Guddiga Ardayda iyadoo la isticmaalayo cod qarsoodi ah, taas oo dhiirigelinaysa hogaaminta ardayda iyo ka qaybqaadashada maamulka dugsiga.

English: Learners in Vihiga County are urged to prioritize their education for a better future. Parents and guardians are encouraged to provide supportive environments for academic success.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi katika Kaunti ya Vihiga wanashauriwa kuzingatia masomo yao kwa ajili ya maisha bora ya baadaye. Wazazi na walezi wanahimizwa kusaidia mazingira ambayo yatasaidia mafanikio ya kitaaluma.
Ekegusii: Abaki bansonye Vihiga batigire omokirigori bw'aki bw'omi. Baki bakanjaa naki bonyigori banteka emorori abaria abaki bw'aki bonyaki.
Dholuo: Daleni ku Vihiga, mwathgi kachien duto gi weche mag chieng' mar piny kendo. Bwakni gi ng'ato oyie kaka wandu kendo piny duong' mar tich.
Somali: Ardayda ku sugan degmada Vihiga waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay mudnaanta siiyaan waxbarashadooda si ay mustaqbalka uga fogaadaan dhibaato. Waalidiinta iyo mas'uuliyiin waxaa lagula talinayaa inay abuuraan jawi taageero leh si ay ardaydu ugu guuleystaan waxbarashada.

English: Residents of Bomet County are urged to report gender-based violence incidents to the police immediately. Do not settle cases privately; support efforts to protect victims and ensure offenders face justice.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Kaunti ya Bomet wanashauriwa kuripoti matukio ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia kwa polisi mara moja. Usitatue kesi kibinafsi;unga mkono juhudi za kulinda waathiriwa na kuhakikisha waliotenda makosa wanakabiliwa na haki.
Ekegusii: Abakire b’Bomet bakenye buya kosi nyasa ya nyaka bosi omokang’ori kw’ogotegeri buya. Naki biforori bw’egera bwi bosi; bakanie buya buseki bategori buseka omorimania na mwamori bosi bota omongima.
Dholuo: Omondo Bomet County nawo, nwa kwach ni awachung’ gi ng'ato miyo g’ontie piny mangeny gi chodo. Koro ok nyal konyo konyo; nyalo konyo pum ne okonyori to ochiko chiek.
Somali: Dadka ku nool Gobolka Bomet waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay si degdeg ah ugu warbixiyaan ciqaabta ku saleysan jinsiga booliska. Ha soo afjoojin kiiska si gaar ah; taageer dadaallada lagu badbaadinayo dhibanayaasha iyo xaqiijinta in dambiilayaasha la horkeeno cadaaladda.

English: Tenwek High School will participate in the KSSSA national Term Two games from August 2–6 in Thika, Kiambu County. Prepare accordingly for this important competition.
Kiswahili: Shuleni Tenwek itashiriki michezo ya kitaifa ya KSSSA ya Kipindi cha Pili kuanzia Agosti 2–6 huko Thika, Kaunti ya Kiambu. Jiandikishe ipasavyo kwa ajili ya mashindano haya muhimu.
Ekegusii: Tenwek High School ikwenda kuteurwa mu KSSSA national Term Two games buya August 2–6 oria Thika, Kiambu County. Tegere buya kosi oria naki naki ikikore buya.
Dholuo: Tenwek High School bende y jong' golo ma KSSSA mar Term Two k’oloo August 2–6 e Thika, Kiambu County. Nakiu nyaka ni iwek ni bende ok nyaka kuom gik ma wacho.
Somali: Dugsiga Sare ee Tenwek ayaa ka qayb qaadan doona ciyaaraha KSSSA ee heer qaran ee Term Two laga bilaabo August 2–6 ee Thika, Kiambu County. Si haboon u diyaar garoobid tartankan muhiimka ah.

English: Kakamega School Green Commandos have departed for Kiambu for the KSSSA National Secondary Schools Ball Games. All qualified schools must report to M-PESA Academy by July 31, 2026.
Kiswahili: Kikundi cha Green Commandos cha Shule ya Kakamega kimeondoka kwenda Kiambu kwa Michezo ya Mpira ya KSSSA ya Shule za Sekondari Kitaifa. Shule zote zilizostahiki zinatakiwa kuripoti katika Akademia ya M-PESA kufikia Julai 31, 2026.
Ekegusii: Kakamega School Green Commandos omokire buya Kiambu kw'ekisomo ky'ekikoro kya KSSSA. Masomo matuhaine omogenda bosi bwenyige buya M-PESA Academy buya Ogot 31, 2026.
Dholuo: Kakamega School Green Commandos abichne gi Kiambu for KSSSA National Secondary Schools Ball Games. Sukulu ng'ato ma ok nyalo konyi gi joma M-PESA Academy nyaka yudo raporo kanyogo nyukonyo July 31, 2026.
Somali: Dugsiga Kakamega Green Commandos ayaa u baxay Kiambu si ay uga qaybgalaan Ciyaaraha Kubadda Kolayga ee KSSSA ee dugsiyada sare ee qaranka. Dhammaan dugsiyaadka u qalma waa in ay soo xreportiyaan M-PESA Academy ka hor July 31, 2026.

English: Parents and guardians are urged to actively engage in mentoring their children during the August holiday to reinforce moral values, discipline, and faith at home.
Kiswahili: Wazazi na walezi wanashauriwa kushiriki kwa karibu katika kuwasaidia watoto wao wakati wa likizo ya Agosti ili kuimarisha maadili, nidhamu, na imani nyumbani.
Ekegusii: Ababere na abanikire bagamie gusomeka ngo’oti babaire buya bu iheka buya, omogaka bu naki, na omokoyaki bw'egesabandi.
Dholuo: Gi omer e odhiambo mamoko gi kamano ng'ato nyaka oser e gima chiegni gi chike ma okelo gi ng'ato ma awinjo; iwacho kuom onyiso, chiegni, kendo dik.
Somali: Waalidiinta iyo mas'uuliyiinta waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay si firfircoon uga qayb qaataan hagidda caruurtooda inta ay cuntadan August, si loo xoojiyo qiyamka anshaxa, nidaamka, iyo iimaanka guriga.

English: Wilson Sossion has been appointed as a commissioner of the Teachers Service Commission (TSC) and pledges to enhance teacher welfare and education reforms.
Kiswahili: Wilson Sossion ameteuliwa kuwa kamishna wa Tume ya Huduma za Walimu (TSC) na ahadi yake ni kuboresha ustawi wa walimu na mabadiliko ya elimu.
Ekegusii: Wilson Sossion omokire buya kamoko omonyagaka gee Teachers Service Commission (TSC) na osorori ekirori omogirango chakariga naki naki ekere ne eng'enda.
Dholuo: Wilson Sossion wachari oko ka commissioner mar Teachers Service Commission (TSC) kendo odiso kuom gima oyie chike mar walimu kendo maber ma nyalo tich e kanyero.
Somali: Wilson Sossion waxaa loo magacaabay komishinere ka tirsan Hay'adda Adeegga Macallimiinta (TSC) wuxuuna ballanqaaday inuu kor u qaadi doono daryeelka macallimiinta iyo isbeddelada waxbarashada.

English: Seven teachers have been deregistered by the Teachers Service Commission effective February 25, 2026. Individuals cannot teach unless registered; reinstatement requires Commission approval.
Kiswahili: Walimu saba wameondolewa katika orodha ya Walimu na Tume ya Huduma za Walimu, hii ikianza tarehe 25 Februari, 2026. Watu hawawezi kufundisha isipokuwa wapo kwenye orodha; kurejea katika orodha kunahitaji idhini ya Tume.
Ekegusii: Abagore baria nane bayabere omogaka buya buya bwi' Teachers Service Commission mwakire Obwakabarori 25, 2026. Ababere bataria bashite omogaka buya buya; kugarukire omogaka bwi' Commission kunye.
Dholuo: Baker teachers onge gichako gi Teachers Service Commission to manok kuom February 25, 2026. Kido kadinda to hodu kanyakla; gige gi ng'ato ni Commission moro.
Somali: Todoba macallin ayaa laga tiray diiwaanka machadka adeegga macallimiinta tan iyo 25-ka Febraayo, 2026. Shaqsiyaadka ma wada baran karaan haddii aanay diiwaangashanayn; dib u soo celinta waxay u baahan tahay ogolaansho ka timaadda machadka.

English: Motorists are reminded to exercise caution and adhere to traffic regulations to prevent road accidents and fatalities.
Kiswahili: Madereva wanakumbushwa kuchukua tahadhari na kufuata kanuni za barabarani ili kuzuia ajali za barabarani na vifo.
Ekegusii: Abashurubu bosi, musabire omokire na mosi chirebaki okure mwaki buya bwabokire naki bimenyereri.
Dholuo: Wanyalo e yo bende wathor gi kare, kendo goyo ng'ato ne konyo ka unyalo konyo chike kuom yie kod kar gich.
Somali: Dadka gaadiidka wata waxaa lagu xasuusinayaa inay taxaddar sameeyaan oo ay raacaan xeerarka taraafikada si looga fogaado shilalka wadada iyo dhimashada.

English: Nyabisase Secondary School has reopened under new acting principal Sambora. All students must pay KSh8,000 for damaged property and return with a parent/guardian to clear outstanding fees before re-admission.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Sekondari ya Nyabisase imerejea chini ya kiongozi mpya anayesimamia, Sambora. Wanafunzi wote lazima walipie KSh8,000 kwa mali iliyoaribika na return na mzazi/mlezi ili kulipa ada zilizobaki kabla ya kurudi shuleni.
Ekegusii: Nyabisase Secondary School ekorire buya na omokyenyi omogende Sambora. Abanyamokiri bose bakenye KSh8,000 buya bwakire buya na bosi naki oria bwaki baekunyekirire omokye oria bosi bwaki bagenyi bwaki antesi omonokie.
Dholuo: Nyabisase Secondary School ok nyal nyako moko machielo e yo, ang'ado Sambora. Wana masomo nyaka pimo KSh8,000 gi chayo kod ni watiyo gi mamoko/owuor manok gi ji wee yo chuth koro omako nyaka okany kaluwore.
Somali: Dugsiga Sare ee Nyabisase wuu furmay oo waxaa maamula maamul cusub, Sambora. Dhamaan ardayda waa inay bixiyaan KSh8,000 oo lacag ah oo lagu hagaajiyo hantida dhaawacmay, sidoo kalena waa inay la yimaadaan waalid/mas'uul si ay u bixiyaan lacagaha ka maqan ka hor dib u aqbalaadda.

English: Kisii School Old Boys are constructing an ICT hub to equip students with digital skills. This initiative aims to enhance learners' computer proficiency for their studies and careers.
Kiswahili: Wanaume wa Shule ya Kisii wanajenga kituo cha ICT ili kuwapa wanafunzi ujuzi wa kidijitali. Mpango huu unalenga kuboresha ujuzi wa wanafunzi katika matumizi ya kompyuta kwa masomo na kazi zao.
Ekegusii: Abagosi baki Kisii School bagenyora ICT hub buya bwogokoge bwesibori. Omogoti owi bwokwagia abaki bateganeri bwogogendia buseke bwabaki natii bosi.
Dholuo: Kisii School Old Boys buo ng'ato ICT hub konyo kuom nindigi mag dala. Njenje manono ni iwach ne jo konyo kompyuta mar nyigoro kendo ng'ato e yiero ma okinyi.
Somali: Kisii School Old Boys waxay dhisayaan xarun ICT ah si ay ardayda ugu qalabeeyaan xirfadaha dijitaalka ah. Ujeedada mashruucan waa in la koriyo aqoonta kombiyuutarka ee ardayda si ay uga faa'iideystaan waxbarashadooda iyo mustaqbalkooda.

English: KUCCPS has opened instant university placement for KCSE candidates who missed earlier admission. Eligible students can apply through the KUCCPS Student Portal for available degree programmes immediately.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS imefungua usajili wa papo hapo wa vyuo vikuu kwa wanafunzi wa KCSE walioshindwa kujiunga awali. Wanafunzi wanaoafiki wanaweza kuomba kupitia Portal ya Wanafunzi ya KUCCPS kwa programu za digrii zilizopo mara moja.
Ekegusii: KUCCPS emogori oria bw'igo buya bw'ogori baci banya KCSE bature chaki oria bw'anda. Abandu babereka batania banang'iane oria bw'iga mu KUCCPS Student Portal ku oria bw'iga bware buya.
Dholuo: KUCCPS oyudhi manyien kuot gi ugenje makelo kwom KCSE giwacho to puon gi adhi. Wuond ni ng'ato ma ok eluo ang'wen kuom KUCCPS Student Portal kata wach e kanyakla ma iwach.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay furtey goob degdeg ah oo jaamacad loogu talagalay ardayda KCSE ee waayay gelitaanka hore. Ardayda ku habboon waxay si degdeg ah uga codsan karaan barnaamijyada darajada ku saabsan goobta ardayda ee KUCCPS.

English: Murang'a County Government is offering Sh10,000 bursaries to day secondary school graduates with a C+ and above to support their transition to higher education. Eligible students should check for application details.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Murang'a inatoa ufadhili wa Sh10,000 kwa wahitimu wa shule za sekondari za siku wenye alama ya C+ na juu ili kusaidia mpito wao kwenda elimu ya juu. Wanafunzi wanaostahili wanapaswa kuangalia maelezo ya jinsi ya kuomba.
Ekegusii: Abantu baki Murang'a bong'ere Sh10,000 emokiri omokireri ogenda ogenderera bw'ogenda egere okulanda kireko C+ na buya kuteke omogori buya oria nakiemete omogori obwakire. Abakire oya kugaruka okorora oria ogetogogere.
Dholuo: Ochokere Murang'a County Government owinjore burasari joo Sh10,000 ma nyaka konyo kuom mboyi ma aduok C+ e kendo marach kuom ji tich ma okel gige. Kanyere ma huiyo res nyaka jolo-omiyo mabor.
Somali: Dowladda degmada Murang'a waxay bixineysaa deeqo waxbarasho oo dhan Sh10,000 oo loogu talagalay ardayda dugsiga sare ee maalinle ah ee dhammaystay waxbarashada C+ iyo wixii ka sarreeya si ay uga caawiyaan inay u gudbaan waxbarashada sare. Ardayda u qalma waa iney ka fiirsadaan faahfaahinta codsiga.

English: The Teachers Service Commission has withdrawn the advertisement for 34,016 teacher promotion vacancies due to errors. Wait for the corrected version before taking any action.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma za Walimu imeondoa tangazo la nafasi 34,016 za kuongeza cheo kwa walimu kutokana na makosa. Subiri toleo lililosahihishwa kabla ya kuchukua hatua yoyote.
Ekegusii: Komisheni ya Abanyagati ikorori naki gaki naki 34,016 aibe nyamuka ya abanyagati buya buya bwaki. Para na kiana buya bwaki oria uria omokiriri.
Dholuo: Teachers Service Commission imedhi e jomokore mag 34,016 ma ok bende e nyathi mar koro. Wachone konyo mag jokwothe kendo maler kendo omiyou.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta ayaa ka laabtay xayaysiisa 34,016 fursado korodhsi macallimiin ah sababo la xiriira khaladaad. Sug nooca saxda ah ka hor intaadan qaadin wax tallaabo ah.

English: Teachers are encouraged to recognize and harness their diverse talents beyond their assigned subjects for the benefit of student development. Embrace all your skills to enhance the school community.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanahimizwa kutambua na kutumia talanta zao tofauti zaidi ya masomo waliyopewa kwa ajili ya maendeleo ya wanafunzi. Tumieni ujuzi wenu wote kuimarisha jamii ya shule.
Ekegusii: Abagikosi baraboriwe okucherekeria na ogotenda eng’eno yakiogori nakiemookire obwaki bwamaki. Bokire omokiriri bwosi bwenyige okugeza omorenge buya.
Dholuo: Nyarugni echo ni okanyore kod gima itiye kendo okel matek, yo chike mojiheka to edhi e gige ma nyaka ni. Koso e yo chike duto to golo matunga e school.
Somali: Macallimiinta waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay aqoonsadaan oo ka faa’iidaystaan xirfadooda kala duwan marka laga reebo maadooyinka ay u xilsaaran yihiin si kor loogu qaado horumarka ardayda. Qaado dhammaan xirfadahaaga si aad u xoojiso bulshada dugsiga.

English: Teachers are required to complete their self-appraisal for the Teacher Performance Appraisal and Development (TPAD) process by the end of Term Two. Ensure your evaluation reflects your professional growth.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanatakiwa kukamilisha tathmini zao za kibinafsi kwa ajili ya Mchakato wa Tathmini na Maendeleo ya Utendaji wa Walimu (TPAD) kabla ya kumalizika kwa Kipindi cha Pili. Hakikisha tathmini yako inaonyesha ukuaji wako wa kitaaluma.
Ekegusii: Abagere bategere omogori batarire bataria buya bwokirorere bwamokiri bwana Omotigena Wechisomo nakiendo koshiriri ekegera mbeere ya Term Iburi. Ria moshie bwogere bwokirorere bwokibori.
Dholuo: Wath joma adiera nigi ka okonyo gogo luor ego mar Teacher Performance Appraisal and Development (TPAD) mawacho gi nyaka omiyo konyo owang' e ng'ato gi e odhiambo mar Term Two. Naki gi gima owuon gi ng'ato meyo cham kendo gi tich.
Somali: Macallimiintu waa in ay dhammaystiraan is-dhexgalka naftooda ee habka Qiimaynta iyo Horumarinta Macallinka (TPAD) dhamaadka Term Two. Hubi in qiimayntu ay muujinayso korriinkaaga xirfadeed.

English: Schools are reopening for the new term; parents are encouraged to support school policies and maintain respectful communication for a positive learning environment.
Kiswahili: Shule zinafunguliwa kwa muhula mpya; wazazi wanahimizwa kuunga mkono sera za shule na kudumisha mawasiliano ya heshima ili kuweka mazingira mazuri ya kujifunza.
Ekegusii: Masomo aragya kubokireriya; abaki banyasa baswaki mwaki obueng'ana na bueng'ana bwaki bakanogori bwaki buya bw'amasomo.
Dholuo: Wasukulu ginyalo konyo mar term mokwongo; magol kiwuon to okwayo kuom waluongo ng'ato kendo nindo mar modhi nopiny.
Somali: Dugsiyadu waxay dib u furayaan term cusub; waalidiinta waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa in ay taageeraan siyaasadaha dugsiga iyo in ay ilaaliyaan isgaadhsiin ixtiraam leh si loo helo deegaan waxbarasho oo wanaagsan.

English: The 'Cockroach' movement protests in India have concluded following the resignation of India's education minister.
Kiswahili: Harakati za 'Mpanzi' za kugomea nchini India zimeisha kufuatia kujiuzulu kwa waziri wa elimu wa India.
Ekegusii: Omogaka 'Cockroach' omokinyera bwakire mu India oria bwakere naki oria itiri moseri waki omokigori omogenda.
Dholuo: Mabano mar 'Cockroach' okeleng' kendo en India naki ng'ato gigni, ka waduong' mar masomo en India apak iweyo.
Somali: Dhaqdhaqaaqa 'Dhidid' ee Hindiya ayaa dhamaaday kaddib markii wasiirka waxbarashada Hindiya is casilay.

English: St. Anne's Sega Girls Senior School has launched a book club where students have written and published their own books. Encourage your children to participate in such literacy initiatives.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Sekondari ya Wasichana ya St. Anne's Sega imeanzisha klabu ya vitabu ambapo wanafunzi wameandika na kuchapisha vitabu vyao wenyewe. Himiza watoto wako kushiriki katika mipango kama hii ya kujifunza kusoma na kuandika.
Ekegusii: Shule ya Msichana ya St. Anne's Sega imetangaza klabu ya vitabu ambapo wanafunzi wameandika na kuchapisha vitabu vyao. Himiza watoto wenu kushiriki katika mipango hii ya uandishi.
Dholuo: St. Anne's Sega Girls Senior School oyudhi buku club ma ng'ato piny orwako kendo nitel gi buku dwi. Rendors ng'wono kuom abor to nyaka nyalo nyikiny kar chuny.
Somali: Dugsiga Sare ee Gacanta St. Anne's Sega waxay sameysay koox buugaag ah oo ardaydu ay qoreen oo daabaceen buugaagtooda. Ku dhiirigeli carruurtaada inay ka qaybqaataan howlahaan akhriska.

English: Parents and educators are encouraged to support students in their educational journeys, as mentorship plays a crucial role in overcoming obstacles and achieving success.
Kiswahili: Wazazi na walimu wanahimizwa kusaidia wanafunzi katika safari zao za elimu, kwani ushauri ni muhimu katika kushinda vikwazo na kufanikiwa.
Ekegusii: Ababere na abarori bataraki bambarire abaki batarire naki, buse engochori bw'ekigagano buzi bunta na bwana omotere buse oria batobo bwaremi buya.
Dholuo: Wuodhi ne walimu ohipi mwathoroni ka gini oying’ gi thum, tawi kanyoni puonj nyaka gichung’ gi piny mokuoch ne dendi.
Somali: Waalidiinta iyo macallimiinta waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay taageeraan ardayda safarkooda waxbarasho, maadaama hagiddu ay door muhiim ah ka ciyaarayo ka adkaanshaha caqabadaha iyo gaarista guusha.

English: Students at JKUAT on industrial attachment must clear outstanding household fee balances immediately or risk failing and having to repeat the program. Ensure payment to avoid consequences.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa JKUAT kwenye mafunzo ya vitendo wanapaswa kulipa salio la ada za nyumba lililobaki mara moja au wanaweza kukabiliwa na hatari ya kufeli na kulazimika kurudia programu. Hakikisha unalipa ili kuepuka madhara.
Ekegusii: Abakire bu JKUAT bari mugambo bu industri batarianira bosi bosi bu emaki bwana ikigango batarianire buira ora bakuzire bosi nende bu mweng'ere. Naki aboraganya bukoragano bu bori iremokirano.
Dholuo: Wanafunzi ku JKUAT ma industrial attachment nyalo wajibika kwach ni eche kanyakwayo ma nyalu omong'ongo chiye nyaka omiyoni kata joge gi nyaka nyiso to. Kelo kanyakwayo to lare mar kendo!
Somali: Ardayda JKUAT ku sugan ee ku jira tababarka warshadaha waa in ay si degdeg ah u xaliyaan deynta khidmadaha guryaha, haddii kale waxay khatar ugu jiraan inay ku guuldareystaan ​​iyo inay qasab ku noqdaan barnaamijka. Hubi in lacagta la bixiyo si looga fogaado cawaaqib xumo.

English: Teachers are encouraged to apply Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs in their teaching methods to enhance Curriculum-Based Education (CBE) learning outcomes.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanahimizwa kutumia Ngazi ya Mahitaji ya Maslow katika mbinu zao za kufundisha ili kuboresha matokeo ya ujifunzaji wa Elimu Inayotokana na Mtaala (CBE).
Ekegusii: Abere bochera bosi bori muchege Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs naki boki bwana bwaki boki bwogetenge Curriculum-Based Education (CBE) buya busibari.
Dholuo: Makarand nyaka ji aimo Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs e ng'ato ma nyaka miyo okinyi, kuom gindo ma okinyi e Curriculum-Based Education (CBE).
Somali: Macallimiinta waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay isticmaalaan Hierarchy of Needs ee Maslow si ay u hagaajiyaan hababka waxbarashada una kordhiyaan natiijooyinka waxbarashada ee ku saleysan manhajka (CBE).

English: The Government is developing a 30-year Public Sector Transformation Policy to increase opportunities for young Kenyans in government employment.
Kiswahili: Serikali inaandaa Sera ya Maboresho ya Sekta ya Umma ya miaka 30 ili kuongeza fursa za kazi kwa vijana wa Kenya katika ajira za serikali.
Ekegusii: Obwaki bw'osibori bwahiga bw'otware 30 naki Okenye buya bw'ogendeshere bw'osema ore nouria omokiri buya bwakire bw'obaire bw'ogotora.
Dholuo: Gavana owinjo chalo mar Public Sector Transformation Policy ma ok nyaka 30, kuom wacho mar yiembe ma ok nyal ilgongo kendo chuo nyaka ninde.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay horumarineysaa Siyaasadda Isbeddelka Qaybta Dadweynaha oo ah 30 sano si loo kordhiyo fursadaha dhalinyarada Kenyan-ka ah ee shaqada dowladda.

English: Young people are encouraged to actively engage with their local Church and participate in discussions about their needs and concerns. Your voice matters—join the conversation for a better future.
Kiswahili: Vijana wanahimizwa kujiunga na Kanisa lao la eneo na kushiriki katika mijadala kuhusu mahitaji na wasiwasi wao. Sauti yako ina maana—jiunge na mazungumzo kwa ajili ya majukumu bora ya baadaye.
Ekegusii: Abakere bakiomokiri batiane neza na ekereke buya na baturia buya bwa kwomaka mwaki oria buya bwokere abaki. Enka bwaki bwerere—nengo uria bwoyoka ore buya bwang'ana.
Dholuo: Ng'ato nyaka okonyo e chokruok gi oying' molo e yiero mar chike gi nyamin duong' ka nyiri e golo gi chalo. Nying' wach nyaka goyo—timo chalo ng'ato mar buo.
Somali: Dhalinyarada waxaa loo dhiirrigelinayaa in ay si firfircoon ula socdaan kaniisadahooda deegaanka ayna ka qayb qaataan doodaha ku saabsan baahiyahooda iyo welwelkooda. Codkaaga waa muhiim—ku soo biir wada hadalka mustaqbal wanaagsan.

English: All institutions in Africa are urged to engage with young people as vital contributors to society. Organizations must listen to their needs to remain relevant and effective.
Kiswahili: Taasisi zote barani Afrika zinahimizwa kuungana na vijana kama washiriki muhimu katika jamii. Mashirika yanapaswa kusikiliza mahitaji yao ili kuendelea kuwa muhimu na yenye ufanisi.
Ekegusii: Díosibori zose mu Africa naki abarori baki akina naki abaki omogari oria. Mahepe naki kosi omokwa ogendaki bana baki okubokere omokire naki omokiri.
Dholuo: Gik ma ok nyalo chako e Africa nyaka oying' ma young people nyalo timo kendo nyalo mano e chike. Moka ma odhi ni in gi wacho ma nyinge duto, miyo wachone gi adiera.
Somali: Dhammaan hay'adaha Afrika waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay la shaqeeyaan dhallinyarada sida wax ku ool ah ee bulshada. Ururada waa inay dhegeystaan baahiyahooda si ay u sii ahaadaan mid khuseeya oo wax ku ool ah.

English: Chuka University and the National Biosafety Authority have partnered to enhance biosafety education and research, offering opportunities for students and staff in internships and training.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Chuka na Mamlaka ya Kitaifa ya Usalama wa Biolojia wametafuta ushirikiano ili kuboresha elimu na utafiti wa usalama wa biolojia, wakitoa fursa kwa wanafunzi na wahitimu katika mafunzo na utafiti.
Ekegusii: Chuka University na National Biosafety Authority batarane okuja osikere buya na bwaki, naki abokire emokere ekiendo na emokere oria.
Dholuo: Chuka University ne National Biosafety Authority omedh mochung' ka nyiso chike ma okel gi biosafety, mirando piny gi chandruok ma okel gi internships kendo chike.
Somali: Jaamacadda Chuka iyo Hay'adda Qaranka ee Badbaadinta Bay'ada ayaa iska kaashanaya sidii kor loogu qaadi lahaa waxbarashada iyo cilmi-baarista badbaadada bay'ada, iyagoo bixiya fursado ardayda iyo shaqaalaha tababaro iyo waayo-aragnimo.

English: The National Transport and Safety Authority (NTSA) has launched 'Operation Watoto Wafike Salama' to ensure safe transport for students during the upcoming August holiday. Parents and school administrators must ensure vehicles are roadworthy and drivers are qualified.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Usafiri na Usalama wa Barabarani (NTSA) imeanzisha 'Operation Watoto Wafike Salama' kuhakikisha usafiri salama wa wanafunzi wakati wa likizo ya Agosti inayokuja. Wazazi na wasimamizi wa shule wanapaswa kuhakikisha magari yanafaa kwa barabara na madereva wanastahili.
Ekegusii: Abwaki bw'Abwaki n'Itagari (NTSA) batarani 'Operation Watoto Wafike Salama' buya bwi kufwanana ne mwendo mwa bange bwanande naki chochoro. Ababere na abagitura bakenye bukwanjane baserari bukihe bui zihangiri za omokari naki abochokari babaine buya.
Dholuo: National Transport and Safety Authority (NTSA) omiye 'Operation Watoto Wafike Salama' kuon gima ok othe ni nyaka nitsiye nyithindo gi dhako makare kendo gi tich mar August. K'Ong' adhi jodi nyaka un ng'ato kendo kwaya dhako ok ang'wen.
Somali: Hay'adda Qaranka ee Gaadiidka iyo Badbaadada (NTSA) waxay bilawday 'Hawlgalka Watoto Wafike Salama' si loo xaqiijiyo in ardayda si ammaan ah loogu safro inta lagu jiro fasaxa bisha Agoosto. Waalida iyo maamulayaasha dugsiyada waa inay hubiyaan in gaadiidka ay yihiin kuwo ammaan ah isla markaana darawalladu yihiin kuwo xirfad leh.

English: Police in Bomet are investigating the deaths of a teacher and a prison officer suspected to be linked to a love triangle. Residents are urged to avoid speculation and allow authorities to conduct their investigation.
Kiswahili: Polisi wa Bomet wanachunguza vifo vya mwalimu na afisa wa gereza wanaoshukiwa kuwa na uhusiano na mkataba wa kimapenzi. Wananchi wanatakiwa kuepuka uvumi na kuwapa mamlaka nafasi ya kufanya uchunguzi wao.
Ekegusii: Abakire bu Bomet baria bakiogoti bwogoya bwabaki bwabere bworoguru omokire na bokiibere bwakirigo omoshonire. Abakire barakiriigana baturia bujorori na babaki bategane omotendere bu bakiore.
Dholuo: Polisi e Bomet aroko kuom diech mar teacher kod diech mar prison kuom konyo rito mar chalo. Waduogo nyaluongo ka ichieng to oting' mag konyo gi yore mar gima polisi ok oting' konyo.
Somali: Boliska Bomet waxay baarayaan dhimashada macallin iyo sarkaal xabsi oo la tuhunsan yahay in ay ku xiran yihiin xariir jacayl. Dadweynaha waxaa lagu boorinayaa in ay ka fogaadaan hadalka aan salka lahayn iyo in ay oggolaadaan hay’adaha inay fuliyaan baaritaankooda.

English: The latest Collective Bargaining Agreement has awarded teachers salary increases ranging from KSh693 to KSh2,055.
Kiswahili: Mkataba wa Pamoja wa Majadiliano wa hivi karibuni umeongeza mishahara ya walimu kati ya KSh693 hadi KSh2,055.
Ekegusii: Ekirogo gendagwa hersia yaki tigai omokireri baba iriarwe makanga KSh693 na KSh2,055.
Dholuo: Kakibagi kode mag tich e chicha pok aneno inye piny, obedi te tich kanyakla kanyakla e KSh693 kendo KSh2,055.
Somali: Heshiiska heshiiska wadajirka ah ee ugu dambeeyey wuxuu macallimiinta siiyay koror mushaar oo u dhaxeeya KSh693 ilaa KSh2,055.

English: Teachers are encouraged to voice their concerns regarding the latest Collective Bargaining Agreement, as many feel it does not adequately meet their economic needs.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanahimizwa kueleza wasiwasi wao kuhusu Makubaliano ya Pamoja ya Kazi ya hivi karibuni, kwani wengi wanaona kuwa haya meetings mahitaji yao ya kiuchumi.
Ekegusii: Abagori batariri batega buya nyanzvi buseere buseki bwakomeza bwabwanana, naki bingi baba batega buya bujagano bosi bwaki bagenye oboranya bwokanyaboki bweng'ene.
Dholuo: Abweni gie eyo ret ngeyo chike mar dondo gi chuo, to chalo manyien an gi kakaok gima ne gieyo mar withi.
Somali: Macallimiinta waxaa laga dhiirrigelinayaa inay muujiyaan welwelkooda ku saabsan Heshiiska Iskaashiga Casriga ah, maadaama ay badan yihiin kuwa dareemaya in uusan si ku filan u qancinayn baahiyahooda dhaqaale.

English: The High Court has ordered the transfer of Gatoto Comprehensive School to the Mukuru community; immediate enforcement by the National Police Service is required.
Kiswahili: Mahakama Kuu imeamuru kuhamasishwa kwa Shule ya Msingi ya Gatoto kwa jamii ya Mukuru; huduma ya polisi wa kitaifa inahitajika kutekeleza mara moja.
Ekegusii: Ong'anya mkong'o amogori akirenda Gatoto Comprehensive School buya Mukuru; naki omose oria bw'egesera bw'ikorwa bwi chiremo.
Dholuo: Kachieng' gi High Court oseti to ge Gatoto Comprehensive School e Mukuru; kido piny mos teko ng'ato mar National Police Service ne ok nyal duto.
Somali: Maxkamadda Sare waxay amartay in Gatoto Comprehensive School loo wareejiyo bulshada Mukuru; ciidamada booliiska qaranka waxay ku baahan yihiin in ay si degdeg ah u fuliyaan.

English: Learning in Oldonyiro Ward, Isiolo County, has stalled indefinitely as the Kenya National Union of Teachers withdraws 59 teachers from four primary schools due to rising insecurity.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo katika Kata ya Oldonyiro, Kaunti ya Isiolo, yamekwama bila mwisho baada ya Chama cha Walimu wa Kenya kuondoa walimu 59 kutoka shule nne za msingi kutokana na kuongezeka kwa ukosefu wa usalama.
Ekegusii: Obwaki bwaki bworeri mu Oldonyiro Ward, Isiolo County, bwarigenye buya naki Kenya National Union of Teachers bugete 59 abaki bori mu masomo anane ore itabere bori naki oria kiogoti.
Dholuo: Kanya maghiny ku Oldonyiro Ward, Isiolo County, ochung' gi wendo ni Kenya National Union of Teachers opo 59 nyaka zeyoni ku e sekondari nigi kamano chalo kwaya.
Somali: Waxbarashada degaanka Oldonyiro, Gobolka Isiolo, ayaa hakad gashay si aan waqti go'an lahayn ka dib markii Ururka Qaranka Macallimiinta Kenya uu ka baneeyay 59 macallin afarta dugsiga hoose ee deegaanka sababo la xiriira amni xumo soo kordhay.

English: Students in ICT and software development at Kiambu National Polytechnic will benefit from a new dual training program, blending classroom learning with real-world industry experience.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi katika ICT na maendeleo ya programu katika Chuo Kikuu cha Kiambu watafaidika na programu mpya ya mafunzo ya pamoja, ikichanganya masomo darasani na uzoefu wa kweli wa viwandani.
Ekegusii: Abana baki ICT na biuminya busema ku Kiambu National Polytechnic bokechakaririe mwaki owekire, bonyaki naki bwatire obwakire naki mwaki kosiya.
Dholuo: Dawu Manyuongi k'Okwan Gi ICT kod software development e Kiambu National Polytechnic, iwuok chiemo program machal. Kaka, ng'ama iwinjore e chike kod wendo mar joma imar gi nyithindo.
Somali: Ardayda ICT iyo horumarinta software-ka ee Kiambu National Polytechnic waxay ka faa'iidaysan doonaan barnaamij cusub oo laba-jibbaaran, kaasoo isugu jira waxbarasho fasalka iyo khibrad warshadeed oo dhab ah.

English: The Educating Linda Programme offers annual scholarships to 47 academically gifted, financially disadvantaged Kenyan schoolgirls. Apply now to support girls' education in Kenya.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Kuelimisha Linda unatoa ufadhili wa kila mwaka kwa wasichana 47 wa Kikenya wenye uwezo wa kiakademia lakini wanakabiliwa na changamoto za kifedha. Omba sasa ili kusaidia elimu ya wasichana nchini Kenya.
Ekegusii: Pogramu ya Kwigisha Linda inagashotia majaribu ekiboko 47 abaki bategauria, naki ekibere eria bwaki omogori kiijia ke Kenyanya. Naki omokanya nyaraki goabaki mwene egesang'oti buye.
Dholuo: Programme educa Linda owinjore tich ma okinyi chike mar 47 ma chike kod piero mag tich gi otieno. Abiro in gi karuok ma ineno gi edhika mar kadi gi goyo ma tich Kenya.
Somali: Barnaamijka Waxbarashada Linda wuxuu bixiya deeqo sanadle ah oo loogu talagalay 47 gabdhood oo Soomaaliyeed oo leh xirfado tacliimeed wanaagsan, laakiin ka maqan taageero dhaqaale. Codso hadda si aad u taageerto waxbarashada gabdhaha Kenya.

English: The NextGen.Ke Youth Employment Programme is now available for 15,000 university and TVET graduates, offering 12-month stipend-supported workplace placements. Apply for the pilot phase starting now.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Ajira wa NextGen.Ke sasa upo kwa wahitimu 15,000 wa vyuo vikuu na TVET, ukitoa nafasi za kazi za miezi 12 zenye udhamini wa posho. Omba kwa awamu ya jaribio inayanzia sasa.
Ekegusii: NextGen.Ke Buya bwaki bwaki bosi bw'oshure na 15,000 abaki b'ekiserani na TVET, baki na okiri b'ekegondo b'akiyorie obwakire bw'iboka bw'etabukire busi. Haki duka buya bwakire bw'ogosi.
Dholuo: NextGen.Ke Youth Employment Programme nyalo gimare mo 15,000 kuom chalo kod TVET, ichiko ng'ato maler mar 12 miyo. Konyi mar pilot kuom nango.
Somali: Barnaamijka Hubinta Shaqooyinka Dhallinyarada NextGen.Ke ayaa hadda la heli karaa 15,000 oo ka qalinjabisay jaamacadaha iyo xarumaha TVET, isagoo bixinaya meel shaqo oo lagu taageerayo mushaar 12 bilood ah. Codso wakiilada horumarinta hadda.

English: Teachers, remember that your words have the power to shape a learner's future. Use them wisely to inspire confidence and ambition in every student.
Kiswahili: Walimu, kumbukeni kwamba maneno yenu yana nguvu ya kubadilisha maisha ya mwanafunzi. Tumia maneno hayo kwa hekima ili kuhamasisha ujasiri na malengo katika kila mwanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Abakiriri, mwakire buya naki chire chinu ching'anya omokiri. Makiere buya buya kuchireka naki ikirori na obororere mumaki.
Dholuo: Walimu, chier duto tuchuno kata godi chikeyo tinde. Konyo tinde ma ok wacho mar wahinya kuom jowuok duto.
Somali: Macallimiinta, xasuusta in erayadiinnu ay awood u leeyihiin inay qaabeeyaan mustaqbalka ardayga. Si xikmad leh u isticmaal si aad u dhiirrigeliso kalsoonida iyo hiyi arday kasta.

English: Graduates are reminded to wear their official gowns and caps during the graduation ceremony to uphold tradition and signify their academic achievements.
Kiswahili: Wahitimu wanakumbushwa kuvaa mavazi rasmi na kofia zao wakati wa sherehe ya kuhitimu ili kudumisha desturi na kuashiria mafanikio yao ya kitaaluma.
Ekegusii: Abagurani batarige kugana amaguru na masabo yabo oria bategereire buya bu granduashoni, omokinyanirire omokong’ena na buya bwokire bu mang’ana.
Dholuo: Matiro nyaka gichongo gi ng'ama duto kendo dende magi kuom yoho mar graduu kendo kuom ng'ama e bende otemo e piny.
Somali: Dhalinyarada qalinjabisay ayaa lagu wargelinayaa inay xirtaan goonnada iyo koofiyadaha rasmiga ah inta lagu jiro xafladda qalinjebinta si loo ilaaliyo caadooyinka iyo muujinta guulahooda waxbarasho.

English: Community members are urged to support students in Homa Bay who qualified for higher education but lack funding. Donations of financial contributions and learning materials are needed. A fundraising event will take place on July 31, 2026, at Governors Park in Homa Bay Town.
Kiswahili: Wanajamii wanahimizwa kuwasaidia wanafunzi wa Homa Bay ambao wamestahiki kujiunga na elimu ya juu lakini hawana ufadhili. Mchango wa fedha na vifaa vya kujifunzia unahitajika. Tukio la kukusanya fedha litaandaliwa tarehe 31 Julai 2026, katika Governors Park katika Mji wa Homa Bay.
Ekegusii: Abanegere bakang'ana batariania banchere babo chabi bw’aki anake mokwenyegire kwomotibori bwanomwe bu Homa Bay bengine aseria oria bagenge emwaki. Naki bwaki ba biogire, eng'ono, na ebirori bwaki buarima. Oboragabani bwaki bungi bujengire ku Julai 31, 2026, bu Governors Park bu Homa Bay Town.
Dholuo: Dhokange dede toiyore gi wasomaji e Homa Bay ma ok nyal duok e chako. Tiyo madhi dondo gi joma nyaluok gi yore duto. Kaka nyise ochiemo madhi e yo 31, 2026, e Governors Park e Homa Bay Town.
Somali: Bulshada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay taageeraan ardayda Homa Bay ee ka qaybqaadatay waxbarashada sare laakiin aan haysan maalgelin. Lacagaha deeqda ah iyo agabka waxbarashada ayaa loo baahan yahay. Dhacdo ururinta lacagta ayaa lagu qaban doonaa July 31, 2026, ee Governors Park ee Homa Bay Town.

English: Healthcare workers in Migori are invited to participate in continuing medical education and mentorship programs funded by the TramutoPorter Foundation at Lwala Community Hospital.
Kiswahili: Wafanyakazi wa afya katika Migori wanakaribishwa kuhudhuria mafunzo ya kuendelea ya matibabu na programu za uongozi zilizofadhiliwa na Msingi wa TramutoPorter katika Hospitali ya Jamii ya Lwala.
Ekegusii: Abanyakuri boko Migori barekera kuingia mu edugusi mosugu na oria bwire boki oria mwena TramutoPorter Foundation bueri Lwala Community Hospital.
Dholuo: Bwakher mwaki ku Migori nyaka ka gweno konyo kaka dhok magi keto vyoma kor koth ralruok kod masenene mar TramutoPorter Foundation ka Lwala Community Hospital.
Somali: Shaqaalaha caafimaadka ee Migori waxaa lagu casuumay inay ka qeybqaataan barnaamijyada waxbarashada caafimaadka joogtada ah iyo barnaamijyada hagidda ee ay maalgeliso Hay'adda TramutoPorter oo ka socda Isbitaalka Bulshada ee Lwala.

English: The Senate Committee on Education urges urgent investment in ECDE centres and vocational institutions in Bomet County to improve infrastructure and learning conditions.
Kiswahili: Kamati ya Seneti kuhusu Elimu inaomba uwekezaji wa haraka katika vituo vya ECDE na taasisi za ufundi katika Kaunti ya Bomet ili kuboresha miundombinu na hali ya kujifunzia.
Ekegusii: Omochokire bw'abe Bunge buya bw'amasomo boria bwanera ikikire omotirimbia omokiriri mu masomo ne ohaki bwanera mu Bomet County kuga bw'aki naki oria bw'egonde.
Dholuo: Komiti ya Seneti kuom Uthiego bor gi chongo nyaka pesa mwak oro ECDE machalo e Bomet County to yende mingo nyaka gi dhako magu e giko duto.
Somali: Guddiga Senate-ka ee Waxbarashada ayaa ku baaqaya in si degdeg ah loo maalgeliyo xarumaha ECDE iyo machadyada xirfadaha ee Bomet si loo hagaajiyo kaabayaasha iyo xaaladaha waxbarasho.

English: The official handover of the Vice-Chancellor's office from Prof. Ipara to Prof. Makhanu Sibilikhe will take place on July 28, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. in the University Senate Boardroom.
Kiswahili: Kukabidhi rasmi ofisi ya Makao Makuu ya Naibu Chansela kutoka Prof. Ipara kwa Prof. Makhanu Sibilikhe kutafanyika tarehe 28 Julai 2026, saa 4:00 asubuhi, katika Chumba cha Baraza la Seneti la Chuo Kikuu.
Ekegusii: Kigori kinyasa kiabaki bw'ogenda bw'ogenda bw'oVice-Chancellor buya Prof. Ipara buya Prof. Makhanu Sibilikhe buya kiana ki oingo July 28, 2026, buya bw'o10:00 a.m. buya buya University Senate Boardroom.
Dholuo: Handover makelo mar Vice-Chancellor man gi Prof. Ipara to Prof. Makhanu Sibilikhe nyaka Ombare olok kuom Jula 28, 2026, ni 10:00 a.m. e University Senate Boardroom.
Somali: Gudbinta rasmiga ah ee xafiiska Kuxigeenka Madaxda Jaamacadda ayaa ka dhici doonta Prof. Ipara ilaa Prof. Makhanu Sibilikhe 28-da Luulyo, 2026, saacadda 10:00 subaxnimo ee Qolka Golaha Senatiga Jaamacadda.

English: Parents and community members are urged to actively engage with children during the August holiday to foster character development and emotional wellbeing. Take this time to reinforce values and habits.
Kiswahili: Wazazi na wanajamii wanahimizwa kujihusisha kikamilifu na watoto wakati wa likizo ya Agosti ili kuimarisha ukuaji wa tabia na ustawi wa kihisia. Tumia muda huu kuimarisha maadili na tabia.
Ekegusii: Abakire nakiendechi bano bataritane buya na bana bwonthe buya bwakiuga buya mu mwaki wa August omokiri ogokora gucokireri charita na omokiryogori. Nyasa oni oekire buya na amenye.
Dholuo: Odadgi gi bende ma pari, nyaka in e kendo orwaki kaka in e yo mar August, nyaka igowe gi chochora mwand gi chando modhiambo. Konyo nyaka in timbe gi dhozi kendo gichandi.
Somali: Waaliyiinta iyo xubnaha bulshada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay si firfircoon uga qayb qaataan carruurta inta lagu jiro fasaxa August si ay u taageeraan horumarinta dabeecadda iyo caafimaadka dareenka. Waqtigan qaado si aad u xoojiso qiyamka iyo caadooyinka.

English: The Government proposes a Tertiary Education Fund to expand financial support for students in universities and TVETs. Eligible students are encouraged to apply for assistance once approved.
Kiswahili: Serikali inapendekeza Mfuko wa Elimu ya Juu ili kuongeza msaada wa kifedha kwa wanafunzi katika vyuo vikuu na vituo vya ufundi. Wanafunzi wanaostahiki wanahimizwa kuomba msaada mara tu watakapokubaliwa.
Ekegusii: Abagere bataruri bano na buya bweng'ena buya bwanene bwagere buya kubwonego bwakibori bwomotimetraki na TVETs. Abato bano abakorenda buya baria bwanene baisia kuchakire kubwonego once bwairori.
Dholuo: Gavumenti otimone fundi mar edukeshon mag tero kuom nyaka eyo nyaka yore eyoji manadho chiegni kendo TVETs. Wandiga ma gikonyo kendo ginemisele ginyalo kanyakore kuom yore manadho oyunji.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay soo jeedinaysaa Fondh Tertiary Education si loo ballaariyo taageerada maaliyadeed ee ardayda jaamacadaha iyo TVET-yada. Ardayda u qalma ayaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay codsadaan taageero markii la ansixiyo.

English: Effective school leadership is crucial for institutional growth. Schools are encouraged to foster strong leadership to unlock their untapped potential and facilitate meaningful progress.
Kiswahili: Uongozi mzuri shuleni ni muhimu kwa ukuzaji wa taasisi. Shule zinahimizwa kukuza uongozi imara ili kufungua uwezo wao ambao haujatumika na kuwezesha maendeleo ya maana.
Ekegusii: Ongorori bw'eshule ekyekirori ebindire enkiro ya bwakire. Abeshule bakenyerere kugaka orokore ogotang'anya abyobori buya buoba omogore tessore.
Dholuo: Orii chike koro ok owuok forogo chalo. Masomo en zindruok kanyari nigi chike ma ok odhi nyalo ng'wech gi pwodo to gichung' gi ng'ati duto.
Somali: Hogaaminta dugsiga ayaa muhiim u ah koritaanka hay'adaha. Waxay dugsiyada ku boorinayaan inay xoojiyan hogaaminta si ay u furtaan awoodahooda aan la isticmaali karin iyo in ay fududeeyaan horumar macno leh.

English: The revised university funding model will provide tailored financial assistance based on students' socio-economic circumstances, increasing support for those from low-income families.
Kiswahili: Mfumo mpya wa ufadhili wa vyuo vikuu utaweza kutoa msaada wa kifedha unaokidhi mahitaji kulingana na hali ya kijamii na kiuchumi ya wanafunzi, ukiongeza msaada kwa wale kutoka familia zenye kipato cha chini.
Ekegusii: Ekirocha naki ekegana bw’oseria buya bwakinyige buya buwakore buya bakinyamaki batarugwa, kwegana boa bugetarugani bwekinyamatoki bwakigana bia batarugwa.
Dholuo: Modudho ma wuedhi gi chiegni mar iniversiti nyaka nymoro kanyal mar kang'erego bura, kendo wadhoma ma nyaka bedo gumo kanyal mar nitie ma nyalo konyo.
Somali: Habka maalgelinta jaamacadda ee la hagaajiyay wuxuu bixinayaa gargaarka maaliyadeed ee khaaska ah oo ku saleysan xaaladaha bulsho-dhaqaale ee ardayda, isagoo kor u qaadaya taageerada kuwa ka yimaada qoysaska dakhligoodu yar yahay.

English: Schools are reminded to design educational trips that enhance curriculum delivery and learner development. Ensure these trips focus on real-world experiences and align with national education goals.
Kiswahili: Shule zinaonywa kuandaa safari za kielimu zinazoongeza utoaji wa mtaala na maendeleo ya wanafunzi. Hakikisha safari hizi zinazingatia uzoefu wa ulimwengu halisi na zinaendana na malengo ya elimu ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Masuku naki bwakire boki bwanene boro buya bwaki bwire bwang'enda ne busechi bwaki bwokire buya, na busane buya bwaki na sheria daki naki. Tora buya bwaki bwang'enda boki busechere naki buya buya bwokiri bwanene.
Dholuo: Mga kwandeni koyo mwaki mang'era ji bende bende mang'wech kuom nyiri masomo mang'eyo kendo nyiri gi kendo. Konyo piny duto joma makare akwan komi kendo ni gik ma ginyalo timo kendo giyiero ni nyaka ginyal chier makelo.
Somali: Dugsiyada waxaa lagu xusuusinayaa in ay qorsheeyaan safarro waxbarasho oo kor u qaadaya cashar-bixinta iyo horumarinta ardayda. Hubi in safarradan ay diiradda saaraan khibradaha dhabta ah oo ay waafaqsan yihiin yoolalka waxbarashada qaranka.

English: Chepchoina, Njoro, Titimet, and Chepsalei Secondary Schools have received new buses to improve student transport for academic trips and co-curricular activities.
Kiswahili: Shule za Sekondari Chepchoina, Njoro, Titimet, na Chepsalei zimepokea mabasi mapya kuboresha usafiri wa wanafunzi kwa safari za masomo na shughuli za ziada.
Ekegusii: Masomo ma Chepchoina, Njoro, Titimet, na Chepsalei bayarire bosi buya bwakure bwong'ene bwakiere bwaburori buya.
Dholuo: Chepchoina, Njoro, Titimet, ne Chepsalei Secondary Schools nyalo winjruok bus ma okonyi nyalo weche dhok kuom chula magi kod nyako maber.
Somali: Dugsiyada Sare ee Chepchoina, Njoro, Titimet, iyo Chepsalei ayaa helay basas cusub si loo hagaajiyo gaadiidka ardayda ee safarada tacliinta iyo hawlaha isboortiga.

English: The government will fully support students admitted to public universities, colleges, and TVET institutions regardless of financial background.
Kiswahili: Serikali itawasaidia kabisa wanafunzi walioandikishwa katika vyuo vikuu vya umma, vyuo, na taasisi za TVET bila kujali hali yao ya kifedha.
Ekegusii: Abakonjwa bataria bwakirori bwokire oburegi bosi bwokirori bosi bwakire, bwaki naki abaki bonyaki mirongo.
Dholuo: Chandruok magweno nigi chiemo chiegni kuom jotieno mar public universities, colleges, kod TVET institutions, kendo pod ng'ato timbe kendo chike mang'ere.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay si buuxda u taageeri doontaa ardayda lagu qaatay jaamacadaha, kulliyadaha, iyo hay'adaha TVET, iyadoo aan loo eegin asalka dhaqaale.

English: Young people in Keumbu are encouraged to enroll in local Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) institutions to acquire skills for economic independence.
Kiswahili: Vijana wa Keumbu wanahimizwa kujiunga na taasisi za Teknolojia na Mafunzo ya Ufundi (TVET) za hapa ili kupata ujuzi wa kujitegemea kiuchumi.
Ekegusii: Abaki bantarire bu Keumbu baria bakenye buengegi bwaki botalia abarigiriri bakanegeri abateka na bwaki bwagere bu nyasa.
Dholuo: Dala duto ni kuom Keumbu ochung' eyo mar ng'ato nene to en mana kuom gondo mag Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) to goro tich kanyo.
Somali: Dhalinyarada ku sugan Keumbu waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay iska diiwaan geliyaan hay'adaha Tacliinta Farsamada iyo Tababarka (TVET) si ay u helaan xirfadaha madax-bannaanida dhaqaale.

English: Teachers are encouraged to prepare for retirement early by cultivating a saving culture, investing wisely, and planning for continued professional growth. Start your retirement plan today.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanahimizwa kujiandaa kwa kustaafu mapema kwa kukuza tamaduni za akiba, kuwekeza kwa busara, na kupanga ukuaji wa kitaaluma endelevu. Anza mpango wako wa kustaafu leo.
Ekegusii: Abakopesi batosetegana boki bw'oko bw'ogetoro bosi abirire omokogo, bagenyeri omokosi, batangire busekwetere bw'ogetoro bwachiengo. Bwakere eng'ene otenye!
Dholuo: Mwalimu yore magi nyiso bura maler gi wach kod nyaka oneni, jochalre gi tich ma ok gremo, kendo nyaka omego lweny mag pinje. Jiarno nyalo adier gi bura!
Somali: Macallimiinta waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay si dhaqso ah ugu diyaar garoobaan hawlgabka iyagoo dhisaya dhaqanka kaydinta, maalgashiga si xikmad leh, iyo qorshaynta koritaanka xirfadeed ee joogtada ah. Ku bilow qorshahaaga hawlgabka maanta.

English: The government and education stakeholders are urged to prioritize infrastructure improvements in Samburu County schools, including dormitories and libraries, to support academic excellence.
Kiswahili: Serikali na wadau wa elimu wanaombwa kuweka kipaumbele kwa maboresho ya miundombinu katika shule za Kaunti ya Samburu, ikiwemo mabweni na maktaba, ili kusaidia ufahamivu wa kitaaluma.
Ekegusii: Abagere na abaki bwiisi baire omokirigania khwihondeza hinyate za inki bwakire mu masomo eSamburu, gana tenda na masome, buya geke ohuchi bwakire bw'ogenda.
Dholuo: Kik dongo mago marahuma kod jomatindo marweny kuom gima koro ahinya gi infrastructure mar Sudan nene e Samburu County, nadiro dormitories gi libraries, to nyal gi academic excellence.
Somali: Dowladda iyo daneeyayaasha waxbarashada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay mudnaanta siiyaan horumarinta kaabayaasha dugsiyada ee Gobolka Samburu, oo ay ku jiraan hoyga ardayda iyo maktabadaha, si loo taageero heerka waxbarashada.

English: The KUCCPS portal is now open for KMTC applications for the September 2026 intake, running until August 11, 2026. Eligible applicants are KCSE graduates from 2000 to 2025.
Kiswahili: Portal ya KUCCPS sasa iko wazi kwa maombi ya KMTC kwa ajili ya waandikishaji wa Septemba 2026, ambayo itaendelea hadi Agosti 11, 2026. Waombaji wenye haki ni wahitimu wa KCSE kuanzia mwaka 2000 hadi 2025.
Ekegusii: Portal ya KUCCPS ikianyakiore buya maviya ya KMTC ya gotiriya mwaki wa September 2026, ikingana naki mwaki wa August 11, 2026. Abaki bakanoria naki naki nakiinyire KCSE bosi bosi buya 2000 kosi 2025.
Dholuo: Portal ya KUCCPS yawuok giyudhi kuom applications mag KMTC gi September 2026, kendo nigi gi August 11, 2026. Wang'ni itiyo ema ni KCSE graduates manom 2000 to 2025.
Somali: Albaabka KUCCPS hadda wuu furan yahay codsiyada KMTC ee qaadashada Sebtember 2026, waxaana soconaya ilaa Ogosto 11, 2026. Codsadayaasha u qalma waa dhammaan ardayda ka qalin jebisay KCSE intii u dhaxaysay 2000 ilaa 2025.

English: The Kenya National Union of Teachers (KNUT) has elected new regional officials in the Rift Valley. All members are encouraged to support the newly elected leaders.
Kiswahili: Shirikisho la Walimu wa Kenya (KNUT) limechagua viongozi wapya wa kanda katika Bonde la Ufa. Wanachama wote wanahimizwa kuunga mkono viongozi wapya waliochaguliwa.
