Ekegusii: Abaki bwenyene bwi Kenya National Union of Teachers (KNUT) bakanyire abaki boire bakanana bu Rift Valley. Abaki genda bekorere abaki bwenyene boire.
Dholuo: Kenya National Union of Teachers (KNUT) abed gi jaluo mag nyaka e Rift Valley. Won kanyo chalo dwondgi gi ji miyo chalo nyaka.
Somali: Ururka Macalimiinta Qaranka ee Kenya (KNUT) ayaa dooratay madax cusub oo gobolleed ku yaal Rift Valley. Dhamaan xubnaha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay taageeraan hoggaamiyayaasha cusub ee la doortay.

English: The Kenya National Union of Teachers (KNUT) is conducting Rift Valley Regional leadership elections. All teachers are encouraged to participate and support their union's efforts for improved welfare.
Kiswahili: Shirikisho la Walimu Kenya (KNUT) linafanya uchaguzi wa uongozi wa Kanda ya Bonde la Ufa. Walimu wote wanahimizwa kushiriki na kuunga mkono juhudi za shirikisho lao kwa ajili ya kuboresha ustawi.
Ekegusii: Abakoro abaki Kenya National Union of Teachers (KNUT) bonyaki buya butaka bwa Rift Valley. Abakoro bose baishire omokire ogwaki na baborori omokirangia bw'ogendi.
Dholuo: Kenya National Union of Teachers (KNUT) ne oketho gima joma tich kuom Rift Valley. Gik ma joma tich nyaka omiya kuom weche magoya nochiko e kwayo.
Somali: Ururka Qaranka ee Macallimiinta Kenya (KNUT) wuxuu qabanayaa doorashooyinka hogaaminta gobolka Rift Valley. Dhammaan macallimiinta waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan oo ay taageeraan dadaallada ururkooda ee corashadooda.

English: Equity Group Holdings and AMREF International University have signed a five-year agreement to enhance healthcare education and innovation across Africa.
Kiswahili: Equity Group Holdings na AMREF International University wametia saini makubaliano ya miaka mitano kujenga elimu ya afya na uvumbuzi kote Afrika.
Ekegusii: Equity Group Holdings na AMREF International University baragani bw'ekegumu bw'amekebwaki omogori naki ogenda bwaneni bwanakire kareka ogwoge buya buya na enyakere.
Dholuo: Equity Group Holdings kod AMREF International University ne oying' gitione mar mwaka tano upang’ chuny help kare nyithindo gi inonyo matek kanyakla Africa.
Somali: Equity Group Holdings iyo Jaamacadda AMREF International ayaa saxiixay heshiis shan sano ah si kor loogu qaado waxbarashada caafimaadka iyo hal-abuurka across Afrika.

English: Over 100,000 teachers have been recruited in Kenya since 2020, with an additional 20,000 expected next year. This initiative aims to improve staffing in public schools.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya walimu 100,000 wametumiwa nchini Kenya tangu mwaka wa 2020, na 20,000 zaidi wanatarajiwa mwakani. Hii ni juhudi ya kuboresha ajira kwenye shule za umma.
Ekegusii: Abagere 100,000 bakiere omosiri Kisii mokigo 2020, na omosiri 20,000 bantedekire omoka omokiri. Egesagwaki nigo etaga abandu bakanarie mu masomo omogere.
Dholuo: Juma 100,000 kindergadi oter e Kenya kanyo gi 2020, ni 20,000 nofweny gi chalo mosando. Gik ma okonyo ni ng’ato nodhi gi dwondu e maber e shule owang'ni.
Somali: In ka badan 100,000 macallin ayaa lagu shaqaaleysiiyay Kenya tan iyo 2020, iyadoo 20,000 kale la filayo sanadka dambe. Howlgalkaan waxa uu ujeedkiisu yahay in lagu hagaajiyo shaqaaleynta dugsiyada dadweynaha.

English: The Meru County Assembly has approved the disbursement of bursary funds for needy learners. Eligible students and parents should anticipate assistance soon, pending approval from the Controller of Budget.
Kiswahili: Bunge la Kaunti ya Meru limeidhinisha utoaji wa fedha za ufadhili kwa wanafunzi wahitaji. Wanafunzi na wazazi wanaostahiki wanapaswa kutarajia msaada hivi karibuni, baada ya kupitishwa na Mweka Hazina.
Ekegusii: Abwaki bwa Meru buya naki bwakirori obwakinyegera bwakona buya ekinyanga kisuma kene. Abarema buya naki abaki buya bosi oria buyaoche bwaki, tusi buya bwakino naki buya naki bwaki bwakinyange.
Dholuo: Meru County Assembly nonyono yie to gonda bursary ng'ato kanyo ma obir. Kido kuom mag kido kendo ma ginyalo ganda to ok ongi, kendo godo konyruok e Controller of Budget.
Somali: Golaha Deegaanka Meru ayaa ansixinaya in lacagta bursary-ga loogu deeqo ardayda baahan. Ardayda iyo waalidiinta u qalma waa inay sugtaan caawimaad dhawaan, iyadoo sugashada ansixinta ka timaadda Maamulka Miisaaniyadda.

English: West Pokot County has launched a major distribution of 400 ECDE chairs and play equipment to Early Childhood Development Education centres in Sook and Endough Wards.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya West Pokot imezindua usambazaji mkubwa wa viti 400 vya ECDE na vifaa vya michezo kwa vituo vya Elimu ya Maendeleo ya Utotoni katika Mitaa ya Sook na Endough.
Ekegusii: Omoiyaki moke minto West Pokot osetoraki ekere 400 emosiine na erigorioka naki enyancha zia kianjogoo ya Ekidogo cha Moitokori mu Sook na Endough.
Dholuo: West Pokot County owdhi madibor gi jomoko 400 ECDE ng’ato kod piny mar ji waura kuom Early Childhood Development Education centres e Sook kod Endough Wards.
Somali: Gobolka West Pokot ayaa bilaabay qaybinta weyn ee 400 kuraas ECDE iyo agabyada ciyaaraha ee xarumaha Waxbarashada Horumarinta Carruurta ee ku yaal Sook iyo Endough Wards.

English: The NextGen.KE youth employment programme is now open, targeting 30,000 beneficiaries for paid internships and skills training. Apply now to secure your future in the job market.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa ajira wa NextGen.KE kwa vijana sasa umefunguliwa, ukiwalenga wanufaika 30,000 kwa mafunzo ya kazi na ujuzi. Jisajili sasa ili kuhakikisha mustakabali wako kwenye soko la ajira.
Ekegusii: Programu ya ajira ya NextGen.KE ya vijana sasa imefunguliwa, ikilenga wanufaika 30,000 kwa mafunzo ya kazi na ujuzi. Tuma maombi sasa ili kujiwekea mustakabali mzuri kwenye soko la ajira.
Dholuo: NextGen.KE program ma nyalo tuo oganda mono, timore gi 30,000 nyalo timo ji for internshipo duto gi dhok ma okore. Bolo chalo konyo e kamano to nyaka ugi kido chuno.
Somali: Barnaamijka shaqo-abuurka dhallinyarada NextGen.KE hadda waa furan, isagoo higsanaya 30,000 oo ka faa'iidaysanaya tababaro lacag leh iyo tababaro xirfadeed. Codso hadda si aad u hubiso mustaqbalkaaga suuqa shaqada.

English: Tenwek High School will play a friendly match against Mara Sugar FC tomorrow at Silibwet Stadium, starting at 10:00 a.m. This is part of their preparations for the KSSSA National Term Two Games.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Upili ya Tenwek itacheza mechi ya kirafiki dhidi ya Mara Sugar FC kesho katika Uwanja wa Silibwet, kuanzia saa nne asubuhi. Hii ni sehemu ya maandalizi yao kwa Mchezo wa Kitaifa wa KSSSA wa Kipindi cha Pili.
Ekegusii: Tenwek High School ikikina buya kegarama na Mara Sugar FC buya kesibori chike tichang'ani Silibwet Stadium, kiahaki 10:00 a.m. Iyi ne egia oria nakukina bwogori bwakana KSSSA National Term Two Games.
Dholuo: Tenwek High School oketho gamo maler gi Mara Sugar FC buo kendo chienge chuo kuom Silibwet Stadium, nigi piny 10:00 a.m. Nii ni mwakango mar KSSSA National Term Two Games.
Somali: Iskuulka Sare ee Tenwek wuxuu ciyaar saaxiibtinimo la yeelan doonaa Mara Sugar FC berri ee Stadium Silibwet, laga bilaabayo saacadda 10:00 subaxnimo. Tani waxay qayb ka tahay diyaar-garowgooda Ciyaaraha Qaran ee KSSSA ee Term Labaad.

English: Parents and students affected by the KSh1 billion Finland education scam are encouraged to demand refunds from the county government. A protest is planned for next Tuesday.
Kiswahili: Wazazi na wanafunzi waliothirika na udanganyifu wa elimu wa KSh1 bilioni kutoka Finland wanahimizwa kudai marejesho kutoka kwa serikali ya kaunti. Maandamano yanapangwa kufanyika Jumanne ijayo.
Ekegusii: Abarera na abana bakiibori ekonoria ya KSh1 billion buya bwa Finnish bokiire bwakora nyamunyeka obwakire bwaki pire oga omogori ogete. Omoige buya bukirori bwaki omitunganiria rukorome rwokiga buya.
Dholuo: Wuon mokweya abor gi jukiner ji mag KSh1 billion kuom Finland ma okonyore, nyis bende gi sunga kuom owang' ping' wangu. Ndalo motegno ni bende giyere kar koyo ngalato mar ter.
Somali: Waalidiinta iyo ardayda ay saameysay khiyaamo waxbarasho oo ka dhacday Finland oo qiimaheedu yahay KSh1 bilyan waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa in ay codsadaan lacagtooda dib loogu soo celiyo dowladda hoose. Banaanbax ayaa la qorsheynayaa Talaadada soo socota.

English: Schools in North Eastern are prohibited from charging students for participation in co-curricular activities. Parents should report any illegal levies to the Ministry of Education.
Kiswahili: Shule za Kaskazini Mashariki zina marufuku ya kuwalipisha wanafunzi kwa ushiriki katika shughuli za ziada. Wazazi wanapaswa kuripoti malipo yasiyo halali kwa Wizara ya Elimu.
Ekegusii: Amakora gaki bukaranga bukhure mu North Eastern barimaki ogotega abaki bosi kuhogora mwaki bwogekorane. Abagaka baria boro nyaki naki buya buya buya buya bwogekorane buya bosi boro nyaki mwogana buya Ministry of Education.
Dholuo: Masomo e North Eastern ok nyal golo chuno piny kendo koro ji mar co-curricular activities. Wazazi oyie nyalo kede kanyo kanyengo mar nyaka ma ok nyal buo kuom Ministry of Education.
Somali: Dugsiyada waqooyi-bari waa mamnuuc in ay ardayda ka qaadaan lacag ka qaybgalka hawlaha isboorti. Waalidiintu waa inay soo gudbiyaan wax kasta oo lacag maxkamad ah oo sharci darro ah Wasaaradda Waxbarashada.

English: The Ministry of Education acknowledges the vital role of Curriculum Support Officers (CSOs) in schools. Support and resources are available for their welfare and professional development.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inatambua umuhimu wa Maafisa Waandaji wa Mitaala (CSOs) shuleni. Msaada na rasilimali zipo kwa ajili ya ustawi na maendeleo yao ya kitaaluma.
Ekegusii: Wabere buya bw'ekegero e Kebose e naki bwamaki bosi buse kerubori omokoro wa Curriculum Support Officers (CSOs) abaki mwaki. Bwakanyanre bw'ekegoro na masoko biri omanye buya bw'ose etegene bosi.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education ochiwo ka Curriculum Support Officers (CSOs) ne ok ni mondo oduogo sa. Gik ma oketo ogend ang'wen e kitegi kendo kuom ma nyal oting'oni.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay garowsan tahay doorka muhiimka ah ee Sarkaalka Taageerada Manhajka (CSOs) ee iskuulada. Taageero iyo kheyraad ayaa diyaar u ah wanaagga iyo horumarinta xirfadeedkooda.

English: Archbishop Njenga Girls will compete for the KSSSA national girls' football title starting July 4 at M-Pesa Academy after winning the regional championship.
Kiswahili: Wasichana wa Archbishop Njenga watachuana kwa taji la kitaifa la soka la wasichana la KSSSA kuanzia Julai 4 katika Chuo cha M-Pesa baada ya kushinda michuano ya kikanda.
Ekegusii: Abishop Njenga Girls batorera ekegero kosi kosi ya bano b’abbosibori batiokorie naki Juli 4 kwomok M-Pesa Academy bui &lemo bano b’abbosibori.
Dholuo: Archbishop Njenga Girls nyalo yudi k'Omboko ma k'oti KSSSA mar girls' football chwech moloyo July 4 e M-Pesa Academy nyaka owinjore chwech mar region.
Somali: Sareedna Njenga Gabarada waxay tartami doonaan horyaalka kubbadda cagta ee KSSSA, bilowda July 4, xarunta M-Pesa Academy ka dib markii ay ku guuleysteen horyaalka goboleedka.

English: The government plans to establish the Tertiary Education Funding Authority (TEFA), dissolving HELB, the Universities Fund, and the TVET Fund. More details will follow regarding student support.
Kiswahili: Serikali inapanga kuanzisha Mamlaka ya Ufadhili wa Elimu ya Juu (TEFA), ikivunja HELB, Mfuko wa Vyuo Vikuu, na Mfuko wa TVET. Maelezo zaidi yatatolewa kuhusu msaada wa wanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Abagere batagania kuchanguria Tathi obwakire bu Tertiary Education Funding Authority (TEFA), bujejuja HELB, Obwakire bwabachenga, na Obwakire bwaku TVET. Amakori manene omogendeorere kuchinda abaturia.
Dholuo: Government en bedo gi tielo mar Tertiary Education Funding Authority (TEFA), kendo HELB, Universities Fund, kod TVET Fund ne okelo. Nanga chako ma jopiny otimo buoi kuom ndalo.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay qorsheyneysaa inay aasaasto Hay’adda Maaliyadda Waxbarashada Sare (TEFA), iyada oo la burburinayo HELB, Fadhiyada Jaamacadaha, iyo Fadhiga TVET. Faahfaahin dheeraad ah ayaa soo socota oo ku saabsan taageerada ardayda.

English: Tengecha Girls' High School is fully operational with uninterrupted learning; ignore false closure claims circulating on social media.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Sekondari ya Wasichana ya Tengecha inafanya kazi kikamilifu bila kuingiliwa kwa masomo; puuza madai ya uongo kuhusu kufungwa yanayosambazwa kwenye mitandao ya kijamii.
Ekegusii: Tengecha Girls' High School ikigana naki, oria ogaki naki. Oigana buya omokinyere buya omorori ogena omokiri goro.
Dholuo: Tengecha Girls' High School oting' kode e mangu; ng'ato onge choro mar konyo chalo ma ohinga e social media.
Somali: Tengecha Gabaraha Dugsiga Sare waxay si buuxda u shaqaynaysaa iyadoo aan la joojin waxbarashada; iska ilaali sheegashada been abuurka ah ee ku faafaya baraha bulshada.

English: The appointment of Wilson Sossion as a commissioner of the Teachers Service Commission (TSC) has been made; teachers can expect upcoming reforms to benefit the profession.
Kiswahili: Mteule wa Wilson Sossion kama kamishna wa Tume ya Huduma za Walimu (TSC) umefanyika; walimu wanaweza kutarajia mabadiliko yatakayofaidisha taaluma hiyo.
Ekegusii: Omosareri bwa Wilson Sossion ng'ani commissioner wa Teachers Service Commission (TSC) bwaki; abarori baki bakenyote omokiri bwaki burotora bwakire busekenye gaki.
Dholuo: Wang'ni Wilson Sossion kama komishina wa Teachers Service Commission (TSC) oreet; walimu en kony ndo ng'ato e tich kendo.
Somali: Wilson Sossion ayaa loo magacaabay komishan ka tirsan Guddiga Adeegga Macalimiinta (TSC); macalimiinta waxay filan karaan isbeddello soo socda oo faa'iido u yeelanaya профессiyanka.

English: Parents and students are reminded to make informed relationship choices during university education. Healthy relationships enrich campus life; avoid secrecy and manipulation to prevent costly consequences.
Kiswahili: Wazazi na wanafunzi wanakumbushwa kufanya maamuzi sahihi kuhusu mahusiano wakati wa masomo ya chuo kikuu. Mahusiano mazuri yanaboresha maisha ya chuo; epukeni usiri na udanganyifu ili kuepuka madhara ya gharama kubwa.
Ekegusii: Abakire na abakiisi baremiire kukwenda bwakire buya bwaki kiumia chintori chiri buya. Bwakire buya buya bwagororere buseme boki, ebwire buya buya bwokemokire, notera okoreri oborori bwaki.
Dholuo: Wang'ni gi waduong' mar kanyakla kuom ibiro wach mar nyaka konyo joma. Kanyal gi waduong' en joma, kit gi chalo mar nyaka dhok; nyal bik ang'eyo kendo chopo yore maluoro.
Somali: Waalidka iyo ardayda waxaa lagu xusuusinayaa in ay sameeyaan doorashooyin xog ogaal ah oo ku saabsan xiriirada inta lagu jiro waxbarashada jaamacadda. Xiriirada caafimaadka qaba waxay hodan ka dhigaan nolosha jaamacadda; iska ilaaliya qarsoodin iyo khiyaano si aad uga fogaato cawaaqib xun.

English: St. Patrick's High School-Iten remains closed due to a dormitory fire. All students have been sent home to ensure a thorough investigation and review of safety measures.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Upili ya St. Patrick-Iten imefungwa kutokana na moto uliozuka kwenye bweni. Wanafunzi wote wametumiwa nyumbani ili kuhakikisha uchunguzi wa kina na ukaguzi wa hatua za usalama.
Ekegusii: Shule ya Wasichana ya St. Patrick-Iten imefungwa kutokana na moto katika nyumba ya kulala wanafunzi. Wanafunzi wote wametumwa nyumbani ili kuhakikisha utafiti wa kina na mapitio ya hatua za usalama.
Dholuo: St. Patrick's High School-Iten neno ombulu ahinya kendo gathoruru chieko e chonge. Gik ma oganda ongi nigi mager kendo giyale mondo gichokore shok-gi kendo nyaka jomoko ne.
Somali: Dugsiga Sare ee St. Patrick-Iten ayaa xiran sababtoo ah dab ka kacay hostel-ka. Dhammaan ardayda ayaa la diray guryahooda si loo hubiyo baaritaan dhammeystiran iyo dib-u-eegis ku saabsan hannaanada badbaadada.

English: Free sanitary towels are now available for vulnerable schoolgirls at Ngundu Primary School as part of the OMANGA Care Initiative. Ensure your daughters benefit from this program for better menstrual hygiene.
Kiswahili: Nafasi za taulo za kike bure sasa zinapatikana kwa wasichana wa shule walio katika mazingira magumu katika Shule ya Msingi Ngundu kama sehemu ya Mpango wa OMANGA Care. Hakikisha wana daughters zako wanapata faida kutoka kwa mpango huu kwa usafi bora wakati wa hedhi.
Ekegusii: Abagatano buya bosi bwabere buya buya ku ng'endo ya ng'endo omokiriri ogokenga Ngundu Primary School, buya buya bw'OMANGA Care Initiative. Itarori oigana bosi ogendaka buya buya buya buya obwakere bw'oguchi bwong'enda bosi.
Dholuo: Kisumu sani ituwore mag pi bende owano kuom nongo duka matut ma Ngundu Primary School nyaka yore kanyo OMANGA Care Initiative. Nyer auma kuom dhano chiegni golo wacho duogo ma wanj kinde.
Somali: Jaantusyo bilaash ah ayaa hadda diyaar ah oo loogu talagalay gabaraha iskuulka ee nugul ee ku sugan Dugsiga Hoose ee Ngundu iyadoo qayb ka ah Hindisaha Daryeelka OMANGA. Hubi in gabdhahaaga ay ka faa’iidaystaan barnaamijkan si ay uga wanaagsan yihiin nadaafadda caadada.

English: Early Childhood Development and Education (ECDE) teachers in Nyamira County may strike if salary harmonisation as per the SRC is not implemented by the end of the month.
Kiswahili: Walimu wa Maendeleo ya Utoto na Elimu (ECDE) katika Kaunti ya Nyamira wanaweza kugoma ikiwa uratibu wa mishahara kama ilivyoamuriwa na SRC hautatekelezwa kabla ya mwisho wa mwezi.
Ekegusii: Abaki baki bw'ogokore bw'echikoro cha buya na bwere nyamindi mu Nyamira County benyene boti bite ugere bongo mwaki wa mwaki bulia obwakire bw'ekanyanga ya SRC butaragirire naki omokende mwaki.
Dholuo: Walimu ma jopiny ochiko kanyika (ECDE) e Nyamira County ok nyal kata obedi ka sach mindo ma SRC omiye bende ka tinde mar namba.
Somali: Macallimiinta horumarinta carruurta iyo waxbarashada (ECDE) ee gobolka Nyamira ayaa malaayiin ka dhigi kara haddii isu-dheellitirka mushaharka sida ku xusan SRC aan la dhaqan gelin dhammaadka bisha.

English: Authorities in Migori urge students to resolve conflicts peacefully and report disputes to teachers or adults. Violence is not the solution.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka za Migori zinawasihi wanafunzi kutatua migogoro kwa amani na kuripoti matataizo kwa walimu au watu wazima. Vurugu si suluhisho.
Ekegusii: Abakire baki Migori bakwambira abaki nyang'ori genda okuboreka magokire buya na kwongereza omogoti bai abaki ankarani oba abaki baki. Obwateka buya si ng'eno.
Dholuo: Ababire ka Migori obiro gi mwachwa kuom oluwore vinya kanyonyo kendo bende omiya gi chike a loso ng'ato chuth. Gik ginyalo nyalu.
Somali: Mas’uuliyiinta Migori waxay ku boorinayaan ardayda inay si nabad ah ku xalliyaan khilaafaadka isla markaana ay warbixin ka siiyaan macallimiin ama dadka waaweyn. Rabshaddu maaha xalka.

English: Ronald Ngala Utalii College in Kilifi will admit its first cohort of 1,000 students for tourism and hospitality programs starting September 1, 2026.
Kiswahili: Chuo cha Utalii Ronald Ngala kilichoko Kilifi kitakubali kundi lake la kwanza la wanafunzi 1,000 kwa programu za utalii na ukarimu kuanzia Septemba 1, 2026.
Ekegusii: Ronald Ngala Utalii College buya Kilifi naki ing'ania ogenda 1,000 abaire bwakwenda busekeri na bwiire buya naki bitaiya 1, 2026.
Dholuo: Ronald Ngala Utalii College e Kilifi nyalo yie kawegi guok 1,000 ngima mar tumbo gi dunia machon to otieno kendo ok gima September 1, 2026.
Somali: Koleejka Ronald Ngala Utalii ee Kilifi ayaa fasax u siin doonta kooxdeeda koowaad ee 1,000 arday ah barnaamijyada dalxiiska iyo martigelinta oo bilaaban doona Sebtember 1, 2026.

English: Itigo Girls High School will compete in the KSSSA National Term Two Games from August 2 to 6 in Thika, Kiambu County, aiming to win the national title and qualify for the East Africa School Games.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Sekondari ya Itigo Girls itashindana katika Michezo ya Kitaifa ya KSSSA ya Kipindi cha Pili kuanzia Agosti 2 hadi 6 huko Thika, Kaunti ya Kiambu, ikilenga kushinda taji la kitaifa na kujiandaa kwa Michezo ya Shule za Afrika Mashariki.
Ekegusii: Itigo Girls High School itagana na KSSSA National Term Two Games gucheke Augosti 2 na 6 mu Thika, Kiambu County, ekegana okucheka matego ya taiga na okugeteka bwakire bwa East Africa School Games.
Dholuo: Itigo Girls High School ikadogo kanyo onge ng’ato KSSSA National Term Two Games e yo August 2 mpaka 6 e Thika, Kiambu County, owuon kuom win gi national title kod kwalifai ku East Africa School Games.
Somali: Dugsiga Sare ee Itigo ayaa ka qeyb galaya Ciyaaraha KSSSA ee Qaranka Term Two laga bilaabo Agoosto 2 ilaa 6 ee Thika, Gobolka Kiambu, iyagoo ujeedadoodu tahay inay ku guuleystaan cinwaanka qaranka isla markaana ay u qalmaan Ciyaaraha Dugsiyada Bariga Afrika.

English: Rongo University students will hold a candlelight vigil in memory of Sharon Otieno this Friday evening. All students are encouraged to participate.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa Chuo Kikuu cha Rongo watafanya tukio la kukumbuka Sharon Otieno kwa kutumia mishumaa Ijumaa hii usiku. Wanafunzi wote wanahimizwa kushiriki.
Ekegusii: Abanyan Rongo University bonyang'anya omogori bw'ogokorori moki buya bw'oshikire Sharon Otieno bw'oni mwibori. Abanyan bakorera nyanenda bwenjogoto.
Dholuo: Wuod Rongo ma Rongo University nyaka bedo kachode mar gi weche mag joma inyuol Sharon Otieno piny mokuong' nyaka. Joma inyuol nyaka yore kanyakore.
Somali: Ardayda Jaamacadda Rongo waxay qaban doonaan karinleyn iftiin ah xusuusta Sharon Otieno habeenka Jimcaha. Dhammaan ardayda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan.

English: The Government has allocated KSh2 billion to facilitate teacher promotions, doubling the annual number of teachers promoted from 25,000 to 50,000.
Kiswahili: Serikali imetenga KSh2 bilioni kuwezesha kuhamasishwa kwa walimu, ikiongeza idadi ya walimu wanaohamishwa kila mwaka kutoka 25,000 hadi 50,000.
Ekegusii: Abagereji b'ekarati b'ekiraka KSh2 bilioni omosi b'ogakinyanyia mabila bw'abarimu, b'ogoroki b'amaire naki 25,000 orokinyanyani 50,000.
Dholuo: Gavana owacho KSh2 billion to gi thum kode mar jop teacher, kendo ok nyiso gima chalo jop teacher mana ohero 25,000 to 50,000.
Somali: Dowladu waxay bixisay KSh2 bilyan si loo fududeeyo kor u qaadista macalimiinta, iyadoo labo jibaartay tirada sanadlaha ah ee la kor u qaadayo macalimiinta oo ka timid 25,000 ilaa 50,000.

English: The Kenya National Teachers' Forum calls for urgent consultations with the Teachers Service Commission and stakeholders to review the 2026 Collective Bargaining Agreement due to widespread dissatisfaction among teachers.
Kiswahili: Jukwaa la Walimu wa Kitaifa la Kenya linatoa wito wa kutafuta mazungumzo ya haraka na Tume ya Huduma za Walimu na wadau ili kupitia Mkataba wa Pamoja wa Kazi wa mwaka 2026 kutokana na kutoridhika kwa kiwango kikubwa miongoni mwa walimu.
Ekegusii: Omoige wa K nasionali buye bwekhano abogosi bwiira buya buorwa ichenhachire na Abwaki bw'ogosi bwakwetere buya buokireri bw'2016 bwi bwenge bweng'ana mwaki abogosi.
Dholuo: Kenya National Teachers' Forum en gi idhi nyasaye e dekoni ma dwaro e Teachers Service Commission kod jochomo, kuom to kanyo nocodhi 2026 Collective Bargaining Agreement kendo ni nyaka nembia ma ok nyalo yudo chalo gi otek kwa nyasa.
Somali: Ururka Macalimiinta Qaran ee Kenya wuxuu soo jeedinayaa in si degdeg ah lagula tashado Guddiga Adeegga Macalimiinta iyo daneeyayaasha si loo eegto Heshiiska Kaalmada Wadajir ee 2026 sababo la xiriira baahida guud ee macalimiinta.

English: Public primary and junior secondary school headteachers and deputies are invited to register for the Jukwaa la Wasomi Mediation and Preventive Security Training Programme at www.jukwaalawasomi.co.ke. The program, which costs KSh17,500 after a 75% scholarship, offers skills in dispute resolution and preventive security.
Kiswahili: Makarani wa shule za msingi za umma na shule za sekondari za awali wanakaribishwa kujiandikisha kwa Programu ya Mafunzo ya Upatanishi na Usalama wa Kuzuia ya Jukwaa la Wasomi kwenye www.jukwaalawasomi.co.ke. Programu hii, ambayo inagharimu KSh17,500 baada ya ufadhili wa 75%, inatoa ujuzi wa kutatua migogoro na usalama wa kuzuia.
Ekegusii: Bwakire buya bwedugusi bwanare na buwigane bujosia bosi bosi buya naki Jukwaa la Wasomi bujengete nyandwari egesia na bwiro www.jukwaalawasomi.co.ke. Bwakire buya buoragwa KSh17,500 bendo buinagire 75% bwokang'onganya, buya bwakire nyanatigwa buseki bokere bwamokire bujogorokere na buirinagio bokere.
Dholuo: Wakhead teacher na deputy wa shule giri ginyitho gi jowegi ber to ikonyo nyalo jowangi jukwaa la Wasomi Mediation and Preventive Security Training Programme, nyalo kare gi www.jukwaalawasomi.co.ke. Nyoch program, ma okonyo KSh17,500 ka kachok 75% piny, nyalo tinde chiko e tarik gi nyukwongo mar misinga kendo preventive security.
Somali: Madaxa dugsiyada hoose ee dadweynaha iyo ku-xigeennadooda ayaa lagu martiqaaday inay iska diiwaangeliyaan Barnaamijka Tababarka Xallinta Khilaafaadka iyo Amniga Ka Hortagga ee Jukwaa la Wasomi www.jukwaalawasomi.co.ke. Barnaamijkan wuxuu ku kacayaa KSh17,500 ka dib deeqda 75% ah, wuxuuna bixiyaa xirfadaha xallinta khilaafaadka iyo amniga ka hortagga.

English: KUPPET urges teachers to be aware of ongoing efforts to address welfare issues, including medical cover and promotion delays. Stay informed about outcomes affecting your career and benefits.
Kiswahili: KUPPET inawasihi walimu kuwa makini na juhudi za sasa za kushughulikia masuala ya ustawi, ikiwemo bima ya afya na ucheleweshaji wa matangazo ya vyeo. Ubaki na taarifa kuhusu matokeo yanayoathiri kazi na manufaa yako.
Ekegusii: KUPPET ikerere abekere igi naki buya bw'ogokire naki bw'ekireri, naki buya buya bw'ekirekabere. Kira buya buya naki bw'osiogotere obori bw'ogokire na naki bori buya buya.
Dholuo: KUPPET en tug'ruok nyithindo to be giwacho kuom jowe me wacho e mag nyukli, ka gima timo lowo mar theng' ne gichudo. Gima mabor, jochamo piny mag miyo owacho gi thom buoch kwen.
Somali: KUPPET waxay ku boorinaysaa macallimiinta inay ka warqabaan dadaallada socda ee lagu hagaajinayo arrimaha daryeelka, oo ay ku jiraan caymiska caafimaadka iyo dib u dhaca koritaanka. La soco natiijooyinka saameynaya xirfaddaada iyo faa'iidooyinkaaga.

English: The police in Nyamache are investigating a machete attack on a primary school teacher. Anyone with information should report to the nearest police station.
Kiswahili: Polisi katika Nyamache wanafanya uchunguzi kuhusu shambulio la mapanga kwa mwalimu wa shule ya msingi. Mtu yeyote mwenye taarifa anapaswa kuripoti kwenye kituo cha polisi kilicho karibu.
Ekegusii: Ababere baki Nyamache baria bakiite gwi chaki buya mbochi omogori kutenye omogotire. Omosongari onekirigha naki obwakipe bade gagori buya.
Dholuo: Polisi e Nyamache nigi chogo gi dho-mokinyi mar machete. Moka bura kamano onge gima ochung' e chike polisi.
Somali: Police-ka Nyamache waxay baadhayaan weerar mindi ah oo lagu qaaday macallin dugsiga hoose. Qof kasta oo haysta macluumaad waa inuu u soo sheego saldhigga police-ka ugu dhow.

English: The African Union is establishing its first Continental Campus in Nairobi's Upper Kabete area, consolidating five institutions for improved coordination and efficiency.
Kiswahili: Umoja wa Afrika unaanzisha Kampasi yake ya Kivita ya kwanza katika eneo la Upper Kabete jijini Nairobi, ikikamilisha taasisi tano kwa ajili ya kuboresha uratibu na ufanisi.
Ekegusii: African Union ikoranga omokiriri buya bwaki bwabere na Upper Kabete, Nairobi, ikinganya inyuigo itano orori bwaki bwogoramogoya na obokobori.
Dholuo: African Union en gin ochung' kaka e Campus Continental ni Nairobi, kuom Upper Kabete, kendo en konyo miye chike five kiwruok mang'ere kendo chalo.
Somali: Midowga Afrika ayaa dhisaya xaruntiisii koowaad ee Qaramada Afrika ee ku taala aagga Upper Kabete ee Nairobi, iyadoo isku xireysa shan hay'adood si loo hagaajiyo isuduwidda iyo waxtarka.

English: The University of Nairobi is reviving the Chair of Indian Studies and introducing Hindi language classes. Stay tuned for enrollment details and course offerings.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Nairobi kinazindua tena Kiti cha Masomo ya Kihindi na kuanzisha madarasa ya Kiswahili. Fuata kwa karibu maelezo ya kujiandikisha na mipango ya kozi.
Ekegusii: Chuo Kikuu cha Nairobi kinarudisha nafasi ya Masomo ya Kihindi na kuanzisha madarasa ya lugha ya Kihindi. Fuata kwa karibu maelezo ya kujiandikisha na kozi zitakazotolewa.
Dholuo: Universiti mar Nairobi en gi ngero manok duto kendo ocweyo kelas Hindi. Nyiwore chuth kendo chandruok mar enrollment.
Somali: Jaamacadda Nairobi ayaa dib u soo nooleynaysa Kursiga Daraasaadka Hindiya iyo sidoo kale soo bandhigaysa fasallada luqadda Hindi. La soco faahfaahinta iska diiwaangelinta iyo koorasyada la bixiyo.

English: Parents are encouraged to remain actively involved in their university students' lives to ensure their discipline and success. Continued guidance can help students make positive choices.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanashauriwa kubaki wakishirikiana katika maisha ya wanafunzi wao wa vyuo vikuu ili kuhakikisha nidhamu na mafanikio yao. Kusaidia kwaendelea kunaweza kuwasaidia wanafunzi kufanya chaguzi chanya.
Ekegusii: Abakire buya batoria bencilire mumachibori buya bwakire bano bering'ina osero chire buya, buya ogeti oria buya bwokire. Ogeto bwaki, bano bokingoraki bwaki biong'ere buya.
Dholuo: Gik ma ineno, ikwongo otony kendo iketi gi lweny mar yath ma minyalo ka timbe yath tinde, kendo kuom joma okonyo. Kanyiero ma okelo duto nyiso ji aneno kendo duto.
Somali: Waalidiinta waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay si firfircoon uga qaybqaataan nolosha ardaydooda jaamacadda si ay u hubiyaan anshaxooda iyo guulahooda. Hagaajinta joogtada ah waxay caawin kartaa ardayda inay doortaan go'aano wanaagsan.

English: Butere Technical Training Institute will hold its first graduation ceremony in November 2026. Eligible graduates should begin preparations and pay the graduation fee as outlined in the memo.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Mafunzo ya Ufundi Butere itafanya sherehe yake ya kwanza ya kuhitimu mwezi Novemba 2026. Wahitimu wanaostahili wanapaswa kuanza maandalizi na kulipa ada ya kuhitimu kama ilivyoainishwa kwenye hati.
Ekegusii: Butere Technical Training Institute ikwenda bwakire bwaki bwa genda bwaki bwaki buya buya mwokwenda 2026. Abaki bwanikire banyo baisioria buya bwogenda na bano oia bwaki bwa genda buori mwabiri.
Dholuo: Butere Technical Training Institute okinyi chonde manano ma ginyo 2026. Naki chalo mego kendo timo chike gore ogend kendo gibed gi gori chike mar memo.
Somali: Butere Technical Training Institute ayaa qabanqaabin doonta xafladda koowaad ee qalin-jabinta bisha Nofembar 2026. Qalin-jabiyeyaasha u qalma waa in ay bilawdaan diyaarinta iyo bixinta lacagta qalin-jabinta sida lagu caddeeyay warqadda.

English: Parents and students are urged to report any delays in emergency medical care at healthcare facilities to ensure swift action and accountability in the healthcare system.
Kiswahili: Wazazi na wanafunzi wanahimizwa kuripoti ucheleweshaji wowote wa huduma za matibabu ya dharura katika vituo vya afya ili kuhakikisha hatua za haraka na uwajibikaji katika mfumo wa afya.
Ekegusii: Bwakire buya na abato naki bwakirwe kuria oria bwaki bwake omokurumoka buya buseku bwa buya ibirebaki obwakire mu obwakere naki obwakire naki omokurumoka omokire.
Dholuo: Wuodhi au ji kolo yore konyo nyasach buya ma konyo nyime niyo koyi richo mar nyathini kod giwigi kuom nyalo dho mwandu mar nyathini.
Somali: Waalidiinta iyo ardayda waxaa lagu dhaarigelinayaa inay soo sheegaan wixii dib u dhac ah ee ku saabsan daryeelka caafimaadka degdega ah ee xarumaha caafimaadka si loo hubiyo in tallaabooyin dhakhso ah la qaado loona xisaabtamo nidaamka daryeelka caafimaadka.

English: All students admitted to public universities and Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) institutions will receive full funding for their education.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wote waliokubaliwa katika vyuo vikuu vya umma na taasisi za Elimu ya Ufundi na Mafunzo ya Kitaalamu (TVET) watapata ufadhili kamili wa masomo yao.
Ekegusii: Abana bose abakarire mu masomo ndetse na Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) batobora gochaganya emekengera y'amasomo yabo.
Dholuo: Gik ma nyasaye ng'ato kendo oporte e univesiti ma wan gi teko ne jopor e Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) nyakazi, nyasa an gi funding duto kuom gi joma.
Somali: Dhammaan ardayda lagu aqbalay jaamacadaha dadweynaha iyo machadyada Waxbarashada iyo Tababarka Farsamada (TVET) waxay heli doonaan maalgelin buuxda oo waxbarashadooda ah.

English: Professor Susan Chepkong'a Yego has been honored as Mace Bearer during the installation of the Vice Chancellor of the University of Nairobi, showcasing women's leadership in academia.
Kiswahili: Profesa Susan Chepkong'a Yego amesherehekiwa kama Mvutaji wa Mace wakati wa uwekaji wa Wakatibu Mkuu wa Chuo Kikuu cha Nairobi, kuonyesha uongozi wa wanawake katika elimu.
Ekegusii: Profesa Susan Chepkong'a Yego oseria kwomokireri nyankore ya Mace Bearer buya buya buhoko bw'ogenda ogia ogetairia Vice Chancellor wa University of Nairobi, ogetaraki omokiri bwakire bwaki bwaki bw'ekorori.
Dholuo: Profesa Susan Chepkong'a Yego awacho ka Mace Bearer kuom njira mago mar Vice Chancellor ku University of Nairobi, kendo ema nongo'ni jokeny mar kwa.
Somali: Professor Susan Chepkong'a Yego ayaa lagu sharfay inay noqoto Mace Bearer inta lagu guda jiro ku rakibidda Madaxweyne Kuxigeenka Jaamacadda Nairobi, taasoo muujinaysa hogaaminta dumarka ee cilmiga.

English: The government has launched a free artisan certification programme to benefit skilled workers in the informal sector. Register for assessment to receive a nationally recognized certificate at no cost.
Kiswahili: Serikali imezindua mpango wa vyeti vya ujuzi wa ufundi bure kwa ajili ya wafanyakazi wenye ujuzi katika sekta isiyo rasmi. Jisajili kwa ajili ya tathmini ili upate cheti kinachotambuliwa kitaifa bure.
Ekegusii: Oria bw'ogotire buya obokirori bwi artezani buinende buya bwochaki bwi obwakulani. Enchimi buya bwetire omorendo ochire buya omoshanga oburori naki.
Dholuo: Chandrew chieng' ni govermend oseting' pondo ma okel ji i koro muche progam mo ene kendo. Koro ka dhano ni owete ka adiera ka okel certificado ma omera kanyalo chano.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay soo saartay barnaamij shahaado-qaadasho furan si ay uga faa'iidaystaan shaqaalaha xirfadlayaasha ah ee ka howl gala qaybta aan rasmi ahayn. Iska diiwaangeli qiimeyn si aad u hesho shahaado la aqoonsan yahay oo dalka laga helo adoon wax kharash ah bixin.

English: KUPPET demands an immediate review of the collective bargaining agreement with TSC to secure better pay for teachers. Action is required to address growing salary disparities by 1 August 2026.
Kiswahili: KUPPET inasisitiza kufanya mapitio ya haraka ya makubaliano ya pamoja ya kazi na TSC ili kuhakikisha walimu wanapata mshahara mzuri. Hatua inahitajika kutatua ongezeko la tofauti za mishahara kufikia tarehe 1 Agosti 2026.
Ekegusii: KUPPET igana osorori naki bokonere buya buya bwa masomo naki TSC buya bwebene oigere bwakireri bwaki naki osiba ome. Naki also naki omogaka okore okogokige obwakireri buya buya buya bwakireri bwaki naki 1 Agosti 2026.
Dholuo: KUPPET iyawore ni konyo japuonj marach kuom TSC odhiere ka oremo ngeyo kaka jaluwo puonj. Nia odhiere piny ni nyiso manyien mar jaluwo puonj okel 1 Agwong' 2026.
Somali: KUPPET waxay dalbaneysaa in si degdeg ah dib loo eego heshiiska wadaxaajoodka oo lala galo TSC si loo xaqiijiyo mushaaraad wanaagsan oo macallimiinta ah. Tallaabo ayaa loo baahan yahay si wax looga qabto farqiga mushaaraadka ee sii kordhaya iyo 1da Agoosto 2026.

English: A state-of-the-art vocational training centre for learners with visual impairments will open on August 19, 2026, in Kiminini. Parents are urged to enroll their children for market-driven skills.
Kiswahili: Kituo cha mafunzo ya ufundi chenye vifaa vya kisasa kwa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu wa kuona kitashtuliwa tarehe 19 Agosti 2026, Kiminini. Wazazi wanahimizwa kuwasajili watoto wao kwa ujuzi unaoendana na soko.
Ekegusii: Ekigori kinyang'anya ekinyekere naki omogaka bwaki bwaki ohabwiria mu Kiminini, oria omogori iketiri ongetekia Omokere 19, 2026. Ababere bara omang'ana bakore aborabaki bagerete omogaka mekwenda.
Dholuo: Kik gi jomuoyo mwakire mago kendo mukwongo mocha ma oe yore gi kompuor mang'iyo kendo yore kendo abich nyaka omiyo e Kiminini, August 19, 2026. Wazazi owuoyo nyaka itie nyasach mar kido duto.
Somali: Maktabadda tababarka xirfadaha casriga ah ee ardayda indho-la'aanta ah ayaa la furi doonaa bisha Agoosto 19, 2026, magaalada Kiminini. Waalidiinta ayaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay diiwaan geliyaan carruurtooda si ay u helaan xirfadaha suuqa ku habboon.

English: Totum Comprehensive School will represent the Rift Valley Region at the upcoming National Championships in Thika after winning the 2026 Rift Valley JSS Girls' Football Championship.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Totum Comprehensive itawakilisha Mkoa wa Rift Valley katika Michuano ya Kitaifa inayokuja huko Thika baada ya kushinda Mashindano ya Soka ya Wasichana wa JSS Mkoa wa Rift Valley 2026.
Ekegusii: Totum Comprehensive School ikorere buya naki igenda buya Rora ya Rift Valley kiongoni cho National Championships mu Thika oria chibori buya 2026 Rift Valley JSS Girls' Football Championship.
Dholuo: Totum Comprehensive School nigi gymo Rift Valley Region e thande manyien mar National Championships gi Thika ka osetimo 2026 Rift Valley JSS Girls' Football Championship.
Somali: Iskuulka Totum Comprehensive wuxuu matali doonaa Gobolka Rift Valley tartanka Qaranka ee soo socda ee Thika ka dib markii uu ku guuleystay tartanka kubadda cagta gabdhaha JSS ee Rift Valley sanadkii 2026.

English: St. Mary's Nai Boys Boarding School students affected by the recent dormitory fire will receive blankets to help restore comfort. Further assistance efforts are ongoing.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa Shule ya Kijiji ya St. Mary's Nai Boys walioathirika na moto wa hivi karibuni katika hostel watapokea mablanketi kusaidia kurejesha faraja. Misaada zaidi inaendelea.
Ekegusii: Abanoni ba St. Mary's Nai Boys Boarding School bakenyerire ekosi kukore burokoni bwanenge burokori bwakabaki, barchengere burokoni bwabwakorere. Ekirogo nyasa bwendeka burokoni bwakabaki bwabwaki.
Dholuo: Wang' eng' St. Mary's Nai Boys Boarding School ma oserem gi kendo eyo mar kidi mag dak ndo chul gi mbiri kuom toth. Kanya, timbe mang'ere kendo olego mabor nother.
Somali: Ardayda St. Mary's Nai Boys Boarding School ee ay saameeyeen dabkii dhawaan ka dhacay hoolka ayaa heli doona dharkuuf si loo soo celiyo raaxada. Caawimo dheeraad ah ayaa sii socota.

English: Gilbert Mwavali is now the Chief Principal of Kaimosi Friends National Polytechnic. Stakeholders can expect continued growth and enhancement of quality training opportunities under his leadership.
Kiswahili: Gilbert Mwavali sasa ndiye Mkurugenzi Mkuu wa Kaimosi Friends National Polytechnic. Wadau wataweza kutarajia kuendelea kwa ukuaji na kuimarika kwa fursa za mafunzo ya kiwango bora chini ya uongozi wake.
Ekegusii: Gilbert Mwavali naki naki Omogori Osibori wa Kaimosi Friends National Polytechnic. Abanyabere baore bokingia obokinyaki bwogendi naki oboragania bwokorania bwogendera omokinyanire.
Dholuo: Gilbert Mwavali nyaka be Chief Principal ka Kaimosi Friends National Polytechnic. Kwaya ma okelo nyinge ni wachin mokuongo kod thuolo mag nyiri matindo mag training piny kendo osetimo yiengi.
Somali: Gilbert Mwavali waa Maamulka Guud ee Kaimosi Friends National Polytechnic. Danaystayaasha waxay ka filan karaan koror joogto ah iyo horumarinta fursadaha tababarka tayada leh hoos yimaada hoggaamintiisa.

English: Bars and alcohol-selling establishments are prohibited from operating within 300 metres of schools. Licensing authorities must enforce this law to protect learners.
Kiswahili: Mizani na maeneo ya kuuza pombe yamezuiliwa kufanya kazi ndani ya mita 300 kutoka shule. Mamlaka ya leseni lazima zitekeleze sheria hii ili kulinda wanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Makiagiri na emotiendori ya abarubugu iyebwaki kuorangwa naki 300 mete bwakire burokore. Abakumbatige buya bwaki omokiri obwakire okumanya ibirongo.
Dholuo: Baar na mawuoro an gi kadhogo en chieg 300 matindo to gima sekola. Kwechiyo maber ni nyaka oyiero ni chieg ma okonyo chike machuok.
Somali: Makhazadaha iyo goobaha lagu iibiyo khamriga waa la mamnuucay in ay ka howlgalaan 300 mitir ee dugsiyada. Hay'adaha shati-siinta waa inay xafidaan sharcigan si ay u ilaaliyaan ardayda.

English: Musingu High School will not pursue participation in the KSSSA National Games in Thika. The football program is focused on league commitments following their elimination from regional championships.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Msingi ya Musingu haitashiriki kwenye Michezo ya Kitaifa ya KSSSA huko Thika. Mpango wa soka unazingatia wajibu wa ligi baada ya kufukuzwa katika michuano ya kikanda.
Ekegusii: Musingu High School ogokire kugendana na KSSSA National Games mu Thika. Kihiga kya kiama kikiria omogaka orokiore orienjone egesia busi omokang'ane omokuhaka.
Dholuo: Musingu High School ng'ama enik ma ok amochi kokweyo gi KSSSA National Games e Thika. Program ma ooduon dongo ni ok nyal igoyi konyo gi nyalo weche kuom jua gi kawe.
Somali: Musingu High School ma qaadan doonto ka qaybgalka Ciyaaraha Qaranka KSSSA ee Thika. Barnaamijka kubadda cagta wuxuu diiradda saaraya waajibaadka horyaalada kadib markii laga reebay tartamada gobolada.

English: Teachers will see swift implementation of their adjusted salaries under the 2025–2029 Collective Bargaining Agreement by the Teachers Service Commission.
Kiswahili: Maalimu wataona utekelezaji haraka wa mishahara yao iliyorekebishwa chini ya Makubaliano ya Pamoja ya Kazi ya 2025–2029 kutoka Tume ya Huduma za Walimu.
Ekegusii: Ab Lehrer bonyange igokire oria oborani bwaki bwabo bwaki bota bwaki bwaki 2025–2029 na Teachers Service Commission.
Dholuo: Makarani baryo ka idhi gi tere magero mag yien jodeno 2025–2029, ka okonyo jogo mag Teachers Service Commission.
Somali: Macallimiinta waxay arki doonaan fulinta degdega ah ee mushaaraadkooda la hagaajiyay hoos yimaada Heshiiska Qandaraaska Wadajirka ah ee 2025–2029 ee Kaamiradda Adeegga Macallimiinta.

English: More than 350 girls at Lugulu Comprehensive School have been displaced due to a fire in their dormitory. Temporary accommodation is available at Lugulu Girls National School.
Kiswahili: Wasichana zaidi ya 350 katika Shule ya Lugulu Comprehensive wametengwa kutokana na moto uliozuka katika bweni lao. Malazi ya muda yanapatikana katika Shule ya Taifa ya Wasichana Lugulu.
Ekegusii: Abakire a 350 bengesibori batariga oduma ku Lugulu Comprehensive School buia omokinyaki bw'egiresi. Omosibori omogenda buia wakiirire ku Lugulu Girls National School.
Dholuo: Joini 350 ng’ato ma girls ka Lugulu Comprehensive School ne en buo kendo bende buo gi udi kendo. Kanya ng’ato gi tir e Lugulu Girls National School.
Somali: In ka badan 350 gabar ah ayaa laga soo qaxay Dugsiga Sare ee Lugulu sababo la xiriira dab ka kacay guryohooda. Hoy ku meel gaar ah ayaa laga heli karaa Dugsiga Qaran ee Gabaraha Lugulu.

English: There is an acute shortage of teachers in West Pokot County, affecting the quality of education for thousands of learners. Urgent government intervention is needed to address this crisis.
Kiswahili: Kuna upungufu mkali wa walimu katika Kaunti ya West Pokot, ukihatarisha ubora wa elimu kwa maelfu ya wanafunzi. Msaada wa haraka wa serikali unahitajika kutatua crise hii.
Ekegusii: Omosi ogekire abakirorane mu Nyancha ya West Pokot, buya bokiere obwakire bweng'anya oria orese abana. Omosaroraki ogogooigwa ogokorere omokiri ino.
Dholuo: Oseyo ogendani magi kichochoni kuom West Pokot County, maok gi genene ngima mondo osel kelo siong' maler. Nede keto ji ofuoch mokwongo to golo ogendani ni osethuro tige.
Somali: Waxa jirta baahi weyn oo macallimiin ah oo ka jirta Gobolka West Pokot, taasoo saameyn ku yeelanaysa tayada waxbarashada kumanaan ardayda ah. Waxaa lagama maarmaan ah in dowladda ay si degdeg ah u tallaabsato si loo xalliyo dhibaato tan.

English: Kajiado North residents can now propose projects for the NGCDF budget, including more classrooms and labs, as public consultations finalize priorities for the next funding cycle.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Kajiado North sasa wanaweza kupendekeza miradi kwa bajeti ya NGCDF, ikiwa ni pamoja na madarasa na maabara zaidi, huku mashauriano ya umma yakiweka kipaumbele kwa kipindi kijacho cha ufadhili.
Ekegusii: Abakajiado North baria bingi buya buya buya bwaki bwakinyoncia buya bwaki baki bingi bwaki bwenda mageria, eyaki omong’eyo na banzanaki, go omotigari oria ogenda bwaki bendi baki buya bwaki bwenda oria bwaki bwaki bwaki bwenda omotigari.
Dholuo: Ab resident wa Kajiado North an bisa piny gi ma ng'ato ne ok nyalo renti projekti mo NGCDF budget, kuom ng'eyo klase mar golo kod labs, ka public consultations ne ok wathni dhano ma okonyo chike mar ng'ato.
Somali: Degmada Kajiado Waqooyi waxaa hadda la oggol yahay in dadka degaanku ay soo jeediyaan mashaariicda miisaaniyadda NGCDF, oo ay ku jiraan fasallo dheeraad ah iyo maktabado, iyada oo la dhammeystirayo talooyinka dadweynaha ee mudnaanta loogu darayo wareegga maalgelinta xiga.

English: Students interested in chess, the Kenya National Schools Chess Championships will be held at Alliance High School. Prepare your teams and practice to compete!
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanaovutiwa na chess, Mashindano ya Shule za Kitaifa ya Chess nchini Kenya yatafanyika katika Shule ya Juu ya Alliance. Andaa timu zenu na fanyeni mazoezi ili kushiriki!
Ekegusii: Abakire ba chess, masomo ya Kenya National Schools Chess Championships ekerire hasi Alliance High School. Egesete bende moiyaki na ogachikire buya!
Dholuo: Kanyo kuom chess, Kenya National Schools Chess Championships nigi konyo e Alliance High School. Nyaka itiyo jamo nyuol to chor gi lok!
Somali: Ardayda xiisaynaysa shatara, Tartanada Shatarka Dugsiyada Qaranka ee Kenya waxaa lagu qaban doonaa Iskuulka Sare ee Alliance. Diyaari kooxihiina oo tababara si aad ugu tartanto!

English: The Agricultural Finance Corporation (AFC) is recruiting for senior leadership and legal positions. Submit applications by August 3, 2026, with required documents via the AFC online recruitment portal.
Kiswahili: Kampuni ya Fedha ya Kilimo (AFC) inatafuta viongozi wa juu na nafasi za kisheria. Wasilisha maombi yako kabla ya Agosti 3, 2026, pamoja na nyaraka zinazohitajika kupitia lango la mtandaoni la ajira la AFC.
Ekegusii: Abagere akabere Egesia ya Abakire Enyagira (AFC) barebana abaki bosi na abaki ba mijehige. Omosokoti mwaki bwere wa August 3, 2026, na abaki bosi abashere boda na AFC online recruitment portal.
Dholuo: Agricultural Finance Corporation (AFC) ok owinjore mar senior leadership gi jigwen. Timo pok tich kendo yore kanyalo, kuom August 3, 2026, ka ogendուրջ kod document mokuoch gi AFC online recruitment portal.
Somali: Hay'adda Maaliyadda Beeraha (AFC) waxay shaqaaleynaysaa xafiisyo sare iyo meelaha sharciga. Fadlan soo gudbi codsigaaga ugu dambayn August 3, 2026, iyadoo la raacayo dukumiintiyada lagama maarmaanka ah ee ku saabsan boorsada shaqaalaynta AFC online.

English: All employers must comply with the new minimum wage law to avoid penalties. Ensure your practices are in line with the updated wages immediately.
Kiswahili: Waajiri wote wanapaswa kufuata sheria mpya ya mshahara wa chini ili kuepuka adhabu. Hakikisha taratibu zako zinaendana na mishahara iliyo sasishwa mara moja.
Ekegusii: Abakora bose baritwaki naki ekegero ikirogo chiri chochi okorwaki. Naki omoganya bw'aki okorwaki bw'ane okorere emegare naki bw'aki obere naki.
Dholuo: Wang'ni miluokni kwe ranyisi k'aluwo gi sharia mar ranyis maber, to wech niki. Nisung'ni tiyo mar ranyis nyaka wete lweny gi kit.
Somali: Dhamaan shaqaaleyahaynayaasha waa inay la jaanqaadaan sharciga cusub ee mushaharka ugu yar si ay uga fogaadaan ganaax. Hubi in habraacyadaadu ay waafaqsan yihiin mushaharka la cusboonaysiiyay isdaba-joog.

English: Kenyans seeking overseas education, jobs, or healthcare are advised to prepare for a 20% increase in visa applications. Ensure your application is complete and submitted promptly.
Kiswahili: Wakenya wanaotafuta elimu, ajira, au huduma za afya nje ya nchi wanashauriwa kujiandaa kwa ongezeko la 20% la maombi ya visa. Hakikisha maombi yako yamekamilika na yameshawishika kwa wakati.
Ekegusii: Ab Kenyan baria bokireri bwomwaki, buya, kana merechenchani bosi naki kwerekia kaato 20% mu visa. Naki omogori bwomwaki nikori bwakwenda na bwaki tekeria.
Dholuo: Wuod nyaka Marekani, job, kaka magingo, ginyal gi 20% ng'ama gi visa applications. Nyal nyaka kit gite kendo oting' gi chako.
Somali: Kenyanka raadinaya waxbarasho, shaqo, ama daryeel caafimaad oo dibadda ah ayaa lagu talinayaa inay is diyaariyaan koror 20% ah oo ku yimaada codsiyada fiisaha. Hubi in codsigaaga uu dhameystiran yahay oo si degdeg ah loo gudbiyo.

English: Kisii School will hold a grand alumni reunion this weekend, offering career and mentorship talks for students. All students are encouraged to attend.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Kisii itafanya mkutano mkubwa wa watangulizi wikendi hii, ikitoa mazungumzo kuhusu kazi na ushauri kwa wanafunzi. Wanafunzi wote wanahimizwa kuhudhuria.
Ekegusii: Shule ya Kisii igena omogori buya buya bwaki, ikwenda eng'ania egokogo naki omogori na oboti bwaki. Abana bosi basibori baki baria.
Dholuo: Kisii School bende nene ka wakore ma gitimre maler ni this weekend, mondo obwakoru ma kar cher nding' mang'eny piny. Hande nyaka anyisowa gach sini.
Somali: Dugsiga Kisii ayaa qabanqaabinaya kulan weyn oo shahaadooyinka isugu yimaaddaan maalinta Axadda, iyadoo la bixinayo hadallo ku saabsan xirfadaha iyo hanuuninta ardayda. Dhammaan ardayda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan.

English: Kiambu County has launched a birth registration drive to ensure all learners can access education services. Parents are encouraged to register their children promptly.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kiambu imeanzisha kampeni ya usajili wa kuzaliwa ili kuhakikisha wanafunzi wote wanapata huduma za elimu. Wazazi wanahimizwa kuwaj registering watoto wao haraka.
Ekegusii: Omosome wa Kiambu oria naki ore okeria emokire obwakire bwatebu orokeng’ omogotiogoti. Ababere bariajiire okuboka abana babo nkegong’ere.
Dholuo: Kiambu County ewang' miyo mar bura kanyo, chiw gi timo yieng' ng'wech, ng'ato en kendo ng'ato owacho. Wazazi ubiro ramba kwayo ji piny ma.
Somali: Degmada Kiambu waxay bilowday ololaha diiwaangelinta dhalashada si loo hubiyo in dhammaan ardaydu ay helaan adeegyada waxbarashada. Waalidka waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ilmahooda si degdeg ah u diiwaan geliyaan.

English: Kericho County is recruiting 210 ECDE teachers. Interested candidates should apply to be part of this investment in early learning.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kericho inatafuta walimu 210 wa ECDE. Wagombea wenye nia wanapaswa kuomba ili kuwa sehemu ya uwekezaji huu katika elimu ya awali.
Ekegusii: Kericho County ikirugani 210 abekere ba ECDE. Abaki ba kenye batariga bw’ogenda bwere ikiruga bw'ogenda buya mu gisagani gikirane.
Dholuo: Kericho County noke kanyakore 210 ECDE chiegni. Aora kendo, bende gima bende owacho gi joma inyuol kwaya kendo kony kendo tich makare.
Somali: Degmada Kericho waxay shaqaaleyneysaa 210 macallin oo ECDE ah. Musharrixiinta danaynaya waa in ay codsadaan si ay qayb uga noqdaan maalgelintan waxbarashada hore.

English: Total orphans who scored a C in KCSE and wish to join Bukura Agricultural College are encouraged to seek assistance for enrollment.
Kiswahili: Watoto yatima wote waliofanya mtihani wa KCSE na kupata kiwango cha C wanahimizwa kutafuta msaada wa kujiunga na Chuo cha Kilimo cha Bukura.
Ekegusii: Abana bakiabaki bataroboka C mu KCSE hamwe n'iberegi bangahe bendo koboka naki Bukura Agricultural College, bataririre kuigwa bwi enyuone.
Dholuo: Bura g'ogielo cha kelo C ka KCSE kata keth omak mana weche ma okonya g'iyogo moko ku Bukura Agricultural College ma okonyo chula.
Somali: Dhalinyarada agoonta ah ee helay C KCSE oo doonaya inay ku biiraan Bukura Agricultural College waxaa loo diyaariyay inay raadsadaan caawimaad diiwaangelin.

English: The Government encourages innovation in implementing Competency-Based Education (CBE) tailored to Kenyan needs.
Kiswahili: Serikali inahimiza ubunifu katika kutekeleza Elimu Iliyotegemea Ufanisi (CBE) inayolingana na mahitaji ya Wakenya.
Ekegusii: Ongorori wakiikire atuma bujore bwakiitihari bwakobwa Buya (CBE) buororire buya bwa Kenya.
Dholuo: Chor moko oyie ka govenoma oting'o gi chike mar Competency-Based Education (CBE) ma odak kod chike duto mar Kenya.
Somali: Dowladda waxay dhiirrigelinaysaa hal-abuurka hirgelinta Waxbarashada Ku Salaysan Aqoonta (CBE) oo loo habeeyey baahiyaha Kenya.

English: The Government is actively working to restore stability at Moi University. Academic staff and stakeholders are encouraged to engage in ongoing discussions for improved governance and welfare.
Kiswahili: Serikali inafanya kazi kwa bidii kurejesha utulivu katika Chuo Kikuu cha Moi. Wafanyakazi wa kitaaluma na wadau wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mijadala inayoendelea kwa ajili ya kuboresha utawala na ustawi.
Ekegusii: Abagere bakiuga buya naki chenga buya buseki bwang'anya Moi University. Abakire buseki naki abashamaki bosi naki omokireri omotende bategere buseki buya naki ogenda.
Dholuo: Gevernment oinwaki gi juma mar piny to thego chike kuom Moi University. Abiro, jopinyi mag akademi kende jochweyo to adiera ka wacho e ji mar ging'ore gi mag puoche.
Somali: Dowladda waxay si firfircoon u wada shaqaynaysaa si dib loogu soo celiyo xasilloonida Jaamacadda Moi. Shaqaalaha tacliinta iyo daneeyayaasha ayaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qeybqaataan wadahadallada socda si loo hagaajiyo maamul wanaagga iyo daryeelka.

English: Teachers are urged to ensure prompt payment of outstanding examination allowances before the 2026 national examinations. Please contact the Ministry of Education for updates on this matter.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanahimizwa kuhakikisha malipo ya tofauti za mtihani yanafanyika kabla ya mtihani wa kitaifa wa mwaka 2026. Tafadhali wasiliana na Wizara ya Elimu kwa maelezo zaidi kuhusu jambo hili.
Ekegusii: Abagumbi barakire kuomokoreba kweenda kwomokore buya naki zia chimbaraga mbere ya 2026 eng'ito ya inyu kogatenda. Naki nu bwendo bwigana Obwakabere bw'Adinani.
Dholuo: Abaluhya bwiye to chungi ringo matek mar jochak (examination allowances) kendo golo podo piny to ratiro ma 2026. Sawa kuom Ministry of Education kuom ng’ato nyalo yal gi chandruok e yo ma.
Somali: Macallimiinta waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay hubiyaan bixinta lacagaha imtixaanka ee deynka ah ka hor imtixaannada qaran ee 2026. Fadlan la xiriir Wasaaradda Waxbarashada si aad u hesho warbixinno ku saabsan arrintan.

English: Heads of institutions must verify and ensure the accuracy of all data submitted during the Junior School onboarding exercise, using only official names and correct formats by the specified deadlines.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa mashirika wanapaswa kuthibitisha na kuhakikisha usahihi wa data zote zilizowasilishwa wakati wa zoezi la kujiunga na Shule ya Msingi, wakitumia majina rasmi tu na muundo sahihi kabla ya tarehe zilizoainishwa.
Ekegusii: Abakorenjore batorankie banene bategire okorokire omokiri bwiinyachire hamwe n’osi bwariri bwetamwe buya banye inki oigire bwi nyakaira buya bahenjerere bwere buya.
Dholuo: Duoko mang'ich oter chiw g'iseche gi weche magwona e piny mokuol kuom Junior School, nyal tigi nimoni e yore mag ohinga kod weche ma ok nyal eyo gi yore ma osono.
Somali: Madaxdhaqameedyadu waa inay xaqiijiyaan oo ay hubiyaan saxnaanta dhammaan xogta la soo gudbiyey intii lagu jiray hawlgalka diiwaangelinta Dugsiga Hoose, iyadoo la adeegsanayo kaliya magacyada rasmiga ah iyo qaababka saxda ah waqtiga la cayimay.

English: Teachers are urged to voice their concerns regarding unsatisfactory salary adjustments. Contact the Teachers Service Commission (TSC) for clarity and to address these issues.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanasisitizwa kuwasilisha wasiwasi wao kuhusu marekebisho mabaya ya mishahara. Wasiliana na Tume ya Huduma za Walimu (TSC) kwa ufafanuzi na kushughulikia masuala haya.
Ekegusii: Abagoti baagoreke kuta bamaire bw’ogotegana buya bwaki. Maki bosi buya naki mwaki ya Bahere ya Abagoti (TSC) naki buya bw’omihe.
Dholuo: Ong'ere chieng' konyo nyako ma ogendoni manok yande kod jowuothe. Konyo Teachers Service Commission (TSC) ot nyalo konyo yande kendo to imiyo nyaka.
Somali: Macalimiinta waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay muujiyan walwalka ku saabsan korodhka mushaarka ee aan ku habooneyn. La xiriir Hay'adda Adeegga Macalimiinta (TSC) si aad u hesho caddayn iyo xalinta arrimahan.

English: Teachers in Narok County are urged to report salary disputes to their unions, KNUT or KUPPET, to ensure fair treatment and due process is followed in disciplinary actions.
Kiswahili: Walimu katika Kaunti ya Narok wanahimizwa kuripoti migogoro ya mishahara kwa vyama vyao, KNUT au KUPPET, ili kuhakikisha matibabu ya haki na mchakato sahihi unafuata katika hatua za kinidhamu.
Ekegusii: Abaganga baki Narok baria mwaki omogangire okorere agakire buya bonyekane nkera bu KUPPET kana KNUT, kugira omotire bwake buya na bwenyanye buya mugarano maningo.
Dholuo: Wach wacho e Narok County nyal e yo loso kachieng' chunyi mar wadhi kaka KNUT oba KUPPET, kuom timo chiegni mar kanyo kod chalo makare e ji monge.
Somali: Teachers-ka ka howlgala Gobolka Narok waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay warbixiyaan khilaafaadka mushaharka ururada ay ka tirsan yihiin, KNUT ama KUPPET, si loo hubiyo in cadaaladda la raaco oo habka anshaxa loo dhaqangeliyo.

English: The Teachers Service Commission has appointed new county directors and transferred several others in a recent reshuffle. Key positions affected include Siaya, Bungoma, Mandera, and Homa Bay Counties.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma za Walimu imeteua wakurugenzi wapya wa kaunti na kuhamasisha wengine kadhaa katika mabadiliko ya hivi karibuni. Nyadhifa muhimu zilizohusika ni kaunti za Siaya, Bungoma, Mandera, na Homa Bay.
Ekegusii: Abakire ba Teachers Service Commission baing'ere abaki mbwaki banye okutegena abaki baki na bweritere bingi buya. Abaki abaki bwicki buya naki bwogorie buya bungi, naki Siaya, Bungoma, Mandera, na Homa Bay.
Dholuo: Teachers Service Commission oketie dirach nyaka county manyien kendo oketie nying' achiel, to okonji chalo dawidi. Moko ma acheny oloyo ne nyaka Siaya, Bungoma, Mandera, gi Homa Bay Counties.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegyada Macallimiinta ayaa magcaabay agaasimeyaal cusub oo dowlad goboleed iyo sidoo kale beddelay kuwo kale qalalaasihii dhawaan dhacay. Meelo muhiim ah oo ay arrintan saameysay waxaa ka mid ah degmooyinka Siaya, Bungoma, Mandera, iyo Homa Bay.

English: KUPPET has rejected salary increments proposed by SRC due to unfair pay disparities. Teachers may consider industrial action if concerns are not addressed.
Kiswahili: KUPPET imekataa ongezeko la mishahara lililopendekezwa na SRC kutokana na tofauti zisizokuwa na haki. Walimu wanaweza kufikiria hatua za kiviwanda ikiwa wasiwasi haujatatuliwa.
Ekegusii: KUPPET orore bwakire oria bwakinyaki buike bwa SRC buya bwakire buya bui na boki bwaki. Abarekenya bakenyete bende bakore buya buya boke oigane.
Dholuo: KUPPET an gi chalo mazur kendo ng'ato machiek gi SRC ka osimbo kanyakla. Kowe oganda ineno joma yudo weche mar ndalo chagru kendo chalo ka isetimo.
Somali: KUPPET ayaa diiday kororka mushaharada ay soo jeedisay SRC sababo la xiriira farqi mushahar oo aan cadaalad ahayn. Macallimiintu waxay tixgelin karaan hawlgallo warshadeed haddii cabashooyinka la xallin waayo.

English: Teachers are urged to complete their Teacher Performance Appraisal and Development (TPAD) records before the July 31, 2026 deadline to qualify for the KSh2 billion promotion program.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanakumbushwa kukamilisha rekodi zao za Tathmini na Maendeleo ya Utendaji wa Walimu (TPAD) kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho ya Julai 31, 2026 ili kuweza kustahiki katika mpango wa kukuza wa KSh2 bilioni.
Ekegusii: Abasomu baria bakenye kukireka kego chireka ticha chirekebwaki (TPAD) mere buya buya buya kuzeria kede nyamwaki 31, 2026 buya konyeganie chire bota kSh2 billion.
Dholuo: Walimu matin gi dhoge ka owete TPAD mane otime magi kuom juma 31, Mwezi wa Moka, mwaka 2026, iweyo kuom githo gi KSh2 billion ma okonyo tel.
Somali: Macalimiinta waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay dhameystiraan diiwaannada Qiimeynta iyo Horumarinta Waxbarashada (TPAD) ka hor taariikhda kama dambaysta ah ee 31ka Luulyo, 2026 si ay u xaqiijin karaan barnaamijka kor u qaadista oo ah KSh2 bilyan.

English: ECDE teachers in West Pokot County should file their written submissions by [insert date] as per the court's instructions. The next court hearing is scheduled for September 23, 2026.
Kiswahili: Teachers wa ECDE katika Kaunti ya West Pokot wanapaswa kuwasilisha maandiko yao kabla ya [ingiza tarehe] kulingana na maagizo ya mahakama. Kusikilizwa kwa kesi ambayo inayofuata kumewekwa tarehe Septemba 23, 2026.
Ekegusii: Abere ba ECDE mu West Pokot County bonyorera eeria bw'ogori [insert date] ng'ekorua za ibwoni. Olokio bw'ogori bwakirera buse nyakire mu September 23, 2026.
Dholuo: Abaluhya ECDE ku West Pokot County nyalo simegi yo-yawore duto kendo nyalo meko kende goyo to duto owinjre. Nyasa mokuongo kendo tich mokwongo ni September 23, 2026.
Somali: Macalimiinta ECDE ee Gobolka West Pokot waa in ay soo gudbiyaan qoraalooda dhigaalka ah ka hor [gelin taariikhda] sida ay amar u tahay maxkamadda. Dacwadda xigta ee maxkamadda waxay qorshaysnayd in la qabto Sebtembar 23, 2026.

English: The proposal to shorten the school day to four hours is under discussion. Stakeholders are encouraged to engage in consultations regarding potential impacts on the education system.
Kiswahili: Pendekezo la kupunguza muda wa shule hadi masaa manne linajadiliwa. Wahamasi wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mashauriano kuhusu athari zinazoweza kutokea kwenye mfumo wa elimu.
Ekegusii: Omosarane ogokorere omogeyo ogukirigana na oria imihoro ine ng'ende oria oria ikuania. Ababere barebireri okuhingania mindu yaki buya konyera buya kosi ya masomo.
Dholuo: Piny ng'ato kuom wendo gi sukulu mane en nyaka kanyo e nyaka dhohoro chuo. Wuodhi kanyo kuom konyo e tich kuom ceng' bedo gi tak maina e piny miyo konyo.
Somali: Qorshaha ah in maalinta dugsiga la gaabiyo ilaa afar saacadood ayaa wadahadal ku jira. Dhamaan daneeyayaasha waxaa la dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan talo bixin ku saabsan saamaynta ay tani ku yeelan karto nidaamka waxbarashada.

English: The application window for the September 2026 intake at Kenya Medical Training College (KMTC) is now open. Apply through the KUCCPS Student Portal by August 11, 2026.
Kiswahili: Dirisha la maombi kwa ajili ya kujiunga na Kenya Medical Training College (KMTC) mnamo Septemba 2026 sasa limefunguliwa. Tuma maombi yako kupitia Kituo cha Wanafunzi cha KUCCPS kabla ya Agosti 11, 2026.
Ekegusii: Ebusaka bwa kwang’anya bwakire buya buno bw’ogenda mu septemba 2026 ku Kenya Medical Training College (KMTC). Ing’enza bwekuung’ana ku KUCCPS Student Portal na mahinda 11, 2026.
Dholuo: Ng'ato marach ma ok walok gi inyalo konyo itimo September 2026 ku Kenya Medical Training College (KMTC) nyalo jate. Ineyo ku KUCCPS Student Portal nyaka August 11, 2026.
Somali: Fursadda codsiga ee gelitaanka Sebtembar 2026 ee Kenya Medical Training College (KMTC) hadda waa furan. Codso oo adeegso KUCCPS Student Portal-ka ka hor August 11, 2026.

English: The Directorate of Criminal Investigations (DCI) has arrested Richard Gikuhe Mbugua, the prime suspect in the murder of Technical University of Kenya lecturer Edgar Mokua.
Kiswahili: Idara ya Upelelezi wa Jinai (DCI) imemkamata Richard Gikuhe Mbugua, mshukiwa mkuu katika mauaji ya mhadhiri wa Chuo cha Teknolojia cha Kenya, Edgar Mokua.
Ekegusii: Ongorori bw'Obwaki bw'Abakire (DCI) amaki Richard Gikuhe Mbugua, omokireri omokima bw'aramoro bw'abarimi bw'ogwete Technical University of Kenya, Edgar Mokua.
Dholuo: Direktori eng'iyo ma gonyo (DCI) anyal Richard Gikuhe Mbugua, nyaka lemo chamo ma en odugo e piny mar Technical University of Kenya, Edgar Mokua.
Somali: Hay’adda Baarista Dembiyada (DCI) waxay qabatay Richard Gikuhe Mbugua, qofka ugu suurta gala ah dilka macallinka Jaamacadda Farsamada Kenyatta, Edgar Mokua.

English: Masinde Muliro Senior School has received a brand-new school bus to enhance student transport for academic, sports, and co-curricular activities.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Upili ya Masinde Muliro imepata basi jipya kabisa ili kuboresha usafiri wa wanafunzi kwa ajili ya shughuli za masomo, michezo, na shughuli za ziada.
Ekegusii: Masinde Muliro Senior School omogenda oria omokiri bosi buya bwake busemo bota bosi bwagwaki babsaraki, kutebete bwakire, na bosi bwaki omokiranya.
Dholuo: Masinde Muliro Senior School en gima neno bundi buse mokuongo gitim gi jomomiyo mar wuoth, kuom foko, gi chike magyore.
Somali: Masinde Muliro Senior School waxay heshay bas cusub si loo hagaajiyo gaadiidka ardayda ee waxbarashada, isboortiga, iyo howlaha kale ee dugsiga.

English: Butere Technical Training Institute is holding its first-ever event; all interested students and stakeholders should participate.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Mafunzo ya Ufundi Butere inafanya shughuli yake ya kwanza; wanafunzi wote na washikadau waliovutiwa wanapaswa kushiriki.
Ekegusii: Butere Technical Training Institute igetere omochigori chaki; abaki bwakireri bochane na migori buya batararire.
Dholuo: Butere Technical Training Institute noyeng' gi jomokonyo mag nyalo; jomoko mar jowe duto kanyo ni bende wachung' manono.
Somali: Butere Technical Training Institute waxa ay qaban qaabineysaa munaasabadkeedii ugu horreeyay; dhammaan ardayda iyo daneeyayaasha xiiseynaya waa in ay ka qeyb galaan.

English: Tabitha Githaiga is the new principal of Njoro Technical Training Institute. Staff and students are encouraged to support her leadership and transition at the institution.
Kiswahili: Tabitha Githaiga ndiye mkuu mpya wa Taasisi ya Mafunzo ya Ufundi ya Njoro. Wafanyakazi na wanafunzi wanahimizwa kumuunga mkono katika uongozi na mpito wake katika taasisi.
Ekegusii: Tabitha Githaiga naki omokinyanya osibori bia Njoro Technical Training Institute. Ababere na abanza batareri boke omoreri na omokinyanya wakwe khomoreria omogoti.
Dholuo: Tabitha Githaiga now en Principal mar Njoro Technical Training Institute. Jater e yo eweyo k'iyudhi gi yore maki, kendo ninde manieyo anyaka kowe yore marwe.
Somali: Tabitha Githaiga waa madaxa cusub ee Machadka Tababarka Farsamada ee Njoro. Shaqaalaha iyo ardayda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay taageeraan hogaaminta iyo isbedelka ay ku jirto machadka.

English: Kenyatta University is now accepting applications for partial undergraduate scholarships for the 2026/2027 academic year. Apply by July 31, 2026, with necessary documents and forms.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Kenyatta sasa kinakubali maombi ya ufadhili wa masomo ya sehemu kwa wanafunzi wa chuo kikuu kwa mwaka wa masomo 2026/2027. Tuma maombi yako kabla ya Julai 31, 2026, ukiwa na nyaraka na fomu zinazohitajika.
Ekegusii: Kenyatta University ekinagire okogendia abaki bw’ogwokorota maarangoro okwega kwa mwaka wa masomo 2026/2027. Oseme gukorwa ka nyang’ori ya 31, 2026, naki bwakibori buya na ekihigo.
Dholuo: Kenyatta University wan gi kolu joma duok e piny mar scholarships marach to gi joma ngondugi gi 2026/2027. Iyu magi chike by July 31, 2026, gi chike to ni jopiny.
Somali: Jaamacadda Kenyatta ayaa hadda aqbaleeysa codsiyada deeqda waxbarasho ee qeybta ah ee ardayda jaamacadda sannadka tacliinta 2026/2027. Fadlan codso ka hor 31-da Luulyo, 2026, adigoo isticmaalaya dukumiintiyada iyo foomamka lagama maarmaanka ah.

English: All educators in Kenya are urged to prioritize safety and demand enhanced security measures in schools. Immediate investigations into recent violence against teachers must be expedited for justice.
Kiswahili: Walimu wote nchini Kenya wanahimizwa kuzingatia usalama na kudai hatua za usalama bora katika shule. Uchunguzi wa haraka kuhusu vurugu za hivi karibuni dhidi ya walimu lazima ufanywe ili kupata haki.
Ekegusii: Abagweta bogenyange buya batariri batarire naki batora bwire obwakire buya mu masumo. Naki orokirori rionge bosi mu kutokora obwaki bwogubiri bwaki bwomokarigana oko kusiwekere abagweta.
Dholuo: Dak kune nyandugi ma Kenya, wer e pwodhi kakachoe konyo gi nigi makelo bende chalo mar kelo. Nasuru mar minyasa kuom kare nyaka uok nyaka kiwuok e nyaka.
Somali: Dhammaan macalimiinta Kenya waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay mudnaanta siiyaan badbaadada oo ay dalbadaan tallaabooyin amni oo la xoojiyey dugsiyada. Baaritaannada degdegga ah ee ku saabsan rabshadihii dhowaan loogu gaystay macalimiinta waa in la dedejiyo si loo helo cadaalad.

English: The government plans to provide full funding for all university and college students starting September 2026. Stay informed on details regarding funding and implementation.
Kiswahili: Serikali inapanga kutoa ufadhili kamili kwa wanafunzi wote wa chuo kikuu na vyuo kuanzia Septemba 2026. Fuatilia maelezo kuhusu ufadhili na utekelezaji.
Ekegusii: Abagenderi bataria buya buria bwokinyore bwia buyanunaki na colleges bwose buya bwania bwoka September 2026. Bwakore omokiri omogoti ku bwokinyore na buya bwokubwaki.
Dholuo: Gavana kendo oik kamano kuom puodho mag funding puot gi tich niu karie mak wendo September 2026. Rachuonyo piny e ginto kuom funding gi chieg.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay qorsheyneysaa in ay bixiso maalgelin buuxda oo loogu talagalay dhammaan ardayda jaamacadaha iyo kolleljiyada laga bilaabo Sebtember 2026. La soco faahfaahinta maalgelinta iyo hirgelinta.

English: The Garissa County Education Board is accused of imposing unauthorized cash levies on learners. Parents and guardians should report any such demands to the Ministry of Education immediately.
Kiswahili: Bodi ya Elimu ya Kaunti ya Garissa inakabiliwa na tuhuma za kuweka tozo za pesa zisizo za kibali kwa wanafunzi. Wazazi na walezi wanapaswa kuripoti mahitaji hayo kwa Wizara ya Elimu mara moja.
Ekegusii: Abashokoti bendera bu Garissa bosi baraki jorumaraki buseke bwaki buiende. Abakiri na abaki baki biongeria obwakire bosi bwaki buseke bura bwakire bwaki bwakiriri Bwakire bwa Abakire.
Dholuo: Garissa County Education Board otimeyo kuom ploko duto ma ok oundu e gima ongi kelo pochi e learners. Vanjinyak mar parents to guardians nochako gima ongi nikech mano piny Ministry of Education.
Somali: Guddiga Waxbarashada ee Degmada Garissa ayaa lagu eedeeyay inuu soo rogay qaab dhaqaale oo aan la oggolaan oo lagu soo rogay ardayda. Waalidka iyo ilaaliyeyaasha waa in ay si degdeg ah uga warbixiyaan dalabaadka noocaas ah Wasaaradda Waxbarashada.

English: Parents are urged to pay school fees on time to support school operations and ensure quality education.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanahimizwa kulipa ada za shule kwa wakati ili kusaidia shughuli za shule na kuhakikisha elimu bora.
Ekegusii: Abakore bateganya kwigana gusurori meka masomo nyaki bw'ogokware bui, buya bwanene bwagokunyegani omogori bw'ekigoro.
Dholuo: Odhiero ma nyaka nyaka joma okonyo kuom konyi gi timbe mar chike, kendo umo gima atimoro duto.
Somali: Waalidku waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay waqtigooda ku bixiyaan lacagta dugsiga si ay u taageeraan hawlaha dugsiga iyo inay hubiyaan waxbarasho tayo leh.

English: There is currently no formal offer or funding available to clear teachers' salary arrears. Teachers should stay informed on any developments regarding salary payments.
Kiswahili: Kuna ofa rasmi au ufadhili wa kulipa deni la mishahara ya walimu kwa sasa. Walimu wanapaswa kubaki na habari kuhusu maendeleo ya malipo ya mishahara.
Ekegusii: Ojwaki omokirighani na oborori bwakireri bwaki bwogana bwasichendi. Abakilasi batarire bamenyere okorwakira buya eng'echi bwokwirane bwasichendi.
Dholuo: Nyasaye ni kendo en ahinya kata magi ma ok jachieng' e wacho ma niko ma jachieng' bende nyal makuom. Jachieng' nyalo wadi e yo marach kama owach ka mitindo ma oseyuduh.
Somali: Hadda ma jirto dalab rasmi ah ama maalgelin loogu talagalay in la bixiyo deynta mushaarka macallimiinta. Macallimiintu waa inay sii jiraan wararkii ku saabsan bixinta mushaarka.

English: Orero Boys Senior School in Homa Bay County is providing replacement mattresses, blankets, and bed sheets to 107 students affected by a dormitory fire. Parents will be informed through class teachers.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Upili ya Orero Boys katika Kaunti ya Homa Bay inatoa matandiko mapya, blanketi, na mavazi ya kulalia kwa wanafunzi 107 walioathirika na moto katika bweni. Wazazi wataarifiwa kupitia walimu wa darasa.
Ekegusii: Orero Boys Senior School mosi Homa Bay County eyaagirira omokoro ogenda, mbukoni, nakiitake buya 107 abogenda na oroka ogwang'ana. Abakire bosi bwantigana babaenda kuchire buya.
Dholuo: Orero Boys Senior School e Homa Bay County en gi kuom dho-mattress machiegni, dho-blanket, kendo dho-bed sheets manok e 107 dhoot mar dho-dormitory moiyore. Dhoot nigi pari gi dongo mag class teachers.
Somali: Dugsiga Sare ee Orero Boys ee Gobolka Homa Bay ayaa bixinaya barkimooyin beddelan, barkimooyin, iyo goonnada sariirta 107 arday oo ay saameysay dab ka kacay dormitory. Waalidiinta waxaa lagu wargelin doonaa macallimiinta fasallada.

English: France has passed a law banning social media usage for children under 15, effective September 2026, requiring age verification for new accounts and extending to all users by January 2027.
Kiswahili: Ufaransa umepita sheria inayopiga marufuku matumizi ya mitandao ya kijamii kwa watoto chini ya umri wa miaka 15, kuanzia Septemba 2026, inayohitaji uthibitisho wa umri kwa akaunti mpya na itawajumuisha watumiaji wote ifikapo Januari 2027.
Ekegusii: France yaki ogetagani oria omogori bwakire buya omogori babere buya 15, nabwaki buya Septemba 2026, na okenyani oborati bwaki bwokire bwakire buya maarifa na bwaki buya Janweli 2027.
Dholuo: France wowacho dhrugo mar kanyakla social media bene duto ma dongo 15, ka ombulu September 2026, ma okelo pacho madongo e yo mar kanyakla mga piny, kendo gi chako kuom duto nduogo January 2027.
Somali: Faransiiska waxay soo saartay xeer mamnuucaya isticmaalka warbaahinta bulshada ee carruurta aan gaadhin da'da 15, oo dhaqan galaysa Sebtember 2026, waxayna u baahan tahay in la xaqiijiyo da'da akoonnada cusub, sidoo kale waxay ku faafineysaa dhammaan isticmaalaasha Janaayo 2027.

English: The National Registration Bureau has launched a mobile ID registration program for eligible secondary school students, starting July 20, 2026. School principals must facilitate the process.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Usajili wa Kitaifa imezindua programu ya usajili wa kitambulisho kwa wanafunzi wa sekondari wanaostahili, kuanzia Julai 20, 2026. Wakuu wa shule wanapaswa kuwezesha mchakato huu.
Ekegusii: Eguru ya Nyangusu ya Inyancha ikiachiye buya obwaki buya bwaki buya bwira na abandu babere bwogana buya gucheka abanchanane, mugana nyankweri Ebutusu 20, 2026. Abakire b’eshule naki baretabere baria buya bwaki.
Dholuo: Bureau mar Kanyakla osegwe thok ma oting' ID ng'ato kendo gi giongo ma oketho, manok kwayo Julai 20, 2026. Maekel mar shule nyaka ojal gi joma oketho kendo ni.
Somali: Xafiiska Diiwaangelinta Qaranka wuxuu bilaabay barnaamij diiwaan gelin ID moobil ah oo loogu talagalay ardayda dugsiga sare ee u qalma, oo bilaabanaya July 20, 2026. Madaxda dugsiyada waa inay fududeeyaan habka.

English: Elgeyo Marakwet County has formed a special committee to combat rising cases of FGM in Kerio Valley. Residents are urged to report any suspected cases immediately, as FGM is illegal.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Elgeyo Marakwet imeunda kamati maalum kupambana na kuongezeka kwa kesi za FGM katika Bonde la Kerio. Wanakijiji wanahimizwa kuripoti kesi zozote zinazoshukiwa mara moja, kwani FGM ni kinyume cha sheria.
Ekegusii: Kisiro cha Elgeyo Marakwet kionekere chakamorori chire kageria omoriba buya bwakire okwene buya bw’FGM mu Kerio Valley. Abakiyesi bareme obokire buya bwogetere bwaki naki, buya bwe FGM biano naki.
Dholuo: Elgeyo Marakwet County anyalo chako komiti ma okonyo chalo duto ma FGM oherorey mondo to ng'ama Kerio Valley. Wuoyi oting' nyaka ber ng'ato ma okonyo ohero hoka, kendo FGM nigi piny.
Somali: Degmada Elgeyo Marakwet ayaa sameysay guddi gaara oo lagula dagaallamayo kiiska korodhka ah ee FGM ee ku saabsan Wabiga Kerio. Dadweynaha waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay si degdeg ah u soo sheegaan kiisaska shaki leh, maadaama FGM ay sharci darro tahay.

English: Mwea Technical and Vocational College is now offering training in modern agricultural practices and rabbit farming. Enroll to gain skills for self-employment in the agribusiness sector.
Kiswahili: Chuo cha Ufundi na Ufundi Stadi cha Mwea sasa kinatoa mafunzo katika mbinu za kisasa za kilimo na ufugaji wa sungura. Jisajili ili kupata ujuzi wa kuajiriwa mwenyewe katika sekta ya kilimo.
Ekegusii: Mwea Technical and Vocational College naki itegere omokiranya oria ogokere omonene mu mitsi ya agriibusiness na otaki ogotegere okokora. Naki mwaki okokora omokiranya oria oboriri.
Dholuo: Mwea Technical na Vocational College niki ohero gima gitimo mag joti gi nyithindo mar gik makwongo gi sa. Odug tobed gi joma okethi kido kuom joma agri-business.
Somali: Jaamacadda Teknolojiyadda iyo Xirfadaha ee Mwea waxay hadda bixisaa tababar ku saabsan dhaqanka beeraha casriga ah iyo koritaanka bakaylaha. Isdiiwaangeli si aad u hesho xirfado ku aaddan shaqo-abuurka qeybta ganacsiga beeraha.

English: Teachers are advised to review their payslips following the implementation of Phase II of the 2025–2029 Collective Bargaining Agreement, which may reflect minimal salary increases.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanashauriwa kuchunguza payslip zao kufuatia utekelezaji wa Awamu ya Pili ya Mkataba wa Mashauriano wa Kikazi wa 2025–2029, ambao unaweza kuonesha ongezeko dogo la mishahara.
Ekegusii: Abakora bosi abaki bagenzi bategere buya obwakinyanihamaki bwa payslip zabo orenge bamwaki naki Phase II buse 2025–2029 Collective Bargaining Agreement, buya bwetere bwoneka naki abaki buya bwamomogekanya.
Dholuo: Mwalimu nyasaye ka konyo gima ongi e payslips gi tetere mag Phase II mar 2025–2029 Collective Bargaining Agreement, ka odhi piny ma ok nyal chieng' modong'.
Somali: Macalimiinta waxaa lagu talinayaa inay dib u eegaan payslip-kooda ka dib hirgelinta Waqtiga II ee Heshiiska Shaqada ee 2025–2029, kaas oo muujin kara korodh minimal ah oo mushaharada.

English: Parents are urged to remain actively involved in their university children's lives by monitoring their activities, offering guidance, and instilling strong values to prevent negative influences.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanahimizwa kuendelea kushiriki kikamilifu katika maisha ya watoto wao wa chuo kikuu kwa kufuatilia shughuli zao, kutoa mwongozo, na kuimarisha maadili mazuri ili kuzuia athari mbaya.
Ekegusii: Ababere baturia bano bakiere buya muigi bwabaki bano bama bonyang'ani, bosianga bwaki bwendo, na bokiire omokiri omogori oria nimaratikire omokiri buya.
Dholuo: Bura uru dhi gima to nyithindo mar university, nyal bende timo bura ni giwuok, nopogore maber, kendo nochuo ng'ato maber nyaka itimo goyo duto.
Somali: Waalidiinta waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay si firfircoon uga qayb qaataan nolosha carruurtooda jaamacadda iyagoo la soconaya hawlahooda, bixinaya hanuun, iyo dhisaya qiyam adag si looga hortago saameyn xun.

English: All Kenyans are urged to participate in tree-planting initiatives at their former schools to combat climate change and boost forest cover. Ensure seedlings are nurtured until maturity for best results.
Kiswahili: Wakenya wote wanashauriwa kushiriki katika mipango ya upandaji miti katika shule zao za zamani ili kutatua mabadiliko ya tabianchi na kuongeza kiwango cha msitu. Hakikisheni kwamba miche inatunzwa hadi kuwa mkubwa kwa matokeo bora.
