Ekegusii: Abakane bose bakang'ana omokiranya omotati mwikibori yabo yakari buya pinyenje ya climate change naki baire bw'ogendachire. Naki oregesia orokokere buya okorondo.
Dholuo: Bende wadu alluochi kuom gima ginyal gi jowando tree-planting e dhako ma ok nyal kuom konyo nyasach ni gima ginyalo, kendo itie forest cover. Nyal konyo seedlings donge marach luoro nyaka nyaka gi gima giyier.
Somali: Dhammaan Kenyanka waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay kaqeybqaataan mashaariicda geedka beerista ee dugsiyadoodii hore si looga hortago isbeddelka cimilada iyo in la kordhiyo dhirta kaymaha. Hubi in la daryeelo abuurka ilaa uu ka gaadho bislaanshaha si loo helo natiijooyin wanaagsan.

English: The Meru Governor's office is using sports events to address Gender-Based Violence, teenage pregnancy, and drug abuse. Engage with local sports programs to help empower youth in your community.
Kiswahili: Ofisi ya Gavana wa Meru inatumia matukio ya michezo kushughulikia Unyanyasaji wa Kijinsia, ujauzito wa vijana, na matumizi ya madawa ya kulevya. Shiriki katika programu za michezo za jamii ili kusaidia kuwaimarisha vijana katika eneo lako.
Ekegusii: Ofisi ya Gavana wa Meru inatumia matukio ya michezo kukabili Viuclutui vya Kijinsia, ujauzito wa vijana, na matumizi ya dawa za kulevya. Jihusishe na programu za michezo za eneo lako kusaidia kuimarisha vijana katika jamii yako.
Dholuo: Ofisi mar Governa Meru nigi nyaka kuom jodal odhiambo kwach owinjruok, nyiri ewi, gi chako maber. Jiin joma nyaka winjruok ahinya ka ng'ato ochung' mar mago duto kuom jomain yath.
Somali: Xafiiska Guddoomiyaha Meru wuxuu isticmaalayaa dhacdooyinka ciyaaraha si uu ula tacaalo Rabitaanka Jinsiga ee ku saleysan, uurka dhallinyarada, iyo isticmaalka daroogada. Ka qayb qaado barnaamijyada ciyaaraha deegaanka si aad gacan uga geysato kor u qaadida dhalinyarada deegaankaaga.

English: Form Four candidates are encouraged to engage in comprehensive revision programs to prepare effectively for the KCSE exams. Prioritize revisiting, reviewing, and repetition of syllabus content.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa Kidato cha Nne wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mipango ya marekebisho ya kina ili kujiandaa vyema kwa mtihani wa KCSE. Tilia mkazo upya, hakiki, na kurudiarudia maudhui ya mtaala.
Ekegusii: Abakinyanya bane borana Bakeng’ero na naki baria okorora nyang’ori ya KCSE. Bakiere oborere, okuborere na obwakuragia bwenge bwosi bwa syllabus.
Dholuo: Abiriyo Form Four wanyal moko kuom kendo yienu gi giluong' ma okinyi kanyakla e KCSE. Wacho marach kuom tich, romo, kendo tiyo gi duto ma nikech syllabus.
Somali: Ardayda fasalka afaraad waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ku hawlan yihiin barnaamijyo dib-u-eegis oo dhameystiran si ay si hufan ugu diyaar garoobaan imtixaannada KCSE. Mudnaanta sii dib-u-eegidda, dib-u-dhiska, iyo ku celcelinta maaddooyinka manhajka.

English: The Vihiga Teaching and Referral Hospital (VTRH) is now the preferred healthcare provider for teachers under KUPPET in Vihiga County.
Kiswahili: Hospitali ya Ualimu na Rufaa Vihiga (VTRH) sasa ndiyo mtoa huduma wa afya anayependekezwa kwa walimu chini ya KUPPET katika Kaunti ya Vihiga.
Ekegusii: Vihiga Teaching and Referral Hospital (VTRH) naki ngomokireri ya buya bwakire buya bwanjoka KUPPET mu oria Vihiga.
Dholuo: Nya Vihiga Teaching and Referral Hospital (VTRH) ne amora mana nyaka ng'ato ka KUPPET kendo Vihiga.
Somali: Isbitaalka Macallimiinta iyo Talo-bixinta Vihiga (VTRH) wuxuu hadda yahay adeeg bixiye caafimaad oo la doorbido oo loogu talagalay macallimiinta KUPPET ee ku sugan Gobolka Vihiga.

English: Parents are encouraged to support their children in developing resilience, emotional intelligence, and adaptability, as good grades alone do not guarantee future success.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanahimizwa kumuunga mkono mtoto wao katika kujiendeleza katika uvumilivu, akili ya kihisia, na uwezo wa kubadilika, kwani alama nzuri pekee hazihakikishi mafanikio ya baadaye.
Ekegusii: Abakire bategereje buya bakiigane buya bakanana bakanene wazire, omogogotere omosa, nakiire omogoria, naki oserere obwakire bwatari buya busibori bwanake.
Dholuo: Pinyono machiegni nyathi gidhi wach kuom tich, gichung gi nyithindo, kod tich ma ok gite, niya kende miyo piny mar bura en wendo.
Somali: Waalidiinta waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay taageeraan carruurtooda si ay u horumariyaan adkeysiga, garaadka dareenka, iyo la qabsiga, maadaama darajooyin wanaagsan kaliya aysan damaanad qaadin guul mustaqbalka.

English: The National Government Constituencies Development Fund (NG-CDF) allocation has increased to Sh61.8 billion, benefiting students, public schools, and health facilities across Kenya.
Kiswahili: Kiasi cha fedha kutoka Mfuko wa Maendeleo wa Jimbo la Serikali ya Kitaifa (NG-CDF) kimeongezeka hadi Sh61.8 bilioni, kikinufaisha wanafunzi, shule za umma, na vituo vya afya kote Kenya.
Ekegusii: Gasi ya National Government Constituencies Development Fund (NG-CDF) igokire go naki Sh61.8 billion, ikubwakire abaki, masomo amaki, na bota bwakiri bwakire buya mu Kenya.
Dholuo: Ng'ato gi buya maler no ng'ato gi Sh61.8 billion, ma oket gi wanjura, shule duto, ne wathore madong' tije e Kenya.
Somali: Fondo Horumarinta Deegaanka Dawladda Qaran (NG-CDF) ayaa kordhay ilaa Sh61.8 bilyan, taasoo ka faa'iidaysanaysa ardayda, iskuulada dadweynaha, iyo xarumaha caafimaadka guud ee Kenya.

English: The Teachers Service Commission is seeking qualified candidates for commissioner posts. Interested individuals should prepare to apply based on merit and suitability.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma za Walimu inatafuta wagombea wenye sifa kwa nafasi za kamishna. Watu wanaovutiwa wanapaswa kujiandaa kuomba kulingana na uwezo na ufanisi.
Ekegusii: Abakoryani bakiaria buse bui ogenda  buya omogori bosi. Abande bataria bwokire kubwoge buya obwakire na obogori.
Dholuo: Teachers Service Commission nyaka ong'ere joma okinyi ma ber e commissioner. Joma nitie ni, nigi konyo kueyo goyo ma gi duto en kido.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macalimiinta waxa uu raadinayaa musharrixiin aqoon u leh xilalka komishanka. Shakhsiyaadka danaynaya waa in ay diyaar u noqdaan in ay codsadaan iyadoo lagu salaynayo karti iyo ku habboonaan.

English: Kenyan universities are tasked with leading discussions to shape the country's development agenda following Vision 2030. Engage with the proposal and contribute to this vital national conversation.
Kiswahili: Vyuo vikuu vya Kenya vinawajibika kuongoza mijadala ya kuunda ajenda ya maendeleo ya nchi kufuatia Vision 2030. Jihusishe na pendekezo hili na changia katika mazungumzo haya muhimu ya kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Amakoya gaki oemagane na ugwaki bw'ene Nyasa chogoria ya Vision 2030. Naki oria tugirire khokigo na mwaki buya buya bw'ogokong'ana.
Dholuo: Miguzo kendo magi okinyi ni kuom mar kanyakla kaka nyalo tera chula kuom Vision 2030. Koro toth kare nyalo chiegni e ndalo duto ma okinyi.
Somali: Jaamacadaha Kenya ayaa loo xilsaaray in ay hogaamiyaan wadahadalada si loo sameeyo ajandaha horumarineed ee dalka iyadoo la raacayo Aragtida 2030. Ka qayb qaado soo jeedinta oo ka mid noqo wadahadalka muhiimka ah ee qaran.

English: The principal of St. Teresiah Preparatory School has been released on a cash bail of Sh100,000 or a surety bond of Sh200,000 following an assault charge.
Kiswahili: Mwalimu mkuu wa Shule ya Valibuk Prep St. Teresiah ametolewa kwa dhamana ya pesa ya Sh100,000 au dhamana ya Sh200,000 kufuatia tuhuma za shambulio.
Ekegusii: Mwalimu mookire wa Shule ya Valisa ya St. Teresiah amechiriwa kwa dhamana ya pesa ya Sh100,000 au dhamana ya mjezi ya Sh200,000 baada ya kulaumiwa kwa shambulio.
Dholuo: Ong'wech ma St. Teresiah Preparatory School osekoro aneno kuom chike duto Sh100,000 kata chike ma nyalo yudo Sh200,000 ka owinjruok kuom tinge.
Somali: Madaxa Dugsiga Sare ee St. Teresiah ayaa la sii daayay kadib markii lagu kafay Sh100,000 ama dammaanad Sh200,000 ka dib eedeyn huwan.

English: Heads of Institutions are encouraged to project professionalism through their appearance and conduct, as this sets a standard for students and staff in schools.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa Taasisi wanahimizwa kuonyesha ujuzi na weledi kupitia mwonekano na tabia zao, kwani hii inaweka kiwango kwa wanafunzi na wafanyakazi shuleni.
Ekegusii: Abakire batarera barekire omokirori biao na ogokogo bw'ekinyatire, buya baineria omokoro buya baturia bware bosi ne bakirigani.
Dholuo: Wuon gonde nochiegni kuom chike mag pacho kendo piny, wacho ni nyiri kanyo mar chiw, kik ibednino ng'wonji ma omiyo timo wendo kuom jamaa kod waki.
Somali: Hoggaamiyeyaasha Hay'adaha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay muujiyaan xirfadaysanimo iyada oo loo marayo muuqalkooda iyo dhaqankooda, maadaama tani ay dejinayso heer ardayda iyo shaqaalaha dugsiyada.

English: Victoria Muoka has officially taken up the position of Central Regional Director in Nyeri, while John Nzuvu has reported to the Western Region as the new Regional Director.
Kiswahili: Victoria Muoka amekalia rasmi nafasi ya Mkurugenzi wa Mkoa wa Kati huko Nyeri, wakati John Nzuvu amejitenga na Mkoa wa Magharibi kama Mkurugenzi Mpya wa Mkoa.
Ekegusii: Victoria Muoka omokire mwaki oremokanya Central Regional Director buya Nyeri, na John Nzuvu omokire mwaki omogoti buya Regional Director buya Western Region.
Dholuo: Victoria Muoka awachiko kamano mar Central Regional Director e Nyeri, kendo John Nzuvu awuonyo e Western Region njeng' Regional Director moko.
Somali: Victoria Muoka waxa si rasmi ah u qaatay jagada Agaasimaha Gobolka Bartamaha ee Nyeri, halka John Nzuvu uu u tagay Gobolka Galbeed sidii Agaasime Goboleed cusub.

English: Wilson Sossion and Antonina Lentoijoni have been nominated to the Teachers Service Commission. Their appointments await vetting by the National Assembly.
Kiswahili: Wilson Sossion na Antonina Lentoijoni wameteuliwa kwenye Tume ya Huduma za Walimu. Mteule wao unatarajiwa kuangaliwa na Bunge la Kitaifa.
Ekegusii: Wilson Sossion na Antonina Lentoijoni babaetere omosi na Teachers Service Commission. Abaki buya abaki omogama bwakinyang'ani bwa National Assembly.
Dholuo: Wilson Sossion gi Antonina Lentoijoni en odek omiye kuom Teachers Service Commission. Konyo ma odek odefee kanyonyo gi National Assembly.
Somali: Wilson Sossion iyo Antonina Lentoijoni ayaa lagu magacaabay Hay'adda Adeegga Macallimiinta. Magacaabistooda waxay sugayaan baaritaan ka yimaada Golaha Shacabka.

English: Parents in Busia County are urged to actively support their children's education by monitoring academic progress and attending school meetings to ensure disciplined and successful learners.
Kiswahili: Wazazi katika Kaunti ya Busia wanahimizwa kusaidia kwa nguvu elimu ya watoto wao kwa kufuatilia maendeleo ya masomo na kuhudhuria mikutano ya shule ili kuhakikisha wanafunzi wanakuwa na nidhamu na mafanikio.
Ekegusii: Abaki baki Busia batiosa orete buya bwaki bweng'ane naki chirebaki bwesibori naki bwogenda bwokire buya bwenjige bosi naki buya bwaki bwakirorania.
Dholuo: Kikwayi ni obet piny Busia k’o yudhi nyathi kwayo, kendo omiyogi kanyen makelo thuru, kendo omiya miyo jopiny makwayo.
Somali: Waalidiinta Gobolka Busia waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay si firfircoon u taageeraan waxbarashada carruurtooda, iyagoo la soconaya horumarka aqooneed iyo ka qaybgala kulammada dugsiga si ay u hubiyaan in ardaydu yihiin kuwo anshax leh oo guuleysta.

English: Attention: Kibingei Girls High School in Kericho County is experiencing a severe water shortage, causing students to walk over 800 meters daily to fetch water. Immediate action is needed to restore the water supply.
Kiswahili: Tahadhari: Shule ya Sekondari ya Wasichana Kibingei katika Kaunti ya Kericho inakabiliwa na upungufu mkali wa maji, ikilazimisha wanafunzi kutembea zaidi ya mita 800 kila siku kutafuta maji. Hatua za haraka zinahitajika kurejesha usambazaji wa maji.
Ekegusii: Ikania: Kibingei Girls High School omokirori inchemi ya majii, omotebere buya buya buya na buya orutuo ochare 800 meters orogori omokosi majii. Omosukire buya buya buya buya oruo ebisabaki ya majii.
Dholuo: Ng'ato: Kibingei Girls High School kuom Kericho County en gi ndalu mobet, ma oket gi kambi ka boys noket punde 800 meters jorwe ka iting' ndalo. Kakewa piny eyo kofia namba kanyona ka awuoro ng'ato.
Somali: Digniin: Dugsiga Sare ee Gabdhaha Kibingei ee Gobolka Kericho ayaa la kulmaysa yaraanta biyo weyn, ardayduna waxay maalin kasta soconayaan in ka badan 800 mitir si ay u helaan biyo. Tallaabo degdeg ah ayaa loo baahan yahay si dib loogu soo celiyo sahayda biyaha.

English: AGC Tenwek Hospital has successfully performed Kenya's first keyhole surgery for a newborn with a rare congenital condition. This advanced procedure enhances local paediatric healthcare capabilities.
Kiswahili: Hospitali ya AGC Tenwek imefanikiwa kufanya upasuaji wa kwanza wa kuingilia kwa funguo nchini Kenya kwa mtoto mchanga mwenye hali nadra ya kuzaliwa. Utaratibu huu wa kisasa unaimarisha uwezo wa huduma za afya za watoto katika eneo hilo.
Ekegusii: AGC Tenwek Hospital naki omokore kosi ekhinyaki ogenda Ekegusii omokiri naki omoige keyhole omokiri naki oborane buya. Ekitari naki shinyaki ekoragania ogendani ya paediatric.
Dholuo: AGC Tenwek Hospital oseremo Kenya kendo gi keyhole surgery mar pien ma ok nyal nyuol. Kichal mokuo machiegni optimizes paediatric healthcare mar local.
Somali: Isbitaalka AGC Tenwek waxa uu si guul leh u sameeyay qalliin fure-yar ah oo ugu horreeyay Kenya ee loogu talagalay dhallaanka leh xaalad dhashay oo aan caadi ahayn. Habkan horumarsan wuxuu kor u qaadi doonaa awoodaha daryeelka caafimaadka caruurta ee deegaanka.

English: Former KCSE candidates can now access and verify their certificates online via the KNEC e-Certificate portal. Register as an applicant on the site to get started.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa zamani wa KCSE sasa wanaweza kupata na kuthibitisha vyeti vyao mtandaoni kupitia lango la KNEC e-Certificate. Jisajili kama mpiga ombi kwenye tovuti ili kuanza.
Ekegusii: Abakire ba ehemal KCSE baryang’ere na bware na bagenyire eceri zao online ka omotagari ya KNEC e-Certificate. Regista ng'enda asibori mu site ino oreka bw'ononchora.
Dholuo: Kondegi gi KCSE odesk e kinde mondo awonore kanyakla kod kuonde gi KNEC e-Certificate portal. Bende wacho kuom nyaka onyuolo.
Somali: Magaalada hore ee KCSE waxay hadda ka heli karaan oo xaqiijin karaan shahaadooyinkooda khadka tooska ah iyada oo loo marayo bogga KNEC e-Certificate. Isdiiwaangeli sida codsadayaasha ah si aad u bilowdo.

English: The Kenya Independent Commissions Workers Union (KICOWU) demands that the Teachers Service Commission suspends the conversion of secretariat staff's employment terms until further consultation is conducted.
Kiswahili: Shirikisho la Wafanyakazi wa Kamati Huru la Kenya (KICOWU) linaitaka Tume ya Huduma za Walimu kukatisha mabadiliko ya masharti ya ajira ya wafanyakazi wa sekretariari hadi mazungumzo zaidi yafanyike.
Ekegusii: Umwaki wa Abantu ba Kenya ba Maalimu (KICOWU) okore ogakanga ikireka omokire buya bwakire buya buya buya omogori omogorere omokere oro nyina.
Dholuo: Kenya Independent Commissions Workers Union (KICOWU) en ng'idh e yo ma Teachers Service Commission nyal ma ok puodhi ni puoth sekendi ma denda gi ng'eyo mar kumakamano.
Somali: Ururka Shaqaalaha Komishanka Madaxa-banaan ee Kenya (KICOWU) wuxuu dalbanayaa in Komishanka Adeegga Macallimiinta la joojiyo beddelka shuruudaha shaqaalaha xafiiska ilaa la sameeyo wada-tashi dheeraad ah.

English: The Public Service Commission has announced 130 government job vacancies, including the Vice Chancellor position at Bomet University. Interested applicants should visit www.publicservice.go.ke for details and apply online or submit applications in person.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma za Umma imetangaza nafasi 130 za kazi za serikali, pamoja na nafasi ya Makamu Mkuu wa Chuo katika Chuo Kikuu cha Bomet. Waombaji wenye nia wanapaswa kutembelea www.publicservice.go.ke kwa maelezo na kuomba mtandaoni au kuwasilisha maombi kwa mkono.
Ekegusii: Amashirika ga Makiya gaki bw'ekirori gaki 130 ogereng'ana kiaki, kigocha kinyako e Vice Chancellor k'Bomet University. Abakire ogenda bw'ekirori batarere ogenda www.publicservice.go.ke buya gaki na omobori bwa oria buya.
Dholuo: Public Service Commission omedhi 130 koni mar serikali, ka wacho gi Vice Chancellor e Bomet University. Konyo mang’weny yope konyo juma www.publicservice.go.ke kanyal ni kanyo online kamano, to kanyo ma wacho e pacho.
Somali: Komishanka Adeegga Dadweynaha ayaa shaacisay 130 firaaqo shaqo oo dowladeed, oo ay ku jirto jagada Madaxweyne ku xigeenka jaamacadda Bomet. Codsadayaasha xiiseynaya waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay booqdaan www.publicservice.go.ke si ay u helaan faahfaahin iyo inay online ka codsadaan ama codsiyada si toos ah ugu gudbiyaan.

English: Beware of job recruitment scams claiming to secure positions in the Teachers Service Commission and National Police Service. Recruitment is free and merit-based—do not pay for job promises.
Kiswahili: Kuweni makini na udanganyifu wa ajira unaodai kusaidia kupata nafasi katika Tume ya Huduma za Walimu na Huduma ya Polisi ya Taifa. Uajiri ni bure na unategemea sifa—usilipe kwa ahadi za kazi.
Ekegusii: Ishokong'ania abaki bosi abaki obokirigania konyanagwo omogaki mu Teachers Service Commission na National Police Service. Obokirigania bori naki na obokire naki—ntseng'eti bosi buya ikigana.
Dholuo: Kube kido bura mogik ma adhi nyiri nyaka miwuok ma okinyi e Teachers Service Commission kod National Police Service. Jotieko ne okinyi kendo biro chako—dhi nyiso kwach ma ibiro e job.
Somali: Ka digtoonow khiyaamooyinka shaqo raadinta ee sheeganaya inay kuu xaqiijinayaan meelaha ka banaan Adeegga Macallimiinta iyo Ciidanka Booliiska Qaranka. Qorista waa bilaash oo ku saleysan kartida - ha bixin lacag si aad shaqo u hesho.

English: St. Joseph's Sino Secondary School has received a new 67-seater bus to facilitate student transport for academic trips and exams.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Sekondari ya St. Joseph's Sino imepokea basi jipya lenye viti 67 ili kusaidia usafiri wa wanafunzi kwa ajili ya safari za kitaaluma na mitihani.
Ekegusii: Chire na Chikoro cha St. Joseph's Sino ore buse buya omogori 67 obwakwiri omokore bw'ekibori oria oria naki oria naki.
Dholuo: St. Joseph's Sino Secondary School en kelo bus nyaka 67 kamoro ma ok nyal winjogo miyo tіd madhiya motegno kuom chalo ma ok nyal winjogo.
Somali: Dugsiga Sare ee St. Joseph's Sino wuxuu helay bas cusub oo 67 xarag ah si loo fududeeyo gaadiidka ardayda safarada tacliinta iyo imtixaannada.

English: Qualified P1 teachers are urged to register and update their records with the Teachers Service Commission (TSC) to be considered for upcoming recruitment opportunities.
Kiswahili: Walimu wenye sifa za P1 wanasisitizwa kujiandikisha na kuwasilisha taarifa zao kwa Tume ya Huduma za Walimu (TSC) ili waweze kuzingatiwa kwa fursa za ajira zinazokuja.
Ekegusii: Abagoti bano batokeri P1 bategetegeriwe kuboka na gukang'ana bano omokora kera kw'ogendi na Abagabuni b'Abakere (TSC) buse batora oria bano abarigoti bu pweke.
Dholuo: Abich P1 ma ok nya ji nyi en ywech to kwach kawuono kendo ikadho record na Tichni Tich-gi (TSC) to igol mopogore ma osemagogi.
Somali: Macallimiinta P1 ee shahaadada leh waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay isdiiwaangeliyaan oo ay cusbooneysiiyaan diiwaankooda Ururka Adeegga Macallimiinta (TSC) si loo tixgeliyo fursadaha shaqo ee soo socda.

English: Parents are urged to resolve custody disputes outside of school to prevent emotional distress for learners and disruption of the educational environment.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanatakiwa kutatua mizozo ya utunzaji wa watoto nje ya shule ili kuzuia msongo wa mawazo kwa wanafunzi na kuvuruga mazingira ya elimu.
Ekegusii: Ababere baria abogori bosi toke ng'eno bwakore bwaki matakire bwaki bwahene buya burokere oria abogori.
Dholuo: Otimre an gi ng'ato oting'eyo to giyudhi joma ohuor kaka gichamo chike mag nyithindo, khan gi miyo pe giweche mokwongo mane yande gi ng'ato to ginyis gendo.
Somali: Waalidiinta waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay xalliyaan khilaafaadka mas'uuliyadda carruurta meel ka baxsan iskuulka si looga fogaado agab xanuun leh oo loogu talagalay ardayda iyo carqaladeynta deegaanka waxbarashada.

English: Tinderet Technical and Vocational Training College has completed a new tuition block and Electrical and Electronics Workshop to enhance training opportunities. Enroll now to benefit from upgraded facilities.
Kiswahili: Chuo cha Mafunzo ya Ufundi na Kitaaluma cha Tinderet kimekamilisha jengo jipya la ada na Warsha ya Umeme na Elektroniki ili kuboresha fursa za mafunzo. Jiandikishe sasa ili kufaidika na vituo vilivyoboreshwa.
Ekegusii: Tinderet Technical and Vocational Training College imaraki igena busharu na ogoti bw'ekarori bw'ibara na ogoti bw'egikonyi bw'osembera obw'ekikoro. Bwakurora omokire ogotare bakuria ogoti bwasibori.
Dholuo: Tinderet Technical and Vocational Training College awuoro ng'wonjruok kanyikiyo newo ma en tuition block kod Electrical ne Electronics Workshop, kuom kit mar training. Nyal gi enrol kake to nyaka ung'eyo benefiti kuom ndiege maber.
Somali: Kolahadda Tababbarka Farsamada iyo Xirfadaha ee Tinderet ayaa dhameystirtay dhismaha cusub ee lacagaha waxbarashada iyo Warshada Korontada iyo Elektaroonigga si loo xoojiyo fursadaha tababbarka. Isku qor hadda si aad uga faa'iidaysato adeegyada la hagaajiyay.

English: All students, student leaders, friends, and stakeholders of TUM are invited to an urgent assembly today at 4 PM at the TUM Graduation Square to honor the legacy of former TUMSA President Elvis Otieno.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wote, viongozi wa wanafunzi, marafiki, na wadau wa TUM mnakalibishwa katika mkutano wa dharura leo saa 10 jioni kwenye Uwanja wa Kuanzisha TUM kuenzi urithi wa Rais wa zamani wa TUMSA, Elvis Otieno.
Ekegusii: Abanyanji bosi, abokwa bano, abaki na abakire baki TUM, mugesia moshule moitemo naki bw'ekebori nyaki ine oria nyakare buya na 4 PM na TUM Graduation Square buya buorogori bw'ekere buya bw'otego bwi TUMSA, Elvis Otieno.
Dholuo: Waneno ng'ato maneo, wakiwacho, nyasaye, kod dhok mag TUM owar gi yore e nyiso ma nyalo taw owuon gima 4 PM e TUM Graduation Square, to jachieng' ni kaka jowet ni Elvis Otieno, ombulu mag TUMSA.
Somali: Dhammaan ardayda, hoggaamiyeyaasha ardayda, asxaabta, iyo daneeyayaasha TUM waxaa lagu casuumay shir degdeg ah maanta saacadu markay tahay 4 PM, goobta qalinjebinta TUM, si loo xuso hibooyinkii Madaxweyne Elvis Otieno oo hore u ahaa TUMSA.

English: All public university and college students will receive full state funding starting September 2026, pending Parliament approval. No qualified learner should be denied access due to financial constraints.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wote wa vyuo vikuu na vyuo vya umma watapata ufadhili kamili wa serikali kuanzia Septemba 2026, ikiwa tu itathibitishwa na Bunge. Hakuna mwanafunzi aliye na sifa anayeweza kukataliwa kutokana na ukosefu wa fedha.
Ekegusii: Abanaiti banye na buya buya bwaki bwenkore naki chimbere ya September 2026, oketendekwenye ng’otanyane ya Parliamenti. Omo ogendebwaki abaki ebwakire buya omosi bwanekore ogenda buya bwaki bwakire naki.
Dholuo: Oloo ma okinyi gi studenti nyaka ni wacho bang' chiegni kelo e reg gi konyruok maler kuom Septemba mokuongo 2026, ka Parliament ng'eyo. Naki mbaka chalo omiye kuom pien ng'eyo ma ok ohuor.
Somali: Dhammaan ardayda jaamacadaha iyo kuliyadaha dadweynaha ayaa heleysa maalgelin buuxda oo dowladeed laga bilaabo Sebtember 2026, balse waxay ku xiran tahay ansixinta Baarlamaanka. Arday kasta oo xaq u leh in waxbarasho la siiyo looma diidi doono sababo la xiriira dhaqaale xumo.

English: Nyabisase Secondary School has reopened for learners. Readmission began July 20; Grade 10 students report first, followed by Form Three and Form Four. A fine of KSh 3,500 is required, and students must be accompanied by a guardian.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Sekondari ya Nyabisase imefunguliwa tena kwa wanafunzi. Kupokea wanafunzi wapya kulianzia Julai 20; wanafunzi wa Kidato cha 10 wajiunge kwanza, wakifuatiwa na Kidato cha Tatu na Kidato cha Nne. Faini ya KSh 3,500 inahitajika, na wanafunzi lazima waje na mlezi.
Ekegusii: Nyabisase Secondary School eria naki ikireri. Omosome orequatene otikore July 20; abari 10 oseria ema, nwe mwena buya Form Three na Form Four. Inyanya KSh 3,500 ikareri, buse oseria abwaki naki ogenda.
Dholuo: Nyabisase Secondary School anyal piny mo lwak. Kaka nyime kuodhi e piny July 20; jodak Grade 10 nyaka omiyo, nyaka chwech Form Three kod Form Four. Nango KSh 3,500 an gi irweyo, kendo jodak jomoko kuom wacho tinde.
Somali: Dugsiga Sare ee Nyabisase wuu furmay. Dib-u-qaadashada waxay bilaabatay Luulyo 20; ardayda Fasalka 10 ayaa ugu horeysa, kadibna Fasalka 3 iyo Fasalka 4. Lacag dhan KSh 3,500 ayaa loo baahan yahay, ardayduna waa inay la socdaan ilaaliye.

English: Kivaywa Boys High School students affected by the recent dormitory fire have received essential support including mattresses and uniforms. Parents are encouraged to stay engaged in their children's education.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa Kivaywa Boys High School walioathiriwa na moto wa bweni wa hivi karibuni wamepata msaada muhimu ikiwa ni pamoja na mablanketi na mavazi ya shule. Wazazi wanahimizwa kuendelea kushiriki katika elimu ya watoto wao.
Ekegusii: Abanashimikire ku Kivaywa Boys High School abatebwe na mwakire ikirong'endi bagakire obokiri bwakire bwakubonerebu bw'ekirunzi na bosibori. Ababere bataraga buya batarorere boki nyang'anga bwakaberengeke mu buya bw'abana babo.
Dholuo: Wanaoino mar Kivaywa Boys High School moiboro ka otemo kolo mar dormitary nyaka awinjo ng'ato. Makiwuongo tinge koro watiyogo e ndiko mag mwana wawe.
Somali: Ardayda Kivaywa Boys High School ee ay saamaysay dabka dhawaan ka dhacay xeryaha waxay heleen taageero muhiim ah oo ay ka mid yihiin fadhiyo iyo dhar iskuulka. Waalidiinta ayaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay sii wadaan ka qaybqaadashada waxbarashada carruurtooda.

English: Parents and guardians are urged to monitor their children's whereabouts closely to prevent abduction incidents. Report any suspicious activity to local authorities immediately.
Kiswahili: Wazazi na walezi wanahimizwa kufuatilia kwa karibu mahali watoto wao walipo ili kuzuia matukio ya utekaji. Ripoti shughuli zozote za kushuku kwa mamlaka za eneo mara moja.
Ekegusii: Abaranga naki buya baki bokiere buya bwaki nyamotonireri bwaki abaki odongori. Bwakire ijonyokere naki buya boke buya buarte bwaki noki abane.
Dholuo: Nyasaye kendo nyamunyo to gikwaya kuom nyako ma otimo e kuonde magi, nikech kama e ng'ato mochwo inji. Tieng'e kanyakla kwayo gi daktari mar e iyie kuom gichando.
Somali: Waalidiinta iyo masuuliyiinta waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay si dhow ula socdaan meesha ay carruurtooda joogaan si looga hortago dhacdooyinka afduubka. Wixii dhaqdhaqaaq shaki leh ah la soco booliska maxalliga ah isla markiiba.

English: Public secondary schools must submit learner enrolment data to the Ministry of Education by Friday, July 24, to ensure capitation funds are disbursed.
Kiswahili: Shule za sekondari za umma zinapaswa kuwasilisha data ya uandikishaji wa wanafunzi kwa Wizara ya Elimu kabla ya Ijumaa, Julai 24, ili kuhakikisha fedha za ukaguzi zinatolewa.
Ekegusii: Masomo mayaki naki achokareri ogenda omokiri ogenda abwakire Esibori nabunaka Ekeruri, Omosorori 24, osibori mudiria bw'achibori bwabwakire bano.
Dholuo: Maseno mag nyaka toge gi data mar ing'wen kod jango okelo kendgi ka Ministry of Education ng'ato kelo chuo, Juma, July 24, kuom gi tich kode mag kapita.
Somali: Dugsiyada hoose ee dowladda waa in ay soo gudbiyaan xogta diiwaangelinta ardayda Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ka hor Jimcaha, July 24, si loo xaqiijiyo in lacagaha waxbarashada la qaybiyo.

English: The Public Service Commission will implement a nationwide sensitization program to promote constitutional values in public service across all government institutions.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma za Umma itaendesha programu ya uhamasishaji kote nchini ili kuimarisha maadili ya katiba katika huduma za umma katika taasisi zote za serikali.
Ekegusii: Ekegusii Eegakwere oshiere bw'oshwenyaki bwakire tekerai ekebwaki bw'ekigena bw'ogekuru bw'ekerebu bwakire emori bosi emonera ikitanga.
Dholuo: Public Service Commission nyaka yie program mar sensitization manok gi dhano ma okonyo yore e public service kata nyasae gi chutho duto.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Bulshada ayaa hirgelin doona barnaamij wacyigelin ah oo qaran si loo kobciyo qiyamka dastuuriga ah ee adeegga dadweynaha dhammaan hay'adaha dowladda.

English: The Ministry of Education has confirmed the reappointment of members to the TVET CDACC and KICD councils, essential for curriculum and training reforms.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu imethibitisha kuteuliwa upya kwa wanachama wa baraza la TVET CDACC na KICD, muhimu kwa mabadiliko ya mitaala na mafunzo.
Ekegusii: Ong'anya bw'ekere areki osotagani abaki b'amatagari ku TVET CDACC na KICD, egosi kera orokwo buya naki obokireri.
Dholuo: Minisiri mar Kilo oyier konyruok reappointment mar jodong' i TVET CDACC gi KICD councils, ma oket gi jodi kod thuolo moko.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa xaqiijisay dib u magacaabista xubnaha guddiyada TVET CDACC iyo KICD, taasoo muhiim u ah isbeddelka manhajka iyo tababarka.

English: The shortage of digital devices is a significant barrier to implementing the Competency-Based Curriculum in Early Childhood Development Education. Schools should prioritize securing digital hardware for effective learning.
Kiswahili: Upungufu wa vifaa vya kidijitali ni kikwazo kikubwa katika utekelezaji wa Mtaala wa Ujuzi katika Elimu ya Maendeleo ya Utotoni. Shule zinapaswa kipaumbele kununua vifaa vya kidijitali kwa ajili ya kujifunza kwa ufanisi.
Ekegusii: Abwaki bw'ekigori kya digital buya omogendo buya bwigachoka kuomokiriri bw'ekirigo buya ku Tichamu bw'Abogoti. Abakirobaki bakwoge buya bategere buya omogondo bw'ekigori kya digital buya omotigoria bwogende.
Dholuo: Mokoro mar digital gi dhano duto en sigend kendo en chieg mar gik ma ok nyal konyo Competency-Based Curriculum kod Early Childhood Development Education. Makanisi nyalo golo chike mag dhano digital kendo to ginyalo jamma.
Somali: Cushitaanka qalabka dijitaalka ah wuxuu yahay caqabad weyn oo ka hortagaysa hirgelinta Manhajka Ku Salaysan Aqoonta ee Waxbarashada Ilmaha Yaryar. Dugsiyadu waa inay mudnaanta siiyaan helitaanka qalabka dijitaalka ah si waxbarashada loo horumariyo.

English: All secondary schools participating in the KCB Group National Term Two Games must complete player eligibility verification by July 15 to ensure compliance before the event starting August 2.
Kiswahili: Shule zote za sekondari zinazoshiriki katika Michezo ya Kitaifa ya KCB Group Term Mbili zinapaswa kukamilisha uthibitisho wa sifa za wachezaji kufikia tarehe 15 Julai ili kuhakikisha ufuatiliaji kabla ya tukio linalaanza tarehe 2 Agosti.
Ekegusii: Ekaasa naki omokireri moikire KCB Group National Term Two Games gaki naki bwakire emetegere ochiari buiya July 15 bakore okorora amaki angichoka August 2.
Dholuo: Kakare mag kiwuon chikech kanyo KCB Group National Term Two Games nyalo wang’ni jaluo jaluo chula mar 15, kuom ne ok gichung’ ka ng’ato oser kanyo aginje August 2.
Somali: Dhammaan dugsiyada sare ee ka qaybgalaya Cayaaraha Qaranka ee KCB Group waxay waajib ku tahay in ay dhameystiraan hubinta u-qalmitaanka ciyaartoyda ilaa 15ka Luulyo si loo xaqiijiyo waafaqsanaanta ka hor dhacdada oo bilaabmaysa 2da Agoosto.

English: Dr. John Wycliffe Odhiambo Okumu is the new Chief Principal of Kisumu National Polytechnic, succeeding Catherine Kelonye, who has retired.
Kiswahili: Dkt. John Wycliffe Odhiambo Okumu ni Mkuu mpya wa Kisumu National Polytechnic, akimrithi Catherine Kelonye, ambaye ameondoka kazini.
Ekegusii: Dr. John Wycliffe Odhiambo Okumu naki naki mwaki omokireri buya omokigo Kisumu National Polytechnic, agere Catherine Kelonye, ogerere.
Dholuo: Daktari John Wycliffe Odhiambo Okumu nyaka Chief Principal nigi Kisumu National Polytechnic, owadgi Catherine Kelonye, ogendore mace.
Somali: Dr. John Wycliffe Odhiambo Okumu waa Maamulaha Sare cusub ee Kisumu National Polytechnic, isagoo badalaya Catherine Kelonye, oo hawlgab noqotay.

English: Makerere University has launched digital transcripts and online degree programs, allowing graduates to access academic credentials securely from anywhere.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Makerere kimeanzisha nakala za dijitali na programu za shahada mtandaoni, ambazo zinawawezesha wahitimu kufikia hati za kitaaluma kwa usalama kutoka popote.
Ekegusii: Makere University emokore buya bw'ekoranabi na buretu buya bw'amasomo, buya oboki bw'abasomi kukang'ana ekirebuo k'amasomo gagana omokima bw'ekiranga kosi.
Dholuo: Makerere University omediek nyanwuok  ma e dital transcripts kendo online degree programs, en ego jumba dholuo ka ogend bura kuom yiene.
Somali: Jaamacadda Makerere ayaa soo saartay warqadaha digital ah iyo barnaamijyada darajada khadka tooska ah, taasoo u oggolaanaysa dhallinyarada inay si amaan ah u helaan aqoonsiga tacliimeed meel kasta.

English: Students applying for scholarships are advised to provide truthful family details. Misrepresentation will be verified and may lead to disqualification from funding.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanaotafuta ufadhili wa masomo wanashauriwa kutoa maelezo sahihi kuhusu familia zao. Upotoshaji utathibitishwa na unaweza kusababisha kutengwa kwenye ufadhili.
Ekegusii: Abana bakiambiri na scholarships batarire buya bwakire bwokire. Kwekere buya bwakire boki’ekere, ebwaki obwise buse omwe.
Dholuo: Nomiya kuom nondo magogo ng'ato koni chalo mung'eyo kata ombulu. Tero ochung' gi bandu mag nyaka ng'ato kendo nyaka maduong' to ng'ato otahgi.
Somali: Ardayda codsanaya deeqaha waxbarasho waxaa lagu talinayaa inay bixiyaan faahfaahin qoys oo dhab ah. Warbixinta khaldan waxaa la xaqiijin doonaa waxaana ay keeni kartaa in laga reebo maalgelinta.

English: Kabaa High School will undergo a major facelift, starting with the replacement of asbestos roofs and paving from the main gate to the administration block.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Sekondari ya Kabaa itapata mabadiliko makubwa, ikianza na urekebishaji wa paa za asbestosi na kupavedisha kutoka lango kuu hadi jengo la utawala.
Ekegusii: Kabaa High School ikireri omosundo omokire, buya oreka kwogereja emarara ya asbestos na opo na chibori chogendi naki mugambo kwang'ana ekichori.
Dholuo: Kabaa High School hero gi chalo ma ok to, manom kendo nigi chabo mar asbestos kendo ne ng'ato mar ihip chalo mwakni gi admin.
Somali: Dugsiga Sare ee Kabaa waxaa lagu sameyn doonaa dhisme cusub, iyadoo la beddelayo saqafka asbesthoska iyo la dhisayo dariiqa laga bilaabo albaabka weyn ilaa xafiiska maamulka.

English: The government is prioritizing the completion of stalled education facilities in Chebara, Elgeyo Marakwet County to enhance service delivery.
Kiswahili: Serikali inatoa kipaumbele kumaliza michezo ya elimu iliyokwama katika Chebara, Kaunti ya Elgeyo Marakwet ili kuboresha utoaji wa huduma.
Ekegusii: Abagia batogoria kukwibori ekibungatia ienokikire ebiri mu Chebara, Elgeyo Marakwet County, naki omorori banzaki bwere.
Dholuo: Gavana ok nyalogi gima omedhi wuoth kuom nengo mar edjoni e Chebara, Elgeyo Marakwet County, kuom tich kendo joma nyalogi.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay mudnaanta siineysaa dhammaystirka xarumaha waxbarashada ee hakad galay ee Chebara, degmada Elgeyo Marakwet si loo horumariyo adeegga.

English: The introduction of School-Based Assessment (SBA) for Grade 10 is now active in Kenya, allowing learners to showcase their competencies through projects and practical activities.
Kiswahili: Utambulisho wa Tathmini Inayotokana na Shule (SBA) kwa Darasa la 10 sasa umeanza nchini Kenya, ukiwapa wanafunzi fursa ya kuonyesha ujuzi wao kupitia miradi na shughuli za kibinafsi.
Ekegusii: Omosaranya ogwakiriri Ogwakire mweng'orie (SBA) naki ghana 10 itokire buya muria Kenya, orokire abare kosi baemere nyasa bategena obwakiri bwabo buya bwiihere nyasa na boti kyanyere.
Dholuo: Jumaa kuom School-Based Assessment (SBA) mar Grade 10 okonyo nimar gima en Kenya, ma owuok hiwami ng'ato nyaka omiye jo riti kendo wathni gi piny ka awinjo.
Somali: Hordhaca Qiimeynta Dugsiga (SBA) ee Fasalka 10 ayaa hadda ka dhex muuqata Kenya, taas oo u oggolaanaysa ardayda inay muujiyaan xirfadahooda iyada oo loo marayo mashaariic iyo hawlo wax ku ool ah.

English: The Murang'a KUPPET Branch has endorsed Michael Murigi for the National Trustee position in the upcoming union elections. Members are encouraged to support his candidacy.
Kiswahili: Tawi la KUPPET la Murang'a limemuidhinisha Michael Murigi kwa nafasi ya Mjumbe wa Kitaifa katika uchaguzi wa umoja ujao. Wanachama wanahimizwa kumuunga mkono katika uteuzi wake.
Ekegusii: Branch ya KUPPET ya Murang'a yamerererea Michael Murigi omogori ochieng’ere miosii ya National Trustee mu oria gong’endo yaki. Abanyaki bamogori baire bakiere omokangiri buya.
Dholuo: Murang'a KUPPET Branch omiya Michael Murigi mar tich mar jodongo kwom chako mar una. Jodongo golo ominjore ka wacho e ngima mag pi.
Somali: Laanta KUPPET ee Murang'a waxay taageertay Michael Murigi inuu u tartamo jagada Aqoonyahan Qaran ee doorashooyinka ururka soo socda. xubnaha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay taageeraan musharaxnimadiisa.

English: Homecare International will award scholarships to over 100 needy children by the end of the year. Eligible families should apply for assistance through the organization.
Kiswahili: Homecare International itatoa ufadhili kwa watoto zaidi ya 100 wenye uhitaji kabla ya mwaka kukamilika. Familia zinazostahili zinapaswa kuomba msaada kupitia shirika hilo.
Ekegusii: Homecare International osererete obogogo bwaki bwaki omokire 100 abarori bwogori buya mogire oria. Emogori egane omokinya agana bwaki omogori ogwaki omokirikari.
Dholuo: Homecare International yawuot konyo kanyakla madhi 100 mawuok kuom gi chiegni tich. Joma ok nyaka piny ng'ato bedo abich, to ok nyaka malong'ore gi lag' e konyo.
Somali: Homecare International ayaa deeqo waxbarasho siin doona in ka badan 100 carruur ah oo baahi qaba dhammaadka sanadka. Qoysaska ku habboon waa inay codsadaan caawimaad iyada oo loo marayo ururkan.

English: Kericho County will host the National Chess Championships from August 1 to 3, 2026, at Alliance Boys' and Girls' High Schools. Participants must qualify through regional contests.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kericho itakuwa mwenyeji wa Mashindano ya Kitaifa ya Chess kuanzia Agosti 1 hadi 3, 2026, katika Shule za Upili za Alliance kwa Wavulana na Wasichana. Washiriki lazima wapate nafasi kupitia mashindano ya mikoa.
Ekegusii: Kericho County ebaria National Chess Championships buya August 1 kutenda 3, 2026, kosibori Alliance Boys' na Girls' High Schools. Abakinyaki bakenye buya buya omokinyaki bokorani bataranya.
Dholuo: Kericho County nyiso National Chess Championships piny otieno kuom August 1 kendo 3, 2026, e Alliance Boys' and Girls' High Schools. Kaka wath oganda nyal katare kuom regional contests.
Somali: Koonfurta Kericho waxay martigelin doontaa Tartanka Qashinta Qaranka laga bilaabo Agoosto 1 ilaa 3, 2026, iskuulada sare ee Alliance Boys' iyo Girls'. Ka-qaybgalayaasha waa in ay ku guuleystaan tartanada gobollada.

English: The KSSSA National Term Two Games will take place at the M-PESA Foundation Academy in Thika. Students and schools are encouraged to participate in the competition starting soon.
Kiswahili: Mashindano ya Kitaifa ya KSSSA msimu wa pili yatafanyika katika Chuo cha M-PESA Foundation kilichoko Thika. Wanafunzi na shule wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mashindano yanayokuja hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Masano osero ki KSSSA naki emokiri ya chanda ikoreri kire na M-PESA Foundation Academy naki Thika. Abana naki masano baria bagiye baji gore omokiri ogendi.
Dholuo: KSSSA National Term Two Games nyalo timo e M-PESA Foundation Academy ku Thika. Wuodogo gi shule pi enni miyo weche kendo ohinga mar tich manyien.
Somali: Ciyaaraha Qaran ee KSSSA Term Two waxay ka dhici doonaan Akadeemiyada M-PESA Foundation ee Thika. Ardayda iyo dugsiyada waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan tartanka oo dhowaan bilaaban doona.

English: The Ministry of Education is initiating a comprehensive review of safety protocols in schools, focusing on dormitory conditions and emergency preparedness to prevent future tragedies.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inaanzisha mapitio kamili ya itifaki za usalama shuleni, ikilenga hali za mabweni na maandalizi ya dharura ili kuzuia maafa ya baadaye.
Ekegusii: Abana b'ekiburi ki'ekaranga b'Abagoti baratenda onyongezi bwaki bwasalama mu masomo, barorere kw'abiaganya bwaki bw'ibisi na bwaki bw'ekere b'ekikoro ogokong'ana obwakire obwakire.
Dholuo: Ministry o' Kizio nigi e ng'ato ma okonyo nind gi yore puonj e suk, mana kendgi ma konyo kendo nyiso puonj e lweny ma ok nyaka weyo yore matek.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa bilowday dib-u-eegis ballaaran oo ku saabsan habraacyada amniga ee dugsiyada, iyadoo diiradda la saarayo shuruudaha hoyga iyo diyaarinta xaaladaha degdegga ah si loo hortago masiibooyinka mustaqbalka.

English: School leaders are encouraged to actively listen to staffroom discussions to gain valuable insights, improve communication, and address staff concerns effectively.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa shule wanahimizwa kusikiliza kwa makini mijadala katika ofisi ya walimu ili kupata maarifa ya thamani, kuboresha mawasiliano, na kushughulikia wasiwasi wa wafanyakazi kwa ufanisi.
Ekegusii: Abanyamwano boti naki bapererete ng'ana bushokoti bweng'ana bwakinyaki bweng'ana bwere oria, bwere bushokoti bwabwaki, buya bwaki naki buya bui nyamokoro.
Dholuo: Dhiang'ni wekni mag joma marach gidung' ka koro timo konyo mawa to ok nyal timo, nyaka chako gonde, kendo ok gima anyalo dongo joma marach.
Somali: Hoggaamiyeyaasha iskuulada waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay si firfircoon u dhageystaan doodaha aqoon-yahannada si ay u helaan fikrado qiimo leh, u hagaajiyaan isgaadhsiinta, ayna si hufan uga jawaabaan welwelka shaqaalaha.

English: Naikarra Comprehensive School has qualified for the National Kenya Music Festival and will perform on August 3 at Kabarak University.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Naikarra Comprehensive imeshiriki katika Tamasha la Muziki la Kitaifa la Kenya na itatumbuiza tarehe 3 Agosti katika Chuo Kikuu cha Kabarak.
Ekegusii: Naikarra Comprehensive School ekererete okire bw'ere ogienye National Kenya Music Festival na ikegererie oria August 3 na Kabarak University.
Dholuo: Naikarra Comprehensive School abiro konyo gi National Kenya Music Festival, kendo bende bende ka August 3 e Kabarak University.
Somali: Dugsiga Naikarra Comprehensive wuxuu u qalmaa Tartanka Heesaha Qaranka ee Kenya waxaana uu soo bandhigi doonaa 3-da Agoosto ee Jaamacadda Kabarak.

English: Enkare Ngiro Secondary School has qualified for the national Kenya Music Festival at Kababii University after winning the Giriama Dance category in the Rift Valley Regional Festival.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Sekondari Enkare Ngiro imepata nafasi ya kushiriki Tamasha la Muziki la Kitaifa la Kenya katika Chuo Kikuu cha Kababii baada ya kushinda kwenye kundi la Ngoma za Giriama katika Tamasha la Kikanda la Rift Valley.
Ekegusii: Enkare Ngiro Secondary School eyaboki ogetire bw'ogoti bwa Kenya Music Festival ku Kababii University omokigo azokere Giriama Dance buo mu Rift Valley Regional Festival.
Dholuo: Enkare Ngiro Secondary School asik twigie kuom Kenya Music Festival e Kababii University kata ok wina Giriama Dance e Rift Valley Regional Festival.
Somali: Dugsiga Sare ee Enkare Ngiro ayaa ku guuleystay inay ka qayb qaataan Tartanka Muusiga Qaranka ee Kenya oo ka dhacaya Jaamacadda Kababii kadib markii ay ku guuleysteen qaybta Qoob-Kacalka Giriama tartanka Gobolka Rift Valley.

English: Inspector General of Police Douglas Kanja, Deputy Inspector General Eliud Lagat, and Basic Education Principal Secretary John Ololtuaa must appear in court regarding Gatoto School management transfer delays.
Kiswahili: Inspector General wa Polisi Douglas Kanja, Naibu Inspector General Eliud Lagat, na Katibu Mkuu wa Elimu ya Msingi John Ololtuaa lazima wajitokeze mahakamani kuhusiana na ucheleweshaji wa uhamishaji wa usimamizi wa Shule ya Gatoto.
Ekegusii: Mogaka mwaki wa Polisi Douglas Kanja, mwaki wa kiongoni Eliud Lagat, na mwaki ogendete wa Elimu ya Msingi John Ololtuaa bwanabe banabere omokwere mu ikirango naki naki foroto ya Gatoto School.
Dholuo: Inspector General of Police Douglas Kanja, Deputy Inspector General Eliud Lagat, na Principal Secretary wa Masomo Kachoko John Ololtuaa giyeni kuonigwa chochoge ma nyalo ng'eyo chieng' Gatoto School.
Somali: Taliyaha Guud ee Booliiska Douglas Kanja, Ku-simaha Taliyaha Guud Eliud Lagat, iyo Xoghayaha Guud ee Waxbarashada Aasaasiga ah John Ololtuaa waa in ay maxkamad hortiisa yimaadaan ee ku saabsan dib-u-dhacyada ku saabsan maamulka Dugsiga Gatoto.

English: Civil servants are rejecting the latest SRC salary review and may strike. Ongoing negotiations for a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) must conclude before any salary changes.
Kiswahili: Watumishi wa umma wanakataa mapitio ya mshahara ya SRC na wanaweza kugoma. Mazungumzo ya sasa kuhusu Mkataba wa Maslahi ya Pamoja (CBA) lazima yakamilishwe kabla ya mabadiliko yoyote ya mshahara.
Ekegusii: Abanene b'ogendi baria baturia na omogenda wa SRC omogenderete naki bwania. Otaki bw'iri buiora b'ogendi boke burokia bwi CBA bwi Onge na buyang'ane bwi buria bw'ena.
Dholuo: Abana mar serikali neno joma ok odhiere nyaka maler moko SAC. Ngeche manyien ahinya magi oter mar CBA to osekelo odhiere anyien.
Somali: Shaqaalaha dowladda waxay diidayaan dib-u-eegista mushaharka ee ugu dambeysay ee SRC waxayna suurtogal tahay inay mudaaharaad sameeyaan. Wadahadalada socda ee Heshiiska Shaqada (CBA) waa in lagu dhameystiraa ka hor isbedel kasta oo mushahar.

English: The government is enhancing support for Kenyans working abroad through stronger partnerships with training institutions. Graduates are encouraged to prepare for international employment under the Kenya-Germany Labour Mobility Programme.
Kiswahili: Serikali inaimarisha msaada kwa Wakenya wanaofanya kazi nje ya nchi kupitia ushirikiano thabiti na taasisi za mafunzo. Wahitimu wanahimizwa kujiandaa kwa ajira za kimataifa chini ya Mpango wa Mabadiliko ya Kazi wa Kenya-Ujerumani.
Ekegusii: Ong'anya ogetagania buya bwiabere abaki bendo Kenya bwi abaki bendo ng'endo abaki bwi banching' bw'ositendani. Abachwaki bareraki bwi nibokirebwe buya bw'ogendi bw'ekibere Kenya-Germany Labour Mobility Programme.
Dholuo: Ong’wing’o ne okinyi ni zia jathoguo ma Kenya mang’eyo e lweny gima okel konyo wacho gima gigi goyi, kendo chiege mawatemo tobedo konyo konyo. Jotieno nyaka ginyalo manyien maler e kanyo ma Kenya-Germany Labour Mobility Programme.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay xoojineysaa taageerada muwaadiniinta Soomaaliyeed ee shaqo raadinaya dibadda iyada oo la xoojinayo iskaashiga la leh hay'adaha tababarka. Ardayda qalin-jabineysa waxaa lagu dhiiri-gelinayaa inay isu diyaariyaan shaqo caalami ah iyadoo la raacayo Barnaamijka Dhaqdhaqaaqa Shaqaalaha ee Kenya-Jarmalka.

English: Teachers in Mombasa are invited to participate in specialized training by the NCTC to detect early signs of extremist recruitment among students.
Kiswahili: Walimu Mombasa wanakaribishwa kuhudhuria mafunzo maalum kutoka NCTC ya kubaini dalili za awali za kuandikishwa kwa vijana kwenye matumizi ya uk extremist miongoni mwa wanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Abakiri baki Mombasa baragwanire kutire omokiri emosi obwakire naki NCTC buya otogore obwakianga obwamogasi nibori mynene edzimuri omoragoria.
Dholuo: Walimu ku Mombasa ne en yocha ka ng'ato konyo ɓer kod NCTC kuom kuomoyo to gima othego teko ne nyime mar extreme recruitment pakati nigi.
Somali: Macallimiinta Mombasa waxaa lagu martiqaaday inay ka qaybgalaan tababar khaas ah oo ay bixiso NCTC si ay u ogaadaan calaamadaha hore ee q absorbinta xagjirnimada ardayda.

English: TVET institutions are encouraged to adopt digital skills training to meet job market demands. Strengthening industry partnerships is essential for equipping learners with relevant competencies.
Kiswahili: Taasisi za TVET zinahimizwa kuanzisha mafunzo ya ujuzi wa dijitali ili kukidhi mahitaji ya soko la ajira. Kuimarisha ushirikiano na viwanda ni muhimu kwa kuwapa wanafunzi ujuzi unaohitajika.
Ekegusii: Mashule a TVET naki naki omokore omokirori bwakire buya bige bwenche buya abatebaki bakinyora omokiri. Gokiena buya bwagamo konyere buya bagia naki abatebaki naki abatia obwaki.
Dholuo: TVET bende nyasachi kuom nyigiri chuth maber kuom ang'wen mar jodala. Wang'ni mar pi jodong' e kar tich nyaka obenj gi jawer mar ywakito.
Somali: Hay'adaha TVET waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay qaataan tababarka xirfadaha dijitaalka si ay u la kulmaan baahida suuqyada shaqada. Xoojinta iskaashiga warshadaha ayaa muhiim u ah si loo siiyo ardayda xirfadaha ku habboon.

English: Residents of Angata Barrikoi in Narok County are urging the county government to prioritize bursary allocations for learners affected by insecurity and economic hardship.
Kiswahili: Wakazi wa Angata Barrikoi katika Kaunti ya Narok wanahimiza serikali ya kaunti iweke kipaumbele katika ugawaji wa bursary kwa wanafunzi walioathiriwa na ukosefu wa usalama na ugumu wa kiuchumi.
Ekegusii: Abakire ba Angata Barrikoi muri Nyamira ni abarora oria ogenda omogori ekuoru na chakesi chogokire omokinyaraki chabare aba abarire ba chirembere abokorani ogenda era mu bukoriamwanire.
Dholuo: Watu ma okonyo Angata Barrikoi e Narok County ne ogendini kuom ng'wech mar county nyaka awach ng'ato to gi bursary duto nyaka jitugo kuom jaluo mane otingo gipogore gi kinde gi golo.
Somali: Dadweynaha Angata Barrikoi ee gobolka Narok ayaa ku boorinaya dowladda gobolka inay mudnaanta siiso qeybinta deeqaha waxbarasho ee ardayda ay saameeyeen amni darro iyo dhibaato dhaqaale.

English: KUPPET demands that the Teachers Service Commission enroll all intern teachers in the Social Health Authority cover to ensure equal healthcare access. Action is urged to avoid potential strike.
Kiswahili: KUPPET inasisitiza kwamba Tume ya Huduma za Walimu iandikishe walimu wote wanapofanya kazi za majaribio kwenye bima ya Mamlaka ya Afya ya Jamii ili kuhakikisha upatikanaji sawa wa huduma za afya. Jitihada zinahitajika ili kuepusha mgomo wa uwezekano.
Ekegusii: KUPPET ikorogena Esasa ya Baraza la Walimu igezire omokore buya bwaki mwetegero wa Abantu bo Bwaki to ore ogogena omokore na'okire. Bwakire bwarorane buya buria ogokore omokire.
Dholuo: KUPPET owiya ni Teachers Service Commission nyal enroll nyathi intern rehetra kendo tich onge mondo oonge kuom Social Health Authority, e yo nyaka walos gi tich ma ok nyal kod. Gik mane ohero mondo ginyal ni ok ma in gi od.
Somali: KUPPET waxay codsaneysaa in Gudiga Adeegga Macallimiintu ay diiwaan geliso dhammaan macallimiinta tababarka ah inay ku jiraan caymiska Hay'adda Caafimaadka Bulshada si loo hubiyo in la helo daryeel caafimaad oo siman. Tallaabo ayaa la codsanayaa si looga fogaado gacan ka hadal suurtagal ah.

English: Mwendwa Kilatya has been admitted to Africa Nazarene University to pursue a Certificate in Business Management, starting August 2026.
Kiswahili: Mwendwa Kilatya amekubaliwa katika Chuo Kikuu cha Africa Nazarene ili kufuatilia Cheti katika Usimamizi wa Biashara, kuanzia Agosti 2026.
Ekegusii: Mwendwa Kilatya omogogotye mu Africa Nazarene University buya omogoti bw’ogenderi bw’Buya bw’Oboribori, oigana nyaki August 2026.
Dholuo: Mwendwa Kilatya owinjore e Africa Nazarene University kuom wacho Certifike e Business Management, manok odhi  August 2026.
Somali: Mwendwa Kilatya ayaa lagu soo dhaweeyey Jaamacadda Afrika Nazarene si uu u qaato Shahaadada Maamulka Ganacsiga, oo bilaabanaysa Agoosto 2026.

English: Education stakeholders are encouraged to invest in and expand day schools to promote parental involvement and help reduce student unrest.
Kiswahili: Wadau wa elimu wanahimizwa kuwekeza na kupanua shule za siku ili kukuza ushiriki wa wazazi na kusaidia kupunguza machafuko miongoni mwa wanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Abakire guhaka kumekorere mwaki naki omokochereri bugenyi busome buibori omogaka naki omogeere buigani bwaki bwakiri bwomoyaki.
Dholuo: Mizinda magi nyaka ogeto niya ikwayo e miko gem, koro nyaka to ng'ato ohowo e dala kendo to nyaka otimgo gi chuny magi.
Somali: Xubnaha waxbarashada waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay maalgashadaan oo ay ballaariyaan dugsiyada maalinlaha ah si ay u taageeraan ka qaybgalka waalidiinta iyo in la yareeyo rabshadaha ardayda.

English: Parents and guardians are reminded to ensure accurate submission of student enrolment numbers, as discrepancies can lead to legal consequences for school administrators.
Kiswahili: Wazazi na walezi wanakumbushwa kuhakikisha kuwa nambari za usajili wa wanafunzi zimewasilishwa kwa usahihi, kwani kutofautiana kunaweza kuleta madhara ya kisheria kwa wasimamizi wa shule.
Ekegusii: Ababere nakiabaki bakiagone omogori ogwentori bw'egokire bwakore misi, naki bw'ogekorere omosera miri, egonoria naki obwaki buseke bw'abo buibori buate.
Dholuo: Kanyakore kod mawuon mag jowetegi en konyol gi chik ore ma tich, ni kisumo othin gima wadh nyaka wadh wuoyo kuom jo kela.
Somali: Waalidiinta iyo ilaaliyayaasha waxaa lagu xasuusinayaa inay xaqiijiyaan in ay si sax ah u soo gudbiyaan lambarrada diiwaangelinta ardayda, maadaama khaladaadku keeni karaan cawaaqib sharci ah oo ka dhalan kara maamulka dugsiga.

English: The Kenya Union of Post Primary Education Teachers (KUPPET) will hold elections for the Regional Secretary for the Rift Valley on August 21, 2026, in Nakuru County.
Kiswahili: Shirikisho la Walimu wa Elimu ya Posta K Kenya (KUPPET) litafanya uchaguzi wa Katibu wa Kanda wa Bonde la Ufa tarehe 21 Agosti, 2026, katika Kaunti ya Nakuru.
Ekegusii: Abaki buse baki buya KUPPET bakananga aboti buya buya bworenda bwakire buya bwokire bwokiri bwokiyaki bworenda bye, bwesibori busi, mu Nakuru.
Dholuo: Kenya Union of Post Primary Education Teachers (KUPPET) neng'eyo chiegni mar Regional Secretary kuom Rift Valley ka August 21, 2026, e Nakuru County.
Somali: Ururka Macalimiinta Dugsiyada Sare ee Kenya (KUPPET) wuxuu qaban doonaa doorashooyinka Xoghayaha Goboleedka ee Rift Valley 21-ka Agoosto, 2026, gudaha Gobolka Nakuru.

English: Amus College has qualified for the 2026 FEASSSA Games in Morogoro, Tanzania, representing Uganda in both boys' and girls' football.
Kiswahili: Chuo cha Amus kimethibitisha kushiriki katika Michezo ya FEASSSA 2026 huko Morogoro, Tanzania, kikrepresenta Uganda katika soka la mvulana na msichana.
Ekegusii: Amus College omokora busi bwenda ku 2026 FEASSSA Games mu Morogoro, Tanzania, omong'ere Uganda mu kiomokiri nakiinye.
Dholuo: Amus College abiro kuom nyaka 2026 FEASSSA Games e Morogoro, Tanzania, omiyiera Uganda muochi bura ne wende.
Somali: Amus College ayaa uqalmatay Ciyaaraha FEASSSA 2026 ee Morogoro, Tanzania, iyagoo matalaya Uganda labadaba kubadda cagta wiilasha iyo gabdhaha.

English: Chuka University has been awarded a KSh 191 million grant to lead a multi-country research initiative focused on outbreak preparedness and disease surveillance across Africa.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Chuka kimepatiwa ruzuku ya KSh milioni 191 kuongoza juhudi za utafiti wa nchi mbalimbali zinazolenga kujiandaa na mlipuko na ufuatiliaji wa magonjwa kote Afrika.
Ekegusii: Chuka University etagire omokiri emekeri 191 million KSh okwe nyaki oborukire buya bwose obwakireri bweng'enda naki obokiriri buya eafrica.
Dholuo: Chuka University optimier ka ne kiamu gi KSh 191 million kendo obet gi tich mag dala mar nyiri kendo jola chula ng'wech mar yawuok kendo kelu kendo kanyisi maber e Africa.
Somali: Jaamacadda Chuka waxaa loo awoodey deeq dhan KSh 191 milyan oo lagu hoggaamin doono mashruuc cilmi baaris oo ka duwan dalal badan oo diiradda saaraya diyaar garowga cudurrada iyo ilaalinta cudurrada guud ahaan Afrika.

English: The Employment and Labour Relations Court will hear the salary dispute between West Pokot County Government and ECDE teachers on July 22, 2026. All parties involved must be present.
Kiswahili: Mahakama ya Ajira na Mahusiano ya Kazi itasikiliza mgogoro wa mshahara kati ya Serikali ya Kaunti ya West Pokot na walimu wa ECDE tarehe 22 Julai, 2026. Osipokuwa na wahusika wote wanahitajika kuwapo.
Ekegusii: Ekitabo ky'Emunyu na Ekwenda bakenye ikorango omogori bw'egere ekirikwenyene nyekina Obori bw'Abakerubi ba West Pokot na abakiabaki ba ECDE buya nakire na Nyamatsiga 22, 2026. Abakekebatani boni bakore buya.
Dholuo: Kit kanyinjo mar Pesa kod Tichni oked gi minge mar pesa ka West Pokot County Government kendo ECDE ewaloni nyaka Julai 22, 2026. Wadu ongie gi neno nyaka bende.
Somali: Maxkamadda Shaqaalaha iyo Xiriirka Shaqada waxay dhagaysataa khilaafka mushaharka u dhexeeya Dowladda Gobolka West Pokot iyo macallimiinta ECDE taariikhda 22-da Luulyo, 2026. Dhammaan dhinacyada ku lugta leh waa inay joogaan.

English: Educators are encouraged to implement mother tongue-based instruction to enhance learning and comprehension for children. Embrace local languages to support effective education.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanahimizwa kutumia mafunzo yanayotokana na lugha ya mama ili kuboresha kujifunza na ufahamu kwa watoto. Kubali lugha za kienyeji ili kusaidia elimu bora.
Ekegusii: Abavuga baneqe batari omokinyaki babwaki bakenye omokinyaki bwaki bwakuria bwomogoti bwabaki. Naki omokinyaki ogokogori omogeno bwaki bende bwaki.
Dholuo: Jogwok malo ka wanyal dhi nyakinyruok ma ohinga nying' kendo jopiny. Kweyou luor ma ok ranyruok gi bwak.
Somali: Macallimiinta waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa in ay hirgeliyaan casharro ku saleysan luuqadda hooyo si kor loogu qaado barashada iyo fahamka carruurta. Ka faa'iidayso luuqadaha deegaanka si aad u taageerto waxbarashada waxtarka leh.

English: The 2026 national Term Two games will take place from July 26 to August 3 in Kiambu County. Participating teams should prepare for arrival on July 27; official opening is on July 29.
Kiswahili: Michezo ya Taifa ya Kipindi cha Pili ya mwaka wa 2026 itafanyika kuanzia Julai 26 hadi Agosti 3 katika Kaunti ya Kiambu. Timu zitakazoshiriki zinapaswa kujiandaa kuwasili Julai 27; ufunguzi rasmi utafanyika Julai 29.
Ekegusii: Emnati ya 2026 ya Term Mbiri ikoraki bw'ogotaka buya buya gose ku gosi gh'ekiga ki Kiambu. Abashang'anyi batarora batorire bwanogoti bw'ogotaka ku July 27; ugoya bw'ekinyega buya buya buya ni July 29.
Dholuo: Luo 2026 ng'ato mar Term Two naki ng'iyo muonjo maanduku mar July 26 kendo August 3 e Kiambu County. Timbe oko magi omiyo wacho makel malong' kanyenya e July 27; nyaka weche mago ni japuonj e July 29.
Somali: Ciyaaraha Qaran ee Term Two 2026 waxay ka dhici doonaan 26ka July ilaa 3da Agoosto ee Degmada Kiambu. Kooxaha ka qaybgalaya waa in ay diyaariyaan imaanshahooda 27ka July; furitaanka rasmiga ahna wuxuu dhacayaa 29ka July.

English: Parents and students are encouraged to advocate for equal educational opportunities regardless of school categorization in order to bridge existing inequalities in the education system.
Kiswahili: Wazazi na wanafunzi wanahimizwa kuunga mkono fursa sawa za kielimu bila kujali aina ya shule ili kufunga pengo lililo katika mfumo wa elimu.
Ekegusii: Abere na abaki bendi omogaka bateganire omokire bwaki akoraki bw'osiende omogokige bwaki oria ogenda bw'ogendire naki bw'oe se na kosienda oria eyaki.
Dholuo: Makuokoru na wang'ni idhi peke kaluwore kanyaluok kothni manok ma ok toge ei chalo mar jomokinyi, koro oboke chike kaka inyang'ani kanyakla yath.
Somali: Waalidiinta iyo ardayda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay u ololeeyaan fursado waxbarasho oo siman, iyadoon loo eegin nooca dugsiga, si loo xirfadaheeda farqiga ka jira nidaamka waxbarashada.

English: Invigilators and supervisors from the 2025 national examinations are urged to verify their details on the KNEC CP2 system to expedite payment processing.
Kiswahili: Wakaguzi na wasimamizi wa mitihani ya kitaifa ya mwaka 2025 wanashauriwa kuangalia taarifa zao kwenye mfumo wa KNEC CP2 ili kuharakisha usindikaji wa malipo.
Ekegusii: Abinvigilatori na abakiigori boti 2025 buya bw'amasomo bosi bataragiao bakiere weka obwakore omogori bwaniru KNEC CP2 buya bwi ikore bware b'ekirori.
Dholuo: Mokoro ni jowadgi gi jopok e ngero 2025, in bende ka godo maler kendo miluok e KNEC CP2 system, kata owadgi marach e yo.
Somali: Kormeerayaasha iyo kormeerayaasha imtixaanka qaran ee 2025 waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay xaqiijiyaan faahfaahinta ay ku leeyihiin nidaamka KNEC CP2 si loo dedejiyo habka lacag bixinta.

English: Civil servants will receive higher salaries and revised allowances effective July 1, 2026, as approved by the Salaries and Remuneration Commission.
Kiswahili: Watumishi wa umma watapata mshahara mkubwa na posho zilizorekebishwa kuanzia Julai 1, 2026, kama ilivyothibitishwa na Tume ya Mishahara na Malipo.
Ekegusii: Abana bakiya bakenye baki osibori omotere omokire na obwakire buya oria bwegana July 1, 2026, gotire ekenye na Obwakire bw'Abana ba Ikirigo.
Dholuo: Malim be oyudo nyalo bende chalo marach mar edhi, naki juma 1, 2026, ka nyalo ok nyal wacho chiwruok e Salaries and Remuneration Commission.
Somali: Shaqaalaha dowliga ah waxay heli doonaan mushaar korodh iyo gunnooyin cusub oo dhaqan galay 1-da Luulyo, 2026, sida ay ansixiyeen Guddiga Mushaarka iyo Lacag-bixinta.

English: Parents are urged to financially support local schools to reduce fee arrears and improve educational outcomes. Your participation is crucial in strengthening community-based education.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanahimizwa kusaidia kifedha shule za hapa nyumbani ili kupunguza deni la ada na kuboresha matokeo ya elimu. Ushiriki wako ni muhimu katika kuimarisha elimu inayotegemea jamii.
Ekegusii: Abakire naki kiishoka nyasa omokiri emakenye matigori na aborere kworogori joshure. Osianeni bw'Ong'anya okwenda omokiri emetegeri ya bwakire.
Dholuo: Kare moloyo moloyo to dongo masomo mag local, kudhi kwe gi fee mar ariyo kendo nyalo yo chalo manyien. Inyalo bende wacho nyaka in gi piny yie kendo dhokere masomo maber.
Somali: Waalidiinta waxaa loogu baaqay inay maaliyad ahaan u taageeraan iskuulada maxalliga ah si loo yareeyo deymaha lacagta iyo kor loogu qaado natiijooyinka waxbarasho. Ka qayb qaadashadaada waa mid muhiim ah si loo xoojiyo waxbarashada ku saleysan bulshada.

English: Teachers are urged to uphold professionalism and integrity in their duties to ensure quality education for all learners.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanakaribishwa kuendeleza utaalamu na uaminifu katika majukumu yao ili kuhakikisha elimu bora kwa wanafunzi wote.
Ekegusii: Abakire bategerekereri obwaki naki oigane mu maarengo yabo baiserane omokiri mwaki oria na bwaki bwaki obosi.
Dholuo: Jogore majahlore in uwere chalo mar nyiso to konyo chieng' mar yore gi kendo okwana mak gima olego puodh.
Somali: Macalimiinta waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ilaashadaan xirfadda iyo daacadnimada howlahooda si loo hubiyo waxbarasho tayo leh oo dhammaan ardayda ah.

English: The Trans Nzoia County Government will open a Vocational Training Centre for the visually impaired in September. Eligible individuals are encouraged to apply for admission.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Trans Nzoia itafungua Kituo cha Mafunzo ya Ufundi kwa watu wenye uoni hafifu mwezi wa Septemba. Watu wenye sifa wanashawishiwa kuomba kujiunga.
Ekegusii: Abagabe b'obi Trans Nzoia b'okwenda osichokire nyanza y'ekang'ani motete mhereka eyekobo bwokogoria bendi mu Septemba. Ababere b'ogokogoria naki bakenendete kwenda kugenda.
Dholuo: Trans Nzoia County Government otero Vocational Training Centre ma nyathi madhi e September. Koro, ng’ato ma en kanyo e yo ma nyaka itimere e dar.
Somali: Dowladda Gobolka Trans Nzoia waxay furi doontaa Xarunta Tababarka Shaqada ee dadka indhaha la' aan ah ee bisha Sebtember. Qof kasta oo u qalma waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inuu codsado akhrin.

English: Teachers and education stakeholders in Kisii County urge youth to engage in upcoming educational initiatives. Stay informed for details and participation opportunities.
Kiswahili: Walimu na wadau wa elimu katika Kaunti ya Kisii wanawasihi vijana kujihusisha na mipango ya elimu inayokuja. Pata taarifa kwa maelezo na fursa za kushiriki.
Ekegusii: Abagere na abakiaki bwakiga bwaki Kisii baria akiroria abogendi banya mwaki tiri bosi buya bwaki buya. Nigana bayaki baswaki buya na obwakioria.
Dholuo: Wachung' owach nyaka gi in-gi gi koni kanyakla Kisii marach jomoko piny mondo wajogi konyo eyo gima opogore gi joma oik piny. Konyo kama jomoko ka ng'ama okinyi.
Somali: Macallimiinta iyo danaystayaasha waxbarashada ee Gobolka Kisii waxay ku boorinayaan dhallinyarada inay ka qaybqaataan hawlaha waxbarasho ee soo socda. La soco faahfaahinta iyo fursadaha ka qaybqaadashada.

English: All teachers in Kenya will receive their enhanced July salaries on Monday, with the second phase of the 2025-2029 Collective Bargaining Agreement fully implemented.
Kiswahili: Walimu wote nchini Kenya watapokea mishahara yao iliyoongezeka ya mwezi wa Julai Jumatatu, huku awamu ya pili ya Mkataba wa Makubaliano wa Pamoja wa 2025-2029 ikitekelezwa kwa ukamilifu.
Ekegusii: Barabara zose za abaki mu Kenya ng'ochakire bokirori buya bw’ojiri omokiri, ore bakire buya bw'ogokorere 2025-2029 bw'ogogabirira buya bwakire.
Dholuo: Mokoro gi Kenya nyalo wegi sa nyama ma en kaka ma Jiwo, kod phas mar thieth 2025-2029 mar nyalo lweny.
Somali: Dhammaan macalimiinta Kenya waxay heli doonaan mushaarkooda kordhiyay ee bisha Luulyo Isniinta, iyadoo labaad ee heshiiska shaqaalaha 2025-2029 si buuxda loo dhaqan gelinayo.

English: Parents are urged to prioritize their children's education as essential for fighting poverty and securing economic opportunities. Support your child's learning and academic progress.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanahimizwa kuweka kipaumbele katika elimu ya watoto wao kama njia muhimu ya kupambana na umasikini na kupata fursa za kiuchumi. Tunga mkono kujifunza na maendeleo ya kielimu ya mtoto wako.
Ekegusii: Ababere batoreri kwerekana esia bwana naki omosi naki buya omoka, bwakire bosi kana ekegero. Moserere omogogo buya bwotebogere.
Dholuo: Wazazi nyal kod gi chike to giwacho ng'ama inyalo bed jomoko mar dongo. Nyal ng'eyo kuom chike mar oyudi gi nyimre gi jodak.
Somali: Waalidiinta waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay mudnaanta siiyaan waxbarashada carruurtooda, maadaama ay muhiim u tahay la dagaallanka faqriga iyo helitaanka fursadaha dhaqaale. Taageer barashada iyo horumarka tacliimeed ee caruurtaada.

English: Parents are urged to thoroughly vet domestic workers to ensure the safety of their children amid rising child abuse cases. Monitor who interacts with your children closely.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanashauriwa kuangalia kwa makini wafanyakazi wa nyumbani ili kuhakikisha usalama wa watoto wao kutokana na kuongezeka kwa kesi za unyanyasaji wa watoto. Fuatilieni kwa karibu nani anayeshirikiana na watoto wenu.
Ekegusii: Ababere naki banya mwaki omoka bwakinyera abaki bosi omokende bwaire bwakichire buya bweng'enda bwoketere eng'enda. Ogendeti bwaki bw'enyaki ne baki.
Dholuo: Nyang'ore mago to yore ng'ato konyo ka in ji higni kendo gima omiye. Chamo ni ogend jo konyo ruma chiegni miyo.
Somali: Waalidiinta waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay si wanaagsan u baadhaan shaqaalaha guriga si loo hubiyo badbaadada carruurtooda xilli ay kordhayaan kiisaska dhibaatooyinka caruurta. Si dhow ula soco cidda la falgalaysa carruurtaada.

English: Teachers are encouraged to seek mental health support if experiencing loneliness or emotional strain. Access available resources to enhance well-being and prevent burnout.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanahimizwa kutafuta msaada wa afya ya akili wanapohisi upweke au msongo wa mawazo. Tembelea rasilimali zilizopo kuboresha ustawi na kuzuia kuchoka.
Ekegusii: Abagweno bataragane nibagire ohireka omogusii mosi omotigori bosi bwokere omokire omosi. Iriosia abwaki bungi buira bosi omokire naki omokiri ogendani.
Dholuo: Dende kanyogo to duong’ gi chier mar piny dhakoro, ka ikelo dende kanyonyo wacho, kata ka ikeloo ng’won. Jibed gi dho ne giwacho mar jowet tich.
Somali: Macallimiinta waxaa la dhiirigelinayaa inay raadsadaan taageero caafimaad maskaxeed haddii ay la kulmaan kalinimo ama culeys dareen. Isticmaal kheyraadka la heli karo si kor loogu qaado wacan-nimada iyo in laga hortago dhibaatooyinka xad-dhaafka ah.

English: Students entering Grade 10 are encouraged to choose from three Career Pathways in Senior School: Arts and Sports Science, Social Sciences, or Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM).
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanaoingia darasa la 10 wanahimizwa kuchagua kutoka njia tatu za kazi katika Shule ya Juu: Sanaa na Sayansi ya Michezo, Sayansi za Kijamii, au Sayansi, Teknolojia, Uhandisi na Hisabati (STEM).
Ekegusii: Abakwanirie Grade 10 bano bukore kubiri bwokori bwaitu bu kubanga buchekire: Arts na Sports Science, Social Sciences, oba Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM).
Dholuo: Dholuo ni waduong’ gi Grade 10 ng’eyo bedo e mwandu mag kar golo achiel kuoneni: Arts and Sports Science, Social Sciences, kata Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics (STEM).
Somali: Ardayda gashay Fasalka 10 waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka doortaan saddex Jid oo Shaqo ee Dugsiga Sare: Farshaxanka iyo Cayaaraha, Sayniska Bulshada, ama Sayniska, Teknoolojiyada, Injineernimada iyo Xisaabta (STEM).

English: KCSE candidates: Prepare for exams in November. Ensure you are equipped with resources as educational opportunities vary significantly.
Kiswahili: Wagombea wa KCSE: Jiandikishe kwa ajili ya mitihani mwezi Novemba. Hakikisha uko na rasilimali kwani fursa za kielimu zinatofautiana sana.
Ekegusii: Abakandori ba KCSE: Naki mugosi bukore bwanaka mu Novemba. Naki genda naki ore inyorori buya buingi bu магазин”.
Dholuo: KCSE gi nyaka: Wachieni kuom chajruok mar exam e November. Nadi gi chuth mar nyaka kendo chawi, to chalo mar itim mabor nyaka chieng'.
Somali: Ardayda KCSE: Isku diyaarso imtixaanaadka bisha Nofembar. Hubi inaad haysato agab, maadaama fursadaha waxbarasho ay si weyn u kala duwan yihiin.

English: Congratulations to Simeon Ongaga, newly appointed Nyanza Region Referees' Instructor by the Kenya Football Federation. His achievement highlights the support from students and the teaching community.
Kiswahili: Hongera kwa Simeon Ongaga, aliyeteuliwa kwa nafasi ya Mwalimu wa Waamuzi wa Mkoa wa Nyanza na Shirikisho la Soka la Kenya. Mafanikio yake yanasisitiza msaada kutoka kwa wanafunzi na jamii ya walimu.
Ekegusii: Naki oria Simeon Ongaga, omokiri omogoo Nyanza Region Referees' Instructor bu Kenya Football Federation. Naki boga bw’ogokiri bu naki oria bwokosi bw’abarigori na abaki bu orokiragatse.
Dholuo: Namatire Simeon Ongaga, weche mar yore Nyanza kuom Wanyadgi mag Referee gi Kenya Football Federation. Nying' piny manadili koro nyal kuom oko mar sudhruok gi ma-giwa.
Somali: Hambalyo Simeon Ongaga, oo noqday Macallinka Tiyaatarka Gobolka Nyanza ee ay magacaawday Xidhiidhka Kubadda Cagta Kenya. Guushan ayaa muujinaysa taageerada ka timaadda ardayda iyo bulshada macallimiinta.

English: The Ministry of Education prohibits public schools from introducing new levies without prior approval from parents and the ministry. Any unauthorised charges will not be tolerated.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu inakataza shule za umma kuanzisha ada mpya bila idhini ya wazazi na wizara. Malipo yoyote yasiyo na kibali hayatarajiwi.
Ekegusii: Obori buya bu Nyanchua bw’ogenda egesia obogenda bwanakire buya bu genda bwenkore bu naomi bwebong'i. Omosha ogori naki obokere naki buya burikire.
Dholuo: Ministri mar Tich ok nyal konyo chike mag gi sa wacho wuotho moko ma ok nyal doko gi kotte kendo ministri. Kotte duto ma ok joma golo ok nyal jopiny.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay mamnuucday in dugsiyada dadweynaha ay ku daraan canshuuraha cusub iyada oo aan loo helin ogolaansho ka hor ka yimaada waalidiinta iyo wasaaradda. Feejenaha aan la oggolaanayn lama aqbali doono.

English: Tenwek High School clarifies that all students were in official uniforms during the recent Speech and Prize-Giving Day, rejecting claims of political attire.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Sekondari ya Tenwek imethibitisha kuwa wanafunzi wote walivaa mavazi rasmi wakati wa Siku ya Hotuba na Kutunukiwa, ikikataa madai ya mavazi ya kisiasa.
Ekegusii: Tenwek Secondary School orenge omokireri bw'ogechere buya burokire buya abokiri buya bakeshe omokire buya naki buya.
Dholuo: Tenwek High School omer kelo ni joma okwayi ne gima en official uniforms gang' mang'ongo mar Speech and Prize-Giving Day, oyiwore gi chako eyo ong'we mar dho-politics.
Somali: Dugsiga Sare ee Tenwek wuxuu caddeynayaa in dhammaan ardaydu ay ku wearing uniform rasmi ah maalintii dhawaan ahayd ee Khudbada iyo Abaalmarinta, isagoo diidayaa sheegashooyinka dharka siyaasadeed.

English: Public servants are advised to review the new salary structure released by the Salaries and Remuneration Commission, with updated salary scales effective immediately across all CSG grades.
Kiswahili: Wajumbe wa umma wanashauriwa kukagua muundo mpya wa mishahara uliochapishwa na Tume ya Mishahara na Malipo, ambao unatekelezwa mara moja kwa viwango vyote vya CSG.
Ekegusii: Abanyakazi b’egumba bayie buya bwakorori bw’amasakiyano bushayire buya na Komisino ya Amasakiyano na Omosora, na buya bw’amasakiyano bushayire bosi bwanana egesereti ya CSG.
Dholuo: Kenyans ma ok nyaka wandu, wadhol gi nyalo timo kwayoni mar kanyakla maber kuom Salaries and Remuneration Commission, kuom kwayoni buroni ma wacho nyasaye modhi e yo machiegni timbe chieg CSG.
Somali: Shaqaalaha dowladda waxaa lagu talinayaa inay dib u eegaan dhismaha mushaharka cusub ee ay soo saartay Hay'adda Mushaharka iyo Magdhawga, iyadoo miisaska mushaharka la cusboonaysiiyey ay dhaqangalaan isla markiiba dhamaan darajooyinka CSG.

English: The KSSSA national football championship may expand to 24 teams in 2026; consultations are ongoing. Current championship postponed to July 31 for review of the proposed format.
Kiswahili: Mashindano ya kitaifa ya soka ya KSSSA yanaweza kuongezeka kuwa timu 24 mwaka 2026; mashauriano yanaendelea. Mashindano ya sasa yameahirishwa hadi Julai 31 kwa ajili ya kupitia muundo uliopendekezwa.
Ekegusii: Championship ya KSSSA naki ekirori kiane 24 abaki mu 2026; abaki buya batigena. Ekirori abaki bwaki endori mu July 31 buya busege buya naki omokiri ogwaki.
Dholuo: Championship mar KSSSA e yo tich ka 24 itiyo e 2026; winjruok ni kuom. Tich mar nyalo piny to e nyaka 31 to wacho ma nyal konyo.
Somali: Tartanka kubadda cagta qaranka ee KSSSA ayaa laga yaabaa in uu kordho ilaa 24 koox sanadka 2026; wadatashiyo ayaa soconaya. Tartanka hadda la hakiyey ilaa 31ka Luulyo si loo eego qaabka la soo jeediyey.

English: Kibabii University honors outgoing VC Prof. Isaac Ipara after 14 years of service. All staff and students are encouraged to continue building on the progress made during his tenure.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Kibabii kinamuenzi Makamu Mkuu wa Chuo anayemaliza muda wake, Prof. Isaac Ipara, baada ya huduma ya miaka 14. Wafanyakazi wote na wanafunzi wanahimizwa kuendeleza maendeleo yaliyofanywa wakati wa utawala wake.
Ekegusii: Kibabii University igenogoria omong'anyi wakioche VC Prof. Isaac Ipara buya nyanchoka 14. Abaki naki students nakiaki ogenda omogondo orokire babaiga buya bu kigendo chiang’ani na bu nakiaki.
Dholuo: Kibabii University oremo gi VC wachnigi Prof. Isaac Ipara kuom yore 14. Wana kamano ne ng'eeny to kelo nindgi gi piny gi tich modhiero no.
Somali: Jaamacadda Kibabii waxay sharfeysaa madaxa hore ee jaamacadda Prof. Isaac Ipara ka dib 14 sano oo adeeg ah. Dhammaan shaqaalaha iyo ardayda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay sii wadaan horumarka la gaadhay intii uu xafiiska joogay.

English: Bomet County public Junior Secondary Schools will receive 240 interactive smart boards as part of the government's digital learning initiative. Schools are urged to integrate this technology into classroom instruction.
Kiswahili: Shule za Sekondari za Kawaida za Kaunti ya Bomet zitapata bodi za smart 240 za kuingiliana kama sehemu ya mpango wa serikali wa ujifunzaji wa kidijitali. Shule zinashawishiwa kujumuisha teknolojia hii katika ufundishaji wa darasani.
Ekegusii: Shule za Sekondari za Mwanga wa Chini za Kaunti ya Bomet zitaegetwa buya 240 za mashamba ya akili kama sehemu ya mipango ya serikali ya kujifunza kidijitali. Shule zinashauriwa kuunganisha teknolojia hii katika mafundisho ya darasani.
Dholuo: Bomet County ema pubuki Junior Secondary Schools ohinga 240 interactive smart boards ochiek tieko ka gik ma gavamano no ng'ere digital learning. Makanisa par eyo nyaka kiongore ni technology ng'ato gi mawuok.
Somali: Bomet County waxay heli doonaan 240 buugag kale oo casri ah oo isdhexgal ah dugsiyada hoose ee dhexe, si qayb ka ah hindisaha waxbarashada dijitaalka ah ee dowladda. Dugsiyada waxaa lagu wargelinayaa inay ku daraan teknoolojiyaddaas waxbarashada fasallada.

English: Universities are encouraged to diversify funding sources and build multiple income streams to ensure financial resilience. Institutions should cultivate industry partnerships and commercialize research.
Kiswahili: Vyuo vikuu vinahimizwa kutafuta vyanzo mbalimbali vya ufadhili na kuunda njia tofauti za kupata mapato ili kuhakikisha ukweli wa kifedha. Taasisi zinapaswa kuendeleza ushirikiano na sekta na kufanya shughuli za utafiti kuwa za kibiashara.
Ekegusii: Amaklasi alatwaki bwakire obwaki bwa bahata omokibori bwegwenda bwogwenda na bwegwenda bwebwaki. Ekererwa kerekatwaki bwaki bw'omogongo na obwakirate omotabiri.
Dholuo: Sikulu oserian to en gichung' adhi gi bunde mag ng'won. Kilo duto okinyi to oyuok gichungo madhi nyaka itho.
Somali: Jaamacadaha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay kala duwanaadaan ilaha maaliyadeed iyo inay dhistaan ilaha dakhli ee badan si loo hubiyo adkeysi dhaqaale. Hay'adaha waa inay xoojiyaan iskaashiga warshadaha iyo in la ganacsiyo cilmi-baarista.

English: Schools must balance authority with constitutional rights in discipline matters. Educators are urged to evolve practices in response to technological changes and legal scrutiny.
Kiswahili: Shule zinapaswa kulinganisha mamlaka na haki za kikatiba katika masuala ya nidhamu. Walimu wanahamasishwa kuboresha mbinu zao ili kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya kiteknolojia na uangalizi wa kisheria.
Ekegusii: Masoko magang’ana ahanti na obwaki bwaki bw’egiri mu oringo bwabere. Abakire ba masoko barashoriwe okerebete obwakire bwabo buya nyamaki buikiri mueng’ana na obwakire buo bw’okore.
Dholuo: Dio nyaka makad viongozi gi nding' kendo uwongo moro ka ngima ng'ato gi. Manyien dhola tiyo ni omiya kadhoya to kendo bura duto kuom dodo.
Somali: Dugsiyadu waa inay dheelitiraan awoodda iyo xuquuqda dastuuriga ah arrimaha anshaxa. Macallimiinta waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay horumariyaan habraacyada si ay uga jawaabaan isbeddelada teknolojiyadda iyo baaritaanka sharciga.

English: Nyakach Constituency is receiving six new school buses for AIC Naki, Ragen AIC, Pawtenge, Olembo Boys, Rakwaro Mixed, and St George's Special School, to be distributed by the end of the 2026/2027 financial year.
Kiswahili: Jimbo la Nyakach linapata mabasi mapya sita ya shule kwa AIC Naki, Ragen AIC, Pawtenge, Olembo Boys, Rakwaro Mixed, na Shule Maalum ya Mtakatifu George, ambayo yatapewa mwishoni mwa mwaka wa kifedha 2026/2027.
Ekegusii: Nyakach Constituency igorea busi ogenda nane omokiriri naki buya AIC Naki, Ragen AIC, Pawtenge, Olembo Boys, Rakwaro Mixed, na St George's Special School, obwaki abokire omokire ogendo 2026/2027.
Dholuo: Nyakach Constituency okinyi bus ng'wech six ma nyal jotinda AIC Naki, Ragen AIC, Pawtenge, Olembo Boys, Rakwaro Mixed, kendo St George's Special School, ka to bende timo mondo owach ni kendo e bungu 2026/2027.
Somali: Degmada Nyakach ayaa heshay lix basaska cusub ee dugsiyada AIC Naki, Ragen AIC, Pawtenge, Olembo Boys, Rakwaro Mixed, iyo St George's Special School, kuwaas oo la qaybin doono dhammaadka sanadka maaliyadeed 2026/2027.
