English: A new modern dining hall with a fully equipped kitchen has been commissioned at Mung'ala Senior School to enhance the students' meal experience.
Kiswahili: Jengola kisasa la chakula lenye jikoni lililotengwa linafanywa kazi katika Shule ya Mung'ala ili kuboresha uzoefu wa chakula wa wanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Ogo chichorá chirekeri omokirori hamwe na nakiaki omokinyia ekomoshonire k' Mung'ala Senior School kuga omokinyia bw'ogwe bwakiabwonire.
Dholuo: Dinning hall mar bedo to kod kit gi dyad yore mochungo en Mung'ala Senior School, Iwuon ng'wech mar gikuok dwondiyono.
Somali: Maktabadda Sare ee Mung'ala waxaa loo sameeyey qol casri ah oo cunto lagu cuno leh jikada si buuxda loo qalabeeyey si loo hormariyo khibradda cuntada ardayda.

English: The government is committed to completing stalled public schools in Chebara, Elgeyo Marakwet County. Students and parents can expect improvements in access to education as projects progress.
Kiswahili: Serikali ina dhamira ya kukamilisha shule za umma zilizokwama huko Chebara, Kaunti ya Elgeyo Marakwet. Wanafunzi na wazazi wanaweza kutarajia maboresho katika upatikanaji wa elimu kadri miradi inavyoendelea.
Ekegusii: Abgetsi baki na inyakire oborori bw'echibundu bw'ekibundori mu Chebara, Elgeyo Marakwet. Abakiriire n'ababere buseikho bw'ekitabo batarigori naki naki buya naki bw'ogachinjani.
Dholuo: Kagelo otero kuom konyo joma nigi yore e choch kanyakla mag juok e Chebara, Elgeyo Marakwet County. Jodongo kendo jomoko bur gony oting' ka malong' gichike.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay ka go'an tahay dhamaystirka dugsiyada dadweynaha ee hakad galay ee Chebara, Gobolka Elgeyo Marakwet. Ardayda iyo waalidiinta waxay filan karaan horumarin ku timaada helitaanka waxbarashada marka mashaariicdu horumar sameeyaan.

English: Parents are urged to set a responsible example for their children to prevent drug abuse and its consequences, including school fires. Please support measures to eliminate substance abuse in our communities.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanahimizwa kuweka mfano mzuri kwa watoto wao ili kuzuia matumizi mabaya ya madawa na athari zake, ikiwa ni pamoja na moto shuleni. Tafadhali support hatua za kuondoa matumizi ya madawa katika jamii zetu.
Ekegusii: Abakire batorere emaki biong'ana bwaki bwaki bwakuriri buya bengesia naki bwaki bwakora oria kwerekera oria buya bwaki bwiyokiyoi. Ndaki mwaki ekegwaki ekibwaki bwaki bwetigwe buya mu banzaki bwegikiranio bwaki.
Dholuo: Buka it kuom gi ohinga wach kuom tieko mag owang' mar jomoko kendo kanyo doro ni ng'ato ma oyudo to chako maber kendo ok nyal jora. Teya kuom chonjo mar tije to nyalo ng'ato mar ohinga kendo to kendo.
Somali: Waalidiinta waxaa lagu boorinayaa in ay tusaale mas'uuliyad leh u noqdaan carruurtooda si looga hortago isticmaalka daroogada iyo cawaaqibkiisa, oo ay ku jiraan dabka iskuulka. Fadlan taageer tallaabooyinka lagu cirib tirayo isticmaalka maandooriyaha bulshadeena.

English: All parents and education stakeholders are encouraged to ensure equal opportunities for all learners, regardless of their schools.
Kiswahili: Wazazi na wadau wa elimu wanahimizwa kuhakikisha fursa sawa kwa wanafunzi wote, bila kujali shule zao.
Ekegusii: Abagania naki baeri baki meko ogena nyasa hamweki bwaki bwakire bugete bwakinyang'ani bwaki bujina naki bugetabaki omogori.
Dholuo: Wang'ni kendo grupo mar masomo mane okonyo chunyogi kuom ng'ato piny, kendo duto adiera e kariboni ni jitendi e yo.
Somali: Waalidiinta iyo dadka ku lug leh waxbarashada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay hubiyaan fursado siman dhammaan ardayda, iyadoon loo eegin dugsiyada ay dhigtaan.

English: Kenyan health professionals can expect expanded international employment opportunities in Germany through KMTC's strengthened partnership with German industry leaders.
Kiswahili: Wataalamu wa afya kutoka Kenya wanaweza kutarajia fursa kubwa za ajira kimataifa Ujerumani kupitia ushirikiano ulioimarishwa wa KMTC na viongozi wa sekta ya viwanda vya Ujerumani.
Ekegusii: Abanyasa b’abehealthi ba Kenya baria bataria bosi mbega yane ya ikirori omogomo bwakire bwakunyonyesha buya na bwiinyangani bwemokiri mukariri wa KMTC na abaki b’aba German.
Dholuo: Kenyani mogikani modhi e kite ng'ama modhi gi thurwa mar Kenya Medical Training College (KMTC) kod ma joma okinyi kuonde gi joma mago.
Somali: Xirfadlayaasha caafimaadka ee Kiiniya waxay filan karaan fursado shaqo oo shisheeye oo la ballaariyey oo ku yaal Jarmalka iyada oo loo marayo iskaashiga xooggan ee KMTC iyo hoggaamiyeyaasha warshadaha Jarmalka.

English: 100 vulnerable students from Muhoroni and Nyakach sub-counties in Kisumu have received bursaries totaling Sh4.25 million. Beneficiaries should confirm their funds with the Kisumu Senator's Office.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi 100 wenye uhitaji kutoka kata za Muhoroni na Nyakach katika Kaunti ya Kisumu wamepata ruzuku yenye jumla ya Sh4.25 milioni. Walengwa wanapaswa kuthibitisha fedha zao ofisini ya Seneta wa Kisumu.
Ekegusii: Abana 100 abakiishonire mu Muhoroni na Nyakach sub-counties e Kisumu baria baturetete bursaries buse bwa Sh4.25 million. Abakiabwanana baria borachi boti keyi bwaki omogoti “Kisumu Senator's Office.”
Dholuo: Vulnerable mudho 100 ku Muhoroni gi Nyakach sub-counties e Kisumu ne owadgi bursaries nyaka Sh4.25 miriyoni. Beneficiaries bedo e ng'ato maritho ni gin duto ku Kisumu Senator's Office.
Somali: 100 arday oo nugul ka socda degmada Muhoroni iyo Nyakach ee Kisumu ayaa helay deeqo waxbarasho oo guud ahaan gaareysa Sh4.25 million. Ka faa'iideystayaashu waa inay xaqiijiyaan lacagtooda xafiiska Senator-ka Kisumu.

English: Teachers from Kirinyaga, Kiambu, Nyandarua, Nyeri, and Murang'a counties are invited to the KUPPET Central Region Sports Tournament in Kirinyaga from August 7-9. Register by July 31: football teams at Sh3,000; volleyball, basketball, handball teams at Sh2,000; and individuals for racquet and board games at Sh500.
Kiswahili: Teachers kutoka kaunti za Kirinyaga, Kiambu, Nyandarua, Nyeri, na Murang'a wanakaribishwa kwenye Mashindano ya Michezo ya KUPPET ya Mkoa wa Kati yatakayofanyika Kirinyaga kuanzia Agosti 7-9. Jisajili kabla ya Julai 31: timu za soka kwa Sh3,000; timu za mpira wa wavu, mpira wa kikapu, mpira wa mkono kwa Sh2,000; na watu binafsi kwa michezo ya rafu na bodi kwa Sh500.
Ekegusii: Abaki baki ba Kirinyaga, Kiambu, Nyandarua, Nyeri, na Murang'a barikore buya ku KUPPET Central Region Sports Tournament buya Kirinyaga buya August 7-9. Bwakirire buya July 31: matimu gba kanyenga ku Sh3,000; matimu gba volleyball, basketball, na handball ku Sh2,000; na abaragi buya michero na bwiire ku Sh500.
Dholuo: Watu magi kuom Kirinyaga, Kiambu, Nyandarua, Nyeri, kod Murang'a nigi ni urembe ku KUPPET Central Region Sports Tournament e Kirinyaga manok gima August 7-9. Weren juma ku July 31: timbu magi fuutbol ku Sh3,000; timbu magi volleyball, basketball, handball ku Sh2,000; kendo jaber ku racquet kod bor dho anyira ku Sh500.
Somali: Macallimiinta ka socda county-yada Kirinyaga, Kiambu, Nyandarua, Nyeri, iyo Murang'a waxaa lagu casuumay tartanka isboortiga KUPPET ee gobolka dhexe ee ku yaal Kirinyaga, laga bilaabo Agoosto 7 ilaa 9. Isdiiwaangeli inta aan la gaarin Luulyo 31: kooxaha kubadda cagta waxaa lagu diiwaangelinayaa Sh3,000; kooxaha kubadda koleyga, kubadda gacanta iyo kubadda laliska waxaa lagu diiwaangelinayaa Sh2,000; iyo shakhsiyaadka ciyaaraha racquet-ka iyo ciyaaraha miiska Sh500.

English: The University of Nairobi highlights its legacy of academic excellence and leadership under its past Vice-Chancellors. Students are encouraged to honor this tradition by upholding values of integrity and respect in their academic pursuits.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Nairobi kinaangazia urithi wake wa ubora wa kitaaluma na uongozi chini ya Makamu Vice-Chancellors wake wa zamani. Wanafunzi wanahimizwa kuheshimu jadi hii kwa kudumisha maadili ya uaminifu na heshima katika juhudi zao za kitaaluma.
Ekegusii: Yamwaki ya Nairobi igana omogaka mwaki waki nyakiyaki na bugi mang'anya bwaki omong'ania bosi. Abanyeshuri bonyorore bamenye okuhanzire omogaka uyu buya omokong'ania na omogori mu bumwe bwabo bwegasire.
Dholuo: University of Nairobi en ng'eyo mondo an gi kanyakla mar akademia, kendo nyaka joma ochiunga mag yramo. Waduong' kato e yo nyaka nene rembe, kendo chako ng'ato gi konyo.
Somali: Universitiga Nairobi wuxuu muujinayaa dhaxalkiisa heerka waxbarasho iyo hoggaamineed ee ku saabsan Rektoradii hore. Ardayda waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ixtiraamaan dhaqankan iyagoo ilaalinaya qiyamka daacadnimada iyo ixtiraamka inta ay ku guda jiraan waxbarashadooda.

English: Parents are urged to remain vigilant and report any suspicious activities to local authorities, especially during evening hours, following the tragic murder of a seven-year-old boy in Nyamira County.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanahimizwa kubaki makini na kuripoti shughuli zozote za kushuku kwa mamlaka za eneo, hasa wakati wa usiku, kufuatia mauaji ya kusikitisha ya mvulana wa miaka saba katika Kaunti ya Nyamira.
Ekegusii: Ababere barokige bionge na bosiere bambi bwaki bware buya bionge bosiere bukorere buya, bwere buya bwagashia buya bwaki bwomoka bwi ogenda, buya naki bwaki bworanga buya mu Nyamira.
Dholuo: Bere magi konyo to konyo goyo nyiso ne giyou giwe loko gitiyogo mar sok gi, kar ka ma obedo nyaka, ka ok ng'ama nyal gi pi salo mar goyo, nyalo gi jodong' gi kita.
Somali: Waalidka waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay si feejigan u joogaan oo ay soo sheegaan wax kasta oo shaki leh oo ay arkaan, gaar ahaan saacadaha habeenkii, ka dib dilkii nasiib-darrada ahaa ee wiil todoba jir ah lagu dilay Gobolka Nyamira.

English: New educational infrastructure projects funded by the NG-CDF are now completed at Ndumberi Primary School in Kiambu, promoting quality education. Similar upgrades are planned for other schools in the constituency.
Kiswahili: Miradi mipya ya miundombinu ya elimu iliyofadhiliwa na NG-CDF sasa imemalizika katika Shule ya Msingi ya Ndumberi huko Kiambu, ikikuza elimu ya ubora. Maboresho kama haya yanapangwa kwa shule nyingine katika eneo bunge hilo.
Ekegusii: Maki naki abwaki ogendendani ebwaki naki kuri NG-CDF emokiania naki ku Ndumberi Primary School ki Kiambu, giterera oria ogendendani omokibori. Bwakire buya bwaki bwakina okere menye oria ebuya bwaki buya ngo ige ise ke orire.
Dholuo: Mikano mag duto mar wale mag joma lokruok ng'weny e Ng-CDF no oketuru e Ndumberi Primary School ka Kiambu, to golo nyaka ochako ma nyal ng'won ni. Konyore duto ma okel awei e sukulu duto mag konstituensi.
Somali: Mashruucyo cusub oo waxbarashada ah oo ay maalgelisay NG-CDF ayaa hadda la dhameystiray dugsiga hoose ee Ndumberi ee Kiambu, taasoo kor u qaadeysa tayada waxbarashada. Dayactirro la mid ah ayaa lagu qorsheynayaa dugsiyo kale oo ka tirsan xildhibaanada.

English: The Trans Nzoia Governor has called for the appointment of qualified Luhya scholars as vice-chancellors at MMUST and Kibabii University to promote fairness in leadership opportunities.
Kiswahili: Gavana wa Trans Nzoia ameitaka serikali kuteua wanazuoni wa Luhya waliohitimu kuwa naibu makamu wa wahitimu katika MMUST na Chuo Kikuu cha Kibabii ili kukuza usawa katika fursa za uongozi.
Ekegusii: Omogaka wa Trans Nzoia oseria ogetarire abere abaki Luhya abaki baingira weka mbokira MMUST na Kibabii University naki bw'ogenda omokiri chaki abokire bogo.
Dholuo: Gavana mar Trans Nzoia owinjire kuom chula magi giko Luhya ma ok nyal yego kama vice-chancellor e MMUST kendo Kibabii University to gige ofumu e chageno maban.
Somali: Guddoomiyaha Trans Nzoia wuxuu codsaday in la magacaabo cilmi-baarayaal Luhya ah oo karti leh inay noqdaan ku-simaha rektarada MMUST iyo Jaamacadda Kibabii si loo dardar-geliyo sinnaanta fursadaha hogaaminta.

English: A new Kenya Medical Training College campus will open in Matuu, Matungulu Sub-county, in September 2026. Parents are encouraged to prepare their children for enrollment in medical programs.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kipya cha Mafunzo ya Tiba nchini Kenya kitateketezwa huko Matuu, Kaunti Ndogo ya Matungulu, mnamo Septemba 2026. Wazazi wanahimizwa kujiandaa kuwapeleka watoto wao katika programu za tiba.
Ekegusii: Ekikoro Enya kya Kenya Medical Training College kigeiginia Matuu, Matungulu Sub-county, mwaki wa Septemba 2026. Ababere bakoragie ogendene babo bagenyane eng’ori ya bwakire buya.
Dholuo: Kampasi nyewi ya Kenya Medical Training College kuom Matuu, Sub-county ya Matungulu, ikwero tiyo September 2026. Wazazi ochako ka oting'o buo nyithindo mago okel ochak nyaka konyo kanyandit e programa mar medik.
Somali: Jaamacad cusub oo Tababarka Caafimaadka Kenya ah ayaa furmi doonta Matuu, Gobolka Matungulu, bisha Sebtember 2026. Waalidiinta waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa in ay u diyaariyaan carruurtooda in ay ku biiraan barnaamijyada caafimaadka.

English: The Ministry of Education has announced new appointments effective July 17, 2026, including key positions in curriculum development and quality assurance for education.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu imetangaza uteuzi mpya unaoanza tarehe 17 Julai, 2026, ikihusisha nafasi muhimu katika uandaaji wa mtaala na uhakikisho wa ubora wa elimu.
Ekegusii: Omiseli wa Barabara y’Emakanga ya Elimu omonye acokinya abanyagore buya buya omogiri wa 17, 2026, oria omogende ogokire amang'anya mweng'eni mabe na busekecha mu nkiro z’amaubiri.
Dholuo: Ministry of Education oyie swar mpya ma okel kuom Julu 17, 2026, kendo gi doko madongo eyo kuom konyruok mar kutind kendo ng'ama mar winjruok e kalisela.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada waxay ku dhawaaqday magacaabis cusub oo dhaqan gal ah 17-keeda Luulyo, 2026, oo ay ku jiraan jaggooyin muhiim ah oo la xiriira horumarinta manhajka iyo tayada waxbarashada.

English: Mandatory leadership training for TSC secretariat staff begins January 1, 2026. Completion is required for promotion to posts above TSC grades 6, 7, and 8.
Kiswahili: Mafunzo ya uongozi ya lazima kwa wafanyakazi wa sekretarieti ya TSC yananza Januari 1, 2026. Kumaliza mafunzo ni lazima ili kuongezwa cheo juu ya viwango vya TSC 6, 7, na 8.
Ekegusii: Kwere kavundori ka abaki banzaki bakeshe ya TSC kōmoka 1, 2026. Kogana naki kosi ekibirori buya buya ekekire ya TSC wendo 6, 7, na 8.
Dholuo: Kagwere mar tiniki mokuongo ni TSC secretariat milando jomar nyaka 1, 2026. Kachung' jomoko ma ok nyaka ka ok nyal mbere kuono ku TSC grades 6, 7, e 8.
Somali: Tababarka hogaaminta ee khasabka ah ayaa bilaabanaya 1-da Janaayo, 2026, ee shaqaalaha xafiiska TSC. Ka-qaybgalka ayaa lagama maarmaan u ah kor u qaadista xilalka ka sarreeya darajooyinka TSC 6, 7, iyo 8.

English: The KUCCPS late application portal is now open for 57,681 students who missed university placement for the 2026/2027 academic year. Qualified candidates from KCSE 2022-2025 must apply promptly.
Kiswahili: Pango la maombi ya kuchelewa la KUCCPS sasa lipo wazi kwa wanafunzi 57,681 waliokosa nafasi ya chuo kikuu kwa mwaka wa masomo 2026/2027. Wagombea waliohitimu kutoka KCSE 2022-2025 wanapaswa kuomba mara moja.
Ekegusii: Poritali ya kuwasilisha maombi ya KUCCPS imefunguliwa kwa wanafunzi 57,681 ambao hawakupata nafasi ya chuo kikuu kwa mwaka wa masomo 2026/2027. Wanafunzi wanaostahili kutoka KCSE 2022-2025 wanapaswa kuomba haraka.
Dholuo: Portal mag KUCCPS mar kiwuoyo no wacho kata neno ma 57,681 choch kanyag' mai koro gima ok gipar mitie go joma kanyoni e siko 2026/2027. Joma pok miyo nyaka ok nyal piny KCSE 2022-2025 nyaka chiwoyi.
Somali: Goobta codsiga dambiga ee KUCCPS hadda way furan tahay 57,681 arday oo ka maqan jaamacad lagu qoondeyn lahaa sanadka waxbarashada 2026/2027. K candidatku ku kalsoon yahay KCSE 2022-2025 waa inay si degdeg ah u codsadaan.

English: All educational trips in Uganda are temporarily suspended while a comprehensive investigation and the development of new road safety guidelines take place.
Kiswahili: Safari za elimu zote nchini Uganda zimesitishwa kwa muda wakati wa uchunguzi wa kina na ukuzaji wa miongozo mipya ya usalama barabarani.
Ekegusii: Makiogoria oria mwaki Uganda nakiore bw'aki aria ore buya chingi bw'aki fwenye kutang'ania na bw'aki oria buya bw'aki ng'ama tsimbia.
Dholuo: Bolo dongo ma weng' e Uganda chenro ni ahinya, wakati chik gi tich ma oket e piny.
Somali: Dhammaan safarada waxbarashada ee Ugaandha waa la hakiyay ilaa baaritaan dhameystiran iyo horumarinta tilmaamaha cusub ee badqabka waddooyinka la sameeyo.

English: Gerald Orina, Chief Principal of Riokindo National High School, has announced his candidacy for the Borabu Constituency parliamentary seat in the 2027 General Elections.
Kiswahili: Gerald Orina, Mwalimu Mkuu wa Shule ya Sekondari ya Kitaifa ya Riokindo, ametangaza kuwania kiti cha ubunge cha Jimbo la Borabu katika Uchaguzi Mkuu wa 2027.
Ekegusii: Gerald Orina, Omochiri Omosabaki wa Riokindo National High School, amenyorokere buya bwake bwokutukire omong'anya bweng'ere buya bwa Borabu mu 2027 General Elections.
Dholuo: Gerald Orina, Chief Principal wa Riokindo National High School, awachok gi dhano yakanyo ka Borabu Constituency kwotech gi 2027 General Elections.
Somali: Gerald Orina, Maamulka Sare ee Dugsiga Sare ee Riokindo, ayaa shaaciyey in uu kandid ah u yahay kursiga baarlamaanka ee deegaanka Borabu doorashada guud ee 2027.

English: Attention all Technical and Vocational Education and Training institutions: Ensure all assessment fees are settled by July 20, 2026, for access to assessment tools. Trainees must leave phones in secure areas before entering assessment rooms.
Kiswahili: Tawa habari kwa taasisi zote za Elimu na Mafunzo ya Ufundi: Hakikisha ada zote za tathmini zimelipwa kabla ya Julai 20, 2026, ili kupata zana za tathmini. Wakufunzi wanapaswa kuacha simu kwenye maeneo salama kabla ya kuingia kwenye vyumba vya tathmini.
Ekegusii: Abwakire mosi buya bwemoni na Gwamo buya bwete: Waki bosi bwaki bosi mosi bwaki kuta nyang’ori bosi buya bwetare buya Juli 20, 2026, buya kutenda nyang’ori bwaki bosi. Abamelure bataria bosi bwiita ng’ori bosi bwi ite boma bwiugusi.
Dholuo: Osuba ma joma Technical and Vocational Education and Training: Neni nyaka konyo fee dhedhi mbul 20, 2026, nyaka ng'eyo mar assessment tools. Wuok no nyaka konyo maber e piny mager mabor mokiwa buo odhi.
Somali: Digniin dhammaan hay’adaha Waxbarashada Farsamada iyo Tababarka: Hubi in dhammaan khidmadaha qiimayntu la bixiyo ka hor July 20, 2026, si loo helo agabka qiimaynta. Tababarayaasha waa inay taleefannadooda ka tagaan meelaha amaanka ah ka hor inta aysan gelin qolka qiimaynta.

English: Candidates who sat for KCSE from 1989 to 2025 can now access their digital KCSE and KCPE certificates via the KNEC online portal. Complete identity verification and pay KSh 1,450 to obtain your e-certificate.
Kiswahili: Wagombea walioshiriki KCSE kuanzia mwaka 1989 hadi 2025 sasa wanaweza kupata vyeti vyao vya dijiti vya KCSE na KCPE kupitia portal ya mtandao ya KNEC. Kamalisha uthibitisho wa kitambulisho na kulipia KSh 1,450 ili kupata cheti chako cha e.
Ekegusii: Abakandi bakiore KCSE buya 1989 na 2025 bagana bakiere kuwana abaki e-KCSE na e-KCPE buya omogori wa KNEC. Tia omokang'andi osibori na ubwi omoshere KSh 1,450 okwenda obaki e-certificate.
Dholuo: Ng'ato mokuongo gi KCSE manok gi 1989 to 2025 no ng'eyo' kanyo to e-digital KCSE kod KCPE certificates e KNEC online portal. Timo ihinya ma okonyo kendo ng'we KSh 1,450 kuom igi e-certificate.
Somali: Murashaxiinta ka soo qayb galay KCSE intii u dhaxeysay 1989 ilaa 2025 hadda waxay heli karaan shahaadooyinkooda dijitaalka ah ee KCSE iyo KCPE iyada oo loo marayo bogga internetka ee KNEC. Hubi aqoonsigaaga oo bixiso KSh 1,450 si aad u hesho shahaadadaada e-shahaadada ah.

English: Parents are reminded to ensure their children are aware of school policies regarding conduct during breaks to avoid misunderstandings that could lead to disciplinary actions.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanakumbushwa kuhakikisha watoto wao wanajua sera za shule kuhusu tabia wakati wa mapumziko ili kuepusha kutokuelewana ambayo yanaweza kusababisha hatua za kinidhamu.
Ekegusii: Ababere baria batarerete banasiba baksoma bwaki bwaki buti bategende buinse buria buene bwanosibere obwanogore buigori omokimori bwaki bweng'enda obwakore buine bwanebere obwasire borire.
Dholuo: Ninine mawuongi kuom riwruok gi higa osemak kanyal, kuom nyaka dwaro maber kwaya nyaka gin polices ma otim higa osemak.
Somali: Waalidka waxaa la xasuusinayaa inay xaqiijiyaan in caruurtooda ay ka warqabaan siyaasadaha iskuulka ee ku saabsan dhaqanka inta lagu jiro nasashada si looga fogaado fahamkhaldan oo keeni kara tallaabooyin anshax xumo.

English: Prayer Day for students preparing for national exams will be held at schools across Kenya. Parents, educators, and the community are encouraged to participate in supporting learners.
Kiswahili: Siku ya Sala ya wanafunzi wanaojiandaa kwa mitihani ya kitaifa itafanyika katika shule mbalimbali nchini Kenya. Wazazi, walimu, na jamii wanahimizwa kushiriki kusaidia wanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Osibori naki buya buigana bwokire bwete buya buseke omogende nyanaro. Ababere, abarubera, naki omogendi banogore bousego bwosekire buigana.
Dholuo: Juma mane ng'anyo kendo kuom wadhogo ma ng'ato ma okonyo e nyime kendo ni. Jothurwa, wathor, kod dhiko nyaka oting'o kuom wadhogo.
Somali: Maalin Ducad ah oo loogu talagalay ardayda diyaarinaysa imtixaannada qaranka ayaa lagu qaban doonaa iskuulada dalka oo dhan. Waalidiinta, macalimiinta, iyo bulshadu waxa la dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qaybgalaan taageeridda ardayda.

English: Kenyatta University graduates are encouraged to embrace innovation, entrepreneurship, and ethical leadership to create jobs and address socio-economic challenges.
Kiswahili: Graduates wa Chuo Kikuu cha Kenyatta wanahimizwa kukumbatia ubunifu, ujasiriamali, na uongozi wa kimaadili ili kuunda ajira na kushughulikia changamoto za kiuchumi na kijamii.
Ekegusii: Abagetu ba Kenyatta University barahiye obwataka, obwaki naki bwemokiriri okore buya na bwachenda obokere naki oboragori.
Dholuo: Kenyatta University ma chunya nyasaye, kanyo to gi dhano doyie, kendo nyasaye mare konyo daka to kachiel masira gi dhano mar luor.
Somali: Ardayda ka qalin-jabisa Jaamacadda Kenyatta waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay qaataan hal-abuur, ganacsi, iyo hogaamin anshax leh si ay u abuuraan shaqooyin iyo inay wax ka qabtaan caqabadaha bulshada iyo dhaqaalaha.

English: Students seeking to transfer to universities or TVET institutions must apply within the 30-day window and ensure they meet programme requirements and available vacancies. Verify all information before submitting applications.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanaotaka kuhamia vyuo vikuu au taasisi za TVET lazima watekeleze maombi ndani ya siku 30 na wahakikishe wanafaa kwa masharti ya programu na nafasi zilizopo. Hakikisha unathibitisha taarifa zote kabla ya kuwasilisha maombi.
Ekegusii: Abantugendi banoigne okugenda kumaketano kana TVET institutions naki batarori muja 30, na banoigne okwiberega na maarifa ga program naki abairo bengi. Osogorie amahoranaki nyasa omokugenda okanyora.
Dholuo: Jong'ere ma en kuom chalo kuom nyimruogi to wongo ni konyo e 30 duka, kendo chako ni en kanyalo gin mwandiko maber kendo kanyo bende. Nyal ng'eyo dede wacho nyaka inyal chalo.
Somali: Ardayda raba in ay u guuraan jaamacadaha ama hay'adaha TVET waa inay codsadaan mudada 30-ka maalmood ah oo hubiyaan inay buuxiyaan shuruudaha barnaamijka iyo boosaska la heli karo. Hubi dhammaan macluumaadka ka hor inta aadan gudbin codsiyada.

English: All public servants enrolled in the Public Service Superannuation Fund (PSSF) must update their membership records by August 14, 2026, via the PSSF Member Self-Service Portal or Mobile App.
Kiswahili: Watumishi wote wa umma waliojiandikisha kwenye Mfuko wa Pensheni wa Huduma za Umma (PSSF) wanapaswa kusasisha rekodi zao za uanachama kabla ya Agosti 14, 2026, kupitia Portal ya Huduma ya Kibinafsi ya PSSF au Programu ya Simu.
Ekegusii: Abaki nyamwaki bwenyina mu Public Service Superannuation Fund (PSSF) bategere ilanduki banchire bendi bui August 14, 2026, gi PSSF Member Self-Service Portal naki Mobile App.
Dholuo: Wathogni wacho kuom Public Service Superannuation Fund (PSSF) nyalo weche ni gino nitie ka wachiwe record mar membership gi August 14, 2026, kuom PSSF Member Self-Service Portal kata Mobile App.
Somali: Dhammaan adeegayaasha dadweynaha ka diiwaangashan Sanduuqa Hawlgabka Adeegga Dadweynaha (PSSF) waa inay cusbooneysiiyaan diiwaankooda xubinnimada ilaa 14ka Agoosto, 2026, iyaga oo adeegsanaya Portalka Is-adeegga Xubnaha PSSF ama App-ka Mobile-ka.

English: Michael Murigi has received the endorsement of Maureen Makena for the KUPPET Central Region Trustee seat ahead of the 2026 elections. Supporters are encouraged to rally behind his campaign.
Kiswahili: Michael Murigi amepata kuungwa mkono na Maureen Makena kwa kiti cha Mkurugenzi wa KUPPET katika Mkoa wa Kati kabla ya uchaguzi wa mwaka 2026. Wafuasi wanahimizwa kumuunga mkono katika kampeni yake.
Ekegusii: Michael Murigi akorete oboreri bwaki bwa Maureen Makena buya mwaki wa KUPPET Central Region Trustee ka 2026. Abaki baki abashindani naki ni bweriitire moshene yaki.
Dholuo: Michael Murigi awinjore denda ma Maureen Makena mar KUPPET Central Region Trustee kiwang'ni 2026 election. Nyasaye ng'ato makanda ni oting'o konyo mar joma.
Somali: Michael Murigi wuxuu helay taageerada Maureen Makena si uu uga mid noqdo xilka KUPPET ee Gobolka Dhexe ka hor doorashooyinka 2026. Taageerayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay taageeraan ololihiisa.

English: Attention: Special schools and rehabilitation centres are facing funding shortages, affecting support for learners with disabilities. Institutions are encouraged to seek alternative funding sources to improve facilities and resources for education.
Kiswahili: Taarifa: Shule maalum na vituo vya kurekebisha vinakabiliwa na ukosefu wa ufadhili, unaathiri msaada kwa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu. Taasisi zinahimizwa kutafuta vyanzo mbadala vya ufadhili ili kuboresha miundombinu na rasilimali za elimu.
Ekegusii: Ekereri: Masomo emoyaki na ogenda bwogekire buya emonchire buya buria, bwakabere bweng'ani nyagire na ekyingori. Abakire buya bagenyere bware ekererete yore omokomo ogendi bakire ogenda buya.
Dholuo: Naki: Madiko mar special kod rehabilitation nenge ohele funding, ka ng'amo kethni gi joma okonyruok. Kanyenya okonyruok nyaka gingo funding iriyo to nyaka pi ketho mar chike.
Somali: Dardaaran: Dugsiyada khaaska ah iyo xarumaha dib-u-habaynta waxay la kulmayaan dhibaatooyin dhaqaale, taasoo saameyneyso taageerada ardayda naafada ah. Hay’adaha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay raadiyaan ilo maalgelin oo kale si loo hagaajiyo goobaha iyo kheyraadka waxbarashada.

English: Teachers will continue receiving their existing house, hardship, and commuter allowances despite the 2025–2029 CBA adjustments. No action is required from teachers regarding their allowances.
Kiswahili: Walimu wataendelea kupata posho zao za nyumba, ugumu, na usafiri bila kubadilishwa licha ya marekebisho ya CBA ya 2025–2029. Hakuna hatua inayohitajika kutoka kwa walimu kuhusu posho zao.
Ekegusii: Abakire bakenye bano bokuigana ibo naki, ibonjo, naki komi boki bware bwioria odhi 2025–2029 CBA. Omosoriori oria ikiraki buya nang'ena abaki buya bonyonyore iebaki.
Dholuo: Weteno bed gi piny kuom chike, lok gyt madhako, kendo gi nyamre ka no duto e piny 2025-2029 CBA. Moko bedo morning e tich kwachni kuom weteno kanyakla oganda.
Somali: Macalimiinta waxay sii wadi doonaan inay helaan deynkooda guri, dhibaato, iyo mushaaraadka safarka inkasta oo isbadallada CBA ee 2025-2029. Wax tallaabo ah kama baahan tahay macalimiintu marka ay timaado mushaaraadkooda.

English: Teachers can now access the revised salary conversion tables according to TSC's Phase II salary structure effective July 1, 2026, until June 30, 2027. Please check your earnings accordingly.
Kiswahili: Walimu sasa wanaweza kufikia meza mpya za kubadilisha mishahara kulingana na muundo wa mishahara wa Awamu ya II wa TSC, kuanzia Julai 1, 2026, hadi Juni 30, 2027. Tafadhali angalia mapato yako ipasavyo.
Ekegusii: Ab老师 teese enang'ania omokiriri busiane bwokutiririe obwakire bwa TSC Phase II bwotongoria tekaroria omokongo wa 1, 2026, naki owenyono 30, 2027. Naki inya obwakire bwomokiriri bwokusi.
Dholuo: Abijo nying' towet gi wang' ji kendo twal gi TSC Phase II kama nyaka 2026, kaka Juol 1, kendo to kech konyruok 30, 2027. Nyal gi dhi nyis gi iewe.
Somali: Macallimiinta hadda waxay gali karaan jaantusyada dib loo habeeyey ee is-weydaarsiga mushaharka sida waafaqsan qaabka mushaharka ee TSC ee Marinka II oo dhaqan galaya 1da Luulyo, 2026, ilaa 30ka Juun, 2027. Fadlan hubi dakhligaaga sida ku xusan.

English: Teachers employed by the Teachers Service Commission (TSC) will earn higher salaries effective July 1, 2026, as part of Phase II of the 2025-2029 Collective Bargaining Agreement.
Kiswahili: Walimu walioajiriwa na Tume ya Huduma za Walimu (TSC) watapata mishahara mikubwa kuanzia Julai 1, 2026, kama sehemu ya Awamu ya Pili ya Mkataba wa Pamoja wa Kazi wa 2025-2029.
Ekegusii: Abarebuya baboka na Teachers Service Commission (TSC) boku'oborere oria chirebu chihiga chire na nyabasi ya Nyakiyembe 1, 2026, mageria a Phase II ya 2025-2029 Collective Bargaining Agreement.
Dholuo: Wachoko omiye e Teachers Service Commission (TSC) bende wacho tije madhi mokuongo e Juli 1, 2026, ka nyaka mar Phase II ma 2025-2029 Collective Bargaining Agreement.
Somali: Macallimiinta ka shaqeeya Guddiga Adeegga Macallimiinta (TSC) waxay heli doonaan mushaar sare oo dhaqan galaya 1-da Luulyo, 2026, qayb ka ah Waqtiga II ee Heshiiska Iskaashiga 2025-2029.

English: Kenya now offers over 26,000 government services online, streamlining access to essential services. Citizens can apply, pay, and receive services digitally, improving convenience and efficiency.
Kiswahili: Kenya sasa inatoa huduma zaidi ya 26,000 za serikali mtandaoni, ikiweka njia rahisi ya kupata huduma muhimu. Wananchi wanaweza kuomba, kulipa, na kupata huduma kidijitali, kuongeza urahisi na ufanisi.
Ekegusii: Kenya ekirorere emasiro 26,000 ebiyae bwiire buya online, buya omokirisia obokire obwakirori. Ababere banagire, babugire, na barekire ebiyae buya buya, buya obokire naki naki.
Dholuo: Kenya nyalo poi piny 26,000 miyo kare gi jumbi ma ok nyal kuom joma. Jotiede  nyalo dhog, pwodhi, kendo neno jumbi gi inyuol, okonyo tich kendo gi puodho.
Somali: Kenya hadda waxa uu bixiya 26,000 adeegyo dowladeed oo khadka tooska ah, taasoo sahlaysa helitaanka adeegyada muhiimka ah. Muwaadiniintu waxay codsan karaan, bixin karaan, oo ay adeegyada ku heli karaan si dijitaal ah, taasoo hagaajineysa raaxada iyo waxtarka.

English: The UNESCO-CODEMAO Youth Coding Initiative is offering an AI training program in Shenzhen, China from July 19 to 26, 2026, for selected teachers and students.
Kiswahili: Mpango wa Mafunzo ya AI wa UNESCO-CODEMAO kwa Vijana unatoa mafunzo katika Shenzhen, China kuanzia Julai 19 hadi 26, 2026, kwa walimu na wanafunzi waliochaguliwa.
Ekegusii: Omochanda bu UNESCO-CODEMAO bwakire buya bwokire bu AI mu Shenzhen, China bwakabere 19 - 26 Nyakanga, 2026, buya bw’ekerekwa abalimo abateka na abashuri.
Dholuo: UNESCO-CODEMAO Youth Coding Initiative nyaka nigo program mar AI e Shenzhen, China kutoka July 19 ng'ato July 26, 2026, ka jaluo kwayo ne ng'ato konyal.
Somali: Barnaamijka Dhalinyarada ee UNESCO-CODEMAO wuxuu bixiya tababar AI ah oo ka dhici doona Shenzhen, Shiinaha laga bilaabo 19 ilaa 26 Luulyo, 2026, oo loogu talagalay macallimiin iyo ardaydo la doortay.

English: The Kenya Medical Training College (KMTC) is conducting an academic and clinical exchange program for Occupational Therapy students between Teso and Nairobi campuses starting July 13, 2026.
Kiswahili: Chuo cha Mafunzo ya Tiba Kenya (KMTC) kinaendesha mpango wa kubadilishana kitaaluma na kliniki kwa wanafunzi wa Tiba ya Kazi kati ya kampasi za Teso na Nairobi kuanzia Julai 13, 2026.
Ekegusii: Chuo cha Mafunzo ya Tiba Kenya (KMTC) kiri kugura porogaramu ya kubadilishana masomo na kliniki kwa wanafunzi wa Tiba ya Kazi kati ya maeneo ya Teso na Nairobi kuanzia Julai 13, 2026.
Dholuo: Kenya Medical Training College (KMTC) en gi tere mar tich kod gima otero ma okonyo kanyalo tich ng'ato mar Occupational Therapy pakati ka Teso to Nairobi, manok shok kanyakore July 13, 2026.
Somali: Iskoolka Tababarka Caafimaadka ee Kenya (KMTC) ayaa bilaabaya barnaamij is-dhaafsi ah oo tacliin iyo klinik ah oo loogu talagalay ardayda Terabka Shaqada ee u dhaxeeya xarumaha Teso iyo Nairobi laga bilaabo 13-ka Luulyo, 2026.

English: Nakuru County is providing specialized training for clinical officers and nurses to enhance mental health services. Healthcare providers are invited to participate in improving mental healthcare access.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Nakuru inatoa mafunzo maalum kwa maafisa wa afya na wauguzi ili kuboresha huduma za afya ya akili. Watoa huduma za afya wanakaribishwa kushiriki katika kuboresha upatikanaji wa huduma za afya ya akili.
Ekegusii: Kaunti ya Nakuru igenda oria inyarakire chirigori miyo na buya buorere buya buya obwakirori bwakorigo maagano. Abakire abakiigana bazerekuorere mukinyanuru oria bwanoni bwakibori bukhore.
Dholuo: Nakuru County en oloo ng'ato ma okel ratiro madhi kuom jowi gi neno kama odek golo mental health. Jowi mar ubut ma en konyo nyiso ng'ato to yudo yien mokuome kuom golo mental health.
Somali: Degmada Nakuru waxay bixineysaa tababar khaas ah oo lagu horumarinayo adeegyada caafimaadka maskaxda ee shaqaalaha caafimaadka iyo kalkaaliyeyaasha. Bixiyeyaasha adeegyada caafimaadka ayaa lagu casuumay inay ka qaybqaataan hagaajinta helitaanka daryeelka caafimaadka maskaxda.

English: The National Industrial Training Authority (NITA) Skills Show showcases student talent in fashion and other disciplines. Students and the public are encouraged to participate in this annual celebration of skills.
Kiswahili: Mamlaka ya Kitaifa ya Mafunzo ya Viwanda (NITA) inaonesha vipaji vya wanafunzi katika mitindo na taaluma nyingine. Wanafunzi na umma wanahimizwa kushiriki katika sherehe hii ya kila mwaka ya ujuzi.
Ekegusii: Abasinda b’Obwakire bwa NITA banochere omogaka gokire, abere abereki baisibete biano poria omogaka ogwakire bui omogeire naki. Abasinda naki omogaka abogenda bakenyori kwogenda bui ogenda ogwakire bui bwano.
Dholuo: National Industrial Training Authority (NITA) Skills Show eyo nyal dhiye piny kanyo e tich mar fashion kod joma ok nyal. Jaduong' nikech kama gi jopiny to nyalo jigwe e gin nyamre duto chuyoo.
Somali: Hay'adda Tababarka Warshadaha Qaranka (NITA) ayaa muujinaysa xirfadaha ardayda ee moodada iyo culuum kale. Ardayda iyo dadweynaha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan xafladdan sanadlaha ah ee xirfadaha.

English: 31 graduates from Kiambu National Polytechnic are departing for Germany for vocational training and jobs under the Kenya Germany Labour Mobility Programme.
Kiswahili: Wahitimu 31 kutoka Kiambu National Polytechnic wanaondoka kuelekea Ujerumani kwa mafunzo ya ufundi na kazi kwa mujibu wa Mpango wa Uhamaji wa Kazi kati ya Kenya na Ujerumani.
Ekegusii: Abagere 31 bano bakwenda kukiga Germany buya bwakire buya buori bw’ekibunganya kibe kiae Kenya Germany Labour Mobility Programme.
Dholuo: 31 joge mag Kiambu National Polytechnic osechoki kata Germany kuom tikh gi job mangenyi e Kenya Germany Labour Mobility Programme.
Somali: 31 ka qalinjebiyeyaal ah oo ka baxay Kiambu National Polytechnic ayaa u dhoofaya Jarmalka si ay u helaan tababaro xirfadeed iyo shaqooyinka hoosta Barnaamijka Is-muujinta Shaqada Kenya iyo Jarmalka.

English: Retired teachers in Kenya facing pension delays are urged to ensure all required documentation is complete to expedite their payments.
Kiswahili: Walimu waliostaafu nchini Kenya wanahimizwa kuhakikisha kwamba maandiko yote yanayohitajika yako kamili ili kuharakisha malipo yao ya pensheni.
Ekegusii: Abagere buya baki babwaki bwakira omokiri mu Kenya bataria naki bwiire bwaki bwerege buya bosi omobono bwanokirinaba kera baki buya bwokire obwakire bwabo.
Dholuo: Maboko konyi oket kanyige kwenyruok teso oket ne gima e nyinge guok e kaka oseto duto mar yieng' gi konyruok duto.
Somali: Macallimiinta hawlgabka ah ee Kenya ee wajahaya dib u dhac pension ayaa lagu boorinayaa inay hubiyaan in dhammaan dukumintiyada looga baahan yahay ay dhameystiran yihiin si ay u dedejiyaan lacagaha ay xaqa u leeyihiin.

English: Student teachers in Kenya are encouraged to engage actively with digital resources during their teaching practice while maintaining professional integrity and critical thinking skills.
Kiswahili: Walimu wapya nchini Kenya wanasisitizwa kushiriki kwa kiasi kikubwa na rasilimali za kidijitali wakati wa mazoezi yao ya kufundisha, wakidumisha uaminifu wa kitaaluma na ujuzi wa kufikiri kwa kina.
Ekegusii: Abanyigoti bage bokinyaki bwire bu ekega obookerere bwanaka bwaki bwetigere miki bisterture na egesia bwakirori na obokiri bu namunyu.
Dholuo: Awachina eka wacho kuom kwayoni kariboni e Kenya nyalo giyende gi digital resources mokwongo. Ninde oise kogo piny (professional integrity) gi miriu (critical thinking) ka osiwe.
Somali: Macallimiinta ardayda ee Kenya waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa in ay si firfircoon ula falgalaan kheyraadka dijitaalka ah intay ku jiraan tababarka waxbarashada, iyagoo ilaalinaya ixtiraamka xirfadeed iyo xirfadaha fikirka dhidibbada.

English: A new Early Childhood Development and Education (ECDE) center is now open in Ziwani, benefiting over 150 learners. This facility provides a safe and child-friendly environment for early education.
Kiswahili: Kituo kipya cha Maendeleo na Elimu ya Awali (ECDE) sasa kipo wazi Ziwani, kikinufaisha zaidi ya wanafunzi 150. Kituo hiki kinatoa mazingira salama na rafiki kwa watoto kwa ajili ya elimu ya awali.
Ekegusii: Ekirogo ekiri bwaki naki Early Childhood Development and Education (ECDE) kisomogori kirema kosi Ziwani, kinyorere abaki 150. Ekirogo kino kibe egosibori naki ekirogo ke bwaki bwaki bwakire abaki.
Dholuo: Kaka nyakiri ma okelo gi Early Childhood Development and Education (ECDE) center kendo e Ziwani, jopiny 150 marach. Nthiso en mwaki mag nyathi kendo oting' kendo ma okinyi chike mar nyathi.
Somali: Xarun cusub oo Horumarinta iyo Waxbarashada Carruurta (ECDE) ayaa hadda laga furay Ziwani, iyadoo ka faa’iidaysanaya in ka badan 150 arday. Fursadan waxay bixisaa deegaan amaan ah oo carruurtu ku takhasustaan waxbarashada hore.

English: Teachers are encouraged to focus on building trust, maintaining consistency, and fostering meaningful relationships in the classroom to enhance student engagement and learning outcomes.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanahimizwa kuzingatia kujenga uaminifu, kudumisha uthabiti, na kukuza mahusiano ya maana katika darasa ili kuboresha ushiriki wa wanafunzi na matokeo ya kujifunza.
Ekegusii: Abakora bajagani buse bwaki bwaki bwate naki, buse bwaki bwakoreng'ana buse bwate burosia buse bwasibasibwa mu ikisomo gose okugwenda omokireri na bosi bwanaka bwaki.
Dholuo: Wanano nyaka bedo kuom gindo kanyo, kuom neno chalo, e kendo osechung' maler mar nyim duong' e kendo golo koro yie e nyim joma kendo thuon ma wan joma.
Somali: Macalimiinta waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay diiradda saaraan dhisidda kalsoonida, sugidda joogtaynta, iyo kor u qaadista xiriir macno leh gudaha fasalka si loo xoojiyo ka qaybgalka ardayda iyo natiijooyinka waxbarasho.

English: Mr. Simon Ongaga from St. Joseph Nyabigena High School has been appointed as the Nyanza Region Referees Instructor by the Football Kenya Federation. This role will enhance soccer talent development in the region.
Kiswahili: Bw. Simon Ongaga kutoka Shule ya Sekondari ya Mtakatifu Yosefu Nyabigena amepewa nafasi ya Mfundisha wa Waamuzi wa Mkoa wa Nyanza na Shirikisho la Soka Kenya. Majukumu haya yatasaidia kukuza talanta ya soka katika mkoa.
Ekegusii: Mr. Simon Ongaga gwekore ebu St. Joseph Nyabigena High School omokiri ekegero Nyanza Region Referees Instructor naki Football Kenya Federation. Omochamo ogenda otwere omotigo okokire mu naki chimbibori.
Dholuo: Mzee Simon Ongaga ochok nyaka weche wuon St. Joseph Nyabigena High School ni yuok gi Referees Instructor mar Nyanza. Weche yieyo e yo ma onge nyaka joma okel kendo joma nyari e duto mar buu ma nyakach.
Somali: Mr. Simon Ongaga oo ka socda Dugsiga Sare ee St. Joseph Nyabigena ayaa loo magacaabay Macallinka Tijaabada Garsoorayaasha Gobolka Nyanza ee Xisbiga Kubadda Cagta Soomaaliya. Doorkan wuxuu kordhin doonaa horumarinta hibada kubadda cagta gobolka.

English: The Ministry of Education has reshuffled principals across several national polytechnics; affected institutions should prepare for the changes and incoming leaders.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu imebadilisha wakuu wa shule katika vyuo vikuu vingi vya kitaifa; taasisi zilizoathirika zinapaswa kujiandaa kwa mabadiliko na viongozi wapya wanaoingia.
Ekegusii: Obwakire bw'Elimu buyaire buyaire buyaire omokinyani bosi bw'ekoroseri; eng'ogoti omokinyani baagorani bwanakirio buyaire buyaire nakiing'ana.
Dholuo: Kod Ministry of Education oter chunya wahindogo e tinde manyien; maik gi yore kendo kendo ma gin jorito ma ng'wech.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ayaa dib-u-habayn ku samaysay madaxda jaamacadaha qaranka; hay'adaha ay saameysay waa inay isu diyaariyaan isbeddellada iyo hogaamiyeyaasha cusub.

English: Kenyan health professionals can explore overseas employment opportunities in Germany through KMTC's new partnership. Graduates are encouraged to participate in this initiative for career advancement.
Kiswahili: Wataalamu wa afya nchini Kenya wanaweza kuchunguza fursa za ajira za kigeni nchini Ujerumani kupitia ushirikiano mpya wa KMTC. Wahitimu wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mpango huu kwa ajili ya maendeleo ya kazi zao.
Ekegusii: Abakinyakare bakiingira bwereki busechukire bwensomba bu Germany buhoro bwaki BWAKI's bwebokire. Abakinyanagi bakesenyegeke bakenye bwereki busechenyangi aburere.
Dholuo: Ababukaji mar kenyani nyinge owacho e dholuo kamano ni tigi modhiero kendo kanyango e jamni matek kuom KMTC owach. Wuon mipango wan timo ng'ato kuom gi nyako ma wach gima jomoko.
Somali: Xirfadlayaasha caafimaadka ee Kenya waxay baari karaan fursadaha shaqo ee dibadda ee Jarmalka iyada oo loo marayo iskaashiga cusub ee KMTC. Qalinjebiyeyaasha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan talaabadan si ay u horumariyaan xirfadooda.

English: Kaimosi Friends National Polytechnic has launched a mentorship program for trainees to build life skills and resilience. All students are encouraged to participate in these empowerment sessions.
Kiswahili: Kaimosi Friends National Polytechnic imezindua mpango wa ukaribu kwa wanafunzi kujenga ujuzi wa maisha na uvumulivu. Wanafunzi wote wanahimizwa kushiriki katika vikao hivi vya uwezeshaji.
Ekegusii: Kaimosi Friends National Polytechnic oreyirete programu ya ngo'ano buya buya bwanogoti kiko obokirori bwaki na gochaki. Abogisyo bosi batosia bushanganga munchindo iyi.
Dholuo: Kaimosi Friends National Polytechnic abich gi program moko ma okonyo kuom trainees kuonde gi chike mar matendo. Waseche mag adiera omedruok kuom this empowerment sessions.
Somali: Kaimosi Friends National Polytechnic waxay bilawday barnaamij hanuunineed oo loogu talagalay ardayda si ay u dhisaan xirfadaha nolosha iyo adkeysiga. Dhammaan ardayda ayaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka qaybqaataan kalfadhiyada tayada kor u qaadeya.

English: Taita Taveta County is developing a Child Care Policy to establish formal Child Care Centres for children under four years. Stakeholders are encouraged to stay informed on this initiative.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Taita Taveta inakunda Sera ya Uangalizi wa Watoto ili kuanzisha Kituo rasmi cha Utunzaji wa Watoto kwa watoto chini ya miaka minne. Wadau wanahimizwa kubaki na taarifa kuhusu juhudi hii.
Ekegusii: Omosome Taita Taveta etare ogenda nakiya oseriania burokire burokire buseketi bwakiri bwaseta burokire bwabere bora tsibori naki. Abakire bitwaki obwaki nabwaki bwakiri burokire burokire.
Dholuo: Kaunti ya Taita Taveta ikenyere kuonge gi polisi mar chike mar watoto kuom kuomni chike manore uyweyo sa chike mabor. Miyo ma duto noyie kuok kod jopiny nojong' e juogi maneno.
Somali: Degmada Taita Taveta waxay horumarinaysaa siyaasadda Daryeelka Carruurta si loo aasaaso Xarumo Daryeel Carruur oo rasmi ah oo loogu talagalay carruurta ka yar afar sano. kuwa danaynaya waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay la socdaan howshan.

English: The University of Nairobi aims to restore staff unity and improve its reputation under new Vice-Chancellor Prof. Ayub Gitau's leadership.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Nairobi kinakusudia kurejesha umoja wa wafanyakazi na kuboresha sifa yake chini ya uongozi wa Makamu Mkuu wa Chuo, Prof. Ayub Gitau.
Ekegusii: Yagano ya Nairobi igenda kogeria bwakire bwaki abaki na kwongere buya bwayo kiongori bwaki Vice-Chancellor prof. Ayub Gitau.
Dholuo: Yong' Osieno wuod Nairobi nyal-rayi gi choro motegno kendo nigi mbaka bende ka nyinge gi ma nyasa ni Vice-Chancellor Prof. Ayub Gitau.
Somali: Jaamacadda Nairobi waxay ujeedadeeda tahay in dib u soo celiso midnimada shaqaalaha iyo hagaajinta sumcadeeda hoos tagta hogaaminta cusub ee Kulliyadaha, Prof. Ayub Gitau.

English: TVET institutions are urged to enhance student recruitment campaigns to address declining enrolment. Principals should actively promote their programs to attract more students.
Kiswahili: Taasisi za TVET zinahimizwa kuimarisha kampeni za kuandikisha wanafunzi ili kukabiliana na upungufu wa wanafunzi. Wakuu wanapaswa kukuza kwa nguvu mipango yao ili kuvutia wanafunzi zaidi.
Ekegusii: Makanisa ya TVET nakiagigwa kugikore masibori ya kubwaki kosi ya wakiireri kutenda igokorokere nakiato gochaki. Abashikori bakanisa nakiagigwa okugina bwaki bwabwe kutenda wakiireri bigee.
Dholuo: TVET kanyo nyis mar tini kuom nyakanyre niwuonde kuom puonji piny to osetwogo ndolo. Jotich kende noloo chike mauruok kuom nyasaye motenyo.
Somali: Hay'adaha TVET ayaa lagu boorinayaa inay xoojiyaan ololayaasha qabsashada ardayda si wax looga qabto hoos u dhaca tirada diiwaangelinta. Madaxdhaqameedka waa in ay si firfircoon u xayeysiiyaan barnaamijkooda si ay arday badan u soo jiitaan.

English: African universities are encouraged to unify branding and academic standards to enhance global visibility. Collaboration is vital for recognition of academic qualifications across the continent.
Kiswahili: Vyuoni vya Afrika vinahimizwa kuungana katika uuzaji na viwango vya elimu ili kuboresha mwonekano wa kimataifa. Ushirikiano ni muhimu kwa kutambuliwa kwa sifa za kitaaluma kote barani.
Ekegusii: Masomo ya Afrika ikoreriere gwabogori bwaki naki khwakire ya masomo. Kugendana ikorori naki buya moekorera emanyere omokirori ya masomo mo Afrika.
Dholuo: Jano mar’Afrika bende en jied ego mar branding gi chalo kanyo kata jithinyo to wachni e sa. Kanyim ni gima yieng’ kadhi, bwachni ma jothinyo wegi kanyakla e Afrika.
Somali: Jaamacadaha Afrika waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay isku mid yihiin sumad iyo heerar waxbarasho si ay u kordhiyaan muuqaalka caalamiga ah. Iskaashigu waa muhiim si aqoonsi loo helo shahaadooyinka waxbarasho ee qaaradda.

English: The Teachers Service Commission has finalized the July 2026 payroll for over 400,000 teachers; salary payments will proceed, but details on Collective Bargaining Agreement increments are still pending.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma za Walimu imemaliza malipo ya mishahara ya Julai 2026 kwa walimu zaidi ya 400,000; malipo ya mishahara yataendelea, lakini maelezo kuhusu nyongeza za Makubaliano ya Pamoja yanaendelea kusubiriwa.
Ekegusii: Komishini ya Abere bu Kiagene buona igwadaraki ya Julai 2026 ya abere 400,000. Ahera buaboki ataranya, asi buya bu ng'ogeti bu Kogaki bu Aria bu Waki omena giuga.
Dholuo: Teachers Service Commission nopono ma July 2026 payroll ciclo kata 400,000 nyasaye; nyamre kumpe ni tich ok nyal ng'eyo, lakini mago mar Collective Bargaining Agreement g'iyo kendo nyalo ter.
Somali: Guddiga Adeegga Macalimiinta ayaa dhammaystiray mushaharka bisha Luulyo 2026 ee ka badan 400,000 macallin; lacagaha mushaharka ayaa bilaaban doona, laakiin faahfaahinta kordhinta Heshiiska Isku-xidhka ayaa weli sugaysa.

English: This announcement is for a tragic event affecting King David Junior School in Uganda, where a bus accident resulted in 21 fatalities, including 20 pupils. Please ensure the safety of students during outings and adhere to all road safety guidelines.
Kiswahili: Tangaza hili ni kuhusu tukio la kusikitisha linalohusisha Shule ya Msingi ya Mfalme David Junior nchini Uganda, ambapo ajali ya basi ilisababisha vifo vya watu 21, ikiwa ni pamoja na wanafunzi 20. Tafadhali hakikisha usalama wa wanafunzi wakati wa matembezi na ufuate taratibu zote za usalama barabarani.
Ekegusii: Ongorori ino naki ekerori eria osibori oreka ogokore King David Junior School ebwetane Uganda, omogaka naki bus igotaka oreke obwakore 21, omokinyore omokinyete 20. Naki okore omokinyete obwakore nubwakire emesia okenye na oriona bwaki obwiru bwokire.
Dholuo: Okwong' ni gima en joma goro ma ng'ato to gima oket tak ka King David Junior School e Uganda. Kanyo gima ochung' bus oweyo to 21 joge ni 20 ma en puoch. Nyasaye chuo chiko kuom gima timo ni wathogni puoch e tere mag joma ochak gi ngero ma ok otimo.
Somali: Ogeysiiskan waxa uu quseeyaa dhacdo murugo leh oo ka dhacday Iskuulka King David Junior ee Uganda, halkaas oo shil bas ah uu sababay in 21 qof ku dhintaan, oo ay ku jiraan 20 arday. Fadlan hubi badbaadada ardayda inta lagu guda jiro safarada una hoggaansan dhammaan tilmaamaha badbaadada waddooyinka.

English: Attention university students: Under the new Variable Scholarship and Loan Funding (VSLF) model, financial support is categorized into Bands 1-5 based on need. Ensure your eligibility is assessed through the Means Testing Instrument (MTI) to determine your funding level.
Kiswahili: Tafadhali wanafunzi wa chuo: K chini ya mfano mpya wa Ruzuku na Mkopo wa Mabadiliko (VSLF), msaada wa kifedha umeainishwa katika Makundi 1-5 kulingana na mahitaji. Hakikisha kwamba sifa yako inathaminiwa kupitia Kibadilisha Kuthamini (MTI) ili kubaini kiwango chako cha ufadhili.
Ekegusii: Abaki bwakire bw'amasomo: Kwenye mwaki omogenda wa Variable Scholarship and Loan Funding (VSLF), eng'endo y'ebyogombwa ibwanisire mu Banda 1-5 ngokwogena. Egakure naki ogotung'ana naki bw'eng'endo yane ikonyorere (MTI) kukwogana dakania bwang'ena.
Dholuo: Mokinyi gi chike iloso: Kaka wan gi kachieny e nyim Mar bedo gi Chenro gi Ngeche (VSLF), chike mag riek owacho mag chuny puodho ni Band 1-5 nyaka long' nyaka joma. Nyisawa ng'ama udi maduong' e ji Machuok Kiwruok (MTI) mondo wachi maboro ma chike mag ng'ato.
Somali: Digniinta ardayda jaamacadaha: Habka cusub ee Maalgelinta Deeqda iyo Amaahda Isban, taageerada maaliyadeed waxaa loo qaybiyay qaybaha 1-5 iyadoo lagu saleynayo baahida. Hubi in lagu qiimeeyo shuruudahaaga adigoo isticmaalaya Qalabka Imtixaanka Kharashka (MTI) si loo go'aamiyo heerkaaga maalgelin.

English: School management committees are urged to support scouting clubs to develop discipline and life skills among students.
Kiswahili: Kamati za usimamizi wa shule zinasisitizwa kusaidia vilabu vya utafutaji ili kuendeleza nidhamu na ujuzi wa maisha miongoni mwa wanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Abaki bwakire busekwana bategana naki batarakuri kushirikiana nabana batarakuri bururi bwere bwaki bobiori na buinokire buno bwaki.
Dholuo: Koech mandu gi chike mag shule nochung' to abir gi scouting clubs kendo omiya discipline kod pachi kendo kuom wende.
Somali: Guddiyada maareynta dugsiyada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay taageeraan kooxaha baarista si ay u horumariyaan anshaxa iyo xirfadaha nolosha ardayda.

English: Parklands Baptist School has seven days to revoke the recently implemented 14.5% fee increase or face legal action from parents and guardians.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Baptist Parklands ina siku saba kukatisha ongezeko la ada la asilimia 14.5 lililoanzishwa hivi karibuni au kukabiliwa na hatua za kisheria kutoka kwa wazazi na walezi.
Ekegusii: Parklands Baptist School ina masaa ang'anya nane ekare omokungi omokire abwaki buya buya 14.5% naki buya omogenda naki abaki na aoga.
Dholuo: Parklands Baptist School en koro ng'ama owacho 14.5% doho mar fee owuon, to e chieng' abich nigi, ma en kido kik ma gin jaruo gi chike gi ohero.
Somali: Iskuulka Parklands Baptist wuxuu haystaa toddoba maalmood oo uu ka joojiyo korodhka dhibcaha ah ee 14.5% la bilaabay ama la kulmi doono mid ka mid ah wakiilada waalidka iyo daryeelayaasha.

English: The Uzalendo Half Marathon aims to raise KSh100 million for scholarships for academically gifted but financially disadvantaged learners. Join the nationwide fundraising effort to support education.
Kiswahili: Uzalendo Half Marathon inakusudia kukusanya KSh100 milioni kwa ajili ya elimu ya wasomi wenye uwezo lakini wanakabiliwa na changamoto za kifedha. Jiunge na juhudi hizi za kitaifa za ukusanyaji fedha kusaidia elimu.
Ekegusii: Uzalendo Half Marathon inagashanire KSh100 million naki naki kikuching’anya bwire bujire na ogendani pyeng’ana naki niboka boke mwaki obwaki bwaki. Ria bung’ana bwogenda obong’ana.
Dholuo: Uzalendo Half Marathon inyo kuom wachore KSh100 milioni kuom chiegni manyien ma ok eluo ma oting' golo. Kende gi fundraising ka ok stoko eyo chieh.
Somali: Uzalendo Half Marathon waxa uu leeyahay ujeeddo ah in la ururiyo KSh100 million si loogu taageero deeqo waxbarasho ardayda aqoonta leh ee dhaqaale ahaan danyarta ah. Ku soo biir ololaha lacag ururinta ee qaranka si aad u taageerto waxbarashada.

English: Public secondary school principals will be summoned by the National Assembly to account for the management of capitation funds. Be prepared to provide evidence on financial records and compliance issues.
Kiswahili: Madarasa ya sekondari ya umma yatakabiliwa na wito kutoka Bunge la Kitaifa ili kuweza kufafanua kuhusu usimamizi wa fedha za capitation. Jiandae kutoa ushahidi kuhusu rekodi za kifedha na masuala ya kufuata sheria.
Ekegusii: Abanyaki bwiikere buya bw'amasomo bataroka ebeere bwiikere buya bw'ibwaki bota bwi'ekirogo. Makiere ogore omogori bw'omeria bonda bw'akiri bwakire buya naki k'waki bw'oyagano bw'endogori.
Dholuo: Okwanyono mar jango abich puburu maber bende oser piny National Assembly manyiso chieg mar kapitasheni. Nyalo ngʼeyo to golo ngʼwono e chieg mar ifuondo kendo joma kanyo.
Somali: Madaxda dugsiyada sare ee dadweynaha ayaa lagu casuumay Golaha Qaranka si ay ula xisaabtaan maamulka lacagaha capitation. Diyaar u noqo inaad bixiso cadeymo ku saabsan diiwaannada maaliyadeed iyo arrimaha waafaqsanaanta.

English: Young people are urged to embrace open dialogue and self-discipline in challenging situations. Violence is not a solution; communicate with your parents to prevent tragedies.
Kiswahili: Vijana wanahimizwa kukumbatia mazungumzo ya wazi na kujidhibiti katika hali ngumu. Vviolence si suluhisho; wasiliana na wazazi wako ili kuzuia majanga.
Ekegusii: Abakire bakiire baneqe omokinyani omokihorori na obwakire bwokwania mu nakiire karorire. Omokinyani si ng’eno; oria bosi bosi na bakirinji batoroto orogoya obokwiyorie.
Dholuo: Ojuma gi yore ka ng'ato nyal kata miyo. Nasi ningo chalo; to kanyono gi tuo ni yore ma ok nyal ketho.
Somali: Dhallinyarada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay qaataan wada hadal furan iyo is xakameyn xaaladaha adag. Rabshaddu xal ma ahan; la xidhiidh waalidkaaga si aad uga hortagto masiibooyinka.

English: The bell at Nasokol Primary School serves as a vital timekeeper for students, ringing at 5:00 p.m. to signal boarders and day scholars to prepare for lessons.
Kiswahili: Kengele katika Shule ya Msingi ya Nasokol inatumika kama kiongozi wa muda kwa wanafunzi, ikilia saa 11:00 jioni kuwatangazia wanafunzi wa bweni na wa siku kujiandaa kwa masomo.
Ekegusii: Emucheri buya bu Nasokol Primary School emogori obwakire omokirori bwabaki, bwokire buya bwakire 5:00 p.m. bwokire abaki boibori na abaki babwaki botiige omokirori.
Dholuo: Belo mar Nasokol Primary School nyalo chier kago mar thuon, oyuegi kaka 5:00 p.m. kuom joge ariyeko kendo joge chon gi tiyo mar thuon.
Somali: Baalka Dugsiga Hoose ee Nasokol wuxuu yahay qalab muhiim ah oo waqti gooya ardayda, wuxuu dhankaa karayaa 5:00 galabnimo si uu u muujiyo ardayda dekedda iyo kuwa maalinlaha ah inay is diyaariyaan casharrada.

English: Youth are encouraged to embrace Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) for self-reliance and job opportunities. Skills in trades are essential for independence and income stability.
Kiswahili: Vijana wanahimizwa kupokea Elimu na Mafunzo ya Ufundi na Ufundi Stadi (TVET) kwa ajili ya kujitegemea na fursa za ajira. Ujuzi katika amali ni muhimu kwa uhuru na uthabiti wa mapato.
Ekegusii: Omosome bwakire bonyang'ane obwakire na Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) buya kosi bwakiita bweng'ari bwake na obokire. Egokiriri mu obwakire buya bwakire buya buya enkindiri na emosi.
Dholuo: Sikire ma wendo ineno ka wato gi Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) oketh ler kende kendo nyaka matek. Konyo gi piny ma oket kama ineno chalo kendo wende kaka.
Somali: Dhallinyarada waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay qaataan Waxbarashada Farsamada iyo Tababbarka Xirfadaha (TVET) si ay u noqdaan kuwo madaxbannaan oo ay shaqo u helaan. Xirfadaha ganacsiga waa muhiim si loo gaadho madax-bannaanida iyo xasilloonida dakhliga.

English: Homa Bay County Junior Secondary Schools football championship will take place at Mbita National School from July 15-19, 2026. Participating teams must maintain discipline and punctuality.
Kiswahili: Mashindano ya soka ya shule za upili za Mkoa wa Homa Bay yatafanyika katika Shule ya Kitaifa ya Mbita kuanzia Julai 15-19, 2026. Timu zinazoshiriki zinapaswa kudumisha nidhamu na kuwa wastaarabu.
Ekegusii: Ogendi bw’erebu bw’osekene bw’omereri bu Homa Bay County buokorie bu Mbita National School bu na Jiga 15-19, 2026. Abakereri bakenye tobuya okwigana na orere.
Dholuo: Championship mar nyiego kuom Junior Secondary Schools e Homa Bay County bende okonyo e Mbita National School manok bende e yo 15-19, 2026. Tim mar yawuok nyaka oter gi migiem.
Somali: Tartanka kubadda cagta ee dugsiyada hoose ee Homa Bay County ayaa ka dhici doona Iskuulka Qaranka ee Mbita laga bilaabo Luulyo 15 ilaa 19, 2026. Kooxaha ka qayb galaya waa inay ilaaliyaan anshax iyo waqtiga.

English: Universities are now issuing admission letters to students placed by KUCCPS for the 2026/2027 academic year. Successful applicants should visit their university's official website to access their admission documents.
Kiswahili: Chuo kikuu sasa kinatoa barua za kujiunga kwa wanafunzi waliowekwa na KUCCPS kwa mwaka wa masomo 2026/2027. Wanafunzi waliofanikiwa wanapaswa kutembelea tovuti rasmi ya chuo chao kupata hati zao za kujiunga.
Ekegusii: Abere oria bwire bategereere buya banaki bendorori bulongori yawa KUCCPS mwaki wa 2026/2027. Abaki bano bagenyia buya bakenya besibori buya bwaki bwsomere.
Dholuo: Univierisiti nyaka kujiwogi admission letters ma students kanyo gi KUCCPS kuom mwaka wa masomo 2026/2027. Joma wawinjo chiegni ochung' moloyo ku ugenyuni gi website ma univierisiti.
Somali: Jaamacadaha waxay hadda bixiyaan warqadaha aqbalaadda ardayda uu KUCCPS ku talinayso sanadka tacliinta 2026/2027. Ardayda guulaysatay waa in ay booqdaan website-ka rasmiga ah ee jaamacaddooda si ay u helaan dukumentiyada aqbalaadda.

English: Parents in Nandi County are urged to be vigilant regarding child safety due to rising incidents of suspected sodomy. Strengthen child protection measures and report any concerns immediately.
Kiswahili: Wazazi katika Kaunti ya Nandi wanashauriwa kuwa makini kuhusu usalama wa watoto kutokana na kuongezeka kwa matukio ya kutuhumiwa sodomy. Imarisha hatua za ulinzi wa watoto na ripoti yeyote ya wasiwasi mara moja.
Ekegusii: Baba na mama baki Nandi County, mugosi naki omokiri ogokiri buya oreki boki bwikire bwaki omokiri bwaka bute naki bokia boki bware. Mokaetebwaki bwene omogori buya naki ogosi otisi omokireri.
Dholuo: Isechi ma Nandi County, wakuo kod leyo mar watoto kata kata to kendo wachoni mar sodomy otieno nyaka. Pinyu leyo mar ochron mar watoto kendo tere yie kendo iweyo ji nyaka.
Somali: Waalidiinta degmada Nandi waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay taxadar ka muujiyaan badbaadada carruurtooda sababa la xiriira kordhinta dhacdooyinka la tuhunsan yahay ee sodomy. Xoojiyo tallaabooyinka ilaalinta carruurta oo wargeli wixii walwal ah isla markiiba.

English: KUPPET regional elections are set for August 21, 2026. Nomination papers and fees (Ksh 20,000 to Ksh 50,000) must be submitted by August 15, 2026.
Kiswahili: uchaguzi wa KUPPET wa mikoa umepangwa kufanyika tarehe 21 Agosti 2026. Karatasi za uteuzi na ada (Ksh 20,000 hadi Ksh 50,000) zinapaswa kuwasilishwa kabla ya tarehe 15 Agosti 2026.
Ekegusii: Electsheni za KUPPET zijabuya kuora 21, 2026. Abatere bakananaki naki omokongeri (Ksh 20,000 mpaka Ksh 50,000) buya buya mini 15, 2026.
Dholuo: Nying' konyo yien KUPPET ng'ato are tich mar August 21, 2026. Kuing'ni chalo mar ng'ato mamoko (Ksh 20,000 to Ksh 50,000) owuon to ok nibedh ng'ato ka August 15, 2026.
Somali: Doorashada goboleedka KUPPET waxay qorshaysan tahay 21-ka Agoosto, 2026. Warqadaha musharaxnimada iyo khidmadaha (Ksh 20,000 ilaa Ksh 50,000) waa in la soo gudbiyaa kahor 15-ka Agoosto, 2026.

English: KUCCPS is offering free career guidance services at the Kenyatta International Convention Centre (KICC) in Nairobi for students preparing for university, TVET, and college admissions.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inatoa huduma za bure za mwongozo wa kazi katika Kituo cha Mikutano cha Kimataifa cha Kenyatta (KICC) mjini Nairobi kwa wanafunzi wanaojiandaa kwa ajili ya kujiunga na chuo kikuu, TVET, na vyuo.
Ekegusii: KUCCPS igenda buya gereka bwakire bwokireri buya bweng'endo bwakarumba ku Kenyatta International Convention Centre (KICC) mu Nairobi buya bwakire abana bakanoka bara gechama ku mayaka, TVET, na koleji.
Dholuo: KUCCPS owa gi thonno mar kariere maber kuom students ma en kod gi univasi, TVET, gi college admissions e Kenyatta International Convention Centre (KICC) Nairobi.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay bixineysaa adeegyo bilaash ah oo talooyin shaqo ah oo ka socda Xarunta Shirarka Caalamiga ah ee Kenyatta (KICC) ee Nairobi, ardayda diyarinaysa gelitaanka jaamacadaha, TVET, iyo kulliyadaha.

English: Masinde Muliro University of Science and Technology is hosting a Summer School on disaster risk management from July 13 to July 17, 2026. Interested participants should register now.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Masinde Muliro cha Sayansi na Teknolojia kinakaribisha Shule ya Majira ya Joto kuhusu usimamizi wa hatari za majanga kuanzia Julai 13 hadi Julai 17, 2026. Washiriki wenye hamu wanapaswa kujiandikisha sasa.
Ekegusii: Masinde Muliro University of Science and Technology igogogoya Summer School eya disaster risk management eikire buya July 13 kosi July 17, 2026. Abaki bataria igogoya bosi bange bwerane.
Dholuo: Masinde Muliro University of Science and Technology ng'eyo joma chalo kendo gi nindgi chiew gi mang'wonj piny konyo higa odoko 13 to 17, 2026. Joma weche ni chon mag tich kare to ginyalo kita.
Somali: Jaamacadda Masinde Muliro ee Sayniska iyo Tiknoolajiyada waxay qabaneysaa Dugsiga Xagaaga ee maareynta khataraha masiibooyinka laga bilaabo 13ka ilaa 17ka Luulyo, 2026. Ka qaybgalayaasha xiiseynaya waa in ay hadda isdiiwaangeliyaan.

English: All Western Region teams participating in the 2026 KSSSA National Games must assemble at Kakamega School on July 26 and depart for Thika on July 27. Ensure travel arrangements are made in advance.
Kiswahili: Timu zote za Mkoa wa Magharibi zinazoshiriki Michezo ya Kitaifa ya KSSSA 2026 zinapaswa kukutana katika Shule ya Kakamega tarehe 26 Julai na kuondoka kuelekea Thika tarehe 27 Julai. Hakikisha mipango ya usafiri imefanywa mapema.
Ekegusii: Abakare buya buki na Nyasa 2026 KSSSA National Games bakenya buya ka Kakamega School ng’enda July 26 na batoroge buya Thika July 27. Naki buya bwateka omogori bwa mbere.
Dholuo: Nyathinyi kanyanza masa Western Region ma en kany ni biro oting’ e 2026 KSSSA National Games, watiyogo e Kakamega School, nyakito 26 rombore gi oketo e Thika, nyaka 27 rombore. Chiek chalo bura mar pao en ka nyaka otang’ ki samaki.
Somali: Dhammaan kooxaha Gobolka Galbeed ee ka qaybgalaya Ciyaaraha Qaranka KSSSA 2026 waa inay ku soo ururaan Iskuulka Kakamega 26ka Luulyo una baxaan Thika 27ka Luulyo. Hubi in diyaarinta safarka la sameeyo ka hor.

English: Students are encouraged to embrace Physics and other STEM subjects to aid Kenya's industrialization and innovation efforts. Engage in practical learning and explore opportunities in these fields.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanahimizwa kupokea Fizikia na masomo mengine ya STEM ili kusaidia juhudi za viwanda na uvumbuzi nchini Kenya. Jihusishe na kujifunza kwa vitendo na gundua fursa katika nyanja hizi.
Ekegusii: Abakinyang'ania batarere oikinyi Physics na eng'ogoti STEM buya bwekore buya bwakeri bwanatea bwokinyang'ania na buya bwororere. Kiora mu miorokoni oigoti naki akore omong'anya buya buse.
Dholuo: Wang'ni opogore konyo Physics ne masomo ma en STEM e chiemo osethano Kenya. Tego e piny gi tich mar juoyo kendo weche e yo ma en mondo obet.
Somali: Studentiga waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay qaatan Fiisigiska iyo maadooyinka kale ee STEM si ay gacan uga geystaan ​​warshadaynta iyo hal-abuurka Kenya. Ka qayb qaado barashada wax ku oolka ah oo sahami fursadaha ka jira meelahaan.

English: Teachers in Transmara West are invited to participate in the inaugural Transmara West Teachers' Sports Tournament on Sunday, July 19, 2026, at Kilgoris Boys Playing Ground to promote mental wellness and fitness.
Kiswahili: Teachers kutoka Transmara Magharibi wanakaribishwa kushiriki katika Mashindano ya Michezo ya Walimu ya Transmara Magharibi yatakayofanyika Jumapili, Julai 19, 2026, katika Uwanja wa Michezo wa Kilgoris Boys ili kukuza ustawi wa akili na ufanisi wa mwili.
Ekegusii: Abakire bosi baki Transmara West basemeke bwebwaki omokiri ogwenda mwango ogwende omokiri Transmara West Teachers' Sports Tournament bw'ogenda ku Nakiiri, Nyakoto 19, 2026, ku Kilgoris Boys Playing Ground bw'ogikinyora omokore omogendi na orogotenda.
Dholuo: Walimu ka Transmara West en ng’ato kuom yieng’ kuom Transmara West Teachers' Sports Tournament magi mar juma, July 19, 2026, e Kilgoris Boys Playing Ground kuom konyruok mentale e dhoot.
Somali: Macallimiinta Transmara West ayaa lagu casuumay inay ka qeyb galaan tartanka isboortiga macallimiinta ee ugu horreeya oo ka dhici doona Axadda, 19-ka Luulyo, 2026, goobta ciyaaraha ee Kilgoris Boys si loo dhiirrigeliyo caafimaadka maskaxda iyo fayoqab.

English: Grade 10 and Form Three learners at Thika High School will be released early for their August holiday on July 21, 2026, at 7 AM. Parents must arrange safe transport for their children.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa Kidato cha Kumi na Kidato cha Tatu katika Shule ya Sekondari ya Thika wataruhusiwa kutoka mapema kwa likizo ya Agosti tarehe 21 Julai, 2026, saa moja asubuhi. Wazazi wanapaswa kupanga usafiri salama kwa watoto wao.
Ekegusii: Abaki bwa Grade 10 na Form Three bu Thika High School bwakire magusi bw'otagwania omogori bw'oro jogi bwa Agasti bwakire 21, 2026, bukinyasa 7 za mioro. Ababere bobogori bagire omogori ogwakire bw'otang'ana bw'abaki babo.
Dholuo: Wang'ni 10 kod Form Three mar Thika High School bende en gi duong' ng'ato kare August ochako e July 21, 2026, e 7 AM. Pende mawuok gi tich bende ni miluoch mokwongo kuom chao kagi.
Somali: Ardayda fasalka 10-aad iyo foomka 3-aad ee Dugsiga Sare ee Thika ayaa si hore loogu sii daayay fasaxa August 21, 2026, saacadu markay tahay 7 subaxnimo. Waalidiintu waa inay diyaariyaan gaadiid ammaan ah oo carruurtooda loogu keeno.

English: Public universities are facing a KSh28 billion funding crisis. Students, parents, and staff should be aware of potential impacts on university operations and quality of education.
Kiswahili: Chuo kikuu cha umma kinakabiliwa na mgogoro wa ufadhili wa KSh28 bilioni. Wanafunzi, wazazi, na wafanyakazi wanapaswa kufahamu athari zinazoweza kutokea kwenye shughuli za chuo na ubora wa elimu.
Ekegusii: Masomu ma public naki kanibori ka funding ka KSh28 billion. Abasomori, abamwaki, na abakochi bakenye ore kire kiring'ana kiong'endi koka masomu na obokire bwaki.
Dholuo: Mokoro mar pubilc ni yo KSh28 billion magi. Wuon gi ji, gin chuno, gi staff deber gi timo kenyoni kanyo ka omiyo ji kuom nyasi mar kenyoni kod thum mar masomo.
Somali: Jaamacadaha dadweynaha ayaa wajahaya dhibaato Dhaqaale oo gaaraysa KSh28 bilyan. Ardayda, waalidiinta, iyo shaqaalaha waa inay ka warqabaan saameynta suurtagalka ah ee ku imaan karta howlaha jaamacadda iyo tayada waxbarashada.

English: Tenwek High School in Bomet County will hold its Speech and Prize Giving Day on Saturday, July 18, featuring the unveiling of two new buses to enhance student transport.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Sekondari ya Tenwek katika Kaunti ya Bomet itafanya siku ya Hotuba na Kutilia mkazo tuzo siku ya Jumamosi, Julai 18, ikiwa na uzinduzi wa mabasi mawili mapya kuboresha usafiri wa wanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Tenwek Secondary School mu Bomet County ikorera omokigori na Ore Bokone bwaki bwa oria, Omoseru, Okore 18, ogokirwa busebu bwa mbili bushindani bwaki bwaki bwakurire omwenda bwaki.
Dholuo: Tenwek High School chike Bomet County okonyore kendo bura ma yo jomoko e konyo, nyaka juma, July 18, kaka yiengi gi weng' bus abich abiro golo mi bunde joma.
Somali: Dugsiga Sare ee Tenwek ee ku yaal Gobolka Bomet ayaa qabanqaabinaya Maalinta Khudbadda iyo Abaalmarinta Sabtida, Juuly 18, iyadoo lagu soo bandhigi doono laba bas oo cusub si kor loogu qaado gaadiidka ardayda.

English: The Kakuyuni Digital Hub is now open, providing access to digital skills training, online jobs, and e-government services for Kakuyuni residents. Take advantage of these resources today!
Kiswahili: Kituo cha Kijidigitali cha Kakuyuni sasa kiko wazi, kikitoa mafunzo ya ujuzi wa dijitali, kazi za mtandaoni, na huduma za serikali mtandaoni kwa wakazi wa Kakuyuni. Tumia rasilimali hizi leo!
Ekegusii: Kakuyuni Digital Hub oregire, oja omokiriri bw'ogotegera, bujimbo bwa inyanja, na masomo e-government ku bakuruki ba Kakuyuni. Naki bw'oge oregia ogotegere bu!
Dholuo: Kakuyuni Digital Hub osebedo, nikech okelo kuom joma kendo fi chuo digital, kazi mar online, mathoth e-government mar joma Kakuyuni. Kony kanyasa ka weche manok!
Somali: Hubka Dijitaalka ah ee Kakuyuni ayaa hadda furan, isagoo siinaya dadka deggan Kakuyuni tababaro xirfadeed dijitaal ah, shaqooyin khadka tooska ah, iyo adeegyo e-gov. Ka faa'iidayso khayraadkan maanta!

English: Over 400 girls from local primary schools participated in a STEM Bootcamp at Siyoi Comprehensive School on July 16, 2026. Join efforts to encourage girls in STEM and related fields.
Kiswahili: Zaidi ya wasichana 400 kutoka shule za msingi za mtaa walishiriki katika Bootcamp ya STEM katika Shule ya Siyoi Comprehensive tarehe 16 Julai 2026. Jiunge katika juhudi za kuhamasisha wasichana katika STEM na nyanja zinazohusiana.
Ekegusii: Abagazi 400 be ogendi buya buora bwaki bategereire mu STEM Bootcamp buya Siyoi Comprehensive School ku July 16, 2026. Bwakareka ikinyanganya buya gire kegonje abagazi mu STEM naki naki abogendia.
Dholuo: Ng'ato 400 nyasach kisumo kanyo ne ulan gi STEM Bootcamp e Siyoi Comprehensive School nyaka Jawar 16, 2026. Nde piny kanyo machari mwach nyasach e STEM manok gi chunyi maber.
Somali: In ka badan 400 gabdho oo ka socota dugsiyada hoose ee deegaanka ayaa ka qaybgalay STEM Bootcamp oo ka dhacay Siyoi Comprehensive School 16ka Luulyo, 2026. Ka qayb qaado dadaalada lagu dhiirigelinayo gabdhaha STEM iyo kuwo la xiriira.

English: Egerton University invites the public to a candle-lighting ceremony today in honor of the late Prof. Catherine Wawasi Kitetu. Join the celebration at the Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences grounds.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Egerton kinakaribisha umma kwenye sherehe ya kuwaka kwa mishumaa leo kumuenzi marehemu Prof. Catherine Wawasi Kitetu. Jiunge na sherehe hii kwenye uwanja wa Shule ya Sanaa na Sayansi za Kijamii.
Ekegusii: Egerton University ikinyakire obwakire bosi ku ceremoni ya okubetitia mwakire naki buwaki bwakire bwa Prof. Catherine Wawasi Kitetu. Naki hamwe na bosi ku nkitabu ya Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences.
Dholuo: Egerton University oheroya kamano kuom mabor ma oketho ng'ato ka giyudruok gi Prof. Catherine Wawasi Kitetu. Nya tije mar yudo kwayo e mag jaga mar Arts kod Social Sciences.
Somali: Jaamacadda Egerton waxay ku martiqaadaysaa dadweynaha munaasabad shumac-lidda ah maanta si ay u xusaan Prof. Catherine Wawasi Kitetu. Ka soo qaybgal dabaaldegga goobta Fanka iyo Cilmiga Bulshada.

English: The burial of Meru National Polytechnic trainee Benedictor Ntinyari will take place on Tuesday, July 21, 2026. The community is encouraged to support the bereaved family during this time.
Kiswahili: Mazishi ya mwanafunzi wa Meru National Polytechnic, Benedictor Ntinyari, yatafanyika Jumanne, Julai 21, 2026. Jamii inahimizwa kusaidia familia iliyokumbwa na msiba kipindi hiki.
Ekegusii: Abandu ba Meru National Polytechnic, omokogorori Benedictor Ntinyari, bosi inyenjire naki omokinya, Nyakabiria, Olokogori, 21, 2026. Abandu batoro bosi dusoma oboke go bogo baretani oria.
Dholuo: Burial mar Meru National Polytechnic trainee Benedictor Ntinyari oket kendo tiyo e Wuok, July 21, 2026. Dahlak mar komuni nowinjruo kanga machielo ochiko ang'wen ma ogenda ohala ni.
Somali: Aas qaran ee macalinka Meru National Polytechnic, Benedictor Ntinyari waxa la qaban doonaa Talaada, 21-da Luulyo, 2026. Bulshadu waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay taageeraan qoyska murugada leh waqtigan.

English: The National Assembly Departmental Committee on Education is addressing funding challenges in higher education. Stakeholders are urged to participate in upcoming consultative meetings to improve the Higher Education Funding Model.
Kiswahili: Kamati ya Kudumu ya Bunge kuhusu Elimu inashughulikia changamoto za ufadhili katika elimu ya juu. Wadau wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mikutano ya ushauri inayokuja ili kuboresha Mfano wa Ufadhili wa Elimu ya Juu.
Ekegusii: Komiti ya Idara ya Elimu katika Bunge Kuu inashughulikia changamoto za ufadhili katika elimu ya juu. Washikadau wanahimizwa kushiriki katika mikutano ya ushirikiano inayokuja ili kuboresha Mfano wa Ufadhili wa Elimu ya Juu.
Dholuo: Komiti mag goro mar National Assembly kuom Education en gibiro konyo onyo kuom piny gi funding ka wech joma adhiyo. Jotega obiro timo konyo ka motegno gi tich ng'ato kuom wiye mag Higher Education Funding.
Somali: Guddiga Waaxda Waxbarashada ee Aqalka Shacabka ayaa ka wada hadlaya caqabadaha maalgelinta ee waxbarashada sare. Subagga wax-soo-saarka ayaa lagu boorinayaa in ay ka qeybgalaan kulamada talo-qabashada ee soo socda si loo hagaajiyo Habka Maalgelinta Waxbarashada Sare.

English: The Kenya Institute of Special Education (KISE) will conduct a nationwide special needs assessment in schools to identify learners requiring assistive devices. The assessment is expected to be completed within two months.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Kenya ya Elimu ya Maalum (KISE) itafanya tathmini ya kitaifa ya mahitaji maalum katika shule ili kubaini wanafunzi wanahitaji vifaa vya msaada. Tathmini inatarajiwa kukamilika ndani ya miezi miwili.
Ekegusii: Kenya Institute of Special Education (KISE) igenge omokirongo bwaise obwakire bwabaki bwere ore mgana bokia okenyengwa buse bwo omogori bwaki. Ibigwi buse bwakire okwenda buse buya na buora buse bisi.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Special Education (KISE) kanyal gi tich mar special needs kuom jochung' kanyakla, e yo jomoko lokruok miyo ongeyo gichungo mar assistive devices. Tichno othin gi kuonye ng'ato abich.
Somali: Jaamacadda Kenya ee Waxbarashada Gaarka ah (KISE) waxay sameyn doontaa qiimeyn qaran oo ku saabsan baahiyaha gaarka ah ee ardayda iskuulada si loo ogaado ardayda u baahan qalabka kaalmada. Qiimeyntu waxa la filayaa in la dhammeeyo laba bilood gudahood.

English: A public participation forum will be held on July 15, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. at Kinoru Youth Resource Centre to discuss the proposal to allocate Kinoru Primary School land for government offices.
Kiswahili: Mkutano wa ushirikiano wa umma utafanyika tarehe 15 Julai 2026, saa 4:00 asubuhi katika Kituo cha Rasilimali za Vijana cha Kinoru kujadili pendekezo la kupewa ardhi ya Shule ya Msingi ya Kinoru kwa ofisi za serikali.
Ekegusii: Ong'anya bw'ogosibori bwanenge yaki, ng'echi 15, 2026, buya 10:00 mioria, na Kinoru Youth Resource Centre, bokwene bw'aki buya oro naki ogosibori bw'okweria ogotegere omogori bw'ogwasimbia buye ogokoti ku Kinoru Primary School.
Dholuo: Forum ma chuny ma nyalo golo e nyime konyruok odhiambo, July 15, 2026, e 10:00 a.m. e Kinoru Youth Resource Centre kuom wacho mahiga mar nyaka manono jotigro lokruok e Kinoru Primary School kuom bu kayie mag govenment.
Somali: Shir dadweyne ayaa la qaban doonaa 15-ka Luulyo, 2026, saacaddu markay tahay 10:00 subaxnimo, Xarunta Kheyraadka Dhallinyarada Kinoru si looga wada hadlo talada dhulka Dugsiga Hoose ee Kinoru loo qoondeynayo xafiisyada dowladda.

English: Residents of Kinoru area are urged to participate in discussions regarding the proposed excision of Kinoru Primary School land for sub-county offices. Your voice matters!
Kiswahili: Wananchi wa eneo la Kinoru wanahimizwa kushiriki katika majadiliano kuhusu kupendekezwa kwa kukatwa kwa ardhi ya Shule ya Msingi ya Kinoru kwa ajili ya ofisi za sub-kaunti. Sauti yako ni muhimu!
Ekegusii: Abakire baki Kinoru barabaki bakanegere mwaki bw'egaki nyarongo bwaki buse bosi bw'ekibondo bwaki bw'ogenda bwaki bw'ekibanda bw'ekisoma ya Kinoru. Omo buya buya!
Dholuo: Wuon gigi wahou ka gingo chike matindo kuom kigoro chiwo gini mag Mwongo Rabuor ni to in bende gi Kinoru Primary School. Koro in bende gite!
Somali: Dadka deegaanka Kinoru waxaa lagu boorinayaa in ay ka qayb qaataan wadahadallada ku saabsan qorshaha qodista dhulka dugsiga hoose ee Kinoru si loogu dhiso xafiisyada hoos yimaada degmada. Codkaaga ayaa muhiim ah!

English: Starting in 2026, secondary schools will transition to Senior Schools (Grades 10-12) under the Competency-Based Curriculum, categorized as C1 to C4 based on their previous classifications.
Kiswahili: Kuanzia mwaka 2026, shule za sekondari zitahamia katika shule za juu (Darasa la 10-12) chini ya Mtaala wa Uwezo, zikiwa katika makundi ya C1 hadi C4 kulingana na uainishaji wao wa awali.
Ekegusii: Gekire 2026, masomo gaki bwegana na masomo makuru (Gredi 10-12) ng'enda yerebaki mu Mugeni Ogaki, bw'okorwaki C1 kendo C4  mwaki ohigori orokire.
Dholuo: Kanye 2026, shule gi tich mar sekondari ng’edi ku Senior Schools (Grade 10-12) maler e nyime Competency-Based Curriculum, kendo gima giruok gi C1 to C4 e nyime gima odhiere.
Somali: Laga bilaabo 2026, dugsiyada sare waxay u guuri doonaan Dugsiyada Sare (Fasallada 10-12) oo ku saleysan Manhajka Aqoonta Awooda, waxaana loo qaybin doonaa kategoryo C1 ilaa C4 iyadoo loo eegayo kala soocdii hore.

English: All schools must obtain prior approval from education authorities for educational trips. Submit a completed School Visit Application Form signed by the Head of Institution before planning any visit.
Kiswahili: Shule zote zinapaswa kupata idhini ya awali kutoka kwa mamlaka ya elimu kwa ajili ya safari za kielimu. Wasilisha fomu ya maombi ya ziara ya shule iliyo kamilika na kusainiwa na Kiongozi wa Taasisi kabla ya kupanga ziara yoyote.
Ekegusii: Busia bwose buya kworeri emokireri bweranda boke buya bui emabere buya. Omokireri oremote ekerori nyaki mwaki na omokireri omogotirei kera bwesebatuma.
Dholuo: Ong'eyo nyaka oriti e yo gima dhi nyaka ma nyaka tot gi edhi. Chula fomu mar School Visit Application mane gi sakir gi Head of Institution bende onge wach nyaka gima dhi nyaka.
