Somali: Dhammaan dugsiyada waa inay helaan ogolaansho ka hor ah hay'adaha waxbarashada safarrada waxbarasho. Soo gudbi foomka codsiga booqashada dugsiga ee dhammeystiran oo saxiixan madaxa hay'adda ka hor inta aan qorshayn booqasho kasta.

English: Enroll in Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) institutions to gain practical skills for employment and self-reliance. Embrace this opportunity for a better future.
Kiswahili: jiandikishe katika taasisi za Elimu na Mafunzo ya Ufundi na Ufundi Stadi (TVET) ili kupata ujuzi wa vitendo kwa ajili ya ajira na kujitegemea. Kumbatia fursa hii kwa ajili ya siku zijazo bora.
Ekegusii: Jung'ana momwaki na Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) buya ogenda oria buya bwaki buya oria buya oria. Iwa nyaki omokosi buya ige naki na emokere.
Dholuo: Jalou koth e Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) nyasaye kaka ubich ng’ato kendo weche gi maliya. Bende joodo e nind e yo mokwongo.
Somali: Kusoo biir hay'adaha Waxbarashada Farsamada iyo Tababarka (TVET) si aad u hesho xirfadaha praktikalka ah ee shaqo iyo is-xilqaan. Fursadan qaado si aad mustaqbalkaaga u hagaajiso.

English: The government is distributing 11,139 assistive devices to learners with disabilities in all 47 counties. These devices aim to enhance access to quality and inclusive education.
Kiswahili: Serikali inagawanya vifaa 11,139 vya kusaidia wanafunzi wenye ulemavu katika kaunti zote 47. Vifaa hivi vinakusudia kuboresha upatikanaji wa elimu bora na jumuishi.
Ekegusii: Govana oria enche 11,139 oboardi boki bwabaki nyansagani bwiire baki basichani naki 47 ochieng’ori. Oboardi omogoti omoka naki boki togo bome buseche bwiire baki bwaki borori.
Dholuo: Government imiya 11,139 ng'ato manyasa moyieng' marach ka ler gichwonyo e 47 manyo. Ewi ng'ato ariyo nyal tinde tingo magero ginen joma gi lweny kod wendo tich.
Somali: Dowladdu waxay qaybinaysaa 11,139 qalab ka caawiya ardayda naafada ah dhammaan 47-ka degmo. Qalabkan wuxuu ujeedkiisu yahay in kor loo qaado helitaanka waxbarasho tayo leh iyo mid ka mid ah.

English: The Kenya National Union of Teachers (KNUT) urges parents, teachers, and community leaders to educate youth on the risks of gambling and promote responsible decision-making.
Kiswahili: Shirikisho la Walimu wa Kenya (KNUT) linawataka wazazi, walimu, na viongozi wa jamii kuwafunzisha vijana kuhusu hatari za kamari na kukuza maamuzi mazuri.
Ekegusii: Chingecha chaki Kenya National Union of Teachers (KNUT) ekeria abaki, abarimu, na abaki baki chireme ehagere ore ogetobori oiga bwire ne bakerere oria buya.
Dholuo: Kenya National Union of Teachers (KNUT) in gima owuon koni, joma okel, gi jopiny mang'ena, ka wathony gi yien mar mamoko magero kendo togtore kanyanjore mag kuom chalo mar ping' gi yo.
Somali: Ururka Qaranka Macalimiinta Kenya (KNUT) wuxuu ku boorinayaa waalidiinta, macalimiinta, iyo hogaamiyeyaasha bulshada inay wax ka baraan dhalinyarada khataraha sharadka iyo inay dhiirrigeliyaan go'aan qaadasho mas'uul ah.

English: The KUCCPS inter-institutional transfer portal is open for 30 days from July 15, 2026. Apply online at www.students.kuccps.ac.ke and pay a Ksh1,000 fee to initiate your transfer.
Kiswahili: Mradi wa kuhamasisha uwakilishi wa KUCCPS umekaribishwa kwa siku 30 kuanzia Julai 15, 2026. Omba mtandaoni kwenye www.students.kuccps.ac.ke na lipa ada ya Ksh1,000 ili kuanzisha mchakato wa uhamishaji.
Ekegusii: Portal ya KUCCPS ya kuhama kati ya taasisi ziko wazi kwa siku 30 kuanzia Julai 15, 2026. Omba mtandaoni kwenye www.students.kuccps.ac.ke na lipa ada ya Ksh1,000 ili kuanzisha hamahama yako.
Dholuo: Potal ku-transfer mar KUCCPS okungo gi 30 ndogo manie Julai 15, 2026. Nyiso kanyakla e www.students.kuccps.ac.ke kata buo Ksh1,000 mondo ubed gi transfer.
Somali: Barta wareejinta hay'adaha KUCCPS ayaa furan 30 maalmood laga bilaabo 15ka Luulyo, 2026. Codso khadka tooska ah ee www.students.kuccps.ac.ke oo bixi lacag dhan Ksh1,000 si aad u bilaawdo wareejintaada.

English: Schools approved on the Kenya Education Management Information System (KEMIS) but not receiving final registration emails should log in with their original email or use "Forgot Email" to access alternative addresses and complete registration.
Kiswahili: Shule zilizopitishwa katika Mfumo wa Usimamizi wa Habari za Elimu Kenya (KEMIS) lakini hazipati barua pepe za usajili wa mwisho zinapaswa kuingia kwa kutumia barua pepe yao ya awali au kutumia "Sahau Barua Pepe" kupata anwani mbadala na kukamilisha usajili.
Ekegusii: Masomo akang'anya mu Kenya Education Management Information System (KEMIS) abwaki tugana mu bwoga bwakirori bwesibori yenda bakorire buya bulanda bwegena, kana baskorere "Forgot Email" nge'ekegeranya ekenyo egokoreje na bambarorore hashiori.
Dholuo: Masomo maber konyruok e Kenya Education Management Information System (KEMIS) to ok nyal weche mag kanyo tho ok walok logolo mokuongo e email mag pi konyruok gi "Forgot Email" to bedo e email to kod ruok mar kanyo.
Somali: Dugsiyada ku qeexan Nidaamka Maareynta Macluumaadka Waxbarashada Kenya (KEMIS) laakiin aan helin iimayllada xaqiijinta ugu dambeeya waa inay galaan akoonkooda iimaylka asalka ah ama isticmaalaan "Iimaylka Maqan" si ay u helaan ciwaannada kale oo ay dhammeeyaan diiwaangelinta.

English: JKUAT will admit 7,114 government-sponsored students for the 2026/2027 academic year. Newly admitted students must rely on JKUAT's official communication channels to avoid scams.
Kiswahili: JKUAT itakubali wanafunzi 7,114 wanaosimamiwa na serikali kwa mwaka wa masomo 2026/2027. Wanafunzi wapya wanaopokelewa wanapaswa kutegemea kanali rasmi za mawasiliano za JKUAT ili kuepuka mashauli.
Ekegusii: JKUAT ikore eng'ani 7,114 buya buya bosi bware vendere omokwere 2026/2027. Abogoti b'okwere buya bosi baswete egesia buya za JKUAT omokibere omotere ogwenyera.
Dholuo: JKUAT nyalo nyis 7,114 wasomaji ma gi chande govens. Wasomaji ma nyalo nyis nyaka timo ya JKUAT e nyaka mana ma ok konyo e yo.
Somali: JKUAT waxay aqbali doontaa 7,114 arday oo dowladdu maaliyad dhaqaale siisay sanadka 2026/2027. Ardayda cusub ee la aqbalay waa inay ku xirmaan kanaallada rasmiga ah ee JKUAT si ay uga fogaadaan khiyaamooyinka.

English: Nyamira University will admit its pioneer cohort of students in September as planned. Parents and students should prepare for this admission.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Nyamira kitapokea kundi lake la kwanza la wanafunzi mnamo Septemba kama ilivyopangwa. Wazazi na wanafunzi wanapaswa kujiandaa kwa ajili ya kujiunga.
Ekegusii: Nyamira University ikwenda okang'ana abaki bagera bapeere buya mwokiri wa September. Abaki na abaki boke bateganye naki omokang'ano oyaki.
Dholuo: Nyamira University niki ginyalo gi joma thurwa mar loso kido mag ng'ato e September. Wazee mane joma thurwa nyalo to kod ginyisia kendo kawo gi ng’ato ma abir owuon.
Somali: Jaamacadda Nyamira waxay qabsan doontaa ardaydeedii ugu horreysay bisha Sebtembar sida qorshuhu yahay. Waalidiinta iyo ardayda waa inay is diyaariyaan qabashada ardayda.

English: Adolescent mothers in Kirinyaga County can now resume education or enroll in vocational training at county polytechnics. Visit your local polytechnic for more information.
Kiswahili: Makao ya vijana wa kike wanaokumbana na matatizo ya ujauzito katika Kaunti ya Kirinyaga sasa wanaweza kuendelea na masomo au kujiunga na mafunzo ya ufundi katika vyuo vya kaunti. Tembelea chuo chako cha karibu kwa maelezo zaidi.
Ekegusii: Abakia baki mwaki wa Kirinyaga baria naki bwanamakariri owaki bunka omogaka bwaki. Maki buya bwaki bwa bwanamakariri buya omogaka bwaki.
Dholuo: Ma jomoko ma nyaka kendo gi kar ka gima oknyal, kendo kare ma tinye ka olore gi lweny mokuot kod nyamrer. Kiwach nyaka nene kuom inyo nyaka kuor lweny mokuot ma e gi.
Somali: Hooyooyinka dhallinyarada ah ee ka tirsan Gobolka Kirinyaga hadda waxay dib u bilaabi karaan waxbarashada ama ku biiri karaan tababarka xirfadeed ee jaamacadaha gobolka. Booqashada jaamacaddaada deegaanka si aad u hesho macluumaad dheeraad ah.

English: Parents are advised to monitor their children for symptoms of mumps and seek medical attention if they appear. Keep symptomatic children at home until assessed by a healthcare professional.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanashauriwa kuangalia watoto wao kwa dalili za mumps na kutafuta huduma ya afya wakionekana. Wakati huu, wahifadhi watoto wenye dalili nyumbani hadi wapimwe na mtaalamu wa afya.
Ekegusii: Ababere bateganire kwogetia abaki bengine boche buya bwa mumps egwaki obonenge. Ria abaki ba naki buya na bwebogo otengete bwecho bwasema.
Dholuo: Waruo gin jachien nyaka ichung' motegno kendo tuke iwuok ma ng'wonya mar mumps, kendo nyaka ng'eyo joma oter e thur. Telo jachien ma ng'wonya ka ohero gi jomi duto mar thuru.
Somali: Waalidiinta waxaa lagu talinayaa inay la socdaan carruurtooda calaamadaha qufaca iyadoo la raadinayo daryeel caafimaad haddii ay soo baxaan. Carruurta calaamadaha leh ku hay guryaha ilaa laga baaro xirfadle caafimaad.

English: Kibabii University confirms that no new Vice-Chancellor has been appointed; Prof. Isaac Ipara Odeo remains in office. Disregard any false reports circulating on social media.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Kibabii kimeweka wazi kwamba hakuna Makamu Mkuu mpya aliyewekwa; Prof. Isaac Ipara Odeo anaendelea na wadhifa wake. Puzilia mbali ripoti zozote za uongo zinazosambazwa kwenye mitandao ya kijamii.
Ekegusii: Kibabii University enyaki omokire naki naki naki Vice-Chancellor mosire; Prof. Isaac Ipara Odeo oria ogenda. Omosire buse bw'ogenda obuna bw'osiye buya oria morere ogenda.
Dholuo: Kibabii University owinjore ni ng'ama Vice-Chancellor nyaluo eyo; Prof. Isaac Ipara Odeo ni owuon e kany. Gima kanyono e social media koro ne othing' otieno.
Somali: Jaamacadda Kibabii waxay xaqiijisay in aan la magacaabin Madaxweyne cusub; Prof. Isaac Ipara Odeo wuxuu weli xilka hayaa. Ka indho sarreeya warar qalafsan oo ku saabsan baraha bulshada.

English: A private members' Bill is proposed to regulate senior school enrolment, limiting students to specified streams starting 2027. Stay informed about potential changes in school admissions.
Kiswahili: Muswada wa wanachama binafsi umependekezwa kuimarisha usajili wa shule za sekondari, ukipunguza wanafunzi katika mwelekeo maalum kuanzia mwaka 2027. Fuata mabadiliko yanayoweza kutokea katika usajili wa shule.
Ekegusii: Eseke buya buya bwaki bw'Ekiyang'ania bwokore eng'endi buya bw'ogoti bw'bwaki bosi, motirenda buya buya bw'aboga bw'abetugi bw'ekere 2027. Naki kitibori ogoti buya bw'ogendio mu emwaki bwakihorere.
Dholuo: Okwany piny oyie mar Private Members' Bill wacho ni oketo kawuono mag piny gigo, kendo oketo gi lastini gimojogo mar nyaka 2027. Jochung' gi chuo ma okonyo e konyo ma e piny.
Somali: Sharci gaar ah ayaa la soo jeediyay si loo xakameeyo diiwaan gelinta ardayda dugsiyada sare, iyadoo la xadidayo ardayda inay doortaan qaybaha cayiman laga bilaabo 2027. Ka warhay isbedellada suurtagalka ah ee qabsashada dugsiyada.

English: Public universities and TVET institutions are under parliamentary audit scrutiny. Institutions must provide accurate responses to all audit queries to avoid personal accountability for mismanagement of public funds.
Kiswahili: Vyuo vikuu vya umma na taasisi za TVET zinakaguliwa na bunge. Taasisi lazima zitoe majibu sahihi kwa maswali yote ya ukaguzi ili kuepuka dhima binafsi kwa usimamizi mbaya wa fedha za umma.
Ekegusii: Makiokwenda naki TVET naki abere kora muchabe. Abere naki bwakire buya buya buite oria obwakubaki oria bachamo buya kiaireetete khore omokiri ogore omotigoti bwaki.
Dholuo: Kenyang' iwinjo mag Oganda mar joma gi TVET wacho ka gin e micha mar bunge. Makarita cha konyo unyalo chas gi jogi jote mar ma dhi puonjog e nyalok kendo to kod ga konyo denda mar puonjo.
Somali: Jaamacadaha dadweynaha iyo hay'adaha TVET waxay ku jiraan kormeerka baarlamaanka. Hay'aduhu waa inay bixiyaan jawaabo sax ah oo ku saabsan dhammaan su'aalaha kormeerka si ay uga fogaadaan mas'uuliyadda shakhsiyeed ee maareynta xun ee lacagaha dadweynaha.

English: Kabete National Polytechnic trainees have elected new student leaders for the 2026/2027 academic year, including Oinepu Philemon Saruni as President.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa Kabete National Polytechnic wamechagua viongozi wapya wa wanafunzi kwa mwaka wa masomo 2026/2027, akiwemo Oinepu Philemon Saruni kama Rais.
Ekegusii: Abakikire b'ekibung'oni kya Kabete baire omokiri b'amasomo b'ekibung'oni b'ekiga 2026/2027, na Oinepu Philemon Saruni akire Nyaigenda.
Dholuo: Joluo mar Kabete National Polytechnic en oting' kod abok mar jowet mar 2026/2027, omiyo Oinepu Philemon Saruni en Jodongo.
Somali: Ardayda Kabete National Polytechnic waxay doorteen hoggaamiyayaal cusub oo arday ah sanadka baarlamaanka 2026/2027, oo ay ku jiraan Oinepu Philemon Saruni oo ah Madaxweynaha.

English: The 2026 National Term Two Games will take place from July 28 to August 1 at MPESA Academy, featuring top secondary school teams in football, rugby sevens, volleyball, and netball.
Kiswahili: Mashindano ya Kitaifa ya Term Mbili ya 2026 yatafanyika kuanzia Julai 28 hadi Agosti 1 katika Akademia ya MPESA, yakijumuisha timu bora za shule za sekondari katika soka, rugby sevens, mpira wa pete, na voliboli.
Ekegusii: Bwakire buya 2026 bwaki boki bounane bweng'enda bu Terenane bu Mboko, buristo bwang'oka bwake, buya ntokama 28 bu iloka 1 bu Augusti ki MPESA Academy, bwaki bwamiboko bu eng'endo boki bwaki bu mugoya, rugby sevens, volleyball, na netball.
Dholuo: Isechi 2026 mar National Term Two Games nyalo timo wanji from July 28 to August 1 ku MPESA Academy, kawo joma secondary school ma okonyo gi football, rugby sevens, volleyball, kod netball.
Somali: Ciyaaraha Qaranka ee Waqtiga Labaad ee 2026 waxay dhici doonaan laga bilaabo Luulyo 28 ilaa Ogosto 1, xarunta MPESA Academy, iyadoo la ciyaarayo kooxaha ugu fiican ee dugsiyada sare ee kubbadda cagta, rugby sevens, kubbadda voli, iyo netball.

English: Theology colleges have 90 days to comply with Ministry of Education regulations or face closure. Ensure your institution meets registration and accreditation requirements by the deadline.
Kiswahili: Vyuo vya teolojia vina siku 90 kutii kanuni za Wizara ya Elimu au kukabiliwa na kufungwa. Hakikisha taasisi yako inatimiza vigezo vya usajili na uthibitisho kabla ya tarehe ya mwisho.
Ekegusii: Masomo egesibori gotwe amoko 90 buya gendo okore genda Obwakire bwe Kiongosi bwokire mugenda oboka ogwaki. Gana igana egesibori yenu iri mu nkiru oho itumwa na oria bwakire.
Dholuo: Makar kanyono ni ng'ama ji 90 kuonge ka otele makelo kwaya ma Ministry of Education. Konyo ng'eyo ni yun ji nyap ndege mag mûra gi kwer kanyakre.
Somali: Colleges-ka diinta waxay haystaan 90 maalmood si ay u raacaan shuruucda Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ama waxay wajihi doonaan xirid. Hubi in hay'addaada ay buuxiso shuruudaha diiwaangelinta iyo aqoonsiga ka hor waqtiga kama dambaysta ah.

English: The Ministry of Education cannot independently review or increase salaries for TVET trainers, as remuneration is regulated by the Salaries and Remuneration Commission.
Kiswahili: Wizara ya Elimu haiwezi kujihusisha moja kwa moja na ukaguzi au ongezeko la mishahara ya wahitimu wa TVET, kwani malipo yanasimamiwa na Tume ya Mishahara na Malipo.
Ekegusii: Nkiro bu Omosome bu Atetegani omonye obokosi bwokutamaya  bwatangwa, buya obotire bwenu bwomobogoni bwi Salaries and Remuneration Commission.
Dholuo: Gimoni mar Uthiw ne ok nyal duto kanyonyo kapo kanyogolo kata ng'ato mar TVET, minyuongo yath joma ok nyal dwaro e ng'ato mar Salaries and Remuneration Commission.
Somali: Wasaaradda Waxbarashada ma awooddo inay si madax-bannaan u eegto ama kor u qaaddo mushaarada tababarayaasha TVET, maadaama lacag-bixinta ay xakameyso Guddiga Mushaaraadka iyo Lacag-bixinta.

English: Attention educators and parents: A crisis in reading proficiency has been identified, with 60% of Grade 4 learners unable to read at a Grade 3 level. Urgent measures are needed to improve foundational literacy.
Kiswahili: Kazi kwa walimu na wazazi: Kuna mgogoro katika uwezo wa kusoma, ambapo 60% ya wanafunzi wa Darasa la 4 hawawezi kusoma kwa kiwango cha Darasa la 3. Hatua za haraka zinahitajika kuboresha uelewa wa msingi wa kusoma.
Ekegusii: Abaki bosi na abagi: Ekitogotero kirekereraki naki, ne 60% ya baana baki 4 naki baria bakanikere buya buya bwa baki 3. Ntang'ana igechere okwitagania kujiendere buya bwa geti.
Dholuo: Nind to yie nyaka, inyalo wadhi: Piny koro yore chiro ka methe, ka 60% mar Grade 4 duto ne oganda omiyo tiend wach kendo konyo ni koro piny 3. Ototogi mara konyo kendo in gi ndalo mag joma kagi.
Somali: Dhegeyso macallimiin iyo waalidiin: Dhibaatada aqriska ayaa la ogaadey, 60% ardayda darajada 4-aad ayaa aan awoodin inay akhriyaan heerka darajada 3-aad. Tallaabooyin degdeg ah ayaa loo baahan yahay si loo hagaajiyo aqoonta aasaasiga ah ee akhriska.

English: Dickson Muganda, a teacher at Butere Girls High School, has returned after being reported missing. He apologized for his absence; schools and parents are urged to emphasize communication and accountability.
Kiswahili: Dickson Muganda, mw teacher wa Butere Girls High School, amerudi baada ya kutangazwa kupotea. Amekiri makosa kwa kutokuwepo; shule na wazazi wanahimizwa kuweka mkazo katika mawasiliano na uwajibikaji.
Ekegusii: Dickson Muganda, omokere ogenda Butere Girls High School, narorore buya maki kera atigiri. Naagijere oria buya bwe yachemokere; masomoni na obokirigori batarore bonyere kera kusiikiria na obwakire.
Dholuo: Dickson Muganda, mudho bura e Butere Girls High School, oting'uru ng'ato kamano. Omedhoye gima en gima oting'o; shule kod abandu en piny konyo tich tich mokuongo gima dhok e gima wacho.
Somali: Dickson Muganda, macallin ka tirsan Dugsiga Sare ee Butere Girls, ayaa soo laabtay ka dib markii la soo sheegay inuu lumay. Wuxuu raalli gelin ka bixiyey maqnaanshihiisa; iskuulada iyo waalidiinta waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay xoogga saaraan isgaarsiinta iyo mas'uuliyadda.

English: Parents are encouraged to adopt authoritative parenting styles, which promote warmth, clear expectations, and open communication to enhance children's educational success and personal development.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanahimizwa kutumia mitindo ya malezi ya kimamlaka, inayohimiza upendo, matarajio wazi, na mawasiliano ya wazi ili kuboresha mafanikio ya elimu na maendeleo ya kibinafsi ya watoto.
Ekegusii: Ababere bakenyagia kugonchora oboranga bwakire, bwetenda obokire, omogende, na omonani omokiraki oria buya buya osekeria iborori bochechi bwere omorori ogenda oria nekuora.
Dholuo: Gik mang'ere, ka gin pi lwenyi mar joma, mane oktiyo cha oganda, chako machal, kendo tichni moloyo, ewitik weche mar kony gi andingo kuom joma kiyo chike kendo chike mwakalo.
Somali: Waalidiinta waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay qaataan qaab-dhaqan waalidnimo oo awood leh, kaas oo korodhsada diirimaad, filashooyin cad, iyo isgaarsiin furan si loo xoojiyo guusha waxbarashada iyo horumarka shakhsiyeed ee carruurta.

English: The 2026 Kenya Secondary Schools Sports Association (KSSSA) National Term Two Games will feature boys' and girls' volleyball competitions. Schools are encouraged to prepare for the national showdown at MPesa Academy.
Kiswahili: Mashindano ya Kitaifa ya Michezo ya Nguvu za Pili ya Shule za Sekondari za Kenya (KSSSA) mwaka 2026 yatahusisha mashindano ya mpira wa wavu kwa wavulana na wasichana. Shule zinahimizwa kujiandaa kwa mashindano haya ya kitaifa yatakayofanyika katika Taasisi ya MPesa.
Ekegusii: Amakanga ya 2026 ya Kenya Secondary Schools Sports Association (KSSSA) ya Term Mbiri ekeria kocheria buya na bwaki buya. Masoko naandiki eka raki omokong’ana omoshokari omokire e MPesa Academy.
Dholuo: Chieng' 2026 Kenya Secondary Schools Sports Association (KSSSA) National Term Two Games biro chalo ng'ato kendo ng'ato mag volleyball. Sukulu dhi rubi kuom gitimre duto mar lokruok e MPesa Academy.
Somali: Ciyaaraha Qaranka ee Term Two ee 2026 ee Ururka Isboortiga Dugsiyada Sare ee Kenya (KSSSA) waxay ka koobnaan doonaan tartano kubbadda kolayga loogu talagalay wiilasha iyo gabdhaha. Dugsiyadu waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay u diyaargaroobaan tartanka qaranka ee ka dhici doona Akademiga MPesa.

English: All schools are reminded to uphold safety and integrity for learners. The Teachers Service Commission enforces strict regulations against misconduct, ensuring a secure environment for all students.
Kiswahili: Shule zote zinakumbushwa kuhifadhi usalama na uadilifu wa wanafunzi. Tume ya Huduma za Walimu inatekeleza kanuni kali dhidi ya tabia mbaya, kuhakikisha mazingira salama kwa wanafunzi wote.
Ekegusii: Masomo onyang’ere kutegeneza abaki bw’osi buya na obwaki. Ekibuga cha Abakire b’amasomo kiri otaganya maagano gakuya bositani, kiainchaka obwaki buya kubaki bose.
Dholuo: Nying wa chike to gokwongo gige safar mar ler nu. Teachers Service Commission oromo chodi mar eka miyo koro nyalu, to nongo gi safa mar olwalruok.
Somali: Dhammaan iskuullada waxaa lagu xasuusinayaa inay ilaaliyaan amniga iyo daacadnimada ardayda. Guddiga Adeegga Macalimiinta wuxuu dhaqan gelinayaa xeerar adag oo ka dhanka ah falalka xun, si loo hubiyo in dhammaan ardaydu helaan degenaansho.

English: Kisii County will air live FIFA World Cup matches on public screens in designated town centres. Locations will be announced soon.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Kisii itatumia skrini za umma kuonyesha mechi za Kombe la Dunia la FIFA moja kwa moja katika vituo vya miji vilivyotengwa. Miji itatangazwa hivi karibuni.
Ekegusii: Naki Kisii, oria magetere FIFA World Cup omokiri kumwaki aborori bionge buwaki. Abwakire bwebere kosi bwagwanire.
Dholuo: Kisii County konyo tich FIFA World Cup mawadhi e public screens ka ng'ato matang' fuo. Ngeyo maber toonge e woono.
Somali: Koonfurta Kisii waxay si toos ah u baahin doontaa ciyaaraha Koobka Adduunka ee FIFA shaashaddaha dadweynaha ee xarumaha magaalooyinka loo qoondeeyey. Meelaha ayaa la shaacindoonaa dhawaan.

English: Parents and educators are urged to promote discussions on sexual purity, emphasizing the importance of eschewing sexual immorality as outlined in Scripture.
Kiswahili: Wazazi na walimu wanakumbushwa kuhamasisha majadiliano kuhusu usafi wa kijinsia, wakielezea umuhimu wa kuepuka uasherati kama ilivyobainishwa katika Maandiko.
Ekegusii: Bwakire buya buya naki abaki naki abere buya kukoreri buya kuise eng'eno ya bobori, buya bosi buya buesa buya kukiragani bori boke bwaki bwaboka mu Esikeri.
Dholuo: Wazazi onge nigi koryo gi walimu to gwend gi ndalo manamiyo kanyakla e kwe, nyaka akar kucng' gima giyienjore e nicho.
Somali: Waalidka iyo macallimiinta waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay dhiirrigeliyaan wada hadallo ku saabsan nadaafadda galmada, iyagoo muujinaya muhiimadda ka fogaanshaha falalka galmo ee xun sida lagu sheegay Kitaabka.

English: Students are advised to consider accredited universities beyond the most prestigious ones for equal quality education. Choose programs that align with your career aspirations, regardless of university reputation.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanashauriwa kuzingatia vyuo vikuu vilivyothibitishwa zaidi ya vyuo maarufu kwa ajili ya elimu bora sawa. Chagueni programu zinazoendana na malengo yenu ya kazi, bila kujali sifa ya chuo.
Ekegusii: Abogotera buya bano baki kyosi abaki orokire buya orokire naki bwere bwenyingi buya bosi bwakire. Omoserokoti omosoratikire buya orokire naki omokirori bwogotakire, oregori bwokere bwenyia bwabaki.
Dholuo: Wang'ni gonyo chako ka uchego chuo mar yiero ma yieng'ni kuom jukgi mag nyasaye, kendo chuno atika mar chike e tich duto. Tichni chono mokuongo to oseyudo gi nyiero mar chike gi chuo, kata chuo yieng'ni.
Somali: Ardayda waxaa lagu talinayaa inay fiiriyaan jaamacadaha la aqoonsan yahay ee aan ahayn kuwa ugu caansan si ay u helaan waxbarasho tayo leh. Dooro barnaamijyo ku haboon himilooyinkaaga shaqo, iyadoon loo eegin magacyada jaamacadda.

English: TVET institutions have received KSh 5.2 billion in capitation for the 2025/2026 financial year. Institutions are encouraged to commercialize training facilities to generate additional income.
Kiswahili: Taasisi za TVET zimeshuhudia upokeaji wa KSh bilioni 5.2 kwa ajili ya mwaka wa fedha wa 2025/2026. Taasisi zinahimizwa kuboresha vifaa vya mafunzo ili kupata mapato ya ziada.
Ekegusii: Institusyon za TVET ziri na KSh 5.2 billion mu kapiteisheni ya mwaka wa fedha 2025/2026. Institutions nakiagania kudhuriya moshoncho omotere kugena omokiraka ogendete.
Dholuo: Institutions ma TVET wacho ni watiyo KSh 5.2 billion kuom kapetition moro niya 2025/2026. Wachieng' ni institutions odhi kod kanyo kendo odhi chako kuom joma okel kata ji ogendani.
Somali: Hay’adaha TVET waxay heleen KSh 5.2 bilyan oo lacag ah sannadka maaliyadeed 2025/2026. Hay’adaha waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ganacsi ka dhigaan xarumaha tababarka si ay u helaan dakhli dheeri ah.

English: The 2026 KSSSA national Term Two games will feature new champions as defending champions Butere Girls and record holders Wiyeta Secondary will not compete.
Kiswahili: Michezo ya kitaifa ya KSSSA ya kipindi cha pili ya mwaka 2026 itakuwa na mabingwa wapya kwani mabingwa walindaji Butere Girls na washikilia rekodi Wiyeta Secondary hawatashiriki.
Ekegusii: Mitego ya KSSSA ya mwaka wa 2026 itakuwa na mabingwa wapya kwa sababu mabingwa walioshinda Butere Girls na wenye rekodi Wiyeta Secondary hawatachuana.
Dholuo: Oyugi gi 2026 KSSSA national Term Two games en ka nyalo taya ng'ato ma jonyal, makiwuon gi Butere Girls kata Wiyeta Secondary, ma en jomoko.
Somali: Ciyaaraha heer qaran ee Term Two 2026 ee KSSSA ayaa soo bandhigi doona horyaallo cusub maadaama horyaalka difaacanaya Butere Girls iyo rikoodh-hayaha Wiyeta Secondary aysan ka qaybgelin.

English: Grade 9 learners must select their preferred 12 Senior Schools before the Kenya Junior School Education Assessment (KJSEA). Ensure to choose 9 boarding and 3 day schools as per guidelines.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa darasa la 9 lazima wachague shule 12 za sekondari wanazopendelea kabla ya Tathmini ya Elimu ya Shule ya Msingi ya Kenya (KJSEA). Hakikisha unachagua shule 9 za bweni na 3 za kutwa kama inavyoelekezwa.
Ekegusii: Abakire b’iga 9 bataria bataria minto bw’ogenda okwenda okua 12 bui bw’eshuleni bwanogenda bwogwenda Kenya Junior School Education Assessment (KJSEA). Motigana obwakarire buno 9 bw’eshule ebindigo na 3 bw’eshule bui bwabere.
Dholuo: Wang'eyi gi Grade 9 nochak e piny kode 12 Senior Schools mwakwayo KJSEA. Nyasaye idhi chike 9 gi boarding gi 3 day schools kaipok piny.
Somali: Ardayda fasalka 9 waxa ay dooranayaan 12 Dugsiyo Sare oo ay jecel yihiin ka hor inta aan la qaban Qiimaynta Waxbarashada Dugsiga Hoose ee Kenya (KJSEA). Hubi inaad doorato 9 dugsiyo jooga iyo 3 dugsiyo maalinle ah sida tilmaamaha ay qoreen.

English: Mokwo Girls Secondary School has launched a biogas project to provide clean cooking energy, reducing dependence on firewood. This initiative promotes sustainable learning and environmental responsibility.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Sekondari ya Mokwo Girls imeanzisha mradi wa biogas kutoa nishati safi ya kupikia, ikiweza kupunguza utegemezi wa kuni. Mpango huu unakuza kujifunza endelevu na wajibu wa mazingira.
Ekegusii: Mokwo Girls Secondary School omokarakiarire omokiruka bw'ogotitie bw'ogotiga, buya bwenjaki bukiraki buya, iyo bura naki omotegeri bw'ogitwenda emokoko. Ekarera iyi esaba omokorwe bw'engiro naki bw'ekigwa.
Dholuo: Mokwo Girls Secondary School en gi piny biogas nyalo timo chuny gi ndar, opogni piny kuom medo kuom choch. Riwruok maniecho ni iweya koda gi kanyakla.
Somali: Dugsiga Sare ee Mokwo Gabdhaha ayaa bilaabay mashruuc biogas ah si loo bixiyo tamar nadiif ah oo lagu kariyo, iyadoo la dhimayo ku tiirsanaanta dhuxusha. Tani waxay kor u qaadaysaa waxbarasho waarta iyo mas'uuliyadda deegaanka.

English: The Kenya Defence Forces is renovating classrooms in 10 primary schools in Laikipia County to enhance education and support peace efforts. Communities are encouraged to engage with schools for improved facilities.
Kiswahili: Jeshi la Ulinzi la Kenya linaregesha madarasa katika shule 10 za msingi katika Kaunti ya Laikipia ili kuboresha elimu na kusaidia juhudi za amani. Jamii zinahimizwa kushirikiana na shule kwa ajili ya kuboresha vifaa.
Ekegusii: Abako bw’akiwabo b’akerubo b’akiwabo b’Kenya baria na boro ikireri mu masomo 10 ekegusii mu Laikipia County bui omokinyani bw’amasomo na bui omogokire bui bw’ogoria. Abaki b’akiirori bakirorane b’antu baibori na mashule bui ikireri egesa.
Dholuo: Kenya Defence Forces ne okony ni thak 10 gi lwere mag chwere mar primary e Laikipia County, kuom duong' mar pendidikan kendo nyal timo chike mag dongo. Ameer gi dhako konyo chunyi e lwere mar chwere ma ok gi nindo.
Somali: Hay'adda Difaaaca Kenya waxay dib u habayn ku sameynaysaa fasallada 10 iskuul oo hoose ee Gobolka Laikipia si ay u hormariso waxbarashada iyo taageerto dadaallada nabadda. Bulshadu waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay la shaqeeyaan iskuulada si loo hagaajiyo adeegyada.

English: All Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) trainers must apply for mandatory licenses or face legal action by June 30, 2026. Submit details of unregistered trainers by April 30, 2026.
Kiswahili: Wafundishaji wote wa Elimu na Mafunzo ya Ufundi na Kiufundi (TVET) lazima waombe leseni za lazima au kukabiliwa na hatua za kisheria kabla ya tarehe 30 Juni, 2026. Wasilisha maelezo ya wafundishaji wasiojiandikisha kabla ya tarehe 30 Aprili, 2026.
Ekegusii: Abaki bose bakiabaki na bota buhare bu tekinolojia na bota bu chikechera (TVET) bakenyere kodori ya badi bende banya bangu biyokaga bwanogusore bwiiga 30, 2026. Gwokengere ogendi bu bakiabaki bataria buhii buorori bwiiga 30, 2026.
Dholuo: Ong'iyo chiegni chalo gi ma ok nyal duto kuom Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) onwandu ma ok nyal chamo katonda no gige go. Timo kata e yo ma ogend gi chalo ng'wenyo mar chalo ok nyal duok nyaka abiro konyo. Konyo chike ma oho ni ogend kuok gi ka aprile 30, 2026.
Somali: Dhammaan tababarayaasha Waxbarashada Farsamada iyo Khibradda (TVET) waa inay codsadaan liisamada khasabka ah ama waxa ay la kulmayaan talaabo sharci ah vóór June 30, 2026. Faahfaahinta tababarayaasha aan diiwaangashanayn soo gudbi ilaa April 30, 2026.

English: Students and parents in Emuhaya Constituency can expect improved school infrastructure as new investments are being rolled out, including classroom construction and renovations in local schools.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi na wazazi katika Jimbo la Emuhaya wanaweza kutarajia kuboreshwa kwa miundombinu ya shule kwani uwekezaji mpya unatekelezwa, ikiwa ni pamoja na ujenzi wa madarasa na ukarabati wa shule za hapa.
Ekegusii: Abanyabere na abagitiri baki Emuhaya Constituency babwete obwakire busembetere bu bachosi, na bwanoria buria bu siyende buliri butongigwaki, buria bu kusiemekana obwakire bwabaka na oburebhaka mu masikoni abaki.
Dholuo: Dhi nyaka joma students kod joma mamoko e Emuhaya Constituency wacho kuom inyal chalo mondo omiyo ruwore gi ineno, ka nane ne oteme chakruok  kod piny mar ulek e shule mar e gima okelo.
Somali: Ardayda iyo waalidiinta gobolka Emuhaya waxay filan karaan horumar ku yimaada kaabayaasha iskuulada iyadoo maalgelin cusub la hirgelinayo, oo ay ku jiraan dhismo iyo dayactir fasallo iskuulada maxalliga ah.

English: All teachers are required to participate in the ongoing superannuation verification exercise to ensure accurate retirement records. Please verify your records to avoid future issues with retirement benefits.
Kiswahili: Walimu wote wanapaswa kushiriki katika zoezi la uthibitishaji wa kustaafu linaloendelea ili kuhakikisha kuwa rekodi za kustaafu ni sahihi. Tafadhali thibitisha rekodi zako ili kuepuka matatizo ya baadaye na mafao ya kustaafu.
Ekegusii: Abaki bwakire banasicha borgesekwa mu kikuyu ching’oti chabere ching’anya chiri goche tuchekire oria. Ndaki emogori yenyu gose naki, gohemba omogori inya omokire.
Dholuo: Dhi yudo gima dhakano nyaka omiyo ong'ere mag anyim mar superannuation kuon gi tugo ng'ato. Koro, joo chieko onge ni yong' tugo ma omiyo omiyo to nyaka timo joma nyaka.
Somali: Dhammaan macalimiinta waxaa looga baahan yahay inay ka qayb qaataan hawsha xaqiijinta hawlgabka ee socota si loo hubiyo rikoorada hawlgabka ee saxda ah. Fadlan xaqiiji rikooradaada si looga fogaado dhibaatooyin mustaqbalka ah oo la xiriirta faa'iidooyinka hawlgabka.

English: St. Ignatius Mukumu Boys High School has launched a fundraising programme to assist Grade 10-12 students facing financial difficulties. Individuals and organizations are encouraged to contribute.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Sekondari ya Wavulana ya St. Ignatius Mukumu imeanzisha mpango wa kukusanya fedha kusaidia wanafunzi wa Darasa la 10-12 wanaokabiliwa na matatizo ya kifedha. Wanindividual na mashirika yanakaribishwa kuchangia.
Ekegusii: Ishule ya St. Ignatius Mukumu Boys yaramakire pogramu ya kuteganya fedha naki chibori bokeria buye Grade 10-12 bwakire kwang'ana na buya. Abaki na masang'ana barokere boborere.
Dholuo: St. Ignatius Mukumu Boys High School anyisime chiegni manyo yo nyaka chungo ma ok anyal mwak 10-12 ka uwach marach ma nyalwa kit. Kaluo dholuo gi dhako chuny jo goyweyo nyaka timo.
Somali: Dugsiga Sare ee St. Ignatius Mukumu waxay bilawday barnaamij ururin lacag ah si ay u caawiso ardayda fasallada 10-12 ee wajahaya dhibaatooyin dhaqaale. Shaqsiyadu iyo ururada waxaa lagu dhiirigelinayaa inay ka qayb qaataan.

English: Parents, encourage your children to explore their unique strengths and interests under the Competency-Based Education system; STEM is one option among many, including arts and sports science.
Kiswahili: Wazazi, wahimizeni watoto wenu kuchunguza nguvu zao na maslahi yao tofauti chini ya mfumo wa Elimu Inayoegemea Ujuzi; STEM ni chaguo moja kati ya nyingi, ikiwa ni pamoja na sanaa na sayansi ya michezo.
Ekegusii: Ababere, munyakenye abana bakenyere okuchekira buya bwabo na migenyo yabo mwachibori ciakiremo; STEM naki eri enyang’ana, keri nibori na yaki omokang’ana bw'ekebaki.
Dholuo: Mokinyi, chonyo nyaka ochiko watoto kuyang' nyiso ma duto ma ok nyal gi kanyat ng'ama oyak nigi Competency-Based Education; STEM ne en joma makelo, kuom arts and sports science.
Somali: Waalidiin, ku dhiirrigeli carruurtiina inay baarayaan awoodahooda gaarka ah iyo danahooda iyada oo lagu jiro nidaamka Waxbarashada Ku Saleysan Awoodaha; STEM waa mid ka mid ah doorashooyin badan, oo ay ku jiraan farshaxanka iyo sayniska cayaaraha.

English: The Education Stakeholders Association of Kenya calls for immediate action on unimplemented recommendations regarding school unrest rather than establishing a new task force.
Kiswahili: Chama cha Wadau wa Elimu Kenya kinatoa wito wa hatua za haraka kuhusu mapendekezo ambayo hayajatekelezwa kuhusu machafuko shuleni badala ya kuunda kikundi kipya kazi.
Ekegusii: Emokiri bwakire buya bwetendere bweng'ene Obwakire buya bw'ensiinya bu Kenya buya mwaki tsibori osibori oria abate naki bwakure ogokire bogena obwena omokabere omeria.
Dholuo: Education Stakeholders Association of Kenya ong'eni konyo nyaka gichamo gi godo gituo mwakanyo gi ma ok nyal jochung' wakwayo kendo ma ok nyal chalo ginyalo nyal.
Somali: Ururka Saamileyda Waxbarashada ee Kenya wuxuu ku baaqayaa in si degdeg ah wax looga qabto talooyinka aan la fulin ee ku saabsan qalalaasaha dugsiyada halkii la sameyn lahaa guddi cusub.

English: Nakuru will host the Rift Valley Primary and Junior Schools Term Two Regional Championships from July 18-22. All participating teams must arrive by July 17, 5:00 p.m. for registration.
Kiswahili: Nakuru itakuwa mwenyeji wa Mashindano ya Mikoa ya Termi ya Pili ya Shule za Msingi na Za Kijuni za Bonde la Ufa kuanzia Julai 18-22. Timu zote zinazoshiriki lazima zifikie kabla ya Julai 17, saa 11:00 jioni kwa ajili ya usajili.
Ekegusii: Nakuru naki oria naki bw'ekitenda bw'ekidasa bw'ogusibori naki bwa Nyakiri chire iki bw'ekodie kisole 18-22. Abagikore bosi batie bw'ogendi bw'ogaki boti bw'ogukora bw'ogenda bw'oku 17, 5:00 ekeria.
Dholuo: Nakuru udhi Rift Valley Primary ne Junior Schools Term Two Regional Championships e kendo duto gi July 18-22. Timbe duto ma ok nyis ukwongo nigi July 17, 5:00 p.m. kuom register.
Somali: Nakuru wuxuu martigelin doonaa Tartanka Labaad ee Degmooyinka Dugsiyada Hoose iyo Kuwa Dhallinyarada ee Rift Valley inta u dhaxaysa 18-22 Luulyo. Dhammaan kooxaha ka qaybgalaya waa inay yimaadaan ugu yaraan 17 Luulyo, saacadda 5:00 galabnimo si ay isu diiwaangeliyaan.

English: Due to unreliable rainfall affecting agriculture, the school feeding programme is at risk. Parents and guardians are encouraged to ensure children have alternative food sources.
Kiswahili: Kutokana na mvua zisizo za kuaminika zinazoathiri kilimo, mpango wa lishe shuleni uko katika hatari. Wazazi na walezi wanahimizwa kuhakikisha watoto wanapata vyanzo vingine vya chakula.
Ekegusii: Naki omokiri omogoya ogwokire omokiri, karanga ya ikemare ya mashure ikwanganani. Abaki na abarugani bakenyanga omokiri batarorire oria ng'ania.
Dholuo: Nenera kuom nyasi marach ma oserdwe kanyal, chike mag yien koro gere. Wazazi kata walonji ne ok nyal kuom piny, to watiyo ma ok oter gi daktari tindo.
Somali: Sababo la xiriira roobab aan la isku halayn karin oo saameynaya beeraha, barnaamijka cunnada iskuulka wuxuu halis ugu jiraa. Waalidiinta iyo ilaaliyayaasha waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay xaqiijiyaan in carruurdu haystaan ilo cunto oo kale.

English: Urgent action is needed to address gulley erosion threatening Nasokol Girls Secondary School. Affected parties are encouraged to collaborate on remedial measures before the rainy season.
Kiswahili: Hatua ya dharura inahitajika kushughulikia mmomonyoko wa ardhi unaotishia Shule ya Sekondari ya Wasichana ya Nasokol. Wahusika wanahimizwa kushirikiana katika kuchukua hatua za kurekebisha kabla ya msimu wa mvua.
Ekegusii: Omosera omotogetire okoranduria goro gori na atigwaki togo Nasokol Girls Secondary School. Abamogori bakenye bakore ogebori obiria bwogendana omong'asi bwogende.
Dholuo: Kwere kuom ndalani manyien to golo gonde miyo gi gulley erosion ma ogero Nasokol Girls Secondary School. Wuodhi ma oter gima otemore nyaka ginyal gi thum mar kuni.
Somali: Tallaabo degdeg ah ayaa loo baahan yahay si wax looga qabto ciriiriga gully-ga oo khatar ku ah Dugsiga Sare ee Gabdhaha Nasokol. Qaybaha saameeysan waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay wada shaqeeyaan qorshayaasha wax ka qabashada ka hor xilliga roobka.

English: Parents and educators are urged to prioritize character building alongside academic achievements to foster holistic education and prevent unrest in schools.
Kiswahili: Wazazi na walimu wanasisitizwa kuweka kipaumbele katika kujenga tabia sambamba na mafanikio ya kitaaluma ili kukuza elimu kamili na kuzuia machafuko shuleni.
Ekegusii: Bazukuru nakiabwaki omokiri omokiri boberane omotirori bw'ogokire bwokigo buachire buogetire omotigoru naki igokire naki kianaki obokoreri mu masomoro.
Dholuo: Kagango gi joma chuni ne ok nyal pende ma okonyo ngima, kendo ohalo bende karuok maber kuom piye mar jendani, e golo ng'eyo.
Somali: Waalidiinta iyo macallimiinta ayaa lagu boorinayaa in ay mudnaanta siiyaan dhismaha dabeecadda si la isku dhisayo waxbarashada oo dhamaystiran iyo ka hortagga dibadbaxyada iskuulada.

English: 293,869 students have been successfully placed in universities, TVET institutions, and colleges for the 2026/2027 academic year. For details on your placement, check with KUCCPS or your institution.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi 293,869 wamepangwa kwa mafanikio katika vyuo vikuu, mashirika ya TVET, na vyuo kwa mwaka wa masomo 2026/2027. Kwa maelezo kuhusu upangaji wako, angalia na KUCCPS au taasisi yako.
Ekegusii: Abantu 293,869 bataranegwa omokirigori mu masomoo, TVET, na koleji mu mwaka wa masomo 2026/2027. Omosaritie waku na omotenda nyuaboni, oreka na KUCCPS ng’ana oria koleji yako.
Dholuo: 293,869 nyaka wachiko kaka gichako e yunivesiti, TVET marach, kod koleji kwom mwaka 2026/2027. Kanyakore gi ngima mar wachni, wrie KUCCPS kata yore gi ndalo.
Somali: 293,869 arday ayaa si guul leh loogu qoondeeyey jaamacadaha, hay'adaha TVET, iyo kulliyadaha sanadka tacliinta 2026/2027. Faahfaahin ku saabsan qoondeyntaada, la xiriir KUCCPS ama hay'addaada.

English: Taxpayers are urged to report any suspected payroll irregularities to the Ministry of Public Service as the government investigates potential fraud and mismanagement in the public payroll system.
Kiswahili: Wanalipakodi wanahimizwa kuripoti yeyote anayeaminika kuwa na kasoro katika malipo ya mishahara kwa Wizara ya Huduma za Umma wakati serikali inapochunguza udanganyifu na usimamizi mbaya katika mfumo wa malipo ya umma.
Ekegusii: Abakora emihigo baraireriinjire kuhabogorere onyonche oria nanga enkaibori mu Bakati bu Mwaki ya Public Service, nikore oria obwakiri bwa oria bwaki bwaki naki kare ikiri naki.
Dholuo: Kweyo chiegni ota to ogend gi anyango maler ma ok ding' gima piyo ng'ato e Ministry of Public Service, ka serikali naki gima jogo e kanyadongo ma ok aoro ni pe to ni matendo maricho e yiengi.
Somali: Canshuur-bixiyayaasha waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay soo sheegaan wax kasta oo lagu tuhunsan yahay khilaaf ku saabsan mushaarka wasaaradda Adeegga Dadweynaha maadaama dowladda ay baarayso musuqmaasuq iyo maareyn xumo suurtagal ah ee nidaamka mushaarka dadweynaha.

English: Over 21,000 junior secondary schools will receive interactive smart boards to enhance digital learning as part of the government's Competency-Based Education curriculum initiative.
Kiswahili: Ziada ya shule za sekondari za chini 21,000 zitapata kwenye matumizi ubao wa smart wa kuingiliana ili kuboresha masomo ya kidijitali kama sehemu ya mpango wa serikali wa mtaala wa Elimu Inayozingatia Ufanisi.
Ekegusii: Bwakire bwakubiri na 21,000 bwesikuli bujunior bwana buya bwiya bairogo bwanogere ichigori cha digital learning mokiri buya bwakire buhige bwa govana bwakebere bwekubetere bu Competency-Based Education.
Dholuo: Ang'wen 21,000 makao magero mag junior secondary bende ne en gambo mar interactive smart boards kuom nyalo pwodhi digital learning kuchoko programa mar government ma nyal nyise chike joma jothurwa.
Somali: In ka badan 21,000 dugsiyo hoose oo dhexe ayaa heli doona looxyada smart-ka ah si loo xoojiyo barashada dijitaalka ah, taasoo qayb ka ah hindada waxbarashada ku saleysan xirfadaha ee dowladda.

English: Education stakeholders are urging for increased investment and support for student innovation in Kenya's Competency-Based Curriculum to help young innovators turn ideas into viable products.
Kiswahili: Wadau wa elimu wanahimiza kuongezeka kwa uwekezaji na msaada kwa ubunifu wa wanafunzi katika Mitaala ya Msingi ya Upelelezi nchini Kenya ili kuwasaidia vijana wanaobuni kugeuza mawazo yao kuwa bidhaa zinazoweza kufanya kazi.
Ekegusii: Abashisye b'eshuri batarerera ubwakire bw'ekireri n'ekibori gitokire buya buya mw'ekiga kya g'ekigori cha Kenya, buya erekere banye ebinyango kubone abanyaki kitirigana bategire ebinyang'oi n'ekirori.
Dholuo: Ng'ato ma awinjo magi gi nyiso ni ing'wegi oweteye ka owet koro nyaka chwech ang'wen e Kenya gi Competency-Based Curriculum, ng'ato mayotore ang'wen tuch mokwongo kendo oket gi.
Somali: Howlwaddii waxbarashada ayaa ku baaqaya in la kordhiyo maalgelinta iyo taageerada cusub ee ardayda ku saleysan Barnaamijka Waxbarashada ee Awoodda Leh si ay gacan uga geystaan in hal-abuurada dhallinyarada ay fikradahooda u beddelaan alaab dhab ah.

English: Universities encourage students to embrace entrepreneurship, balancing academics with small businesses to support themselves during their studies.
Kiswahili: Vyuo vikuu vinahimiza wanafunzi kukumbatia ujasiriamali, wakifanya mchanganyiko wa masomo na biashara ndogo ili kujiwezesha wakati wa masomo yao.
Ekegusii: Nchamokire ikaire mabo naki ochieng' buya, bataria omosare na buya bwaki naki ogenda emong'ere baria buya ore moke.
Dholuo: Makaroo nyaka yieng' can duto mondo wadhi nyaka entrepreneurship, kony joma yieng' gi nitie mar business maber to konyi mar jiwuong' kendo odhiem.
Somali: Jaamacadaha waxay dhiirigelinayaan ardayda inay qaataan ganacsi, iyaga oo dheellitirinaya waxbarashada iyo ganacsiyada yaryar si ay naftooda uga taageeraan inta ay baranayaan.

English: Parents and guardians in Mwala Sub-county are urged to monitor and prevent drug abuse among youth to combat rising defilement and school dropouts. Take action now to protect future generations.
Kiswahili: Wazazi na walezi katika Wilaya ya Mwala wanashauriwa kufuatilia na kuzuia matumizi mabaya ya dawa miongoni mwa vijana ili kukabiliana na kuongezeka kwa udhalilishaji na wanafunzi wanaoacha shule. Chukua hatua sasa ili kulinda vizazi vijavyo.
Ekegusii: Baba na mama baki Mwala Sub-county, mwakiibokere naki onyore na omotigania omokiri buya muijagi bw'ekirenda naki okulana osimbori. Naki naki kiende egeserere geitung'ani.
Dholuo: Dhaani mag piny Mwala pi ng’ato e tek gi chike kwach ng’ama koro kwachuma gono k’one maadong’ gi ng’ato, to golo dhóbiro gi ng’ato mang’won. Konyi ng’ato now to ng’ato chike lok.
Somali: Waalidiinta iyo daryeelayaasha ku sugan degmada Mwala waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay la socdaan oo ay ka hortagaan isticmaalka daroogada dhallinyarada si loo dardargeliyo ka hortagga kufsiga iyo ka qaybgalka dugsiga oo dhicay. Qaado tallaabo hadda si aad u ilaaliso jiilasha mustaqbalka.

English: KCA University has launched a Korean Language Centre in Ruaraka to enhance graduates' global competitiveness. Students are encouraged to enroll and take advantage of upcoming scholarships and partnerships.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha KCA kimeanzisha Kituo cha Kiswahili cha Korea huko Ruaraka ili kuboresha ushindani wa kimataifa wa wahitimu. Wanafunzi wanahimizwa kujiandikisha na kufaidika na ufadhili na ushirikiano utakaojitokeza.
Ekegusii: KCA University omokire Omoige akekorino ya Koree ku Ruaraka bushere buya buya buya abeereri bateganeri. Abarekari barianoki obwakare bae ahaki ahanokire namae na buya bwake.
Dholuo: KCA University okedhi Korean Language Centre e Ruaraka kuom pinje mar graduati. Wanj jedo dhok ma losore gi ng'ato mi mwak gi juma mar scholarships maber kod partnerships.
Somali: Jaamacadda KCA waxay furtay Xarunta Luqadda Kooriyaanka ee Ruaraka si ay kor ugu qaaddo tartanka caalamiga ah ee ardayda ka qalinjebisa. Ardayda waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay isqoraan oo ka faa'iidaystaan deeqaha waxbarasho iyo iskaashiyada soo socda.

English: Parents and educators, be aware: children's behavior is influenced by political actions and rhetoric. Model positive values to counteract negative behaviors observed from public figures.
Kiswahili: Wazazi na walimu, fuateni kwa makini: tabia za watoto zinaathiriwa na vitendo na maneno ya kisiasa. Onyesha maadili chanya ili kupunguza tabia mbaya zinazoonyeshwa na viongozi wa umma.
Ekegusii: Abakira naki kosi, muigire: omogori bw’ogotigana buya kosi bwosi buya bonga bwaki buya bosi ha osero. Geria omogori mwaki omogori buya bosi buya bosi obore bwaki osero.
Dholuo: Niende gi mawuok, yoro: chumbi kuom konyo moloyo kendo magi e yo keth. Nindo duto ma ok ojgo chumbi ma yoregi e ji duto.
Somali: Waalidka iyo macalimiinta, ogow: dhaqanka carruurta waxa saameeya falalka siyaasadeed iyo hadallada. Muuji qiimaha wanaagsan si aad uga hortagto dhaqamada xun ee laga dareemayo dadka dadweynaha ah.

English: The Murang'a County Government has ended the ECDE teachers' strike, ensuring better salaries, permanent jobs, and a four-year salary review program starting July.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Kaunti ya Murang'a imemaliza mgomo wa walimu wa ECDE, ikihakikisha mishahara bora, ajira za kudumu, na mpango wa kupitia mishahara kila mwaka kuanzia Julai.
Ekegusii: Omoio wa Murang'a oiga oseriania obwakire bw'abarimu ba ECDE, buya nakinyang'a omokireri, emoko ya ng'eno eya mwabere, na omogoti wa omokireri buya bwokiyera bwakire isubuya 4 omokong'endo omokireri omoya.
Dholuo: Oganda Marang'a owang'ni okonyo gi chuo mag ECDE, kuom gima ochung' ka oket gi dako mag ng'ato, jodong' gi chuo mag nachako, kendo ng'e gima oganda mag chuo otik kanyalo miyo kendo mar mwere.
Somali: Dowladda Murang'a waxay soo afjartay shaqo joojintii macallimiinta ECDE, iyada oo la hubinayo mushahar ka wanaagsan, shaqooyin joogto ah, iyo barnaamij dib-u-eegis mushahar afar sano ah oo bilaabanaya bisha Luulyo.

English: Urgent repairs are needed for the damaged perimeter fence at Arya, MM Shah, and Lake Primary Schools in Kisumu Central to ensure safety and security. Constituency leadership is urged to act swiftly.
Kiswahili: Matengenezo ya haraka yanahitajika kwa uzio wa shule wa Arya, MM Shah, na Lake Primary Schools katika Kisumu Central ili kuhakikisha usalama na ulinzi. Uongozi wa eneo unashauriwa kuchukua hatua haraka.
Ekegusii: Omboro ogwakire buya buya keri ebira ya peremita na Arya, MM Shah, na Lake Primary Schools ka Kisumu Central, omokire buya na obwakire bwakire. Abakeri ba constituency batianyire buya ogenda.
Dholuo: Nyakwar eyo magi e chieng' kare ma otieno kuom piny gi jigang' gi godo e Arya, MM Shah, to nyaka Lake Primary Schools e Kisumu Central to yudo dholuo kendo chamo. Okwong' ji kwot gi weche kendo oting'o nyaka ng'ato.
Somali: Dayactir degdeg ah ayaa loo baahan yahay xarunta go'an ee dhaawacmay ee iskuulada Arya, MM Shah, iyo Lake Primary ee Kisumu Central si loo hubiyo amniga. Hoggaanka deegaanka waxay ku dhiirrigelinayaan inay si dhaqso ah u falgalaan.

English: Former students of Oruba Boys High School are encouraged to regularly engage with their alma mater to support improvements in infrastructure and academic standards.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa zamani wa Shule ya Upili ya Oruba Boys wanahimizwa kushiriki mara kwa mara na shule yao ya zamani ili kusaidia kuboresha miundombinu na viwango vya kitaaluma.
Ekegusii: Ababere bu Oruba Boys High School bataraka kugarukire nyakong’ene gakiere gabo bu soronchori naki omogori bu bwakiri bwensikati na benshigano.
Dholuo: Bonde mag Oruba Boys High School nochiemo nitie ka chunyi kod joma okel pi daktari megi gi ma okonyo chuny.
Somali: Ardaydii hore ee dugsiga sare ee Oruba Boys waxaa lagula talinayaa inay si joogto ah ula shaqeeyaan dugsigoodii si ay u taageeraan horumarinta kaabayaasha iyo heerarka waxbarasho.

English: Universities in Kenya are preparing for the transition of the first Competency-Based Education (CBE) cohort in 2029. Institutions must enhance collaboration for inclusive education and support learners with disabilities.
Kiswahili: Vyuo vikuu nchini Kenya vinaandaa mpito wa kundi la kwanza la Elimu ya Msingi Kulingana na Ufanisi (CBE) mwaka 2029. Taasisi zinapaswa kuongeza ushirikiano kwa ajili ya elimu jumuishi na kusaidia wanafunzi wenye ulemavu.
Ekegusii: Masomo g’ewanjabi eKenya nakiugenda oreka oria tindi ugenda oreka igenda ya Competency-Based Education (CBE) kosi 2029. Mikere igaigana bwana omokireri osuga okebere omokire oria bwana omokireri naki nakiogenda.
Dholuo: Makal Kanyugo e Kenya nigi kwa chako mar yawa mar sa' joma ɓer tic ng'ielo mar Competency-Based Education (CBE) e 2029. Jomoko nyaka golo makuoyruok e wango mar loro ng'iyo kendo wachien joma chuny.
Somali: Jaamacadaha Kenya waxay ku diyaar garoobayaan isbeddelka kooxdii ugu horreysay ee Waxbarashada Ku Salaysan Aqoonta (CBE) sanadka 2029. Hay'adaha waa inay kor u qaadaan iskaashiga si loo helo waxbarasho dhameystiran iyo taageero waxbarasho oo loogu talagalay ardayda naafada ah.

English: The Public Service Commission (PSC) is to be summoned by Parliament to address concerns over the irregular recruitment of 28 Foreign Service Cadets.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma za Umma (PSC) itaitwa na Bunge kujibu maswali kuhusu kuajiriwa kwa kawaida kwa Cadets 28 wa Huduma ya Kigeni.
Ekegusii: Komisheni ya Abanene (PSC) ikarangi bwogori bui Parlemendi okuhabereza ekerori naki obwakire bwogori bweakire bwokunyora 28 Abacakurani boro Borabu.
Dholuo: Public Service Commission (PSC) ne owinjo e Parlamendi kuom gige gi chalo mag recruitment mar 28 Foreign Service Cadets ka jiok.
Somali: Xafiiska Adeegga Dadweynaha (PSC) ayaa baarlamaanka lagu casuumay si uu uga jawaabo walaac ku saabsan shaqaaleynta aan caadiga ahayn ee 28 Askar Cadet Kaalmo Caalami.

English: Students placed in 43 public universities via KUCCPS are eligible to apply for government scholarships. Apply through the Higher Education Financing portal after receiving your admission letter.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi waliopewa nafasi katika vyuo vikuu 43 vya umma kupitia KUCCPS wanastahili kuomba mikopo ya serikali. Omba kupitia lango la Ufadhili wa Elimu ya Juu baada ya kupokea barua yako ya kujiunga.
Ekegusii: Abigere baki baki 43 obwakire bueri naki KUCCPS nibokire buigane bunyerere bwa serikali. Bwakire burokore buya Higher Education Financing portal nyang'ore nabwire buya admission letter yanyu.
Dholuo: Anyango ma wathogo e 43 public universities kuom KUCCPS ng'ani otagni kuom scholarships ma government. Otiyogo chuo gi Higher Education Financing portal kendo utimore ng'ama udwaro admission letter.
Somali: Ardayda lagu soo dhaweeyey 43 jaamacadaha dowliga ah ee KUCCPS waxay xaq u leeyihiin inay codsadaan deeqo waxbarasho oo dowladeed. Codso adigoo adeegsanaya portal-ka Maaliyadda Tacliinta Sare ka dib markaad hesho warqaddaada soo dhoweynta.

English: The KUCCPS proposes raising entry qualifications for teacher training to improve education quality and justify better salaries. Higher standards are essential for aspiring teachers.
Kiswahili: KUCCPS inapendekeza kuongeza vigezo vya kuingia kwenye mafunzo ya ualimu ili kuboresha ubora wa elimu na kuhalalisha mishahara bora. Viwango vya juu ni muhimu kwa walimu wapya wanaotafuta fursa.
Ekegusii: KUCCPS omokanya bw'ogekire abwaki bwanariga bugetege buya bwanariga bosi buijire obwakire buya bwomboka bwanariga buya bwanani. Ogorogoti buya bwaki bori bwere kenyora buya obwakire bwanariga.
Dholuo: KUCCPS nyal kuom ka gik inde oting' e golo ma ewinjruok duto kuonde gi piny mar nyasaye kendo wacho mar konyo piny. Gik ma okinyi duto nyaka jibedni kuom jokelogi.
Somali: KUCCPS waxay soo jeedinaysaa in kor loo qaado shuruudaha gelitaanka tababarka macallimiinta si loo hagaajiyo tayada waxbarashada iyo in la xaqiijiyo mushaar fiican. Heerarka sare waa lagama maarmaan macallimiinta mustaqbalka.

English: Malava Boys High School remains the qualified representative for the National Secondary Schools Games after the dismissal of Chesamisi Boys' appeal. Keep an eye on updates from the Supreme Jury.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Upili ya Malava Boys inabaki kuwa mwakilishi halali wa Michezo ya Shule za Sekondari za Kitaifa baada ya kufutwa kwa rufaa ya Chesamisi Boys. Fuata taarifa kutoka kwa Jopo Kuu.
Ekegusii: Malava Boys High School ni omokiriani omogori oregotebwaki ogega bwae obokiriecha Chesamisi Boys. Nakiagire buya naki ogete obwakirumi bwakire bwaki.
Dholuo: Malava Boys High School nono nigi gi kwang' dhiang' ma ikwalo kaluwore kanyo kuom National Secondary Schools Games nyaka Chesamisi Boys' appeal ne oweyore. Nyisogi maler kuom makonji ma nyal tek nyaka ng'ato.
Somali: Dugsi Sare ee Malava Boys wuxuu sii ahaanayaa wakiilka ku habboon ee Ciyaaraha Dugsiyada Sare Qaranka ka dib markii la diiday racfaan ka yimid Chesamisi Boys. La soco wararka ka imaanaya Garsoorka Sare.

English: A fundraising event for retired headteacher Paul Kimutai Koech's hospital and funeral expenses will be held on July 17. His burial is scheduled for July 21 in Cheswerta Village.
Kiswahili: Tukio la kuchangisha fedha kwa ajili ya gharama za hospitali na mazishi ya mstaafu mkuu wa shule Paul Kimutai Koech litafanyika tarehe 17 Julai. Mazishi yake yanatarajiwa kufanyika tarehe 21 Julai katika Kijiji cha Cheswerta.
Ekegusii: Ekerandi ya kuziria emomoi ya otagari umosi Paul Kimutai Koech ekerire tekaraka na July 17. Omoechoriori bwakire buya July 21 oria Cheswerta.
Dholuo: Odhok gi fund e tich mamoko ma paach Paul Kimutai Koech ng'eyo nyaka oter 17. Konyo mag e yore 21 e Cheswerta Village.
Somali: Dhacdo lacag ururin ah oo loogu talagalay kharashka isbitaalka iyo aaska macallin hore Paul Kimutai Koech ayaa la qaban doonaa July 17. Aaskiisa waxa la qorsheeyey in la sameeyo July 21 tuulada Cheswerta.

English: Youth are urged to reject manipulation by politicians offering handouts. Embrace peace and focus on building a better future.
Kiswahili: Vijana wanah encouraged kukataa udanganyifu kutoka kwa wabunge wanaotoa misaada. Kubali amani na zingatia kujenga maisha bora.
Ekegusii: Abaguita bakenye bagenyere kuchere kereri naki bikore baki bato gaki jenda. Beria osokoti naki ogokirenda osoroki ijogori.
Dholuo: Nyar ades gi tee gi kare mokwongo ka politiko ruothor handouts. Tingo piny gi ketho kaka ogendani.
Somali: Dhalinyarada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay diidaan ka faa'iidaysiga siyaasiyiinta bixiya gunooyinka. Qabso nabadda oo diiradda saar dhisidda mustaqbalka wanaagsan.

English: The appeal hearing for Kisumu Boys against St. Mary's Yala regarding age-ineligible players will take place on July 15 at 9:00 a.m. All interested parties should attend.
Kiswahili: Sikumbusho la rufaa kwa Kisumu Boys dhidi ya St. Mary's Yala kuhusu wachezaji wasio na umri sahihi litafanyika tarehe 15 Julai saa 3:00 asubuhi. Vyote vilivyo na nia vinapaswa kuhudhuria.
Ekegusii: Ateka ya kugechezia Kisumu Boys buya St. Mary's Yala nyang'ere maige aendi webia ikorere mokiri 15 getabu 9:00 kumakwere. Abamokirani bosi burori bateganeri.
Dholuo: Ong'ere mar kisumu boys ma ok oher ni St. Mary's Yala kanyidha ng'ato maguruok ki 15, Okwak 9:00 aam. Wuodho wacho tich ok wacho piny.
Somali: Dhageysiga racfaanka ee Kisumu Boys ka dhan ah St. Mary's Yala oo ku saabsan ciyaartoyda aan ku habboonayn da'da ayaa dhici doona July 15 saacadda 9:00 subaxnimo. Dhammaan dhinacyada daneynaya waa inay yimaadeen.

English: Students who have changed their mobile phone number must update their registered number with HELB to regain access to services via *642#. Contact HELB customer support with your ID number and new number to proceed.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi ambao wamebadilisha nambari zao za simu wanapaswa kuongeza nambari zao zilizoregistriwa pamoja na HELB ili kupata huduma kupitia *642#. Wasiliana na huduma kwa wateja wa HELB kwa kutumia nambari yako ya kitambulisho na nambari mpya ili kuendelea.
Ekegusii: Abesabere bakiria omokiri bagia kiongoni bw'ene bwanjige bwanaririre bw'ana HELB nkioria bw'eyenya bwananga na *642#. Kigonzi HELB omogori gendogo buse naki abwakira naki bw'ena bw'ogae.
Dholuo: Jalwombo mag dong'ni joma ok gi chamo chuno mwal bende giyek gi chamo mar HELB kik vayogo chinyuru kod *642#. Konyo HELB ngeyo joma negi ID chuo kod chamo chako kuom nyisech.
Somali: Ardayda beddelay lambarkooda taleefanka waa in ay cusboonaysiiyaan lambarkooda diiwaangashan ee HELB si ay u helaan adeegyada iyada oo loo marayo *642#. La xiriir taageerada macaamiisha HELB adiga oo wata lambarkaaga aqoonsiga iyo lambarka cusub si aad u sii waddo.

English: PCEA Mai-a-Ihii Booth Boys High School is closed indefinitely. All students must be picked up by their parents immediately due to serious allegations involving the principal and BOM chair.
Kiswahili: Shule ya PCEA Mai-a-Ihii Booth Boys High imefungwa kuanzia sasa. Wanafunzi wote wanapaswa kuchukuliwa na wazazi wao mara moja kutokana na madai mazito yanayohusisha mkuu wa shule na mwenyekiti wa BOM.
Ekegusii: PCEA Mai-a-Ihii Booth Boys High School eria ogoti. Abere bose batoria na abandu babo naki konu bwebwa buya bwaki na boti buya buya buya omogoti na BOM chair.
Dholuo: PCEA Mai-a-Ihii Booth Boys High School ni ng'we ka jomoko. Jotemo nyalo chako byok kendo konyo ne joma nyaka chamo kendo nyaka marach bang' wang'ni kuom jomoko kendo BOM chair.
Somali: Dugsiga Sare ee PCEA Mai-a-Ihii Booth Boys wuu xiranyahay muddo aan la sheegin. Dhammaan ardayda waa in waalidiintooda ay si degdeg ah u soo qaadaan sababo la xiriira cabashooyin culus oo ka dhanka ah maamulaha iyo guddoomiyaha guddiga maamulka.

English: Laikipia University will hold an Academic Open Week from July 20–24, 2026, for students to resolve academic issues. Students are encouraged to attend with parents or guardians for support.
Kiswahili: Chuo Kikuu cha Laikipia kitafanya Wiki ya Wazi ya Kimasomo kuanzia Julai 20 hadi 24, 2026, kwa wanafunzi kutatua masuala ya kimasomo. Wanafunzi wanahimizwa kuhudhuria pamoja na wazazi au walezi kwa msaada.
Ekegusii: Laikipia University ikore osibori ya Mugeti omokonyi bw'ekegendene buya bw'oseanja bw'ikoma 20–24, 2026, buya buinterni ogenda buya kosiia omogori. Abakosi bakenya gukorane ne nyamachekire babo kana ibogoya buya bagerane.
Dholuo: Laikipia University e bonyo Academic Open Week mar July 20–24, 2026, wan gi dhur gi kanyakla. Wanafunzi nyaka kuyang’ gi kaka kata gi chiemo ma konyo.
Somali: Jaamacadda Laikipia waxay qaban doontaa Toddobaadka Furitaanka Tacliinta laga bilaabo Luulyo 20–24, 2026, si ardaydu u xalliyaan arrimaha tacliinta. Ardayda waxaa laga dhiirrigelinayaa inay la soo diriryaan waalidiinta ama ilaalinta si ay u helaan taageero.

English: Parents are urged to take responsibility for instilling discipline in their children to combat the rise of student unrest in schools.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanashauriwa kuchukua jukumu la kuimarisha nidhamu kwa watoto wao ili kupambana na kuongezeka kwa machafuko ya wanafunzi shuleni.
Ekegusii: Ababere baria bakanire kubwateka omonene mu masinde ya abana bo gukeng'ana na obwakiri bw'amatoke mu masomo.
Dholuo: Wang'ni owinjruok ka udi timbe gi modhuro mar abor ne omer ka imar yore e pinje mamok gi lul.
Somali: Waayeelada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay mas'uuliyad qaataan si ay udhigaal dhisaan carruurtooda, si loola dagaallamo kororka qaraxyada ardayda ee iskuulada.

English: The Teachers Service Commission (TSC) is urged to fast-track promotions for over 20,000 qualified teachers to enhance career progression.
Kiswahili: Tume ya Huduma za Walimu (TSC) inasihiwa kuharakisha kupandishwa kwa zaidi ya walimu 20,000 waliostahili ili kuboresha maendeleo ya kazi.
Ekegusii: Omoige bu Ticha Diri (TSC) oborakire oria buya bu sosi ogenda 20,000 bu ticha bateganane buemokire oria riobo.
Dholuo: Wang'ni Teachers Service Commission (TSC) nyal riek mar kanyo piny ni ofe 20,000 ma ok oyweyo kuom gima giwacho mag kwa.
Somali: Komishanka Adeegga Macallimiinta (TSC) waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay dedejiso kor u qaadista in ka badan 20,000 macallin oo aqoonsan si loo hormariyo horumarka xirfadeed.

English: Students placed by KUCCPS consider course availability, costs, and requirements before transferring universities. Transfer applications will be accepted during the designated transfer window; eligibility criteria apply.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi waliochaguliwa na KUCCPS wanapaswa kuzingatia upatikanaji wa kozi, gharama, na vigezo kabla ya kuhamia vyuo vingine. Maombi ya uhamisho yatachukuliwa wakati wa kipindi maalum cha uhamisho; vigezo vya kustahiki vitatumika.
Ekegusii: Abanene baki ku KUCCPS batarora igori, mirongo, na eng'era bosi mbere batoraki ore bajiingira mabu. Ababere bataraki bosi bwakira na miyo ya abaroti bwaki orokiri; emokiri ya abaki ibwaki isangacha.
Dholuo: Okwoth gi KUCCPS nyaka kanyo kwer mar kachon, wendo, kod iting' ma ok nyal chamo ng'ato bende oyieyo. Kachien chayo omiyo ikelo ng'ato mokuongo; ng'ato ma ok ng'iyo nyal chamo.
Somali: Ardayda lagu qoondeeyay KUCCPS waxay ka fiirsadaan helitaanka koorsooyinka, kharashaadka, iyo shuruudaha ka hor inta aysan u guurin jaamacadaha. Codsiyada guurka waxaa la aqbali doonaa intii lagu jiro waqtiga loogu talagalay guurka; shuruudaha u-qalmitaanka ayaa jira.

English: Parents are encouraged to support their children's career interests instead of pushing them towards medicine and teaching, which may not align with students' passions.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanah encouraged kusaidia maslahi ya taaluma ya watoto wao badala ya kuwabeba kuelekea tiba na ufundishaji, ambayo inaweza kutokubaliana na mapenzi ya wanafunzi.
Ekegusii: Abakire batarore buya bagabire emokiri bw'imbokere y'abana babo, naki bataragireka abenyi bami bw'akaranga na kw'ensenge, omokiri omokinyake oria bobori nyasa.
Dholuo: Kik joma nobiro konyo loso ma ok nyaka winj gi chako ma jomoko, kendo eyo nyaka kibiro gi tich ma ok nyaka piny kuom, ka wacho koyi juchwe.
Somali: Waalidka waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay taageeraan danaha xirfadeed ee carruurtooda halkii ay ku cadaadin lahaayeen caafimaadka iyo barashada, taasoo laga yaabo in aanay waafaqsaneyn xiisaha ardayda.

English: Former Egerton University students recognize Kimani Njoroge for his exceptional teaching in coding and technology, shaping many careers in software and IT fields.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wa zamani wa Chuo Kikuu cha Egerton wanamtambua Kimani Njoroge kwa ufundishaji wake bora katika uandaaji wa programu na teknolojia, akikimu taaluma nyingi katika sekta ya programu na teknolojia ya habari.
Ekegusii: Abasomoi b’Egerton University baranga Kimani Njoroge k’ogendanye obwaki mu kutendekera bakora na tekinolojia, bakiibire mbochaki ebikora bingi mu software na IT.
Dholuo: Masomo mar Egerton University osetinge Kimani Njoroge kuom tege mag ng'iyo e coding kod technology, koro oseyudo thuolo duto e software kod IT.
Somali: Ardaydii hore ee Jaamacadda Egerton ayaa aqoonsaday Kimani Njoroge sababtoo ah waxbarashadiisa sarreysa ee ku saabsan koodhka iyo tiknoolajiyada, isagoo qaabeynaya xirfado badan oo ku saabsan software iyo IT.

English: Teachers are advised that the Kenya National Union of Teachers (KNUT) may call for a strike if the proposed five-year renewal of practising licences by the Teachers Service Commission is not withdrawn.
Kiswahili: Walimu wanashauriwa kwamba Chama cha Kitaifa cha Walimu wa Kenya (KNUT) kinaweza kuita mgomo ikiwa mapendekezo ya upya leseni za kufanya kazi kwa miaka mitano na Tume ya Huduma za Walimu hayataondolewa.
Ekegusii: Abagereki baria naki naki Kenya National Union of Teachers (KNUT) naki bataria kusiire omokirima kwe mibea ya itano ibokire yebetwe omotiragani wa Teachers Service Commission omoma buya.
Dholuo: Ahenyinyi para gima Kenya National Union of Teachers (KNUT) en bende nyal timore gi chalo ma chonruok 5 kuonde makare mar konyo ng'ato ka licens mar jumba kod Teachers Service Commission awach ni ok nyal otim.
Somali: Macallimiinta waxaa la soo jeedinayaa in Ururka Qaranka Macallimiinta Kenya (KNUT) uu ku dhawaaqi karo dibadbax haddii soo jeedinta shanta sano ee cusboonaysiinta shatiyada shaqo ee Golaha Adeegga Macallimiinta aysan la noqon.

English: Learners are urged to respect the law and engage in peaceful dispute resolution, as the courts uphold justice and accountability, deterring violence and ensuring community safety.
Kiswahili: Wanafunzi wanahimizwa kuheshimu sheria na kushiriki katika kutafuta suluhu za amani, kwani mahakama zinaimarisha haki na uwajibikaji, zikizuia vurugu na kuhakikisha usalama wa jamii.
Ekegusii: Abagere mameranage omogaka na bagenge omokang'oya osiebaki, naki omokama mong'era gufundukire omotete na ogogoto, omorogoti oriri ogwedori naki obwakire bw'omokere.
Dholuo: Jang'adi remb osiepna kuom chak mar law, kendo ok nyalo endore oko ni goyi, awalong' mar justice kendo accountability, to gichung' violence kod giyogi safar mar jamii.
Somali: Ardayda waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay ixtiraamaan sharciga oo ay ka qaybqaataan xallinta khilaafaadka si nabad ah, maxkamaduhuna waxay ilaalinayaan cadaaladda iyo xisaabtanka, taasoo ka hortagta rabshadaha isla markaana hubinaysa ammaanka bulshada.

English: Political leaders are urged to serve as role models for the youth and avoid incitement. Youth are encouraged to reject harmful practices and prioritize peace for a better future.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa kisiasa wanashauriwa kuwa mfano mzuri kwa vijana na kuepuka uchochezi. Vijana wanahimizwa kukataa vitendo vya kuharibu na kuweka mbele amani kwa ajili ya siku zijazo nzuri.
Ekegusii: Abanyabaki bakiire bosi batie bakiore omokosi bwakire moshere omwaki na bugeto bwabaki. Abakosi bakiiri buaki buhende kosi noseri ne bwania buhoro bwaki.
Dholuo: Jogoo mar serikali wan moko nikech konyo ni jomok wacho maler e piny. Jomok nyaka isekanyo mitego ma wacho maler, kendo noting'o duto ka ng'ato uyie maginchi ma yie.
Somali: Hoggaamiyayaasha siyaasadeed waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay noqdaan tusaale iyo in aysan kicin. Dhalinyarada waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay diidaan dhaqanada waxyeelada leh iyo in ay mudnaanta siiyaan nabadda si mustaqbal wanaagsan u helaan.

English: The Irish Government has expanded the Back-to-School Clothing and Footwear Allowance to include preschool children aged 2 and 3, benefiting an estimated 37,000 additional families.
Kiswahili: Serikali ya Ireland imepanua Msaada wa Vazi na Viatu vya Kurudi Shuleni ili kujumuisha watoto wa shule ya awali wenye umri wa miaka 2 na 3, ikinufaisha familia zisizopungua 37,000 zaidi.
Ekegusii: H serikali ya Ishiime yaeng'ereire omokireri ogwakamano gose gobwaki omogori buya na mbega buya kanda 2 na 3, buya ekere omogori 37,000 bwantigani.
Dholuo: Gavumenti mar Ireland yong' kod Back-to-School Clothing and Footwear Allowance kuom watoto ma oketi kuom chiegni 2 kendo 3, kendo neno kanyakla 37,000 onyalo.
Somali: Dowladda Irishga waxay ballaarisay lacagta dharka iyo kabaha loogu talagalay qofka soo lugeynaya dugsiga si loo darto carruurta xanaanada ku jirta da'da 2 iyo 3, taasoo ka faa'iideysanaysa qiyaastii 37,000 qoys oo dheeraad ah.

English: A search is ongoing for Yvonne Wanjiru, a Grade 10 student from Murang'a County who went missing after being expelled from St Charles Lwanga High School. Please report any sightings to the Kandara Police Station.
Kiswahili: Utafutaji unaendelea kwa Yvonne Wanjiru, mwanafunzi wa daraja la 10 kutoka Kaunti ya Murang'a ambaye alipotea baada ya kutimuliwa kutoka Shule ya Sekondari ya St Charles Lwanga. Tafadhali ripoti uwepo wowote kwa Kituo cha Polisi Kandara.
Ekegusii: Oria egokoreka Yvonne Wanjiru, omokere omogori omokere omogeno ocha Murang'a, oyo oborwanyane nyang'anu orokere buya ku St Charles Lwanga High School. Naki bwakire busire ing'ina bota buya ku Kandara Police Station.
Dholuo: Konyo e kwondhori Yvonne Wanjiru, ndalo 10 mar Murang'a, ka gweno gi yore me St Charles Lwanga High School. Omiyo, teri kendo yore kadho e Kandara Police Station.
Somali: Baadhitaan ayaa socda si loo helo Yvonne Wanjiru, ardayda fasalka 10-aad ee ka socota Gobolka Murang'a oo lumay kadib markii laga jafay Dugsiga Sare ee St Charles Lwanga. Fadlan soo sheeg wax walba oo aad aragto oo ku saabsan. U dir warbixin ka timid Barkada Booliska Kandara.

English: The Directorate of Criminal Investigations (DCI) is investigating the death of a Grade 9 student at CITAM Schools Ngong. All community members are urged to avoid speculation during this time.
Kiswahili: Mkurugenzi wa Uchunguzi wa Makosa ya Jinai (DCI) anachunguza kifo cha mwanafunzi wa Kidato cha Tisa katika Shule za CITAM Ngong. Wanajamii wote wanasisitizwa kuepuka uvumi wakati huu.
Ekegusii: Abagere bure bachekanagirira Oria Okwanjire (DCI) nakioni okorori bw'ogori buse okoreri bw'ogotina kadogo Chikogo 9 naki CITAM Schools Ngong. Abaki chibori naki bokiri baki orianagirira oboki obokubere naki omorori.
Dholuo: Jok'ero ma kanyruok kanyaluok (DCI) nyaloyo koro kut jowinyo ka kelo chike e CITAM Schools Ngong. Jomoromo nyaka gimoro gi kanyalo chike ogendani yore.
Somali: Hey'adda Baarista Dembiyada (DCI) waxay baareysaa geerida arday fasalka 9-aad ah oo ka tirsan Dugsiyada CITAM ee Ngong. Dhammaan xubnaha bulshada waxaa lagu boorinayaa in ay ka fogaadaan maleyn iyo qiyaas xilligan.

English: All workers, parents, teachers, and students must understand that continuous learning is essential in the age of AI. Adapt and update your skills to remain relevant in the evolving job market.
Kiswahili: Wafanyakazi wote, wazazi, walimu, na wanafunzi wanapaswa kuelewa kwamba kujifunza bila kukoma ni muhimu katika enzi ya AI. Badilisha na sasisha ujuzi wako ili ubaki muhimu katika soko la ajira linalobadilika.
Ekegusii: Ababere, babi, abarimu, nakiogenda batoria obwakire buya bwakibori bweng'e buya ikiri mu gereka ya AI. Nakiogenda nakiobwensionye ahokore asuboria buni buya obwakire.
Dholuo: Ng'ato, mawuonyo, owadgi, kod mighta tigi nyalo yawi chiemo ni kuom joma dhok e chunya mar AI. Yienge kod bende bulu matindo gi bende ma oket gi nyaka nochiko mar dhok.
Somali: Dhammaan shaqaalaha, waalidiinta, macalimiinta, iyo ardayda waa inay fahmaan in barashada joogtada ah ay muhiim tahay xilligan ee AI. Diyaariyo oo cusboonaysii xirfadahaaga si aad ugu sii jirto suuqa shaqada ee isbeddelaya.

English: Amagoro Comprehensive School has lost 27 laptops valued at Ksh400,000 to theft, affecting over 1,000 students' digital learning. The community is urged to report any information regarding the burglary.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Upili ya Amagoro imempoteza kompyuta kibao 27 zenye thamani ya Ksh400,000 kutokana na wizi, huku ikihusisha kujifunza kwa kidijitali kwa wanafunzi zaidi ya 1,000. Jumuiya inaombwa kuripoti taarifa yoyote kuhusu wizi huo.
Ekegusii: Amagoro Comprehensive School ekegoro 27 laptops eria tseta Ksh400,000 naki robbery, omokiriri 1,000 sogori naki omong'ene ogokore. Ababere batarorere bakiere naki orokire gotigana khogotegana.
Dholuo: Amagoro Comprehensive School osebedo kod 27 laptops ma nyalo weche Ksh400,000 kendo okonyo, ibilonji 1,000 jotegno ma oket gi dhog piny. Jotegi ochiko nyisore kendo owete chandruok chieko.
Somali: Iskuulka Amagoro Comprehensive wuxuu lumiyey 27 laptop oo qiimahoodu yahay Ksh400,000 oo dhacay, taasoo saameyn ku yeelatay barashada dijitaalka ah ee in ka badan 1,000 arday. Bulshada waxaa laga codsanayaa inay soo gudbiyaan wax kasta oo macluumaad ah oo ku saabsan xadgudubka.

English: Parents of students at PCEA Mai-a-Ihii Booth Boys High School in Kikuyu, Kiambu County, are advised to ensure their children's safety and consider transferring them if needed, following allegations of abuse.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wa wanafunzi wa Shule ya Upili ya PCEA Mai-a-Ihii Booth Boys katika Kikuyu, Kaunti ya Kiambu, wanashauriwa kuhakikisha usalama wa watoto wao na kufikiria kuhamisha wanafunzi wao ikiwa ni lazima, kufuatia tuhuma za unyanyasaji.
Ekegusii: Abagi b’abarwaki b’amatongo kw’ PCEA Mai-a-Ihii Booth Boys High School mu Kikuyu, Kiambu County, boragani bwogekire omotondo bwabaki bwokogekire omogendi bwogekire, no boriango bwoba gotanga bakanose itaki boche boke.
Dholuo: Kikuyu, Kiambu County, e piny, koro nyira mar abiro miyo duto ma PCEA Mai-a-Ihii Booth Boys High School nyaka golo ni gima ma ok nyal bwogore. Koro nyaka wunyiso duto makinde owalre ni nyakalruok mane bende wacho.
Somali: Waalidka ardayda ku nool PCEA Mai-a-Ihii Booth Boys High School ee Kikuyu, Gobolka Kiambu, waxaa loogu talagalay inay hubiyaan badbaadada carruurtooda iyo inay tixgeliyaan in la wareejiyo haddii loo baahdo, kaddib markii la soo jeediyay eedeymo xadgudub ah.

English: All senior schools must register eligible Grade 10 learners for the Senior School-Based Assessments by July 30, 2026, through the SBA portal. Timely registration is crucial for eligibility.
Kiswahili: Shule zote za sekondari zinapaswa kuwasajili wanafunzi wa Kidato cha 10 waliofaa kwa ajili ya tathmini za Shule za Sekondari kabla ya tarehe 30 Julai, 2026, kupitia lango la SBA. Usajili kwa wakati ni muhimu kwa ajili ya ufaa.
Ekegusii: Masomo mang'anya ongaananaka buya bwakorane abantugori bakiita Grade 10 kuora kusiina bwakube ne Senior School-Based Assessments buya 30, 2026, oria mu SBA portal. Gekore bwakogenda buya buya bwokire buya egokire.
Dholuo: Ramba, ma kwaya senior miyo chike mwak 10 mane en chike no ng'ato manyien kuom Senior School-Based Assessments kendo iye kanyo nyalo thurwa nyaka 30, mwaka 2026, kuom SBA portal. Jotengo mar timbe en chike nyaka kata.
Somali: Dhammaan dugsiyada sare waa inay diiwaan geliyaan ardayda fasalka 10-aad ee u qalma imtixaanaadka Dugsiga Sare ee Ku Saleysan ilaa July 30, 2026, iyaga oo adeegsanaya portal-ka SBA. Diiwaangelinta waqtigeeda ayaa muhiim u ah u-qalmitaanka.

English: The community is urged to report any signs of domestic violence or child neglect to local authorities to help prevent tragic incidents.
Kiswahili: Jamii inasihiwa kuripoti dalili zozote za unyanyasaji wa ndani au neglect ya watoto kwa mamlaka za eneo ili kusaidia kuzuia matukio ya kusikitisha.
Ekegusii: Ababere batagwa naki buya bwose bwachoche bwomokang’ani omogore buya na boki mwomokang’ani bwogokiriga buya bwake.
Dholuo: Homa chike goyo kuom ber kendo mar joma mag ng'ato to ongeyo hibed ni ongi kod nyaka joma.
Somali: Bulshada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay warbixin ka bixiyaan calaamadaha rabshadaha qoyska ama dayacaadda carruurta maamulka deegaanka si loo caawiyo ka hortagga dhacdooyinka murugada leh.

English: The family of Kenya Medical Training College student Anne Adhiambo seeks justice following her suspicious death on July 7. Police investigations are ongoing.
Kiswahili: Familia ya mwanafunzi wa Chuo cha Mafunzo ya Tiba Kenya, Anne Adhiambo, inatafuta haki kufuatia kifo chake cha kushangaza mnamo tarehe 7 Julai. Uchunguzi wa polisi unaendelea.
Ekegusii: Ekiroto cha mwaki wa Onyanchiri ya Kenya Medical Training College, Anne Adhiambo, kinea bw'ogendire oria omogusii omobogoria buya kaigi na 7 chuka. Abatware ba abatoshanye kworagania.
Dholuo: Wang'ni mar Anne Adhiambo, owang' ni student kuom Kenya Medical Training College, owuon ji ma ohaler en mar heri duto ka juma 7. Okwong' pogruok kuom jaduong'.
Somali: Qoyska ardayda Kenya Medical Training College, Anne Adhiambo, ayaa raadinaya cadaalad ka dib markay ku geeriyoodey shaki leh 7-dii Luulyo. Baaritaanada booliisku waa socdaan.

English: The 2026 KSSSA national Term Two football games will take place in Thika, featuring new teams such as Tenwek Boys and Highway Secondary School.
Kiswahili: Michezo ya mpira wa miguu ya kitaifa ya Kipindi cha Pili ya KSSSA 2026 itafanyika Thika, ikijumuisha timu mpya kama Tenwek Boys na Shule ya Sekondari ya Highway.
Ekegusii: Maki 2026 KSSSA kietorori ya Term Mbiri ya bori boki naki Thika, naki abate bantekore oria Tenwek Boys na Highway Secondary School.
Dholuo: 2026 KSSSA ichuni mawuok tigi chieng' dhak gi dho football e Thika, nikech timbe chak ng'ato kuom Tenwek Boys na Highway Secondary School.
Somali: Ciyaaraha kubadda cagta ee KSSSA qaranka ee Term Two 2026 ayaa ka dhici doona Thika, iyadoo kooxo cusub ay ka mid yihiin Tenwek Boys iyo Dugsiga Sare ee Highway.

English: Kakamega High School has won the Western Region football championship and will represent the region at the KSSSA national games in Thika.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Kawaida ya Kakamega imeshinda mashindano ya soka ya Kanda ya Magharibi na itawakilisha kanda hiyo katika michezo ya kitaifa ya KSSSA Thika.
Ekegusii: Kakamega High School nakiore omokiri wa buya bw'ekegera bw'amaani na omokiri omogori bw'ekegera bwa KSSSA buya bw'ekekera Thika.
Dholuo: Kakamega High School obat kambi e Western Region kuonji e football championship kendo okonyo nyaka winjruok e KSSSA national games e Thika.
Somali: Dugsiga Sare ee Kakamega ayaa ku guuleystay tartanka kubadda cagta ee Gobolka Galbeedka wuxuuna matali doonaa gobolka ciyaaraha qaranka KSSSA ee ku dhacaya Thika.

English: Four schools in West Pokot County have received smart boards and laptops to enhance digital learning ahead of the Competency Based Education (CBE) rollout.
Kiswahili: Shule nne katika Kaunti ya West Pokot zimepata bodi za smart na laptop ili kuboresha ujifunzaji wa kidijitali kabla ya kuzindua Elimu Iliyotolewa Kulingana na Uwezo (CBE).
Ekegusii: Shule nane mu West Pokot County zioraishie smart boards na laptops buogotire omokore buya mu digital learning naki buongo bwa Competency Based Education (CBE).
Dholuo: Kanya in West Pokot County njima teri mar smart boards kod laptops kuom nyalo tho diji, to gima nyaka timo gi Competency Based Education (CBE) ma en mar otimre.
