Somali: Afarta dugsiyo ee ka tirsan Degmada West Pokot ayaa helay looshyo casri ah iyo laptopyo si loo xoojiyo barashada dijitaalka ah ka hor bilowga Barashada Ku Salaysan Aqoonta (CBE).

English: Report any suspicions of child sexual abuse immediately to the police, chiefs, or children's officers. It is mandatory to report; failure to do so is an offence.
Kiswahili: Ripoti ukiukaji wowote wa unyanyasaji wa kijinsia kwa watoto mara moja kwa polisi, wenyeviti wa kata, au maafisa wa watoto. Ni lazima kuripoti; kutokufanya hivyo ni kosa.
Ekegusii: Naki naki ogenda buya obware bwagendo bwokiri obwakiire buya, signa abashatani, naki abatechani baki. Naki ikirukire buya; kugendana na buya naki ikirukire oria.
Dholuo: Nyonj bura buo mar yong' gige gi chako gibuoyo kuom polisi, mayom, to kanyongo. Nitie kit kony, gi pinje kendo ok kony joma.
Somali: Inta badan in la soo sheegto shakiga ku saabsan xadgudubka galmada carruurta isla markiiba booliska, ciidanka tuulada, ama mas'uuliyiinta carruurta. Waa waajib in la soo sheego; diidmada ayaa ah dembi.

English: St. Paul's Nyankanda Secondary School is closed indefinitely due to a fire that destroyed the boys' dormitory. All male students must remain at home until further notice.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Sekondari ya Mtakatifu Paulo Nyankanda imefungwa mpaka taarifa nyingine itakapotolewa kutokana na moto ulioteketeza hosteli ya wavulana. Wanafunzi wote wa kiume wanapaswa kubaki nyumbani hadi taarifa zaidi itolewe.
Ekegusii: Chuo cha Nyankanda cha St. Paul kimefungwa bila ukomo kwa sababu ya moto ulioharibu hostel ya wavulana. Wanafunzi wote wa kiume wanapaswa kubaki nyumbani hadi arifa zaidi itolewe.
Dholuo: Chik St. Paul's Nyankanda Secondary School nyalo koro tinde piny kod ochak mar moto ma awacho nyari boys' dormitory. Waduogo waɗoni ohero kod aunga kendo oritumre buok.
Somali: Dugsi Sare ee St. Paul's Nyankanda wuxuu xiranyahay mudda aan la cayimin sababo la xiriira dab burburiyey hoyga wiilasha. Dhamaan ardayda ragga ah waa in ay ku sugnaadaan guriga ilaa ogeysiis kale.

English: Parents of students from St. Paul's Gekano Boys School are advised to await further communication from the Ministry of Education regarding the school's closure and reconstruction efforts.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wa wanafunzi wa Shule ya Wavulana ya St. Paul's Gekano wanashauriwa kusubiri mawasiliano zaidi kutoka Wizara ya Elimu kuhusu kufungwa kwa shule na juhudi za ujenzi mpya.
Ekegusii: Ababere b'abiogotari b'ogenda buchekere bwa St. Paul's Gekano Boys School barikwereka okire oria buya bwamokirire ogendani bw'ekegesori bwiinyaki bw'ekibokori naki bwekwete.
Dholuo: Makarokogi gi chike mag St. Paul's Gekano Boys School, yot puro wuok ni gomo kamano ka itimogo chula kera kendo kod kido mar Ministry of Education mag chula maikare e ntero kendo ruoth.
Somali: Waalidka ardayda ka tirsan Dugsiga Sare ee St. Paul's Gekano Boys waxaa lagu talinayaa inay sugaan isgaarsiinta sii socota ee ka imanaysa Wasaaradda Waxbarashada oo ku saabsan xiritaanka dugsiga iyo dadaallada dib-u-dhiska.

English: KNEC is recruiting qualified teachers to become examiners for the 2026 KJSEA and KCSE exams. Apply online and submit recommendations by the specified deadline.
Kiswahili: KNEC inatangaza nafasi za walimu wenye sifa kuwa wapima mitihani kwa ajili ya mtihani wa 2026 KJSEA na KCSE. Tafadhali omba mtandaoni na ushushe mapendekezo kabla ya tarehe iliyotolewa.
Ekegusii: KNEC naki omokire abaki bwakire banga omokireri bosi bwakore 2026 KJSEA na KCSE. Naki oria intore naki omokiri bwabwa asema bwakire buya.
Dholuo: KNEC ogi e yo mag ring'ni yaduokto duto ka wang'ni nyaka ombe examiners nam KJSEA mag 2026 e KCSE. Osebedo kuom inya online kendo in gi chiegni mar kan.
Somali: KNEC waxay shaqaaleyneysaa macalimiin aqoon leh si ay u noqdaan imtixaanqaadayaasha imtixaanaadka 2026 KJSEA iyo KCSE. Codso khadka tooska ah oo soo gudbi talooyinka ka hor waqtiga lagu xusay.

English: Parents are urged to address their concerns regarding school leadership and management directly to the relevant authorities rather than protesting on school grounds.
Kiswahili: Wazazi wanashauriwa kuelekeza wasiwasi wao kuhusu uongozi na usimamizi wa shule moja kwa moja kwa mamlaka husika badala ya kupinga kwenye maeneo ya shule.
Ekegusii: abaki bosi bakireri buya bamasinde bokenyie oborori ba shuleni naki babere abaki bosi bareturire buya bwagamo bamasinde.
Dholuo: Parents nyaka timo dwond ogenda ma okonyo chalo buo e konyruok gi joma nopondo, kendo to kelo yore chalo maket e duto mar oganda.
Somali: Waalidiinta waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay si toos ah ula xidhiidhaan mas'uuliyiinta khuseeya arrimaha hogaaminta iyo maareynta dugsiga halkii ay ku muujin lahaayeen cabashooyinka meelaha dugsiga.

English: Heads of Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) institutions must collect March 2026 examination results from New Mitihani House weekdays from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. after clearing any fee arrears. Results queries must be submitted online within 30 days or face a KSh5,000 penalty.
Kiswahili: Viongozi wa taasisi za Elimu ya Ufundi na Ufundi Stadi (TVET) lazima wakusanye matokeo ya mtihani ya Machi 2026 kutoka New Mitihani House siku za kazi kuanzia saa 2:00 asubuhi hadi saa 11:00 jioni baada ya kulipa madeni yote. Maswali kuhusu matokeo yanapaswa kuwasilishwa mtandaoni ndani ya siku 30 au kukabiliwa na faini ya KSh5,000.
Ekegusii: Abakiri bakiinyansa bu Technical na Vocational Education and Training (TVET) batura buya nakiere Mariko 2026 naki Moka Mitihani muriri tichenda na 8:00 mna 5:00 naki mioria buya bwana motigana buya obwena bwaki. Abaki bwaki bwanika buya buya buriri buya tie bwenyere buya naki 30. Obwaki bwaki bwanika buya buya okang’ana na KSh5,000.
Dholuo: Niachogo ma chiegni gi Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) en giyou mondo wach mar March 2026 kuom New Mitihani House maler gi pi 8:00 p.m. kadhi 5:00 p.m. nyaka owang'ni gin fee arrears. Kanyore ma wacho ni konyruok on online oyie ka 30 romb kite, ok nyalo chako gi KSh5,000.
Somali: Madaxda hay'adaha Tacliinta Farsamada iyo Tababarka (TVET) waa inay ururiyaan natiijooyinka imtixaanka Maarso 2026 ee New Mitihani House maalin walba ilaa 8:00 subaxnimo ilaa 5:00 galabnimo ka dib marka la bixiyo dhammaan daynka. Su'aalaha natiijooyinka waa in lagu soo gudbiyaa khadka tooska ah gudaha 30 maalmood ama keelid ah ciqaab dhan KSh5,000.

English: Kakamega School's football team, the Green Commandos, has advanced to the Western Region final. Supporters are encouraged to attend the final match at Kanduyi Stadium.
Kiswahili: Timu ya soka ya Shule ya Kakamega, Green Commandos, imefikia fainali ya Kanda ya Magharibi. Wafuasi wanahimizwa kuhudhuria mchezo wa fainali katika Uwanja wa Kanduyi.
Ekegusii: Chuo cha Kakamega, mteam wa soka wa Green Commandos, wamefika kwa fainali ya Mkoa wa Magharibi. Wapenzi wanahimizwa kuhudhuria mechi ya fainali katika uwanja wa Kanduyi.
Dholuo: Chak jok' Kakamega, Green Commandos, abiro konyo gi final ma okel ka Western Region. Jotendji en to chalo kuom match mar final e Kanduyi Stadium.
Somali: Kooxda kubadda cagta ee Iskuulka Kakamega, Green Commandos, ayaa u soo baxay kama dambaysta Gobolka Galbeed. Taageerayaashu waxaa lagu dhiirrigelinayaa inay ka soo qeybgalaan cayaaraha kama dambaysta ah ee ka dhacaya Stadium-ka Kanduyi.

English: Households in Siaya are urged to switch from unclean cooking fuels like firewood and charcoal to improve children's health and reduce respiratory illnesses.
Kiswahili: Familia katika Siaya zinashauriwa kubadilisha kutoka kwa mafuta machafu ya kupikia kama kuni na makaa ili kuboresha afya ya watoto na kupunguza magonjwa ya kupumua.
Ekegusii: Abaki baki bw'isi Siaya barengire gukombokere buya bui naki chabo na naki chaa imbire okogeya emosi buya bwakire oria buya.
Dholuo: Odhiambo e Siaya nyaka wa giwacho odhie koth kendo koth ikarok e tichu ma ok no gielo raw.
Somali: Qoyskii ku nool Siaya waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay ka beddelaan shidaalka aan nadiifka ahayn sida alwaaxda iyo kharashka si ay u hagaajiyaan caafimaadka carruurta iyo yareeyaan cudurrada neefsashada.

English: The Kenya Institute of Special Education (KISE) has trained Teachers Service Commission (TSC) officers to support inclusive education for learners with disabilities.
Kiswahili: Taasisi ya Kenya ya Elimu Maalum (KISE) imetoa mafunzo kwa maafisa wa Tume ya Huduma za Walimu (TSC) ili kusaidia elimu jumuishi kwa wanafunzi wenye ulemavu.
Ekegusii: Ishule ya Mwakilishi wa Maki (KISE) iligana na Watumishi wa Walimu (TSC) bwakire zoka buya buya kweria buya buya obwakire aaki abaki bware buya.
Dholuo: Kenya Institute of Special Education (KISE) oonge ni Teachers Service Commission (TSC) kuom tinye ji nyaka tedo e gige mar kata jowi gi chako.
Somali: Machadka Kenya ee Waxbarashada Gaarka ah (KISE) ayaa tababar u fidiyay xubnaha Gobolka Adeegga Macallimiinta (TSC) si ay u taageeraan waxbarashada dadka naafada ah.

English: Teachers Service Commission employees can register for the Public Service Superannuation Scheme (PSSS) by visiting the PSSS Member Portal and completing the sign-up process.
Kiswahili: Wafanyakazi wa Tume ya Huduma za Walimu wanaweza kujiandikisha katika Mpango wa Pensheni wa Huduma za Umma (PSSS) kwa kutembelea Tovuti ya Wajumbe wa PSSS na kukamilisha mchakato wa kujiandikisha.
Ekegusii: Abakonzi b'Aberega bu TSC bakwaniora kuingira mu Public Service Superannuation Scheme (PSSS) gworogoya ku PSSS Member Portal na bambarireki mu panzori ya kusign-up.
Dholuo: Makar ni Teachers Service Commission ok nyal chako kuom Public Service Superannuation Scheme (PSSS) nikech kuom PSSS Member Portal to in gi wacho wach koro.
Somali: Shaqaalaha Kormeerka Macalimiinta waxay isdiiwaan gelin karaan Qorshaha Hawl-wadeennada Adeega Dadweynaha (PSSS) iyaga oo booqanaya Portal-ka Xubinimada PSSS isla markaana dhamaystiraya habka isdiiwaan gelinta.

English: Victor Makanda is the new chairman of the Kenya Secondary School Heads Association (KESSHA) for the Nyanza region. School heads are encouraged to support him in his new role.
Kiswahili: Victor Makanda ndiye mwenyekiti mpya wa Chama cha Wakuu wa Shule za Sekondari Kenya (KESSHA) wa eneo la Nyanza. Wakuu wa shule wanahimizwa kumpa sapoti katika jukumu lake jipya.
Ekegusii: Victor Makanda ni omogaka omogendi buya wa Kenya Secondary School Heads Association (KESSHA) mwakinyanga ya Nyanza. Abere omokireri bosi baregeterera naki omogenda wamogori.
Dholuo: Victor Makanda en nyingi jodongo mar Kenya Secondary School Heads Association (KESSHA) yore Nyanza. Jodongo mudhika nyaka kuom ng'ato niya ma okwayo duto.
Somali: Victor Makanda waa guddoomiyaha cusub ee Ururka Madaxda Dugsiyada Sare ee Kenya (KESSHA) ee gobolka Nyanza. Madaxda dugsiyada waxaa lagu boorinayaa inay taageeraan isaga xilkiisa cusub.

English: Mombasa County has launched childcare programs at Mtongwe and Kisauni Technical Colleges to support young mothers in TVET and reduce dropout rates.
Kiswahili: Kaunti ya Mombasa imeanzisha mipango ya huduma za watoto katika Vyuo vya Ufundi Mtongwe na Kisauni ili kusaidia akina mama vijana katika TVET na kupunguza viwango vya kuacha masomo.
Ekegusii: Mombasa County omegana emonera yaki naki bw'egurani mu Mtongwe na Kisauni Technical Colleges oria bogenyaki nyakokere bosi buya bosi buya nyakokere kiroki.
Dholuo: Mombasa County niongo ohing' gima matindo kuom nyundo kod chike e Mtongwe gi Kisauni Technical Colleges to yore young mothers e TVET gi to tich jochungo.
Somali: Dowladda Mombasa waxay bilawday barnaamijyo daryeelka carruurta ah oo ka socda kulliyadaha farsamada ee Mtongwe iyo Kisauni si ay u taageeraan hooyooyinka dhalinyarada ah ee TVET oo ay hoos u dhigaan heerka ka bixitaanka.

English: A Kajiado man has been sentenced to 20 years in prison for defiling his 13-year-old stepdaughter. The convict has 14 days to file an appeal.
Kiswahili: Mwanamume wa Kajiado amepewa kifungo cha miaka 20 gerezani kwa kumuangamiza binti yake wa kambo mwenye umri wa miaka 13. Mfungwa ana siku 14 za kutoa rufaa.
Ekegusii: Mogaka wa Kajiado omokire omokiro ore 20 mwaki obokiragia otoko 13 omokiri. Omokiri ondoi 14 orio oreregebwaki omokirongi.
Dholuo: Pek wilawa mare 20 ng'ato kanyakla kuom gweny mar unyalo 13 mwarumo. Wilawa oyudo 14 nyakar kendo ahinya thoko.
Somali: Nin ka socda Kajiado ayaa lagu xukumay 20 sano oo xabsi ah kadib markii uu kufsaday gabar uu ka dhashay 13 sano. Xukunka ayaa leh 14 maalmood oo uu kaga dacwoon karo.

English: Highway Secondary School will represent Nairobi at the KSSSA National Games from July 28 to August 1 at M-Pesa Academy in Thika after winning the regional football title.
Kiswahili: Shule ya Sekondari ya Highway itawakilisha Nairobi katika Michezo ya Kitaifa ya KSSSA kuanzia Julai 28 hadi Agosti 1 katika Akademia ya M-Pesa huko Thika baada ya kushinda taji la mpira wa miguu wa kikanda.
Ekegusii: Highway Secondary School oserere na Nairobi buya KSSSA National Games buya July 28-Agosti 1 buya M-Pesa Academy Mosongari Thika buya omokira obwaki buya bushere bwanogori.
Dholuo: Highway Secondary School niki gote Nairobi e KSSSA National Games manok odhi e July 28 kendo August 1 e M-Pesa Academy Thika nyaka ogendini buo regional.
Somali: Dugsiga Sare ee Highway ayaa matali doona Nairobi ciyaartoyda KSSSA ee Qaranka laga bilaabo Luulyo 28 ilaa Ogosto 1 ee Akadeemiga M-Pesa ee Thika ka dib markii ay ku guuleysteen horyaalka kubadda cagta ee gobolka.
